title: Sr. Certification Designer, Data Center Certifications
descriptionHtml:
Are you an accomplished certification designer ready to shape the future of data center workforce credentialing through rigorous exam development, psychometric excellence, and data-driven program innovation across AWS’s global Data Center Communities?

AWS Data Center Learning’s mission is to develop the best data center workforce on Earth. The organization is responsible for providing training, certification, and career development pathways to all new and existing AWS data center employees worldwide. Our team is constantly looking to optimize the experience and provide our operations teams with a work-ready, credentialed workforce.

Our Certification team is seeking a Senior Certification Designer who moves beyond traditional assessment design and leads collaborative job-task analysis workshops to blueprint and build industry-leading certification programs. In this role you will act as a credentialing strategist, psychometric practitioner, and empathetic designer, partnering with cross-functional teams to build certification ecosystems that span exam development, item writing, blueprint design, credential management, and certification pathway architecture. This position requires consistent collaboration with Senior Leaders in Data Center Operations, Safety, Security, Logistics, Planning, Delivery, and other teams to design and deliver valid, reliable, and defensible certification programs. You will consult with technical subject-matter experts, apply psychometric principles and emerging technologies, and use data-driven iteration to produce certification experiences that drive measurable workforce capability outcomes.

We are looking for a professional who designs and delivers innovative certification solutions at scale. The ideal candidate will have proven mastery of exam development methodologies, job-task analysis, item writing best practices, psychometric principles, and credentialing standards (such as ISO 17024 or equivalent). You must be able to manage multiple complex certification projects simultaneously, mentor fellow designers, and drive the future certification development roadmap. The ideal candidate demonstrates ownership of outcomes, thinks big about scalable credentialing solutions, dives deep into psychometrics and operational challenges, and maintains the highest standards while moving fast to meet business needs.

As the Senior Certification Designer, you will represent our organization across Data Center Communities. This entails translating organizational competency frameworks into actionable certification strategies that balance rigor and agility: modular, scalable exam architectures that adapt to evolving workforce needs. Your role will require communicating at all levels of the organization, working with senior leaders, and building relationships across global time zones and geographies.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and manage end-to-end certification programs—from exam blueprinting and item development through field testing, standard setting, and credential maintenance.

- Facilitate job-task analysis workshops and apply competency-mapping principles to create defensible certification blueprints.

- Lead item writing workshops, guiding SMEs in developing high-quality exam items (multiple choice, scenario-based, performance-based) aligned to blueprint domains.

- Apply psychometric techniques (classical test theory, IRT, item statistics, standard-setting methodologies) to ensure exam validity and reliability.

- Use performance analytics and candidate feedback to iterate on exam design, optimize item banks, and demonstrate program quality.

- Lead cross-functional certification projects in matrixed environments, mentoring junior designers and raising credentialing standards.

- Design scalable, modular item banks and certification architectures supporting multiple credential levels, roles, and geographies.

- Manage the full certification lifecycle and communicate strategy alignment with senior leadership across Global Data Center Operations.

A day in the life
Your morning kicks off with a little detective work—diving into item bank analytics and pass/fail dashboards, hunting down those sneaky underperforming items with lousy discrimination indices or bias flags waving for attention. Next, you'll pop into strategic meetings with senior leaders from Data Center Operation, playing translator between "here's what's breaking in the field" and "here's what our certification roadmap needs to fix." By mid-morning, you're running a job-task analysis workshop with subject-matter experts—think: sticky notes flying, task criticality debates getting spicy, and knowledge requirements taking shape for a shiny new data center operations credential. After lunch (fuel up, you'll need it), you're leading an item writing jam session—coaching SMEs on crafting scenario-based questions that actually make people think, red-penning drafts for technical accuracy, and making sure everything maps back to those all-important blueprint weightings. Your afternoon? It's a choose-your-own-adventure: maybe you're wrangling a standard-setting panel for an updated cert form, geeking out over item-level psychometric reports with a senior psychometrician or teaming up with the learning experience crew to make sure prep resources and exam objectives are best friends. Through it all, you're the person holding the big picture and the fine details—making sure every certification that ships is valid, reliable, defensible, equitable, and actually measures the stuff that matters most for the workforce.

About the team
Our mission is to develop the best Data Center workforce on Earth. The AWS Data Center Certification team sets the trusted standard that empowers the world's most skilled data center workforce. We create rigorous, scalable certification programs that validate that builders within Data Center Operations demonstrate the technical competencies needed to work safely, securely, and effectively. The team designs credential pathways that span a builder’s entire career journey: from foundational role-based certifications and safety credentials to advanced operational qualifications for tenured employees. Our certifications provide individuals with meaningful, portable credentials and provide the organization with a verified, defensible record of workforce capability. Our work directly underpins the safety, availability, and operational excellence of AWS’s global data center infrastructure.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Technical Training, Design, or a related field
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5+ years of with Learning & Development and course facilitation experience
- Experience applying concepts of learning science, educational psychology, and instructional design principles to learning solutions
- Experience developing or delivering training programs across multiple sites or regions

descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team which is passionate about solving real world data management and governance challenges. Come build large scale distributed systems that are central to the next generation of analytics in the cloud.

AWS Lake Formation is a service that helps build and secure data lakes in a simple, scalable, server-less architecture. We are looking for software engineers to join our growing team!

As a Software Engineer in Lake formation you will:
- Solve unique and first-order problems in areas of Big Data, Distributed Systems, and Server-less data processing
- Influence and build products that will leverage scale of resources to orchestrate data management and governance
- Be catalyst to deliver a truly disruptive product while still early enough to have impact and influence

Key job responsibilities
- Translate functional and technical requirements into detailed architecture, design and extensible code
- Be an advocate of industry best-practices to produce reliable, fault-torrent and dependable code
- Code and test complex system modules; develop and leverage frameworks to be effective and efficient
- Participate in architecture, design and code reviews to maintain our high development standards
- Mentor other engineers, defining our challenging technical culture, and helping to build a fast-growing team

A day in the life
Morning coffee in hand, you dive into Slack to catch up on overnight discussions

By mid-morning, you're deep in code, building features that help customers wrangle petabytes of data without breaking a sweat. You might be designing a new orchestration framework, squashing a gnarly concurrency bug, or whiteboarding with teammates to architect a solution that scales elegantly from startup to enterprise.

After lunch, you join a design review where ideas fly freelyYou collaborate with partner teams across AWS (think Glue, S3, Athena) to ensure Lake Formation plays nicely in the broader analytics ecosystem.

During oncall, you hop on a call with a customer or solutions architect to understand a real-world data governance challenge. These conversations fuel your work, you're not just writing code; you're solving problems that help organizations unlock the value of their data securely and at scale.

Before wrapping up, you spend time mentoring a newer engineer, reviewing code, or spiking on a crazy idea that might just work.

You close your laptop knowing you've built something meaningful !

About the team
We are builders and data people that are obsessed with our customers and take-on big challenges. We support each other and encourage different views. We also like to have a bit of fun along the way.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Construction Manager, DCCD, DCCD
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


AWS is used by millions of users around the globe—from small start-ups to household names like Netflix and NASA—and AWS Support is one of the largest and fastest growing business units within AWS. Our team’s goal is to innovate and to improve customer success, trust, and experiences with both AWS products and with AWS Support.

Our team has the rare opportunity to support every service and every AWS account, and we are obsessed with creating exceptional customer experiences. Because of our team’s broad mission and scope, we need a talented, passionate senior product experience designer who can create elegant, intuitive user interfaces and who has strong ideation skills, robust holistic systems thinking, deep attention to detail, and passion for turning difficult tasks into simple and delightful experiences for customers.

We produce and support a range of tools that enable AWS Support engineers to diagnose and solve customer problems, and we also produce and support customer-facing tools that are used for self-service, monitoring, learning, and using AWS. We're looking for a talented, passionate senior user experience researcher to work on internal tools, like case management and engineering support, and external tools, such as the Service Health Dashboard, Personal Health Dashboard, Support Center, Knowledge Center, AWS Forums, and Trusted Advisor.

As a product experience researcher, you’re comfortable discussing methodologies with the research team, and are equally comfortable discussing project road maps with executive leaders. You thrive on creating metrics, prioritization rubrics and business impact for research - all while sharing and communicating them to peers outside of the research and design community. Your research insights shape the way the organization understands and builds for our customers. You will have a significant impact on the creative direction of AWS Support products with an emphasis on solving major challenges and shaping the success of the customer experiences of AWS customers, internal service teams, and AWS Support engineers worldwide. Come join us and help create world-class customer support experiences for AWS.

Build a research road-map; communicate and refresh on regular basis to ensure relevancy.
Identify best method or mix of quantitative and qualitative methods based on research questions, timeline and resourcing.
Build and continuously improve a robust and thoughtful approach to gather customer insights and collaborate with other research teams in Amazon to align on best practice.
Designing, conducting, and analyzing results from a variety of research studies including usability lab studies, remote research, field studies and survey design.
Recruit and schedule usability participants for research studies.
Provide direction and vision for evolving the role of research in product development; identify opportunities to increase efficiency and impact.
Build positive, collaborative relationships across User Experience Design, Product Management, and Development teams.
Synthesize a wide range of primary and secondary data types to perform quick and thorough analyses leading to focused, insightful, and actionable findings.
Successfully persuade decision makers at all levels of the organization to take aligned action on research findings – inspire them and help them internalize opportunities to delight customers and differentiate our service.
Develop insight-based knowledge management frameworks to drive decision-making and prioritization of investments.

Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Construction Manager will be responsible for construction project management and oversight of construction related activities as they relate to new builds or general capital projects which includes the ownership of the project scope, quality, schedule, and budget.


A day in the life
Some of the typical daily tasks of the Construction Manager:
Direct interface with construction general contractors during the bidding, award, execution, and project closeout/punch list phases.
Conduct negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids/proposals with detail and accuracy.
Create construction project scope and request for proposals.
Financial analysis of construction.
Construction project management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
Constructability reviews of electrical and mechanical designs associated with the construction of new data centers or optimization of existing data centers.
Construction document management including submittal review, RFI’s, change orders, and invoicing.
Construction project quality control.
Record and report key construction metrics to team members and management.
Drive teams to perform troubleshooting and root-cause failure analysis associated with equipment failures.
Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
Able to read and interpret construction specifications and drawings for all disciplines.
Define data center system-level architecture, specify/document performance and equipment requirements, create/communicate conceptual designs, and create/maintain project documentation.
Experience with large scale technical operations or large-scale compute farms.
Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, and OSHA.
Experience in controls and commissioning of large scale projects.
Experience with power management and power monitoring systems.
Certifications such as Professional Engineer (PE), LEED, and/or Certified Construction Manager (CCM)

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of construction management of large, complex projects involving large-scale mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) plants experience
- Knowledge of electrical engineering principles including switchgear, UPS, transformers, and circuit breakers

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
- Knowledge of critical data center equipment
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
- Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
- Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
- Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

title: Fleet Data Manager (Fixed-term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Fleet Procurement and Capacity Planning (FPAC) team manages a large-scale international commercial vehicle fleet across 10 European markets. This fleet depends on accurate, timely data flowing between two Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), Amazon's internal planning systems, and multiple cross-functional stakeholders.

This role owns the operational delivery and quality of all fleet data provided by FMCs (Ayvens and Arval) to Amazon. You will be the single-threaded owner ensuring that vehicle lifecycle data (from order placement through deployment, maintenance, defleeting, and remarketing) is delivered per contractual SLAs, meets validation standards, and flows reliably into the planning tools and reporting mechanisms that drive fleet capacity decisions.

This is a hands-on data operations and vendor management role. You will spend the majority of your time ensuring data reliability, resolving reporting failures with FMC technical contacts, and supporting the internal teams who depend on this data to make procurement and capacity decisions worth hundreds of millions in OPEX annually.

Please note that this is a 12 months fixed-term contract.

Key job responsibilities
1- Maintain Fleet Data Reliability
- Own the end-to-end data delivery relationship with Ayvens and Arval technical points of contact, ensuring reporting against established SLAs and contractual obligations
- Monitor, triage, and resolve data quality issues across SDR (Supply Delivery Reporting) and SRR (Supply Return Reporting) pipelines, including idle stock positions at VIN level
- Support Weekly Business Reviews and Variable Last Mile Rentals reporting cadences by ensuring upstream data is accurate and delivered on time
- Escalate systemic data failures through the appropriate FMC governance channels (Monthly Business Reviews, performance reviews).
2- Enable Planning Tools and Downstream Consumers
- Ensure data feeds into FORCE (Fleet Optimization, Requirement and Control Engine) and FAB (Fleet Allocation and Balancing) meet signal integration requirements
- Partner with the MAPS team (Mid-Term Planning) and Fleet Planning to resolve data gaps that block planning accuracy and automation
- Triage new data requests from internal stakeholders against existing data specifications; eliminate redundancy before placing additional requirements on FMCs
3- Drive Continuous Improvement

- Identify and implement process improvements to reduce manual data reconciliation effort
- Develop monitoring mechanisms to proactively flag reporting inaccuracies before they propagate into planning decisions
- Document and maintain the fleet data catalogue, including ownership, refresh cadences, quality thresholds, and known limitations
- Ensure any new fleet programs (LMR expansion, new country launches, Middle Mile integration) include data requirements in vendor agreements from the outset
4- Cross-Functional Coordination

- Align with Fleet Partnerships (FMC contractual owners), Fleet Deployment & Redeployment, Planning, and GFPA (Global Fleet Planning Analytics) on data priorities and dependencies
- Influence FMC behavior through performance metrics and contractual accountability rather than direct authority
- Represent data requirements in FMC governance forums (MBR/QBR)

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs

- Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience in an operational role

title: Sr. Program Manager, Fleet Accountability, DSP Compliance & Experience
descriptionHtml:
Our north star is zero incidents. We deliver results through our accountability flywheel—working backwards to generate actionable insights, creating and leveraging signals to proactively detect risk, and building high-quality mechanisms to change behavior and drive improvements.

Our organization operates globally across NA, EU, MENA, APAC, and LATAM, partnering with cross-functional teams including Global Fleet & Products, Global Road Safety, regional operations, and legal teams.

We are seeking a high-judgment Sr. Program Manager to lead Fleet Accountability. This role will be instrumental in establishing sustainable mechanisms to ensure DSPs maintain safe, functional vehicles across our complex fleet, directly impacting the safety and experience of thousands of DSP Delivery Associates (DAs) worldwide.

We are seeking a candidate who can dive deep into the details, invent scalable solutions, earn trust with cross-functional partners, insist on the highest standards for safety and compliance, and demonstrate cross-functional ownership by building long-term solutions across teams by working backwards from the customer.

Key job responsibilities
As the Sr. Program Manager for Fleet Accountability, you will partner across teams to own the strategy, execution, and scaling of fleet accountability programs across multiple regions.

• Diagnose Fleet Defects End-to-End: Work backwards from driver-reported vehicle issues and safety signals to identify root causes—whether they stem from process breakdowns, data pipeline gaps, misaligned incentives, or behavioral dynamics.

• Build Preventive System Controls: Identify where technology and process redesigns can prevent non-compliance without relying on downstream enforcement. Partner with tech teams to implement proactive mechanisms—such as real-time alerts, automated compliance triggers, or guardrails—that drive DSP action before violations occur.

• Own Fleet Enforcement Mechanisms: Once upstream foundations are validated, support the launch of Monitoring and Enforcement Plans (MEPs) for priority fleet compliance areas. Ensure mechanisms are scalable, data-driven, and integrated into our broader compliance infrastructure.

• Establish Safety Coverage Standards: Define and enforce vehicle condition standards across vehicle types, regions, and delivery programs. Create mechanisms to track compliance, close coverage gaps, and feed insights back into the accountability flywheel.

• Create Detection and Remediation Systems: Design signals and tracking mechanisms to proactively identify fleet safety risks—from HVAC failures to device malfunctions. Build remediation frameworks that drive DSP action and measure resolution effectiveness.

• Drive Leadership Alignment: Manage Director and VP-level reviews, building compelling narratives that frame fleet accountability within our broader compliance strategy. Drive crisp decision-making on prioritization, sequencing, and resource allocation.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing driver-reported vehicle defects to identify emerging patterns, then join a working session with fleet and technology partners to validate whether a data signal is measuring the right thing. After lunch, you could be building a business case for a system control that prevents non-compliance upstream, followed by a leadership review where you present your prioritization roadmap. No two days look the same—you will move fluidly between diagnosing root causes, designing scalable solutions, and driving cross-functional alignment across teams in various stages of maturity.

About the team
The DSP Compliance & Experience team ensures Amazon's Delivery Service Partners maintain the safety, compliance, and performance standards required across our last-mile network. We build monitoring systems that detect risk, enforcement mechanisms that drive corrective action, and self-service tools that give DSPs visibility into their compliance obligations. Our team manages this full lifecycle end-to-end—from identifying policy gaps, to building the mechanisms that change behavior, to delivering the tools DSPs use daily. You will work alongside program managers who own these workstreams while partnering cross-functionally with fleet, safety, operations, and technology organizations.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience working in a matrixed organization
- Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization

title: Principal Engineer, Nitro System, EC2
descriptionHtml:
EC2 is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer to drive technical excellence across our Nitro System organization. You will architect the future of EC2 virtualization, leading innovation in the Nitro Hypervisor, Instance Features including Nitro Enclaves and Confidential Computing, Nitro Card virtualization components, and the engineering of new EC2 Core Platforms—directly impacting millions of customers running workloads on AWS.

As a Principal Engineer, you will shape the technical strategy for one of the most critical systems in cloud computing, working at the intersection of hardware and software to deliver near bare-metal performance with industry-leading security. This role offers the opportunity to influence the architecture of systems processing billions of customer requests daily while mentoring engineers and driving cross-organizational technical decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and drive the technical roadmap for Nitro Hypervisor, Nitro Card components, and EC2 Core Platform engineering across multiple quarters
- Architect and implement Nitro Hypervisor features supporting new instance families across Intel, AMD, and Graviton processors
- Lead development of Nitro Card firmware bundles and system services running on virtualization hardware
- Participate in end-to-end technical delivery for new EC2 Core Platform bring-up, from hardware specifications through production deployment
- Design and deliver confidential computing capabilities including Nitro Enclaves, memory encryption, and cryptographic attestation
- Lead deep-dive investigations for complex production issues spanning hypervisor, firmware, hardware, and control plane interactions
- Mentor and grow engineers across multiple teams through code reviews, design reviews, and hands-on technical guidance
- Drive kernel upgrades to latest LTS versions while maintaining backward compatibility and minimizing downstream patch footprint
- Design qualification processes for new platforms ensuring high reliability and minimal annual failure rates
- Participate in on-call rotation providing expert-level support for production systems and drive operational excellence initiatives


A day in the life
As a Principal Engineer in the EC2 Nitro System organization, you will oversee multiple projects collaborating with internal and external organizations. Projects range from designing and launching next generation EC2 Core Platforms to building Nitro Hypervisor features, Nitro Card components, and confidential computing capabilities. You'll participate in day-to-day development, debugging, and release management to deliver customer value. Your work spans collaboration across time zones, including the US West Coast, engaging with Nitro Firmware, Launch, hardware engineering, control plane, and service teams. You'll balance hands-on technical work with strategic leadership through architecture reviews and mentorship.

About the team
The EC2 team builds the foundation of modern cloud computing, delivering the Nitro System that powers millions of instances globally. Our mission is providing customers with near bare-metal performance while maintaining industry-leading security. You'll collaborate with engineers across firmware, hardware, control plane, and service teams to solve complex problems at the hardware-software intersection—from hypervisor optimizations to confidential computing features protecting customer workloads. Based in Berlin, we're a global team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and sustainable engineering practices. You'll help customers run their most critical workloads securely and efficiently.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
- Experience in professional software development building scalable production systems
- Experience with systems programming in C/C++ or similar low-level languages
- Experience with systems software, embedded systems or distributed systems
- Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple teams
- Proficiency in software engineering practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience communicating with peers, technical teams, and senior management to collect requirements and describe technical designs
- Openness to leveraging AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and technical problem-solving

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with high-performance computing, real-time systems, or bare-metal optimization
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to present complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences

There are also a great range of benefits that make Amazon a great place to work, including our popular Dogs At Work program which has been proven to lower stress and boost morale and is now running successfully in our corporate offices around Australia.

Our commuter benefits scheme allows employees to save on the cost of getting to and from work while Amazon also offers subsidized health insurance for employees and their dependents on top of salary continuance (income protection), and life insurance.

Amazon has all kinds of jobs for all kinds of people, and prides itself on hiring individuals with all types of background and experiences and celebrates diversity of leadership and thought as a key component in its mission to create the most customer-centric company in the world.

You'll collaborate with our marketing or operations teams to develop category initiatives, troubleshoot challenges as they arise, and present recommendations to senior leadership. As a Category Growth Manager, you'll be part of a supportive environment where your ideas matter, your contributions are visible, and you'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve our customers. title: Program Manager, FSOE PM, JCFS
descriptionHtml:
オペレーション技術統括本部（英語名称JCFS: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions）はアマゾンジャパン オペレーション部門（JP Ops）の中核部門として、物流プロセスの設計・導入・改善に取り組むとともに、物流プロセスのベースとなる建屋の設計を最適化して、拠点の価値を最大化することに注力しています。

アマゾンジャパンは、商品をお客様に迅速に届けるための大規模拠点の立ち上げをリードするプロジェクトマネジメントをおこなうとともに、今までにない新しい建屋・設備に関するイノベーションやソリューションを生み出すことで、拠点の価値を最大化する活動を推進するSr Program Managerを探しています。
このポジションは、Amazon拠点の新規工事や改修工事のプロジェクトにおいて、社内ステークホルダーと連携してマスタープランの作成、予算管理、リスク管理をリードするプロジェクトマネジメントの役割を担います。そして、そのような下流の仕事に加え、政府や自治体といった法律や規制を司る社外ステークホルダーとネットワークを構築し、今までにない新しい建屋・設備に関するソリューションを生み出すことで、長期的にアマゾン拠点のコスト構造を改善していく上流のプログラムマネジメントの役割も担います。そのため、このポジションには、建屋・設備に関するプロジェクトの上流から下流までの幅広いフェーズにおいて、リーダーシップを発揮し、技術的視点で問題解決や改善提案を実行できる能力と経験が求められます。また、国内外ステークホルダーと電話会議や対面で業務依頼、交渉をするため日本語、英語によるコミュニケーション能力、プロジェクトメンバーとの定例会議におけるファシリテーション能力、プロジェクト進捗レポート作成のためのドキュメンテーション能力も必要です。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
-政府・自治体・業界団体といった社外ステークホルダーとのネットワーク・信頼関係を構築し、規制緩和・法改正の実現に向けた折衝・交渉をリードする。
-アマゾン拠点の新規工事や改修工事のプロジェクトマネージャーとして、スケジュールや予算のプランニングをおこない、実行段階において進捗管理とリスク管理をおこなう。
-規制・行政手続きに関わる課題を特定し、解決に向けた中長期のプログラムマネジメントをおこない、実現可能性の検証から施策の実行・定着までをリードする。
-拠点の安定したオペレーション体制を脅かすリスク（行政・近隣・法規制に起因するものを含む）を早期に特定・評価し、リスク低減に向けた関係者調整と対応策の立案・実行をおこなう。
-行政・自治体・近隣との折衝プロセスにおいて、社内ステークホルダー（経営層・法務・広報・オペレーション等）と連携し、組織横断的な対応体制を構築・維持する。


A day in the life
毎週のチームミーティングで、各メンバーの進捗や成果、優先する取り組み、サポートが必要な内容を確認しながら業務をおこないます。業務を進めるうえで何か迷うことがあれば、チャット、ビデオ通話、F2Fの会話を通して気軽に相談しながら、チーム全体でサポートし合います。フレックスが基本ですが、原則18時以降は会議やメールは行いません。有給消化率も高く長期休暇も、もちろん取得可能です。

About the team
アマゾンジャパンオペレーションのエンジニアリング部門として、大規模拠点の立ち上げや建屋・設備の改善によって、アマゾンジャパンの成長に直接影響を与える事ができます。そして、政府や自治体といった社外ステークホルダーとネットワークを構築し、法改正や規制緩和をおこなうことで、革新的なソリューションを生み出すダイナミックな活動をおこないます。また、社内経営層はじめJCFS各チームやファイナンス、調達部門等、様々なステークホルダーとの協業が必要なポジションです。海外のチームとも交流を持ち、相互のベストプラクティスの横展開を積極的に推進する事でアマゾン、アマゾンジャパン並びに自分自身の成長に繋げる事ができます。入社後はチーム全体で既存プロセス・知識の共有、トレーニング、日々の面談を行い、オンボーディングをサポートします。

Basic qualifications

- 大学の学士 または工学の修士号
- 政府や自治体を巻き込んだ渉外折衝業務に従事した経験
- 建設プロジェクトや新規ビジネスの立ち上げにおける 5年以上のリーダーシップおよびプロジェクト管理の経験
- 社内の部門横断的なチームと関わり、社外のパートナーを調整した経験
- MS Office (Word、Excel、Power Point) および CAD のオペレーションスキル
- 日本語と英語の口頭および書面によるコミュニケーション能力（ビジネスレベル）

Preferred qualifications

- MBA、修士号、またはエンジニアリング関連分野の高度な学位

title: Software Development Engineer, Ads Core Services
descriptionHtml:
Build the real-time, globally distributed platform that controls billing, budgeting, payments, and promotions for Amazon Advertising — processing multi-million transactions worth 100x in dollar value daily with millisecond SLAs, directly impacting the experience of advertisers worldwide. Your work powers the financial levers behind one of Amazon's fastest growing businesses.

The Iron Mountain platform is the singular system managing all advertiser-facing financial functions — billing, invoicing, accounting automation, budgets, promotions, payments, and Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) — in real-time while being transparent and auditable from the ground up. These systems serve Sponsored Ads worldwide across all advertising displayed on or off Amazon. With international expansion driving 10X traffic growth, you'll solve critical distributed systems challenges: building architecture that scales exponentially, maintains high availability with minimal downtime (where outages directly impact revenue and advertiser business), and guarantees millisecond response times for front-end advertiser experiences. Our team spans Bangalore, Seattle, and New York — truly global in spirit.

title: Indirect Tax Risk & Assurance Analyst, Intl Indirect Tax Controllership
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an Indirect Tax Risk & Assurance Analyst to join our International Indirect Tax Controllership (IITXC) team. This team operates as a core component of the Second Line of Defense (2LOD) within Amazon's Tax Governance, Risk and Assurance (GRA) Program, providing independent oversight, periodic assurance testing, and residual risk reporting across Amazon's international indirect tax operations.
You will perform control testing, extracting and analysing data, in order to assess the strength of controls in place to manage Amazon's indirect tax risks. Following data analysis, you will draw conclusions on accuracy and control effectiveness, collaborating with other teams to agree findings and remediation actions required. Testing will be routine and adhoc and involve working on extremely large data sets, requiring use of tools and AI to maximise testing impact at scale.
The role covers all regions excluding North America, with a primary focus on International Stores (Retail and Marketplace), and is expected to expand to all business lines in the future. You will be expected to enhance testing programs and methodology where improvements can be made.
This is an individual contributor role requiring VAT/indirect tax experience, strong analytical skills, and the ability to operate independently in ambiguous, multi-jurisdictional environments.


Key job responsibilities
•Operate recurring operational and transactional data extraction as part of 2LoD risk evaluation.
•Data analysis and manipulation of extremely large data sets, utilizing data analytical tools wherever possible.
•Data interpretation against expected results of assurance testing and working with other teams to assess the impact of findings on the risk profile.
•Overseeing the completion of actions set to remediate issues found within assurance testing, including generating associated metrics for leadership.
•Propose and implement additional testing plans based on outcomes of testing.
•Identify opportunities to enhance controls, monitoring approaches, and operational risk practices.
•Leverage and develop tools and AI to improve efficiency and enable assurance activities at scale.
•Consult with Tax Planning experts on indirect tax impact of findings identified during testing.



A day in the life

Basic qualifications

- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field, or a Bachelor's degree and experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Ability to analyze operational and transactional data to identify control gaps, weaknesses, or inconsistencies and formulate actionable risk mitigation recommendations.
- Strong interest in technology and AI; ability to work alongside technical colleagues on automated control design or GenAI-assisted assurance workflows.
- Experience operating in multi-jurisdictional environments within large organizations or commercial marketplaces with complex indirect tax obligations.
- Ability to communicate complex tax and risk findings clearly to both technical and non-technical (non-tax) audiences, including senior leadership.
- Experience working collaboratively and independently across functional boundaries with business operations, tax planning, tax compliance, internal audit, and risk/monitoring teams.
- Experience in large multinational business, with a significant portion in a VAT/GST planning, advisory, audit or assurance capacity, or 3+ years’ experience in global tax/law/accounting practice in indirect tax (VAT/GST) advisory or assurance.
- Good indirect tax awareness across multiple jurisdictions (focus on EU VAT legislation).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with assurance, control frameworks, or operational risk management, enabling effective review and validation of testing methodologies, evidence, and controls.
- Master's degree (LL.M., M.Sc.) in Tax or Law; professional qualification such as CTA, ADIT, ACA, or ACCA.
- Familiarity with SOX/internal controls testing, COSO framework, or similar risk and control methodologies.
- Experience with e-commerce, digital marketplace, or platform business models and the associated indirect tax complexities.
- Exposure to customs duties, digital services taxes, or withholding tax on digital transactions.
- Experience presenting to VP/Director-level stakeholders or external regulators and auditors.
- Project management experience or formal PM methodology (PMP, PRINCE2); ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and deliver to deadlines.

title: Manager – VAT Risk & Assurance, Amazon Tax Advisory & Planning Team
descriptionHtml:
The Manager – VAT Risk & Assurance will support the Senior Manager in reviewing, validating, and embedding VAT risk controls across business operations.

This role combines VAT advisory expertise with operational assurance to strengthen controls, enhance compliance, and support informed business decision-making.

The Manager will help operational teams de-risk VAT exposure by ensuring testing, evidence collection, and compliance assessments are robust, consistent, and aligned with regulatory, policy, and organizational requirements.

This role has option to be hired in Luxembourg, London or Manchester.

Key job responsibilities
• Review and validate operational assurance activities: Ensure all assurance work aligns with VAT requirements, regulatory expectations, and internal standards, providing independent validation of outcomes.
• Evaluate testing methodologies, evidence collection, and sampling approaches: Assess the robustness, appropriateness, and effectiveness of controls and assurance procedures, identifying any gaps or inconsistencies.
• Identify gaps, risks, or weaknesses in operational compliance: Analyse operational processes and transactional data to pinpoint areas of risk, providing actionable recommendations to mitigate VAT exposure.
• Collaborate with VAT advisory teams: Partner with VAT advisory colleagues to ensure outputs meet controllership expectations, translating technical guidance into practical operational application.
• Support continuous improvement: Drive enhancements to VAT processes, assurance practices, and operational risk controls, promoting efficiency, scalability, and consistency across multi-jurisdictional operations.
• Provide insights and recommendations to the Senior Manager: Deliver evidence-based observations and guidance to support strategic oversight, operational risk prioritisation, and decision-making.
• Challenge operational readiness and monitoring: Review SOPs, controls, and operational outputs to ensure consistency with VAT policy and governance expectations, highlighting issues for corrective action.
• Support issue identification and escalation: Maintain awareness of operational gaps or recurring issues, flagging systemic or high-risk matters to the Senior Manager for action.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of knowledge of VAT in EU/UK
- Experience tax advisory (excluding compliance)
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Extensive experience in VAT advisory or assurance, ideally from top-tier consulting/advisory firms (Big 4 or equivalent) or in large, highly regulated corporate environments.
- Strong technical knowledge of VAT legislation, with a track record of providing practical, business-focused advice to upport operational and strategic decision-making.
- Exposure to assurance, control frameworks, or operational risk management, enabling effective review and validation of testing, evidence, and controls.
- Experience operating in multi-jurisdictional environments, large organisations, or commercial marketplaces with complex VAT obligations

title: Risk Manager II, TSI SCI & Res-Q
descriptionHtml:
Millions of Selling Partners trust Amazon's marketplace to grow their businesses, and hundreds of millions of customers depend on us every day. Behind that trust is a network of systems, tools, and workflows designed to detect and resolve fraud and abuse at scale — and our team builds them.
We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will drive end-to-end program execution for risk reduction initiatives across TSI SCI and Res-Q. In this role, you will own cross-functional program delivery — building roadmaps, aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, and driving process automation to eliminate defects and improve operational efficiency at scale.
You will partner with engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams to define program scope, manage trade-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. You'll own root cause and preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects, drive process automation initiatives that reduce manual investigation effort, and ensure programs are delivered on time, at quality, and with measurable impact.
This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon protects seller and customer trust by combining structured program management with process automation expertise that fundamentally improves how our organization operates.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end program management for risk reduction initiatives — defining scope, building roadmaps, tracking milestones, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams.
• Drive cross-functional alignment across Risk Managers, Operations, Science, Legal, and Policy stakeholders to define program scope, prioritize features, and manage trade-offs — with defect elimination and operational efficiency as the primary lens.
• Identify, design, and implement process automation opportunities that reduce manual investigation effort, eliminate repetitive workflows, and improve investigator productivity — partnering with engineering teams to translate operational pain points into automation solutions.
• Own root cause / preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects — when defect pattern analysis reveals recurring failure modes, document root cause findings, define preventive actions with measurable closure criteria, and track implementation through to validated defect elimination.
• Build and manage program roadmaps for automation and process improvement launches, tracking dependencies, identifying risks, and driving escalation management across multi-team initiatives.
• Conduct defect pattern analysis to identify systemic abuse trends, process gaps, and opportunities for automation coverage expansion — translating findings into prioritized program requirements.
• Lead escalation triage for program-impacted workflows — rapidly diagnosing whether issues stem from process gaps, system failures, or policy misalignment, and routing to the appropriate team with clear severity assessment and remediation path.
• Define and instrument success metrics to measure program impact, automation coverage, defect escape rates, process cycle time reduction, and seller experience improvement.
• Drive process improvement initiatives using structured methodologies (DMAIC, Kaizen, or equivalent) mapping current-state workflows, identifying waste and bottlenecks, and implementing scalable solutions.
• Manage stakeholder communication and program governance - preparing and presenting program updates, launch readiness reviews, and impact assessments to senior leadership, quantifying the value of risk reduction investments.
• Own change management for new process launches and automation deployments — ensuring smooth adoption across operations teams through documentation, training, and feedback loops.
• Conduct deep dives into escalation data, process metrics, and system gaps to identify launch blockers and ensure seamless program implementation.

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing program dashboards and defect metrics — checking milestone progress, flagging blockers, and identifying where process automation can reduce manual effort. You'll meet with investigators and Risk Managers to understand which workflows are creating friction and translate those insights into program requirements.
You'll drive sprint planning and stakeholder alignment meetings — prioritizing initiatives by defect elimination impact and operational efficiency gains. You'll analyze escalation data to spot systemic issues that process automation should solve, and work with operations leaders to validate that deployed solutions are actually reducing investigation workload.
Your week includes cross-functional program reviews with Science, Legal, Operations and Policy, launch readiness assessments, RC/PA deep dives on systemic defects, process mapping workshops for automation opportunities, and presenting program progress at WBRs and MBRs.

About the team
The Res-Q team operates as the central command for abuse-related escalations, conducting investigations and driving systemic improvements across Amazon's global stores. Through our various intake channels, we handle the most complex and sensitive cases that require expert judgment and cross-functional coordination.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 2+ years of experience in risk management, trust & safety, fraud prevention, or marketplace integrity domains
- Experience driving process automation or process improvement initiatives that delivered measurable operational efficiency gains
- Experience managing programs across technical and non-technical teams with competing priorities
- Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision making
- Experience with defect analysis, root cause investigation, and structured problem-solving methodologies
- Experience writing program requirements, process documentation, and stakeholder communications
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with interdependencies

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with process automation tools, workflow orchestration, or RPA (Robotic Process Automation) platforms
- Experience defining and tracking program metrics, and driving data-informed prioritization
- Experience launching automation solutions that directly reduced operational defect rates or manual investigation workload
- Strong written and verbal communication skills to influence technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies and sprint-based delivery
- Experience with change management and driving adoption of new processes/tools across operations teams

title: Finance Manager, Amazon Business Finance
descriptionHtml:
Entering the business to business (B2B) market is one of Amazon’s most exciting growth opportunities and since launching in 2015, Amazon Business (AB) already has more than 6 million customers WW. We are growing fast, and require talented finance professionals to help us scale.

Amazon Business is hiring a Finance Manager to support the WW Small Business team. You will partner with key business leaders to identify opportunities to drive growth, provide timely analysis, insightful guidance, and financial leadership. This role will lead the finance activities, create scalable reporting mechanism and analysis including creating new frameworks required to grow Small Business spend.

AB Finance offers a rich learning experience and an opportunity to develop professionally. We are a young business, and you will be challenged to weigh in on decisions that have long-term strategic impact, and to produce insightful analytics that help us accelerate growth. You will work closely with business partners and get exposure to senior leaders, and become a subject matter expert. We are looking for individuals who can engage business partners to drive results and who welcome the challenge of building structure and supporting high growth.


Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the Finance Business Partner to the Small Business customer segment. Partner with key stakeholders across the US, EU and JP.
- Solve complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, business insights, and recommendations that deliver results, drive improvements, and influence leaders
- Own customer acquisition and engagement mechanisms within WW Small Business Finance
- Influence business decisions with effective verbal and written communication, data driven analysis and modeling, and presentation of options and alternatives
- Perform financial reporting, ad-hoc data analysis, and financial modeling using a broad range of tools including Excel, SQL, and Cognos

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 7+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 7+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- Experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience performing ad hoc analysis using advanced Excel

title: Senior Manager, Global Automotive Sales
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a Senior Manager, Global Technical Sales to lead a team of enterprise sales professionals supporting our most strategic automotive OEM customers headquartered in Japan. In this role, you will manage and develop a team of Senior Account Managers and Global Account Managers responsible for driving revenue growth, cloud adoption, and AI transformation across Japan's iconic automotive manufacturers.

You will set the sales strategy for your segment, coach your team through complex deal cycles, and personally engage at the CXO level to unlock transformational business outcomes. You will bring deep domain knowledge in the automotive OEM landscape and the ability to navigate Japanese business culture at the most senior levels, requiring native-level fluency in Japanese and professional fluency in English.


Key job responsibilities
•Sales Leadership: Directly manage, coach, and develop a team of quota-carrying Account Managers and Global Account Managers focused on Japanese automotive OEMs.
•Revenue Ownership: Own the aggregate revenue target for the automotive OEM segment in Japan/APJ. Drive pipeline generation, deal progression, and forecast accuracy across your team.
•Sales Strategy: Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for AWS within Japan's automotive OEMs, aligning with global account plans and the broader AWS Industries direction.
•Executive Engagement: Build trusted advisor relationships with CXOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, and business leaders at Japan's leading automotive manufacturers — conducting engagements in Japanese at the executive level.
•AI & Cloud Adoption: Champion AI transformation with OEM customers, articulating how AWS technologies address use cases including software-defined vehicles (SDV), ADAS, connected car, autonomous driving, smart manufacturing, digital twins, and Industry 4.0.
•Cross-Regional Coordination: Partner with counterparts in North America and EMEA to ensure seamless customer coverage for Japanese OEMs with worldwide operations. Coordinate global account strategies and joint engagement plans.
•Deal Leadership: Personally engage on large, complex opportunities. Shape deals to meet customer needs, ensure optimal resourcing and product mix, and resolve escalations.
•Talent Development: Recruit, hire, onboard, and retain top sales talent. Raise the bar through coaching, performance management, and career development.
•Orchestration: Leverage extended resources, Solutions Architects, Specialist Sales, Professional Services, Partners, Marketing, and Support to deliver holistic customer outcomes. You orchestrate these teams but do not directly manage them.
•Customer Advocacy: Represent the voice of the customer back to AWS service teams via product feature requests (PFRs) and executive sponsorship requests.
•Mechanisms & Scale: Build repeatable sales plays, executive engagement frameworks, and pipeline management mechanisms that scale across the team.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, including direct quota-carrying roles
- 5+ years of front-line sales management experience leading quota-carrying account managers or sales executives
- Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in a complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environment
- Business-level fluency in Japanese (native or JLPT N1+) required for executive customer engagement
- Professional fluency in English (CEFR C1 or equivalent) required for cross-regional collaboration, internal leadership forums, and global account coordination
- Experience building and influencing relationships at the C-level of large enterprise customers
- Experience creating long-term transformational account strategies to drive enterprise-wide technology adoption at multinational automotive OEMs

Preferred qualifications

- BA/BS in Engineering, Business, or Computer Science, and/or MBA
- Deep domain knowledge in the automotive OEM industry including trends such as SDV, electrification, ADAS, connected car, and smart manufacturing in the Japanese market
- Direct experience selling into Japanese automotive OEMs
- Understanding of how AI/cloud is transforming OEM operations from R&D and manufacturing to supply chain and customer experience
- Experience managing global account teams across multiple geographies with proven cross-regional collaboration
- Track record of large, complex deal negotiations, including enterprise agreements and multi-year commitments
- Strong business acumen with the ability to translate cloud/AI capabilities into business value for automotive executives

title: Investigation Specialist II , Global Product Verification (GPV)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Product Verification (GPV) team is Amazon's premier product authentication and verification team, protecting marketplace integrity through comprehensive product verification systems. We specialize in seller verification, strategic product procurement, and implementing comprehensive authentication standards. By focusing on PQ metrics, we tackle critical challenges including counterfeit prevention, expiration compliance, and product condition accuracy. Through collaborative partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, we ensure Amazon remains the most trusted destination for authentic products worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
As a GPV Investigator, you will be part of a team responsible for inspecting and auditing products sold by third-party sellers on Amazon.com store for various defects impacting Amazon’s customers. You will leverage various tools (microscopes, x-ray, et al), systems, standard operating procedures and job aids to assist in identifying product quality defects across a range of programs.The below are key areas of responsibility of this role:
* You will be expected to meet weekly investigative targets established by leadership.
* You be expected to meet weekly quality assurance goals as defined by leadership.
* You will also identify opportunities to improve our internal processes and procedures to help streamline our day-to-day operations.
* You will work closely with leadership and Sr. Investigators in identifying tends and themes to assist our internal customers, Product Quality stakeholders, in driving upstream improvements in Seller quality metrics, and overall cx.



A day in the life
As a GPV Investigator 2, here's what your typical day-to-day activities look like:
* Conduct product investigations
* Follow established investigation procedures
* Focus on low to medium complexity issues
* Update investigation tracking systems
* Attend team meetings
The role focuses on building expertise in Global Product Verification (GPV) investigation techniques, which involves verifying that products meet global quality standards, analyzing product deviations, conducting product investigations across international markets, and contributing to GMP compliance and the overall quality system.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of quality assurance engineering experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
- Experience working with computer and web based tools
- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel
- Experience analyzing large datasets and translating them to actionable business insight

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
- 2+ years of fraud/risk investigations experience
- 2+ years of implementing metric-based strategies utilizing continuous improvement concepts, or 3+ years of fraud identification and detection, investigation and analysis for root causing and providing suitable preventive mechanisms experience

title: Network Development Engineer, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Core Networking team is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our Backbone Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) team. Network Development Engineers partner with our broader Infrastructure organization on configurations standards and tools, and collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, and also deploy and sustain networking software tools.

AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. We own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking's goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.

Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers perform high quality network and/or systems operations, deployments, scaling, technology refresh, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allow us to scale at higher volume.
• Lead network projects in the areas of network sustaining engineering, network deployment/implementation, network scaling, technology refresh, best practices application, and/or network optimization.
• Sustain Amazon Web Services’ next generation networks for significant AWS customers by providing critical network support to diagnose, mitigate impact, and resolve large-scale networking events.
• Operate and troubleshoot network routing, interconnectivity, platforms, performance, and configurations issues; including necessary low level application interaction, Unix systems, and new age networking software tools.
• Partner with our broader Network/Infrastructure organization in the areas of network engineering, configurations standards, and tools.
• Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
• Maintain standards across the networking toolset and ensure that we are fully compliant to those standards and policies.
• Deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes.
• Create and review documentation and process regarding network. implementation/deployments, recurring issues, new standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer material, etc.

A day in the life
• Work in a 24x7 team on call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.


About the team
Within AWS Networking, the Backbone, Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is
responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure
that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations.
BERE provides the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a
network that grows by 70% annually. In addition, they have teams that are responsible for the design
and operation of our global corporate office and data center network, allowing tens of thousands of
Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

EEO/Accommodations
AWS is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace to deliver the best results for our customers. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status; we celebrate the diverse ways we work. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please let us know and we will connect you to our accommodation team. You may also reach them directly by visiting please https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/us.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of major internet routing protocols experience
- 4+ years of working in a Linux/Unix environment experience
- 4+ years of automation scripting using Python, Bash, Shell and/or Perl experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of scripting languages (bash, python, etc.)
- Thorough understanding of TCP/IP networking, IP routing, Server Load Balancing, and Network Security architecture and core technologies such as IP, TCP, OSPF/IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Server Load Balancers, Firewalls, ACLs, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, LDAP, NFS, etc.
- Experience with one or more of the following routers, server load balancer, and firewall vendor platforms: Cisco, Juniper, Alcatel-Lucent, Arista, Brocade, Extreme, Citrix, F5, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.

title: Bi-Lingual Support Engineering Operations Manager , LEO Enterprise Customer Support
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking an experienced Support Engineering Manager to lead escalations and incident management team. This role combines technical leadership with operational excellence to ensure seamless handling of complex customer escalations and major incidents. The ideal candidate will build and lead a high-performing team responsible for resolving critical technical issues across our satellite network infrastructure, while maintaining the highest standards of customer satisfaction.

As the Escalations & Incident Team Manager, you will partner in implementing incident response protocols, managing critical customer escalations, and ensuring rapid resolution of complex technical issues. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams including, Engineering, and Product teams to drive technical solutions and prevent recurring issues. Your team will serve as the escalation point for our most challenging technical problems, requiring you to balance tactical incident response with strategic improvements.
This position demands strong technical acumen leadership skills, and the ability to make critical decisions impacting customer endpoints.
Success in this role requires a leader who can thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrate technical expertise in satellite communications or networking (AWS TGW, VPC NETDEV), and maintain composure during critical incidents. You'll be expected to continuously improve our incident management processes, mentor team members, and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization.

This role can be based in Cork or Dublin.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead and develop a team handling high-severity technical escalations and major incidents
• Establish and maintain continuous escalation support with balanced workload distribution across all shifts, including escalation matrices, incident response protocols, and resolution SLAs.
• Drive root cause analysis for critical incidents and implement preventive measures
• Oversee incident communication processes and stakeholder management
• Collaborate with NOC, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve complex technical issues
• Manage incident response team capacity and skill development
• Ensure timely resolution of escalated issues and high customer satisfaction
• Develop and maintain incident management playbooks and procedures
• Role requires flexibility to work in a 24x7 operational environment, including rotating shifts and participation in on-call rotation for critical escalations outside regular business hours
• Must coordinate coverage across multiple time zones and be available for major incident management during off-hours, ensuring continuous support and balanced workload distribution across all shifts
This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing IT environments on behalf of customers
- Experience in managing IT environments on behalf of customers
- Professional fluency in English and at least one of the following: French, German, or Spanish
- Experience with operational metrics (SLA adherence, CSAT, MTTR) to drive support team performance

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Experience driving projects to improve operations and support-related processes
- Experience handling large enterprise technical customer escalations

title: Loads and Dynamics Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

To deliver on that mission, Amazon is looking for talented candidates who combine superb technical, research and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively. We’re looking for people who innovate and love solving hard problems and building hardware. You will work hard, have fun, and make history!

Key job responsibilities
- Perform structural/dynamic loads analyses, and multi-body dynamic simulations for subsystem and vehicle level trades.
- Contribute to spacecraft structural/dynamics test planning, equipment and instrumentation selection, and data acquisition.
- Perform analysis using FEA models for all vehicle states: GSE/transport, launch vehicle (stowed), on-orbit states (dispensing, deployments).
- Pretest simulations, response limiting/notching definition, and post-test data analysis and correlation/validation of analytical model.
- Work with GNC team to deliver linear modal models of principal structural disturbance responses to the integrated flight simulation & similar analysis tools.
- Verify compliance with launch vehicle requirements

A day in the life
Loads and Dynamics engineers are responsible for spacecraft level loads analyses across the entire spacecraft life cycle (concept and configuration development, design, test, validation, qualification, and in-service operations). Our engineers work closely with many other technical disciplines and organizations to integrate solutions to complex engineering problems and have both large impact and high visibility.

About the team
As part of a small, passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will provide technical expertise and analytical solutions to support the development and qualification of for various spaceflight systems.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- 3+ years of experience in dynamic analysis and testing (modal, random vibration, shock, and/or acoustics)
- 3+ years experience with finite element analysis NASTRAN (or equivalent)

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of experience with model preparation delivery and interpretation of results for coupled load analysis, including experience with component modal synthesis reduction techniques, such as Craig-Bampton
- 3+ years of experience in on orbit disturbance modeling and multi-body dynamics
- 3+ years of experience with modal testing and correlation of hardware
- Masters in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or related field
- Demonstrated experience in several of the following areas:
- Experience with full vehicle qualification for flight
- Experience testing components and vehicles
- Dynamic analysis with MSC ADAMS or Wave6
- Programming skills in Matlab/Python
- Knowledge of FEMAP, IMAT and Matlab
