title: Project Engineering Manager, AMZL Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. Amazon is looking to hire an experienced, innovative, hands-on, and customer-obsessed Project Engineering Manager that can drive innovation, standardization and expansion in the Amazon logistics (AMZL) network.

As a member of the MEU Field Engineering team you will be responsible for managing a broad range of exciting deployment projects including new launches, Automated solutions, Material Handling Equipment (MHE) re-layouts and other building retrofit improvements.

Key job responsibilities
- Managing highly complex concurrent projects related to the deployment of engineering solutions in delivery stations of MEU Amazon Logistics (AMZL) network
- Owning a program or a portfolio of projects related to launches or retrofits of different technology types including Automation, Material Handling Equipment or other building improvement projects
- Leading the whole project/program lifecycle from concept and budgeting creation to handover at completion to relevant stakeholders
- Handling independently or with minimal guidance different tactical phases of the projects/program. This may include dealing with substantial constraints related to resource allocation, capex and timelines linked to business requirements
- Interacting with Senior level management across different functions to provide trade off solutions that satisfy potential conflicts
- Identifying inefficiencies of processes or standards within the allocated country or at European level and proactively leading improvements with the relevant teams


A day in the life
You will plan and manage execution of engineering projects in AMZL delivery stations primarily across MEU or EU if required. Your day could include cross-functional engagement within the organization to agree program strategy, attend the site to monitor deployment progresses, plan and manage resources to execute activities according to business goals, enable efficient mechanisms to handover to customers. You will make strategic decisions on behalf of the business and see the outcome come to fruition through coordination of stakeholders, both internal and third party, and finally celebrating in the successful launch of the project… Day One for all of us!

About the team
The MEU Field Engineering team is comprised of a talented and diverse group of project and program managers who drive coordination of all activities required to safely build complex solutions across the AMZL network. Our team puts a high value on work-life harmony and we are dedicated to developing and supporting our new team members. We care about your career growth, so we assign projects based on each individual's development. Our team is intentional about building a climate where respect, equity and positive recognition of differences are cultivated as we think it is the best environment to foster innovation.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent
- Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders
- Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and process improvement methodologies
- Speak, write, and read fluently in German and English at C1 level or above
- Working experience in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering or equivalent
- Working experience as Project Manager of multiple complex projects or as Program manager
- Working experience in managing project/program lifecycle on cross-functional aspects (i.e. Budget creation, vendor tendering, execution, handover to customer mechanisms etc.)
- Proficiency in planning and analysis tools: Excel & Microsoft Project or similar
- Proficiency in engineering design tools: AutoCAD or similar

title: Risk Specialist II , TERA
descriptionHtml:
Risk Specialist II, TERA (Travel and Expense Reimbursement Audit)

Amazon's Finance Operations Risk Management Services is seeking a Risk Specialist II to join our Travel and Expense Reimbursement Audit (TERA) team within Accounts Payable. In this Individual Contributor role, you will own the execution of risk, audit, fraud detection, and process improvement initiatives across a dynamic global business environment.

You will work independently and cross-functionally with business teams, process owners, product teams, and technical teams to identify risks, investigate potential fraud and financial abuse, strengthen controls, and develop scalable solutions that improve controllership and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and investigative skills with experience in audit, expense compliance, fraud/risk management, or accounts payable. You should be comfortable working with large datasets, performing deep dives, identifying root causes, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
Key Responsibilities

Execute pre- and post-reimbursement audits to identify and prevent potential fraud, abuse, waste, policy violations, and financial risks at the earliest possible stage.

Independently conduct risk assessments, audits, deep dives, investigations, and special projects related to employee expense reimbursements and corporate card spend.

Analyze expense and transaction data to identify anomalies, patterns, emerging risks, control gaps, and potential fraudulent activity.

Perform root cause analysis on identified defects and risks and translate findings into actionable recommendations and sustainable control improvements.

Develop and implement data-driven and automated solutions using tools such as Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, Tableau, or similar technologies to improve risk detection and reduce manual effort.

Identify opportunities to improve automated expense audit mechanisms, including increasing detection accuracy and reducing false positives.

Review employee expense reimbursements and corporate card transactions for compliance with Amazon's Travel and Expense policies, corporate card policies, and Business Code of Conduct.

Investigate complex or unusual transactions and clearly document the risk, evidence, root cause, financial impact, and recommended remediation.

Identify gaps in existing fraud prevention and detection mechanisms and risk assessment methodologies, and drive initiatives to address those gaps.

Design, implement, and standardize audit procedures, SOPs, process controls, and mechanisms that improve consistency, efficiency, and defect detection.

Own assigned projects and workstreams end-to-end, including defining objectives, developing project plans, analyzing data, coordinating stakeholders, implementing solutions, and measuring outcomes.

Conduct process walkthroughs, evidence reviews, quality reviews, and deep dives to resolve complex risk and compliance issues.

Communicate audit findings, risk insights, trends, and recommendations clearly to business, product, operations, and technical stakeholders.

Influence stakeholders without direct authority to adopt recommended controls, process improvements, and best practices across global teams.

Partner with product and technical teams to identify opportunities for scalable technology and automation solutions that strengthen expense risk controls.

Provide data-driven input into the FinOps Cards & Expense automated audit roadmap, with a focus on improving fraud detection accuracy and reducing false positives.

Monitor implemented controls and mechanisms to assess their effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Proactively identify emerging fraud, abuse, waste, compliance, and operational risks and recommend appropriate preventive or detective controls.

Basic Qualifications

MBA/Postgraduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, or a related field and/or professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE).

7+ years of relevant professional experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, forensic investigation, accounts payable, expense audit, fraud detection, or a related field.

Strong experience in data analysis using tools such as Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, or similar analytical technologies.

Demonstrated experience independently owning complex projects, audits, investigations, or process improvement initiatives from problem identification through implementation.

Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in expense reimbursement audit, internal audit, corporate card risk/fraud, financial investigations, forensic accounting, conflict-of-interest investigations, or related risk and compliance functions.

Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Chartered Accountant (CA), or equivalent professional qualification.

Strong forensic data analysis skills, with experience using SQL or Python and visualization tools such as Tableau or QuickSight.

Experience developing automated controls, audit mechanisms, fraud detection rules, or data-driven risk monitoring solutions.

Strong understanding of fraud risk management, internal controls, audit methodologies, financial risk, and root cause analysis.

Experience working with large datasets to identify anomalies, trends, control weaknesses, and potential financial risks.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex risk findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize multiple high-impact initiatives, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous situations.

Experience partnering with business, operations, product, and technical teams to implement scalable risk and control solutions.

Ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of controls and process improvements without direct authority.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience establishing successful partnerships with internal and external teams to execute tactical initiatives or equivalent
- 4+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
- Experience with research and investigation skills or equivalent
- 4+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience handling confidential information

Preferred qualifications

- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with SQL and Excel
- 5+ years of fraud identification and detection, investigation and analysis for root causing and providing suitable preventive mechanisms, or 2+ years of security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, or law enforcement experience
- Experience leading prioritization of tasks, team scheduling, time management, and meeting deadlines
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner

title: ProServe Partner, Programs, ProServe Partner Organization
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

Would you like to be part of a team that is redefining the Cloud industry by driving measurable AWS revenue growth through strategic partner-led customer acquisition? Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) has identified a $137M incremental ARR opportunity in thousands of existing AWS customers with high-growth attributes who have never had a ProServe engagement. We are looking for a world-class PPO ProServe Account Executive to own and drive our partner ecosystem in generating and converting this pipeline at scale.

As a PPO ProServe Account Executive within the ProServe Partner Organization (PPO), you will own and drive the strategic relationships and operational cadence with select Partners in our partner network such as Accenture, EPAM, Deloitte, Slalom, Thoughtworks, Kyndryl, and Effectual. The Program leverages Partner reach and scale to generate ProServe pipeline from a curated cohort of ~6,800 high-growth-potential AWS customers. You will drive partner accountability for account coverage, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and conversion. This is a strategic partner management, pipeline generation, and deal acceleration role, not a cloud delivery role.

This role reports directly to the Sr. ProServe Partner Leader, and operates within the ProServe Partner Organization (PPO). This Program uses a programmatic, wave-based coverage model leveraging AI-powered Sales Agents, GenAI-powered account intelligence, and ProServe Investment to systematically convert high-DSI-potential customers into ProServe engagements. You will be the connective tissue between these partners and AWS driving strategic alignment, ensuring account assignments are actioned, pipeline is building, feedback loops are tight, velocity targets are met, and escalations are resolved with minimal oversight.


Key job responsibilities
• Own and drive the strategic and operational relationships with select partner organizations (I.e. Accenture, EPAM, Deloitte, Slalom, Thoughtworks, Effectual) responsible for generating pipeline across ~6,800 accounts.
• Drive partner accountability for account coverage commitments, pipeline creation targets, opportunity progression, and conversion to ProServe engagements.
• Co-sell directly alongside partners on partner-originated opportunities. Once a partner identifies and qualifies a customer need, join discovery calls, shape the ProServe solution proposal, and present the AWS value proposition to customer decision-makers.
• Own the ProServe deal through closure on partner-sourced opportunities (prime or sub): once partners originate and qualify pipeline, take ownership of opportunity progression from qualified stage through SOW execution, MSA creation (if necessary) navigate internal AWS approvals (legal, investment committees), and drive deals to booking.
• Lead customer-facing conversations on ProServe commercial constructs once partners have opened the door. Articulate Fixed Price packaging, investment models, and engagement value to C-suite and VP-level buyers alongside the partner account teams who originated the opportunity.
• Orchestrate cross-functional deal support on partner-originated deals by engaging ProServe Solution Architects, Delivery Leads, and Pricing teams to accelerate deal velocity and remove technical or commercial blockers before they stall progression.
• Coordinate with existing AWS Account Teams (ProServe PAEs, Account Managers, and Technical Account Managers) on partner-originated opportunities where target accounts roll up to parent accounts already covered by established AWS teams. Ensure alignment on customer engagement strategy, avoid conflicts with in-flight motions, and leverage existing account relationships to accelerate deal progression.
• Own the wave-based account assignment strategy: design and optimize account distribution to partners, manage the 30-day review cycle, analyze coverage gaps, process returned accounts, and reassign for maximum coverage and conversion.
• Design, lead, and continuously iterate on partner cadences (weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews) to track progress, remove blockers, and accelerate deal velocity.
• Leverage AI-powered Sales Agent outputs and GenAI-powered account intelligence to equip partners with account-specific sales plays, customer research, and propensity-to-buy signals that accelerate their prospecting.
• Own end-to-end pipeline reporting and analytics across the partner ecosystem: accounts contacted, opportunities created, pipeline TCV, conversion rates, and velocity against the 200 new-logo target.
• Own and govern ProServe Investment allocation for partner-led opportunities, ensuring compliance with the adjusted 1x ARR-to-Investment guardrail and tracking payback period.
• Proactively identify high-performing partner motions, systematize best practices, and drive adoption across the partner ecosystem. Surface patterns in partner feedback to inform program iteration.


A day in the life
As a PPO ProServe Account Executive, you will be the operational hub connecting AWS and our partner ecosystem. Your days will include running pipeline review cadences with partner leads, analyzing account coverage and conversion data, distributing AI-generated account intelligence to partners, coordinating account assignments and reassignments, tracking partner progress against velocity targets, and removing blockers that slow deal progression. You will lead across a select set of partners simultaneously, each with different working styles, geographic strengths, and specializations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong strategic partner management skills, exceptional operational rigor, executive-level communication, and the ability to influence without authority across multiple external organizations. You should have a demonstrated track record of independently owning complex partner programs, driving pipeline outcomes, and holding senior partner stakeholders accountable in a co-sell environment. You will be comfortable working in a programmatic, data-driven environment where GenAI tools accelerate account research, and where success is measured by pipeline creation velocity, partner coverage rates, and ultimately, new ProServe customer acquisition that drives downstream AWS spend growth.


About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience structuring and negotiating complex agreements and leading cross-functional groups to orchestrate and successfully complete deals
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Re-imagining the application of AI tools to drive Program outcomes.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.

Associate Solutions Architect

As an Associate Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers successfully implement AI and cloud technologies. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient AI and cloud architectures. You’ll drive technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.

Building relationships to understand our customers is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.

You’ll also act as an evangelist in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just want to be part of an industry movement; you’ll want to be leading it. As a builder, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.

这里是亚马逊云科技(AWS)解决方案架构师团队，如果你想指引并帮助客户使用最先进的AI和云服务, 如果你愿意以技术引领行业的发展，如果你喜欢充满激情的工作，我们期待你的加入! 作为亚马逊云科技的解决方案架构师，你将是备受客户信任的技术向导，通过技术为客户创造长远的价值。你将与公司遍布全球的产品、开发、技术支持、客户经理等团队通力合作, 用广泛的云服务为客户提供最佳方案, 用先进的云理念解决客户的难题。

这里有最丰富的技术方向供你选择，你可以深入研究Agents, AI, 容器, 微服务, DevOps, 也可以发展数据分析专家, 尝试各种数据库以及数据分析方案; 你可以利用AWS Bedrock/Kiro来为客户展示最先进的AIDLC理念，也可以利用AWS的工具搭建一款Serverless的手机应用, 也可以制作一部你自己的游戏; 你可以专注物联网，边缘计算的方案设计和应用实现，也可以训练一台自己的无人驾驶小车。

我们会发展技术深度与沟通技能兼备的人才，我们会培养面向客户需求定义技术方案的能力，我们会锻炼复杂场景下达成目标的意志。在这里，你即可以与全球顶尖企业碰撞思想，也可以与草根初创公司共同成长。


Key job responsibilities
成为AWS解决方案架构师, 你将：
* 响应客户云服务技术咨询，执行云计算方案原型开发。
* 为用户制定合理的上云方案, 帮助用户开启云之旅。
* 拓展用户对云产品的理解, 促进IT架构优化和技术转型。
* 与云产品和研发部门深度合作, 根据客户的需求不断改进亚马逊云产品。
* 通过客户workshop, 大型公开活动等方式传递云上最佳技术实践。

Basic qualifications

- 2026年9月 - 2027年6月之间毕业的应届毕业生
- 研究生及以上学历
- 理工科背景以及计算机，人工智能，大数据，云计算等相关专业优先。
- 熟悉Linux, Windows操作系统，存储, 网络、数据库等IT行业基础知识。
- 具备开发经验和能力。
- 具备快速学习及深度钻研能力。
- 关注细节, 工作严谨, 口头和书面表达沟通能力强。
- 熟练的英语听说读写技能。

Preferred qualifications

- 对Agents, AI及云技术感兴趣或有实操经验的申请者优先。
- 有计算机相关竞赛奖项者优先。
- 有相关工作经验者优先。

title: Transportation Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is seeking Transportation Operations Managers to work in out sites across the country. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute over a billion shipments each year to our loyal customers.

The Transportation Operations Manager has complete responsibility for Transportation Operations at a number of sites within a pre-defined region of the country. This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive process improvements and the ability to keep pace with our explosive growth while motivating others to meet the challenges of an extremely deadline-driven environment.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

You will be a key member of the development team and will be the main interface between internal engineering and operations teams as well as our manufacturing partners.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop test strategy, implement and optimize test setup/processes at Contract Manufacturing sites including identification, specification, design and qualification of test fixtures, test equipment and diagnostic software.

• Identify and report product failures to manufacturing and quality teams
• Train operators on test processes and support recurring certification programs
• Record, analyze, and report process metrics to predict and eliminate process failures
• Support PCBA debug and root-cause failure analysis at Contract Manufacturing sites
• Provide feedback to Engineering on test coverage, fault isolation capability, and PCBA failure trends for continuous improvement efforts
• Manage configuration changes and manage configuration control throughout the process

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience in hardware lab equipment such as digital scopes, logic analyzers, and soldering tools
- Experience in Linux/RHEL, or experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP) and experience in Ubuntu/Solaris
- 3+ years of experience designing and building test fixtures and complex test systems including RF Functional Tests, High Power Electrical Tests, ICT/bed-of-nails fixtures
- 3+ years of experience integrating software and hardware systems

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience designing and building test fixtures and complex test systems including RF Functional Tests, High Power Electrical Tests, ICT/bed-of-nails fixtures
- Experience with test plans and protocols related to established Space Hardware test processes (GEVS / SMC-S-016)
- Knowledge of software tools for test automation (e.g. NI LabVIEW and TestStand, Python, etc.)
- Experience with electrical design including power supplies, FPGAs, sensors, RF, and high-speed digital interfaces
- Ability to write detailed tester operating procedures and create deployment/capacity plans

title: Network Deployment Engineer, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (NIDD)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Network Deployment Engineer to build Amazon Dedicated Cloud regions as part of our Infrastructure Operations team. As dedicated cloud regions continue to expand and grow, Infrastructure Operations is looking for builders to take on the challenge of scaling network systems allowing us to stay ahead of customer demand. As a Network Deployment Engineer, you will work in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network. The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. Engineers will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers.

The ideal candidate should be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possess strong written and verbal communication skills and have significant experience in supporting large scale, enterprise class networks. Excellent network implementation and troubleshooting skills combined with a proven documentation methodology is also required. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential. In addition to providing top-tier management and support of Amazon’s vast network infrastructure, Network Deployment Engineers are expected to build or enhance tools, develop best practices, refine operational procedures and think proactively.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Clearly communicate project status and blockers to leadership and project management.
- Perform device build and cabling validation activities.
- Manage cabling vendor activities and performing quality assurance activities.
- Support Network Engineering deployment activities during scheduled change management windows and participate in the migration (possibly off business hrs), basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware
- Complete customer requests via Remedy trouble ticketing system
- Troubleshoot networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low-level application interaction. Deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes.
- Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflow and Collaborate with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
- Travel within geographical work area is required, up to 40% travel outside traditional work area may be required possibly including international travel and experience with small project scopes and ambiguous details within a relevant work environment

A day in the life
A day in the life of a Network Deployment Engineer on our team includes attending meetings, creating and executing change management activities in the data centre, deploying hardware, connecting cabling, troubleshooting links, updating tickets, working with peers from all across AWS to innovate and develop, and finding new ways to do it all better for our customers.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with networking fundamentals
- Knowledge of cabling best practices
- Knowledge of data center infrastructure design, operations, or delivery
- 1+ years of technical work experience, or Bachelor's degree in an advanced technical program
- High school or equivalent diploma, or CCNA or equivalent level networking certification
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals such as BGP, OSPF and other R&S technologies
- 2+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience
- CCNA or equivalent level networking certification, or Bachelor's degree
- 1+ years of data center engineering or operations experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descriptionHtml:
AWS Secure Connection Services (SCS) is looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to join our growing team that will be building solutions to complex problems that will scale for Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC). ADC’s bring AWS cloud solutions to a broad range of customers, countries, or organizations. Successful candidates will be able to grasp complex scenarios and find ways to innovate on behalf of the customer to deliver innovative solutions.

At Amazon Web Services, we like to “work backwards”: start by understanding what customers need and using that to guide our software engineering. We’re looking for a software engineer who is experienced in listening to customers, synthesizing their needs, and rapidly iterating our services to quickly put features into customers’ hands. Our best ideas become even better when we get feedback from real customer use. The sooner we can get that feedback, the more quickly we can grow.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

- Working with business teams to understand customer issues and to investigate, prototype and deliver new and innovative solutions
- Developing solutions to complex problems through improvements to processes or automation
- Manage and grow innovative, production-quality tools to solve real operational problems, in Python, Perl, Ruby, Shell, Java, etc.
- Closely coordinating with engineers and product managers across the organization to ensure we are delivering the highest value solutions to meet our customer’s needs

- Have keenness to explore: We are not blatant path followers. The right candidate will be comfortable taking a contrarian view point when it makes sense for our customers.
- Be a Proactive thinker: Thinking critically about long term growth and scaling to meet a global demand is key. The right candidate will be willing to thoughtfully consider all aspects of choices and outcomes.
- Have patience and persistence: Global impact is an iterative process. The right candidate will have an ingrained improvement loop of setting goals based on customer feedback, designing solutions, executing, refining and continuously improving.

Beyond regular design work, you may conduct electrical testing using oscilloscopes and multimeters, generate technical documentation like schematics and wiring diagrams, or assisting field deployment and troubleshooting at fulfillment centers to ensure systems perform reliably in real-world environments.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you passionate about sustainable engineering and innovative design? Join our team to shape the future of data center infrastructure while making a significant environmental impact. You'll collaborate with diverse teams to create energy-efficient solutions that power the digital world.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel should be up to 20% of your time and in-person collaboration efforts in your assigned office location.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement energy-efficient mechanical systems for next-generation data centers
- Lead cross-functional teams in developing innovative solutions for complex engineering challenges
- Oversee project lifecycle from conception through implementation, including budget management
- Foster collaborative relationships with hardware teams to optimize facility-equipment integration
- Guide continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance monitoring

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of critical data center/mission critical mechanical and electrical equipment
- Experience in data center/mission critical design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center/mission critical equipment and facilities

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production

title: Tech Integrations Manager, Global Logistics, Integrations and Visibility, Global Logistics, Integrations and Visibility
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Global Logistics to create and deploy EDI, API, and XML integration solutions that power the movement of inventory across the globe. As a Systems Development Engineer on the GL Integrations & Visibility team, you will architect and implement solutions that enable Amazon to exchange data with external logistics partners. As a Tech Integrations Manager, you will lead the design and implementation of technical solutions that enable Amazon to move products quickly and cost-effectively from overseas suppliers into our fulfillment network. This role combines deep technical expertise in Middleware systems with program management capabilities, offering the opportunity to reshape how global commerce operates at unprecedented scale across multiple geographies.

Key job responsibilities
Design, architect, and implement EDI/API/XML integrations that connect Amazon's logistics systems with external partners and carriers.
Automate partner integration workflows using AWS services and AI/ML tools to reduce integration lead time and build scalable systems.
Lead technical projects from conception through deployment, managing timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
Maintain and optimize mission-critical systems that form the backbone of Amazon's global logistics operations.
Collaborate with development teams to architect scalable business software solutions that meet current and future needs
Provide technical escalation management and troubleshooting for integration issues affecting operational processes
Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, including AI tools, to automate workflows and improve platform capabilities
Partner with business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into technical specifications and system designs

A day in the life
You will work at the intersection of technology and operations, partnering with software development teams, logistics operations managers, and external carrier partners. Your day involves reviewing integration performance metrics, troubleshooting data transmission issues, designing solutions for new carrier onboarding requirements, and leading technical discussions about system architecture. You will balance multiple priorities, from responding to urgent production issues to planning long-term platform enhancements. Internal stakeholders include Global Logistics operations teams, software engineers, product managers, and business intelligence analysts. Your customers are both internal teams who rely on seamless data flow and external logistics partners who integrate with Amazon's systems. You will solve problems related to data accuracy, system reliability, integration scalability, and process automation.

About the team
The Global Logistics team is driving initiatives that reshape how Amazon moves inventory worldwide. We support multiple geographies and operate in an entrepreneurial environment where innovation and customer obsession guide our decisions. Our team values technical excellence, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in ambiguous situations. We work on systems that process millions of transactions daily, connecting Amazon with carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners around the world. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and the willingness to dive deep into complex technical challenges. We balance the need for operational stability with the drive to innovate and improve our platform continuously.

Basic qualifications

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- 5+ years experience with ANSI X12 standards and/or EDIFACT and/or XML, including supply chain documents (214, 315, 310, 856, etc.)
- 5+ years hands-on experience with EDI communications standards and protocols (AS2, SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, API)
- 5+ years experience working with dev teams to design/architect business software solutions
- Excellent oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem-solve, scope technical requirements and prioritize tasks.
- Hands-on experience with AWS services: Lambda, Step Functions, S3, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience prioritizing and delivering projects on time in a fast-moving environment
- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- 5+ years of coding experience in SQL, Python, Java, C++, or Perl
- Experience managing technical relationships with external partners and translating business requirements into technical solutions
- Experience with cloud-based integration platforms and microservices architectures

Our mission is to be an indispensable and trustworthy guide that provides direction and context to customers throughout their shopping journey, helping them find and discover all that Amazon has to offer.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, MONA
descriptionHtml:
AWS runs one of the largest networks in the world, and MONA (Management, Out-of-Band Networks, and Automation) alone owns over one million physical devices across its full lifecycle. We are in the critical path for every new data center powering the AI revolution.

We build the in-house software that solves our hardest network business problems — controllers, software-defined networking (SDN), and planning systems. For example, we own a controller for agentic network auto-remediation, and the planning software that plans every new data center down to capacity and ports. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to be a technical leader and force multiplier: you will partner with the engineering manager to shape our software strategy while continuing to design and build these systems at fleet scale. If you want the scope to influence what we build and how we build it — and to keep building it yourself — this is that role.


Key job responsibilities
- Partner with the engineering manager to shape the team's software strategy — architecture, roadmap, and long-term vision — for the in-house systems behind a 1M+ device network (everything we run, we build ourselves).
- Design and build the in-house systems that solve our business problems — controllers, software-defined networking (SDN), and planning software — end-to-end, architected to scale with robust tests and metrics.
- Own and evolve our controller for agentic network auto-remediation that detects and resolves network issues automatically.
- Build the planning software that plans every new data center — capacity, racks, and ports — and deploys new network fabric.
- Own out-of-band management-plane services: serial console access to every server and router, plus managed connectivity such as SSH.
- Drive correctness and safety for automation acting on production networks: idempotency, guardrails, and observability that proves work actually happened.
- Lead design reviews, raise the operational-excellence and code-quality bar, and mentor engineers.
- Participate in on-call and help lead high-severity incident response.


A day in the life
No two days look the same. One morning you are whiteboarding with the manager and a principal engineer on how to evolve the control plane for the next wave of AI data centers; the next you are deep in a greenfield auto-remediation service that resolves faults automatically instead of paging a human at 3am. You will make a teammate's design better, unblock a data-center build with capacity planning, and harden out-of-band console access to a million devices. You will see your work land at a scale almost nowhere else can offer — with real autonomy and teammates sharp enough to make you better.

About the team
MONA (Management, Out-of-Band Networks, and Automation) is part of AWS Core Networking. We are a highly motivated team of software, systems, and network developers who thrive on solving challenging problems and building large-scale distributed systems. AWS runs one of the largest networks in the world, and MONA alone owns the full lifecycle of over a million physical devices — driving new innovation in one of the largest data center networks on Earth. Everything we run we build in-house: controllers, software-defined networking, planning software, etc.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 7+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 4+ years of highly scalable systems experience
- Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure

title: Production Finance, Originals, ROW Local Originals
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to shape the future of original content production in Latin America? Amazon Prime Video is seeking a Production Finance Analyst III to manage entertainment production finance for our growing Mexico operations. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of our original content investment strategy, working directly with production teams, local producers, and global stakeholders to ensure financial excellence across ambitious television and film projects.

This is a unique opportunity to apply your production finance expertise while tackling complex challenges including Value Added Tax (VAT) compliance, production incentives, and cross-border financial operations. You'll serve as the critical financial liaison between creative production teams and Amazon Studios finance, managing everything from budget reviews to tax credit workflows. If you thrive in a fast-paced, global environment where you can drive both strategic initiatives and hands-on financial controllership, this role offers the perfect blend of analytical rigor and entertainment industry innovation.

Key job responsibilities
Manage production execution budgets for original content shows in Mexico, providing weekly financial status reports to the Latin America Production Finance team including purchase orders, funding updates, and critical production finance information
Serve as the primary financial liaison between multiple original television productions and Amazon Studios finance team, reviewing production budgets, cost reports, trial balances, and reconciliations prepared by show accountants
Oversee production incentive workflows to secure tax credits and cash rebates, while managing Value Added Tax (VAT) compliance and complex cross-border financial requirements specific to the entertainment industry
Collaborate with Line Producers, Production Managers, and cross-functional teams including Legal, Tax, Business Affairs, and Accounting to ensure accurate financial reporting, proper account reconciliation, and seamless production cash flow management
Develop and implement innovative financial reporting processes, controls, and policies that enable effective controllership while supporting the rapid growth and complexity of Prime Video's original content business

About the team
The Latin America Production Finance team is part of Amazon Prime Video's Original Content group, dedicated to investing in the most promising entertainment for our customers across the region. As we expand our Mexico operations, our team plays a vital role in protecting Amazon's investment in original content while enabling creative ambition. We work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where innovation meets financial discipline.

Our team partners closely with production, legal, business affairs, and accounting teams across the globe, serving as trusted advisors to both creative and business leaders. We're building the infrastructure and processes to support Prime Video's rapid growth in Latin America, creating opportunities to shape how production finance operates at scale. Join us in this exciting phase where your financial expertise directly influences which stories get told and how efficiently we bring world-class entertainment to millions of customers.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of entertainment deal making, representing or working for a major scripted production company, studio, network, record label, or music publisher experience
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings, or experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- · 5-7 years of experience in production finance/accounting and an analytical frame of mind

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field, or a Bachelor's degree and experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
- Experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving, or experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Experience in business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)

title: Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Planning
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's dynamic environment as a Senior Supply Chain Manager with a Network Capacity Background, where you will play a crucial role in shaping and optimizing various facets of our operations, concentrating on optimizing and managing the flow of goods, information, or services within the supply chain network. We have exciting opportunities across different business units, each seeking a skilled professional to lead strategic initiatives and drive process improvements, with a specific focus on network capacity and the physical flow of goods or services within the supply chain network. As a Senior Strategic Supply Chain Manager with a Network Capacity Background, you'll take end-to-end ownership of operations, emphasizing capacity planning, logistics optimization, network design, and analysis of operational efficiency.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Product, Finance, and more. Utilize your analytical prowess to identify opportunities for operational improvements, implement scalable systems, and drive automation to enhance efficiency, with a particular focus on optimizing the physical flow and operations within the supply chain network. Whether you're managing network capacity initiatives, overseeing cross-functional programs, or focusing on strategic projects, your impact will be visible, ongoing, and contribute directly to our commitment to being the most customer-centric company on earth.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead strategic initiatives related to network capacity within Amazon's various business units.
• Concentrate on optimizing and managing the flow of goods, information, or services within the supply chain network.
• Balance supply and demand, assess and improve the efficiency of distribution networks, warehouses, or logistics operations.
• Analyze and synthesize data to identify opportunities for enhancing customer experiences and operational efficiency in network capacity.
• Define metrics, develop program management mechanisms, and invent/simplify processes to drive decision-making in complex network capacity situations.
• Collaborate with stakeholders across different functions, influencing and facilitating agreements to achieve shared network capacity goals.
• Manage cross-functional network capacity initiatives, ensuring continuous improvement and adherence to lean philosophy at scale.
• Own a portfolio of cross-functional programs related to network capacity, driving performance improvement and efficiency in project delivery.
• Identify and deliver operational improvement opportunities in network capacity, focusing on inventory management, logistics strategy, and transportation optimization.
• Monitor and optimize key network capacity metrics to ensure the smooth flow of goods or services through the supply chain network.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel (macros, pivots, lookups) at an advanced level

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience

title: Functional App Analyst, AFFS Accounting Onboarding
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is a US-based multinational electronic commerce company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Amazon.com started as an online bookstore, but soon diversified into many other categories, with a vision to be earth's most customer-centric company & to build a place where people can come to find and discover anything they might want to buy online.

Amazon's Finance Operations, Accounting & Analysis (FOAA) team is a fast-paced, team-focused, dynamic environment and delivering great experiences for our customers is top priority. FOAA is seeking a Finance Analyst to support our Accounting Onboarding team.

The Financial Analyst will partner with the Accounting Onboarding team (based in the US) to support various Amazon businesses for launching their products and services by automating their accounting and reconciliation processes. This is an exciting opportunity to join fast-paced businesses at Amazon. The successful candidate will be strategic, analytical, and have a demonstrated ability to support financial systems and architecture. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in cross-functional teams, and demonstrate strong leadership skills.

The candidate must have superior attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities. The position represents an exciting opportunity to be a part of an extremely dynamic and high -paced environment, support a global organization and work with accounting and business teams. The role offers significant opportunities for rapid growth and is a great place to learn about various businesses at Amazon.


Key job responsibilities
- Must have knowledge of an application’s functionality. They know what functionality is available in their system and how to configure it to work for business processes
- Help customers author and release accounting configurations using home grown business configuration management solutions.
- Troubleshoot integration issues by partnering with internal technical teams across the orgs.
- Work very closely with the technical teams across Amazon's lines of businesses to come up with innovative solutions that will accelerate the adoption of technology used for Financial Reporting and reconciliation.
- Work independently to manage projects and support Amazon's global businesses and development teams in the design and implementation of accounting systems.
- Provide project management update within and across business units to transition new processes and/or permanent solutions to support the Amazon accounting team.
- Coordinate with the global accounting teams to establish and maintain strong communication channels.
- Identify, implement, and adhere to best practices across all new project launches -Offering and receiving coaching, support, and guidance to the team.
- Supporting in User Acceptance Testing (UATs) in close co-ordination with business and accounting teams.
- Provide inputs for monthly and quarterly business reviews in a timely manner.
- Facilitate the business reviews with data analysis and follow through with business leaders on actionable items for improving business metrics over a period of time.
- Measuring and monitoring of metrics for new business initiatives.
- Present recommendations to senior management on strategic decisions, and planned future initiatives.
- Demonstrate appropriate understanding / working knowledge of accounting principles and internal controls, and apply them.
- Ensure appropriate financial policies, procedures, and internal controls are in place, documented, and operating as intended.
- Drive process improvements required to enhance controls.
- Actively participate in strategic initiatives and special projects when assigned or required.


A day in the life
Prioritization, Resource Planning and Stakeholder Management.

Gathering requirements from various Amazon businesses integrating with financial automation tools.

Collaborate with engineering teams to come up with optimal solutions for accounting automation.

Work on code review and config review process by following the guidelines.

Participate in UAT and guide internal customers with troubleshooting.

Work on deployments to production after acquiring UAT sign-off from stakeholders.

title: Schichtleiter:in in der Instandhaltung
descriptionHtml:
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

Key job responsibilities
Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf
Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen
Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk

A day in the life
Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren.
Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften.
Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln.



About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Wir bieten:
·      Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon.
·      Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket.
·      Attraktive Weiterbildungsprogramme.
·      Leistungen wie z.B. Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und eine Lebens- und Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung.
·      Prämien für Mitarbeiterempfehlungen.
·      Familienbonus.
·      Bezuschusste Mahlzeiten.
·      Pendlerleistungen: Kostenloses Parken, Kostenübernahme für das Deutschlandticket oder Bike Leasing Angebote.
·      Hervorragende Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem globalen Unternehmen.
·      Mitarbeiterrabatte uvm.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Zusätzlich, eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation als Industriemeister, Handwerksmeister oder Staatlich Geprüfter/Anerkannter Techniker oder mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung
- Praktische Erfahrung im Führen von Teams
- Erfahrung in der Automatisierung und Instandhaltung von Förderanlagen
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Grundsprachkenntnisse in Englisch

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Fremdfirmen
- Verständnis von SPS-basierten Steuersystemen und gesetzlichen Compliance-Anforderungen
- Erfahrung im Gebrauch von computergesteuerten Wartungsmanagementsystemen, um proaktive Wartungsmaßnahmen zu planen und reaktive Maßnahmen aufzuzeichnen
- Studienabschluss, vorzugsweise in einem technischen Fachgebiet oder in Betriebswirtschaft

title: Senior Product Manager - AI, NBS AI and OPS
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented and technical Senior AI Product Manager to lead NBS (New Business and new sellers) AI initiatives. This senior role will spearhead AI-powered solutions to support seller growth, optimize seller recruitment and account management, and address cross-border commerce challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in AI/ML product development, with proven experience driving global initiatives across organizations. This position will identify business opportunities, develop product strategies, and orchestrate collaboration between technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners across regions. The role demands expertise in articulating business opportunities into technical requirements and translating technical concepts into business value, while managing distributed teams and leading product launches in a fast-paced environment. Success requires exceptional stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence without authority, drive alignment, and communicate effectively with senior leadership. Fluency in Chinese and English is essential, hands-on AI development and Cloud deployment competency is a plus. And understanding of cross-border e-commerce is preferred. This position offers the opportunity to shape global selling through innovative AI solutions in the dynamic NBS landscape.

Key job responsibilities
Product Strategy & Development
• Lead the development of AI-driven product strategies to drive NBS AI penetration
• Identify growth opportunities across seller segments and lifecycle stages
• Design and implement AI solutions that enhance seller success metrics and operational efficiency
• Drive efficiency and productivity of seller recruitment, account management or go-to-market activities
• Lead continuous product optimization based on user feedback

Technical Leadership
• Partner with data science and engineering teams to develop and implement AI/ML solutions, develop AI applications for simple use cases through vibe-coding and Amazon AI tools.
• Define clear technical requirements and success metrics for AI-powered features
• Oversee development cycles and ensure successful deployment of solutions
• Drive data-informed decision making across product initiatives

Stakeholder Management
• Lead cross-functional collaboration between central product and program management teams, technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners
• Drive effective communication of product strategy, roadmap, and impact analysis to leadership
• Manage change initiatives and stakeholder alignment across CN team and MP teams

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Knowledge of global trade operations and compliance

descriptionHtml:

Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.
Internal job description

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.
