title: Senior Electrical Engineer – Southern Europe, RME Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s last-mile delivery network in Southern Europe is growing fast — and becoming increasingly electrified. From EV chargers to next-generation sorting technologies, our Delivery Stations (the final logistics hubs from which parcels are dispatched to customers’ doors) are evolving into highly technical environments that demand deep electrical expertise. Today, that expertise is fragmented across operational teams. We’re changing that by creating a dedicated regional electrical authority within the Reliability, Maintenance & Engineering (RME) Leadership Team for Amazon Logistics (our last-mile delivery division, operating 200+ stations across Europe).

As Senior Electrical Engineer for Southern Europe (France, Italy, Spain), you will be the single point of electrical expertise for our Delivery Station network across the region. This is a senior technical expert role at the leadership level: you won’t manage a team directly, but you will deliver results through others — upskilling field teams, shaping standards, and steering technology projects that will define what our sites look like three years from now.

This role is based in Paris, Madrid, Barcelona, or Milan, with approximately 20–25% travel across Southern Europe.


Key job responsibilities
• Define the electrical strategy for future Delivery Stations: Lead upstream electrical engineering for new site installations and technology deployments (including EV charging infrastructure), partnering with design, construction, and central engineering teams to ensure readiness from Day 1.
• Own the 3-year technology roadmap (electrical scope): Evaluate, validate, and prepare the reception of emerging technologies across the Southern Europe network, ensuring electrical systems are designed, specified, and commissioned to the highest safety and performance standards.
• Upskill field teams on electrical standards and processes: Design and deliver training programs for field engineers and technicians across three countries, building consistent electrical knowledge and standardised ways of working.
• Drive cross-regional knowledge sharing: Establish structured Best Practice and Lessons Learned mechanisms with counterparts in the UK and Central/Northern Europe, ensuring innovations scale across the European network while respecting local regulatory contexts.
• Contribute to RME Leadership Team priorities: As a member of the Reliability, Maintenance & Engineering Leadership Team, participate actively in strategic planning, talent bar-raising (conducting interviews to support the team’s significant growth in Europe), and safety governance.


About the team
We are the Reliability, Maintenance & Engineering (RME) team — the people who keep Amazon’s buildings, equipment, and technologies running every single day so Operations can deliver for customers. Our mission: shift from reactive maintenance to predictive intelligence, where systems help us identify issues and prescribe the fix before operations feel the impact. Amazon’s logistics network is growing more complex every year — shifting from mechanical systems to interconnected, AI-augmented digital systems — and we’re building the engineering capability to match.

Basic qualifications

- Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical discipline
- Significant experience in electrical engineering within industrial, logistics, or infrastructure environments
- Proven ability to manage complex technical projects across multiple sites and countries
- Experience influencing and delivering results through others without direct line management
- Fluent English (spoken and written); proficiency in at least one of French, Italian, or Spanish

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with EV charging infrastructure, high-voltage systems, or power distribution design
- Knowledge of European electrical regulations across multiple countries (NF C 15-100, CEI 64-8, REBT, etc.)
- Experience developing technical training programs or standards at scale
- Background in logistics, e-commerce, or high-throughput operational environments
- Lean, Six Sigma, or project management certification

title: Warehousing & Transportation Environmental Program Manager, Amazon Manufacturing Operations, Transportation Operations
locations: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a talented and self-motivated Warehousing & Transportation Environmental Program Manager to support AWS Manufacturing, Test, and Operations (MOTO) facilities. The successful candidate will join the AWS Environmental team — an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring regulatory compliance and the highest-level environmental performance of AWS’s warehousing and transportation operations.
This role sits within the MOTO Environmental organization and owns the Warehousing and Transportation Operations environmental compliance portfolio — a standalone pillar covering Receiving/Distribution Centers (RDCs), Multi-Function Centers (MFCs), and DC/FC facilities (DCFCs) across AMER. This is a new high-impact, ground-floor opportunity to build programs and establish compliance infrastructure from scratch. You will collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards of environmental performance for our warehousing and logistics facilities and our customers, and you will experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
A critical component of this role is supporting infrastructure development through environmental programs — conducting site selection environmental assessments, supporting greenfield permitting for new facility acquisitions, and ensuring environmental compliance during facility buildout and construction phases. This individual will be a key environmental partner to real estate, facilities, and construction teams as MOTO’s warehousing and transportation footprint grows.

This role is based in Herndon, VA (IAD Hub), Seattle, WA (SEA Hub), or Salt Lake City, UT (SLC warehouse).


Key job responsibilities
1. Leadership & Commitment - Own and evolve the MOTO Warehousing & Transportation environmental compliance program to meet changing organizational needs, stakeholder expectations, and regulatory requirements. Champion environmental responsibility across the W&T portfolio and advocate for best-in-class environmental practices at all RDC, MFC, and DCFC facilities.

2. Infrastructure Development & New Facility Support - Lead environmental due diligence reviews for new W&T facility acquisitions, including Phase I/II Environmental Site Assessments and pre-lease environmental screening to identify liability and compliance risk prior to execution. Serve as the environmental compliance owner during facility buildout and construction phases for new W&T sites — Partner with MOTO real estate, facilities, and construction teams to embed environmental compliance requirements into project timelines, contracts, and buildout milestones.

3. Portfolio Compliance Management — RDCs, MFCs, and DCFCs - Establish and maintain environmental compliance coverage for the full MOTO Warehousing & Transportation portfolio — beginning with facility inventory and classification, regulatory applicability screening, and risk-based prioritization across all RDC, MFC, and DCFC sites.

4. Hazardous Materials Management - Manage hazardous materials permitting, monitoring, and reporting across W&T facilities; maintain accurate hazmat inventories and ensure Tier II/EPCRA compliance where applicable.

5. Stormwater Management - Develop, implement, and maintain Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans (SWPPPs) for all applicable W&T facilities; ensure compliance with industrial stormwater permit requirements under NPDES and applicable state-level general permits.

6. Spill Prevention & Emergency Response -Develop and maintain spill prevention and emergency response protocols for W&T facilities; coordinate with operations teams to ensure response plans are current, trained to, and tested. Manage spill incident reporting and corrective action for W&T sites; conduct thorough incident investigations and develop appropriate corrective and preventative actions.

7. Waste Management - Manage waste characterization, manifesting, tracking, and disposal compliance for all W&T facilities in AMER; ensure compliance with RCRA hazardous waste regulations, universal waste rules, and applicable state-equivalent waste programs. Coordinate with waste haulers and treatment, storage, and disposal (TSD) facilities to ensure proper handling, transport, and disposal of all waste streams generated across the W&T portfolio. Develop waste reduction and circular economy initiatives across the W&T portfolio; establish waste metrics and track performance against reduction targets.

8. Vendor & Contractor Environmental Compliance - Oversee environmental compliance for vendors and contractors operating within W&T facilities; develop and enforce environmental performance requirements in contractor agreements and facility leases. Develop environmental lease language standards for W&T facilities; conduct lease compliance inspections and remediate identified environmental obligations with landlords and tenants.

9. Collaboration - Collaborate with environmental, operations, legal, policy, real estate, and sustainability teams to ensure the W&T environmental program remains relevant, effective, and aligned with evolving regulatory requirements across all MOTO W&T facilities.

10. Performance Evaluation - Establish and manage a robust system for monitoring, measuring, and reporting environmental compliance performance across the W&T portfolio. Conduct regular assessments of environmental tools and processes across W&T sites; collate and analyze compliance data to identify trends, gaps, and areas for improvement. Develop environmental metrics to measure, monitor, and forecast performance across the W&T portfolio; prepare and contribute to performance reports for senior leadership on a regular cadence.


A day in the life
Day-to-day, this role manages environmental compliance across the MOTO Warehousing & Transportation portfolio — reviewing regulatory applicability for new and existing facilities, coordinating DOT hazmat shipping compliance with logistics teams, managing stormwater inspection schedules and SWPPP updates, tracking waste manifests and disposal vendor performance, and supporting facility teams on environmental permit requirements. The role simultaneously works upstream — partnering with real estate and construction teams to conduct site selection environmental assessments, supporting greenfield permitting for new W&T sites, and ensuring environmental compliance is fully embedded in facility buildout timelines before a building goes live.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds
- Experience in environmental compliance and permitting, waste management, contractual, regulatory, and liability assessments, environmental permit evaluations and applications, EIAs and water discharge requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, sustainability, or equivalent field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading change in multiple site environments and influenceing those that are not direct reports or within your organization
- Experience with increasing responsibilities in environmental compliance programs in warehouse, logistics, distribution, or transportation operations
- Experience in warehousing, fulfillment, distribution center, or last-mile delivery environmental compliance programs
- Experience supporting environmental due diligence for facility acquisitions including Phase I/II Environmental Site Assessments
- Experience with greenfield permitting, SWPPP development, construction-phase environmental compliance monitoring, and pre-operational environmental authorizations for new facilities

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:

Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:

title: Sr Progrm Manager Returns Carriers, Worldwide Returns and Recommerce - Reverse Logistics Services
descriptionHtml:
# Senior Program Manager, Cost & Carrier Integration – WW Reverse Logistics Services

## About the Team

Amazon's Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce (WWRR) team invents bold solutions in sustainable transportation and returns experiences that create trust and value for customers, selling partners, and shippers and benefit people and the planet.

We are an agile, innovative organization dedicated to "The Four Zeros". We constantly invent to delight customers and create long-term value while encouraging the reuse of returned product and reducing product waste. WWRR includes the full complement of business, product, program, operational, data, and software engineering teams, who work together to identify and remove defects that cause returns, reinvent the return experience, and manage the lifecycle of returned, overstock, and damaged products, with the objective of throwing nothing away.

## Role Overview

In this role within WW Reverse Logistics Services, you will own end-to-end transportation cost strategy and carrier integration across a portfolio of 6–7 carriers, including carrier-managed stores, and last-mile delivery partners. You will lead technology integrations to launch new carriers, and drive cost optimization across the US reverse logistics network.

This is a senior role within the level, requiring strategic thinking, cross-organizational influence, and the ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technology teams across Amazon to develop scalable solutions for complex carrier and cost challenges. This role represents the are to the senior leadership regularly.

## Key Job Responsibilities

- **Own end-to-end transportation cost strategy** – Develop deep understanding of both 1P (first-party) and 3P (third-party) cost structures across the full reverse logistics lifecycle—from customer initiation through carrier pickup, sortation, and final disposition. Conduct 3P cost assessments, benchmarking external carrier rates against internal capabilities to identify optimization opportunities. Identify cost reduction initiatives by analyzing cost trends, blended rates, carrier mix, and network inefficiencies. Program manage cost workstreams across multiple carrier teams, driving alignment on shared objectives and timelines. Collaborate with Amazon carrier teams to conduct opportunity identification, influence roadmaps, and co-develop solutions that reduce cost while maintaining customer experience. Provide data-driven inputs and cost analyses to inform contract negotiations with external carriers.
- **Manage cost as a core business metric** – Own cost reporting and insights across all business reviews (WBR, MBR, QBR). Ensure cost performance is tracked, communicated, and actioned at every level—surfacing variances, root causes, and corrective actions to senior leadership on a regular cadence.
- **Lead carrier integrations and define success metrics** – Manage technology integrations for new carrier launches, ensuring technical and operational readiness across internal and external systems. Establish pre-defined launch success criteria across all CX, operational, quality, and traceability parameters. Ensure every carrier integration achieves a successful launch against these criteria before transitioning to steady-state operations excellence and performance management.
- **Drive program objectives and define key performance indicators** – Provide program management, define project plans, manage implementation activities, and develop processes, documentation, and communications for carrier integration rollouts and ongoing support. Develop and own metrics for cost, CX, loss, traceability, quality, and pickup success; track delivery against program objectives and SLAs.
- **Scale services and tools** – Design processes and procedures that scale with business growth in volume, complexity, and marketplace across carrier-managed stores and pickup networks.
- **Drive resolution of critical issues** – Support processes/systems deep dives to ensure root cause analysis and correction resulting in improved customer experience and cost outcomes.
- **Communicate programs and results** – Present new/updated programs, policies, and carrier strategies to senior leadership, employees, and cross-functional organizations.

## Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience with technology usage
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience managing carrier relationships and/or transportation
- Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment without direct authority

## Preferred Qualifications

- 4+ years of driving process improvements experience
- 1+ years of complex Excel model or proprietary technology management experience
- Basic comfort with SQL query
- Experience with transportation management systems, carrier integration platforms, or logistics technology
- Knowledge of reverse logistics, returns processing, or last-mile delivery operations
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, supply chain, or related field

Key job responsibilities
Pillar 1: Transportation Cost Strategy & Optimization

This pillar represents the strategic core of the role—owning the end-to-end cost picture across the US reverse logistics network. The Senior PM develops deep understanding of both 1P and 3P cost structures across the full returns lifecycle, from customer initiation through carrier pickup, sortation, and final disposition. This includes conducting 3P cost assessments and benchmarking external carrier rates against internal capabilities, analyzing Cost per unit trends, blended rates, carrier mix, and network inefficiencies to identify and prioritize cost reduction initiatives. The role provides data-driven inputs and cost analyses to inform contract negotiations with external carriers, and collaborates with Amazon carrier teams to influence roadmaps and co-develop solutions that reduce cost while maintaining customer experience. This pillar demands analytical rigor, financial acumen, and the ability to connect operational levers to P&L outcomes.

Pillar 2: Carrier Integration & Launch Excellence

This pillar covers the end-to-end ownership of integrating new carriers into the reverse logistics ecosystem—from technical readiness through to successful launch. The Senior PM manages technology integrations across internal and external systems, ensuring operational, technical, and CX readiness before go-live. A critical component is establishing pre-defined launch success criteria across CX, operational, quality, and traceability parameters, and holding each integration accountable to those criteria before transitioning to steady-state operations excellence and performance management. This pillar requires deep cross-functional coordination with technology, operations, and business teams, and the ability to manage complexity across six to seven carriers simultaneously while maintaining high launch quality standards.

Pillar 3: Business Reviews & Performance Management

This pillar anchors the role's accountability for cost and carrier performance as core business metrics. The Senior PM owns cost reporting and insights across all business review cadences—WBR, MBR, and QBR—ensuring cost performance is tracked, communicated, and actioned at every level. This includes surfacing variances, identifying root causes, and driving corrective actions with senior leadership on a regular cadence. Beyond cost, the role develops and owns metrics for CX, loss, traceability, quality, and pickup success, tracking delivery against program objectives and SLAs. This pillar ensures that performance data drives decisions, that issues are caught early through leading indicators, and that the organization maintains a clear line of sight between operational execution and business outcomes.

A day in the life
- **Drive program objectives** – define project plans, manage implementation activities, and develop processes and communications for program rollout and ongoing support
- **Scale services and tools** – design processes that scale with business growth in volume, complexity, and marketplace
- **Define key performance indicators** – develop metrics and SLAs for core programs, and track delivery against objectives
- **Communicate** new/updated programs, policies, and processes to leaders and cross-functional organizations
- **Drive resolution of critical issues** – support deep dives to ensure root cause analysis and correction
- **Negotiate** efficient and reliable processes across partner teams to systematically eliminate dependencies and defects

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.

Across Europe we have more than 50 Fulfillment Centers, hundreds of Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and tens of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.

Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day.
We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.

Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.

• Lead the team, own the annual reporting responsibilities for the team and mentor their direct reports who in turn develop the technicians within the team.

A key focus is on preventative maintenance programs.

title: Sr. Customer Success Manager, Seller Compliance, Compliance Team
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly capable and AI-savvy Senior Customer Success Manager to lead strategic Seller Compliance initiatives that improve Seller success through AI-enabled business transformation. This role sits within the Seller Compliance organization and serves as the bridge between frontline Seller engagement and scalable AI innovation. The successful candidate will work closely with Sellers, Account Managers, Product, and Marketing teams to identify Seller compliance pain points, capture Voice of Seller, and transform proven Account Manager knowledge and best practices into AI-enabled Seller Compliance capabilities.

The role focuses on improving Seller outcomes across both regulatory compliance and Amazon policy compliance by scaling personalized guidance, Seller education, workflow automation, and Seller engagement through AI technologies. This role drives seller-centric requirements, validates solution hypotheses, and partners across organizations to deliver measurable improvements in Seller experience, compliance outcomes, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate combines deep customer obsession, strong business judgment, analytical thinking, and hands-on curiosity with emerging AI technologies. They are passionate about improving Seller success, simplifying complex compliance journeys, and transforming frontline operational expertise into scalable experiences that benefit millions of Sellers.


Key job responsibilities
* Build a deep understanding of Seller compliance journeys across both regulatory compliance and Amazon policy compliance through direct Seller engagement, Voice of Seller (VoS), data analysis, and operational insights.
* Identify recurring Seller pain points, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve Seller success, translating Seller insights into strategic priorities and scalable business initiatives.
* Capture and standardize Account Manager knowledge, best practices, and proven Seller engagement models to improve consistency and scalability across Seller Compliance programs.
* Identify opportunities to transform repetitive Seller support activities and Account Manager workflows into AI-enabled Seller experiences, including Seller education, guidance, workflow automation, and self-service capabilities.
* Define business requirements and partner closely with Product and Account Manager teams to deliver scalable AI-enabled Seller Compliance solutions.
* Validate business hypotheses using data, experimentation, analytics, automation, and AI tools to continuously improve Seller experience, compliance outcomes, and operational efficiency.
* Own key Seller Compliance business metrics and establish mechanisms to monitor Seller adoption, operational effectiveness, AI impact, and business outcomes.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives and influence business strategy by bringing frontline Seller insights into long-term planning, driving alignment across regional and global stakeholders.

Basic qualifications

- * 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Business Operations, Program Management, Marketing, Consulting, Product Management, or related fields.
- * Experience leading cross-functional business initiatives and delivering measurable business impact.
- * Exposure to AI, automation, or emerging technologies through business, operations, product, marketing, or customer-facing initiatives.
- * Strong analytical, problem-solving, and learning agility with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Preferred qualifications

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Senior Industrial Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.

The Senior Industrial Engineering Analytics Engineer will lead the development and application of advanced analytical models to drive manufacturing efficiency, capacity planning, and cost optimization. This role is responsible for building and managing integrated IE models that connect capacity, labor, material flow, PFEP, and cost (COGS) to enable data-driven decision making across factory and site operations. The ideal candidate will combine strong industrial engineering fundamentals with advanced analytics, simulation, business case development, and AI-driven systems to support large-scale manufacturing environments.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and own integrated IE models that connect capacity, labor, material flow, PFEP, and cost (COGS) to support factory planning and operations
- Build and maintain capacity models (target vs. forecast vs. gated capacity), incorporating cycle time, OEE, yield losses, and bottleneck analysis
- Develop labor models to optimize headcount, utilization, and labor cost (LOH) across production systems
- Create and evaluate business cases for capital investments, including ROI, IRR, NPV, and cost-benefit analysis
- Lead COGS modeling, including labor, overhead, scrap, and process-driven cost components • Develop and track scrap and yield models, quantifying cost impact and identifying improvement opportunities
- Design and maintain OEE models (availability, performance, quality) to drive operational efficiency and continuous improvement
- Perform buffer and WIP analysis to optimize inline and interline storage, reduce bottlenecks, and stabilize production flow
- Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs) and value stream maps to represent manufacturing systems and identify inefficiencies
- Integrate PFEP (Plan for Every Part) data into models to optimize material flow, storage, and line-side delivery strategies
- Support factory layout, site planning, and material flow decisions through data-driven insights and modeling
- Perform scenario analysis and sensitivity studies to evaluate production strategies and capacity expansion plans
- Utilize and/or develop factory simulation models (e.g., FlexSim, AnyLogic, Simio) to analyze throughput, bottlenecks, and system performance
- Support factory ramp-up, installation, and operational readiness through model validation and performance tracking
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance,
- Engineering) to align models with real-world constraints and business needs
- Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, executive-level insights and recommendations • Collaborate with MES and Controls teams to integrate shop-floor data with IE models, ensuring accurate OEE measurement and enabling real-time, scalable dashboards for operational visibility and executive decision-making
AI & Data Systems
- Introduce and implement AI-driven tools and platforms to enhance industrial engineering analytics and decision-making
- Design and manage scalable data models and data architecture for IE, capacity, labor, PFEP, and cost analytics
- Develop standardized systems, frameworks, and governance for data modeling, analytics, and reporting
- Automate data collection, validation, and reporting pipelines using AI and advanced analytics tools
- Enable predictive analytics and intelligent decision-making for capacity, throughput, and cost optimization
- Establish best practices for data quality, model standardization, and system integration across the organization

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Industrial or Mechanical), Operations Research, or related fields
- 7+ years of experience in industrial engineering analytics, manufacturing modeling, or operations analysis
- Strong understanding of manufacturing systems, capacity planning, and industrial engineering principles

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building end-to-end IE models integrating capacity, labor, cost, PFEP, and material flow
- Proficiency in capacity modeling, OEE analysis, cycle time studies, and line balancing
- Hands-on experience with PFEP, material flow optimization, and warehouse integration
- Experience with factory simulation tools (e.g., FlexSim, AnyLogic, Simio)
- Strong experience in business case development (ROI, IRR, NPV)
- Knowledge of COGS modeling, cost structures, and financial impact analysis
- Experience with data analysis tools (Excel advanced modeling, Python, SQL, Power BI/Tableau, or similar)
- Familiarity with AI/ML applications in manufacturing analytics (preferred)
- Familiarity with lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads is seeking an experienced Manager for our Programmatic Solutions Consultants team to join our growing business based in New York.

Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.

As a manager, you will own a critical portion of our DSP Services team, which works with enterprise customer and direct advertiser. You will own a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants with expertise in advertising technology, programmatic advertising, and the Amazon DSP, who are leveraging this expertise to develop our customers into proficient users. Your team provides services ranging from custom training programs, to product and campaign strategy sessions, to technical troubleshooting. We help our customers understand how to integrate our technology into their workflow, driving self-sufficiency within the Amazon DSP.

You have experience managing a team and are able to work and inspire directly and indirectly across the US and WW teams. You have a great track record of delivering complex projects and have impressed your stakeholders at all levels with your ability to communicate both written and verbally. You have demonstrated problem-solving capabilities across both technical and non-technical teams. The right candidate also possesses strong analytical acumen and is comfortable drawing metric-based conclusions by managing an extensive amount of data. You stay on top of industry and competitive trends, and you are able to execute at both a tactical and strategic level to drive customer satisfaction.

- Have strong communication skills and experience working across diverse stakeholder groups
- Represent Amazon when meeting with senior executive teams from top customers and build long term strategic relationships

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)
- Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

title: Security and Loss Prevention Specialist, NA
descriptionHtml:
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Security and Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses.

The Security and Loss Prevention Specialist (SLP Specialist) is a key hourly position within Amazon Operations. The SLP Specialist leads the effort to efficiently and effectively protect people, product and data (lives, physical property, equipment, inventory, data, & intellectual property) in a designated building. The SLP Specialist reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager responsible for their geographical area, and aids them in supporting the operational team, and cross functional teams throughout the organization.

Key job responsibilities
* Conduct confidential investigations and prepare prompt written reports of theft, fraud, and critical incidents
* Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement, data protection, physical security infrastructure) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
* Serve as department liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert for site leadership keeping them informed on key issues, strategies, and the department’s performance
* Develop strategies for alarm reduction and conduct system diagnostic for problematic devices by engaging and resolving issues with internal and external partners
* Domestic regional travel up to 25% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You will perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, and you contribute to developing mitigating measures to address them. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our fulfillment, logistics and retail operations locations by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems with subject matter experts and external suppliers to maintain their functionality. You will interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience, or 1+ year in security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, law enforcement, or operations, or Loss Prevention Qualified Career Choice Graduate
- 1+ years of experience using Microsoft Office, including Excel, in a professional capacity
- Workplace incident mitigation or de-escalation and Business Continuity planning experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience making and influencing informed decisions by leveraging data and metrics
- Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced and multi-tasking environment
- Ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, network and influence across all business levels in a diverse workforce environment
- 1+ year of leadership or management and/or supply chain experience
- Investigative interviewing experience; Wicklander and Zulawski, Loss Prevention Qualified, Certified Protection Professional, Loss Prevention Certified, Certified Forensic Interviewer, Certified Threat Assessment Certification or other relevant certifications
- Experience in physical security systems maintenance/implementation and coordinating scope of work with security vendors

title: Marketing Manager, Global Builder Lofts , Developer Experience
descriptionHtml:
AWS Developer Experience is looking for a Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end marketing strategy and digital presence for the AWS Builder Loft program globally. Builder Lofts are physical developer community spaces where builders come together for hands-on workshops, hackathons, technical talks and networking.

This role is critical for driving awareness and sustained audience growth through data-driven campaigns, compelling content, and seamless integration between physical touchpoints and digital engagement.

This is a high-impact role that requires a marketer who combines strong storytelling with multi-channel marketing experience, thinks globally while executing locally, and understands developer communities. We're looking for someone who has the ability to build marketing playbooks, mechanisms, and scalable frameworks that allow a fast-growing global program to operate with consistency and efficiency. You leverage AI tools and automation to multiply your impact, move faster, and continuously improve marketing performance. You will work cross-functionally with PR, community, events, developer advocacy, and product teams across different geographies to build repeatable strategies and execution frameworks for a rapidly scaling global program.

Key job responsibilities
- Promotion Strategy: Develop and execute the Loft promotion strategy across AWS-owned and third-party email programs, social media, web, and grassroots channels to drive awareness, events registration/attendance and returning visitors

- Registration & CRM Management: Manage event registration platforms and ensure seamless data flow to marketing CRMs, maintaining data integrity and enabling automated nurture workflows.

- Content Calendar & Publishing: Own the content calendar for the Builder Loft content series showcasing Loft experiences, builder stories, and hands-on learning opportunities. Coordinate with team members and external partners to drive content creation and ensure editorial quality.
- KPI Tracking & Reporting: Track and report on marketing KPIs including registration conversion rates, email open/click rates, social media engagement, content reach, and web monthly active users.
- Audience Analysis: Conduct demographic and cohort analysis of Loft attendees to inform programming and outreach decisions. Own attendee data analysis, identifying trends in audience composition, repeat attendance, and engagement patterns.
- PR Coordination: Coordinate with AWS PR teams high-profile event announcements, ensuring consistent messaging and maximum media impact.
- Localization: Lead localization efforts where necessary, adapting marketing materials, campaigns, and content for local markets while maintaining brand consistency.
- Physical-to-Digital Engagement Strategy Ownership: Designing the strategy that moves builders from initial awareness and in-person attendance into sustained always-on digital engagement.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with the Community & Partnerships Manager on community channel promotion and co-marketing with partners. Work effectively across AWS with groups such as developer advocacy, digital marketing, field marketing, sales, and startup teams.

A day in the life
You start the morning working on a social media campaign highlighting the communities that the Builder Loft has been working with for the past year with the goal of acquiring new strategic partners who can host events in the space. You use an AI summarization tool to pull key information about previous campaign data, audience insights, industry trends, social media platform know-hows and feed them into the plan.

Mid-morning, you join a cross-functional sync with the PR team to align on the messaging framework for an upcoming high profile Builder Loft event. After that, you're reviewing the content calendar, writing an article, and briefing your agency partner on assets needed for the next campaign sprint.

In the afternoon, you're building a new campaign playbook, documenting the end-to-end process for a "city launch" so that when the next Builder Loft opens, there's a repeatable, high-quality execution plan ready to deploy. You close the day by organizing customer feedback you’ve seen online and compiling a collection of social media posts and other coverage, sending a Slack recap to your team members with synthesized insights and trends.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
- Experience in designing and producing content for a technical audience, such as Software Engineers, System Administrators, or IT professionals
- Experience analyzing digital marketing campaigns, patterns and data trends to determine if they are meeting business objectives, and in turn leading recommendations to optimize
- - Experience managing event registration or marketing automation platforms (e.g., Cvent, Marketo, HubSpot, or similar).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
- - Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to drive efficiency, personalization, and scale
- - Familiarity with community-led growth strategies and grassroots marketing.
- -Experience in event marketing
- - Experience coordinating with PR teams on product launches or location openings.

title: Control Systems Engineer, EMEA Controls
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Data Center Systems team builds services to monitor, control, and alert the data center infrastructure systems. Our services directly contribute to the high availability of AWS data centers and Amazon’s sustainability goals. Teams in Data Center Systems solve complex challenges related to metric ingestion, distributed systems/cloud computing, data visualization, anomaly detection, analytics, and graph networks. The team’s goal is to deliver consistent standards for data center control systems and overall mechanical and electrical design practices across the EMEA region.

We are looking for a Controls Engineer who is passionate about data center operations and automated sequences to increase efficiency and availability. In this role, you will be providing support and developing mechanisms for the next-generation control system design, sequence development, hardware integration, I/O mapping tables, and engineering specifications. You will apply your creative and critical problem-solving skills to develop solutions at scale. Above all, you will care deeply about the customer and delight in creating simple solutions that solve our customers’ biggest challenges.

The ideal candidate will need a broad background in data center or critical environment control systems, IT infrastructure, networking, programming, mechanical facility operations, electrical power monitoring, project management, and demonstrate strong leadership skills.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act with a global perspective and have the ability to contribute to sophisticated innovations in the area of building controls and automation initiatives, this is the challenge you are looking for.

Key job responsibilities
Have deep knowledge of critical infrastructure, building operations, mechanical plant strategies, BMS/EPMS programming concepts, control diagrams, industrial HVAC, electrical line-ups, one-line diagrams, and complex environmental and electrical concepts.
• Lead and facilitate collaboration with multiple teams, including construction, operation, commissioning, software development and sourcing to deliver for customers
• Diagnose and repair complex control system malfunctions requiring extensive knowledge of a variety of electronic or digital control systems and the ability to test and write modifications in multiple system software languages.
• Provide QA/QC oversight of hardware installation, reviewing proposals and programming through the commissioning process
• Experience with data center redundancy, mechanical failure strategies, energy and water conservation practices, and data reporting analytics.
• Knowledge of operating in high-security critical environments while maximizing productivity.
• Innovate new solutions to support team, initiative, and company goals.
• Create and maintain specification documents for global projects.
• Develop and support mechanisms for mechanical and electrical controls products.
• Interact with AWS cloud services and other applications to present, archive, and analyze accumulated data.
• Travel of 50% or more may be required to manage and support project deployments as needed.

About the team
The team is responsible for the provisioning and configuration of mechanical and electrical control systems. This ensures that data center control systems are deployed and configured on time to meet AWS's capacity commitments. Additionally, the team supports commissioning and operational phases and deploys security and software updates to maintain system integrity.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship & Career Growth

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Helmstedt - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.


Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.

A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:

• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2026 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.

descriptionHtml:
Devenez Responsable d'Équipe Logistique chez Amazon et mettez votre expérience au service de notre mission: garantir le traitement efficace et rapide des commandes de millions de clients. Dans ce rôle stimulant où chaque décision compte, vous vivrez l'excitation quotidienne de piloter des opérations à grande échelle dans nos centres logistiques ultramodernes. Vous serez un véritable moteur de transformation, contribuant à repousser toujours plus loin les limites de notre performance opérationnelle au sein du réseau européen.

Key job responsibilities
• Promouvoir une culture de sécurité exemplaire, en faisant de la santé et la sécurité des équipes notre priorité absolue
• Fédérer et faire grandir une équipe de 100 à 200 collaborateurs, en créant un environnement où l'innovation et le développement des talents sont au cœur de votre management
• Piloter la performance de votre périmètre avec une vision stratégique, en optimisant les processus de réception, stockage, préparation ou expédition des commandes
• Concevoir et déployer des initiatives d'amélioration continue à grande échelle, en vous appuyant sur votre expertise et l'analyse approfondie des données

Rejoindre Amazon aujourd'hui, c'est donner un véritable coup d'accélérateur à votre carrière. Nos programmes de développement et l'exposition à des défis complexes dans un environnement en forte croissance vous permettront d'acquérir rapidement de nouvelles compétences.

Ce rôle est un véritable tremplin au sein d'Amazon. Selon vos aspirations, vous pourrez évoluer vers des responsabilités plus importantes dans nos opérations, saisir des opportunités dans d'autres pays de notre réseau international, ou encore vous orienter vers des fonctions transverses - voire combiner ces différentes possibilités. Cette liberté de construire votre parcours, couplée à notre vitesse d'apprentissage et notre échelle d'impact, sont particulièrement valorisées, tant pour progresser au sein d'Amazon que pour saisir à l'avenir des opportunités prestigieuses en externe.

Les centres de distribution (Fulfillment Centers) sont au cœur de notre promesse client. Nous développons un réseau logistique à la pointe de l'innovation, alliant automatisation, algorithmes et expertise humaine pour garantir une efficacité maximale.

title: Credit Risk Manager, Amazon Payments
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history with Amazon's Brazil team! We are seeking a hands-on and analytically strong Credit Risk Individual Contributor to support the execution of our credit initiatives in Brazil and help create access to affordable payment methods. You will own the development and optimization of credit policies, working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to manage and improve our digital credit products.

The ideal candidate possesses solid credit risk management experience, strong analytical skills, and a proven track record executing credit strategies end-to-end. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and monitor credit policies across the customer lifecycle (acquisition, activation, limit management, and maintenance), ensuring alignment with risk appetite and business goals.

- Analyze portfolio performance leveraging data-driven insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization across key metrics (approval rates, FPD, loss rates, Incremental profitability and vintage curves).

- Design and execute A/B tests and champion/challenger experiments to continuously improve underwriting rules, decision models, and segmentation strategies.

- Support collections and recovery strategy execution, including segmentation logic, collection rules, and performance tracking of internal and external collection efforts.

- Build and maintain risk dashboards and reporting cadences, translating complex data into actionable narratives for senior leadership and stakeholders.

- Partner with Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to embed risk controls into customer journeys, ensuring scalable and automated decision-making.

- Identify signs of macroeconomic deterioration or improvement that may impact portfolio performance and propose strategies with clear trade-off analysis.

- Support the development of credit risk frameworks, including risk appetite definition, governance documentation, and policy governance routines.

About the team
Brazil Payments is part of the International Emerging Stores Payments team and focuses on supporting the launch of new payment and financial products to our customers in Brazil.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above

Preferred qualifications

- Deep expertise in credit underwriting, collections strategy and fraud prevention across consumer lending products in Latin American markets, particularly Brazil.
- Proven track record designing and implementing credit risk frameworks that balanced growth targets with loss mitigation in high-growth environments.
- Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical tool (SAS, Python, or R)
- Proven ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable credit strategies
- Familiarity with machine learning models applied to credit scoring or segmentation
- Knowledge of Brazilian credit bureau data (Serasa, SPC, Boa Vista)

descriptionHtml:

As a BIE II, you'll work on building analytical solutions that empower Central Accounting, Ordering as well as Transportation Tech teams worldwide. You'll develop both near-real-time (NRT) streaming pipelines and batch processing pipelines that deliver critical insights for decision-making. You'll also build metrics for the Central Accounting, Ordering and for Transportation, while contributing to innovative AI-powered solutions delivering automated insights across the FOAA org.

The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex technical contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. The candidate is a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big (while paying careful attention to detail), and enjoys working in a fast-paced and global team. We're excited to talk to those up to the challenge!

title: Senior Finance Manager, WW R&R, World Wide (WW) Returns and Recommerce
descriptionHtml:
We invent bold solutions in sustainable return experiences which create trust and value for customers, selling partners, and shippers along with benefitting people, planet, and profit. We champion and lead the way to achieve Zero Defects, Zero Cost of Returns, Zero Product Waste and Zero Carbon (4 Zeroes), at scale.

The WW Returns and Recommerce finance team seeks a self-driven Senior Finance Manager excited about solving complex problems that have a customer facing impact, require strategic long-term thinking and help drive the 4 Zeroes.

As a Senior Finance Manager, you will be pivotal to the team's success by setting the playbook for measuring efficacy of operational programs designed to improve returns experience and simplifying decision support through financial and operational reporting of worldwide returns and concessions cost. You will undertake financial modeling and review progress of various cost reduction programs. This role will provide extensive cross-functional partnership opportunities with senior business and finance stakeholders through governance over weekly/monthly performance reviews.

A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to innovate by building solutions that drive the 4 Zeroes. The successful candidate will demonstrate the following abilities: they influence business owners, support thoughtful decision-making, and adapt to a rapidly-evolving environment. You also bring excellent verbal and written communication skills.



Key job responsibilities
- Measure efficacy of programs designed to improve sellable yield, increase vendor recoveries and reduce cost (Direct-to-disposition, Removals and Palletized Returns for retail vendors, Advanced Grading, Locker+ stores etc.). Influence business decisions by presenting the right performance narrative across customer experience, business model and long-term vision
- Partner with Customer Service (CS) teams to improve CS cost on returns, including discretionary concessions ($400MM spend US)
- Own monthly governance on measuring Free-cash-flow (cost savings) program for Returns business
- Controllership – build systems to improve accuracy of Cognos plans and loads, partner with product teams to build ASIN-level visibility on Net Cost of Returns and Concession (NCRC), including slices for sort vs. non-sort, product family etc
- Automate capability for creating financial bridges, centralize standard work templates across returns finance
- Use active listening skills intuitively to communicate data (both written and verbal) in a clear, concise, and unambiguous manner. Adjusts style for various audiences to articulate complex finance issues clearly
- Remain accountable to hire and develop a high performing finance team, including team engagement, career growth, and performance management
- Contribute to the larger finance community as a corporate citizen

In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
