descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an exceptional Leadership Development Business Partner to guide, architect, and drive high-impact learning solutions that shape the next generation of leaders. This role offers an opportunity to influence organizational excellence at scale while solving complex business challenges through innovative learning approaches.

Key job responsibilities
This role offers collaboration with significant autonomy, and the opportunity to make an impact on Amazon's leadership culture. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguous environments, demonstrates excellent judgment, facilitation, and communication skills, and possesses both strategic vision and practical execution capabilities.

What You'll Do:

- Partner with senior stakeholders to identify, assess, and address critical leadership development needs across multiple organizations and geographies, recommending solutions to enhance leader capability, engagement, culture, and performance
- Design and manage complex leadership development curricula that align with organizational goals and values to drive meaningful behavior change and measurable business impact
- Incorporate innovative approaches, tools, and technologies (e.g., experiential learning, executive roundtables, e-learning, immersive simulations) to deliver impactful learning experiences
- Lead data-driven decision making by establishing metrics, analyzing outcomes, and continuously improving program effectiveness
- Influence strategic direction of leadership development initiatives through compelling narratives and evidence-based recommendations
- Negotiate priorities and resources across competing organizational demands, making trade-offs between short- and long-term needs
- Architect end-to-end learning experiences that transform leadership capabilities before, during, and after formal training interventions
- Force multiply by mentoring and developing others, and by building standards and best practices that scale across the organization
Impact You'll Have:

- Advance leadership capability across client organizations, directly influencing org-level goals and business outcomes
- Improve solution-related metrics and the effectiveness of complex leadership curricula, with potential to shape a broader program portfolio
- Drive meaningful behavior change in leaders through scalable learning solutions
- Streamline and standardize best practices that raise the bar for how leadership development is delivered across teams

A day in the life
As a Leadership Development Business Partner, your days are about one thing: making leaders across Selling Partner Services better at leading. Some mornings you're sitting with a senior business leader, digging into the data to figure out what capabilities are most needed in their organization over the next 12 months. Other days you're designing a curriculum from scratch, facilitating a room full of managers, or piloting something new to see what moves the needle.

You'll partner with HRBPs, senior business leaders, your fellow LDBPs, org and regional L&D teams, and Employee Experience Partners. Your customers span the full leadership pipeline, from people managers to senior leaders, across multiple organizations and geographies. The problems are real and rarely tidy: how do leaders scale themselves, build manager capability that sticks, and strengthen the culture they create every day? You'll own the answers end to end and measure whether it worked.

About the team
The Leadership Institute is a global team dedicated to developing leaders across Selling Partner Services (SPS), a worldwide organization whose mission is to enable the long-term success of our selling partners, providing the most trusted shopping and selling experience and the solutions that accelerate their business growth.

We're embedded within a cross-functional HR team that brings together program management, dedicated data & analytics, research science, HR business partners, instructional design, and Leadership Development Business Partners all collaborating to support SPS united by a shared mission: to elevate our people-focused culture, drive meaningful business impact, and enable exceptional leadership through innovative, scalable people solutions. If that excites you, you'll help shape how leaders grow here.

- Experience leading stakeholder engagements and presentations with senior and international leaders
- Experience conceptualizing and delivering programs for large, cross-functional, global teams, using data and metrics to measure impact, provide insights, and drive improvements

title: Software Development Engineer, Intent Driven Network
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
We empower our engineers to take ownership of their realm and make a difference. They start by gathering requirements, diving deep to choose technologies, designing features and spinning new services, coding and reviewing, deploying software across the globe and maintaining services. In AWS, we are nimble and agile, like being part of a startup, innovating while collaborating with a smart group of people around you. We are thrilled about how software is changing the landscape of networking. We operate on an unimaginable scale. We push the boundaries in robustness, fault-tolerance and smart adaptive algorithms that can react intelligently to real-world events. Software engineers on our team contribute to every phase of the development process and deploy scalable software systems worldwide.

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer with production quality software services experience. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where delivery of new services and features is very rapid.The ideal candidate will demonstrate established software engineering expertise, having successfully developed and launched extensive distributed systems in collaboration with a team. You are adaptable, capable of excelling in a dynamic and entrepreneurial setting. You will be responsible for delivering high quality, extensible design and code. You are expected to mentor and guide junior engineers. You are comfortable managing competing priorities and are able to bring order to ambiguous scenarios. You identify and implement optimizations for performance, scalability, and efficiency. Maturity, impeccable judgment, and the ability to influence and lead are essential to success in this role. You are data-driven and analytical. You have the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both in writing and verbally, across organizations, and up to senior leadership.Previous Routing Protocols/Networking background is a plus.

About the team
We are the AWS Intent Driven Networking (AIDN) Team, and we own the design and development of services to enable Intent-driven management of the AWS Network. Our mission is to transform the way AWS Networks are managed by seeking to make our networks consistent, verifiably safe, predictable and agile. Our vision is to enable our customers to express expected network behavior as Intents that are compiled, tested and reflected in our networks through close-loop Authoritative control systems, with Change SLAs measured in the order of seconds, not days or weeks.

title: System Dev Engineer II, ALG Software and Network Integration and Test
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low-latency internet services to underserved and unserved communities around the world. By leveraging satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Project LEO to leverage the constellation of advanced satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

About the Role

The Systems Development Engineer II will own the operational health, resiliency, and automation of team infrastructure including pipelines that support integration and verification for ALG programs. This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software development, and operational excellence — you will define how teams build, deploy, and maintain reliable test infrastructure, not just how they test.

Working within Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering Integrated Systems Solutions, you will architect and deliver infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and observability solutions, and automation frameworks that keep hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system lab environments healthy, resilient, and scalable. You will serve as the technical owner of pipeline infrastructure reliability, driving decisions on system architecture, deployment patterns, and operational best practices while collaborating across inter-disciplinary teams, partners, and suppliers.

You will identify and eliminate risks to system resiliency, coach others on operational excellence, and use processes such as code reviews, operational readiness reviews (ORRs), and post-incident analyses (COEs) as teaching mechanisms. When systems fail, you ensure contributing causes are identified and eliminated with permanent fixes.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience working on complex hardware/software systems in a distributed environment, with a foundation in Linux, networking, and infrastructure automation.

Security Clearance: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.



Key job responsibilities
Own the design, deployment, operational health, and long-term resiliency of lab infrastructure, test environments, and CI/CD pipelines consumed by I&T engineers and subsystem teams in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system lab environments

Architect and implement infrastructure-as-code solutions, monitoring/observability platforms, and automation that ensure lab systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-effective

Identify and mitigate risks to system resiliency through participation in design reviews, ORRs, and post-incident analyses; drive permanent fixes for contributing causes of failures

Define and drive operational best practices across the lab engineering organization, establishing patterns for automation, observability, alerting, and incident response that raise the bar for the broader team

Deeply diagnose problems across the full stack — hardware, software, networking, and operating environments — and drive root-cause resolution of performance, reliability, and availability issues

Develop and maintain clear, inclusive documentation including runbooks, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures; ensure systems can be maintained and extended by those not familiar with them

Operate independently to identify gaps in infrastructure reliability, propose solutions, and drive implementation with pragmatic tradeoffs between speed and long-term maintainability

Coach and mentor team members on identifying and eliminating risk, operational excellence, and systems engineering best practices; participate actively in hiring

Collaborate with systems engineers, hardware teams, software developers, and external partners to ensure infrastructure supports all phases of integration, test, verification, and validation across satellite and ground element campaigns

Begin contributing to strategic and operational planning (OP1/OP2), ensuring the team makes appropriate investments in agility and resiliency

Basic qualifications

- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale

title: Principal AI Security SA, AWS Security & Networking
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Principal AI Security Solutions Architect to define and drive technical strategy for secure AI adoption and AI-enabled security outcomes across North America. You will work with CISOs, Chief AI Officers, security leaders, enterprise architects, and builders as they move generative AI and agentic systems into production.

Customers need security architectures that support the speed and autonomy of AI systems while preserving control over identities, data, permissions, software supply chains, and runtime actions. Security organizations are also evaluating how AI can improve detection, investigation, vulnerability prioritization, remediation, and analyst productivity. You will help customers make sound decisions across both areas, define measurable outcomes, and carry the lessons from individual engagements into guidance that serves the broader field.

You will operate across organizational boundaries and in areas where the business objective, technology strategy, and solution design remain ambiguous. You will align account teams, security and AI specialists, service teams, partners, and field communities around a coherent technical direction. Your work will produce reference architectures, decision frameworks, assessments, customer offerings, and operating mechanisms that other Solutions Architects can apply consistently.

This is a customer-facing Principal Solutions Architect role. Success requires the ability to move between executive strategy and deep architecture, influence product and field priorities with customer evidence, and build mechanisms that continue producing results without direct involvement from the role holder.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the multi-year technical strategy for Security AI across the AGS Security & Networking SA Team, including priorities, architectural positions, field mechanisms, success measures, and cross-organization dependencies.
- Advise senior customer leaders on security strategy for AI adoption, translating business goals and risk tolerance into clear architecture decisions, governance models, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
- Lead significantly complex customer engagements involving generative AI and agentic systems, including agent identity, least privilege, data protection, prompt and context risks, retrieval security, memory, tool and connector access, software supply chain risk, adversarial testing, runtime monitoring, incident response, and auditability.
- Define architectures for applying AI to security workflows such as detection, triage, investigation, vulnerability prioritization, security posture analysis, remediation, and control validation. Establish evaluation criteria for accuracy, safety, explainability, human oversight, and operational impact.
- Turn recurring customer problems into repeatable field mechanisms, including reference architectures, decision frameworks, assessments, workshops, reusable demonstrations, implementation guidance, engagement qualification, and escalation paths.
- Establish outcome measures that connect technical work to reduced risk, faster secure deployment, improved detection or response, customer adoption, field reuse, and product improvement. Use these measures to adjust strategy and resource focus.
- Build durable working relationships across AWS security and AI service teams, AGS field organizations, the Security and AI/ML Technical Field Communities, account teams, Professional Services, Support, and AWS Partners.
- Gather evidence across customers and use it to influence product strategy, roadmap priorities, service integration, documentation, and field investment. Represent customer requirements in product narratives and senior leadership reviews.
- Create executive and technical narratives that give customers and AWS teams a clear point of view on secure AI adoption and AI-enabled security. Represent AWS in customer forums and industry events where deep technical judgment is required.
- Develop Principal-level technical capability across the SA community through mentoring, architecture reviews, content standards, technical assessments, and communities of practice.
- Identify emerging security risks and capability gaps early, determine which require customer guidance, field education, partner engagement, or product investment, and lead the right organizations toward resolution.
- Serve as an escalation point for high-impact customer decisions where AI architecture, security risk, business priorities, and multiple AWS organizations intersect.

A day in the life
A day may begin with a CISO and Chief AI Officer working session on the control model for production agents that can access sensitive data and take actions through external tools. You may then review a proposed reference architecture with security and AI service teams, resolve conflicting design assumptions, and document the decision criteria for field use.

Later, you may examine results from customer engagements to identify a recurring gap in agent identity, AI workload detection, or AI-assisted investigation. You will decide whether the right response is a customer offering, a reusable architecture, a field enablement mechanism, a partner pattern, or product feedback. You may close the day mentoring a Principal candidate, reviewing an executive narrative, or presenting a data-backed investment recommendation to Directors and VPs.

About the team
The AGS Security & Networking SA Team is part of AWS Customer Solutions & Scale Innovation within AGS NAMER Tech. The team includes Solutions Architects across the United States and Canada who help customers connect and operate applications securely and resiliently on AWS.

Our mission is to accelerate customers' confidence in the cloud through secure and well-connected operations. We work directly with customers, account teams, service teams, and partners to solve complex security and networking problems, create reusable guidance, and turn field evidence into improvements across AWS. The team's 2026 AI security goal covers both security for AI and AI for security, with an emphasis on opinionated guidance, direct customer work, and mechanisms that scale beyond one contributor.

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

title: Delivery Trainer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking energetic, self-motivated Delivery Trainers to join our team and help build a network of customer-centric Delivery Associates in the communities where we operate. As a Delivery Trainer, you have a passion for mentoring others; you are comfortable teaching and guiding conversations in large groups; and you believe in hands-on training and conducting drive-alongs with Delivery Associates to instill safe practices.

As a Delivery Trainer, you are responsible for establishing the right delivery training culture in your delivery station, setting up the training experience, and independently instructing training sessions. You educate Delivery Associates on the foundational safety, quality, and productivity aspects that are an important part of the Delivery Associate daily routine. You enable the success of Delivery Associates by adapting to different learning styles and taking a hands-on training approach to demonstrate what good looks like. You exhibit Learn and Be Curious by answering all Delivery Associates’ questions and finding the answers if you are not sure of the correct response.

As a Delivery Trainer, you are expected to lead by example and demonstrate the Amazon Leadership Principles at all times. In this position you will play a key role in keeping our commitment to exceed customer expectations by ensuring Delivery Associates are set up for success to deliver customer orders, large or small, on time at the right place.

Have you wanted an opportunity to develop the core wireless and networking for an advanced global telecom service spanning both space and terrestrial networks? Have you wondered what it takes to solve a multi-dimentional resource allocation problem at global scale? Amazon LEO's SDN team will design, implement and operate LEO's network control plane. This service will enable a high throughput telecom service using a system of LEO satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure that connect into public and private networks.

- Take responsibility for designing and delivering a modern, flexible, scalable, high throughput, low latency network architecture

- Define and automate processes used for software development, implementation, testing, and maintenance

- Provide operational excellence for control plane services, to including enabling tools and definition/refinement of operational processes

- Diagnose routing and forwarding issues across the control plane, data plane, and physical topology.

- Integrate telemetry, topology, link-state, and network-condition data into route computation and control systems.

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of the design, building and operation of a massive satellite constellation and terrestrial network. We interact with the satellite ground control services, the customer engagement systems and monitoring services to constantly fine-tune our network and deliver a high quality service to our customers. It is our responsibility to ensure that the network works and our customer has a one-of-a-kind experience using our service.

Our team will design, implement and operate the control plane that provides a high throughput telecom service comprised of Low Earth Orbit satellites, customer terminals, gateways, Cloud services and terrestrial network infrastructure that connects into public and private networks.

title: Energy Strategy Manager, AWS Infrastructure Energy Team
descriptionHtml:
Australia's cloud infrastructure is expanding at pace, and the demand for reliable, cost-effective power has never been greater. As an Energy Strategy Manager in AWS's APAC Energy team, you'll be at the center of this growth, leading the connection of data centers to the electricity grid in Melbourne and navigating one of the most dynamic energy markets in the world.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.
In this role, you'll work with utilities, regulators, and local authorities to deliver high-voltage transmission and substation infrastructure on time, on budget, and to specification. You'll manage grid compliance across a growing portfolio of sites, structure and negotiate energy contracts, and develop strategies that keep pace with Australia's evolving regulatory landscape as the grid decarbonizes and decentralizes.
This role offers the opportunity to shape how AWS connects to the Australian grid at scale, balancing rapid infrastructure expansion with technical compliance and long-term energy strategy. If you're energized by the intersection of energy infrastructure and technology and want to work on problems that directly enable the next generation of cloud services, we'd like to hear from you.

This role is based in Melbourne. 10% travel may be required.

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the single-threaded owner for grid connection delivery across AWS data centers in Melbourne, from initial due diligence through energization, directly enabling cloud capacity growth.
• Lead relationships with transmission network service providers (TNSPs), distribution network service providers (DNSPs), and regulators to secure grid capacity and negotiate connection agreements that meet AWS timelines.
• Coordinate across internal teams (Planning, Real Estate, Design, Procurement, Construction, Operations, Finance, and Commissioning) to align power infrastructure delivery with broader site schedules, resolving dependencies and removing blockers.
• Conduct power due diligence for new data center sites, assessing grid capacity, connection feasibility, redundancy requirements, and long-term supply reliability.
• Develop and negotiate utility contracts, energy services agreements (ESAs), and connection agreements, ensuring commercial terms align with AWS standards and regional market conditions.
• Own technical grid compliance across the portfolio, ensuring all connections meet National Electricity Rules (NER), grid codes, and relevant Australian standards.
• Interface with government bodies, market operators (AEMO), and regulatory authorities to obtain approvals, influence policy development, and ensure AWS infrastructure expansion objectives are supported.
• Manage capital budgets for power infrastructure delivery, tracking expenditure against forecasts and identifying cost optimization opportunities.
• Develop strategies to reduce energy costs and improve supply resilience, including assessment of emerging grid technologies, tariff structures, and alternative supply arrangements.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a call to a network service provider, working through connection application timelines or resolving a technical query with the design engineering team for a new substation. By midday, you're reviewing grid compliance documentation with the design team, ensuring submissions to AEMO align with National Electricity Rules. In the afternoon, you could be negotiating commercial terms on an energy services agreement or presenting a capital expenditure forecast to finance stakeholders.
You'll manage multiple concurrent projects at different stages of delivery, from early-stage site due diligence through to energization. No two days look the same, but the thread that connects them is ensuring AWS has the grid capacity it needs, when it needs it, to support growth across Melbourne.

About the team
The APAC Energy & Water team is a multi-disciplinary group covering energy, water, energy procurement, carbon free energy, and strategic partnerships, all working to keep AWS data centers powered, cooled, and connected across the region. This role sits within the energy function, where you'll be part of a team that thrives on solving complex infrastructure problems, building strong utility relationships, and finding creative ways to bring power to some of the most ambitious projects in the country. We work hard, we back each other, and we genuinely enjoy what we do.

title: Sr Content Delivery Manager , Amazon MGM Studios
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Content Delivery Manager based in Tokyo to lead content delivery and launch operations for Amazon MGM Studios growing Japan Originals slate. This role will serve as the strategic operational leader for Studio Content Services (SCS) in Japan, partnering closely with local Post Production and Production teams, the Global Delivery Manager, and teams across Studio Content Services, supporting both original productions and acquisitions for Amazon MGM Studios.

The Sr. Content Delivery Manager will lead the end-to-end Studio Content Services operational framework for Japan — designing and optimizing processes for intake, launch, and asset management while ensuring that each title (Movies and Series) receives successful: a) definition of deliverables, b) appropriate quality assurance for Original Version deliverables, c) timely intake of needed materials into Studio systems and processes, d) clean support for all streaming launch activities, and e) appropriate asset storage and management for downstream usage. The Sr. Content Delivery Manager will serve as the primary Studio Content Services point of contact for assigned titles, overseeing delivery schedules, solving complex challenges with internal stakeholders and external vendors, and ensuring content is delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.

This role will lead the coordination of intake and launch operational support between the Japan-based operation and Amazon’s LA-based Global SCS teams, ensuring that local Japanese needs and time-zone requirements are addressed even while aspects of operations are handled elsewhere. The role requires building and implementing Studio Content Services operational strategies for the Japan territory — making trade-offs between short- and long-term needs, mitigating risk, and balancing speed, quality, and resource constraints as the Originals slate scales significantly.

This position is responsible for identifying and resolving complex operational challenges, making effective trade-offs between delivery timelines and studio release plans, and driving clear communication across languages, time zones, and organizational boundaries. The ideal candidate will be both tactical and strategic — comfortable managing multiple series and movies annually while simultaneously designing long-term solutions, scaling workflows, influencing partner teams to establish and grow Studio Content Services operations in Japan.

Key job responsibilities
1. Serve as the strategic Content Delivery leader for Japan, partnering with Japan Post Production, Global Delivery Manager, Studio Content Services Prime Video Delivery Operations and senior leaders to drive cross-functional initiatives and influence long-term operational goals, and author strategic documents (eg delivery SOPs, process improvements, slate status reports) to drive alignment.
2. Own and drive the on-time, on-budget delivery of movies and series produced and acquired in Japan, including partnering with Post on delivery budgets, ensuring all required assets are complete and delivered according to schedule.
3. Lead negotiations on delivery schedules with outside studios, producers, and production companies to meet overall release goals, make independent decisions on lower risk trade-offs and escalate high impact decisions as appropriate.
4. Actively manage intake processes for assigned titles, assess complex issues, mitigate risk, and drive resolution — serving as an escalation point for operational challenges across the Japan content pipeline.
5. Establish and maintain regular operational connection points between the Japan-based team and Global Studio Content Services in LA — including recurring status reporting, cross-timezone syncs, and intake/launch readiness checkpoints — to ensure continuous alignment and visibility across teams.
6. Drive best practices with external vendor relationships to deliver content on time and within budget, providing strategic guidance on technical requirements, QC processes, and operational expectations.
7. Identify, assess, and resolve technical or operational risks to delivery timelines that might impact studio release plans — proactively mitigating long-term risk rather than only escalating.
8. Design, implement, and continuously improve delivery guidelines and operational procedures, driving consistency and operational excellence across the Japan content pipeline and influencing standards globally.
9. Navigate organizational and process ambiguity in a fast-evolving environment, building operational strategies within a business-strategy context and adapting to shifting priorities, new workflows, and evolving team structures as the Japan Originals slate scales.
10. Advocate for and influence Japan-specific operational needs within the broader Global Studio Content Services framework, building strategic relationships with key stakeholders, and shaping processes and priorities to ensure effective local delivery.
11. Serve as the gatekeeper for sensitive communications between internal and external partners, exercising judgment on when to elevate information and when to limit communications to protect operational and business interests.


A day in the life
No two days look the same — and that’s by design. You’ll start your day syncing with the Global Studio Content Services team in LA before they sign off, and then shift focus to Japan-based partners across Post Production, production companies, and local vendors. A typical day includes managing active title pipelines, reviewing QC results, troubleshooting delivery blockers before launch windows, negotiating schedules with external studios, and driving intake / launch readiness. Cross-timezone syncs with Global Studio Content Services are a regular part of the rhythm – you'll bridge time zones and languages daily, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks between Tokyo and Los Angeles.

As the first hire in Japan, much of this role involves building — defining cadences, shaping workflows, and establishing the operational rhythm to meet launch expectations that will scale as the Japan Originals slate grows. You'll balance hands-on title management with the strategic work of building local Studio Content Services capabilities — addressing on-the-ground challenges, navigating local language dynamics with production teams and vendors, and providing dedicated in-market expertise that strengthens how Studio Content Services operates across the Japan slate.

About the team
Studio Content Services (SCS) owns all intake, management, and distribution operations for Amazon MGM Studios Originals globally — from defining deliverables with Post Production teams, to launching content on Prime Video, to managing assets through their full lifecycle including downstream licensing and preservation. We're a global team spanning LA, Singapore, and now Japan, operating at the intersection of creative and operations. Our culture values ownership, high standards, and trust — we move fast, solve hard problems collaboratively, and take pride in ensuring every title reaches customers at the highest quality.

This is the first dedicated hire in Japan, sitting at the intersection of Delivery, Localization, Content Operations, and PV Delivery Operations (PVDO) to serve as the local point of contact for all Studio Content Services functions. The role reports into the Global Delivery Manager in Singapore and partners closely with Global Studio Content Services in Los Angeles, bridging local production needs with Amazon's worldwide content operations. You'll be joining a team that's scaling rapidly to support a growing Japan Originals slate.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 6+ years of experience in content operations, digital supply chain, or post-production management within media/entertainment – including quality control and creation of domestic and international deliverables
- Experience managing multi-title content pipelines with concurrent delivery timelines
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading operational initiatives across multiple countries, time zones and languages
- Experience leading processes or workflow improvements or implementing operations processes or project management frameworks

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in team management and building (including coaching and mentoring)
- Knowledge of sound, dialogue, and music editing and mixing workflows
- Experience with Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, UHD, HDR, and film workflows
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Experience in a studio, production company or television network
- Established relationships with vendors for DI, sound, mastering, and QC
- Familiarity with the Japanese post-production and media services landscape

title: Médico/a del Trabajo, Workplace Health and Safety (WHS)
descriptionHtml:
En Amazon, la salud y el bienestar de nuestro personal es una prioridad absoluta. Como Médico/a del Trabajo, estarás en el centro de nuestra misión: crear el entorno de trabajo más seguro posible. Trabajarás dentro de un equipo multidisciplinar de Seguridad y Salud, combinando prevención, atención sanitaria, formación y gestión de emergencias. Este puesto combina la presencia en el centro con la gestión administrativa, incluyendo el uso regular de herramientas informáticas (suite Office y herramientas internas de Amazon). Ofrece variedad de funciones, oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de la red de Amazon, y un paquete de compensación y beneficios atractivo.


Key job responsibilities
Como miembro de pleno derecho del equipo de Higiene, Seguridad y Medio Ambiente (HSE), sus responsabilidades abarcan un amplio perímetro:

1 - Seguimiento Médico y Acompañamiento de los Colaboradores: Organizar y realizar las entrevistas de enfermería y los reconocimientos médicos reglamentarios, y asegurar su seguimiento a través de nuestros programas informáticos dedicados. Llevar a cabo acciones de asesoramiento en salud y campañas de sensibilización específicas (TME, gestos y posturas, hábitos de vida saludables). Apoyar al departamento de RRHH y a los responsables en la adaptación de los puestos de trabajo para favorecer el mantenimiento en el empleo, en estrecha colaboración con un equipo multidisciplinar (psicólogo/a, trabajador/a social, osteópata, ergónomo/a).

2 - Gestión de Situaciones de Emergencia y Formación en Primeros Auxilios: Formar y supervisar a los Socorristas Laborales, y realizar los cuidados de urgencia según los protocolos médicos. Analizar las intervenciones para identificar ejes de mejora y participar en las investigaciones de accidentes laborales y enfermedades profesionales.

3 - Prevención de Riesgos Laborales: Apoyar el análisis ergonómico y garantizar la prevención de riesgos sobre el terreno. Gestionar el seguimiento estadístico de los accidentes laborales. Realizar observaciones periódicas para identificar situaciones de riesgo, asegurar su trazabilidad a través de nuestras herramientas internas y contribuir a la implantación de acciones correctivas.

4 - Contribución Activa al Enfoque de Seguridad: Más allá de sus funciones sanitarias, participa activamente en el enfoque de seguridad del centro: realización de auditorías, apoyo a programas específicos y contribución a los análisis de riesgos. Realiza rutinas de seguridad, analiza datos y despliega de forma autónoma planes de acción.

5 - Coordinación y Gestión de la Enfermería: Asegurar el enlace entre el servicio de salud interempresarial y los equipos operativos. Gestionar la enfermería (farmacia, material) y mantener los registros reglamentarios en soporte digital (cuidados de enfermería, accidentes leves, registros de incidentes). Coordinar el aprovisionamiento de primeros auxilios y las fichas de exposición a riesgos, e intercambiar buenas prácticas con la red de enfermeros/as.

A day in the life
Ocupas un papel clave dentro del equipo de Higiene, Seguridad y Medio Ambiente (HSE). Tu día a día será dinámico e impactante, centrado en la creación de un entorno de trabajo saludable y seguro. Alternarás entre la realización de entrevistas de salud, la prestación de asistencia médica, y el análisis, la anticipación y el tratamiento proactivo de los retos de salud laboral. Una parte de tu tiempo también estará dedicada a tareas administrativas a través de nuestras herramientas informáticas: gestión de visitas médicas, análisis de datos en hojas de cálculo y uso de las herramientas internas de Amazon.

About the team
El equipo de Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) desempeña un papel fundamental para garantizar el bienestar mental y físico de nuestro personal en el trabajo. Nuestro equipo trabaja con responsables, asociados y administraciones locales en todos nuestros centros, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de Amazon y las normativas legales, y garantizando la seguridad de nuestros entornos de trabajo. El equipo ofrece una variedad de oportunidades, desde Técnicos de Seguridad hasta Responsables de Programas. Independientemente de tu puesto, contribuirás al desarrollo y la implementación de la estrategia de seguridad en toda la red.

Basic qualifications

- Licenciatura/Grado en Medicina con especialización en Medicina del Trabajo (vía MIR u obtención del Diploma de Especialización en Medicina Ocupacional).
- Experiencia como médico/a del trabajo interno/a o externo/a.
- Conocimiento de la legislación española en materia de seguridad y salud laboral.

Preferred qualifications

- Las cualificaciones preferidas no son obligatorias para postularse en Amazon. Si posees todas las cualificaciones básicas mencionadas anteriormente, estaremos encantados de recibir su candidatura.
- Formación complementaria en salud laboral altamente valorada (Máster en Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, Especialidad en Enfermería del Trabajo o Medicina del Trabajo).
- Una primera experiencia en salud laboral es un plus.
- Un nivel de inglés operativo constituye una verdadera ventaja para su desarrollo profesional y sus futuras oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de nuestros equipos.

title: Site EHS Manager III
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We’re seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to help drive this mission forward. As our next WHS Manager, you'll be more than a safety professional – you'll be a catalyst for change, leading a comprehensive safety program that touches thousands of lives. Working at the intersection of operations and safety, you'll shape the future of workplace health while delivering real-time solutions that protect our most valuable asset: our people.

In this role, you'll serve as the site's safety facilitator, orchestrating our Global WHS Program with precision and passion. You'll partner with Operations leadership to weave safety into the fabric of our daily operations, using data-driven insights to create innovative solutions that reduce risk and enhance productivity. Your ability to build trust, influence change, and drive results will be crucial as you lead comprehensive risk assessments and transform safety data into actionable strategies.
Leadership is at the heart of this role. You'll build and develop a high-performing team of WHS professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site


Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations

- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability

title: Engineering Program Manager, NA Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

Amazon is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to support the Amazon Logistics North America (AMZL NA) Engineering team, part of Amazon's Last Mile organization. The Last Mile team helps get customer packages from delivery stations to a customer's doorstep.

This is a unique opportunity to own high-impact engineering programs and mechanisms that advance the intelligence and reliability of our last mile business. We are looking for an individual who has experience creating scalable, data-driven solutions to complex reliability and engineering problems. In this role, you will be responsible for driving engineering program governance, compliance reporting, data analytics, and documentation systems that enable leadership visibility, cross-functional alignment, and operational excellence across a portfolio of automation and electrical infrastructure projects.

You will build and maintain the mechanisms that keep our engineering organization running at the highest standard—from automated dashboards and compliance reporting to documentation platforms and stakeholder coordination. You will partner with field engineers, electrical contractors, supply chain teams, and operations leaders to deliver scalable processes that reduce rework, improve quality, and accelerate project delivery.

Key competencies of this position include insisting on the highest standards in root cause quality and corrective action effectiveness; analyzing and deep diving systems performance; inventing and simplifying solutions that improve installation and operational processes; and providing technical expertise to internal customers and stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and maintain automated reporting pipelines and performance dashboards (e.g., equipment health trends, failure rates, system uptime) that provide leadership with real-time visibility into program health and enable data-driven decisions

• Translate complex data sets into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for stakeholders at all levels, supporting weekly business reviews and program prioritization

• Build and maintain AI-powered compliance tools that aggregate multi-source data (invoices, training records, action items) into consolidated weekly leadership reports

• Manage multiple concurrent engineering projects (electrical, automation, MHE) across the NA delivery station network, coordinating timelines and deliverables with external contractors

• Track project milestones and completion metrics; identify process gaps through root cause analysis and implement corrective actions that reduce rework and accelerate project delivery

• Own weekly organizational compliance reporting on a strict cadence; monitor metrics including training completion, invoice accuracy, and Correction of Error action item closure

• Administer engineering documentation platforms and develop SOPs that standardize processes across the network; drive document governance including version control, review cycles, and user enablement

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Startup Execution, Operations, RME, and external contractors; facilitate status meetings and manage escalations from field engineers through senior leadership

A day in the life
No two days look alike in this role. You will move fluidly between analyzing performance data and building dashboards, facilitating cross-functional alignment meetings, and designing scalable process improvements that eliminate rework across the network. You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution—architecting a new reporting mechanism one hour and removing barriers for field teams the next. You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership of problems before they are assigned, and find energy in the variety of challenges that come with supporting and driving measurable impact across a fast-moving engineering organization operating at Amazon scale.

About the team
Our diverse team of engineers and program managers owns the full lifecycle, from firm engineering through project execution to final customer hand-off. We are customer-obsessed, data-driven, and never satisfied with the status quo. We capture lessons learned, incorporate them into our mechanisms, and raise the quality bar with each iteration. Our approach to growth is holistic—we continually learn, develop, and expand expertise across the organization, leveraging subject matter knowledge on a global scale. Collaboration is at our core; we are a true team that supports, challenges, and leverages each other's strengths to deliver on the Customer Promise every day.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology
- Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases
- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- 3+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Master's degree in engineering, management, or technology
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python)
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings, or experience developing MOPs and SWMS for planned works
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification

title: Senior Maintenance Technician, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
- Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes
- Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
- Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
- Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
- Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardize processes across the Brazil network

A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an BR-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

Basic qualifications

- High school diploma, or equivalent
- Experience working with CMMS software
- Experience in automated conveyors systems and controls, electrical and electronic principles, preventative maintenance procedures, blueprint and schematic reading, industrial electrical, industrial controls, industrial electronics, Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programs, National Electrical Code (NEC), work order management
- Work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

- Experience with robotic maintenance

title: Engineering Operations Technician, ADC InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switchgears, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems. They provide 24/7 shift coverage which could include 12 hour shifts, rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day work weeks.

Military Ratings/MOSs
- Navy: AD, AE, AT, CE, CM, EM, EMN, ET, ETN, EW, FC, FT, MM, MMN, EN, STG, STS, UT
- Army:15D, 15F, 15X, 15Y, 21P, 21Q, 21R, 31L, 35N, 52C, 52D, 52F
- Marines:612, 613, 1141, 1142, 1161, 6073, 6322, 6323, 6324, 6326, 6332, 6333, 6336, 6337
- Air Force: 3E531, 3E631, 3E032, 3E131, 3E331, 3E431, 2M033, 3D136, 3D137, 3E031

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center
- Troubleshoot of facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs
- Perform limited maintenance tasks to including filter changes, HVAC PMs, rack power installs, rack PDU, and rack ATS replacements
- Provide support to Data Center Operations technicians
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Work a 12 hour shift (rotating 3 and 4 day work weeks days or nights)
- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)
- Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows and spare part inventory
- Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance
- Respond to off hour emergency calls per on call rotation for any one of the region’s sites
- Fully comply with all physical security procedures and policies
- Drive innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities
- Manipulate small wires and objects
- Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work in cramped and/or elevated locations with or without reasonable accommodation
- Ability to work non-standard hours including nights and weekends.

Perform the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:

- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
- Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in noisy environments

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. title: Satellite Systems I&T Engineer, Space Networking Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Develop complex satellite systems that address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. As a satellite systems I&T engineer, you will build, integrate, and verify complex satellite systems while collaborating with multi-disciplined teams in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Amazon Leo is a initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low latency, internet services to underserved and unserved communities and remote communities around the world. By leveraging satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Amazon Leo to leverage the constellation of advanced satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

The System Integration & Test (I&T) Engineer will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary team to design, integrate, and test innovative product solutions. The System I&T Engineer will work closely with colleagues throughout Amazon Leo’s inter-disciplinary team and collaborate with key partners and suppliers to ensure our system exceeds customer expectations. The System I&T Engineer must be responsive, flexible, innovative, and able to succeed within a collaborative, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

As a member of the ALG Engineering Systems Engineering, Integration, Test, and Manufacturing organization, the System I&T Engineer will be responsible for developing the architecture and executing the design, build, and validation of test systems for complex systems and subsystems. The candidate will have the capabilities to develop test procedures, test software, test scripts, APIs, and automation to enable test and verification at various products levels including but not limited to system-on-chip (SoC) calibration algorithm verification, test automation and data analysis for electronics, opto-mechanical/opto-electrical subsystems, and system level tests including environmental tests. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the test architecture supports all aspects of the integration, test, verification, and validation of one or more of the following: the satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals. This includes testing, analyzing, and optimizing the test support equipment to the particular satellite or ground element being developed. Testing efforts include functional and performance testing through various environmental conditions as required and it will be the candidate’s responsibility to ensure the test systems enable efficient test execution and requirements verification.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical background in space systems design, integration, and verification across the development lifecycle. This candidate should enjoy taking ownership over complex problems and delivering well-executed results of high-quality and can work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that provides significant autonomy to be creative in devising and verifying various engineering approaches to meet technical and programmatic requirements.


Key job responsibilities
• Provide System Integration and Test leadership to one or more of the following: the satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals.
• Provide system-level test design technical expertise to one or more of the following products and services: satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals.
• Specify and develop end-to-end payload or sub-system integration and test plans and procedures to validate performance against customer and/or partner requirements
• Create test algorithms, test scripts, and calibration routines as part of performing lab and field evaluation of integrated satellites, bus, payloads or sub-systems
• Analyze system and subsystem test data and engage with cross functionally with teammates, partners, suppliers, or customers to evaluate the product performance and provide proactive feedback on potential improvements.
• Architect, design, and validate mechanical, optical, and electrical support equipment necessary to enable test execution and requirements verification
• Prepare reports documenting test results, test coverage, performance results and other key performance indicator (KPI) metrics, and communicate issues effectively with developers and managers
• Effectively manage and track to closure test anomalies, defects, and bugs; Debug, root-cause, and make continuous improvements of control systems in a high-rate production environment.

Security Clearance: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.



About the team
Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. These solutions are tailored to meet the needs of government and international customers for both space-based and terrestrial applications. The Systems Engineering, Integration, Test, and Manufacturing organization under ALG Engineering plays a vital role in the entire life cycle of the development of an engineering solution, including architecture development, requirements and interface definition through assembly, integration, and test (AI&T), verification, and post-delivery and operational support.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline
- 5+ years of space vehicle, bus, RF payload, or optical payload integration and test or related industry experience
- 5+ years of experience developing space or communication system test requirements, plans, and procedures for system design verification and validation.
- 4+ years of experience developing code in Matlab, LabVIEW, Python, Docker, Rust on Linux platforms and experience with industry standard coding practices
- Experience with testing satellite communications payloads, optical communications payload, spacecraft bus and constituent subsystems, or space vehicle level.

Preferred qualifications

- Familiarity with integration and test of satellite communications, ground terminals, or DoD networks.
- Proficiency with software development and hardware integration related to satellite payloads or ground systems.
- Experience with satellite or terrestrial communications systems and antenna theory
- Experience in verification plan and test plan development related to established test standards (MIL-STD-810, DO-160)
- Computational problem solving and test automation/optimization in one or more of the following: Python, Matlab, LabVIEW, C/C++, Docker, Rust on a Linux platform.
- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills

title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Alexa Smart Home
descriptionHtml:
Alexa Smart Home Science builds the intelligence that lets customers control and automate their homes naturally, spanning voice understanding, proactive automation, habit and preference learning, and the LLM/agentic systems that power the next generation of ambient home experiences. We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to own the scientific direction of a major workstream, turning ambiguous, open-ended problems into production systems that measurably improve the customer experience across millions of homes.
You will define the research agenda for your area, partner deeply with engineering to bring models into production, and raise the scientific bar
across the broader team. You will work at the intersection of large language models, agentic orchestration, personalization, and real-world heterogeneity across homes, devices, and occupants. This is a hands-on role: you will frame the problems, build the models, guide the system design, and mentor other scientists, while influencing product and technical roadmaps beyond your immediate team.

Key job responsibilities
- Independently identify, frame, and solve ill-defined research problems tied to broad Smart Home problem areas, delivering with limited guidance.
- Define system-level technical requirements and partner with engineering teams to adapt scientific techniques to meet production constraints (latency, cost, reliability), making appropriate tradeoffs.
- Own the science strategy and roadmap for a workstream; anticipate future business and technical requirements.
- Design and run rigorous experimentation and evaluation to validate approaches and quantify customer/business impact.
- Build consensus on scientific approach and best practices across multiple teams; influence product features and technical direction beyond your own team.
- Actively mentor and develop other scientists, and raise the bar in hiring.
- Contribute to the internal and external scientific community through publications, patents, and dissemination of scientific artifacts.

A day in the life
No two days look alike, but the throughline is owning a scientific problem from question to production impact. You might dig into evaluation results to find where the experience falls short, frame a hypothesis, and prototype with LLMs or agentic techniques. You will pair with engineering to turn a promising model into a production-ready design, weighing latency, cost, and reliability tradeoffs. Expect alignment with product managers on customer problems, working sessions with fellow scientists, and time mentoring teammates. Your customers are Alexa smart home users across millions of households; your stakeholders span product, engineering, and partner science teams.

About the team
We are the science team behind Alexa's smart home experience. We are applied scientists and science engineers making the home genuinely intelligent: anticipatory, personalized, and effortless. Our mission is to move Alexa from reacting to commands toward understanding a household's rhythms and acting helpfully on the customer's behalf, reliably and at scale. Because no two homes are alike, we embrace that diversity rather than paper over it. We value research-grounded decisions, hands-on work, and long-horizon bets. Scientists own their areas end-to-end, mentor one another, publish, and partner closely with engineering and product.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. title: Controls Integration Engineer, One MHS | Systems Integration and Flow
descriptionHtml:
The Controls Integration Engineer is responsible for the on-site deployment, integration, and commissioning of automated material handling equipment such as sorters, conveyor systems, and Automated work cells. This role is highly execution-focused and hands-on, owning the technical bring-up of Industrial PCs (IPCs), PLCs, industrial networks, and field devices during installation and commissioning phases.
The engineer serves as a technical authority on-site, partnering closely with contractors, system integrators, vendors, and internal engineering teams to ensure systems are installed, tested, and commissioned safely, reliably, and in accordance with project standards and operational requirements.



Key job responsibilities
Deployment & Commissioning
• Execute on-site commissioning activities for sorters, conveyors, and automated work cells.
• Provision, configure, and validate Linux-based IPCs, PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, and field devices per project standards.
• Perform I/O checkouts, network validation, and phased system bring-up activities.
• Execute commissioning and test plans, including sequencing, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
• Support dry runs, functional testing, and integrated system testing through startup and handover.
Troubleshooting & Technical Support
• Serve as the primary on-site technical resource for controls, networking, and system integration issues.
• Diagnose and resolve industrial networking problems (e.g., IP conflicts, VLAN issues, switch configuration, fieldbus communication faults).
• Troubleshoot PLC logic, device configuration, safety interlocks, and system-level faults across electrical, controls, and mechanical boundaries.
• Perform structured root-cause analysis and support implementation of permanent corrective actions.
• Document issues, resolutions, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement and future deployments.
On-Site Technical Leadership
• Provide day-to-day technical direction to technicians, electricians, and commissioning support personnel during system deployment.
• Coordinate closely with system integrators, OEMs, and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues and unblock progress.
• Ensure compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, and commissioning best practices during installation and testing.
Integration & Handover
• Validate equipment functionality against design specifications, controls standards, and operational requirements.
• Support integration of equipment into Warehouse Control Systems (WCS) and higher-level orchestration layers.
• Participate in turnover activities, ensuring systems are stable, documented, and ready for operational ownership.
Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve commissioning efficiency, reliability, and repeatability.
• Contribute to the development and refinement of commissioning tools, test procedures, and deployment standards.
• Provide feedback to design and integration teams to improve future system designs and deployment outcomes.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with networking fundamentals including hands-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc.
- Willingness to travel up to 50% for on-site commissioning and deployment support.
- Hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, EtherCAT, or Modbus TCP.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts in an IEC 61131-3 environment (e.g., structured function blocks, reusable control architectures).
- Experience supporting large-scale commissioning projects such as automated warehouses, conveyor and sorter systems, or complex manufacturing environments.
