title: Sr. Harness Design Engineer, Harness Design
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

In the Sr. Harness Design Engineer role, you will be responsible for conceptualizing, designing, procuring, testing, and support integration for the wiring harnesses across the entire satellite. Robust harness systems are crucial to maintaining reliable electrical system functionality. You will have direct impact on the success of creating a constellation of communication satellites that will be capable of reaching and providing broadband internet to the most remote areas of the world.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Harness design for satellite system requiring interfacing across mechanical, electrical and payload design owners, trading various configurations to identify best overall solution for reliability, manufacturability, test, integration, and cost.
- Support make vs buy decisions, design reviews, and implement manufacturing and integration plans optimized for high rate production.
- Engage various component suppliers and Harnessing manufacturing vendors for component & assembly level qualification.
- Design/develop specifications and produce/procure power/data harnesses which meets electrical design requirements including current rating, targeted power loss, shielding, grounding and EMI/EMC.
- Perform/oversee harness qualification and acceptance tests for launch environments and operation through mission life, including test fixture fabrication for prototype evaluations, and deliver all development and flight hardware per vehicle schedules
- Create 3D CAD routings, 2D manufacturing drawings, schematics, and assembly installation drawings.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Harness Design Engineer, you will be the technical authority on interconnect and cabling solutions. You will provide technical leadership to the team while developing novel space hardware. You will play an integral part of gathering requirements for harness development as well as providing critical input for successful development of avionics hardware.

About the team
On the Harnessing Team, each member has the freedom to explore new ideas and explore their feasibility. Collaboration is critical to success and is always a high priority both within the team, as well as when working with other teams. While you are an individual contributor, it is still expected that each member takes ownership when needed. No job/task is beneath any member.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- 5+ years of experience in the selection of wiring based on current de-rating, voltage drop analysis, shielding effectiveness, temperature, environment, outgassing and mechanical strength.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with JIRA, or related collaborative workflow
- 5+ years of experience in the design, development, test, qualification and acceptance tests, workmanship criteria and integration of spacecraft harnessing.
- 5+ years experience working with external suppliers to develop/select components for spacecraft design or related industries.
- Experience in developing mechanical harness routing solutions for dynamic applications including across articulated joints and hinged-line deployments.
- Experience with Siemens NX CAD and formboard creation, Team center PLM and MES systems
- Experience with Siemens Capital Software Suite

title: Robotics Systems Engineer , Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org.

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop. Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America.

You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits for you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets.

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related STEM field
- Experience working in or around a construction, manufacturing, warehouse, or simliar environment
- 1+ years' experience with technical drawings and/or reading CAD models (mechanical and electrical)
- 1+ years' Experience working on mechanical, electrical, IT networked, or software systems
- Understanding of data collection, reporting processes, and ability to make data-driven decisions
- Ability to review data to set troubleshoot priorities on highly complex technical systems
- Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Interest to work primarily in a construction or warehouse environment in a field-based role
- Ability to travel domestically 75% or more of the year

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration experience
- 1+ years of building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments experience
- Knowledge of configuration management systems, such as Puppet, Chef, Ansible, or related systems
- Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration
- Experience in network capture and systems troubleshooting
- Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments
- Proven experience working on hardware integration or complex mechanical-electrical or networked industrial equipment. Knowledge of specific robotic equipment (Fanuc, ABB), and Allen Bradley PLC experience
- Certified in OSHA, ANSI, or other Automation Safety Certifications. Familiarity with LEAN or Six Sigma, certifications are a plus

title: Program Manager, Amazon Freight Partner (AFP) Program
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) is a rapidly growing, global operation unit, which significantly impacts the customer experience. Within ATS, Amazon Freight Partner (AFP) is a program that enables entrepreneurs to start and grow their trucking business alongside Amazon, with exclusive and customized learning, ability to hire from their local communities, and long-term growth potential. It’s also the preferred supply type to launch and trial new technology such as Zero Emission Vehicles (ZEV).

The Amazon Freight Partner team is seeking candidates with entrepreneurial spirit who are quick learners and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment. We are looking for a Program Manager to help us to continue spearheading the electrification of the worldwide Amazon Middle Mile. You will contribute to the Amazon Climate pledge – our commitment made in 2019 to reach net-zero carbon emissions by 2040.

As key member of a cross functional and global team you will 1) Lead the ZEV weekly business review to drive and continuously improve operations of the existing BET fleet, 2) Manage deployment of new ZEVs across Europe, 3) Build business cases for strategic initiatives, 4) Coordinate due diligence on cross-business collaborations ensuring financial/operational viability and high carrier experience, 5) Influence and build the strategic BET expansion roadmap.

We are actively seeking a data and technology driven innovator, problem solver, comfortable solving ambiguous problems and focused on delighting our customers. You must have experience and be comfortable working with teams across all levels of different organizations.

This role offers an opportunity to make business-critical decisions that will transform the current transportation environment while influencing Senior Leadership on the direction for the Middle Mile business.

Some occasional domestic and international travel required (<10%).

Key job responsibilities
- Own the BET WBR and design/monitor metrics tracking BET fleet growth and operational health
- Contribute to the BET expansion strategy and define the deployment roadmap with cross-functional partners
- Support AFP carriers through vehicle deployment and overcoming payment/operational disparities
- Orchestrate driver type changes for the electric fleet to boost efficiency and achieve diesel TCO parity
- Manage the transition towards a variable consumption-based payment working with 3P vendors, Tax, Accounting, FinOps, and Finance)
- Monitor project execution and customer feedback to ensure quality delivery on target

About the team
Amazon couldn’t deliver at pace without the Amazon Transportation Service (ATS) team. As part of ATS, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centers equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.

We put safety first as our people are our priority, and we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

#TECHNOLOGY #SUSTAINABILITY #TRANSPORT #MIDDLEMILE #ZEROEMISSION #CLIMATEPLEDGE #FASTFORWARD

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience defining and executing program requirements
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience delivering cross functional projects

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals

- Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

title: Senior Business Coach, Delivery Service Partner Program
descriptionHtml:
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses.

The Senior Business Coach (BC) helps Amazon improve the flexibility and quality of its delivery network in the Americas—to help fuel a $4B investment in rural communities bringing even faster delivery to our millions of customers in less densely populated areas. This role’s primary focus is supporting DSP operations across the broader Americas delivery network, with particular emphasis on rural market expansion and mature-state optimization. Specifically, BCs support DSPs in making business decisions that enable them to build healthy, sustainable businesses. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs, supporting business planning and strategy and helping owners address business and operational challenges.

What You’ll Do
As Senior Business Coach (BC), you will manage a portfolio of Delivery Service Partner (DSP) owners within the Amazon delivery network. With the evolution of delivery modes and rural expansion planned for 2026, and continued strategic expansion into 2027, this role is integral to our program's evolution. Sr. BCs provide strategic guidance to DSP owners throughout their business life-cycle of their relationship with Amazon—from pre-launch preparation through mature-state optimization. You will facilitate solution-oriented approaches to remove business obstacles and drive continuous improvement in financial performance, operational efficiency, and safety standards across the network. The position requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, including operations managers, program directors, compliance officers, legal counsel, and finance teams. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, strategic problem-solving skills, and the ability to implement data-driven recommendations that create meaningful change both internally and externally.


Key job responsibilities
Operational Excellence & Financial Advisory
• Lead DSP owners through critical business phases including launch, operational scaling, and seasonal demand optimization
• Provide comprehensive consultation on financial management and operational optimization
• Support development of scalable business processes to ensure consistent performance metrics
• Navigate program evolution by helping owners implement and adapt to strategic changes within traditional DSP operations, including new service types and offerings such as rural delivery expansion and delivery capabilities
• Conduct data-driven business reviews, delivering performance insights and competitive benchmarking analysis

Business Development & Program Management
• Evaluate and interview potential candidates for the DSP program, ensuring alignment with program standards and objectives
• Guide strategic planning and execution of network capacity management

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Enhancement
• Foster strong DSP community engagement through coordination of local events and regional initiatives
• Build and maintain productive relationships with regional stakeholders
• Identify operational inefficiencies and champion process improvements across the network
• Design and implement solutions to enhance overall program effectiveness and DSP owner experience

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor and primary account manager, combining strategic insight with practical business acumen to drive sustainable growth and operational excellence across the DSP network.


A day in the life
Strategic Leadership & Decision Making
• Drive both strategic initiatives and tactical execution to achieve business objectives
• Leverage industry expertise to establish priorities, optimize account management strategies, and develop sustainable long-term solutions
• Navigate ambiguous business environments to formulate clear strategic direction and influence cross-functional priorities
• Demonstrate sound judgment in solution design, balancing complexity with efficiency

Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Lead resolution of complex business challenges through detailed analysis and effective escalation management
• Foster collaborative relationships across multiple business units and organizational levels
• Develop and maintain strong partnerships with key stakeholders through exceptional relationship management
• Deliver compelling verbal and written communications, including executive-level presentations and strategic recommendations

Location & Travel Requirements
• Position is headquartered at our Nashville Hub
• Work arrangement includes structured mix of office presence, field travel, and remote work days. One week per month is dedicated to in-office collaboration at respective/team’s Hub. Significant field engagement is required: minimum 3 days per week of travel for 3 weeks monthly to support portfolio of Delivery Service Partners
• Must be comfortable with regular travel and maintaining a flexible schedule

The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional problem-solving capabilities, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence outcomes in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


About the team
ABOUT AMAZON LOGISTICS
At Amazon Logistics (AMZL), our goal is to provide customers with an incredible package delivery experience through the last mile of the order. To achieve this goal, we partner with a network of small independent delivery businesses (Delivery Service Providers) and the independent contractor community (Amazon Flex) to deliver customer orders. Utilizing continuous improvement initiatives and creative thinking, our Delivery Station teams ensure that millions of packages reach their final destination as efficiently as possible.

title: Pre-Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for independently managing difficult, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — supporting Amazon's logistics network infrastructure.

You work independently within your assigned region, using your knowledge of construction and project management concepts to decide which actions to take to complete projects, and seeking guidance as needed on strategic components. You are tactical with some strategic components, utilizing well-defined processes and best practices to facilitate delivery of high-quality results. You make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to keep projects on track.

Key competencies of this position include ensuring that contracted resources deliver work product in support of project durations, permitting, key performance indicators (KPIs), and quality documentation; managing project teams (developers, design engineers, professional consultants); influencing internal teams (Design Engineering, Amazon Robotics); contract management governance; conceptual estimating and budget oversight; and managing multiple large industrial projects in various locations simultaneously. Translating technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers is essential.

This opportunity combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, design validation, site visits, understanding of local building and fire code issues, utilities, sustainability, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management. The Preconstruction Manager is responsible for the planning and design of scope, budget, and schedule prior to handing off to the Construction Manager — focusing on taking ownership to resolve upstream issues and supporting the construction team throughout the process.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Supervise the implementation and management of Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases of a project
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability
- Minimize disruptions and proactively mitigate risks; plan ahead to prevent problems before they happen

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Develop and manage project budgets and costs; own comprehensive schedule management and cashflow forecasting across assigned preconstruction projects
- Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; negotiate the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
- Contribute to the selection of external vendor partners and manage vendor procurement; oversee professional service providers to ensure their skills and competencies meet project requirements
- Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
- Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
- Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; competently represent project and technical information to diverse audiences
- Maintain good working relationships with stakeholders and vendors; lead constructive dialogue to resolve and prevent project issues
- Act as the primary escalation point for project team members; own and track issues to ensure they are addressed, documented, and resolved

Communication & Reporting
- Prepare and present project status and risk reports; provide clear, concise summaries for projects under your ownership to leadership and management teams
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, checking progress, and driving high-level alignment and consensus
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to 2-3 tiers above level
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement & Innovation
- Optimize preconstruction processes and implement improvements in procedures and playbooks to improve project efficiency and delivery
- Look for opportunities to improve operational excellence and influence the team to determine where to iterate and make improvements
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the preconstruction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Adapt to constant change and innovation; find adaptable solutions for an evolving business

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's owner during the preconstruction phase — navigating uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers, and influencing the best project decisions. You are tactical with some strategic components, working independently and interacting with leadership to resolve issues. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with architects, engineers, and design consultants on design document development, scope changes, and project status
- Reviewing site plans, composite floor plans, and design documents for compliance with Amazon's standards and operational requirements
- Negotiating contract terms with developers, contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
- Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
- Preparing and presenting project status and risk reports for leadership
- Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
- Providing estimating support, interpreting drawings, contributing to budgets, and reviewing lease exhibits
- Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
- Supporting the Construction Manager on active construction projects with preconstruction expertise

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management or an equivalent engineering science
- Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline
- 5+ years of project management experience from design phase through implementation and operation, including negotiating construction, procurement, and labor contracts
- Experience within packaging, processing, or logistical facilities with complex equipment, or comparable experience
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or certification in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills
- Demonstrated success communicating project requirements to diverse audiences (e.g., senior management, peers, fire marshals, utility providers, public officials, vendors)
- Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent

title: Snr Partnerships Manager, European Consumer Business, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced satellite broadband network to deliver fast, affordable connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO), Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering reliable broadband to consumers, businesses, and government agencies globally.

The Consumer Europe team is responsible for bringing Amazon Leo to residential customers across the region through two channels: direct-to-consumer (B2C) and indirect-to-consumer (B2B2C). The indirect channel delivers Amazon Leo services through partnerships with telecommunications operators and internet service providers (ISPs) who own the customer relationship while leveraging Amazon Leo's technology infrastructure.

We are seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to own the commercial performance and partner relationships across our European Consumer indirect portfolio. You will own the customer relationship across a number of Consumer indirect partnerships, primarily in Central Europe and Amazon's emerging European markets. This role is both strategic and operational; you will shape partner requirements, validate deals, support onboarding, and own the post-launch commercial relationship with accountability for revenue, customer experience, and long-term partner success. Beyond day-to-day partner management, you will help define how the regional indirect team operates; building mechanisms, establishing ways of working, and creating frameworks for scalable partner engagement across Europe.

This position may require access to export-controlled information (ECI) subject to EAR and ITAR. Final employment decision is contingent upon satisfactory completion of export control screenings and obtaining any necessary export licenses or approvals, based on nationality, citizenship, and other factors considered by applicable export control regulations.

• Lead formal strategic meetings to review commercial performance, success metrics, and future goals

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Networking team is looking for software engineers who have a passion for diving deep while also being able to see the big picture. We are re-engineering our virtual networking control plane as part of Amazon’s initiative to get EC2 performance to be as close as possible to that of bare metal. This role would involve being part of the team that owns building, scaling, and maintaining high performance software to streamline the management of millions of Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) configurations.

If you are a Software Engineer with a strong background coding in Linux, a passion for improving quality, solving challenging problems and curiosity about virtual networking, then this is your opportunity to own major deliverables and all aspects of the development cycle: scoping, design, implementation, and testing. You will be encouraged to exercise judgment in proactively determining and recommending the best features, designs, and support models based on business objectives, timelines, and resource constraints.

What makes this team a great place to work? Our services underpin the fabric of the EC2 cloud. You have the opportunity to make a large impact and drive the road map for the Amazon cloud.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud services and features that power AWS's core infrastructure
- Collaborate with product managers and senior engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
- Write high-quality, efficient code while adhering to AWS's architectural best practices
- Participate in code reviews to ensure quality, security, and performance standards
- Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across AWS services
- Implement automated testing frameworks to ensure reliability and performance
- Contribute to on-call rotations to support production systems
- Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance
- Document system designs, APIs, and operational procedures
- Continuously evaluate and improve existing systems for performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency
- Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends

About the team
Our team actively supports new members through knowledge-sharing and mentorship. With diverse experience levels, we provide one-on-one mentoring and thorough code reviews. We prioritize your career growth by assigning projects that build your engineering expertise and prepare you for increasingly complex challenges.

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: IB /OB Area Manager, Worldwide Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager. We promise you will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential. As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, join our team in Amazon Operations as an Area Manager.
As an Area Manager, you will have the opportunity to lead and develop your own team of Amazon Associates in a sort center environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring and coaching your team. As a servant leader, the Area Manager will ensure that their team of Amazon Associates have all the tools needed to succeed for any task during a shift. Engaging with your team during a shift to ensure that the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance performance and engagement are maintained are core functions of the role. Come learn how the largest online retailer in the world runs its fulfillment and delivery networks!

As IB / OB Area Manager or Delivery Shift Manager, you will be in charge of part of the operation of our work centers during an assigned shift. These operations involve the management of human, technological and physical resources to ensure the correct execution of the daily operation plan aligned with results.
Within these functions you will be mainly in charge of:
• Continuous improvement pillar: Propose, plan and execute continuous improvement strategies that seek continuous operational efficiency.
• Industrial Safety Pillar: During the shift, you are the main person in charge of safeguarding the well-being of the personnel under your charge, being directly or indirectly hired by the company.
• Pilar Talent Management: Being a Manager at Amazon is a privilege and a responsibility, as a Manager, you will be focused on hiring and developing a workforce who will become the next Amazon leaders.
• Operational Pillar: Review the operational forecast and determine productivity requirements for the operation.
This role is fully onsite and requires flexibility to work and rotate shifts: weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, and Ability to work overtime both in peak season and as needed.

Responsibilities:
• You will be part of the Amazon Operations Team, responsible of the day-to-day management of the site, overseeing the operation that focuses on the delivery of Amazon orders direct to customers.
• Leading a direct/indirect team to ensure that you have a safe work place, properly trained people, and that their needs are addressed so they can focus on their jobs.
• Support and assign job duties to process assistants.
• Due to the nature of Amazon’s business, being able to adapt to sudden changes and growth according to operational necessities.
• Communicate policies to Associates and act as the primary information source for the team, maintaining compliance, consistency, and taking corrective action when needed
• Create, manage, and support recognition and communication programs
• Ensure procedures are followed for building security and product loss prevention
• Partner with the management team to establish and maintain quality control standards
• Develop performance goals and objectives to achieve customer demand and ensure accuracy and quality

Key job responsibilities
· Lead, manage, and develop a team of 20 to 50 Amazon Associates
· Communicate policies to Associates and act as the primary information source for the team, maintaining compliance, consistency, and taking corrective action when needed
· Create, manage, and support recognition and communication programs
· Support all safety programs and OSHA compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all Associates
· Ensure procedures are followed for building security and product loss prevention
· Partner with the management team to establish and maintain quality control standards
· Develop performance goals and objectives to achieve customer demand and ensure accuracy and quality


Job Elements
Must be able to perform the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
· Stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours
· Walk in/and around the warehouse with great frequency; many facilities are over a quarter mile in length
· Access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation)
· Regularly bend, lift, stretch and reach both below the waist and above the head
· Lift and move items up to 49 pounds

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can push and pull wheeled dollies loaded with products up to 100 pounds during shifts

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: Principal Product Manager Technical, AWS Applied AI Solutions - Core Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager Technical to own and drive the product strategy, revenue, and adoption for AI Agent Evaluations within our Core Services AI Foundations team. You will be responsible for defining the long-term vision and building the business around evaluation capabilities that enable development teams to measure, benchmark, and continuously improve the quality, safety, and reliability of their AI powered agents. This includes owning the full product lifecycle from concept through GTM for evaluation tooling, quality scoring methodologies, regression testing frameworks, and human review workflows. You will own one or more products in production while also getting in on the ground floor of new projects that bring evaluation capabilities to customers worldwide.

As a Principal Product Manager you will be part of the larger product leadership community at AWS. This community plays a critical role in broad business planning working closely with senior management to develop business targets and resource requirements influencing long term technical and business strategy helping hire a talented team of PMs and enabling us to deliver solutions rapidly. You will be seen as the subject matter expert for AI evaluation within Amazon AI.

A successful candidate will bring a passion for technology services strong business acumen and judgment proven experience launching products and building business around them ability to define products desire to have an industry wide impact and ability to work within a fast moving environment in a large company to rapidly deliver services that have broad business impact. You will work backward from the needs of development teams building agentic AI applications and define how they assess agent behavior across dimensions including correctness, safety, groundedness, and customer satisfaction. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science teams to translate complex evaluation methodologies into products that scale across diverse use cases and agent architectures.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead product definition for AI agent evaluation capabilities owning the customer working backwards strategy tenets, long-term goals, and working backwards documents including customer and market feedback competitive analysis and business metrics to inform direction • Define product vision including all aspects of future roadmap investment innovation and experimentation for automated evaluation pipelines human review workflows and quality benchmarking tools • Own execution of product planning and development including customer goals and business requirements for product releases ensuring implementation is aligned with product goals and ownership of product positioning • Lead product launches owning GTM plans that deliver results ensuring customer and business goals are met in operational launch plans • Create and revise GTM strategy and be responsible for pricing new features and updating pricing for existing features working closely with finance • Work with field and BD teams to create customer funnel and drive POC to pilot to production motions • Be responsible for creating and reporting on the service's revenue and customer traction through weekly and monthly business reports shared with leadership • Partner with applied scientists and engineers to translate research into production grade product features • Drive alignment across dependent teams (identity, observability, data platform) to ensure evaluation signals integrate seamlessly with the broader Core Services AI Foundations platform • Lead interaction with the technical team including helping make tradeoffs based on customer requirements and QA/testing of the product

A day in the life
You split your time between building the business (developing partnership strategy earning trust with stakeholders defining GTM) and building the product (writing requirements working closely with engineering driving launches). On any given day you might be meeting with a customer's engineering leadership to understand how they assess agent quality at scale presenting product strategy and business results to senior leadership reviewing a pricing model with finance working with field teams on a customer POC or collaborating with applied scientists on how to productize new evaluation research. You operate with high independence across ambiguous problem spaces make tradeoffs across competing priorities and own outcomes from requirements through launch and sustained business growth.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
- 5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)
- Experience with machine learning or AI systems, including familiarity with model evaluation, testing methodologies, or quality assurance frameworks
- Demonstrated ability to write clear, detailed technical product documents (PR/FAQs, technical specifications, architecture diagrams) and drive engineering teams to consensus

Preferred qualifications

- MBA or advanced degree in a technical discipline
- Experience with LLM evaluation, AI safety testing, or automated quality assurance for generative AI systems
- Track record of building and launching evaluation or testing platforms at scale
- Experience working with applied scientists to productize research into customer facing features
- Familiarity with AWS services (AgentCore, SageMaker) and agentic AI frameworks (LangFuse)
- Strong track record of shaping business strategy for technical products or services for large enterprises or partners
- Prior experience bringing to life 0 to 1 AI powered offerings

title: Site Process Engineer, ARS
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, driven, and diverse leaders. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers.
 
Amazon is seeking leaders to work with the Central Operations Process Engineering (PE) team. The PE team is a globally diverse group of operational leaders driving process stabilization, standardization and continuous improvement for the Global Customer Fulfillment (GCF) Network. This team is essential to establish and execute benchmark operating standards, accelerate implementation of technology advancements and to strengthen process knowledge for the operational leaders across the FC network. As we continue to rapidly grow our FC footprint and infuse the organization with new talent, we need to ensure the operations teams are equipped with the needed process knowledge, established standards and benchmark practices for great process control. The team will utilize tools to understand process control and establish process understanding with the outcome of minimizing variation between shifts, buildings and regions, by driving standard operating procedures to deliver strong performance. The team will also work closely with ACES leadership to define, teach, and translate standard work across the GCF Network.

Key job responsibilities
As a Process Engineer, you will have the opportunity to join a diverse team of leaders with the objectives to pursue variation reduction, optimize standard work to reduce cost, and build mechanisms to drive compliance toward the standards. You will be responsible for the prioritization of efforts within the buildings, region, and super region to reduce variation from the standards and ultimately improve process control and performance. This role requires the ability to insist on the highest standards for process execution, interpret data, and lead through influence to deliver meaningful results translating to tangible productivity and efficiency gains across the super region. Some of the position’s key responsibilities include:
- Evaluate performance objectives and metrics across the site and super region to proactively identify process improvement opportunities and largest gaps to benchmark performance supporting prioritization efforts for improvement opportunities
- Audit, teach, and drive execution to the benchmark standards while acting as a catalyst for continuous improvement and process execution in the super region
- Develop and implement detailed standard operating procedures to support daily operations within established process control limits for each fulfillment process
- Partner with operational leaders within the FCs to execute implementation of established standard work and process improvements driving stabilization and standardization across the super region
- Play a critical role in training operational leaders in the FCs as it relates to knowledge gaps within the super region to support reduction of variation in process standards
- Partner with support teams for reviewing critical inputs, new training, best practice sharing, and documentation to drive benchmark performance
- Execute, measure and support communication of variation reduction impacts in partnership with the site leaders responsible for day to day operations
- Work with cross-functional teams such as Engineering, AFT, Learning and Talent Development and ACES to deliver and deploy network wide initiatives
- Ability to travel up to 50% of the time to FCs across the designated super region. There may be travel outside the established super region for specialized trainings or continuous improvement efforts.
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts

If you have concerns related to the increased travel time, please speak to your leader or manager; we are happy to discuss. As we begin a new year, we are confident that this structure will continue to drive our “customer obsession” in supporting our leaders and buildings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: Operations Manager für Führungskräfte mit militärischem Hintergrund (m/w/d) - standortübergreifend
descriptionHtml:
Wir setzen alles daran, einen Standort in Ihrer bevorzugten Region zu finden — deutschlandweit. Sprechen Sie uns an, und wir prüfen gemeinsam die Möglichkeiten.

Amazon leistet Pionierarbeit.

Seit dem Start unserer Online-Plattform im Jahre 1995 haben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen immer wieder neu definiert.

"We actively seek leaders, who can Invent, think big, have a bias for action, and deliver results on behalf of our customers." – Jeff Bezos

Entscheidend für eine Führungsposition in unseren Logistikzentren ist die Fähigkeit ein Team zu führen, Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter zu motivieren und zu inspirieren, sich und dem Team ambitionierte und erreichbare Ziele zu setzen und diese Ziele dann zusammen umzusetzen.

Viele Zeitsoldatinnen und -soldaten haben jahrelang solche wertvollen Erfahrungen gesammelt und Amazon bietet die Möglichkeit, diese Erfahrungen und das Wissen nun in der Wirtschaft einzubringen.

Das Military Recruiting Team von Amazon steht zur Verfügung, um die zahlreichen Möglichkeiten innerhalb von Amazon Operations zu erörtern.

Wir haben die gleichen Erwartungen an alle Führungskräfte, egal ob sie militärische Erfahrung haben oder nicht: Pionierarbeit für die Kundinnen und Kunden leisten und weiter daran arbeiten, Amazon zum kundenorientiertesten Unternehmen der Welt zu machen.

Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem erfahrenen Operations Manager (m/w/d) zur Unterstützung unseres Logistikteams.

Als Operations Manager sind Sie in der Lage, Ihre Teams zu begeistern und zu unterstützen. Gleichzeitig sind Sie bereit, die Ärmel hochzukrempeln und mit anzupacken, wenn Bedarf besteht.

Sie werden die Führung eines Teams von Area Managern und deren Mitarbeitern übernehmen und gleichzeitig dem Senior Operations Manager Ihres Versandzentrums Bericht erstatten. Die Qualität Ihrer Führungsarbeit ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg in dieser Position: Sie begeistern und motivieren Ihre Teams zu Bestleistungen und sorgen durch die Planung von Terminen und Aktivitäten für ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mitarbeiter- und Unternehmensanforderungen.

Ein weiterer wichtiger Bestandteil Ihrer Tätigkeit wird die Leitung von Projekten zur Prozessoptimierung sein, mit dem Ziel, alle Aktivitäten, sowohl Ihre eigenen als auch die Ihrer Teammitglieder, zu vereinfachen. Die Ideen, Innovationen und Veränderungen des Status quo, die Sie entwickeln, könnten im gesamten Amazon Netzwerk umgesetzt werden: Lassen Sie sich diese Riesenchance nicht entgehen.

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre zentralen Aufgaben werden das Management, die Kontrolle, die Organisation und Führung operativer Outbound- oder Inbound-Bereiche an Ihrem Standort sein. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

• Umsetzung von Gesundheits- und Arbeitsschutzstandards in Ihrem Aufgabenbereich sowie Förderung und Anregung einer Gesundheits- und Arbeitsschutzkultur vor Ort • Aneignung von Fachwissen über spezifische übergeordnete Prozesse und Aktivitäten innerhalb der Versandzentren, z. B. Kenntnisse zu 5S-Audits • Zeitnahe Datenerfassung durch stündliche Aktualisierung der operativen Kennzahlen in Ihrer Bestandskontroll- und Systemumgebung • Einhaltung von Produktivitätszielen, Reduzierung von Kosten pro Einheit, Vermeidung von Fehlern und Sicherstellung eines herausragenden Einkaufserlebnisses für unsere Kunden • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen (Personal, Finanzen, Anlagen, Sicherheit, IT) im Hinblick auf Personalbesetzungs- und Zeitpläne sowie Leistungsniveaus • Umsetzen von Prozessänderungen und Teilnahme an funktionsübergreifenden Six-Sigma-Maßnahmen an Ihrem Standort und dem weiteren europäischen Logistiknetzwerk von Amazon

Basic qualifications

- - Sie verfügen über eine Abschlussqualifikation einer anerkannten Einrichtung, mind. auf Bachelorniveau.
- - Sie haben bereits Erfahrung in der Leitung großer, vielseitiger Teams gesammelt.
- - Sie verfügen über hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift in fließendem Deutsch und Englisch.
- - Sie sind in mindestens zwei Bereichen der Fertigungs- oder Logistikkette fachlich kompetent und können eine beachtliche Erfolgsbilanz in einer ähnlichen dynamischen Logistik-, Distributions- oder Fertigungsumgebung nachweisen.
- - Sie arbeiten detailorientiert, wenden Ursachenanalysen an und sind in der Lage, die hierbei generierten Daten auszuwerten.
- - Sie sehen Veränderungen als Entwicklungsmöglichkeit an und sind bei Bedarf bereit, Ihren Standort zu wechseln.
- - Sie wissen dass Schichtarbeit und Wochenendarbeit in unserem Umfeld unumgänglich sind.

Preferred qualifications

- - Masterabschluss.
- - Kaizen- und Lean-Methoden sowie verwandte Techniken sind Ihnen nicht unbekannt.
- Was wir bieten
- Wir erwarten von Ihnen höchste Einsatzbereitschaft und werden diese entsprechend honorieren. Neben einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung, Bezugsrechten für Aktien und standortabhängigen Leistungsprämien bieten wir zahlreiche weitere Arbeitgeberleistungen, wie z. B. Belegschaftsrabatte.
- Amazon verfolgt als Arbeitgeber den Grundsatz der Chancengleichheit. Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft wesentlich zu unserem Erfolg beiträgt. Wir treffen Einstellungsentscheidungen basierend auf Ihren Erfahrungen und Qualifikationen. Wir wissen Ihre Begeisterung für das Entdecken, Erfinden, Vereinfachen und Erstellen zu schätzen. Bei gleicher Qualifikation werden Schwerbehinderte bevorzugt behandelt.
- Amazon nimmt den Schutz Ihrer persönlichen Daten ernst und respektiert die nationalen Datenschutzgesetze sowie die EU-Rechtsvorschriften zum Datenschutz. Sofern nicht anders vereinbart, erlauben Sie dem einstellenden Unternehmen von Amazon durch Einreichung Ihres Lebenslaufs, Ihre persönlichen Daten in der elektronischen Datenbank zu speichern, die von Amazon Corporate LLC. in den USA oder von einer Tochtergesellschaft zum Zweck der Feststellung Ihrer Eignung für diese und für zukünftig angebotene Stellen sowie zur Verfolgung Ihres Bewerbungsprozesses unterhalten wird.
- Wenn Sie wünschen, dass Ihre persönlichen Daten gelöscht werden, können Sie das einstellende Unternehmen jederzeit darüber benachrichtigen. Amazon gibt Ihre Daten ohne Ihre vorherige Zustimmung nicht an Dritte weiter. Im Rahmen des Interviewprozesses mit Amazon werden Sie möglicherweise dazu aufgefordert, dem einstellenden Unternehmen von Amazon zu gestatten, Ihre Bewerbungsdaten und Ihren Lebenslauf separat durch einen Drittanbieter prüfen zu lassen.

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (m/f/d), Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for delivery of best practice systems and problem resolution on all data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure (UPS, MV electrical systems, generators, cooling systems etc.) within the data center environment in a specific location. The role requires a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to complex technical problems. This position requires frequent site interventions, critical switching activities, along with troubleshooting and fixing infrastructure issues. The role would suit someone who enjoys working in a ‘hands on’ capacity on Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) infrastructure such as diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, fire detection systems and building automation systems. You will report to the Data Center Engineering Operations Manager.



A day in the life
The successful candidate will be accountable for:

· Setting and maintaining the highest standards for safety and actively promoting a world-class safety culture in all aspects of operational procedure
· Driving continuous improvement efforts on infrastructure through standardization of procedures and policies, while delivering performance against agreed metrics
· Enabling the operations organization to delivering 100% up-time on all customer supporting infrastructure
· Collaborating effectively with internal & external stakeholders to deliver operational excellence for all AWS customers
· Responsible for ensuring that the preventive maintenance of site-critical facility infrastructure is planned and executed to the highest standards, in accordance to AWS procedures
· In charge of facility monitoring & supervision (via BMS, PMS, Walkthrough...etc.)
· Participation in the successful delivery of build-out and retrofit of Data Center infrastructure
· Ensuring organizational capability to react & respond appropriately to any potential customer-impacting event on any component of electrical or mechanical infrastructure.
· Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management
· Draft, update & maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation pertaining to DCEO

Physical Requirements:
· Work on a 24x7 schedule (where applicable)
· Work at heights and from ladders.
· Perform physical tasks during the shift
· Work in a noisy environment with ear protection

title: Data Center Project Manager, Critical Projects Implementation
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operational data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data center facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.

title: Senior VAT Compliance Analyst, International Indirect Tax Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's diverse business requires VAT filings in a number of jurisdictions globally. Amazon is seeking an energetic and enthusiastic Senior VAT Compliance Tax Analyst to work in its International Indirect Tax Compliance team. This position will be responsible (as part of a larger team) for the preparation of ESS VAT returns and related filings. • Prepare, analyse and submit ESS VAT returns and related filings;

• Prepare and review month-end VAT account reconciliations;

title: Design Verification Engineer, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:

You’ll be part of a team that drives innovation in custom chip development, directly impacting the future of cloud computing.

As a member of the Cloud-Scale Machine Learning Acceleration team you’ll be developing hardware solution for AWS data center including AWS Inferentia,Trainium systems - custom designed machine learning data center accelerator.

We are looking for a passionate Design Verification Engineer to join our newly formed team responsible for verifying high-speed I/O and scale-up/out components across the SoC. You will take full ownership of delivering comprehensive verification solutions at a sub-system/chip level, with strong emphasis on system-wide implications and interactions. This role requires developing and implementing verification environments using state-of-the-art simulation methodology. You will create robust test scenarios and collaborate closely with design, architecture, and software teams to ensure thorough coverage of hardware-software interfaces and cross-module functionality.

- Build and implement verification environments using advanced simulation methodologies and industry-standard tools

title: Sr. Program Manager, Integrated Planning, GEMS, NA Startup
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to join the Startup Integrated Planning team within the Global Engineering, Materials, & Sustainability (GEMS) organization. This team owns the integrated planning function for North America's infrastructure project portfolio, connecting cross-functional workstreams into unified, reliable schedules that guide execution across large-scale new build and expansion/retrofit projects.

This Sr. Program Manager will contribute to the strategic evolution of the integrated planning program, helping mature planning as a discipline. The role oversees a team of contracted project planners, setting the bar for quality and ensuring consistent delivery, while balancing program-level strategy, cross-functional influence, and scaling mechanisms.

This is a rapidly scaling environment where processes exist but are still maturing. Success requires strategic thinking, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the judgment to refine and extend existing frameworks. A strong background in integrated scheduling is critical for providing effective program management at this scale.

This role requires up to 50% travel in the US and Canada and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
Program Strategy & Contracted Planner Oversight
• Shape and advance the workforce and vendor strategy for contracted planners, including capacity modeling, skill-mix optimization, and procurement negotiations that scale with portfolio growth.
• Oversee contracted project planners: set expectations, provide training on planning standards, review deliverable quality, and support escalations.
• Assign and rebalance planners across projects based on priority, complexity, and workload.
• Track project budgets, manage invoicing, and provide funding inputs for planning resources.

Planning Quality, Standards, & Governance

• Ensure weekly planning status reports are accurate, complete, and distributed on time to stakeholders.

Standardization & Continuous Improvement
• Develop, maintain, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures for all planning activities.
• Develop and improve planning tools, templates, and AI-driven automations to boost planner productivity and eliminate manual workflows.
• Identify and lead initiatives that advance planning maturity, including automation, tooling, and capability building.
• Capture lessons learned from completed projects and convert them into repeatable, scalable best practices.

Risk Management & Reporting
• Identify and mitigate program-level planning risks; own escalation paths and drive issues to resolution.
• Ensure planners identify cross-functional dependencies and surface risks early, before they become execution problems.
• Develop and refine risk and reporting frameworks that give leadership the signal needed to make portfolio-level decisions
• Provide clear, data-driven status reporting to senior leadership on portfolio-wide planning performance.

Program-Level Cross-Functional Partnership
• Build and maintain program-level relationships with key partner functions (design, operations, construction, launch, IT, engineering) to drive planning adoption and standardization.
• Serve as the planning liaison with partner functions, championing integrated scheduling practices and ensuring planning inputs are prioritized.
• Drive continuous improvement of integrated planning by gathering feedback from partner functions and refining how planning intersects with their workflows.
• Represent the Integrated Planning program in global and cross-functional forums, aligning planning standards and resolving systemic gaps across disciplines.

descriptionHtml:
