title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Social Advertising
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever discovered a product through a creator you follow on social media, then bought it on Amazon? Do you wonder how brands find the right creators to partner with at scale?

We are building a new social advertising product that helps brands find customers on social media apps through creators. As the Principal PMT for this new product, you will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap. You'll define how brands discover high-affinity creators, how campaigns get activated, how creators get compensated, and how the whole system integrates with Amazon's existing advertising products (DSP, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Creator Ads). You need to be fluent in both worlds: how creators build audiences and monetize content on social platforms, AND how brands evaluate and buy media programmatically.

This is a 0-to-1 role. You would be building a new product from the ground up, working backwards from what brands and creators need to define how the product serves both customers and how it goes to market. If you have built creator tools, advertising products, or multi-sided marketplaces, and especially if you have done more than one of those, we want to talk.

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Product Manager-Technical for this new product, you will be responsible for building a new product at the intersection of the creator economy and advertising technology. To thrive in this role, you will need to demonstrate:
- Bilateral Fluency: You understand both sides of the marketplace: how creators build audiences, create content, and monetize on social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) AND how brands evaluate, buy, and measure media programmatically. You can context-switch between a conversation about creator authenticity and one about ROAS measurement without losing either thread.
- 0-to-1 Builder Instinct: You are an expert at evaluating whether to take a scrappy approach or spend the time to build a durable solution. Every wrong call here costs precious time. You have a track record of getting this right consistently in ambiguous, early-stage environments where there is no playbook to follow.
- Cross-Org Influence: This product delivers most of its value through other teams' systems. You will do significant away-team work in Ads, Associates, and external platform integrations. You earn trust from day one and maintain it through hard conversations where you push partner teams to do things they would not otherwise prioritize.
- Data-Grounded Conviction: You use data to form strong opinions, state them clearly, and update them when evidence warrants. You do not hedge conclusions the data supports, and you do not overstate conclusions it does not.
- Technical Depth: You can engage meaningfully with scientists on matching algorithms, with engineers on API design, and with ads teams on DSP integration architecture. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand the tradeoffs well enough to make product decisions that are technically sound.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing creator-brand match quality metrics and slates of individual creators from yesterday's pilot cohort. A brand partner wants to understand why certain creators rank high for their category. You pull the attribution data and walk them through the quantitative signal: which creators are driving conversions for their brand, at what volume, and how that compares to their managed roster. You then shift to qualitative evaluation of the creator's content, audience fit, and brand alignment. Mid-morning, you're in a working session with the science team debating whether to weight recent conversion velocity or lifetime brand affinity more heavily in the matching algorithm. After lunch, you're drafting the integration spec for how campaigns for this new product will surface inside the DSP console, negotiating scope with the Ads PM who owns that surface. By end of day, you're reviewing creator compensation scenarios with the Associates team, making sure the economics work for the brand (willing to pay), the creator (worth their time), and Amazon (sustainable margin).

About the team
The team is a small group of applied scientists, and engineers. We work across Amazon's creator ecosystem (Associates, Influencer Program, Creator Connections) and ads platform to build something that blends the best parts of both worlds. You would be joining at the stage where there is a solid data hypothesis and brand demand, but the core product decisions are yours to guide.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience technical product management
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- 5+ years working in at least one of: creator/influencer platforms, social commerce, or affiliate marketing
- Familiarity with at least one programmatic advertising platform (e.g., Amazon DSP, Google DV360, The Trade Desk, Meta Ads Manager)
- Experience launching products in multi-sided marketplaces

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Direct experience in BOTH creator/social platforms AND advertising technology (the bilateral intersection is what makes this role unique)
- Experience at a social platform (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest) or creator economy company (LTK, Impact, CreatorIQ, Grin)
- Hands-on experience managing campaigns or building features within a programmatic advertising platform (not just familiarity)
- Track record of taking a product from 0-to-1 (not just optimizing an existing product at scale)
- Familiarity with affiliate marketing economics and creator compensation models

title: Site Leader – Reverse Logistics, Amazon Transportation Brazil
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for a motivated, customer-focused leader to join our team as a Site Leader at XVC4, Amazon's first Recommerce and Return Center in Brazil. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of managers and associates, driving operational excellence in our Reverse Logistics (ReLo) network. You will be responsible for engaging your team to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, and performance — with a relentless focus on maximizing the sellability of every item that passes through the site.
The Recommerce & Returns Site Leader works in Amazon's Reverse Logistics network, responsible for processing customer returns, determining the appropriate disposition (e.g., reselling, refurbishing, liquidating, or donating items), and continuously improving recovery rates. This is a unique opportunity to shape the operations of a greenfield site and build processes from the ground up.

Key Priorities
1. Safety – Ensure a safe working environment for all associates, maintaining zero-tolerance for safety risks and driving a culture of proactive hazard identification.
2. Quality – Maintain the highest standards in grading, processing, and dispositioning of returned items, ensuring accuracy and consistency across all operations.
3. Inventory Recovery – Maximize sellability and recovery rates of returned inventory through process optimization, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.



Key job responsibilities
• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of managers, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and operational excellence
• Drive root cause investigation for quality defects, process failures, and sellability losses, implementing sustainable corrective actions
• Create, implement, and continuously improve processes to maximize item recovery and sellability rates
• Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining capacity requirements, and partnering with cross-functional teams
• Manage safety, quality, productivity, and inventory recovery KPIs with a data-driven approach
• Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, and Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
• Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact, including process design for new workflows in the recommerce space
• Own the end-to-end operational performance of the site, from inbound receiving through final disposition
• Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all site processes
• Analyze data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement in recovery and sellability

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Experience in managing teams
- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques

title: Immigration Policy Specialist , Employee Onboarding Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Immigration team is looking for an Immigration Policy Specialist to join our Employee Onboarding Experience (EOE) organization. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an immigration and public policy subject matter expert who can operate independently in a fast-moving regulatory environment, manage multiple competing priorities, and shift from strategic analysis to tactical execution within the same day.

In this role, you will own deliverables end-to-end: analyzing proposed and final immigration rules for their impact on Amazon's workforce and costs, drafting executive communications, building and running operational mechanisms, leading data analysis and scenario planning, and coordinating across internal and external stakeholder groups. You will regularly produce materials for senior leaders and must be able to write clearly and concisely, with a bottom line up front for a non-specialist executive audience. When a new, unanticipated policy action arrives, you will be ready to pivot immediately, stand up crisis response infrastructure, and keep the work moving forward.


Key job responsibilities
Policy analysis and strategic response
• Analyze proposed and final governmental regulations, administrative actions, and executive actions from federal immigration agencies for their impact on Amazon's workforce, operations, and costs, producing clear impact assessments and options papers for leadership review.
• Develop strategic response options for each regulatory change, including cost modeling, implementation feasibility, legal guardrails, and stakeholder implications.
• Draft and manage the production of executive papers, briefings, decisional documents, FAQs, and options analyses for senior leadership audiences.
• Monitor regulatory review timelines, Federal Register publications, agency guidance, court proceedings, and Congressional activity for early warning of policy changes.
• Lead recurring policy coordination meetings, track action items, circulate summaries, and ensure follow-through.
Mechanism design, implementation, and operations
• Design, build, and run the operational mechanisms required to implement leadership decisions, including approval workflows, tracking tools, escalation processes, and reporting dashboards.
• Own the day-to-day operation of policy-related mechanisms, tracking outcomes, identifying edge cases, resolving issues, and continuously improving based on real-world experience.
Crisis response and rapid mobilization
• When new regulatory actions are announced, often without warning, shift to crisis response mode and stand up coordination calls, agendas, and action-item tracking.
• Triage incoming requests from leadership and stakeholders during crisis periods and own daily or weekly reporting while a response is active.
Communications
• Draft communications explaining policy changes, what they mean for the individual, and what action is needed, coordinating review with Legal, Communications, and HR partners.
• Create and maintain FAQs, toolkits, and reference materials for recruiters, hiring managers, candidates, and employees.
Data analysis and reporting
• Pull, analyze, and present workforce data to support policy decision-making, working with analytics partners.
• Produce reports showing who is affected by policy changes, broken down by dimensions such as role, business line, geography, and time horizon.




About the team
Amazon's Immigration team within EOE supports one of the largest and most complex corporate immigration programs in the world, spanning many countries and a full lifecycle of immigration services from student hire through permanent residence. The policy function is responsible for anticipating and responding to changes in the external regulatory environment that affect Amazon's ability to hire, retain, and move global talent.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree in Law, or 5+ years of Employment Law experience
- Experience creating and delivering written and oral communications for technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience analyzing data and creating reports for leadership
- • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in US employment-based immigration programs (such as H-1B, PERM, OPT, and green card processes), including how the programs work, who they affect, and how regulatory changes create business impact.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in a relevant discipline (e.g. Law, Political Science, Public Policy, Public Affairs, Economic Development)
- Experience in employee relations, labor relations, or labor/employment law
- Experience engaging with regulatory agencies in permit applications or equivalent
- • Experience with DOL prevailing wage requirements, LCA compliance, NIV and IV, PERM labor certification, and/or OPT and student visa programs.
- • Experience with crisis response or rapid-reaction communications in a large, matrixed organization.
- • Experience with external stakeholder engagement such as trade associations, government officials, or peer companies.

descriptionHtml:

You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. title: Applied Scientist, Worldwide Returns & Recommerce - Science
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.
WWR&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing groundbreaking products and driving truly innovative operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon – Returns & ReCommerce.
Amazon WWR&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop highly respected product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
You will help create everything from customer-facing and vendor-facing websites to the internal software and tools behind the reverse-logistics process. You can develop scalable, high-availability solutions to solve complex and broad business problems.

We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WWR&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

* Design, develop, and evaluate highly innovative models for our Natural Language Understanding (NLU) and Large Language Model (LLM) models

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

About the team
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon at Amazon - including Graviton (our server processors), Trainium and Inferentia (our machine learning training and inference accelerators), and the Nitro system that powers modern EC2. We own the full stack, from silicon through the software that makes it work (compilers, runtimes, drivers, and the frameworks that let customers run workloads on our hardware). As a Cloud Hardware Development Engineer Intern, you'll write the software that turns custom silicon into products used by millions.

Annapurna has hardware teams across a range of systems and disciplines, and we work to place you on a technical team aligned with your interests and strengths. Example teams and focus areas include:

- Board and system design for ML servers and accelerator platforms
- Firmware and low-level software development (BMC, device firmware)
- Hardware bring-up, validation, and post-silicon testing
- High-speed interconnect and signal integrity
- System-level integration across compute, networking, and storage
Once you join, we partner with you and our hiring managers to match you to a team where your background and interests fit best, so your project is something you're genuinely excited to work on.

As a Cloud HDE Intern, you'll contribute to real hardware development work, which may include:

- Supporting the design, bring-up, and validation of hardware systems and subsystems
- Developing firmware or low-level software that interfaces directly with hardware
- Debugging hardware-software integration issues in the lab using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other bench equipment
- Writing and running tests to validate hardware functionality, performance, and reliability
- Collaborating with ASIC, systems, and software teams to take hardware from design through deployment
- Documenting your work and presenting findings to the team
You'll be paired with a mentor and manager who will scope your project, support your growth, and set you up to deliver meaningful, measurable impact by the end of your internship.

- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with a final graduation date of December 2027 or later
- Coursework or project experience in digital logic design and computer architecture
- Familiarity with a hardware description language (Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL)
- Understanding of fundamental digital design concepts: combinational and sequential logic, finite state machines, timing, and clocking

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems
- Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
- Can show strong verbal and written communication skills

title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, Ring
descriptionHtml:
Ring is growing in Poland and we are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join our firmware team in Gdansk. You will shape the firmware that runs on IoT devices used by millions of customers worldwide, and you will do it as a technical leader: setting the architecture, raising the bar on quality, and making the engineers around you better.

This is a hands on role. You will still write code and debug hardware. The difference at this level is scope. You will own the technical direction of a significant part of our firmware, decide how subsystems fit together, and be the person other teams come to when a problem crosses a boundary that nobody owns yet. You will take a product from an early idea and an unfinished board through to millions of units in the field, and you will be accountable for the decisions that made it work.

Our team operates with high autonomy and a strong feedback culture. We expect you to disagree with us when you think we are wrong.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the design and implementation of firmware spanning several subsystems, such as connectivity, streaming, power management, sensors, or security.
- Lead your colleagues to deliver high quality C and C++ that will scale with the needs of the business.
- Make architecture decisions that hold up across products, and write them down clearly enough that other teams can build on them.
- Set the technical bar through code review, design review, and the standards you hold yourself to, and empower your colleagues to meet and raise it.
- Mentor engineers, grow the people around you, and multiply what the team can deliver.
- Partner with hardware, QA, cloud, app, and silicon vendor teams to deliver one integrated product experience, and drive the decisions that cross those lines.
- Work with your manager and leadership to shape the firmware roadmap and influence the technical strategy behind it.
- Find and fix the hardest problems we have, including the ones that only reproduce on one board variant, at low temperature, or after eight hours of soak.
- Raise technical risk early, with a recommendation attached.

A day in the life
You start by reviewing a design document and pushing back on a choice that will not hold once a second product picks it up. After standup you write a driver for a new part and test it on the board at your desk. Midday you help the hardware team decide whether firmware can cover a missed power target. In the afternoon you pair on a bug that runs from application code down to a register, and show your colleague how to find it rather than fixing it yourself. You close the day writing to leadership about a schedule risk.

About the team
We build the firmware inside Ring devices, from doorbells and cameras to security products. Our work starts before the hardware exists and continues long after launch, which means we own architecture, bring up, feature delivery, and the health of what is already in customers' homes. Our mission is to make devices that people trust, and to make them ship on time.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
- Deep embedded development experience in C or C++ on resource constrained hardware.
- Experience owning the design of embedded subsystems or products end to end, from architecture through production release.
- Experience shipping embedded products at volume, and a clear view of what separates a working prototype from a product in millions of homes.
- Experience with ARM CPUs, low level drivers, interrupt service routines, and debugging across the hardware and software boundary.
- Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical standard of a team.
- Ability to communicate technical decisions and risks clearly to engineers and to non engineers, in writing.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
- Experience leading bring up of new silicon or boards, working with vendors.
- Commercial wireless protocols such as BLE or Wi-Fi.
- Firmware for battery powered products, and power optimisation as a measured discipline.
- Audio or video streaming on embedded platforms.
- Embedded security, including secure boot, key storage and secure update.
- Embedded Linux and FreeRTOS.
- SPI, I2C and UART, plus JTAG and protocol analysers.
- Experience defining test strategy: unit, regression and system testing on real hardware.
- Building GenAI applications.

title: Principal PMT, FBA IOS
descriptionHtml:
The FBA Inventory team is responsible for one of the most strategically critical and technically complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: managing the inventory volume sent to and stored in the Amazon Fulfillment Network (AFN) across 1MM+ sellers worldwide, while enabling sellers to grow at the pace they desire. Our team sits at the intersection of seller economics, network operations, and latest science thinking — uniquely positioned to align incentives between Amazon and sellers to maximize GMS, optimize network health, and deliver a best-in-class seller experience.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, results-oriented Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead Project Atlas — Amazon's durable target-state architecture for policy-owned inventory enforcement orchestration running inventory removal driven defects down to zero. This is a rare opportunity to own a platform that directly influences seller trust at scale, the integrity of Amazon's compliance posture across every marketplace, and the efficiency of the global fulfillment network. You will drive the strategy and roadmap spanning policy-authoring systems, action APIs, appeal-aware control logic, and the lifecycle-of-record systems that power them — building products that resolve policy intent, seller remediation, appeal state, and removal eligibility upstream, so downstream inventory and removal systems can correctly take execution actions.



Key job responsibilities
1. Own the FBA platform roadmap for Project Atlas — Amazon's durable target-state architecture for policy-owned enforcement orchestration — and the next-generation enforcement experience that turns downstream systems into stateless executors of upstream policy decisions.
2) Drive the shift to policy-owned enforcement, replacing bundled downstream workflows with discrete, policy-issued action primitives each with its own timing, owner, and result.
3) Build seller-protecting controls that make enforcement deterministic, transparent, and appeal-aware — including irreversible-action gates checked against active appeal state, undo/resume logic, and a single lifecycle-of-record so sellers never receive conflicting dates, channels, or instructions.
4) Scale the enforcement platform beyond compliance — partnering with policy, science, and marketplace teams to extend the model to any future use case that touches inventory, offers, orders, removals, or seller communication, while distinguishing reversible (Compliance-Pending) from irreversible (Disposition-Required) violations.
5) Lead cross-functional alignment across CPP/Policy Manager, DISCO, Paragon/AHD, Issue Store, AFT/TASC, FBA, and Retail on the action API contract, policy-authoring validation, and evaluation/enforcement grain alignment — transforming fragmented, downstream-owned enforcement into an automated, policy-driven system with zero unauthorized removals.

- Bachelor's degree

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

title: Reliability Engineer, Product Reliability
descriptionHtml:
This is a Reliability Engineering role. While Reliability testing is one component of the work, this role is fundamentally about driving product reliability from design through mass production. The ideal candidate brings a strong engineering design background and applies that expertise to ensure robust, field-ready products.
We are looking for an engineer who:
• Thinks like a designer — understands how design decisions impact long-term reliability
• Acts like a project leader — drives issues to resolution across teams and geographies
• Bridges design and manufacturing — ensures reliability intent is preserved from concept through mass production
If you have a design engineering background and are passionate about building reliable products at scale, this role is for you.


Key job responsibilities
The Reliability Engineer will lead reliability engineering and operations activities throughout the device execution phase. This role works closely with the core team and contract manufacturers (CM/ODM) to manage system NPI builds and reliability qualification in China, as well as conducting and driving failure analysis for issue resolution.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Design Collaboration (Early Phase): Partner with the design team during early program phases to contribute to design reviews, DFMEA, and design improvements — leveraging reliability insights to influence product architecture and robustness.
2. NPI Build Management: Manage system engineering builds in Asia, serving as the reliability representative to ensure builds meet qualification standards.
3. Reliability Validation Oversight: Manage contract manufacturers to ensure correct and on-time reliability test execution, while maintaining test integrity and data quality.
4. Progress Reporting & Issue Tracking: Report reliability execution progress and issues; track issues from creation through to closure with clear ownership and timelines.
5. Failure Analysis & Corrective Action: Drive and cooperate with cross-functional teams (EE, ME, firmware, quality) on root cause analysis and corrective actions for issues discovered during testing.
6. NPI-to-MP Transfer: Manage the transition from NPI to mass production, ensuring consistent reliability qualification testing and stable reliability levels across different manufacturing sites.
7. Sustaining Support: Support factory escalations, post-ramp qualification activities, and component-level reliability assessments.

Basic qualifications

- • Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related fields.
- • 3+ years of experience in electrical or mechanical design engineering, reliability engineering, or reliability project management.
- • Design background is a significant plus — candidates with hands-on product design experience who want to apply that knowledge to reliability will be highly valued.
- • Solid understanding of product reliability testing methodologies and lifetime evaluation.
- • Strong technical problem-solving skills with demonstrated experience in failure analysis techniques.
- • Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
- • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills; team leadership experience preferred

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in product development with a proven track record of delivering high-volume consumer electronic devices to market.
- Hands-on experience with failure analysis techniques to isolate root causes for EE or ME issues (e.g., cross-section, CSAM, X-ray, electrical characterization).
- Proficiency in reliability and statistical methods — able to perform data analysis, risk assessment, and lifetime forecasting (e.g., Weibull analysis, accelerated life testing models).
- Experience working with high-volume manufacturing sites in Asia, ideally with multiple OEM/ODM partners.
- Experience cross-functionally managing diverse groups of engineering, operations, and product management professionals — proficient at creating and tracking complex development schedules and managing issue resolution.
- Background in consumer electronics (audio, wireless devices, IoT, or connected devices preferred).
- Solid understanding of product development phases (EVT/DVT/PVT/MP).
- Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.

descriptionHtml:

Vous serez un véritable moteur de transformation, contribuant à repousser toujours plus loin les limites de notre performance opérationnelle au sein du réseau européen.

Rejoindre Amazon aujourd'hui, c'est donner un véritable coup d'accélérateur à votre carrière. Selon vos aspirations, vous pourrez évoluer vers des responsabilités plus importantes dans nos opérations, saisir des opportunités dans d'autres pays de notre réseau international, ou encore vous orienter vers des fonctions transverses - voire combiner ces différentes possibilités. Cette liberté de construire votre parcours, couplée à notre vitesse d'apprentissage et notre échelle d'impact, sont particulièrement valorisées, tant pour progresser au sein d'Amazon que pour saisir à l'avenir des opportunités prestigieuses en externe.

Grâce à des technologies de pointe et des processus innovants, nos équipes assurent la réception, le stockage, la préparation et l'expédition de millions de produits chaque jour. Nous développons un réseau logistique à la pointe de l'innovation, alliant automatisation, algorithmes et expertise humaine pour garantir une efficacité maximale.

title: Creative Manager, Elevated Shopping (éshop)
descriptionHtml:
Elevated Shopping enhances the shopping experience through video, LED production, photography,
graphic design, and usability design. With a global network of Creative Hubs in North America, Europe,
and Asia, Elevated Shopping focuses on video and CGI production, LED production, fashion and
product photography, photo retouching, graphic design, automated image acquisition, and image
support services. We continuously innovate and set new industry standards for showcasing millions of
products across multiple global marketplaces.

We are searching for a Creative Manager who will report to the Sr Studio Manager and lead
end-to-end creative production for Amazon’s India (Gurugram) Creative Hub. This is a people manager role:
the successful candidate will directly manage a team of Art Directors, Videographers, and creative
professionals, owning their development, performance, and day-to-day direction. The Creative
Manager will oversee project management, coordinate with Producers on production schedules and budgets, and other stakeholders (who are cross-functional partners, not direct reports), and drive
creative excellence across video, LED production, photography, and motion content. This person must
also have a strong understanding of generative AI tools and their application in creative workflows, as
well as LED production technologies.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage end-to-end creative production for multiple brands and campaigns simultaneously, from
concept through delivery
• Define creative needs and provide creative expertise to internal stakeholders and external clients
• Recommend effective production approaches and launch strategies based on past performance,
client goals, and studio capabilities
• Directly manage a team of Art Directors, Videographers, and creative professionals; partner with
Producers, Digitechs, Stylists, Editors, and 3D Artists as cross-functional stakeholders to ensure
seamless execution
• Drive timely decisions, clear blockers, and escalate appropriately to accelerate campaign
progress
• Manage project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation across concurrent productions
• Provide creative recommendations and insights that inform production decisions and drive
increased performance
• Ensure all creative output meets quality standards and brand guidelines
• Optimize campaign workflows and team processes; recommend improvements to cross-team and
partner processes
• Manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, and production partners
• Own people management responsibilities for direct reports including performance reviews, career
development, coaching, and hiring; foster a high-performing team culture

A day in the life
You’ll start your day reviewing production schedules and connecting with your direct reports (Art
Directors, Stylist, Videographers) on priorities and blockers. You might join a creative kick-off for a new
video campaign, then pivot to reviewing shot lists and storyboards for an ongoing shoot. You’ll
coordinate with Producers on timelines and resource needs as key stakeholders. In the afternoon, you
could be on set overseeing a video production, ensuring all content is captured on schedule, or in a
post-production review providing feedback on edits and color correction. You’ll close the day by
updating stakeholders on progress, conducting a 1:1 with a team member, and planning for the next
production milestone.

About the team
Our Creative Hub team is a dynamic group of creative professionals spanning video production,
photography, styling, LED production, and post-production. We produce high-volume, high-quality
visual content for global brands across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and consumer electronics. We pride
ourselves on operational excellence, creative innovation, and a collaborative culture that empowers every team member to deliver their best work.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- 3+ years of budgeting, scheduling and technical workflows experience
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Experience working on or with large-scale, global creative campaigns
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience building, managing and coaching a team in a high-growth environment
- • 5+ years of digital content management, communications, or content strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with one or more of the following industry tools: 3D Studio Max, Maya, Photoshop, Zbrush, Substance, Unreal, Blender, etc
- Experience with digital asset management tools
- Experience managing and or coordinating projects in a fast pace environment
- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- Experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising
- Knowledge of video production crews, live streaming technologies, studio workflows, edit and post- production techniques, production calendars and staffing
- Experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to inform business decisions with proven business impact (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits), or experience in quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance)
- • 8+ years of experience in studio-based high volume creative production environments
- • Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices
- • Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences

descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は埼玉県川口市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。

※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です

title: Staż w dziale operacji i logistyki -  Gorzyczki 2027
descriptionHtml:
Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.
Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:
Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin


Key job responsibilities
Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.
Kluczowe obowiązki stanowiska:

* Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników

* Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy

* Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych

* Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.

* Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.

* Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.

* Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.

* Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.



A day in the life
Dzień z życia stażysty
Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.


About the team
O zespole
Społeczność stażystów:

* Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowania.

Wsparcie:

* Program stażowy obejmuje kompleksowy system wsparcia, w tym cotygodniowe dyżury dla stażystów, specjalistyczne wsparcie IT i HR oraz zespół programowy dbający o Twój sukces. Dzięki temu otrzymasz wskazówki i pomoc niezbędne do osiągnięcia sukcesu.

Sesje szkoleniowe:

* Dzięki specjalnym sesjom szkoleniowym jeszcze bardziej rozwiniesz swoje umiejętności, uzyskując dostęp do najnowocześniejszych platform szkoleniowych Amazon i wiedzy liderów branży. Te ustrukturyzowane możliwości rozwoju przygotują cię do kolejnego kroku w karierze.

Możliwości:

* Po pomyślnym ukończeniu stażu możemy rozważyć zatrudnienie Cię na stanowisku dla absolwentów lub zaproponować drugi staż, co pozwoli Ci kontynuować drogę zawodową w Amazon. Dodatkowo otrzymasz konkurencyjne miesięczne wynagrodzenie, wsparcie w relokacji oraz dostęp do szeregu świadczeń pracowniczych.

Daty rozpoczęcia stażu w ciągu roku:

* Przyjmujemy stażystów, którzy mogą rozpocząć pracę w dowolnym momencie od stycznia do lipca 2027 r. Każdego miesiąca organizujemy 1–2 dni wdrożeniowe dla nowych pracowników.

title: Solutions Architect II, Direct Tax Technology
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about transforming tax technology through innovation? Amazon's Direct Tax Technology team is seeking a Solutions Architect II to revolutionize how tax professionals work. In this role, you'll leverage modern technologies including Python and generative AI to design and implement solutions that empower Amazon's Direct Tax Reporting and Compliance organization. You'll tackle complex technical challenges at unprecedented scale, building world-class systems that drive efficiency and enable tax professionals to meet Amazon's unique global challenges.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by architecting solutions that transform tax operations for one of the world's most innovative companies. You'll work at the intersection of tax domain expertise and modern cloud technologies, creating elegant technical solutions that directly improve how Amazon's tax team operates at a global scale.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement scalable tax technology solutions using Python, generative AI, and modern development practices to solve complex tax processing challenges
Define front-end architectures and user experiences, owning specific technical components while establishing best practices for model development and solution design
Collaborate with tax professionals, Product Managers, and fellow Solutions Architects to translate customer requirements into technical specifications that engineering teams can execute
Lead end-to-end solution architecture for tax technology projects, including planning, design, implementation, testing, and continuous process improvement as part of an autonomous team
Mentor and develop other Solutions Architects by sharing technical expertise, facilitating knowledge transfer, and contributing to team growth through code reviews and technical guidance

A day in the life
Your day blends creative problem-solving with hands-on technical work. You might start by architecting a generative AI solution to streamline tax compliance workflows, then collaborate with tax professionals to refine user experience requirements. After lunch, you'll dive into Python modeling to optimize data processing pipelines, followed by a design review where you mentor junior architects on best practices. The afternoon could include troubleshooting a technical challenge with your team, contributing to solution planning, and ending with a customer workshop where you demonstrate how new capabilities will transform their tax operations.

About the team
The Direct Tax Technology team sits within Amazon's Tax organization and is dedicated to supporting tax professionals in the Tax Reporting and Compliance group with innovative technology solutions and streamlined processes. Our team tackles the unique and complex challenges that come with operating at Amazon's scale, building systems that enhance processing efficiency and empower our internal customers.

We foster a culture of innovation and collaboration where technical excellence meets business impact. Our mission is to continuously evolve tax technology capabilities, ensuring our tax professionals have the tools they need to succeed. Join a team where your work directly influences how Amazon manages tax compliance and reporting, and where you'll have opportunities to explore emerging technologies like generative AI while growing your skills alongside talented engineers and architects.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

title: RME Technician , BRS2
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Key job responsibilities
Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites

A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Experience in engineering
- Experience in electrical or mechanical engineering
- Advanced proficiency in the local language verbally and in writing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with predictive and preventative maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, and diagnostics on material handling equipment (MHE) and automated conveyor systems
- Experience in condition-based monitoring
- Experience working with print and apply machines

descriptionHtml:
Du bewirbst dich auf unseren Talent Pool für Logistikpraktika mit Start ab Januar 2027. Durch eine frühzeitige Bewerbung profitierst du von:

* Frühzeitiger Berücksichtigung für verfügbare Positionen
* Bevorzugtem Zugang zu gewünschten Standorten und Startdaten
* Größerer Flexibilität bei der Terminplanung im Interviewprozess

Unser vorläufiger Zeitplan: Interviews beginnen ab September, das Role Matching startet voraussichtlich ab Oktober. Dieser Zeitplan kann sich je nach geschäftlichem Bedarf ändern.

Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten

descriptionHtml:

Join the innovative team behind Amazon's most beloved Cameras and Doorbells. We're not just building chips—we're creating the silicon brain that powers millions of homes worldwide, making them safer and smarter.

As a Sr. ASIC Design Engineer on our Blink/Ring ASIC Team, you'll work on cutting-edge System-on-Chip (SoC) designs that directly impact customer experiences. Our vertically integrated environment means you'll see your innovations come to life in products that customers genuinely love—and you'll get there faster with our streamlined time-to-revenue approach.

Innovation at Every Level: Work with our integrated verification/validation environment that spans from architectural modeling through post-silicon validation. We believe in giving engineers the best tools to do their best work.

Customer-Obsessed Engineering: We work backwards from real customer needs to create super-low power, energy-efficient designs featuring the latest advances in AI, video processing, low-power communications, and cutting-edge CMOS fabrication technology.

title: Delivery Service Partner Program, Senior Business Coach
descriptionHtml:
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses.

The Senior Business Coach (BC) helps Amazon improve the flexibility and quality of its delivery network in the Americas—to help fuel a $4B investment in rural communities bringing even faster delivery to our millions of customers in less densely populated areas. This role’s primary focus is supporting DSP operations across the broader Americas delivery network, with particular emphasis on rural market expansion and mature-state optimization. Specifically, BCs support DSPs in making business decisions that enable them to build healthy, sustainable businesses. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs, supporting business planning and strategy and helping owners address business and operational challenges.

As a Senior Business Coach (BC), you will manage a portfolio of Delivery Service Partner (DSP) owners within the Amazon delivery network. With the evolution of delivery modes and rural expansion planned for 2026, and continued strategic expansion into 2027, this role is integral to our program's evolution. Sr. BCs provide strategic guidance to DSP owners throughout their business life cycle of their relationship with Amazon, from pre-launch preparation through mature-state optimization. You will facilitate solution oriented approaches to remove business obstacles and drive continuous improvement in financial performance, operational efficiency, and safety standards across the network. The position requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, including operations managers, program directors, compliance officers, legal counsel, and finance teams. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, strategic problem solving skills, and the ability to implement data-driven recommendations that create meaningful change both internally and externally.


Key job responsibilities
Operational Excellence & Financial Advisory
• Lead DSP owners through critical business phases including launch, operational scaling, and seasonal demand optimization
• Provide comprehensive consultation on financial management and operational optimization
• Support development of scalable business processes to ensure consistent performance metrics
• Navigate program evolution by helping owners implement and adapt to strategic changes within traditional DSP operations, including new service types and offerings such as rural delivery expansion and delivery capabilities
• Conduct data driven business reviews, delivering performance insights and competitive benchmarking analysis

Business Development & Program Management
• Evaluate and interview potential candidates for the DSP program, ensuring alignment with program standards and objectives
• Guide strategic planning and execution of network capacity management

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Enhancement
• Foster strong DSP community engagement through coordination of local events and regional initiatives
• Build and maintain productive relationships with regional stakeholders
• Identify operational inefficiencies and champion process improvements across the network
• Design and implement solutions to enhance overall program effectiveness and DSP owner experience

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor and primary account manager, combining strategic insight with practical business acumen to drive sustainable growth and operational excellence across the DSP network.

A day in the life
Strategic Leadership & Decision Making
• Drive both strategic initiatives and tactical execution to achieve business objectives
• Leverage industry expertise to establish priorities, optimize account management strategies, and develop sustainable long term solutions
• Navigate ambiguous business environments to formulate clear strategic direction and influence cross-functional priorities
• Demonstrate sound judgment in solution design, balancing complexity with efficiency

Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Lead resolution of complex business challenges through detailed analysis and effective escalation management
• Foster collaborative relationships across multiple business units and organizational levels
• Develop and maintain strong partnerships with key stakeholders through exceptional relationship management
• Deliver compelling verbal and written communications, including executive level presentations and strategic recommendations

Location & Travel Requirements
• Position is based out of the Austin, TX office
• Work arrangement includes structured mix of office presence, field travel, and remote work days. One week per month is dedicated to in office collaboration at respective/team’s Hub. Significant field engagement is required: minimum 3 days per week of travel for 3 weeks monthly to support portfolio of Delivery Service Partners
• Must be comfortable with regular travel and maintaining a flexible schedule

The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional problem solving capabilities, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence outcomes in a dynamic, fast paced environment.

About the team
At Amazon Logistics (AMZL), our goal is to provide customers with an incredible package delivery experience through the last mile of the order. To achieve this goal, we partner with a network of small independent delivery businesses (Delivery Service Providers) and the independent contractor community (Amazon Flex) to deliver customer orders. Utilizing continuous improvement initiatives and creative thinking, our Delivery Station teams ensure that millions of packages reach their final destination as efficiently as possible.

The SLP Specialist leads the effort to efficiently and effectively protect people, product and data (lives, physical property, equipment, inventory, data, & intellectual property) in a designated building. The SLP Specialist reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager responsible for their geographical area, and aids them in supporting the operational team, and cross functional teams throughout the organization.

Key job responsibilities
* Conduct confidential investigations and prepare prompt written reports of theft, fraud, and critical incidents
* Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement, data protection, physical security infrastructure) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
* Serve as department liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert for site leadership keeping them informed on key issues, strategies, and the department’s performance
* Develop strategies for alarm reduction and conduct system diagnostic for problematic devices by engaging and resolving issues with internal and external partners
* Domestic regional travel up to 25% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You will perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, and you contribute to developing mitigating measures to address them. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our fulfillment, logistics and retail operations locations by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems with subject matter experts and external suppliers to maintain their functionality. You will interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience, or 1+ year in security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, law enforcement, or operations, or Loss Prevention Qualified Career Choice Graduate
- 1+ years of experience using Microsoft Office, including Excel, in a professional capacity
- Workplace incident mitigation or de-escalation and Business Continuity planning experience

Preferred qualifications

- Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced and multi-tasking environment

title: Senior Embedded Electrical Engineer, Manipulation Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about designing electronics that live inside robots, tightly packaged alongside mechanisms, sensors, and actuators in space-constrained assemblies? Do you want to shape the electrical architecture of next-generation robotic manipulation systems from the ground up?

The Manipulation Robotics group develops robotic systems that pick, grasp, and move millions of items and packages per day across Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems are growing in electrical complexity as we push toward more capable grasping: edge motor drive, advanced sensing technology, tighter integration, and increasing on-tool intelligence. These are hard, novel problems with no off-the-shelf answers, and the embedded electrical architecture is central to making them work at scale. We are looking for a Senior Embedded Electrical Engineer to be the founding EE on our hardware team, owning the electrical design of our robotic systems and grasping tools from concept through production.


Key job responsibilities
- Influence hardware and electrical strategy across the Manipulation Robotics group and adjacent programs. Contribute to technology roadmaps, identify opportunities for mutual platforms, and drive alignment on architectural decisions that span multiple teams
- Own the electrical architecture and board-level design for robotic arm systems and end-of-arm tooling, including power distribution, signal routing, sensor integration, and embedded compute
- Design tightly integrated electromechanical packages, embedding sensors, cameras, and control electronics into compact grasping mechanisms. Define firmware architectures and partner with firmware engineers to define clear interfaces. \
- Perform schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout. Direct and review work from internal and external partners backing design efforts.
- Select and qualify components (interconnects, sensors, motor drivers, FPGAs, microcontrollers, cameras, power converters) based on performance, cost, reliability, and supply-chain resilience
- Define electrical interfaces between subsystems and coordinate with EE teams on adjacent programs to ensure compatibility and reuse
- Partner with systems engineers to comprehend and influence requirements, performance targets, timing constraints, and cost tradeoffs. Work with mechanical engineers to co-develop integrated hardware packages, managing thermal, routing, and spatial constraints jointly
- Build and debug prototypes on the bench; develop test plans and validation procedures for board bring-up, signal integrity, and system-level verification
- Engage with contractors, vendors and contract manufacturers for board fabrication, assembly, and component sourcing; manage external partnerships
- Aid product releases to manufacturing, including DFM/DFT reviews and production ramp

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
We are a small, high-ownership hardware team building robotic manipulation systems, from early-stage R&D through fielded products operating 24/7 in Amazon fulfillment centers. Our tools are getting more capable and electrically denser with each generation. The challenges are real: packaging sensors, actuators, and compute into mechanisms that survive millions of cycles, fit inside tight envelopes, and remain cost-effective at fleet scale. Our engineers own problems end-to-end. You'll work alongside mechanical designers, systems engineers, and software/controls teams in a fast-moving environment where your decisions directly shape what ships. This role is the first dedicated EE on the team, which means you will have outsized influence on how we approach electrical design going forward.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 8+ years of experience in electrical hardware design, including analog and digital circuit design
- Experience with schematic capture, PCB layout, and design for manufacturability using industry EDA tools (e.g., Altium Designer, OrCAD/Cadence, or similar)
- Extensive experience architecting complex electromechanical products, with a strong emphasis on tight packaging, thermal design and scalability
- Experience with component selection, sourcing, and vendor management for electromechanical systems
- Expert-level experience with power electronics and BLDC motor drives
- Knowledge of power electronics, signal integrity, and EMC/EMI considerations for multi-board systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing electronics for robotic or mechatronic systems (arms, grippers, end-effectors, or similar)
- Experience with embedded systems (microcontrollers, FPGAs, firmware interfaces) at the board level. Ability to design firmware architecture and prototype key features
- Experience with sensor systems (vision, depth, force/torque, proximity) including signal chain design and characterization
- Experience managing or directing external EE design firms and contract manufacturers
- Track record of growing junior engineers through mentorship, design reviews, and shared best practices.
- Experience applying IEC 60204 and/or IEC 61508 machinery safety standards preferred.
