descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!


Key job responsibilities

Develop foundation models for content understanding using state-of-the-art deep learning and multimodal learning techniques to analyze video and text
Build time sequence foundation models to understand and predict customer behavior patterns and viewing trajectories
Work closely with engineers and product managers to design, implement and launch solutions end-to-end across various Prime Video experiences
Design and conduct offline and online (A/B) experiments to evaluate proposed solutions based on in-depth data analyses
Effectively communicate technical and non-technical ideas with teammates and stakeholders
Stay up-to-date with advancements and the latest modeling techniques in foundation models, multimodal learning, and time series analysis
Publish your research findings in top conferences and journals

A day in the life
We're using advanced approaches such as foundation models to connect information about our videos and customers from a variety of information sources, acquiring and processing data sets on a scale that only a few companies in the world can match. This will enable us to recommend titles effectively, even when we don't have a large behavioral signal (to tackle the cold-start title problem). It will also allow us to find our customer's niche interests, helping them discover groups of titles that they didn't even know existed. We are looking for creative & customer obsessed machine learning scientists who can apply the latest research, state of the art algorithms and ML to build highly scalable page personalization solutions. You'll be a research leader in the space and a hands-on ML practitioner, guiding and collaborating with talented teams of engineers and scientists and senior leaders in the Prime Video organization. You will also have the opportunity to publish your research at internal and external conferences.

About the team
Prime Video Recommendation Science team owns science solution to power recommendation and personalization experience on various Prime Video surfaces and devices. We work closely with the engineering teams to launch our solutions in production.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

AI/ML & Continuous Improvement

• Drive the feedback loop between quality outcomes (first-pass yield, scrap rates) and upstream process adjustments — ensuring the system learns and improves continuously

Shop Floor Quality & Compliance
• Own the product experience for in-line quality: inspection workflows, non-conformance reporting, root cause analysis tools, and SPC dashboards
• Define how quality data flows back to both the scheduling system (for replan triggers) and the enterprise system (for financial variance reporting)

A day in the life
In the morning, you review overnight production data from our prototyping factory — the scheduling system’s override rate dropped to 7% this week, and you’re preparing the case to promote it from Shadow to Advisory mode. You pull the override-reason breakdown to identify two UX issues driving unnecessary supervisor interventions, then draft requirements for the engineering team.

Mid-morning, you join the scaled factory equipment onboarding review. The laser cutting integration team needs a decision on telemetry frequency — you work through the tradeoffs between data granularity (better for predictive maintenance models) and network cost (lower in batch mode), landing on a tiered approach by signal type.

After lunch, you’re on the prototype factory floor shadowing a powder coating operator through a disruption scenario — a rush order just reshuffled the queue, and you observe how the shop floor app communicates the change. The operator missed the notification; you sketch a design change in your notebook.

You close the day reviewing the ECO blast-radius prototype with the engineering team. An engineering change landed that affects 47 in-flight orders — the impact visualization needs to surface at-risk-dollars more prominently for the Change Control Board’s decision meeting tomorrow.

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Research Engineer specializing in hardware design for cryogenic environments. title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Amazon Web Services Korea is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Engineering Operations is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within third party Colocation facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

한국 AWS DCEO팀에서는 데이터센터에 열정이 있는 MEP(Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) 전문가를 채용하고 있습니다. 데이터센터 엔지니어링 운영팀은 Amazon Web Services의 물리적 인프라의 유지 및 관리를 통해 데이터 센터 MEP의 100% 가용성을 보장합니다.

DCEO는 데이터 센터 내의 모든 전기, 기계 및 화재 / 안전 장비가 계약 조항에 맞게 운영되도록 벤더 및 시설을 관리하는 업무를 담당합니다. 주요 업무에는 인프라의 장애 예방/유지 관리, 리크스 관리, 업체 관리 및 관련 보고 업무가 포함됩니다.

Key job responsibilities
• Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance
• Responsible for the on-site management of shift technicians, senior shift technicians, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices and procedures.
• Manage relationship with third party Colocation providers and their facility staff
• Responsible for the operation of and management of both routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
• Data Center capacity planning and reporting
• May assist in the design and build out of new facilities
• May assist in projects to increase current Facility efficiency
• Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency
• Deliver quality service and ensure all customer demands are met
• Procurement for DCEO related expenditure
• Responsible for asset and inventory management

• 미션크리티컬 시설 운영/유지 보수 성능의 벤치 마크, 분석 및 보고서 작성
• 모든 작업이 절차에 따라 이루어 지도록 벤더 테크니션 현장 관리
• 코로케이션 벤더 및 서드파티(3rd party) 관리
• 스위치 기어, 발전기, UPS 시스템, 전력 분배 장비, 냉각기, 냉각탑, CRAH, 빌딩 모니터링 시스템(BMS) 등과 같은 다양한 크리티컬 시스템 서비스의 운영 및 관리

• DCEO 관련 구매
• 자산 및 재고 관리

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーター, Central Operations
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンジャパンAmazon Logistics(以下、AMZL)部門のセントラルオペレーションチームでは急速に拡大している物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルネットワークを円滑に運営するために注文数の予測や配送ドライバー台数の計画、運用方法を改革していくことを目指したオペレーションを構築します。そのため、イノベーションと問題解決に情熱を持ち、世界最高レベルの顧客体験を創造する能力を持つLogistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターを募集しています。日本にある全てのAMZLデリバリーステーション(以下、DS)をサポートする重要な役割を担っていただきます。

勤務形態は40時間/週、日勤・夜勤8時間勤務のシフト制(土日祝日含む)となります。シフトにより年末年始の勤務あり。

関連情報
・所属部門:ラストマイル(AMZL)
・職種:オペレーション

https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp


Key job responsibilities
全国のDSの配送オペレーションを横断的にサポートしていただく役割を担って頂きます。支える役割を担っていただきます。具体的には荷物量の予測からドライバーの配車計画、配送ルート作成、当日のリアルタイム対応まで、マネージャーやチームと連携しながら以下の業務を遂行します：
1. 配送計画の策定・調整: 全国のDSに対し、日次の荷物量予測に基づきドライバー台数・配送ルートを計画し、リアルタイムで最適化する
2. オペレーション異常への即時対応: 遅延・災害等の発生時に、配送ルート再編成やステークホルダーへの情報共有を迅速に実施し、配送サービス・納期を維持する
3. パフォーマンスの可視化・報告: 日次・週次のオペレーションレポートを作成し、改善機会をマネージャーに提案する
4. オペレーション拡大時の準備・実行: セールイベントや新規サービス・システム導入時に、手順変更の検討・標準作業手順書（SOP）の作成・トレーニング教材の構築を行い、円滑な導入を推進する
5. 業務標準化・改善の推進: チームメンバーとステークスホルダーと協力し、データに基づいた業務プロセスの改善と標準化を推進する

A day in the life
あなたの1日は、全国のDS状況をリアルタイムで把握することから始まります。シフト開始時に朝礼を行い、当日の業務内容を確認します。配送計画、リアルタイム対応、改善推進など、専門チームごとに担当領域が分かれており、あなたの強みや適性に応じたチームに配属されます。
シフト中は、複数のモニターで状況を監視しながら、配送計画の策定・調整業務を行います。突発的な遅延や天候変化に対応する場面もあります。あなたが支えるのは、デリバリーステーションに荷物が届く前からお客様の手元に届くまでの全プロセスです。1人で判断するのではなく、チームメンバーと連携しながらリアルタイムで最適な解決策を見つけていきます。
また、日々のオペレーション対応だけでなく、「もっとこうすれば効率的になるのでは？」というアイデアをチームに提案し、改善プロジェクトを主動していただきます。前職での経験や視点を活かして、新しい仕組みづくりに貢献できる環境です。


About the team
■セントラルオペレーション■
セントラルオペレーションは複数のチームからなる300人を超える大規模な組織です。大多数は日本語を母語とするメンバーですが、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが世界中から集まっています。多様性(DEI)が尊重され、安心して働ける環境です。

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており、仕事とプライベートの両方を充実させることができます。

まずは試してみることを大切にしています。好奇心を持って学び、時にはリスクを取りながら、よりよい成果に繋げていく文化があります。

■キャリアパス■
Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターからキャリアをスタートし、チームのマネージャーとなった実績も多数あります。また、社内公募制度を通じて、国内外の他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。

Basic qualifications

- 高校卒業以上
- PCスキル（WordやExcelなどで文書作成や表作成ができる能力）、但し業務を通じて向上させる意欲があること）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（文書の作成・読解能力）
- 翻訳を活用しながらでもコミュニケーションをとることができる英語力

Preferred qualifications

- 4年制大学での学士号
- チーム内でリーダーシップを発揮し、プロジェクトを完遂した経験
- マネジメント経験（人数・期間は問わず）
- 定量的なデータ分析をもとに、業務改善・標準化を実施した経験
- SQLを使用したデータ取得や、VBAをた業務自動化の実務経験
- ビジネスレベルの英語力

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Merchant Consultant (EITS), Amazon Marketplace Paid Services
descriptionHtml:
【Amazon出品サービスについて】
Amazon出品サービス はAmazon以外の企業がAmazonのプラットフォーム上に商品を出品、販売を行うことができる企業向けサービスです。2007年4月のサービス提供開始から今日に至るまで、多くの法人企業様（以下「販売事業者」)に利用され、さらにその数は毎年増えています。Amazonのミッションである地球上で最も豊富な品揃えを実現するためには今後さらにさまざまな商品を販売事業者様にご出品いただくことが不可欠です。

【マーチャント・コンサルタントとは】
マーチャント・コンサルタントは、Amazonプラットフォームに商品を出品している販売事業者様向けに提供している有料のコンサルティングサービスプログラムを担います。具体的には、販売事業者様の経営戦略や事業戦略を踏まえた上で、課題を特定し、戦略的アドバイスを行ってAmazon.co.jp上での売上最大化を目指します。

【具体的な業務内容】
・担当としてアサインされた複数の販売事業者様に対して、専任コンサルタントとして戦略的プランを策定（本ポジションは、「Electronics & IT Solutions」という商品群（総合家電）を主に扱う既存の販売事業者を担当します）。
・売上実績分析～必要な具体的戦略プラン策定～実行サポート（定期的なビジネスレビューの実施）
・戦略的アドバイスおよび実践的なコーチング
・最新プログラム情報提供

～戦略的アドバイス例～
・購入転換率向上（商品ページ改善・プライシング）
・プロモーション（セールイベント提案）
・広告最適化（スポンサー広告提案）
・品揃えの拡充（新商品立ち上げサポート）
・在庫・物流の最適化（在庫切れ要因分析・配送委託提案）
・ブランディング提案（ブランド登録・分析・ストア作成）
・販路拡大（グローバル展開・アマゾンビジネス）


【主なKPI】
販売事業者様のサービスへの満足度、販売事業者様のマーチャント・コンサルタントへの満足度、出品商品数とその配送品質、広告やセール実施により新たに生み出された売上等。

title: Reliability & Maintenance Engineer, GSF
descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities
1. Execute planned preventive maintenance (PPM) schedules for all refrigeration systems, including tropical rooms, chilled rooms, and frozen rooms.
2. Monitor and maintain optimal temperature parameters across all cold chain zones in strict accordance with defined Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
3. Conduct routine inspections of compressors, condensers, evaporators, expansion valves, and refrigerant piping systems.
4. Ensure refrigerant levels are maintained within specified limits and perform periodic leak detection tests.
5. Monitor and maintain defrost cycles, drain lines, and insulation integrity of all cold rooms.
6. Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and third-party service providers for specialized repairs and annual maintenance contracts.
7. Diagnose and resolve refrigeration system faults, including compressor failures, refrigerant leaks, thermostat malfunctions, and evaporator icing.
8. Respond to temperature excursion alarms and execute corrective actions within defined response timelines.
9. Troubleshoot electrical and control system faults in refrigeration panels, PLCs, and Building Management System (BMS) interfaces.
10. Perform root cause identification for recurring equipment failures and implements verified permanent fixes.
11. Maintain and monitor Diesel Generator (DG) sets, including fuel systems, coolant levels, battery health, and periodic load bank testing.
12. Execute preventive and predictive maintenance on Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, including battery health checks, load testing, and firmware updates.
13. Monitor and maintain electrical panels — including Main Distribution Boards (MDB), Sub-Distribution Boards (SDB), Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), and change-over panels.
14. Conduct periodic insulation resistance (IR) testing, earth resistance testing, and thermography surveys of all electrical systems.
15. Ensure full compliance with applicable electrical safety standards and statutory requirements.
16. Monitor real-time equipment parameters through the BMS, temperature monitoring systems, and energy meters.
17. Conduct daily walkthroughs to identify abnormalities, unusual sounds, vibrations, or visual defects in equipment.
18. Track and maintain equipment runtime hours, energy consumption data, and performance trends.
19. Ensure all monitoring sensors and alarm systems are calibrated and fully functional at all times.
20. Daily Reports — Prepare and submit daily equipment status reports covering temperature logs, DG runtime, UPS status, and all observed anomalies.
21. Weekly Reports — Compile weekly maintenance summary reports covering PPM compliance, breakdown analysis, spare parts consumption, and pending work orders.
22. Monthly Reports — Develop monthly performance reports inclusive of equipment uptime percentage, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), Mean Time To Repair (MTTR), energy consumption trends, and cost analysis.
23. Conduct structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all equipment breakdowns, temperature excursions, and safety incidents using methodologies such as Five-Why Analysis and Fishbone Diagrams.
24. Develop and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with clearly defined timelines, responsible owners, and effectiveness verification criteria.
25. Maintain a CAPA tracker with closure status, evidence of implementation, and effectiveness validation records.
26. Present RCA and CAPA findings during Weekly Business Reviews (WBR) and Monthly Business Reviews (MBR).
Qualifications & Skills
27. Taking care of Soft services activities i.e. Pest control, Housekeeping, Scrap & Garbage disposal.
Handling agency staff & overall shift.
• Education — Diploma or bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Refrigeration & Air Conditioning.
• Experience — Minimum three to five years of hands-on experience in refrigeration systems and base building equipment maintenance.
• Technical Knowledge — Proficiency in refrigeration cycles, electrical systems, DG operations, UPS systems, and BMS platforms.
• Certifications — Preferred certifications in Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, Electrical Safety, or equivalent recognised standards.
• Analytical Skills — Ability to perform structured RCA, develop CAPA plans, and apply data-driven decision-making.
• Reporting Skills — Proficiency in preparing technical reports, dashboards, and MIS outputs using MS Excel and relevant tools.
• Communication — Clear verbal and written communication skills for effective cross-functional coordination.
Working Conditions
• Shift-based operations with rotational shifts as applicable to site requirements.
• Sustained exposure to cold room environments, including frozen rooms operating at sub-zero temperatures.
• Regular work in proximity to live electrical systems — adherence to all safety protocols is mandatory.
• On-call availability required for emergency breakdowns and critical temperature excursion response.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics and Communication/Instrumentation and Controls
- Experience in handling Cooling systems/Chiller/Cold storage for minimum 2years

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of conveyors/automation/control systems maintenance experience

descriptionHtml:

grow a portfolio of multi-million dollar professional services engagements with some of the
largest and most complex automotive and manufacturing enterprises in the world. This is a
high-visibility, quota-carrying role with full ownership of your book of business — you will
hunt, create, and close transformative deals that help customers reinvent their businesses
with cloud and Generative AI.
The automotive and manufacturing industries are in the midst of a once-in-a-generation
transformation. Generative AI, applied machine learning, and cloud-native architectures are
fundamentally reshaping how these companies design products, run factories, and deliver
customer experiences — and the pace is accelerating. You will be at the center of this
transformation, working directly with executives and technology leaders to define bold
visions and then close the deals that make them real.
As the ProServe Account Executive, you own the customer relationship and the revenue.
You are a core member of the sales account team alongside Account Managers, Solutions
Architects, and Partner teams — but you are the one who identifies the professional services
opportunity, shapes it, prices it, and closes it. You will develop and execute against
ambitious revenue targets, build a robust pipeline, and negotiate complex commercial
agreements. Following deal close, you stay connected to ensure delivery of agreed
Customer Business Outcomes (CBOs) and to identify the next wave of opportunities.
If you thrive on complexity, think in terms of multi-year transformation roadmaps, and are
energized by the autonomy to build a business within a business — we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities

• Execute complex commercial agreements — Structure and negotiate deal models including fixed-price SOWs, outcome-based engagements, delivery with partners, and multi-year commitments. Navigate procurement and drive deals to close.
• Own executive relationships — Build deep, trust-based partnerships at C-suite and VP levels. Become the strategic advisor that customers call when they're making their biggest technology bets.


A day in the life
You spend your time where it matters most — with customers and closing deals:

transformation priorities (connected vehicles, smart factories, GenAI, supply chain
digitization) and shape opportunities
• Building and defending proposals, negotiating SOWs, and driving complex deals
through multi-stakeholder approval processes

AWS relationship strategy

scale your reach

strategies
• Staying connected to in-flight engagements to ensure CBO delivery and identify
expansion opportunities

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

descriptionHtml:

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt in der technischen Leitung und der Verantwortung aller Engineering-Aufgaben innerhalb eines Clusters im AMZL-Netzwerk der Region MEU (NL, DE, AT). Du bist verantwortlich für die Führung der technischen Teams inklusive dem Aufbau einer Sicherheitskultur auf höchstem Niveau. Gemeinsam gewährleisten wir eine hohe Anlagenverfügbarkeit für die betroffenen Standorte und arbeiten eng mit dem europäischen Engineering Team zusammen, um zukünftiges Wachstum zu fördern. Zusätzlich treibst du die Umsetzung von netzwerkübergreifenden Verbesserungsinitiativen und die Implementierung neuer Standards voran.

Key job responsibilities
• Gesamtverantwortung für die Instandhaltungsteams sowie für alle Sortier- und Fördersysteme, Flurförderfahrzeuge und gebäudetechnischen Anlagen.
• Sicherstellung einer höchstmöglichen Verfügbarkeit aller Anlagen und die Implementierung moderner Instandhaltungsansätze wie Condition Based Maintenance (CBM).
• Sicherstellung der schichtübergreifenden Störungsbeseitigung an allen technischen Systemen.
• Implementierung aller notwendigen Sicherheitsstandards und einer proaktiven Safety-Kultur im Team.
• Förderung einer permanenten Entwicklung aller Team-Mitglieder im Bereich Hard- und Softskills, um das Wachstum von Amazon Operations zu unterstützen.
• Entwicklung von Konzepten zur ständigen Optimierung aller Anlagen gemäß der Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
• Mitgestaltung strategischer Entscheidungen.
• Leitung und Unterstützung von technischen Greenfield und Brownfield Projekten.
• Planung und Einhaltung des Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsbudgets für das Cluster.

• Strategische Führung und Management der Dienstleister an Standorten ohne eigenes RME-Personal, sowie Sicherstellung der Qualität, Leistung und Kosteneffizienz durch effektive Steuerung der Wartungspartner.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help shape the future of workforce planning and hiring operations? Amazon Workforce Staffing's Global Hiring Experience Operations (GHXO) team is seeking an exceptionally talented individual to join our team as a Specialist II, Global Planning.
We are seeking an experienced planning professional to join our GHXO team. This individual will execute contact center forecasting and scheduling across both internal site locations and BPO vendor sites, manage vendor relationships, and support procurement activities to ensure our hiring operations deliver exceptional candidate and hiring manager experiences at scale.
The ideal candidate will draw from their experience in contact center workforce management, capacity planning, and operational budgeting; demonstrating their ability to analyze data, drive scheduling decisions, execute process improvements, and deliver results in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Experience in BPO vendor management or procurement is a plus but not required.


Key job responsibilities
Execute contact center forecasting models to project staffing needs across internal site locations and BPO vendor sites; ensure alignment with demand plans and hiring targets.

Build and maintain scheduling frameworks for internal and outsourced contact center operations; optimize shift coverage, service levels, and agent utilization across all locations.

Manage day-to-day BPO vendor relationships; track performance against SLAs, escalate issues, and drive corrective action plans.

Support procurement activities for BPO vendors; assist with RFP processes, contract renewals, and cost analysis.

Maintain operational budget planning throughout the fiscal year; track spend against plan, identify variances, and recommend adjustments to stay within budget targets.

Process and develop upcoming year Operating Plan (OP) assumptions for contact center spend across internal and vendor operations; provide data-driven inputs for annual planning cycles.

Analyze key operational metrics (service level, occupancy, shrinkage, attrition) across internal and vendor sites to identify performance gaps and recommend solutions.

Deep dive inefficiencies across internal and vendor operations; own root cause analysis and implement scalable mechanisms to resolve recurring issues.

Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Capacity Planning, Finance, Vendor Management, Operations) to ensure forecasting inputs and vendor deliverables remain aligned.

Develop and maintain operational playbooks, SOPs, and reporting tools that support planning accuracy and accountability across internal and vendor teams.

Triage operational issues across internal and vendor sites; own resolution timelines and communicate status to leadership.


A day in the life
You will work as part of the GHXO planning team, balancing your time between forecasting and scheduling activities for internal and outsourced contact center operations, managing vendor performance, and supporting budget and procurement workflows. You will analyze volume trends, adjust staffing plans, review vendor scorecards, reconcile budget variances, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to remove obstacles and maintain operational excellence.

title: Design Verification Team Leader, Nitro Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind AWS Nitro, the purpose-built system that powers the security, performance, and innovation of every EC2 instance. We operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

We're looking for a Design Verification Team Lead - a design verification technical lead that is responsible for complex SoC sub-system, with cutting edge technology for Nitro system SoC, the foundation of AWS's virtualization, networking, and storage offload infrastructure.

It starts at product definition - we engage from day one, shaping requirements and translating product intent into verification strategies before a single line of RTL is written

It extends into software - we work side-by-side with SW teams, verifying hardware-software interfaces and ensuring seamless integration across the stack, with particular emphasis on networking workloads such as ENA and EFA

It reaches into physical design - we verify physical design aspects within functional verification, bridging the gap between logical correctness and silicon reality

It closes the loop - from spec to silicon, our verification touches every team and every stage of chip development

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute verification plans for IO sub-systems - covering interconnect protocols, peripheral interfaces, and system-level integration with a strong connection to networking flows (ENA/EFA)

- Verify IO sub-system features, including interconnect protocols and various accelerator engines

- Develop and debug C embedded SW as part of hardware-software integration verification

- Build and maintain UVM-based verification environments for various clusters and sub-systems

- Verify ARM advanced interconnect protocols (AMBA CHI/ACE/AXI) ensuring correct coherency transactions, performance verification, and protocol compliance

- Verify the IO virtualization SMMU/TLB operations, page table walks, translation granules, and memory attributes (cache-ability, share-ability)

- Develop constrained-random and directed test strategies targeting corner cases in IO protocol hazards, coherency races, and system boundary conditions

- Drive coverage closure using functional coverage models, assertion-based verification, and formal methods where applicable

- Contribute to performance verification - ensuring micro-architectural implementations meet performance targets alongside correctness

A day in the life
As a Design Verification Team Lead on the Nitro team, you will be responsible for leading the verification of complex SoC sub-systems, driving industry-leading verification methodologies, and ensuring our next-generation Nitro system SoC meets the highest quality bar before reaching silicon.

About the team
What Sets Us Apart?

Full system ownership - our verification leaders gain deep understanding of all system flows and the full SW stack, truly owning the technical scope from product definition through post-tapeout activities. This end-to-end ownership is what defines verification at Annapurna Labs

Agentic AI is embedded in our workflow - not as an experiment, but as a core part of how we design and verify chips

Cutting edge methodologies drive every stage of our verification process

Relentless innovation - we don't settle; we actively seek new approaches that raise the bar on silicon quality

We do classic functional verification (SV/UVM/TLM), but beyond that, we touch physical design aspects, to ensure that the quality of our silicon is beyond logical functionality

Performance optimization at all levels is at the heart of our targets on top of logical correctness verification

Our verification underpins the infrastructure that runs millions of active workloads across AWS, where networking performance and security are non-negotiable

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in design verification of complex SoC or ASIC projects
- Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across design, software, and physical design teams
- Proven track record leading verification of IO sub-systems, interconnect fabrics, or system-level integration blocks
- Deep expertise in UVM/SystemVerilog-based verification environments
- Experience driving verification from product definition through post-tapeout silicon validation
- Experience with performance verification methodologies alongside functional correctness

Preferred qualifications

- Strong knowledge of ARM interconnect protocols (AMBA CHI/ACE/AXI) and coherency verification
- Experience with IO virtualization verification (SMMU, TLB, page table walks, memory attributes)
- C/C++ embedded software programming and firmware-level debug skills
- Experience with hardware-software co-verification
- Familiarity with networking data paths and offload architectures
- Understanding of physical design aspects and their impact on functional verification (e.g., clock domain crossings, power-aware verification)

title: Finance Manager, NA Supply Chain Execution Finance
descriptionHtml:
The NA Supply Chain Execution Finance team is looking for a Finance Manager to serve as a strategic finance partner within the Supply Chain Execution space. This role will own end-to-end financial controllership for key volume planning processes, partnering closely with Network, Sortable, Non-Sortable, and IXD S&OP teams to optimize the flow of 40B+ units through Amazon's North American fulfillment network. Our inbound supply chain has evolved considerably in recent years — with FC-FC transfers reduced from 20% to 13%, over $300M in validated cost savings delivered in FY2025, and more innovation to come.

This Finance Manager will own the financial narrative for their domain — driving cost transparency, building scalable mechanisms, and delivering insights that influence VP-level decisions. You will operate with significant autonomy, manage ambiguity across multiple planning cycles, and influence outcomes across 4+ partner organizations without direct authority.

This is a perfect role for someone who knows how to lead fast, think strategically, and drive results across multiple stakeholder teams. Your experience in operations finance gives you the perspective to look around corners and proactively avoid problems. You know which details drive millions in impact and which ones don't add value. You can clearly communicate complex trade-offs to senior leadership and effectively influence partners using data-driven recommendations.

Finance is all about the numbers…unless you work at Amazon; it's knowing the numbers and so much more. We seek Finance Managers who combine analytical rigor with strategic business partnership — leaders who don't just report what happened, but shape what happens next. Do you view problems as treasures, and are you willing to dive deep to develop solutions that drive nine-figure impact? Will you challenge the status quo, build mechanisms that scale, and influence cross-functional partners without direct authority? At Amazon, we move with purpose and speed, and this requires working with a dynamic network of Operations, Science and Tech, and Supply Chain partners. We are the trusted business advisors — employing every facet of data and communication to ensure our partners and leaders make the best possible decisions. Come teach us a few things, and we'll teach you a few things as we navigate the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Key job responsibilities
1) Financial Controllership & Mechanism Ownership: Own end-to-end financial controllership for assigned planning systems (e.g., True North, F2P, WTPSS, Skippy), ensuring cost inputs are accurate, current, and driving optimal network outcomes

2) Strategic Business Partnership: Serve as the trusted finance advisor to S&OP business partners — translating operational decisions into financial impact, quantifying trade-offs, and recommending actions that optimize for cost and speed

3) Planning Cycle Leadership: Own metric inputs and financial narratives for quarterly and annual planning cycles (OP2, QXG, OP1/3YF), aligning cross-functional assumptions across SCOT, MTP, Capacity, and Operations teams

4) Cost Savings Identification & Delivery: Identify, validate, and track cost savings opportunities across the inbound and outbound network — building entitlement cases and holding organizations accountable to committed plans

5) Executive Communication: Deliver WBR/MBR insights, variance analyses, and strategic recommendations to Director and VP-level audiences. Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives.

6) Cross-Functional Influence: Drive alignment across 4+ partner organizations (S&OP, SCOT, NACF Operations, Network Design, Field Finance) without direct authority — using data, relationships, and mechanisms

7) Automation & Scalability: Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, or simplify finance processes — reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy and timeliness

A day in the life
Own the financial narrative for your domain within NA Supply Chain. Lead weekly and quarterly forecasting that optimizes for end-to-end costs across the network. Build cost models that quantify the impact of operational decisions — from inventory placement to transfer routing to capacity utilization. Present recommendations to Directors and VPs in WBR and MBR forums. Partner with upstream and downstream teams to root cause variances, quantify risks and opportunities, and drive corrective actions. Build mechanisms that create accountability and reduce plan-vs-actual variance.

About the team
The NA Supply Chain Execution Finance team is the financial backbone for US and Canada S&OP, providing controllership, strategic partnership, and technical expertise for 40B+ units annually flowing through Cross Docks, Distribution Centers, and Fulfillment Centers. We translate customer demand into executable fulfillment plans that enable inventory to flow at lower cost and faster speed.

We own critical planning systems (True North, Skippy, F2P, WTPSS) and influence five core levers: Volume, Outbound Cost, Ops Variable, Ops Fixed, and Freight Cost In. A 1% variance in our metrics represents $43-51M annually — the decisions we inform matter at scale.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science), or Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience

descriptionHtml:

This role is visual design, with part UX design and part build. You're the connective tissue between the campaign vision and the finished experience. You bring solid design intuition and a hunger for innovation to every project, and you can bring design-based problem-solving skills to the table at every step of a campaign's life. You translate client objectives and creative feedback into bar-raising design solutions that enhance our customers' lives, then bring those solutions to life in Figma and Webflow.


Key job responsibilities

You work alongside other Interactive Designers, Art Directors and Writers to design mocks for the physical and digital components of a campaign experience. You bring the skeleton framework to the campaign build, plus the campaign skin that makes the pitch believable. You own the customer journey and wireframe components.

title: Embedded Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are breaking new ground with every device we design, from custom silicon to secure software, to enable innovative satellite and ground systems. Be part of a team that pushes the boundaries of satellite communications technology to make global connectivity a reality.

As a Device Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Leo Satellite Gateway team, you will design and develop embedded software for Amazon Leo's satellite and ground systems. You’ll work on fault-tolerant, real-time platforms, collaborating closely with hardware, software systems, and product teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performance solutions.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the next generation of space-based communication systems with minimal legacy constraints. Your work will directly support critical government initiatives, enabling secure and high-performance communication systems for U.S. and allied missions.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Develop embedded software in C, C++, and Python, and Linux kernel drivers.
• Write device drivers and system applications for the various satellite systems.
• Write software to interact with micro-controllers
• Develop and maintain Linux kernel drivers and device-tree overlays for SPI, I3C, I2C, CAN, GPIO, DMA and UIO interfaces.
• Work closely with other software and hardware teams to support board bring-up and integration testing.
• Build and maintain the Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution: BitBake recipes and layers, A/B partition boot, secure boot, eMMC and NOR storage, and SWUpdate image generation.
• Leverage modern application frameworks for Embedded Linux and bare-metal/AMP platforms to develop scalable, modular, and high-performance software.
• Debug and resolve complex hardware-software integration issues using tools like logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.
• Develop kernel features required to support upcoming hardware and software capabilities, targeting AMD/Xilinx Versal and Zynq SoCs.


A day in the life
As part of the Satellite Gateway team, you will design and implement embedded software used in the Amazon Leo products. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams inside and outside of Amazon. You will craft your software from requirements, designs, code, test, to product deployment.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of embedded firmware development experience
- 2+ years of experience with Yocto/OpenEmbedded or a comparable embedded Linux build system

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 3+ years of experience on networking and/or consumer devices using embedded Linux, Yocto, and/or bare-metal targets; experience with eBPF/libbpf or Lua tooling.
- 2+ years of experience in manufacturing diagnostics through production phases like Hardware Validation Testing (HVT), Engineering Validation Testing (EVT), Device Validation Testing (DVT), Production Validation Testing (PVT)

title: Senior Security AI Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンウェブサービス（AWS）では、APJCのカスタマーセキュリティチームに加わるシニアセキュアAIソリューションアーキテクトを募集しています。これはビルダーの役割です。この地域の顧客はAIに急速に移行しており、自律エージェントにIDを与える方法、即時注入を防ぐ方法、AI開発ライフサイクルを管理する方法、規制当局が信頼するガバナンスの証拠を作成する方法など、これまで直面したことのない課題に関するガイダンスを求めています。あなたは彼らがそこにたどり着くのを助け、野心を検証された証明に変えるプロトタイプと概念実証を彼らの環境で実践的に構築する建築家です。多くの場合数日かかります。

あなたはフロンティアで活動しています。そこでは進むべき道はまだ決まっていません。顧客には明確な目標があります。リスク、規制、データレジデンシーの義務を管理しながら、エージェントAIを本番環境に導入することです。あなたの役割は、その方法を設計することです。確立されたパターンが存在しない新しいアプローチを作成し、各顧客のオペレーション状況と規制環境について判断を下すことです。技術的には自給自足です。コードを記述し、IaCでデプロイし、強化し、実際のデータに対してライブでデモンストレーションします。

深さだけが仕事ではありません-規模が仕事です。1人の顧客と一緒に解決する最も難しい問題は、この分野全体を高めるはずです。複雑で斬新なセキュアAIの課題を独自に深く掘り下げ、オリジナルの技術コンテンツ（リファレンスアーキテクチャ、作業コード、パターン、ワークショップ）を作成し、それを共有することで、1人の顧客で実証されたパターンをあらゆる分野で再利用できるものにします。あなたはAWSのサービスチーム（Bedrock、AgentCore、SageMaker）との関係を築いています。あなたは製品ロードマップを形作る分野の声であり、フィールドガイダンスを形作る製品の代弁者です。

セキュリティとガバナンスは、顧客が自信を持ってAIに「はい」と言える理由です。CISOに迅速かつ安全に行動するための枠組み、証拠、ツールを提供し、ガバナンスが成果を遅らせることはないとCIO/CTOに自信を与えます。あなたは、AWSがAIで安全に構築するのに最適な場所であることを証明しています。

Key job responsibilities
AWS AIサービス（Bedrock、AgentCore、SageMaker）、AI拡張開発ツール、IaC（CDK、Terraform）を使用して、顧客のサンドボックス環境で実用的なプロトタイプと概念実証を構築します。これにより、安全なAIコントロールが顧客のデータとリスクモデルに対して機能することが四半期ではなく数日で証明されます。
意思決定の妨げにならないように直接実装してください。エージェントのアイデンティティ、即時注入による防御、AI開発ライフサイクル、ガードレール、会話だけではできないことを検証する監査/証拠パターンなどです。
設計が現実に合わないように、実装中ずっと関与し続け、学んだことに基づいてアプローチをいつ修正すべきかを判断してください。

セキュリティ上の観点からBedrock、AgentCore、SageMakerのサービスチームとの関係を把握してください。あなたは出荷するものを形作るAPJCのフィールド要件の声であり、フィールドがアドバイスすることを形作る製品の声です。

機能のリクエストや直接のエンゲージメントを通じて顧客の声をフィードバックし、数時間で変化する脅威や規制の状況を常に把握できます。
サービスチームのロードマップを現場ですぐに使えるガイダンスに変換し、大規模にパッケージ化されていることを確認します。
リファレンスアーキテクチャ、作業コード、パターン、ブログ投稿、ワークショップなどのオリジナルの技術コンテンツを作成し、同業者や顧客に採用してもらい、1つの顧客獲得を再利用可能な地域のIPに変えます。
地域ベースのソリューションアーキテクトやより広いフィールドコミュニティなど、他の人を指導し、育成することで、地域全体でセキュアAIの技術的水準を高め、次の専門家を育成します。
コンテンツとイネーブルメントチームに実績のあるパターンを渡すので、あなたの立ち会いを必要とせずに現場にガイダンスが届きます。

A day in the life
朝は、スライドデッキではなく、お客様のサンドボックスから始めます。ある金融サービスの顧客が、Bedrockで代理アプリケーションを立ち上げたいと考えていますが、あなたが構築したIDと監査の統制により、CISOが必要とする正確な証拠が一夜にして得られました。コードを整理し、パターンをキャプチャして、2つのガードレールの設定に名前を付ける簡単な要約を用意して、彼らに自信を持って進めてもらいました。

午前中に、Bedrockで構築したいと考えていて、データレジデンシーとPIIの管理に関するガイダンスを必要としているメーカーに、セキュリティセールスパートナーやエリアアカウントチームに加わります。これはまったく新しい問題であり、確立されたパターンは存在しません。そこで、進むべき方向性を設計します。エージェントのアイデンティティとデータレジデンシーのアプローチをホワイトボードで示し、ビルダーチームが採用する非人間アイデンティティパターンのプロトタイプ作成に取り掛かります。

昼食後、真っ向から取り組んで構築し、実際にキーボードを使ってサンドボックスにデプロイし、強化します。その後、コーディングアシスタントのロールアウトに向けたプロンプトインジェクション防御について、お客様のプラットフォームチームと作業セッションを行います。

あなたは一日を締めくくり、自分を超えてスケーリングします。今週のFSIの成果を他の分野で再利用できるリファレンスアーキテクチャにまとめ、それをコンテンツチームに渡してワークショップにし、現場と記事を共有し、学んだことに基づいてAgentCoreチームに機能リクエストを提出します。同じように見える日は二日もありません。つまり、顧客が安全に加速できるように支援し、構築したものを地域全体が恩恵を受けるものに変えることです。

About the team
APJC Customer Securityは、地域の顧客が自信を持ってAWSでAIを採用できるよう支援します。セキュリティ、リスク、規制を確保することで、AIの運用を遅らせるのではなく、加速させることができます。私たちは、Secure AI（AWSをAIで安全に構築するのに最適な場所にする）とAI for Security（AIを使って顧客が身を守るのに役立つ）という2つのプログラムを組み合わせて運営しています。シニア・セキュア・AIソリューション・アーキテクトは、深い技術的専門知識をお客様が必要とするところに直接届けられます。新しい問題に対するアプローチを定義し、それを実際に証明してから、そのパターンをコンテンツチームと現場に渡して規模を拡大します。明確な開発経路、専門家の仲間コミュニティ、リーダーシップの直接的な可視性、業界で最も重要な分野の1つで技術的な方向性を決める自主性が得られます。

Basic qualifications

- 8年以上の特定の技術領域（ソフトウェア開発、クラウドコンピューティング、システムエンジニアリング、インフラストラクチャ、セキュリティ、ネットワーキング、データ＆アナリティクス等）における経験
- 3年以上のアプリケーションおよびインフラストラクチャの設計、構築、またはコンサルティングの経験
- 10年以上のソフトウェアまたはインターネット業界におけるIT開発もしくは導入・コンサルティングの経験
- クラウドセキュリティにおける経験及び知識
- 生成AIセキュリティにおける経験及び知識

Preferred qualifications

- 5年以上のインフラ、データベース、ネットワークいずれかのアーキテクチャ設計における実務経験
- クラウドアーキテクチャに関する知識

title: ファシリティエンジニア - DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services はすべての AWS グローバルインフラストラクチャの設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。私たちは、クラウドを稼働させ続ける人々です。すべての AWS データセンターとお客様がイノベーションに継続的にアクセスできるようにするすべてのサーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電源、冷却設備をサポートしています。私たちはサプライチェーンに影響を与える数千もの要因を考慮しながら、最も困難な課題に取り組んでいます。そして私たちと共に支援したいと考える優秀な人材を探しています。

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Data Center Operationsチームは AWS のバックボーンであり、急速に成長する AWS ビジネスとお客様を 24 時間 365 日サポートしています。私たちは AWS の物理インフラストラクチャを維持し、安全性、セキュリティ、可用性、生産性、容量、効率性、コストの分野における運用パフォーマンスの基準を確保することに取り組んでいます。

Key job responsibilities
Facility Engineer - Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) の役割は、大規模で高密度のデータセンターにおいて、施設（電気/機械システム、制御/消火システムなど）の展開、運用、保守、および関連プロジェクトの管理を担当します。
日常業務では、以下の業務に携わります:
- 建物システムの点検と監視、および施設の問題のトラブルシューティング
- 運用効率の改善とエネルギー削減
- ベンダーやパートナーとの定期メンテナンスと修理の計画と実施。これには、ブレーカー操作、機械/電気設備操作などの重要な施設運用が含まれます
- 新規キャパシティ設置前の電気冷却容量の確認
- 新規データセンター建設および既存データセンター拡張の設計レビュー
- プロジェクトチームメンバーと協力して建設とテストをサポート

A day in the life
柔軟な勤務体制:

通常営業日は 9:00〜18:00 の間で実働 8 時間

勤務時間は、その日および週の業務に応じて相談・調整可能

通常勤務時間外のオンコール業務があり、全チームメンバーで週単位でローテーション

*注: ビジネス状況によっては、この役割でシフト勤務が必要になる場合があります。シフト勤務の詳細については、面接時に説明します。

About the team
チームについて

多様な経験

AWS は多様な経験を重視しています。職務内容に記載されているすべての資格やスキルを満たしていなくても、応募することをお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの場合、従来の道を歩んでいない場合、または関連しない経験がある場合でも、応募をためらわないでください。

なぜ AWS なのか?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

包括的なチーム文化

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

メンターシップとキャリア成長

私たちは、地球上で最高の雇用主になるために、継続的にパフォーマンスバーを引き上げています。だからこそ、ここには、より多角的な専門家に成長するのに役立つ、無限の知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア向上リソースがあります。

ワークライフバランス

私たちはワークライフハーモニーを重視しています。仕事での成功は、家庭での犠牲を伴うべきではありません。だからこそ、柔軟な勤務時間と勤務体制が私たちの文化の一部となっています。職場と家庭でサポートされていると感じるとき、クラウドで達成できないことは何もありません。

Basic qualifications

- ミッションクリティカルな設備の運用と保守に関する 2 年以上の関連実務経験（例: 24 時間稼働の工場、変電所、病院など）
- メンテナンス、変更管理、インシデント管理、ベンダー管理の経験または基本的な理解、およびポリシー、プロセス、手順を遵守して作業する方法
- 日本語（JLPT N2 相当）および英語（TOEIC 550 相当、または英語で日常業務を処理できるレベル）の両方における口頭および読み書き能力

Preferred qualifications

- データセンターに関連する資格（CDCP、CDCS、CDCE、ASHRAE など）、またはデータセンター管理のための資格（第二種または第三種電気主任技術者、エネルギー管理士、第 4 類危険物取扱者、冷凍機械責任者、第二種電気工事士）
- プロジェクト管理資格（PMP、Prince2、ITILv2、BICSI）
- 電気システムに関する高度な理解力（変電所の電源供給システム、変圧器、スイッチギア、VFI クラス UPS、DRUPS、PDU、ATS、STS、SLA または VRLA バッテリーおよび関連システム、ディーゼル/ガスタービン発電機に関連する燃料システム、サージ制御回路、アクティブ高調波フィルター、バッテリー監視システム、分岐回路監視システム、SCADA システム）
- 機械システムに関する高度な理解力（CRAC/CRAH、AHU、チラー、冷却塔、貯蔵タンク、熱交換器、配管システム、ポンプ、バルブ、ダクトシステム、ファン、ダンパー、火災検知・消火システム、排水システム、ビル監視システム、自動制御システム）
- 英語の流暢さ - TOEIC スコア 800 以上または同等

title: Software Development Engineer, AFT External Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. We are responsible for scalable and innovative solutions to enable fulfillment of millions of items every day across the globe. Our team owns the charter to make the AFT WMS more accessible and flexible for emerging markets and businesses. Join the team if you like to build scalable solutions that solves complex business problems and deliver strong business impact.

We are starting several key initiatives in our external fulfillment and are looking for a Software Development Engineer (SDE) who wants to be challenged with building and driving innovative and scalable systems that manage our external fulfillment network. This opportunity includes architectural challenges in making a large volume of constantly changing data available to various applications owned by diverse customers (internal and external) and business use cases; as well as innovative solutions for managing data quality, complex event processing.

We are building new products in this space with scaling requirements to support 10s of million business operations in a day across thousands of Fulfillment Centers. We are looking for SDEs who are passionate to build large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software solutions. You will be empowered to think big, invent and simplify on behalf of our stakeholders and customers, and find elegant solutions to hard problems. You will be influencing other engineers and tech partners in the team to solve multi-region critical complex business features.


Key job responsibilities
As a Software Engineer you will be expected to:
- Design and develop creative solutions to complex engineering problems.
- Effectively mentor junior engineers, helping to maintain appropriate unit test coverage, code documentation, software structure and support
- Own and deliver end to end key initiatives, maintaining effective communication with management and stakeholders
- Identify, evaluate and suggest mitigation strategies for risks during design
- Contribute to system design, process and development standards documentation
- Delivering high quality code on time as part of a cross-functional team.
- Contributing to team discussions around system component design, improvement and integration.
- Designing and developing high performance, test-driven code.
- Working with and maintaining a large existing code base as well as new components; maintaining production code and contributing to deployment and QA processes.

About the team
We are a fast-paced and focused team of passionate Amazonians building Fulfillment solutions used externally. We are standing up fulfillment stack that will scale beyond Amazon sites globally. Our team is part of AFT, and works closely with Amazon Operations, 3rd Party Technical teams following a collaborative engagement model with joint workshops, and dedicated SME support.
The team values high ownership, bias for action, and insists on the highest standards while following a build-fast-and-iterate-fast methodology. We believe in speed through autonomy and safety through guardrails.

This team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to architecture and product strategy while building high-performing, scalable systems that directly impact Amazon internal and external operations and Amazon's growth.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: DCEO Cluster Manager, Data Center Community
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Cluster Manager to serve as a technical leader within Amazon data centers. The position will help ensure the safety, security, availability, and reliability to meet or exceed defined service level agreements of data center operations. The Data Center Engineering Operations Cluster Manager is responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the data centers. This role will assist in maintaining high reliability and performance while keeping the operating costs of the facilities at a minimum. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.9999% uptime. The Data Center Engineering Operations Cluster Manager will collaborate with peer leaders globally on continuous improvement efforts within the organization.

This role leads the team that acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. The team will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3-phase electrical systems that include switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and busways. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers
- Manage the performance of 24x7 engineering technicians and facility Managers in all aspects of their career development
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion

title: Senior ML Kernel Performance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon builds Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

The Acceleration Kernel Library team is at the forefront of maximizing performance for Amazon's custom ML accelerators. Working at the hardware-software boundary, our engineers craft high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every FLOP counts in delivering optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

The Amazon Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at Amazon, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch, enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance.

As part of the broader Neuron Compiler organization, our team works across multiple technology layers - from frameworks and compilers to runtime and collectives. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology

This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge products at the intersection of machine-learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures. You will architect and implement business-critical features, publish cutting-edge research, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on Amazon's ML accelerators.

Explore the product and our history!

Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. * Design and implement high-performance compute kernels for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models
* Analyze and optimize kernel-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware

A day in the life

Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.

Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.

Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. title: Construction Manager, Specialty Programs Design & Construction
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Design & Construction team is seeking a Construction Manager to serve as Amazon's owner's representative in the delivery of built facilities and infrastructure supporting our logistics network. In this role, you will manage the full construction lifecycle — from design review and contractor procurement through construction execution and operational handover — for new builds, retrofits, expansions, and program initiatives across your assigned region.

You will be the primary point of interface between Amazon and its external partners, including developers, general contractors, design engineers, and regulatory authorities, while serving as the key integrator between construction and the internal Amazon teams responsible for equipping, furnishing, and operating our facilities. Projects range from targeted renovations to large-scale new facility builds, including fulfillment centers, sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings.
This role requires strong technical construction expertise, sharp commercial acumen, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects independently. You will bring a disciplined approach to safety, budget management, schedule oversight, contract execution, and stakeholder communication — all in service of delivering world-class facilities for Amazon's customers.

This role requires 60% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as Amazon's owner's representative and primary construction integrator across all assigned projects
• Manage multiple concurrent projects from design phase through construction completion and operational handover
• Conduct detailed reviews of contractor bid packages, budgets, and schedules; identify and resolve discrepancies
• Own comprehensive budget tracking, cashflow forecasting, and cost management
• Negotiate construction, procurement, and labor contracts with developers and general contractors
• Audit contractor performance to ensure skills, competencies, and resources meet project requirements
• Coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) for permitting, regulatory compliance, and approvals
• Review construction documents and ongoing work for conformance to Amazon's building specifications and design standards
• Identify and resolve design conflicts, schedule clashes, and coordination gaps across Amazon execution teams
• Coach and guide project teams — developers, design engineers, contractors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders — throughout the project lifecycle
• Champion Amazon's safety programs and hold all project parties accountable to a safety-first culture
• Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication with all internal and external stakeholders
• Assess project performance through KPIs for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability
• Partner with teams responsible for facility transition, base building management, and turnover documentation
• Identify value engineering and design enhancement opportunities in collaboration with internal engineering partners
• Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the construction process


A day in the life
Each day, you act as Amazon's owner on the ground — ensuring the safe, on-time, and on-budget execution of construction projects across your region. Your day may include:
• Coordinating with general contractors on project status, upcoming milestones, and emerging risks
• Reviewing and responding to RFIs, submittals, change order requests, and schedule updates
• Participating in AOC meetings and driving accountability across the project team
• Conducting site visits to verify construction quality and safety compliance
• Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders on facility readiness, equipment coordination, and operational handover planning
• Reviewing design documents and providing feedback to engineering and design partners

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of proficiency with AutoCAD and/or BIM, and scheduling software (Primavera, MS Project, or similar)
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, or in a related construction discipline
- 5+ years of project management experience spanning design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- 5+ years of experience negotiating construction, procurement, and/or labor contracts

Preferred qualifications

- Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience in profee auditing, coding, and documentation requirements
- Experience in facilities management, including planning, design review, implementation, and project controls
- Experience managing concurrent projects in a program management capacity
- Experience with vendor and contractor/subcontractor negotiation and management skills associated with construction and project execution

title: Area Manager (Central Flow Operations), Area Manager, OB CFOps
descriptionHtml:
※本ポジションの勤務地は東京都青梅市、神奈川県相模原市、千葉県流山市、兵庫県尼崎市のいずれかのフルフィルメントセンター（以下FCとします。）です。勤務地は応募者の方の希望に配慮して決定いたします。

アマゾンの物流拠点であるフルフィルメントセンター(以下FC) は全国に20か所以上あり、内9か所においてAmazon Robotics(以下AR)が導入されています。
Outbound Central Operations Team(以下CFOps)は、この9か所のAR導入FCの出荷工程における中央管制塔として、世界一安定したOperationを構築し、お客様に安定したサービスを提供できるよう、オペレーションの運営・管理やプロセスの創造・構築をする役割を担っています。
Central Flow Operations Area Manager(以下CFOps Mgr)は、複数のFCの出荷責任者としてオペレーションをリモートで進捗管理し、各FCでの生産計画達成へのアクションを遂行していくポジションです。日々のお客様の注文を納期通りに、かつ効率よく出荷していく為に、Amazon独自のオペレーションシステムやツールを用いて出荷オペレーションを進捗管理していきます。
オペレーション進捗管理以外にも、複数FCのオペレーション管理方法の標準化や簡素化等、メカニズムの構築や改善に対してオーナーシップを持ってリードし、現状に満足せず出荷オペレーションをより良くしていくこともCFOps Mgrの重要な役割になります。また、Amazonグローバルの最先端のテクノロジーのテスト運用や導入に携わることもできます。
更に、チーム内で共に働くCentral Flow Operations Process Assistant(以下CFOps PA)の管理・育成をし、個々のパフォーマンスを最大限引き出します。メンバーの意見を吸い上げ、問題解決を共にすることにより、チームのエンゲージメント向上に繋げ、CFOｐｓをより強いチームになるようリードします。

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容と業務内容の配分】
■オペレーション進捗管理　50％
複数FC(3～4拠点)の出荷担当としてオペレーションをリモートで進捗管理し、各FCの生産計画を達成させることに責任を持つことでお客様とのお約束を遵守します。各FCの請負会社(3PL)、またはAmazon社員から提示された出荷計画をベースに、各プロセスが計画通りに遂行されているかを確認し進捗管理をします。そして計画に対し逸脱する場合は軌道修正をしていく為にFC側へ状況確認やリカバリー案の提案を都度行います。計画通りのオペレーションを遂行することは、安定したオペレーション、安定したお客様へのサービスを提供する上で必要不可欠であり、各FCの3PLやAmazon社員と連携を取りながら進めていきます。
■オペレーションプロセス/メカニズムの構築・改善 30％
FCによって異なる管理方法ではなく、可能な限り標準化された手法でオペレーションコントロールし、FC毎のオペレーションのバラつきを無くします。更に複雑な管理を簡素化し、誰がやっても同じ品質になるようなメカニズムを構築し、安定したオペレーションを確立できるように改善を重ねていきます。その上で「これはできない」ではなく、「どうやったらできるようになるのか？」を常に考え、前進していくモチベーションが必要不可欠となります。
また、オペレーションの標準を明確にした手順書や文書の作成、及び各FCへの展開等、オペレーションのあるべき姿になる為の基準を自ら作り上げ、全国FCに展開できる影響力のある業務にも携わって頂きます。

■人材管理・育成　20%
直属の部下としてCFOps PAが数名付き、人材管理や育成、評価を実施します。タスクアサインメントを通じて、それぞれのメンバーの強みを最大限引き出し、成長機会に繋げ育成しながらパフォーマンスを出していく為のサポートをしていきます。定期的な面談も行い、親身になってメンバーの声を聴き、個々で抱えている問題に対して寄り添って共に解決していきます。直属の部下以外のメンバーに対しても、日々のオペレーションでのサポートを行い、チーム全体のエンゲージメントやモチベーションを上げ、安定したオペレーションを作りあげ、カスタマーに貢献できるようマネジメントします。

【働き方について】
・勤務形態：1ヶ月単位の変形労働時間制のシフト勤務。
・勤務時間：1日8時間勤務、1ヶ月を平均して1週間40時間を超えない範囲で設定します。
・休日：年間120日（月平均10日）

Basic qualifications

title: Pr. Delivery Consultant, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS Professional Services is looking for a senior hands-on technical leadership role. The consultant will own the Application Modernisation workstream for a large-scale legacy modernisation program, specifically owning the end-to-end decomposition of a mission-critical Oracle monolith into modern, business-modelled domain APIs. They will define service boundaries, sequence the teardown across business domains, and design production APIs that balance future-state architecture ambition with pragmatic delivery risk. They will work alongside an Agentic AI workstream lead and influence the broader program strategy.
This is not a pure migration or lift-and-shift role. It is a strategic technical leadership position requiring the ability to decompose complex legacy systems with decades of encoded business logic, design production-grade APIs at enterprise scale, and coach senior customer stakeholders through architecture decisions that balance modernisation ambition with operational risk.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the Application Modernisation workstream end-to-end: domain decomposition strategy, service boundary definition, API design, solution architecture, and delivery governance.
• Lead the decomposition of a ~30-year-old Oracle monolith into business-modelled domain APIs.
• Define and sequence the domain teardown across multiple business units, managing dependencies and minimising disruption to consuming applications.
• Design production, web-facing APIs with clear versioning strategies that avoid breaking existing consumers during progressive migration.
• Navigate the tension between future-facing domain contracts and pragmatic v1 designs that limit application rework and regression risk.
• Establish the end-to-end modernisation process: from legacy discovery and domain mapping through to API specification, solution design review, and cutover planning.
• Collaborate with the Agentic AI workstream lead to define how AI-assisted discovery integrates with human-led business architecture and domain design decisions.
• Advise senior customer stakeholders (including enterprise architects, business domain owners, and programme leadership) on architecture direction, sequencing trade-offs, and how much change to absorb per phase.
• Serve as the senior technical authority on legacy decomposition, working across modernisation architects, application developers, data engineers, and customer SMEs.
• Mentor and uplift team capability in legacy modernisation patterns, domain-driven design, and API-first delivery.
• Establish and maintain technical governance: solution design reviews, domain API design standards, and change impact assessment processes.


A day in the life
AWS Professional Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

- Experience with software development life cycle (sdlc) and agile/iterative methodologies
- Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
- Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
- Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (e.g. security, privacy, SOX, HIPAA etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape

- Experience with enterprise systems including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
