title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon Live
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Live is building the future of shoppable entertainment — and brands are at the center of it. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager (Tech) to own the product vision and technical strategy for how brands and advertisers create, publish, and succeed with live commerce on Amazon. This role sits at the intersection of advertising technology, the creator economy, and generative AI — and you'll define the products that make live commerce accessible and irresistible to brands of all sizes.

Your north star is brand adoption and retention. You'll own the product charter for Amazon Live's creator and brand tools — including AI-powered content creation, the Live Creator App, Brand Store live integrations, and brand-facing reporting and analytics. You'll define what we build, push the boundaries of generative AI for content creation, partner with engineering to ship at speed, and use data to deeply understand what drives brands to go live, stay active, and grow their investment. You'll also shape how brands connect with influencers through our platform, building features that make creator-brand collaboration seamless and measurable.

You'll write the strategy documents, define the roadmap, make hard tradeoffs, and own what ships. You'll work in deep partnership with Amazon Ads, UX measurement and reporting, and engineering teams — translating complex advertiser needs into elegant, scalable product experiences. You'll be supported by a co-located engineering team, UX designers, and BI resources, and you'll have the autonomy to shape an emerging product category where the right product decisions directly move leadership goals.

If you're a product leader who thinks in terms of customer problems, can toggle between long-term vision and sprint-level execution, and want to define how Amazon approaches live commerce for brands — this is your role.

Key job responsibilities
This candidate sits within Live’s B2B product team, and owns the product charter for the Amazon Live Creator App as well as other creator tools used by thousands of creators. The candidate is expected to work with GTM, content acquisition, BD & sales teams, as well as broader Amazon Ads and Creator orgs, to help setup our brand and influencer creators for success and deliver great live shopping experiences. They will be supported by a large engineering team, UX designers and Business Intelligence team.
The right person would have experience defining long-term product strategy, enjoys being customer obsessed, has technical knowledge and is comfortable with a high-level of ambiguity. They would be equally comfortable ideating on the next set of content creation features with brands and partners, and in delivering those for millions of shoppers with our engineering team. They will craft and communicate a strategic roadmap and see to its execution.
We move fast; and that allows PMs to deliver on a large impact in a short time frame. Our team actively invests in career growth, and we will work with you to chart a strong growth path forward.

A day in the life
You will craft your product strategy, and then bring it to reality. You are comfortable working on products with complex tradeoffs. You will deeply understand and socialize our evolving needs to our customers, with your content, marketing, BD and design partners.


About the team
Amazon Shopping Videos (ASV) is an exciting, strategic program that harnesses the power of video to help millions of customers discover product inspiration, learn about items they're interested in, and engage with talented creators and communities. We empower customers to effortlessly find relevant content and explore our library of product-focused videos throughout their entire shopping journey on Amazon. We are a dynamic, startup-like initiative within Amazon, aiming to reinvent the way customers use video to shop. To achieve this bold vision, we are seeking motivated, thoughtful self-starters who can forge effective partnerships across our multi-disciplinary teams to drive continuous innovation.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

descriptionHtml:
If you are looking for high impact, high growth opportunity with interesting engineering challenges in a fast-paced environment, this is the role for you. We have a number of untapped high impact engineering and business opportunities with high criticality for Amazon. And have the opportunity to work on the leading technologies like AI/ML, Gen-AI, RAG and various AWS systems.

What will you own?
You will work across a suite of products that drive complex business and engineering logic for managing financial accounting for ~$100B annual spend. These solutions leverage various AWS technologies and AI capabilities to solve large-scale complex problems. The systems demand non-trivial engineering, requiring deep business understanding and strong technical acumen. You will collaborate with stakeholders and product managers to identify opportunities for improving accuracy, expanding the solution across multiple geographies, and defining the technical roadmap while influencing solutions and tech decisions across teams.

Who we are?
We, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) are responsible for building technologies that support financial aspects for Amazon transportation. Amazon’s transportation systems get millions of packages to customers worldwide faster and cheaper while providing world-class customer experience – from checkout to shipment tracking to delivery. Our software systems include services that handle tens of thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted for. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, delivery models and customer experience, increasingly complex transportation network, ever-expanding selection of products and growing number of shipments worldwide, we have an opportunity to build software that scales not only with volume but also with the business models. We leverage advanced technologies including big data, Gen-AI, machine learning, real time analytics and high volume, low latency, high availability services.

TFS is 100+ tech team across eight different platforms. We deal with problems of scale. Billions of dollars of spend is automated through our platforms and pipelines. We are a growing org and we are looking to ramp up our team across all engineering roles. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with our global product teams and customers across the world and other tech teams in the organization as we raise the bar in delivering innovation.
Our engineering team is completely based out of India, and we build global solutions.

We have a large product and tech roadmap and are significantly ramping our tech team to meet the next level of product requirements for Trans Finance.

title: System Development Engineer  , Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We're looking for a Systems Engineer to operate and improve the OTA rollout process that delivers software updates to millions of Customer Terminals in the field. You'll be hands-on with every release — preparing rollout plans, monitoring deployments, triaging field issues, and ensuring CTs across all hardware variants receive the right updates safely.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in operational environments where attention to detail and methodical execution directly impact customer experience. You'll develop deep expertise in CT fleet behavior, firmware compatibility, and large-scale deployment operations.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
What you'll do:
- Execute OTA rollouts end-to-end, preparing rollout plans, configuring device targeting and eligibility rules, staging deployments, and monitoring progress through GA
- Manage variant-aware rollout execution, ensuring each CT hardware variant and firmware branch receives compatible updates in the correct sequence
- Monitor fleet health during rollouts, tracking success/failure rates, device telemetry, and key health indicators, and escalating anomalies per established runbooks
- Triage deployment failures and stalled updates, diagnosing root causes (connectivity issues, firmware incompatibilities, crash loops) and coordinating resolution with firmware and operations teams
- Maintain and improve rollout runbooks, SOPs, checklists, and go/no-go decision criteria
- Manage fleet segmentation, maintaining canary groups, beta rings, and hold-back cohorts, and updating cohort definitions as the fleet evolves
- Build and maintain operational dashboards and reports for rollout status, fleet coverage, and update adoption metrics
- Automate repetitive operational tasks, scripting rollout preparation, health checks, and reporting to reduce manual toil and human error
- Participate in on-call rotation for OTA operations and contribute to post-incident reviews

Basic qualifications

- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale

title: Data Center Chief Engineer , DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.



AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.



Key job responsibilities
Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.

Operate independently with limited direct management

Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed

Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures

Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA

Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians

Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows

Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience

Using Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling.

Instruct others on scheduling, ticketing, and providing mentorship in developing solutions.



Physical Requirements:

Walk job sites in uneven terrain

Work at heights and from ladders

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more

Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment

Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance

Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working

Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired

Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects

Push or pull heavy objects into position

Work in a noisy environment

Work at depths, such as under raised floors



This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- 4+ years of data center experience including industrial electrical and mechanical systems
- 4+ years of administrative experience including Microsoft Office products
- Experience leading technical teams through daily operations, maintenance evolutions, and complex troubleshooting

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in construction or project management
- Can work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment

title: ERP Controls and Security Manager, Accounting Transformation Group
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced ERP Controls and Security Manager to lead the design and implementation of controls, security, and access-governance capabilities as part of a large-scale transformation of Amazon’s Finance ERP platform.
This role sits at the intersection of Accounting, Internal Controls, Security, Finance, and technology, with responsibility for translating controllership, audit, regulatory, and information-security requirements into scalable ERP controls and security capabilities. The scope includes role-based access, segregation of duties, privileged access, automated application controls, access certification, security monitoring, and governance, risk, and compliance solutions.
The successful candidate will partner with Accounting, Internal Controls, Internal Audit, Information Security, Product, Solution Architecture, Engineering, SAP, and implementation partners to define requirements, evaluate design alternatives, and ensure controls and security are embedded throughout design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
This role requires an individual who can move between detailed control requirements and broader ERP architecture decisions. You will need to understand how accounting processes, organizational structures, job responsibilities, system integrations, regulatory requirements, and security standards translate into a controlled, auditable, and maintainable ERP environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Define role-based access and authorization requirements that support business responsibilities while maintaining appropriate segregation of duties.
• Establish capabilities for user provisioning, access approvals, privileged access, emergency access, periodic certification, and access removal.
• Partner with Accounting and Internal Controls teams to identify and design automated and configurable application controls across financial processes.
• Define segregation-of-duties rules, evaluate conflicts, establish mitigation controls, and support remediation of access and control risks.
• Partner with Information Security, Solution Architecture, Engineering, ERP product, and implementation partners throughout design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
• Ensure ERP designs meet applicable IT general control, SOX, audit, data-protection, security, and regulatory requirements.
• Lead controls and security testing, including design validation, role testing, access testing, control-effectiveness testing, defect resolution, and audit-evidence readiness.
• Establish monitoring and reporting for access risks, control exceptions, security events, remediation status, and control effectiveness.

A day in the life
You will work across Accounting, Controls, Security, and technology teams to embed controls and security into Amazon’s Finance ERP platform. A typical day may include evaluating an access-role design, resolving a segregation-of-duties conflict, reviewing an automated control, or assessing testing results. You will partner with Internal Controls, Information Security, Architecture, Engineering, SAP, and implementation teams to manage risks and design decisions. You will also review control and access metrics and communicate issues, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leaders.

About the team
The Accounting Transformation Group drives initiatives that modernize accounting processes, strengthen controllership, and enable scalable growth across Amazon. The team operates at the intersection of Accounting, Finance, Product, Solution Architecture, process design, and technology to build scalable financial capabilities and support Amazon's evolving business needs.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
- 8+ years of experience in ERP controls, ERP application controls, role-based access, segregation of duties, or access-governance capabilities.
- Experience with enterprise ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, or comparable platforms.

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent)
- Experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment, or experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday)
- Experience developing segregation-of-duties rules, security roles, automated controls, access-certification processes, and risk-monitoring capabilities.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help Global Financial Services customers across capital markets, insurance, and banking and payments gain the best value and service from AWS?

At AWS Support we're looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to some of the world's largest financial services organizations.

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively as part of the AWS Unified Operations (UOps) delivery model to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, regulatory requirements, support, and risk management. You will operate as a trusted technical peer to your customers' senior technology leaders owning the cloud strategy conversation end-to-end - defining where the customer is heading why and what success looks like.

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy through application-specific reviews proactive monitoring and custom runbooks. You will establish and evolve frameworks governing customer operations on AWS including DevSecOps practices, Operational Excellence standards, AI strategy, and Target Operating Models. You will use generative AI tools fluently to accelerate your own work and more importantly to unlock deeper insights and proactive recommendations for your customers. You will guide customers on adopting AWS generative AI services to modernise their operations and drive measurable business outcomes. You will leverage AI agents for workload discovery review and risk identification steering agent outputs into actionable strategies that help customers move faster and with greater confidence. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!

Key job responsibilities
• Work proactively as part of the AWS Unified Operations (UOps) delivery model to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
descriptionHtml:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.


Key job responsibilities
· Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
· Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
· In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
· Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
· Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
· Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
· Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
· Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
· Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life
· Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
· Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
· Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
· Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
· Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

title: Sr. Product Manager – Device Software , Leo Network Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical (PMT) to own the software that enables our customers to connect to the Leo Network. In this role, you will define the products and features that connect customers to the Internet, private networks, and the AWS cloud. You will work at the intersection of networking engineering, satellite systems, and customer experience to build software that enables a differentiated customer experience for consumers, enterprises, and the public sector.

This is a high-visibility role that requires deep technical acumen in embedded software, networking, strong product sense, and the ability to influence across engineering, business, and leadership. You will own the device software roadmap from concept through launch, write PRFAQs and technical requirements, and represent the customer in every architectural decision.

Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end software stack powering devices for Leo, including embedded software, networking, and fleet management systems.

Define and drive the software roadmap across multiple device families supporting consumers, enterprises, and public sector customers.

Partner with Principal Engineers and SDEs to prioritize and implement security, usability, and performance capabilities for our customer devices.

Write PRFAQs, technical narratives, and requirement documents to secure resources and align leadership on the device software roadmap.

Collaborate with sales, demand management, and capacity management to gather customer requirements and translate them into product features.

Work cross-functionally with the network infrastructure team to align our customer facing product strategy.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a review of overnight testing results — checking key indicators that tell us how our devices are working. You notice a pattern and make a note to work with your engineering team to identify a solution that will impact millions of customers.

Mid-morning, you’re in a design review with engineering to debate the architecture of a new feature for enterprise customers. You push for a data-driven approach, proposing a novel solution that enables us to deliver a prototype faster to get additional customer feedback on our direction.

After lunch, you’re on a call with an large customer’s network architect who wants to understand how Amazon Leo antennas work with their existing network infrastructure. You walk them through Leo’s technology architecture, the telemetry we expose, and discuss improvements they’d like us to build.

In the afternoon, you’re drafting the PRFAQ for a new feature. You collaborate with a principal engineer to ensure the technical approach is sound, and align with sales, other PMs, and finance teams on the financial impact. You end the day with a quick sync with the software development leader to review our plan for a major software release.

About the team
The Leo Connectivity Product team is responsible for the end-to-end networking stack that delivers connectivity from customer terminals through the satellite constellation to ground gateways and back to the terrestrial internet. We work across the control plane and data plane services that make Leo a carrier-grade networking provider.

Our team culture values deep technical curiosity, customer obsession, and a bias for action. We operate with a startup mentality inside Amazon — moving fast, iterating on data, and shipping capabilities that directly impact customer experience. We are builders who are energized by the challenge of delivering consistent, high-performance networking from a dynamic constellation of LEO satellites.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe the best products come from teams with varied perspectives and experiences.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience defining and managing products leveraging embedded software, ideally in an RF-based communications system.
- Strong understanding of distributed systems and cloud-based software development.
- Strong understanding of network fundamentals: Ethernet, IP networking, QoS
- Familiarity with TCP/IP routing and switching, networking ASICs and FPGAs
- Track record of writing technical requirements documents, PRFAQs, or product specifications.
- Experience working with multiple engineering teams to deliver complex, distributed systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
- Experience with satellite communications, LEO networking, or space-based systems.
- Experience with analyzing sampled network performance data and communicating statistical analysis to stakeholders with varying degrees of context.
- Experience in customer-facing technical product role at a cloud provider or telecommunications company.
- Proven ability to influence without authority across multiple engineering and business teams.
- Familiarity with AWS networking services (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPC) and how enterprise customers build hybrid networks.

Austin, TX USA

Solving complex problems with elegant solutions by working across teams and organizations in Amazon.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. title: Supply Chain Manager III, AWS Cloud Logistics
descriptionHtml:
AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) is seeking an experienced Supply Chain Manager to join our North America and Latin America (NALA) Operations team, owning end-to-end process improvement, capacity planning, damage/claims, and the supply chain for Power and Cooling (PAC) equipment. PAC equipment is the backbone of every AWS data center build, and delays translate directly into day-for-day schedule slips on active construction sites. NALA PAC warehousing is projected to scale for several years, working alongside third-party (3P) carriers and logistics service providers (LSPs). In this role, you will drive LSP process standardization across warehousing and transportation, partner with technology teams on scalable systems design, and serve as the Amazon-side point of accountability for PAC site teams, construction partners, and Global Supply Managers. The ideal candidate has deep supply chain expertise, experience governing third-party logistics providers, a history of leading teams (this is a people manager role) and a track record of building operational mechanisms in high-growth, ambiguous environments where standardization — not improvisation — is the path to scale.

This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and brings a bias for action. You will build processes and mechanisms in real time as PAC transitions to a multi-LSP model — the architectural decisions made in the next 90 days will shape PAC operations for years. You bring deep supply chain expertise across warehousing and transportation, experience managing third-party logistics providers, and a proven ability to build scalable operational processes in high-growth environments. You understand that standardization scales and improvisation does not, and you are energized by the opportunity to build the operational foundation for one of AWS's most critical infrastructure supply chains.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive process standardization across PAC warehousing and transportation, ensuring handoffs, inbound compliance, and outbound execution meet AWS standards across all LSPs
- Own the full damage and claims lifecycle — chain-of-custody through root-cause analysis to financial resolution
- Develop capacity planning models aligning NALA warehouse storage, transportation lanes, and supplier onboarding with PAC's growth
- Enforce consistent performance standards across multiple LSPs through standardized processes, unified reporting, and shared accountability
- Define, enforce, and audit end-to-end transportation and warehousing KPIs in the PAC space
- Partner with technology and data engineering teams on scalable systems design, reducing dependency on provider-specific reporting
- Establish LSP onboarding with the PAC implementation team — embedding ASN, labeling, and compliance requirements pre-shipment
- Serve as the single ACL point of contact for PAC site teams, construction partners, and Global Supply Managers — resolving escalations, disputes, and scheduling conflicts in real time
- Own reporting cadences and lead business reviews on supply health, exception trends, and corrective actions for ACL leadership and PAC stakeholders
- Write documents cross-functionally and present at document reviews
- Mentor and coach team members; serve as an escalation point across the team
- Drive team culture, ACL hiring (MGHD), organizational planning, and the COE review process

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain management, planning, strategic sourcing, commodity management or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Logistics, Business Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field
- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- 3+ years of logistics operations experience
- Experience in process design and documentation
- Experience troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis
- Experience developing and implementing KPI goals and strategies based on broader organization goals
- Experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
- Experience with capacity planning and demand forecasting in a high-growth environment

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field

descriptionHtml:

Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.

Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. title: Software Engineer - Linux kernel, EFA
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about systems programming at the intersection of hardware and software? Do you want your code to directly accelerate the world's largest AI training and inference workloads? The Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) Drivers team is looking for Software Development Engineers to design and implement the kernel drivers and userspace libraries that power high-performance networking for AWS's AI/ML and HPC infrastructure.

EFA is the custom network interface that enables thousands of GPUs and accelerators to communicate at near-wire-speed bandwidth and low latency, making it a critical enabler of both foundation model training and real-time inference serving at unprecedented scale. When customers train the next generation of large language models or serve billions of inference requests with tight latency SLAs on Amazon EC2 P5, P6, or Trn instances, it's our driver stack that moves the data.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and optimize Linux kernel drivers (RDMA/EFA) and userspace provider libraries (rdma-core) that ship to millions of EC2 instances
- Work directly with custom hardware — collaborate with chip designers to bring new silicon capabilities to life in software
- Contribute to the upstream Linux kernel RDMA subsystem and rdma-core open-source project
- Architect solutions for next-generation networking features: GPU-direct RDMA, adaptive routing, collective offloads, and multi-path transport
- Build monitoring and automation tools to enhance driver testing for functionality, reliability, and performance
- Own the full lifecycle: from initial hardware bring-up and feature enablement through testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting across the global AWS fleet

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience in C/C++
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems
- Experience writing low level drivers
- Experience with DMA, PCIe, or hardware/software co-design
- Contributions to open-source projects or upstream kernel work

Reporting to the Senior PCAM NAMER Lead, this role combines hands-on customer engagement with frontline people leadership — coaching PCAs through complex, ambiguous customer situations and driving them to successful outcomes.

This leader is deeply collaborative: partnering with peer PCA Managers, the NAMER leadership team, ProServe Account Executives, Delivery Teams, AGS Sales, and Solution Architect Leadership to accelerate customers’ cloud journeys. The ideal candidate brings a strong identity in building collaborative culture, thrives in ambiguity, and is passionate about developing technical talent while staying close to customers.


Key job responsibilities
People Leadership & Talent Development
- Directly manage a team of 8–10 PCAs, fostering technical excellence, customer obsession, and a collaborative team culture
- Lead performance management, career development, goal setting, and regular 1:1 coaching
- Drive hiring, onboarding, and retention to build and maintain a high-performing team
- Identify and develop future leaders; ensure team certification compliance
- Create an inclusive environment where PCAs can grow, take risks, and learn from ambiguity
Hands-On Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
- Serve as a hands-on technical and strategic advisor alongside PCAs in complex customer engagements
- Build trusted relationships with customers and partners, engaging at the executive level when needed
- Act as an escalation point for technical and commercial challenges within the team's portfolio
- Champion customer satisfaction (CSAT) improvements across all engagements
Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership
- Partner closely with peer PCA Managers to share best practices, balance workloads, and maintain consistency across NAMER
- Collaborate with the NAMER leadership team on regional strategy, coverage planning, and organizational initiatives
- Work with ProServe Account Executives, Delivery Teams, and AGS Sales to ensure seamless pre-sales to delivery handoffs
- Foster knowledge sharing, reusable artifact creation, and community of practice participation
Business Performance
- Drive Billable Bookings performance through team enablement, opportunity coaching, and strategic deal support
- Optimize Engagement Margin (As Sold vs. As Delivered) through quality solution design and right-sized scoping
- Monitor deal velocity, reduce concessions, and identify cross-sell/upsell opportunities
- Champion AI adoption with customers and builders
Operational Excellence
- Track and improve team KPIs: bookings, margin, CSAT, PCA development, and operational metrics
- Drive improvements in Engagement Velocity Acceleration (EvA) and delivery readiness
- Ensure team adherence to ProServe processes, tools, and quality standards

A day in the life
As a PCA Manager, no two days look the same, but every day centers on people, customers, and collaboration:

- Engaging with stakeholders across ProServe, AGS Sales, and partner organizations

- Working directly with customers to understand their cloud journey and unblock progress

- Supporting, guiding, mentoring, and enabling PCAs for success in their engagements

- Direct engagement with ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) to align on opportunity strategy and customer outcomes

- Participating in cross-organizational leadership and management forums

- Meeting customers and stakeholders where they are, whether that is a strategic planning session or a hands-on technical review

- Collaborating heavily with internal and external partners to drive shared outcomes

- Providing a consistent, collaborative bridge across the ProServe sales process, enabling strong relationships between PAEs and PCAs

- Helping to guide and train PCAs to increase engineering maturity and technical depth

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Night Shift, Engineering Operations Technician, ADC DCEO
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switchgears, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems. They provide 24/7 shift coverage which could include 12 hour shifts, rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day work weeks.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. citizen must currently posses and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph and satisfy other security related requirements.

Military Ratings/MOSs
- Navy: AD, AE, AT, CE, CM, EM, EMN, ET, ETN, EW, FC, FT, MM, MMN, EN, STG, STS, UT
- Army:15D, 15F, 15X, 15Y, 21P, 21Q, 21R, 31L, 35N, 52C, 52D, 52F

- Troubleshoot of facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs

- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work

- Manipulate small wires and objects

- Work at heights and from ladders

title: Sr. Product Manager- Technical, WW Ops Finance S&A
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Product Manager-Technical in WW Ops Finance Standardization & Automation, you will lead the vision, roadmap and execution for a combined charter spanning both data management/governance and data consumption by finance routines. We don't build data — we manage and govern it. Data management and governance is the critical function that ensures a trustworthy, reliable supply of data: the oxygen for the entire Amazon Stores Finance organization.

You will own the products that govern how finance data is standardized, certified, and made trustworthy (data platforms, metrics, governance) AND the products that let finance routines consume that governed data at scale — including reporting and financial bridging (variance analysis, carve-outs, plan-vs-actual composition). Applying AI to data management and governance is an exciting frontier for this role: you'll tackle the hard problem of extracting semantic meaning from a multitude of data ecosystems that often lack proper documentation, and translating that into use-case-specific, trustworthy datasets and metrics — a frontier with significant room to invent and evolve. title: Lab Engineer III, Global Materials Science
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Global Materials Science (GMS) organization as a Lab Engineer and be part of pioneering sustainable e-commerce packaging. In this role, you'll lead materials testing and characterization efforts that directly support the development of breakthrough packaging materials. You'll drive technical direction in state-of-the-art laboratories—designing experiments, developing novel test methods, operating advanced equipment, and generating critical data that enables our team to make informed decisions about materials that touch millions of customer experiences daily. You'll work independently to solve complex testing challenges, mentor fellow lab engineers, and serve as a technical resource for cross-functional partners.

Key job responsibilities
Materials Testing & Characterization:
• Lead and independently conduct advanced materials testing using equipment including tensile testers, burst testers, tear testers, rheometers, thermal analysis instruments, and other materials characterization tools.
• Design, develop, and refine test protocols following TAPPI, ASTM, ISO, and ISTA standards as well as internal methods—identifying gaps in existing approaches and proposing improvements.
• Perform complex, multi-variable testing on packaging materials including paper substrates, adhesives, coatings, and alternative fiber materials, interpreting results in the context of broader project objectives.
• Independently troubleshoot equipment issues, optimize test parameters, and ensure proper calibration and functionality across the lab's instrument portfolio.
• Prepare test specimens according to specifications and standard operating procedures, adapting approaches when standard methods are insufficient for novel materials.
• Identify, design, and implement improved lab processes and mechanisms that raise the bar for the entire team. Establish best practices that scale across the organization.

Data Collection & Analysis:
• Collect, organize, and document experimental data with high accuracy and attention to detail.
• Perform advanced analysis of test results—identifying trends, anomalies, and correlations in materials performance data and drawing conclusions that inform project direction.
• Generate comprehensive test reports that synthesize findings, provide interpretation, and recommend next steps.
• Drive data-driven decision making by translating complex test results into clear, actionable insights for engineers, scientists, and business stakeholders.
• Develop standardized data analysis frameworks and templates that improve consistency and efficiency across the lab team.

Laboratory Operations:
• Develop, author, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for testing activities.
• Champion a safe, clean, and organized laboratory environment—modeling best practices for the team.
• Lead laboratory safety programs, equipment maintenance schedules, and readiness initiatives.
• Proactively identify and implement opportunities to improve testing efficiency, data quality, and lab throughput.
• Manage inventory of laboratory supplies and test materials, anticipating needs and preventing disruptions.

Mentoring & Technical Leadership:
• Mentor and train junior lab engineers on testing techniques, equipment operation, data analysis, and lab best practices.
• Serve as a technical point of contact for testing questions, method development, and troubleshooting.
• Provide guidance on experimental design and help team members develop their problem-solving capabilities.
• Raise the technical bar for the team through knowledge sharing, peer review, and constructive feedback.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
• Partner with Advanced Materials Engineers and scientists on experimental design, method development, and result interpretation—operating as a peer contributor to project strategy.
• Communicate test results, technical insights, and recommendations to team members and stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
• Lead supplier qualification testing activities, independently managing the testing workflow and providing go/no-go recommendations.
• Drive sample preparation and testing programs for field trials and deployment validation, coordinating across teams to meet timelines.
• Actively contribute to project planning discussions, bringing technical perspective on feasibility, timelines, and resource requirements.
Documentation & Continuous Improvement
• Own the development and refinement of test procedures, SOPs, and method validation documentation.
• Document experimental procedures, observations, and results thoroughly—establishing documentation standards for the team.
• Identify, propose, and implement improvements to testing methods and laboratory processes, driving measurable impact.
• Apply materials science principles to interpret the significance of test results and connect findings to broader project goals.
• Stay current with emerging test methods and industry developments; bring new approaches into the lab.

Work Environment:
• Primarily laboratory-based work with hands-on equipment operation.
• Standard lab safety protocols and PPE requirements.
• Occasional lifting of materials and equipment (up to 50 lbs), standing, walking, kneeling throughout the day.
• Collaborative team environment with regular interaction with scientists and engineers.


A day in the life
Your day starts with a quick review of the team's testing queue—you've been leading the characterization work for a critical adhesive development project, and today you need to make a judgment call on which test variables to prioritize given a tight timeline. You prepare test specimens, adjusting the conditioning protocol you developed last month based on learnings from the initial rounds of testing.

Mid-morning, you're running tensile and burst tests on paper samples from a new supplier. The results are unexpected—tear strength is significantly higher, but stiffness has dropped. You analyze the tradeoff, pull up historical data for comparison, and draft a recommendation memo for the materials engineer leading the project. You've seen this pattern before with high-recycled-content substrates, and your insight saves the team a week of redundant testing.

After lunch, a junior lab engineer asks for help troubleshooting inconsistent rheometer readings on hot melt adhesive samples. You walk through the temperature ramp protocol together, identify a calibration drift, and coach them on the diagnostic steps so they can handle it independently next time.

Your afternoon includes finalizing a new SOP for environmental conditioning tests—you identified a gap in the existing procedure during last week's accelerated aging study and designed a more robust approach. You present your findings at the team meeting, where your data shows clear performance differentiation among three supplier candidates. The program manager uses your analysis directly in the sourcing recommendation.

This is technically challenging work with real ownership. The methods you develop, the data you generate, and the judgment you apply enable breakthrough materials innovations, support major procurement decisions, and ultimately improve packaging for millions of customers while advancing Amazon's sustainability goals.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The Global Materials Science (GMS) organization is Amazon's Center of Excellence for packaging materials development and supply chain transformation. Our team represents a fundamental shift in how Amazon approaches packaging innovation—owning the invention, development, and optimization of materials that power our fulfillment network.

Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.

Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.

What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster, unlock step-change improvements previously thought impossible.

Our Impact: We're driving Amazon's transition from plastic to paper packaging, developing breakthrough materials and establishing supply chains that reduce costs while advancing our 2040 net-zero commitment. Our work directly influences automation success, customer experience, and sustainability metrics.

Our Culture: We operate with high technical rigor while moving at startup speed. We embrace calculated risk-taking in R&D, fail fast, and iterate based on data. We believe in radical collaboration—our success requires seamless partnership across engineering, procurement, operations, and sustainability teams. We value both technical excellence and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Our Team: We bring together materials scientists, chemists, engineers, lab technicians, and program managers who are passionate about solving hard problems. We partner with world-class academic institutions, leading materials suppliers, and internal Amazon teams to push the boundaries of what's possible in packaging materials.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Paper Science, Polymer Science, Physics or related fields.
- 6+ years of experience in packaging materials development, testing, manufacturing or related field

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Chemistry, Paper Science, Chemical Engineering, or related technical discipline
- 4+ years of laboratory experience in materials testing, quality control, or research environment
- Experience developing test methods or SOPs for materials characterization
- Experience with packaging materials or other forest products testing (paper, adhesives, coatings, or polymers) following standard test methods (TAPPI, ASTM, ISO, ISTA, etc.)
- Hands-on experience with testing equipment such as tensile testers, burst testers, thermal analysis equipment, SEM, DMA, etc. and experience with data analysis tools and statistical methods

title: Manager, Applied Science, AB Marketing Tech
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of a rapidly expanding $35 billion dollar global business. At Amazon Business, a fast-growing startup passionate about building solutions, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. At Amazon Business, we strive to be the most recognized and preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. Bring your insight, imagination and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes and industries. Unlock your career potential.

The Opportunity

This is one of the most consequential science leadership roles in Amazon Business. As Applied Science Manager, you will directly influence over $40B in annual revenue by owning the science strategy that powers how we acquire, engage, monetize, and retain millions of business customers worldwide. Your models won't sit in notebooks. They will run in production, shaping real-time decisions across the full customer lifecycle for one of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses.

You will operate at the intersection of Business Prime, Marketing Science, and Customer Acquisition three of the highest-visibility, highest-impact charters in the organization. Your work will be presented to VPs and SVPs, inform multi-billion-dollar investment decisions, and fundamentally reshape how Amazon Business goes to market. This is not an incremental optimization role. This is a build-the-future role where your science roadmap becomes the business strategy.

What You'll Own

Team Leadership & Talent Development: Build and lead a world-class team of applied scientists and research scientists. Set the technical vision, define the multi-year science roadmap, and create an environment where scientists ship models that move the needle on $40B+ in revenue. You will be the bar-raiser who attracts top talent and develops the next generation of science leaders at Amazon.

Customer Lifecycle Intelligence ($40B+ Revenue Impact): Own the predictive modeling stack that powers customer identification, targeting, spend behavior forecasting, churn propensity, and declining engagement detection across every Business Prime segment. Your models will determine which customers we invest in, how we invest, and when directly impacting billions in customer lifetime value.

Marketing Science & Measurement (Cross-Functional, Multi-Billion Dollar Allocation): Build the causal inference and attribution frameworks that determine how Amazon Business allocates hundreds of millions in marketing investment across paid, owned, and earned channels globally. You will be the single point of science truth for incrementality measurement, marketing mix modeling, and ROI optimization partnering with Marketing, Finance, CPS, and international teams to ensure every dollar drives maximum impact.

Customer Acquisition Engine: Lead the science that accelerates new Business Prime member acquisition at scale. Build propensity models, audience optimization systems, and channel effectiveness frameworks that feed directly into acquisition engines serving 10+ global markets. Your work will be the difference between linear growth and exponential growth.

Benefits Adoption & the "Aha Moment": Build behavioral segmentation and recommendation systems that identify, for each customer vertical and organizational profile, the exact moment and feature combination that converts a trialist into a loyalist. This is the science of delight at scale.

Trust & Safety at Scale: Develop fraud detection models, abuse identification systems, and eligibility classifiers that protect the integrity of the Business Prime ecosystem safeguarding billions in revenue from bad actors.

Experimentation & Causal Inference (Organization-Wide): Establish the experimentation frameworks and causal inference methodologies used across the entire Amazon Business organization. Design experiments that measure incremental impact of product launches, pricing changes, and marketing interventions creating the scientific foundation for how leadership makes high-stakes decisions.

Why This Role Is Different

This is not a role where you optimize a feature in isolation. You will sit at the center of a complex, cross-functional operating model partnering daily with 7+ senior leaders (including Directors and VPs) across Business Prime, CPS Sales, Central Marketing, SSR, GTMO, Finance, and International teams. Your science will be the connective tissue that aligns these organizations around a shared, data-driven growth strategy.

You will have direct senior leadership visibility — presenting findings, recommendations, and roadmaps to VP audiences regularly. The insights your team generates will shape OP1/OP2 planning, Board-level narratives, and multi-year investment theses.

What We're Looking For

The successful Applied Science Manager will have an bias for action in a startup environment, with people leadership skills, a proven ability to build and manage high-performing science teams, define and prioritize research agendas that map to business outcomes, and build methodology and tools that are statistically grounded. You influence product and business strategy through science translating complex analytical findings into crisp, actionable recommendations that senior leaders act on immediately.

We are seeking someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-energy, and fun work environment where we deliver value incrementally and frequently. You are a highly technical leader who knows your subject matter deeply, can elevate the technical bar of your team, and is energized by ambiguity and new problem spaces. You know how to deliver results and show a desire to develop yourself, your colleagues, and your career.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers

title: Sr. Security Engineer, Leo Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are a specialized security team that sits inside a global satellite communications business. Our job is to make sure security lessons become permanent: when a security event happens, we find the root cause, close the immediate gap, and build the mechanism that keeps it closed. We watch across the whole environment, spot the trends others are too busy to chase, and turn them into initiatives that measurably reduce risk.

We work shoulder to shoulder with the builder teams designing, launching, and operating the product, and we partner closely with incident response, detection, and enterprise security functions. Over the coming years our focus is shifting further upstream: getting ahead of incidents through proactive posture improvement, hunting for gaps before they are exploited, and investing in automation so security scales with the business rather than against it. If you want your work to protect customers of a system being built at a scale few companies attempt, you will find that purpose here.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national.

Key job responsibilities
You will analyze the security events observed across Amazon Leo, separating each one into the immediate fixes it demands and the longer-term, systemic trends it reveals across the organization.

You will prioritize this work by the severity and business impact of the threat to Leo, concentrating your effort on the most serious security issues and making sound risk-based trade-offs to deliver against them on time.

You will drive immediate fixes to closure by identifying the right team or individual to own each task, and by creating the mechanisms needed to ensure security outcomes are prioritized and tracked to completion across teams with competing priorities.

You will lead time-boxed Find and Fix missions to investigate and clarify emerging security trends, turning early and ambiguous signals into a validated understanding of the underlying problem.

You will own security initiatives end-to-end that resolve the root cause of systemic trends, favoring centralized, secure-by-default controls that measurably and durably reduce risk across the organization.

You will serve as tier-3 escalation support during security incidents, advise partner teams on difficult security decisions, and advocate for new detection mechanisms and testing tools that reduce security operations cost over time.

A day in the life
In this highly dynamic role, you will decide where your time investments deliver the most security value, balancing proactive posture-improvement work against reactive support when security events arise. Teams across the business will reach out for guidance on a wide variety of security problems, and you can anticipate questions like:

"What's the right way to handle authentication tokens in service-to-service communications?"

"We're planning a confidential new product launch and need to define its security requirements."

"We just had a security event and need to run a root cause analysis to identify and correct what produced it."

When you're not responding to builder teams, you will evaluate overall security posture across the organization to surface architectural defects, hunt for gaps before they become incidents, and propose new security initiatives that correct systemic problems. Through this blend of consultation, investigation, and long-term mechanism building, you will help maintain a high bar for customer security.

About the team
Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build
experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- 5+ years of any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing experience
- 3+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience
