title: 2027 Pathways Internship – MBA & Master of Engineering | Operations Leadership | Italy
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we are looking for Amazon's next generation of Senior Managers to join the Pathways Leadership Program in Amazon Operations.

The Pathways Leadership Internship is a 10-12 week full-time Internship in our operations network for enrolled MBA/MSc/MEng/PhD with 3+ years of experience in a complex role. You will be given a business critical challenge to find a solution for as well as gaining practical experience of being a leader of large teams. Your internship will conclude by presenting an innovative solution to senior management based on your observations, hands on involvement and analytical research within operations. Upon completion of the internship program, your performance will be evaluated. Your performance evaluation, along with role availability, will determine your opportunity to join the full-time Pathways program in 2028.

Our Pathways internship program requires a minimum of 10 working weeks between beginning of June and beginning of September. If it is not possible for you to obtain your visa/work permit maximum one week before your Day 1 with us, we may have no other choice than cancelling your internship under this program for the agreed cycle, but we will endeavor you the opportunity to re-interview for another internship or even for a permanent Amazon job in 2027, subject to availability.

About the Pathways Program

Pathways is a three year program designed to rapidly develop experienced MBA and Master level graduates with the skills needed to be Amazons next Senior Operations Managers and beyond. This is the opportunity to chart your own course. Pathway’s members are highly visible to senior leadership through an exclusive mentoring network. They have flexibility with changing roles, sites and geographies. Through a series of intense, progressively challenging opportunities in our best in class operations network, we will stretch your leadership capacity to its full potential. The business lessons you learn and credibility you develop will set you up for accelerated career growth and prepare you for future leadership opportunities within Amazon Operations and beyond.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Lead continuous improvement projects which could impact safety, productivity, quality and most importantly customer experience
- Develop standard operating procedures
- Direct accountability for setting and meeting operational goals
- Scope and design standardized concepts
- Shadow leaders across operations to learn what it takes to be a manager at Amazon
- With support from management, lead large teams across different shifts
- Learn how leaders conduct weekly business reviews for their sites and support them in the preparation of business reviews
- Collaborate with senior management and support teams, which may include Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance and Human Resources, to develop plans to meet business objectives


A day in the life
This role is based in one of our warehouses across Italy. Locations are subject to change.

For a visual insight into how our networks operate, please join us on a video tour through one of our fulfillment centers:

https://www.amazontours.com/de/

- A relocation package

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a Master of Business Administration (MBA)/Master of Science (MSc)/PhD/Master of Engineering (MEng) and available for 10–12 weeks between June and September to work full time.
- 3+ years of complex professional experience (excluding internships and work studies) with responsibility for project management and delivery
- Very good command of Italian (CEFR B2) and English at the time of application
- Experience in leading projects or teams
- Professional experience in engineering, management, logistics, manufacturing, science or any other STEM field
- Flexible to work in non-traditional shift patterns, which may include nights and weekends
- Open to relocate within the country you have applied to work within
- Analytical skills and sound business judgment
- Delivered complex projects, where you have been required to engage teams and leadership to deliver on business initiatives or goals

- Demonstrable decision-making skills, enabling you to use sound reasoning as and when required
- Direct management experience for employees and their performance
- Previous experience in setting, monitoring and improving KPIs or similar metrics
- Successful track record in supporting internal or external customers
- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal)

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Key job responsibilities

- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce

- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact

- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives

descriptionHtml:
The Applied AI Acceleration Solutions Architecture (AAA-SA) team is transforming how specialist expertise is delivered at scale across AWS. We are building agentic solutions that operationalize deep domain knowledge — enabling on-demand, consultative guidance that traditionally required engagement across multiple specialist roles. Our mission is to ensure every customer has on-demand access to trusted, specialized knowledge through personalized engagements that accelerate their business outcomes.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end-to-end technical program management of our agentic AI platform development, enablement/badging programs, and demo experience initiatives. In this role, you will drive execution across multiple engineering workstreams, coordinate cross-organizationally with Go-to-Market (GTM) teams, Solutions Architects, and service team engineering, and establish the mechanisms that keep this fast-moving, high-ambiguity program on track. You will operate with complete independence, advise VP-level leadership, and bring clarity to significantly complex, cross-functional initiatives at the intersection of AI, customer engagement, and enterprise knowledge management.

This is a strategic role that requires both deep technical program management acumen and the ability to navigate a landscape where the business and architectural strategy is still being defined. You will shape how we measure success, how we communicate progress, and how we scale our solutions from internal specialist teams to AWS field teams, partners, and ultimately customers.

Key job responsibilities
Engineering & Delivery Management

- Agentic AI Platform: Own end-to-end program management for the agentic AI solutions, driving the integrated roadmap and milestones from concept through production across all engineering workstreams.
- Engineering Coordination: Drive engineering coordination across engineering teams that co-develop production-grade AI solutions, and manage sprint cadences, dependency tracking, and releases.
- Risk Management: Proactively identify and mitigate risks across engineering capacity, agentic platform readiness, knowledge accuracy, and change management. Establish escalation paths and drive resolution before blockers materialize.

Business Reviews & Reporting

- Business Reviews: Own and run business reviews with comprehensive metrics on adoption, user satisfaction, knowledge coverage, and engineering velocity. Define the mechanisms that surface the right data to the right audience at the right time. Author monthly business roll-ups for VP-level audiences that synthesize engineering progress, business impact metrics, adoption trends, and strategic recommendations into a compelling narrative.
- Program Flashes: Produce and deliver program flashes providing leadership with crisp, data-driven status updates across all active workstreams — highlighting progress, risks, blockers, and key decisions needed.

Cross-Organizational Coordination

- Multi-org Alignment: Serve as the connective tissue between the Applied AI SA team, dedicated engineering teams, and service team engineering leadership. Align priorities, negotiate resources, and ensure joint accountability across organizations.

- GTM Partnership: Partner with GTM teams, solution architects, sales specialists, and customer success managers to ensure product development is informed by field feedback and aligned to revenue acceleration objectives.

- Ecosystem Integration: Coordinate with broader AWS initiatives (e.g., WWSO agentic programs, enterprise tools) to ensure interoperability, avoid duplication, and maximize the reach of composable knowledge agents.

Enablement & Badging Programs

- Badging Program: Own the program management for AI enablement and badging/certification programs that upskill AWS specialist and field teams. Define learning paths, track completion metrics, and drive adoption targets.
- Knowledge Champion Network: Coordinate the knowledge champion network — ensuring domain experts across specialist roles contribute to and govern AI-ready knowledge assets on a structured cadence.
- Enablement Execution: Manage enablement session planning, asset development tracking, and feedback loop mechanisms that continuously improve solution quality and user satisfaction.

Demo Experience Program

- Demo Development: Coordinate demo development across industry-specific demos, live demo environments, and deployable assets that empower SAs and sellers across all deal stages.
- Platform Evolution: Manage the portal’s transition to next-generation demo infrastructure, including partner onboarding workflows, content publishing processes, and cross-team integration requirements.

You start your morning reviewing adoption metrics and preparing a concise update for a VP-level review on Applied AI Solutions Acceleration program. Mid-morning, you lead a working session with solution architects and engineering leads to align on a technical approach for transforming business outcomes using agentic solutions. After lunch, you partner with go-to-market team members to validate that the solution meets field team needs, then join a design review where you surface hidden risks and push toward a simpler path forward.

The Applied AI Acceleration Solutions Architecture team sits within Applied AI Solutions and was chartered to address the challenge of scaling specialist expertise to meet customer demand.

Our approach is phased and deliberate: we deploy with specialist teams for rapid testing and learning, expand to broader AWS field teams for scale validation, and ultimately launch to partners and customers as proven solutions. Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. title: Data Analyst, RSX
descriptionHtml:
In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities
* Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
* Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
* Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
* Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved
* Write SQL queries and leverage data to surface gaps, track project health, and report on outcomes
* Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program or project management experience

- Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
- Experience writing SQL queries to extract and analyze data, track program health, and drive decisions

title: Principal ProServe Cloud Architect, AWS ProServe AGS NAMER
descriptionHtml:
AWS Professional Services (ProServe) is seeking a ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) specializing in the professional sports and gaming vertical. You will engage directly with organizations such as the NBA, NFL, MLS, NHL, and sports gaming operators to design and deliver cloud solutions tailored to this industry.
As a PCA you operate as the conduit between ProServe Account Executives and Shared Delivery Teams (SDT), ensuring solutions are realistic, achievable, and maximize customer business outcomes (CBOs). You serve as a trusted advisor on industry trends, emerging technologies, and the regulatory landscape.
This is not a role for a sports fan. It requires a professional who understands how leagues operate as businesses: media rights economics, collective bargaining agreements, salary cap structures, franchise revenue models, multi jurisdictional gaming regulations, and how technology underpins live broadcast, fan engagement, and wagering operations. That business fluency, combined with cloud architecture expertise, is what makes this role distinct.
Your success will be measured by SOW signings, successful solution delivery, and customer satisfaction (CSAT).

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
• Designing scalable, secure AWS solutions for sports and gaming customers, accounting for real time processing, regulatory compliance, and peak event traffic patterns
• Providing technical guidance during pre-sales and implementation, translating sports business structures (media rights, revenue sharing, franchise economics) into solution architectures
• Collaborating with Account Managers and SDTs to ensure proposals address sports betting compliance (AML, KYC), responsible gaming requirements, and data privacy obligations
• Advising customers on emerging technologies: sports AI/ML, DTC streaming, connected stadium infrastructure, integrity monitoring, and esports platforms
• Sharing knowledge through mentoring, training, and reusable artifacts that capture the regulatory and business patterns unique to this vertical

A day in the life
As a PCA in the sports and gaming vertical, no two days look the same, but your time centers on customers, partners, and solving real problems:
• Engaging directly with customers to understand their cloud journey, identify pain points, and scope solutions that deliver measurable value
• Partnering closely with ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) to align on opportunity strategy, develop statements of work, and drive deals through the pipeline
• Deep diving into customer environments to assess level of effort, define solution architectures, and build business cases that articulate the ProServe value proposition
• Delivering opportunity scoping and solution design focused entirely around the customer, solving their specific problems rather than selling generic services
• Working across organizational boundaries with Solution Architects, Account Executives, and delivery teams both inside ProServe and across the broader AWS sales organization
• Engaging directly with C suite executives, league technology officers, franchise CTOs, and technical experts inside each sports and gaming organization to build trust and drive outcomes

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. We are seeking an exceptional System Development Engineer for our Network Operations team within the Optical Inter-Satellite Link (OISL) organization. This is a high-impact role where you will be a key contributor to the Network Operations function of OISL — building and operating the tooling, automation, and monitoring systems that support a revolutionary laser communication network connecting thousands of satellites in space.

The Role
This is an individual contributor role. You will contribute to the end-to-end Network Operations capability for OISL, including building tools and services for monitoring and incident response, driving automation of operational workflows, and supporting operational readiness as the constellation scales. You will partner with engineers across the organization to develop solutions that improve laser link reliability and availability.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Support the OISL Network Operations strategy by contributing to tooling development, automation initiatives, and process improvements.
Participate in the NetOps on-call program: contribute to escalation workflows, automated ticketing, runbooks, and incident response.
Support operational cadence: assist with metrics reviews, readiness assessments, and capacity planning activities.

Automation & Tooling
Build scalable services that automate monitoring, fault detection, classification, and ticketing for the optical inter-satellite link network.
Develop data pipelines for KPI tracking, anomaly detection, and proactive issue identification.
Build observability platforms — dashboards, alerting, and real-time monitoring at scale.
Apply ML/AI for fault correlation, root cause analysis, and predictive failure detection.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with hardware, software, and ground network teams to support system reliability improvements.
Contribute to investigations into complex link failures and constellation-level fault patterns.
Participate in architecture reviews and program planning as a Network Operations representative
Individual Contribution.

Hands-on development of tools, services, and automation (Python, Spark SQL, cloud services).
Design testing strategies for distributed satellite network systems.
Author technical specifications and operational documentation.

A day in the life

title: Sr. Data Engineer, Amazon Digital Advertising
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 5, 2026

Are you excited by the idea of building the data foundation that an entire AI-powered product is built on — from the very first pipeline? Do you like the messy, ambiguous problems: wrangling inconsistent data from dozens of outside partners and turning it into something clean, timely, and genuinely trustworthy? If so, we'd love to talk.

Marketing at Amazon happens across a huge range of independent businesses, and the data behind it is scattered across agencies, vendors, and platforms. It's slow to get, inconsistent, and almost impossible to see as a whole. We're a new, AI-native team setting out to fix that — building a service that automatically pulls all of this data together, cleans and normalizes it, and puts AI-powered analytics on top so anyone can ask a question in plain language and get a real answer.

That's where you come in. As a Data Engineer on this team, you'll own the ingestion pipelines and the normalized dataset that everything else depends on. You'll figure out how to reliably pull data from noisy, ever-changing external sources, reconcile feeds that never quite agree with each other, and build the quality checks that catch problems before anyone downstream ever sees them. AI is only as good as the data underneath it, so your work sits squarely on the critical path — if the data foundation is solid, the whole product wins.

You won't just be maintaining pipelines. You'll help shape how data flows through a brand-new system and decide what "good" looks like for schemas and data quality. It's a small, scrappy team with a lot of ownership to go around, and you'll get to leave your fingerprint on something from the ground floor.

If building trustworthy data infrastructure for hard, never-been-done-before problems sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate scalable, reliable data ingestion pipelines that collect marketing data from agencies, ad tech vendors, and internal sources on scheduled intervals — without requiring source teams to change their current processes.
- Define and evolve input schemas and normalization logic that reconcile inconsistent granularity, formats, and terminology across sources into a unified dataset.
- Build automated data quality validation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation to catch and surface defects early, reducing manual auditing and cleaning effort.
- Handle real-world data complexity, such as delayed settlement of certain data sources, mapping records to the correct hierarchies, and deciding when to use planned versus finalized data.
- Partner with modeling and AI engineers to ensure the data foundation is structured for downstream analytics, agent orchestration, and natural-language query.
- Instrument pipelines for observability, freshness/SLA monitoring, and low-touch operations, so the service requires primarily configuration updates as new sources are added.
- Collaborate with data providers and stakeholders to onboard new feeds and improve their timeliness, completeness, and accuracy.
- Contribute to a phased rollout, starting with a core set of sources and expanding over time.

A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing pipeline health and resolving a data quality alert before anyone downstream is affected. Mid-morning, you onboard a new external source — reverse-engineering a messy partner feed and designing the schema to fold it cleanly into the shared dataset. After lunch, you meet with a data provider to close gaps in their feed, then review a teammate's pull request. You close the day prototyping a better way to catch bad records at ingestion. Because this service is being built from scratch, you operate with real autonomy and set the patterns others build on.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
- Experience mentoring team members on best practices

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
- Experience operating large data warehouses

descriptionHtml:
As Senior Network Performance Analyst – AI Transformation, you will own end-to-end network planning for Amazon's Customer Service network, including outsourced (Global Outsourcing) sites. You will work at the intersection of data, strategy, and operations — translating complex demand signals into accurate staffing plans that protect customer experience while delivering cost efficiency.

You will operate independently, managing ambiguity with rigor and judgment. You will partner closely with CS Operations, Global Outsourcing (GO) Vendor Management, CS Finance, Service Delivery, and Planning Intelligence teams. You will present your analysis and recommendations independently to senior leadership influence planning decisions through well-reasoned, data-backed arguments, and contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda.

This role participates in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews and directly influences outsourcing and staffing decisions across the CS network.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the development, maintenance, and execution of network capacity plans for internal and outsourced sites, covering short-term (4-week), operational (monthly/quarterly), and long-term (3-year) planning horizons.
- Proactively identify and mitigate capacity risks by mapping dependencies across internal sites and Global Outsourcing vendor partners. Communicate risks and mitigation plans to the right stakeholders clearly and with specificity. Coordinate with CS Operations and GO Vendor Management teams to ensure staffing plans are aligned with service level targets and outsourcing strategy.
- Support quarterly submissions to CS Finance, providing accurate Year-to-Go (YTG) labor cost projections and revisions versus OP targets.
- Independently apply AI tools (e.g., AgentZ, Kiro) to improve planning workflows without prompting, identifying opportunities to increase the speed, quality, and scale of planning outputs. Develop side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your planning workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
- Build repeatable frameworks that prevent entire categories of planning problems from recurring, becoming the go-to resource when a planning challenge is genuinely hard.
- Present analysis and planning recommendations to leadership independently, adapting your communication style for technical and non-technical, operational and strategic audiences.
- Write clear, concise, and compelling narratives for QBRs, MBRs, and planning reviews. Documents must meet Amazon's standard formatting guidelines, with conclusions that tie to the organization's working-backwards framework.
- Communicate complex planning ideas in a way that is accessible to senior, non-expert audiences. Align cross-functional stakeholders (Operations, Finance, HR, Training and others) to embed planning inputs into execution and operational decision making.

The NSP team is on a transformation journey. descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building intelligent financial systems that protect and empower millions of businesses? Do you want to lead a team at the intersection of AI and complex risk management while growing the next generation of product leaders?

The Amazon Business Payments (ABP) team provides invoicing, working capital, and payment acceptance solutions to Amazon Business customers, sellers, and other small business customers across Amazon. We are part of the global Amazon Payments organization, which aims to delight our customers by building payment experiences and financial services that are trusted, valued, and easy to use from anywhere in any way.

Within ABP, the Credit and Fraud Risk Management team drives credit and fraud decisions for our Business Credit account product with the objective of maximizing credit access, minimizing losses, reducing friction, and maintaining a healthy balance sheet. We are entering a transformative era where Generative AI, large language models, and autonomous AI agents are fundamentally reshaping how we manage risk.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Product Management Technical to own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for our next-generation credit and fraud risk platform while building and leading a high-performing product management team. You will lead through your team, coaching managers and individual contributors to deliver innovation through Generative AI and AI agents that create step-function improvements in efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.

You will partner closely with Science, Engineering, Portfolio Management, Operations, and business teams across multiple organizations to deliver transformational credit and fraud capabilities. This role requires deep technical judgment, the ability to influence senior leaders across Amazon Payments, Amazon Business, and Seller Partner Services, and a proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent.

- Define and own the 3–5 year strategic product vision and roadmap for credit and fraud risk management, aligning your team's priorities to measurable outcomes across a multi-billion dollar lending portfolio.
- Build, lead, and develop a team of product managers and people managers — recruiting bar-raising talent, creating tailored onboarding and development plans, and coaching leaders to grow their own teams effectively.
- Drive innovation through Generative AI and AI agents by identifying use cases where foundation models, autonomous agents, and intelligent automation can transform credit decisioning, fraud detection, and risk operations.
- Set the technical product strategy for how AI capabilities integrate into credit and fraud systems, partnering with Science and Engineering leaders to evaluate emerging architectures and shape trade-offs that preserve long-term strategic flexibility.
- Influence strategic direction across multiple organizations including Payments, Amazon Business, and Seller Partner Services through clear written narratives and executive forums, while establishing metrics frameworks that measure the effectiveness of AI-driven risk decisions.

A day in the life
You start many mornings reviewing your team's written proposals or experiment results, providing feedback that sharpens their thinking before broader reviews. Mid-morning might bring a working session with your Science and Engineering counterparts to evaluate a new AI agent prototype for fraud detection. Our team operates at the intersection of product, science, and engineering, and we are investing heavily in AI-native capabilities that will define the future of automated risk management. descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Retail Growth & Development (WWRGD) organization is seeking a Sr. Design Program Manager, E-Commerce to lead design and program management across our E-Commerce workstreams for the retail grocery store network. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role requiring deep subject matter expertise in grocery retail design, E-Commerce operational integration, and cross-functional program ownership at scale.

This is an exciting, fast-moving role for a design leader who operates at the intersection of design execution and program leadership. You are the right person for this job if you are a highly independent, detail-oriented design professional who thrives in ambiguity, produces designs that satisfy conflicting interests with a high bar for quality, and can drive alignment across multiple stakeholders with competing priorities.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design and program coordination for E-Commerce workstreams including but not limited to: E-Commerce Hubs, E-Commerce Metro Optimization, Amazon Counter, and Dash Carts. You will serve as the single-threaded owner and primary point of contact for each business owner, tracking deliverables, managing timelines, and ensuring designs meet strict launch deadlines. You will define the standards and processes to optimize E-Commerce design in retail stores and ensure scalability across the fleet. As the program lead, you will influence decisions across Operations, Technology, Construction, and Procurement.

The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver with strong program management instincts, deep E-Commerce fluency, and the ability to build scalable design systems that work across a high-volume, multi-workstream portfolio.


Key job responsibilities
- E-Commerce Workstream Ownership: Own and drive the full portfolio of E-Commerce design workstreams, serving as the subject matter expert and primary point of contact for business owners.

- Tracking and Reporting: Track and report on the status of all active workstreams, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and blockers to leadership.
- Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with Operations, Technology, Construction, Procurement, Real Estate, Topology Planning, and senior leadership to align design solutions with business objectives.

- Program Management: Manage the design process end-to-end, interfacing with internal and external design partners to ensure quality and consistency across all workstreams.
- Site-Specific Adaptation: Adapt site-specific conditions, metrics, and standards to store designs while balancing competing operational, customer experience, and cost requirements.

- Design Phases: Drive Schematic Design and Design Development packages through all phases of design, permitting, and construction administration.
- Budget and Schedule: Coordinate with Construction, Procurement, and Operations on budget, schedule, and value engineering.
- Consultant Management: Manage consultants and external partners throughout all phases of the project lifecycle.
- Construction Administration: Provide CA support as needed, including review and approval of submittals and shop drawings.
- Process Improvement: Develop mechanisms to improve efficiency, reduce ambiguity, and scale E-Commerce design delivery across the network.

A day in the life
If you thrive in a dynamic, high-volume environment where design rigor and operational pace must coexist, then we want to talk to you. A typical day involves triaging new E-Commerce design requests, advancing active design packages, and coordinating with the Capital Planning and Construction teams to ensure design handoffs are clean and complete. You will regularly interface with store operations leaders to ground design decisions in real store context, partner with procurement on equipment specifications, and advance process improvements that help the team scale. Our team is on a mission to raise the bar for design excellence at Amazon. Amazon's Security team is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer to design and build agent-based systems that enable the security team to operate at scale on a first-of-its-kind AI Factory. This is a greenfield opportunity: we are building an entirely new security program on a novel platform with no inherited tooling or automation. We expect our teams to be building agent-first, using teams of agents for delivery across detection, response, compliance, and operational workflows. You will architect and implement multi-agent systems that decompose complex security processes into coordinated autonomous workflows. We value strong process decomposition skills, production-quality engineering, and the ability to design systems that operate reliably in disconnected, high-security environments.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Architect and build multi-agent systems for security operations, detection, compliance, and workflow automation.
• Decompose complex security processes into coordinated agent workflows.
• Design reliable agent orchestration patterns for high-security, air-gapped environments.
• Implement robust error handling, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls for autonomous systems.

• Evaluate and integrate agentic frameworks, adapting them for classified environments.
• Partner with security engineers to identify processes suitable for agent-based automation.

You will prototype agentic workflows and lead other engineers in turning successful prototypes into maintainable production capabilities. title: Solutions Architect, LATAM CSC SA
descriptionHtml:
Do you get energized helping customers solve complex problems—not just on a whiteboard, but by building alongside them?

We're looking for a Solutions Architect to join our CSC LATAM team, working with SMB/Enterprise customers across the full breadth of their cloud journey. You'll help customers migrate to the cloud, modernize legacy applications and databases, build cloud-native solutions, and explore how GenAI & Agentic AI can drive their business forward.

We value practitioners—people whose judgment is grounded in real-world experience building and shipping solutions. You'll partner hands-on with customers, turning ideas into working prototypes and production-ready architectures. Whether the challenge is a complex migration, a legacy modernization, a greenfield application, or helping a customer understand how AI can transform their business—you'll bring curiosity, technical depth, and a bias for action.

If you thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly when priorities shift, and measure your success by the outcomes you help customers achieve—we'd love to hear from you.



We value diversity in all its forms — we believe that teams made up of people with different backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking are more creative, innovative, and resilient. Here, every voice matters and contributes to our collective growth.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with enterprise customers to design, build, and implement solutions across cloud adoption, migration, modernization, and new workloads
- Work hands-on with customer and partner teams—building prototypes, proofs of concept, and production-ready architectures together
- Guide customers through cloud migrations—helping them move workloads efficiently and securely
- Help customers explore how AI and emerging technologies can enhance their applications, operations, and customer experiences
- Share knowledge broadly through workshops, technical content, and community engagement

A day in the life
In this role, you'll engage directly with customers to understand their business objectives and technical requirements, then architect cloud solutions that address their specific needs. You might spend your morning collaborating with a startup to design their initial cloud infrastructure, then transition to working with an enterprise team on migrating complex legacy systems to AWS. Throughout your day, you'll partner with AWS specialists and customer teams to validate architectural decisions, troubleshoot challenges, and ensure solutions align with both technical best practices and business goals. You'll also contribute to improving our architectural guidance and resources based on real-world customer experiences, helping shape how we support organizations of all sizes.

About the team
You'll be part of the AWS CSC Solutions Architecture team. We work with enterprise customers across industries—helping them adopt cloud, migrate and modernize their technology landscape, adopt AI, and build for the future. Our team values builders who are curious, collaborative, and customer-obsessed. We learn from each other, support each other's growth, and celebrate diverse perspectives. Whether you're presenting to executives or coding alongside engineers, you'll find a team that values both technical depth and human connection.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
- Knowledge of cloud computing concepts and design considerations
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- Knowledge of programming or other scripting languages and coding skills (C/C++/C#, Node.JS, Java, Python, PHP, Ruby)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
- Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, Containers, S3, EBS, Serverless). Desirable knowledge of AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Quick, Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Comprehend, Amazon Transcribe, etc.

title: Field Quality Assurance
descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

アマゾンジャパンでは、自社管理する配達拠点 Amazon Logistics (AMZL) において、配達品質・配達効率の向上を推進するフィールドクオリティーアシュアランス（FQA）を募集しています。
FQAの主な業務は、オンラインで配達データおよび地図データ・GPSと実地住所情報の照合やオフィスなどの配達可能日時の確認、また配達困難箇所への現地訪問により配達の障害となっている原因を特定し、Amazonの配達システムへデータを反映することです。また、反映したデータが実際の配達に効果が出ているかを分析し、他チームと協力してより効率的な配達ができるよう業務改善を推進して頂きます。
通常の業務は主に、Online Routine 業務、現地調査業務、Adhoc 業務（データ分析やオペレーションチームとの折衝など）行っています。
※こちらはビジネスニーズに合わせて変更される可能性があります。
FQAは日本国内のみならず、グローバルチームとコミュニケーションを取りながら、多様性とスピード感をもって改善活動を進めていきます。データ分析を通じた業務改善の経験を活かしていただけるポジションです。

Key job responsibilities
主な業務内容
・配達データと配達実績からのGPS誤差・カスタマー情報の確認および更新
・オンラインツールを用いたデータの確認と更新
・各ステークホルダーとの連携・アクション実行
・配達困難箇所のデータ分析
・配達データの分析結果を社内関係者へ提供
・配達システムにおける配達問題の情報収集・フィードバック
・安全・品質・作業効率向上に向けたプロジェクトの立案・推進
・業務標準化の推進
・宿泊を伴う全国への出張が発生する場合があります
・「現地調査業務（Easel）」 季節を問わず、配達困難箇所への現地訪問・建物管理者へのヒアリング、宅配ロッカー等の配達場所や配達ルールの調査およびデータ更新
一人、またはペアで実施していただきます
※現地への移動は徒歩が基本となります
※現地調査時にはヒアリング含め、ご意見を頂くこともあります
・その他関連業務
本ポジションはフレックスタイム制勤務となっており、多様な働き方が可能な環境です。

title: Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer, APAC Mech DE
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that’s responsible for designing and delivering capacity for the world’s best data centre services across the globe. You’ll have the opportunity to work with a constant stream of new technologies and products, and experience opportunities to learn and grow while being surrounded by a motivated and diverse team.

In this role you will drive Mechanical Engineering services design, construction and implementation of enterprise data centers, which meet quality and performance levels across the globe. You will work directly with our Design Engineering Stakeholders, Construction, Operations, and Commissioning teams within your assigned region in APAC. You will be the Mechanical Engineering representative on behalf of the Data Center Engineering Team responsible for the successful delivery of projects. You will assist in Data Center site selection, planning, development. You will maintain the highest performance standards and utilize innovation to reduce PUE, water consumption, CAPEX and increase efficiency. As an experienced Mechanical Engineer you will evaluate different cooling systems and make a data driven decision about a suitable solution based on our guidelines. You will be an integral part of our work to change the world through technology.

Responsibilities·


- Participate in site selection reviews, work with local utilities to understand and define site utility requirements, and work with internal teams to understand user requirements.

- Design and collaborate with other disciplines to create a construction document set.

- Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.

- Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify the appropriate mechanical equipment including Air Handling Units, Computer Room Air Handling Units, Chillers, Cooling Towers, Sequence of Operations & Controls systems, Fire Detection/Suppression systems

- Review and approve equipment submittals.

- Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.

- Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of mechanical systems.

- Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers and Operations. This position will involve 20% travel within APAC region and occasionally globally.

About the team
The Data Center Design Engineering team at Amazon Web Services consists of Architects, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Fire Protection and Controls Engineers working to design the next generation of Data Centres. The team is committed to achieving a world-class uptime for our customers and strives to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet our growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs. As an integral member of the team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and create positive change.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: Sales Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
IL EXISTE UN UNIVERS D'OPPORTUNITÉS CHEZ AMAZON

Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle accélère, prend des tournures que vous n'auriez jamais imaginées. Dès le moment où vous nous rejoignez, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : concevoir des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonner la manière dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se connectent au quotidien. C'est ici que vos idées se transforment en impact concret.
Vous travaillerez avec des outils de classe mondiale, des plateformes internationales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à grande échelle . Vous avancerez rapidement, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent. Avec d'innombrables opportunités d'explorer différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez vite, appliquerez vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences que vous ne soupçonniez pas. C'est un environnement conçu pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l'impact de leur travail dans le monde. Prêt(e) à vivre l'aventure ?

QU'EST-CE QUE CELA VOUS APPORTE ?

Avec des équipes présentes dans tout l'univers Amazon, vous n'avez pas à choisir une voie trop tôt. Vous prendrez des responsabilités, développerez de nouvelles compétences et construirez une carrière qui évolue à mesure que vous évoluez.
Le/La Partner Operations Manager assistera le/la responsable pays sur tous les aspects de l'installation et de la maintenance des produits en France, à mesure que nous poursuivons le développement de l'activité. Le/La candidat(e) retenu(e) établira et entretiendra des relations solides avec les partenaires internes et externes – notamment les prestataires de services, les partenaires hôtes, les équipes technologiques et de gestion de produits, ainsi que l'équipe locale de développement commercial.
La personne devra faire preuve à la fois d'esprit analytique et de créativité, en cherchant des moyens d'améliorer les produits, les processus et les outils, et en concrétisant ces idées. De solides compétences relationnelles sont également importantes, car le poste implique des interactions fréquentes avec les dirigeants d'Amazon et ses entreprises partenaires.
Amazon a ouvert ses portes virtuelles en 1995 et s'efforce d'être l'entreprise la plus centrée sur le client au monde, où les clients peuvent trouver et découvrir tout ce qu'ils pourraient souhaiter acheter en ligne. Amazon Hub PARP (Pick-up And Returns Points – Points de Retrait et de Retour) est en pleine croissance et nous travaillons à créer une expérience de livraison de classe mondiale pour les clients grâce à des options de livraison alternatives – casiers (lockers) et points de retrait. Si vous êtes passionné(e) par les opérations de livraison et que vous savez anticiper pour mieux servir les clients, nous avons besoin de votre aide. Si cela vous enthousiasme, venez construire l'avenir avec nous !


Key job responsibilities
PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS DU POSTE

Leadership stratégique et opérations

• Piloter de bout en bout l'installation, la maintenance et les opérations post-installation (retrait, mise hors service, déplacements, redimensionnement) des Points de Retrait et de Retour sur les marchés assignés.
• Mener des projets stratégiques, notamment le lancement de nouveaux produits (casiers Gen5), l'expansion géographique et l'amélioration des processus, en cohérence avec les objectifs de l'entreprise.

Gestion des fournisseurs et prestataires

• Gérer des relations fournisseurs complexes dans les services d'installation et de maintenance, en négociant les contrats pour atteindre un taux de conformité aux SLA (accords de niveau de service) de 90 % et plus.
• Développer stratégiquement la capacité des fournisseurs, en assurant une redondance sur les services critiques tout en réduisant les coûts.

Optimisation des processus et automatisation

• Tirer parti des outils d'IA et des solutions à faible codage (low-code/no-code) pour rationaliser les processus opérationnels, en visant des gains de productivité de 15 à 30 % grâce à l'automatisation.

Gestion financière

• Gérer les finances du programme, y compris les bons de commande, le traitement des factures et la responsabilité du P&L (compte de résultat) pour les centres de coûts assignés.
• Travailler dans le cadre des budgets alloués tout en identifiant des opportunités d'économies grâce à l'optimisation des fournisseurs et à l'amélioration des processus.

Gestion et influence des parties prenantes

• Collaborer avec des équipes transverses (Ventes aux entreprises, Qualité, Produit/Tech, Finance, Marketing) pour soutenir les objectifs de l'entreprise.
• Influencer les parties prenantes internes et externes grâce à des analyses fondées sur les données et à des recommandations stratégiques.

Analyse des données et gestion de la performance

• Réaliser des analyses approfondies pour identifier les causes profondes des problèmes opérationnels et les opportunités d'amélioration.
• Suivre et rendre compte des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), notamment les objectifs de disponibilité de 99 % et plus, le DPMO (Défauts par million d'opportunités), le FTDS (Taux de livraison réussie au premier passage), le temps de cycle et la performance des coûts.
• Mettre en place des tableaux de bord et des mécanismes d'alerte pour signaler de manière proactive toute dégradation de la performance.

Excellence opérationnelle et conduite du changement

• Maintenir la fiabilité du réseau grâce à des stratégies de maintenance proactives et à des mécanismes de contrôle qualité.
• Diriger les équipes lors des transformations opérationnelles, des mises en œuvre de nouvelles technologies et des refontes de processus.
• Favoriser l'adaptabilité face aux évolutions rapides de l'activité et aux exigences de montée en charge.

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme de niveau licence en chaîne d'approvisionnement (supply chain), commerce ou gestion, ingénierie, finance ou dans un domaine technique ou quantitatif connexe.
- Maîtrise du français à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
- Maîtrise de l'anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
- Expérience en opérations, chaîne d'approvisionnement (supply chain), logistique ou gestion de projet (les stages sont pris en compte).
- Connaissance des interactions avec les fournisseurs ou prestataires.
- Expérience de l'analyse de données (par exemple Excel, SQL ou outils de BI) pour identifier des tendances ou des problèmes opérationnels.

Preferred qualifications

- Diplôme de niveau master en ingénierie, administration des affaires, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (supply chain) ou domaine connexe.
- Exposition aux processus de gestion des fournisseurs, y compris le suivi des SLA (accords de niveau de service) et le reporting de la performance.
- Intérêt pour, ou première expérience avec, les outils d'IA, l'automatisation ou les solutions à faible codage (low-code/no-code) pour améliorer les flux de travail ou la productivité.
- Expérience de contribution à des projets transverses impliquant des lancements de produits, une expansion géographique ou une refonte des processus.

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Network Planning Manager, MMNC - Middle Mile Network Control
descriptionHtml:
This role tagged as one of Amazon’s Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to Retail teams and everything in between. You’ll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.


Key job responsibilities
Define the Amazon outbound network planning (Legs, Sorts, CPT) for one of the UK sub-regions covered by 3-5 Sort Centers.
Analyse the best design based on forecast, and historical flows to improve cost, speed and DEA across E2E network.
Partner with teams to align on network changes to solve operational challenges.
Support the planning and organization of complex projects including Peak network transformations

A day in the life
Being a Network Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You’ll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You’ll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you’ll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.

As a Supply Chain Manager, you’ll need to help with both on-the-ground tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site’s resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you’ll be able to learn something new every day.

This role is based in Luxembourg headquarters.

About the team
Amazon couldn’t deliver at pace without the STEP TNO team. As part of STEP TNO MMNC, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.
We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics

- Experience leading process improvements

- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

A day in the life

We support availability by assisting internal teams in communicating prompt and accurate alarm and event notifications.

The FOC ensures safety across all AWS data centers by enforcing Change Management policies and is the communication hub during emergency and normal operations.


About the team

We support Data Center Engineer Operations teams who are responsible for the operation of infrastructure equipment. Our role is to ensure that critical alarms are properly Responded to, Acknowledged, Investigated, and Dispatched (RAID). Additionally, the FOC serves as a communications hub during both standard and emergency operations.

You will operate at the intersection of AI technologies and cloud architecture ensuring AI workloads achieve Well-Architected outcomes across all six pillars -Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability - influencing both internal AWS teams and the broader builder community. The Security and Loss Prevention Expert (SLP Expert) is a key leadership position within the Amazon Security and Loss Prevention (S&LP) team. This position reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager.

- Identify vulnerabilities and conduct root cause analysis using data to define mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards.

- Manage confidential investigations and prepare prompt reports of theft, fraud, and workplace violence/critical incidents.

You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience.

Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our S&LP plan.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection.

We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

title: Sr. Security Solutions Architect, AI-Applied Guidance, Well-Architected Solutions Innovation
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Do you want to set the standard for how builders architect AI workloads that are secure, reliable, and efficient on AWS with security as the foundation? We are looking for a Senior Security Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI to own and drive the strategic vision for security-focused architectural guidance and best practices across AI workloads. You will operate at the intersection of AI technologies cloud architecture and security engineering ensuring AI workloads achieve Well-Architected outcomes across all six pillars of Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability with depth in the Security pillar. You will influence both internal AWS teams and the broader builder community. In this role you will define the long-term technical direction for AI security architectural guidance translate emerging AI/ML security patterns into prescriptive and actionable best practices grounded in the Well-Architected pillars and influence AWS service design to better serve AI builders who need to secure their workloads across the full AI lifecycle.

Key job responsibilities
• Set Strategic Technical Direction for AI Security: Define and own the long-term vision and roadmap for AI/ML security architectural guidance aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Guidance pillars with deep focus on the Security pillar - including identity, access control, data protection, data residency and sovereignty, threat detection, and incident response for AI workloads.
• Provide guidance on security considerations for foundation models, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration, and responsible AI practices. Drive consensus on complex ambiguous security decisions in AI systems.
• Raise the Bar Across the Organization: Establish security standards review mechanisms and architectural guardrails that elevate the entire guidance portfolio. Define what "great" looks like for AI security guidance and hold the team accountable.
• Influence Service Roadmaps: Partner with Stakeholders and Engineers across AWS service teams (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Q, AWS Security services, etc.) to represent the customer voice on AI security validate architectural recommendations and influence product direction based on security patterns observed in production AI workloads.
• Executive Customer Engagement: Engage directly with strategic enterprise customers to validate security guidance through real-world implementations identify emerging AI security challenges and translate insights into scalable best practices.
• Drive Innovation in Content Delivery: Own the strategy for automation tooling and pipelines (including Generative AI-assisted authoring) that accelerate the creation review and publication of AI security guidance at scale. Define mechanisms that ensure guidance remains current as the AI threat landscape evolves rapidly.
• External Thought Leadership: Publish whitepapers blog posts and reference architectures; present at AWS events (re:Invent, Summits, webinars) and industry security conferences to establish AWS as a leading authority on securing Well-Architected AI workloads.
• Mentorship & Organizational Impact: Mentor senior architects on AI security best practices drive hiring bar-raising and build a community of practice that scales AI security architectural expertise across the organization. Contribute to organizational strategy and workforce planning.
• Mechanisms & Operational Excellence: Design and implement repeatable mechanisms (e.g., security review processes, threat modeling for AI workloads, guidance lifecycle management, feedback loops) that ensure sustained quality and relevance at scale.
• Hands-On Technical Validation: Validate security architectural recommendations through prototyping proof-of-concept implementations threat modeling exercises and code samples that demonstrate secure AI patterns.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing a customer's architecture proposal identifying areas where you can simplify complexity and reduce operational overhead. By midday you are leading a technical deep-dive with a customer's engineering team walking through design choices and trade-offs. Later you collaborate with internal partners to unblock a delivery milestone then wrap up by contributing a reusable reference design that other architects can leverage.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across organizational boundaries without direct authority

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience securing Agentic AI patterns: permission boundaries for autonomous agents, secure tool-use architectures, least-privilege orchestration, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
- Expert-level knowledge of AWS security and AI/ML services: AWS IAM, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Macie, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, Amazon SageMaker (with VPC, encryption, role-based access), and related services

title: Data Center Facilities Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

Key job responsibilities
Oversee all aspects of the data center’s critical physical infrastructure.
Maintain high availability and performance while ensuring that all work performed within the site is done to high quality without impact to internal/external customers and maintain service level agreements.

Manage on-site teams of 24x7 shift technicians, sub-contractors and vendors ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures and safety protocols.
Drive safety and security culture and compliance within the team

Hire, coach, and promote team members.

Responsible for team's career development and performance management
Promotes healthy team culture and peak morale

Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures.

Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion.

Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues.

Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.

Utilize root cause analysis and troubleshooting/problem solving skills
Respond to out-of-hours emergency calls.
Role may support more than one location/site.

May assist in the build out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency

Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day to day tasks

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

title: Sr. Regional Enviro Engineer -Water Compliance, AWS Environmental Team
descriptionHtml:
As a Regional Environmental Engineer (REE) specializing in water compliance, you will support water-related environmental compliance at AWS data centers. You will provide technical expertise in permitting and compliance across National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES), Significant Industrial User (SIU) discharge, potable water systems, groundwater wells, onsite wastewater treatment systems, stormwater, and water-quality monitoring and reporting. You will evaluate existing and proposed infrastructure, develop scalable compliance programs and technical standards, monitor environmental performance, and partner with design, construction, operations, and other stakeholders to incorporate water-related regulatory requirements into site design and operation.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead water compliance programs for water supply and discharge across US data center locations
• Develop and maintain the water compliance program that guides how sites and REEs obtain, renew, modify, interpret, and implement NPDES and other water discharge permits under the Clean Water Act, 40 CFR Part 122, and applicable state regulations, and translate effluent limitations, monitoring, operating, reporting, and notification requirements into site-level compliance programs
• Provide guidance on evaluating regulatory applicability and permitting requirements for new sites, expansions, operational changes, and new or modified discharges
• Provide guidance on evaluating industrial wastewater and stormwater permitting and compliance, including federal pretreatment under 40 CFR Part 403, local sewer-use ordinances, POTW requirements, pollution-prevention plans, inspections, best management practices, monitoring, and reporting
• Provide technical guidance on potable water systems and onsite wastewater systems, including design, operation, monitoring, and compliance under applicable drinking-water and septic requirements
• Develop standard templates and technical guidance for water-quality sampling and monitoring plans, review site plans, and set standards for sampling equipment, monitoring systems, and analytical methods under 40 CFR Part 136
• Evaluate water and wastewater treatment processes, system performance, waste-stream characterization, water balances, and discharge pathways to determine permitting and compliance implications
• Build the mechanisms, dashboards, and metrics that track water-quality data, lab reports, DMRs, and compliance performance, and support sites in identifying trends, exceedances, corrective actions, and forecasting across sites
• Read and evaluate engineering plans, process-flow diagrams, P&IDs, and specifications, and partner with design, engineering, construction, and operations teams to build water-related controls into current and future designs early
• Clearly communicate the technical and regulatory basis for environmental requirements and influence partner teams to implement compliant, practical, and scalable solutions
• Set the standards and oversight mechanisms that keep work by employees, contractors, and consultants aligned with applicable environmental requirements and Amazon standards
• Support REEs and sites in their interactions with regulatory agencies, utilities, POTWs, consultants, and contractors, and engage directly on program-level matters
• Support time-critical regulatory notifications, permit applications, and monitoring reports, and support emergency response planning and incident investigations, including root causes and corrective and preventive actions
• Develop and deliver water compliance training for relevant staff
• Stay current with evolving water regulations and industry best practices for domestic and non-contact cooling, particularly in the data center sector


About the team
The AWS Environmental is a team of professionals responsible for the environmental planning, delivery, and operational compliance of all AWS global infrastructure projects.

Basic qualifications

- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental science, chemistry, or a related technical field.
- Experience with NPDES and industrial wastewater permitting and compliance, including interpreting effluent limitations, sampling/monitoring requirements, reporting obligations, and noncompliance notification requirements under the Clean Water Act, 40 CFR Part 122, and federal pretreatment requirements under 40 CFR Part 403, and applicable state or local regulatory programs.
- Experience developing or implementing water-quality sampling and monitoring programs, including sampling plans, sampling locations, analytical parameters and methods, sampling equipment, laboratory coordination, and data evaluation.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering or equivalent.
