title: Data Center Security Manager, DUB South Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking to hire a customer-obsessed Data Center Security Manager to provide hands-on support to our Data Center Infrastructure Operations team across the DUB Cluster.

As a Data Center Security Manager, you will be tasked with running day-to-day data center security operations, supporting and executing security projects and programs, as well as assuring audit compliance with AWS policies and procedures.

Key job responsibilities
Direct and manage contract guard force to run daily data center operations.
Handle site security incidents, escalations or any other security related issues.
Provide after-hours on-call management support and participate in emergent, large scale event response when needed.
Participate in re-occurring data center security audits and reviews.
Executes established compliance processes with AWS policies, standards, guidelines and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.
Provides input on, and may develop security methodologies, policies and procedures.
Write reports and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations.
Oversee new security construction or retrofit projects.
Manage the security P&L for assigned site(s), assist management with financial analysis and contribute to financial decisions for security requirements.
Collaborate with other teams to protect AWS Data Center personnel, information and assets.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply as we focus on talented people who are motivated to learn and be successful in our growing industry. The successful applicant will receive comprehensive onboard training as well as continuous support from a local and regional security team. You will also have opportunities to collaborate and engage with various teams across the globe.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Ability to walk a facility and observe security gaps in physical barriers, security officer procedure, policies, surveillance equipment, and alarm points
Drive campaigns to reduce nuisance alarms
Experience with workflow ticketing and extraction of performance metrics
Investigate accidents, thefts, disturbances, discrepancies
Oversee physical security sub contractors that provide guards, electronic security systems, door construction, door repair, fencing, and access controls
Distill overarching security strategy into daily tactics to reach management goals
Oversee security construction projects
Teach others the proper security processes and methods

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience overseeing security operations and working with security vendors/contractors
- Experience managing multiple complex projects and adapting to change

Preferred qualifications

- Experience acting as a Program Security Officer, Security Specialist, or Security Manager with duties including interpreting and implementing requirements within the personnel, industrial, and physical security disciplines and overseeing security operations
- Associate's degree, or CISSP, CISA, CISM or other security certification

title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Data Centre Engineering

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer who can perform design engineering activities for new build projects. You will become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print across the EMEA region.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective mechanical services systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to senior management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. You will have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on. Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment.

We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

title: Sr Forecasting Analyst, Amazon Advertising
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising is the earth’s most customer centric advertising program and is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including sponsored, display, video, and custom ads—leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys, helping advertisers build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. This role can be based in Seattle or New York.

Forecast and Strategy team (F&S) Team within Amazon Advertising is looking for an experienced professional with excellent analytical skills and strong business acumen to develop and implement our demand forecasting tools and mechanisms in a fast-paced and innovative environment, at a global scale.

As a Sr Forecasting Analyst, you will be responsible for modeling forecasting problems, discovering insights and identifying opportunities through the use of statistical, machine learning, algorithmic, data mining and visualization techniques which you will implement and enhance.

You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to analyze forecast variances, understand and mitigate variance drivers, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and present the insights in concise and effective manner. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impacts the bottom line of the business. Accurate forecasts drive improvements in cost and quality of our advertising operations on a global scale.

The role covers Headcount planning responsibilities as well, which include creating staffing plans, in close partnership with Finance and Ops, leveraging the forecasts you would have generated.

Key job responsibilities
· Produce and communicate Long Range and Short Range forecasts and strategical headcount plans for a variety of business oriented KPIs.
· Design, build and implement innovative forecasting and headcount planning tools and mechanisms, to create a reliable and effective short and long term forecast for a wide range of Amazon Ads departments.
· Build and maintain KPIs that reliably reflect forecasting and staffing accuracy, and downstream impact on the business.
· Create new reporting & analytic opportunities by analyzing and understanding key planning processes
· Thought leadership on integration of new products/services supported by Advertising.
· Write and present documents up to the VP level.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, statistics, computer science, business administration or a related field
- 3+ years of demand planning and forecasting experience
- Experience with statistical modeling / machine learning
- Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent

- Experience with AWS Tools and Technologies (Redshift, S3, EC2)

- Knowledge of Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques

title: Product Manager III, Technical, WW Prime
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about shaping products that reach millions of customers? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and customer experience, turning ambiguity into clear product strategy? As a Technical Product Manager at Amazon, you will own the vision, roadmap, and delivery of products that solve real customer problems at scale. You will partner closely with engineering, design, science, and business teams to define what we build and why — using data, customer insights, and sound judgment to make smart trade-offs. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex technical challenges, influence product architecture decisions, and drive meaningful business outcomes while keeping the customer at the center of everything you do.

Key job responsibilities
- Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and prioritized deliverables.
- Partner with engineering, scientists, end economists to evaluate technical proposals, define requirements for APIs and system components, and ensure product solutions balance performance, scalability, and long-term architectural integrity.
- Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, and operations to deliver products on time and at high quality, influencing teams with different priorities through clear communication and well-structured documents.
- Define success criteria and key performance metrics, distinguish between output and outcome measures, and use data analysis alongside sound judgment to inform decisions — leveraging generative AI capabilities where appropriate to accelerate insight generation and development cycles.
- Influence multiple VP-led organizations on their customer experience approaches and investment priorities
- Own the full product lifecycle from concept through launch and post-launch optimization, monitoring operational health, driving customer adoption, and iterating based on performance data and direct customer feedback.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing product metrics and customer feedback to identify emerging patterns. By mid-morning, you are in a design review with engineers, probing trade-offs in a proposed architecture change and aligning on next steps. After lunch, you draft a product requirements document for an upcoming feature, grounding it in recent customer research. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners in marketing and operations to coordinate an upcoming launch. Throughout, you use AI tools to prototype ideas and accelerate analysis, keeping your focus on delivering the right experience for customers.

About the team
Our team is focused on building products that make a meaningful difference for customers. We operate in a collaborative environment where product managers, engineers, designers, and scientists work side by side to solve complex problems and ship impactful solutions. We value curiosity, clear thinking, and a willingness to challenge assumptions. Looking ahead, we are investing in new capabilities — including AI-driven experiences — to push the boundaries of what our products can do. If you want to shape the future of technology-driven products at Amazon and grow alongside a talented, inclusive team, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Master's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
- Background in analytics and causal inference (strongly preferred)
- Experience working with Machine Learning Scientists, Economists, or other science domains to develop highly scalable systems that solve challenges around forecasting, optimization, personalization, or similar
- Demonstrated cross-functional ownership of complex, ambiguous initiatives, including communicating with senior leadership

title: Optical Network Development Engineer, Core Networking
descriptionHtml:
If you like to work with new technologies and optimizing existing technology have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or service provider environment, we would like to meet you. Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Core Networking team is looking for an Optical Network Development Engineer to join our Inter-DC & Optical team. As an Optical Network Development Engineer, you will be responsible for building, deploying and scaling the Amazon networks that support AWS, customers, and other business units, across multiple global datacenters.
AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. They own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking's goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.


Key job responsibilities
Optical Network Development Engineers perform high quality network and/or systems operations, deployments, scaling, technology refresh, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.
• Create and implement changes on the network.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allow us to scale at higher volume.
• Lead network projects in the areas of network sustaining engineering, network deployment/implementation, network scaling, technology refresh, best practices application, and/or network optimization.
• Sustain Amazon Web Services’ next generation networks for significant AWS customers by providing critical network support to diagnose, mitigate impact, and resolve large-scale networking events.
• Operate and troubleshoot network routing, interconnectivity, platforms, performance, and configurations issues; including necessary low-level application interaction, Unix systems, and new age networking software tools.
• Drive and support innovation from Top of Rack to the Network Border and everything in between.
• Partner with our broader Network/Infrastructure organization in the areas of network engineering, configurations standards, and tools.
• Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
• Maintain standards across the networking toolset and ensure that we are fully compliant to those standards and policies.
• Deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes.
• Collaborate with highest tier escalation engineers/resolvers.
• Create and review documentation and process regarding network implementation/deployments, recurring issues, new standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer material, etc.


A day in the life
Engineers in the Core Networking team have a wide range of responsibilities. In terms of product development and delivery, it covers all activities related to hardware and software development, cross-platforms and software integration, and transition to production for both inhouse commodity and OEM optical platforms. From the lifecycle support perspective, includes day to day operations on-call, sustaining engineering, operational load automation and reduction, product and network security, network data integrity and authoritativeness, availability assurance (SRLG monitoring) and improvement (OLP, RFTS) and fiber infrastructure and vendor performance management. Our engineers not only make decisions on day-to-day work but they also own the long-term strategic view, they build strong partnership with customers to understand their immediate and future needs, their use cases and the things that we/they are not even thinking about so we make sure our solutions will fit into their needs. They bring perspective and context to influence the way we make technology and design choices, how we develop and deliver products that are right sized, fungible and future proof at the optimum cost per bit. They understand the business impact of their recommendations and show good judgment in decision making as we consider technical trade-offs between the immediate short-term technology solutions, operational needs and the long-term business needs.

About the team
AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. We own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking's goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.

Our current network size is >10Pbps of inter data center traffic over >30k devices worldwide and our team is structured to create and evolve these products and solutions while providing highly available, secure and scalable transport for multiple customer fabrics globally.

The team is responsible for the development, delivery and lifecycle support of the optical products used to interconnect AWS Data Centers and PoPs (Point of presence), ensuring diversity of supply and continually lowering data transfer cost for customers. This product portfolio serves a broad customer base and is primarily used to transport Core (EC2 & Prod) and Border (Internet) traffic in and across all but a few AWS commercial and ADC regions globally. Our current network size is >10Pbps of inter data center traffic over >30k devices worldwide and our team is structured to create and evolve these products and solutions while providing highly available, secure and scalable transport for multiple customer fabrics globally.

Meet Kensie, Network Development Engineer --- https://youtu.be/ezF3kpUAhWU\

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of working in a Linux/Unix environment experience
- 4+ years of experience with optical planning and modeling tools.
- 4+ years of experience with optical network design and troubleshooting.
- 1+ years of professional development experience with Python or a similar tool for network automation scripting.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Unix, or experience scripting in one or more language (e.g. Bash, Python, Perl, Ruby)
- 4+ years of network engineering and deployments for large-scale networks in a corporate environment, including hands-on physical infrastructure installations, hardware integration, racking, and cabling experience

- Knowledge of L2 and L3 routing.
- A relevant degree in a related technical discipline or equivalent experience in a large – scale network environment.

Once new partners have completed their initial deployment, you'll continue partnering with them by offering support and insights to ensure they're making the most of their eero experience.

Key job responsibilities

This includes defining and coordinating partners' programme requirements, managing non-standard partner needs, and accelerating deployments by identifying programme expansion opportunities. You'll acquire deep knowledge of customers' vision, products, and objectives, anticipating partner needs and resolving significant pain points before they escalate. As their advocate, you'll work with internal teams and provide compelling evidence to inspire action whilst assisting with sales product demonstrations and coordinating product training for new partners.

You'll steer eero to focus its partner-related efforts on work that delivers the biggest positive impact. As a strategic adviser, you'll earn partners' trust and influence their customer-facing technology strategy, helping them optimise their eero programmes to deliver exceptional customer experiences whilst maximising partner value.

You'll balance proactive outreach—checking in with partners on deployment progress and identifying expansion opportunities—with reactive problem-solving as urgent issues arise. descriptionHtml:
Our Local & Services Advertising business serves the multi-billion dollar US local advertising market segment. We are building a portfolio of AI-powered ad experiences across Amazon owned & operated properties that will connect customers with the best local and services businesses in ways that feel natural, helpful, and seamless. This role will own the end-to-end product vision and execution for this business.
As Sr. Principal, Product Manager - Technical for Local & Services Advertising, you will define the multi-year strategy and drive execution for one of the most ambitious new advertising categories at Amazon. You will own the product lifecycle across multiple ad formats, multiple surfaces, and multiple demand channels. You will partner with engineering, science, and design teams building agentic AI systems that understand full conversation context, dynamically render locally-aware creatives, and drive seamless task completion for customers. You will build consensus across organizational boundaries to deliver a coherent advertiser and customer experience.
This is a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity role requiring collaboration across sales and product marketing to define and scale go-to-market. The leader should thrive on building zero-to-one, bring deep advertising technology expertise, and possess the technical judgment to make the right architecture and product decisions across AI/ML systems, ad serving infrastructure, and cross-surface experiences. You will influence VP and SVP-level strategy, and be accountable for business outcomes measured in billions of dollars.

Key job responsibilities
Product Vision & Strategy
Own and articulate the 3-5 year product vision for Local & Services Advertising, defining how we drive adoption and business growth through differentiated AI-powered experiences
Define the strategy for the new ad product across all Amazon surfaces, including the expansion roadmap across verticals, geographies, and demand sources
Own the P/L and revenue trajectory, making investment decisions that maximize long-term customer and business value
Cross-Surface Product Architecture
Define the product architecture that enables local and services ads to work coherently across Amazon's diverse publishers (e.g., Alexa, Fire TV, Stores etc.)
Own the integration strategy between Services/Local Ads, Conversational Ads, and display/video ad formats to deliver a unified full-funnel experience for local advertisers
Design the agentic task completion experience that enables customers to discover, evaluate, and transact with local service providers
Technical Leadership
Partner with engineering and science teams to define the AI/ML systems powering local ad relevance, including LLM-based contextual targeting, location-aware dynamic creative optimization, and real-time intent signals
Evaluate technical tradeoffs across ad serving infrastructure, privacy-safe agentic AI layers, and cross-surface orchestration systems
Drive architecture decisions for demand ingestion across multiple buying interfaces (Amazon Ads Console, ADSP, API) and demand sources
Ensure solutions scale to serve millions of local advertisers across multiple verticals while maintaining sub-second latency and high relevance
Demand Diversification & Partnerships
Define the demand diversification strategy across distinct buyer personas
Own the product requirements that enable frictionless onboarding for partners, while building toward self-service tools for millions of SMBs
Work with Sales leadership to define the go-to-market strategy that bootstraps demand at scale
Cross-Organizational Alignment
Build consensus and influence roadmaps across APM (supply and CX), SPB (demand and ad serving), Alexa+ (conversational AI), Publisher Partners (e.g., Fire TV), and Sales & Product Marketing (demand generation)
Drive strategic communications including decision narratives, investment proposals, annual planning narratives, and SVP-level business reviews
Act as the single-threaded owner accountable for end-to-end outcomes across organizational boundaries
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Identify and pursue breakthrough opportunities that leverage Amazon's unique value proposition
Define how generative AI and agentic systems fundamentally change local advertising from static impressions to intelligent, conversation-driven task completion
Establish best practices and mechanisms that scale the Local & Services Advertising business and develop the next generation of product leaders

About the team
We sit at the intersection of Amazon Ads, Alexa+, and Amazon's first-party publisher network. Our mission is to unlock the massive local and services advertising opportunity by building AI-native advertising products that are genuinely useful to customers and transformatively effective for advertisers. We are a cross-functional team spanning product, engineering, science, and design, building products that touch hundreds of millions of customers across every Amazon surface. We are in the early stages of a business that will generate billions in revenue, and we are looking for a technical product leader who can see around corners, make bold bets, and deliver results at scale.
Amazon Ads is building a new category of advertising that connects hundreds of millions of customers with local and services businesses at the exact moment of intent, powered by Alexa+ agentic AI. We are creating an advertising experience unlike anything that exists today: one where a customer watching a game on Fire TV can order from their favorite local restaurant through a simple voice command, where a shopper purchasing a kitchen faucet discovers a trusted plumber two miles away and books an appointment without leaving Amazon, and where a traveler asking Alexa about weekend plans completes a hotel reservation through natural conversation. This is the future of local advertising, and we are building it.

- 12+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)
- Experience leading engineering design projects and interacting with cross-functional teams
- Experience facilitating discussions with senior leadership regarding technical / architectural trade-offs, best practices, and risk mitigation
- Experience in B2B, digital advertising, and ad-tech products/services
- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)
- Experience leading and influencing your team or organization, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- Experience managing technical products or online services

title: Engineering Operations Technician, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Senior Product Design Electrical Engineer for our Electrical Products and Services (EPS) team. EPS is a global engineering team within AWS Data Center Engineering, responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of electrical power distribution products used across our rapidly expanding data center footprint. Our product portfolio spans the full electrical distribution chain, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other critical electrical infrastructure.

The EPS team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, they are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. They drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to senior leadership. They seek new ways to improve the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, they have the opportunity to design, innovate, and improve the products our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a work environment where speed and quality matter. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. Amazon's work environment is unique in every aspect and offers a great opportunity for the right candidate.

If you have led or worked with high performing teams of engineers and enjoy working on complex problems, we want to hear from you. At Amazon, the successful candidate will be responsible for working on product designs and supporting our wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

At Amazon, teamwork is necessary for us to accomplish our goals. The successful candidate must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As a product engineer at Amazon, they will work with other internal groups as well as external groups including engineering service providers, manufacturers, vendors, inspectors, third party testing labs, and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel will be necessary but should not be more than 30%. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel may be necessary. Their contribution could consist of leading international projects and could require developing engineering information packages. An understanding of international electrical product design requirements is helpful but not necessary.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with internal partner teams to solicit customer input and define design requirements for product design.
- Lead new product design, development and qualification of critical electrical power distribution equipment for AWS data centers, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other electrical infrastructure.
- Develop Capex and Opex spending budgets taking into account development costs with vendors, prototyping needs, testing and specialized tooling requirements.
- Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical equipment and components, ensuring tier 2-3 supply chain resiliency.
- Ensure compliance with UL, CSA, IEC and federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries through appropriate levels of testing.
- Validate design through prototype, pre-production and first-of-kind builds, conducting DFx and value engineering analysis through each step and updating design and documentation.
- Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical products.
- Provide support for manufacturing activities for new products on concurrent projects in multiple geographical locations.
- Be a leader within the product development team as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

descriptionHtml:
Are you a results-driven operations leader who thrives on building high-performing teams and driving continuous improvement at scale? Amazon is looking for a Senior Manager, Operations to lead a fulfillment center function, where you will own the strategy and execution that keeps our network running safely and efficiently. In this role, you will manage large teams, solve complex operational challenges, and shape the associate experience across your site. Your ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on leadership will directly influence how we deliver for millions of customers. If you are energized by fast-paced environments and motivated by making a meaningful impact on both people and processes, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a team of front-line managers and associates, providing continuous coaching, actionable feedback, and growth opportunities that raise the performance bar across your function.
- Drive operational excellence by analyzing key performance indicators, identifying trends across data sources, and translating insights into strategic actions that improve safety, quality, and productivity.
- Build scalable processes and mechanisms within your function, ensuring consistency and reliability while accounting for cross-functional impacts and network-level considerations.
- Champion a culture of safety by modeling safe behaviors, incorporating safety considerations into all operational planning, and regularly reviewing safety metrics to drive measurable improvements.
- Collaborate across site functions to align on priorities, resolve interdepartmental challenges, and implement new initiatives that improve associate experience and operational outcomes.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing safety and performance metrics, then connect with your leadership team during an operational stand-up to align on priorities. Throughout your shift, you will walk the floor to observe processes, coach managers in real time, and address emerging issues. You will partner with peers across functions to remove bottlenecks, participate in strategic planning sessions, and review progress on improvement initiatives. Expect to balance time between hands-on problem solving and longer-range planning that shapes how your team operates during peak and steady-state periods.

About the team
Our fulfillment center operations team is at the heart of Amazon's promise to customers. We are a group of dedicated leaders who work together to create a safe, inclusive, and engaging environment for thousands of associates while delivering operational results at remarkable scale. Our mission is to continuously improve how we operate — investing in our people, refining our processes, and adopting new technologies. We are focused on building the next generation of operations leaders and welcome those who are excited to make a lasting impact on both our teams and the customers we serve.

title: Sr. Partner Development Manager, Global Ads Partner Development
descriptionHtml:
Global Partner Development manages Amazon Ads' relationships with independent agency and technology partners worldwide. Partners are force multipliers for Amazon Ads, capable of scaling capability, reach, and advertiser outcomes in ways that Amazon cannot achieve through direct sales alone. GPD's job is to build the commercial and capability infrastructure that makes those partnerships productive at scale.
PDMs own the full partner relationship lifecycle: commercial framework, executive engagement, and strategic development, with one standard: partners grow because of Amazon, not despite it.
This is not an account management role. PDMs do not manage campaigns, resolve portal access issues, or own day-to-day execution. They own the long-horizon work that determines whether a partner deepens its commitment to Amazon Ads or finds a path around it. A PDM's most important output is a partner that cannot imagine its growth trajectory without Amazon Ads embedded in it.


Key job responsibilities
Executive Relationship Ownership
• Own the C-suite or most senior relationship with a defined set of agency or technology partners, including CEO, CMO, CRO, and CPO. These relationships are not shared, delegated, or rebuilt quickly if lost.
• Operate consistently at Director, VP, and C-suite level. Meetings produce commitments, not action items.
• Navigate partner organizations at multiple layers simultaneously, including holding company leadership, trading desk principals, and field teams. Influence at one level without losing credibility at another.
• Anticipate partner needs before they arrive. The bar is not responsiveness; it is foresight.

Joint Business Planning
• Architect Joint Business Plans (JBPs) that identify and activate growth pathways for each partner in your book. JBPs put the best of Amazon's resources to work for the partner's business, across marketing, product, and commercial enablement.
• Build JBPs with a two-to-three year horizon. Align partner investments to mutual growth priorities. Know how your partners' strategy is evolving before they tell you.
• Use the JBP as the primary vehicle for grounding the commercial relationship. The PA carries JBP strategy forward into targets and incentives. The scorecard holds both parties accountable and feeds the next JBP refresh.

Partner Agreement Strategy
• Lead the design, negotiation, and renewal of Partner Agreements (PAs) for every partner in your book. Own the commercial framework end to end, including structure, incentive design, and close.
• Co-develop targets with partners based on a genuine understanding of their book of business, growth potential, and client demand. Targets should reflect real stretch and a shared plan to reach them.
• Build PAs that reflect a genuine commercial bet. Both sides have skin in the game and a shared plan to grow.
• Work the year after next. PA renewals should feel like a natural output of the relationship, not a once-a-year negotiation.

Strategic Intelligence and Positioning
• Stay ahead of where each partner is going strategically, including their product roadmap, competitive pressures, organizational changes, and how Amazon Ads fits their long-term model.
• Translate partner signals into a clear internal point of view on how Amazon should engage, invest, or course-correct.
• Use pattern recognition across your book to surface systemic issues. A policy gap that affects one partner likely affects twenty.

Commercial Development
• Identify incremental revenue opportunities within your partner book, with a focus on Amazon-native capability adoption rather than undifferentiated volume.
• Drive adoption of Amazon-native capabilities across partner tech and media roadmaps, including AMC, programmatic video, and first-party data integrations, so that partner-driven revenue is built on Amazon’s unique advantages, not on price or undifferentiated scale.
• Collaborate with product, GGS, and finance to structure incentives, resolve blockers, and close commercial gaps.

Operational Rigor and Delivery
• Translate strategy into execution, ensuring commitments made in planning are delivered through structured follow-through, clear ownership, and measurable outcomes.
• Build partner capability as a core part of the role. Partners deepen their Amazon expertise, unlock differentiation, and adopt the products that drive Quality Dollar growth through PDM-led enablement.
• Serve as the voice of your partners internally. Bring partner feedback, product gaps, and market intelligence to the teams that can act on it.
• Escalate execution work to the right operational channels rather than absorbing it personally. Every hour spent on account management is an hour not spent on the next PA or integration.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or equivalent
- Experience in partner management, channel development, business development, or strategic account management
- Demonstrated track record owning and closing commercial agreements
- Experience operating at Director level and above with external partners or clients

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in digital advertising, ad technology, or marketing technology
- Familiarity with programmatic advertising, DSP platforms, or retail media ecosystems
- Experience with performance-based or tiered commercial structures
- Background working across agency, technology, or consulting partner models

title: Senior Test Engineer, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is seeking a motivated Test Engineer. You will plan, design, execute, and document testing of electrical-drive systems and their components — from individual actuator characterization through system-level validation. This includes the design and operation of test benches, instrumentation selection, data processing, and reporting. You will be accountable for turning raw measurement data into clear engineering insights that drive design decisions for our actuation hardware.

You will work with mechanical, electrical, firmware, and systems engineers within Amazon Robotics. The ideal candidate brings hands-on test bench experience for drive systems, strong measurement and data-processing fundamentals, and a passion for translating test results into actionable design guidance.


Key job responsibilities
• Design, commission, and operate test benches for electrical-drive systems (motors, inverters, gear units), including fixture design, instrumentation layout, and safety concepts.

• Select, integrate, and calibrate torque cells and encoders (incremental and absolute), with a thorough understanding of their working principles and error influences (e.g., cross-talk, temperature drift, mounting misalignment, interpolation error).

• Process and analyze test data using MATLAB, applying the underlying mathematical fundamentals (filtering, FFT, statistics, uncertainty propagation) to extract meaningful performance metrics from raw sensor signals.

• Compile clear, structured test reports that compare results against specifications, highlight anomalies, and derive actionable engineering learnings to feed back into the design cycle.

• Collaborate with Amazon Robotics to align test strategies with product requirements and development milestones.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience with test plan development, building the necessary test bench infrastructure, developing tests and verifying the design
- Experience identifying and reviewing test plans, test cases and testing results with a strong QA background
- Practical knowledge of torque cells and rotary encoders — including their working principles, error influences, and calibration requirements
- Proficiency in MATLAB for measurement data processing, applying the fundamental mathematics of signal processing and statistics

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience with motor characterization

title: Software Development Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the systems that power pricing for millions of business customers — and reinvent how those systems get built at the same time? We're an engineering team inside Amazon Business, and we own the platform behind how business pricing works: the services that decide, calculate, and deliver the right price at scale.

As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you'll own real problems end to end. You'll design and build distributed backend services on AWS, make them faster and more reliable, and take on the harder challenge underneath all of it — keeping a large, always-on platform efficient and cost-effective as it grows. You won't just pick up tickets; you'll take ambiguous problems, shape the approach, and drive them from design through to production.

What makes this role different is that we're also rethinking how we engineer. We're early adopters of AI-native development — building AI tools, chat bots, and agentic workflows that make our whole team faster and our operations more reliable. You'll get to use these tools daily, and you'll help build them. It's a rare mix: deep systems ownership on one side, and a genuine mandate to shape the future of software development on the other.

You'll work closely with engineers, product managers, and partner teams across regions, review and raise the bar on each other's work, and mentor others as you grow. If you like owning a domain, writing code that reaches customers worldwide, and being at the front of the AI shift in engineering, this is a great place to do the best work of your career.

Key job responsibilities
* You will participate in the full development cycle, end-to-end, from design, implementation, and testing to documentation, delivery and maintenance.

* You will evaluate and make decisions around the use of new or existing technologies and tools, and you’ll coach and mentor junior development engineers.

* You will directly work with Senior Engineers and Principal Engineers in the org to define our architecture plans for the next three years.

* You will be driving team to make decisions on build vs re-use by collaborating with Retail and Seller Pricing teams.

* You will be responsible for setting standards and mechanisms for handling operational load.

A day in the life
Designing and reviewing architecture for scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency; writing and shipping production code across Java backend services and AWS infrastructure; building or improving AI-native developer tooling (agents, chat bots, automated workflows); reviewing teammates' CRs and design docs; and collaborating with product managers and partner teams (US/EU) during the shared afternoon working window. A balance of hands-on building, platform/architecture ownership, and applying AI to move the whole team faster.

About the team
Team Vortex is part of Amazon Business Flywheel Inputs (ABFI), based in Hyderabad. We own core platform charters behind Amazon Business pricing — responsible for scaling the architecture, improving reliability, and continuously reducing total cost of ownership. We're a delivery-focused, customer-obsessed team and an early adopter of AI-native engineering: we build and use AI tools, chat bots, and agentic workflows to raise developer productivity and operational health. Engineers here get broad ownership, real cross-team impact, and active investment in their growth.

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

descriptionHtml:

Do you want to build and deploy advanced ML systems that help optimize millions of transactions every day? Are you excited by the prospect of analyzing and modeling terabytes of data to solve real-world problems? Do you like to own end-to-end business problems/metrics and directly impact the profitability of the company? Do you like to innovate and simplify? If yes, then you may be a great fit to join the Machine Learning team for International Emerging Stores (IES).

Machine Learning, Big Data and related quantitative sciences have been strategic to Amazon from the early years. Amazon has been a pioneer in areas such as recommendation engines, ecommerce fraud detection and large-scale optimization of fulfillment center operations. As Amazon has rapidly grown and diversified, the opportunity for applying machine learning has exploded. We have a very broad collection of practical problems where machine learning systems can dramatically improve the customer experience, reduce cost, and drive speed and automation. These include product bundle recommendations for millions of products, safeguarding financial transactions across by building the risk models, improving catalog quality via extracting product attribute values from structured/unstructured data for millions of products, enhancing address quality by powering customer suggestions

We are developing state-of-the-art machine learning solutions to accelerate the Amazon India growth story. Amazon is an exciting place to be at for a machine learning practitioner. We have the eagerness of a fresh startup to absorb machine learning solutions, and the scale of a mature firm to help support their development at the same time. As part of the International Machine Learning team, you will get to work alongside brilliant minds motivated to solve real-world machine learning problems that make a difference to millions of our customers. We encourage thought leadership and blue ocean thinking in ML.

Key job responsibilities
Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems
Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of Amazon’s historical business data to help automate and optimize key processes
Design, develop, evaluate and deploy, innovative and highly scalable ML models
Work closely with software engineering teams to drive real-time model implementations
Work closely with business partners to identify problems and propose machine learning solutions
Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large scale data analyses, model development, model validation and model maintenance
Work proactively with engineering teams and product managers to evangelize new algorithms and drive the implementation of large-scale complex ML models in production
Leading projects and mentoring other scientists, engineers in the use of ML techniques


About the team
International Machine Learning Team is responsible for building novel ML solutions across International Emerging Store (India, MENA, Far-East, LatAm) problems and impact the bottom-line and top-line of India business. Learn more about our team from https://www.amazon.science/working-at-amazon/how-rajeev-rastogis-machine-learning-team-in-india-develops-innovations-for-customers-worldwide

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code
- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor
descriptionHtml:
This is a contract role

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.

Key job responsibilities
• Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees.
• Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
• Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
• Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases.
• Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
• Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
• Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word
- Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience handling confidential information
- Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
- Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Supply Chain Manager Intern, AWS Cloud Logistics
descriptionHtml:
*Internship period: January to June 2027

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) is looking for a motivated Supply Chain Intern to join our team in Singapore. In this role, you will drive documentation standardization, create internal enablement resources, build operational playbooks, and explore agentic AI solutions - all within a global supply chain that powers AWS's infrastructure worldwide. You will be able to leverage Amazon's suite of AI tools, Amazon Quick, and its underlying models to optimize your workflow and productivity while continuing to grow and develop your acumen in AI.

Key job responsibilities
Site Management Framework & Governance: Conduct site visits across APAC warehouses to understand operations firsthand, followed by a gap assessment of existing SOPs, governance, and reporting. Develop a standardized Site Management Framework covering vendor governance, SLA management, performance scorecards, RCCA processes, and escalation matrices. Establish a sustainable review cadence with clear ownership to ensure the framework remains current beyond tenure.

SOP Development & Process Documentation: Author Standard Operating Procedures for key warehouse operational areas including receiving, outbound, inventory management, and exception handling. Develop standardized work instructions and process flows that enable consistent execution across sites and accelerate onboarding of new team members and WSP staff. Ensure all documentation is repeatable, clear, and audit-ready.

Data, Analytics & Automation: Identify opportunities to automate recurring operational workflows using AI agent tooling and Python, such as daily metrics consolidation, exception alerting, SLA tracking, and vendor performance reporting. Build automated workflows and document them as replicable playbooks for adoption across the APAC network.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, but every day has a rhythm. Your morning might start by supporting an operational task for the team - pulling data, updating a tracker, or preparing materials for an upcoming review. You then jump into a call with internal stakeholders to align on a project deliverable, followed by a session with an external partner to understand how supply chain processes work on the ground. After lunch you meet with your assigned mentor, who helps you connect the dots between your projects and the bigger picture of AWS's cloud computing infrastructure and global supply chain. The afternoon is heads-down time on one of your dedicated projects - maybe drafting a playbook, building out a knowledge base page, or redesigning an enablement module. Between project sprints, you are meeting with teams across different functions and geographies to learn how our end-to-end supply chain operates and how AWS services underpin it. You also have a regular check-in with your manager to review progress, remove blockers, and discuss your development goals. Most days end knowing you have contributed to something the team will use long after your internship ends - and that you understand a little more about how the cloud gets built.

About the team
AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) manages a continuously evolving portfolio of shipments through a worldwide supply chain. We deliver the right product at the right time, cost, and place - ensuring our AWS supply chain is reliable. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your contributions will have direct impact on operational efficiency and customer experience. Our team values builders who write things down, simplify complexity, and leave processes better than they found them.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

#auta-sg #auta-asean
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

#auta-sg #auta-asean

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in school for bachelor or above degree, graduating between Aug 2027 – Aug 2028
- Interest and background in business intelligence and data analytics
- Excellent business and communication skills, high attention to detail
- Candidates must be able to legally work in Singapore.
- Able to commit full-time internship.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building reports/visualizations via QuickSight
- Experience analyzing structured and unstructured data using SQL
- Experience in Excel as main presentation tool for data sets
- Comfort with ambiguity; ability to be flexible in a rapidly changing environment.
- Passion for experiencing new technologies, cultures, and locations around the world

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Graduate Shift Manager:in near Hamburg
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium vor dem Starttermin oder Abschluss innerhalb der letzten 24 Monate
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

- Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium vor dem Starttermin oder Abschluss innerhalb der letzten 24 Monate

- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
