title: Software Development Engineer II, Agentic WorkSpaces Client
descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

The mission of Agentic WorkSpaces is to enable AI agents to work the way people do. Across the industry, agents are becoming digital workers. Like every team member, they need identity, permissions, governance, and a trusted place to do their work. The Agentic WorkSpaces Client team builds the front door to that place: the client software people use to securely access and operate the desktop and web applications their businesses rely on, and the software AI agents will use to do the same.

We build the client software that runs on customer endpoints across major operating systems and browsers, and we own critical parts of the connection and user experience for Amazon WorkSpaces, a highly scaled system that delivers remote desktops and streamed applications to millions of end users every day. We are evolving that same client experience to carry agentic workloads, which require secure access, enterprise permissions, governance, observability, and human oversight. Learn more: https://aws.amazon.com/workspaces/

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design, build, and operate customer-facing capabilities across native and web clients, advancing the client that enterprise agents will work through while supporting a system that millions of people depend on today. Industry consensus points to a growing share of cloud desktop workloads becoming agentic in the coming years. We build the client software those desktops are reached through, which is exactly why the Agentic WorkSpaces Client team can lead that shift. Today, most of the team's work is building and running the clients our users rely on; the agentic share of the roadmap grows from there. Your work includes secure session connectivity, client lifecycle, cross-platform architecture, user experience, performance, software updates, operational telemetry, and integrations supporting human and agentic workflows. You will own features from design through production, collaborate with teams across AWS, solve complex issues in customer-managed environments, and maintain a high bar for security, reliability, and operational excellence.

Agentic WorkSpaces offers a combination most roles don't: the early build-out of agent infrastructure on the scale of a mature AWS service. You will not be starting from a blank page, and you will not be maintaining a system in stasis. You will shape the evolution of Amazon WorkSpaces by extending a proven system rather than rewriting it. The problems span operating systems, web technologies, networking, security, and distributed services, and your work will directly influence how people and AI agents securely interact with enterprise applications. We are passionate about our customers and love to solve their most critical problems. If you enjoy hard problems that span the client and the cloud, and want to work with a talented, inclusive team that prides itself on a great work environment, join us.

About the team
ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience leading large, fast-moving projects
- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
- Experience architecting, securing, and operating Amazon Web Services and client software

１）FC構内の安全管理・推進業務

・安全衛生委員会の運営管理（各種調整、資料・議事録作成）

安全保護具や熱中症対策などの備品購買とそれらの在庫の適正化管理。

descriptionHtml:

We have provided customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online pharmacy.

We are looking for a Pharmacy Technician to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they need to get and stay healthy! An active instate pharmacy technician license is required to be considered.

#everydaybetter

• Aid the distribution manager and distribution pharmacists with receiving, shipping, counting, and packing

• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists

401(k) Savings Plan with match

- Active and unrestricted in-state Board of Pharmacy License through the State Board of Pharmacy, if required by State Board of Pharmacy.

- Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and supervisor.
- Ability to read and understand English language labelling on product cartons and prescription labels.

- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member

title: Risk Manager III, REs-Q
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview: This position leads a specialized charter within Risk Mitigation, Escalation Reduction, and Quality Assurance (REs-Q), handling critical VP, SVP, and CEO-level Executive Escalations (EE) for Amazon's Fraud and Abuse Prevention (FnAP), Community Risk (CR), Perfect Order Experience (POE), and Muti-functional Escalations (MPE) vectors. Their team of 7 specialized Risk Managers manages 300+ high-priority cases annually, overseeing $1.1B in listings and serving 220,000 global customers, sellers, and brands. They are expected to maintain >99% accuracy in write-up resolutions within strict 80% 14-day and 21-day SLAs.

1. Problem Complexity: As the primary domain expert in complex fraud and abuse patterns, this role guides critical investigations that impact the entire organization. Leading cross-functional root cause analysis, the position handles EEs from virtually every business unit, working to maintain store trust and prevent business disruption. Past incidents have demonstrated how unresolved fraud cases can severely impact operations, often requiring direct executive intervention. The role's success depends on coordinating comprehensive responses across multiple teams - including Policy, Legal, Operations, Product, and Business units - to effectively combat emerging fraud patterns.

2. Scope and Impact: EEs represent one of the most intricate areas of risk management, requiring expert judgment to identify subtle abuse patterns and sophisticated fraud schemes. The manager ensures quality, while addressing emerging threats company-wide. Their strategic decisions directly impact Seller, Customer, and Brand Experience metrics, influencing Amazon's global risk management strategy.

3. Team & People Management: They lead both EEs and broader REs-Q strategy, providing hands-on mentorship to develop risk managers' technical and analytical capabilities through individualized career development plans. They drive operational planning through MBRs/QBRs, identify key investment areas, prioritize business impact, and negotiate resources with leadership. Monthly program reviews and consolidated reporting to L8-L10 leadership ensure team growth and operational excellence.

4. Execution & Process Improvement: The role drives 1–3-year strategic initiatives and continuous improvement through kaizens and best practice sharing. The manager develops team capabilities in automation while creating preventative mechanisms based on Root Cause Analysis. Resource allocation is optimized for cost-to-serve metrics and operational efficiency, with team members owning specific process improvements to reduce future escalations.

5. Communication: The manager presents strategic decisions through compelling narratives to L8-L10 leadership and coaches team members in executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing without authority. They guide the translation of complex technical findings into clear business impacts and mentor team members in developing investigation frameworks for global adoption, while managing sensitive communications during critical store escalations.

Amazon is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Minority / Female / Disability / Veteran / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation / Age.


Key job responsibilities



About the team
The REs-Q team is responsible for managing escalations related to suspected Selling Partner fraud and abuse on Amazon stores. As the centralized point for all internally-driven abuse-related issues, we operate through the internal-only abuse-escalations@ email alias. By leveraging front-line insights from Selling Partner escalations, we contribute unique perspectives to programs within the Selling Partner Services (SPS) organization.

The ideal candidate is passionate about ensuring customers can make informed purchase decisions and supporting brand owners and sellers in successfully listing and selling their products on Amazon. Your decisions will be crucial in protecting customers and sellers and maintaining the integrity of Amazon's catalog and product listings ecosystem.

title: Military Area Manager, Customer Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
This role focuses on those who have military experience interested in working in the private sector. Amazon’s military recruiting team is available to discuss the many opportunities within Amazon Operations.

At Amazon, thousands of former military are driving innovation and raising the bar on customer experience. On a daily basis, those with military backgrounds are able to apply their knowledge, skills, and leadership abilities in a wide variety of careers – influencing change across the globe.

Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimize productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardize shift practices


A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards), or experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
- Experience in managing and developing teams
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Experience in data analysis and extracting insights to make data-backed business decisions
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience leading large teams, with demonstrable ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in operations management

Preferred qualifications

- Work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

title: Installation Technician, Nights
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Global Engineering Strategy
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Global Engineering Strategy (GES) is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to drive programmatic execution across the GES organization. GES is a global team responsible for leading the engineering due diligence efforts for new and expanding regions, site master planning, and overall site design strategy, while maintaining the highest performance standards and utilizing innovation to reduce budgets and increase efficiency . The team operates at the intersection of data center engineering, real-estate, energy, water, pre-construction, procurement and product teams to ensure AWS can scale its global infrastructure.
This role will own the program mechanisms that enable GES to scale: tracking and reporting on goals and KPIs, driving the cadence of business reviews, managing deployment plans for new DC design transitions/intercepts, and ensuring alignment across regional teams. The Sr. Program Manager will be the connective tissue between strategy and execution, ensuring that what is agreed at leadership level is tracked, measured, and delivered.
Key Responsibilities
Program Governance and Execution
• Own the GES program cadence: MBRs, quarterly reviews, goal tracking, and leadership reporting
• Drive programmatic oversight and reporting of design intercepts and new template deployment
• Maintain the single source of truth for design project delivery status across all regions
• Develop and maintain tooling and databases for design attribute tracking
• Facilitate execution of design project strategy approvals
• Facilitate execution of design project strategy change approvals
• Maintain current design strategy pipeline and initiate trigger of hibernated project for GES Pre-DesignTrack and report on team KPIs including design efficiency metrics, schedule performance, and resource utilization
Stakeholder Coordination
• Coordinate across regional leads to ensure alignment on process, deliverables, and timelines
• Partner with stakeholders to manage cross-team dependencies
• Prepare materials and drive outcomes for leadership reviews with senior leadership
Process and Scaling
• Facilitate maintainance of the GES Runbook, the single point of truth for GES project delivery processes
• Drive process formalization as the team scales, transitioning from ad-hoc to established mechanisms and with consistency across global teams.
Portfolio Visibility
• Maintain a programmatic overview of design intercepts and deployment of new products across the global portfolio
• Provide leadership with clear visibility into pipeline status, resource constraints, and delivery risks


Travel will occasionally be necessary but shouldn’t be more than 25%. International support will be part of the job.

About the team
o Why AWS
o Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

o Diverse Experiences
o Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

o Work/Life Balance
o We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

o Inclusive Team Culture
o Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

o Mentorship and Career Growth
o We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: SDE II, Central Shopping Experience,IES - Shopping aids and Trust
descriptionHtml:
The IES Central Shopping Experience team builds products that make Amazon the most trusted shopping destination for hundreds of millions of customers across fast-growing marketplaces. We tackle a uniquely challenging problem earning the confidence of customers who are new to online shopping or navigating unfamiliar Amazon experiences.

We own three high-impact platforms. The Shopping Aids platform delivers contextual, intelligent tooltips, bottom sheets, sparkles that guide customers through their shopping journey from product discovery to checkout across surfaces. The Trust Widget is live across 12+ locales with 23+ trust markers (returns, payments, delivery, warranty, and more), directly influencing purchase decisions and driving hundreds of millions in annualized OPS impact. We also own Social Proofing, helping customers make confident decisions by surfacing real-time signals of what other shoppers are buying and trusting.

Our tech stack spans native mobile rendering libraries, backend Coral services, DynamoDB-backed data stores, Horizonte applications, and DataCraft analytics pipelines. We build for scale, reliability, and experimentation every feature is validated through rigorous A/B testing.

This is a team where your work is directly visible to customers, measurable in business impact, and technically challenging. If you want to solve real problems at the intersection of customer trust and large-scale distributed systems, we'd love to hear from you.

• Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.

• Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
• Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
• Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
• Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect | Architecte de solutions senior, Agentic WorkSpaces Canada
descriptionHtml:
Do you like helping customers implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems? Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing and AI technologies? Do you have a knack for helping groups understand application architectures and integration approaches? Do you have the consultative and leadership skills to help customers succeed with their cloud efforts? Are you passionate about cloud computing with a special focus on virtualized desktops, applications, document collaboration, and AI-powered, agentic end user computing experiences?

Amazon Web Services is looking for Solutions Architects to help establish AWS Agentic WorkSpaces (formerly known as Amazon End User Computing) as the market leader in end user computing. We are especially seeking SAs with a high level of AI fluency who are excited to help customers adopt the next generation of our portfolio, including Workspaces for Builders and Workspaces for Agents. We built AWS Agentic WorkSpaces services to give customers the agility to respond to the changing needs of their workforce. Customers can scale up or scale down on-demand, providing users with the resources they need, all without deploying and operating infrastructure.

This is a highly technical position for someone who can dive deep, build complex, AWS-optimized architectures, and help customers accelerate their adoption of AWS services and AI-powered, agentic workflows. Your broad responsibilities include owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects. You should be as comfortable discussing complex technical details with a room full of engineers as you are briefing an executive audience. In addition, you will engage with other AWS solutions architects, partner and professional services organizations to drive large and highly complex sales opportunities to closure.

The AWS Agentic WorkSpaces SA team is creating and migrating large scale and compelling workloads on AWS. You will be collaborating with and influencing technical teams requiring AWS expertise and in so doing will be making a significant impact on Amazon’s customers. Enjoy working with enterprise customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI-enabled solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
------------------------------------------------------
Aimez-vous aider les clients à mettre en œuvre des solutions novatrices d'infonuagique et à résoudre des problèmes techniques? Souhaitez-vous le faire au moyen des plus récentes technologies d'infonuagique et d'intelligence artificielle? Avez-vous le talent d'aider des groupes à comprendre les architectures d'applications et les approches d'intégration? Possédez-vous les compétences consultatives et en leadership nécessaires pour aider les clients à réussir leurs initiatives infonuagiques? L'infonuagique vous passionne-t-elle, tout particulièrement en ce qui concerne les postes de travail virtualisés, les applications, la collaboration documentaire et les expériences d'informatique utilisateur agentiques, alimentées par l'IA?

Amazon Web Services est à la recherche d'architectes de solutions pour aider à établir AWS Agentic WorkSpaces (anciennement connu sous le nom d'Amazon End User Computing) comme chef de file du marché de l'informatique utilisateur. Nous recherchons tout particulièrement des architectes de solutions dotés d'un haut niveau de maîtrise de l'IA et enthousiastes à l'idée d'aider les clients à adopter la nouvelle génération de notre gamme de produits, y compris Workspaces for Builders et Workspaces for Agents. Nous avons conçu les services AWS Agentic WorkSpaces afin de donner aux clients l'agilité nécessaire pour répondre aux besoins changeants de leur main-d'œuvre. Les clients peuvent augmenter ou réduire leur capacité à la demande, offrant ainsi aux utilisateurs les ressources dont ils ont besoin, le tout sans avoir à déployer ni à exploiter d'infrastructure.

Il s'agit d'un poste hautement technique destiné à une personne capable d'approfondir les sujets, de concevoir des architectures complexes et optimisées pour AWS, et d'aider les clients à accélérer l'adoption des services AWS ainsi que des flux de travail agentiques alimentés par l'IA. Vos responsabilités générales comprennent la prise en charge de l'engagement technique et de la réussite ultime liés à des projets de mise en œuvre précis. Vous devriez être aussi à l'aise de discuter de détails techniques complexes avec une salle remplie d'ingénieurs que de présenter de l'information à un auditoire de cadres. De plus, vous collaborerez avec d'autres architectes de solutions AWS ainsi qu'avec les organisations partenaires et de services professionnels afin de mener à terme des occasions de vente d'envergure et hautement complexes.

L'équipe des architectes de solutions AWS Agentic WorkSpaces crée et migre des charges de travail d'envergure et convaincantes sur AWS. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes techniques nécessitant une expertise AWS et les influencerez, exerçant ainsi une incidence considérable sur les clients d'Amazon. Appréciez le travail auprès des clients d'entreprise. Vous aurez la passion d'éduquer, de former, de concevoir et de bâtir des solutions infonuagiques et habilitées par l'IA pour un ensemble diversifié et stimulant de clients d'entreprise.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with customers to deploy Amazon Agentic WorkSpaces — Personal, Applications and Core — as well as Workspaces for Builders and Workspaces for Agents.
- Guide customers on designing and operating AI-powered, agentic end user computing experiences, helping them apply AI fluency to real-world builder and agent workflows.
- Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud.
- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS.
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community.
- Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers, blogs, and technical guides.
- Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates.
- Act as a technical liaison between customers, partners, service engineering teams and support.
-------------------------------------

- Guider les clients dans la conception et l'exploitation d'expériences d'informatique utilisateur agentiques et alimentées par l'IA, en les aidant à appliquer leur maîtrise de l'IA à des flux de travail concrets de créateurs et d'agents.
- Renseigner les clients sur la proposition de valeur d'AWS et participer à des discussions architecturales approfondies afin de garantir que les solutions sont conçues pour un déploiement réussi dans le nuage.

- Rédiger des publications destinées aux clients d'AWS, telles que des livres blancs, des blogues et des guides techniques, ou y contribuer d'une autre manière.
- Établir des relations solides avec les personnes techniques chevronnées au sein des entreprises clientes afin qu'elles puissent devenir des ambassadrices du nuage.
- Agir à titre d'agent de liaison technique entre les clients, les partenaires, les équipes d'ingénierie de service et le soutien.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 8+ years of hands-on experience with VDI and DaaS solutions — preferably Amazon WorkSpaces, AppStream 2.0, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, or VMware/Omnissa Horizon. You must demonstrate production-level depth: deployment architecture, image management, directory integration, networking, and operational troubleshooting.
- Demonstrated understanding of agentic AI patterns at Level 200+ depth: foundation model capabilities, prompt engineering principles, tool use/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and autonomous agent workflows.
- Experience serving enterprise or public sector customers in Canada, with demonstrated ability to navigate procurement, compliance, and regulatory requirements (GC Cloud, PBMM, PIPEDA, provincial privacy legislation).
- Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, PowerShell, or Node.js) for building integrations, automation, and proof-of-concept implementations.
- Willingness to travel up to 25% - 50% for on-site customer engagements across Canada.
- Bilingualism in French and English (oral and written communication) is required due to regular interactions with French-speaking stakeholders in Canada and within Amazon entities internationally.
- *************************
- Plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans des domaines technologiques spécifiques (par ex. développement logiciel, nuage informatique, génie système, infrastructure, sécurité, réseaux, données et analytique).
- Plus de 8 ans d'expérience pratique avec des solutions VDI et DaaS, de préférence Amazon WorkSpaces, AppStream 2.0, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops ou VMware/Omnissa Horizon. Vous devez démontrer une expertise approfondie en environnement de production : architecture de déploiement, gestion des images, intégration aux services d'annuaire, réseaux et résolution de problèmes opérationnels.
- Plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans la conception, la mise en œuvre ou le conseil concernant des applications et des infrastructures d'entreprise.
- Compréhension avérée des modèles d'IA « agentique » (niveau 200+) : capacités des modèles de fondation, principes d'ingénierie de requêtes (prompt engineering), utilisation d'outils/appel de fonctions, génération augmentée par récupération (RAG) et flux de travail d'agents autonomes.
- Expérience auprès de clients du secteur privé ou public au Canada, avec une capacité démontrée à gérer les processus d'approvisionnement ainsi que les exigences de conformité et de réglementation (GC Cloud, PBMM, LPRPDE, lois provinciales sur la protection de la vie privée).
- Maîtrise d'au moins un langage de programmation (Python, PowerShell ou Node.js) pour créer des intégrations, automatiser des tâches et mettre en œuvre des preuves de concept.
- Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels représentant 25 % à 50 % du temps afin d'intervenir sur place chez les clients à travers le Canada.
- La maîtrise du français et de l’anglais est requise en raison de la nature du poste qui exige des interactions avec d’autres entités d’Amazon à l’échelle mondiale et avec les employés et les parties prenantes d’Amazon dans d’autres provinces du Canada.

Preferred qualifications

- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
- Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock — model invocation, knowledge base configuration, guardrails, and agent creation.
- Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for standardized tool integration and/or Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication patterns for multi-agent orchestration.
- Experience designing agent evaluation harnesses: defining success metrics, building automated test suites, and conducting structured evaluations of LLM-powered systems against production workloads.
- Experience designing and architecting workload migrations from on-premises VDI to AWS (lift-and-shift and re-architecture patterns).
- Experience with regulated industries in Canada: federal government (GC Cloud framework), financial services (OSFI), healthcare (provincial health authorities), or telecommunications.
- Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases (OpenSearch, Kendra, Pinecone), and knowledge base configuration for production AI systems.
- Experience working with end-user computing or developer communities — delivering workshops, authoring technical content, or contributing to open-source projects.
- **************
- Expérience pratique d'Amazon Bedrock : invocation de modèles, configuration de bases de connaissances, mise en place de garde-fous (guardrails) et création d'agents.
- Connaissance du protocole MCP (Model Context Protocol) pour l'intégration standardisée d'outils et/ou des modèles de communication A2A (Agent-à-Agent) pour l'orchestration multi-agents.
- Expérience dans la conception de dispositifs d'évaluation d'agents : définition de mesures de réussite, création de suites de tests automatisés et réalisation d'évaluations structurées de systèmes basés sur des LLM face à des charges de travail réelles (production).
- Expérience dans la conception et l'architecture de migrations de charges de travail depuis des environnements VDI sur place vers AWS (modèles « lift-and-shift » et de réarchitecture).
- Expérience dans des secteurs réglementés au Canada : gouvernement fédéral (cadre GC Cloud), services financiers (BSIF), santé (autorités sanitaires provinciales) ou télécommunications.
- Expérience pratique de la génération augmentée par récupération (RAG), des bases de données vectorielles (OpenSearch, Kendra, Pinecone) et de la configuration de bases de connaissances pour des systèmes d'IA en production.
- Expérience de travail auprès de communautés d'utilisateurs finaux ou de développeurs : animation d'ateliers, rédaction de contenu technique ou contribution à des projets open source.
- Certification AWS Solutions Architect (niveau associé ou professionnel).

title: SATCOM Gov SysDev Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a System Development Engineer III at Amazon Leo Government, you will define satcom business operations data engineering and customer operational health that raise the bar across multiple teams. You will design and implement resilient, scalable systems while driving test automation and business process improvements that reduce complexity and harness Amazon AI tech to eliminate repetitive work. Your technical expertise will directly shape how teams build, operate systems that our customers and leadership depend on — and your strategic thinking will ensure those systems are ready for what comes next.

Key job responsibilities
- Design technology solutions and architectures that solve complex business and technical problems, decomposing difficult challenges into straightforward components that can be delivered incrementally by you and your teammates.
- Define and implement engineering best practices and operational excellence standards across teams, including leading architecture reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses.
- Identify and drive automation opportunities that reduce operational burden, lower costs, and improve system resiliency — building accessible, inclusive tooling and processes that multiple teams can adopt and extend.
- Partner with engineers, technical program managers, and team leaders to develop technical strategy, influence prioritization, and ensure your organization invests appropriately in sustainable operations and risk mitigation.
- Mentor and coach engineers across your organization, contributing to hiring, career development, and technical assessments while producing exemplary artifacts — code, documentation, runbooks, and dashboards — that set the standard for others.

Security Clearance: Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI, so you must be a U.S. citizen for consideration

A day in the life
You start by reviewing business operational metrics and customer onboarding dashboards to understand the health of your customer systems, then jump into a design review where you help a teammate simplify a proposed architecture. After lunch, you write code for an automation project that will eliminate a recurring class of operational issues across several teams. Later, you collaborate with partner teams to align on integration checkpoints for an upcoming launch, and close out the day by providing feedback on a colleague's runbook and mentoring a junior engineer on troubleshooting techniques.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer-centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in space based systems design and wireless systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale
- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
- Experience configuring, scripting, or integrating an enterprise ITSM/CRM platform such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, or Jira Service Management

title: Data Center Facilities Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

Key job responsibilities
Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical physical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers

Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians in all facets of their career

Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion

Coordinates daily with a multitude of third-party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs

Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures

Routinely operate as the after-hour on-call Data Center Facility Manager for the data centers in the region. This will include responding to any issues within the data centers and managing the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s)

A day in the life
We are seeking an energetic Data Center Facility Manager to serve as a technical resource and leader within Amazon data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. The Data Center Facility Manager will oversee operations and management of technicians responsible for routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switch gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc. They will assist in maintaining a high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 4+ years of work in a management position with 5 or more direct reports experience
- 5+ years of relevant work experience in a data center or other mission critical environment with knowledge in UPS, Generators, HVAC, Evaporators and other critical infrastructure OR 7+ years of Technical (Military/Trade School) training and/or experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of work in a management position with 5 or more direct reports experience
- Advanced electrical or mechanical certifications (Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant engineering discipline)
- 7+ years of experience working in a data center or other mission critical environment with an emphasis on building and equipment operation
- An excellent understanding of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAHU units
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, technical writing or business justifications (white paper experience)

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Prototyping Engineer to join our Prototyping and Integration (PI) Team. In this role, you will serve as the machine shop's principal technical authority on advanced prototype manufacturing—owning the most complex, highest-risk aerospace builds end-to-end and setting the machining strategy, standards, and processes that the entire lab operates by. You will drive CNC programming, setup, and production of the most challenging precision electro-mechanical components, define how difficult parts get made before anyone touches a machine, and partner with design and manufacturing engineering at the earliest stages to influence hardware design for manufacturability, cost, and schedule.

Beyond executing individual builds, you will shape the capability and direction of the prototyping function: establishing shop-wide processes and standards, mentoring and technically leading other machinists and prototyping engineers, and driving continuous improvement initiatives that scale throughput and reliability across the organization. You will be trusted to make independent technical judgment calls on ambiguous, first-of-their-kind parts, to balance competing program priorities across the shop, and to raise the bar on machining quality and velocity for the whole team. This role requires deep, expert-level hands-on CNC expertise, strong process and program ownership, sound engineering judgment under ambiguity, and the ability to lead through influence in a fast-paced development environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the most complex, highest-risk aerospace prototype builds end-to-end on multi-axis mills, lathes, and mill-turn equipment—and serve as the shop's escalation point for the parts no one else can make to print.
- Define the lab's advanced machining strategy—CAM approaches, fixturing philosophy, and process sequencing—and standardize it so the whole team can execute with quality and repeatability at scale.
- Partner with design engineering early in the design cycle to drive design-for-manufacturability and influence decisions before they are finalized.
- Set machining quality and throughput standards across the shop and lead continuous improvement initiatives, owning them to conclusion to measurably increase throughput and reduce cycle time.
- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to machinists and prototyping engineers, raising the capability of the team.
- Make independent technical judgment calls on ambiguous, first-of-their-kind parts, balancing risk, cost, quality, and schedule across multiple concurrent programs.
- Troubleshoot complex quality issues and drive corrective actions to root cause, building lasting process fixes rather than one-off corrections.

A day in the life
You'll spend much of your day at the machines cutting the most demanding aerospace prototypes—and serving as the person the team turns to when a part is too complex, tight, or novel to make any other way. Between builds, you'll review incoming designs for manufacturability, define shop standards, mentor other engineers, and drive improvement initiatives. When a test team is waiting on critical hardware, you'll make the call on how to deliver quickly without compromising quality, and own the outcome.

About the team
The Prototyping and Integration Team accelerates hardware development through rapid prototyping, manufacturing, and integration of novel Line Replaceable Units (LRUs) and systems for the Optical Intersatellite Link organization. Our service areas span Hardware Fabrication, Electrical Integration, Electromechanical Hardware Development, DVT and Qualification Testing, and Quality Assurance. Our learnings are directly applied to scale aerospace manufacturing processes and enable risk reduction through comprehensive testing. We seek candidates who thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments. Success requires high motivation, attention to detail, and the highest standards of execution.

- Expert-level knowledge of HyperMILL, ESPRIT, or equivalent CAM systems, including multi-axis (5-axis and mill-turn) programming of complex geometry
- Expert knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
- 4+ years overseeing continuous improvement initiatives by establishing processes and showing ownership over those areas to conclusion
- Must be able to visually inspect and distinguish fine detail in precision optical/mechanical components
- Must be able to frequently move lab equipment and materials weighing up to 40 pounds

Preferred qualifications

- Experience defining machining strategy and fixturing philosophy for first-of-their-kind or one-off prototype parts with no established process
- Expert experience using Siemens NX, or other CAD systems, including modifying models and designing fixtures/tooling

- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across engineering disciplines and to represent the prototyping function to leadership

title: Data Center Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities (optional but highly recommended)


Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.  Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.

Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders’ management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation and/or under construction data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Engineer, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who depend on you to deliver reliable, well integrated Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The problems you solve are technical: modifying controls logic to address operational issues, developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for firmware upgrades, or investigating complex alarm discrepancies across monitoring systems. For new builds, you own the controls scope from vendor submittal review through commissioning and turnover. You manage vendor relationships, budgets, and schedules for both service contracts and capital projects. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Manager, Controls Technicians you provide technical direction to, and partner teams (Construction, Critical Projects Implementation, Commissioning, DCEO).

title: Applied Scientist, Payments & Fraud Prevention, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building machine learning systems that protect one the world's largest cloud platform? The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention (P&FP) Science team is looking for a driven Applied Scientist to help safeguard AWS and its millions of customers from evolving fraud threats.

In this role, you will design, build, and deploy end-to-end machine learning models that detect and prevent fraudulent activity. You will work with massive, real-world datasets across the AWS payments, signup and usage ecosystem, develop new detection strategies, and take models from concept to production. You will also apply Generative AI (GenAI) techniques to enhance fraud signal discovery and strengthen our detection capabilities.

At AWS, we process billions of transactions every day for hundreds of thousands of businesses worldwide. Fraud patterns shift constantly and our defenses must stay ahead. If you enjoy owning problems end-to-end, shipping models that make real-time decisions at scale, and making a direct impact on customer trust and financial protection, we invite you to join us and help shape the future of fraud prevention at AWS.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and deploy end-to-end machine learning models and rules to detect, prevent, and mitigate fraudulent activities across the AWS payment and usage ecosystem.
Source, extract, and analyze large-scale behavioral, transactional, and historical datasets to uncover fraud patterns and emerging threats.
Apply hands-on expertise in statistical modeling, traditional machine learning, and analytics to identify and isolate issues across the fraud landscape.
Explore and apply GenAI techniques, including large language models (LLMs) and synthetic data generation, to enhance fraud detection capabilities.
Own the full model lifecycle — from data extraction and feature engineering through evaluation, productionalization, and deployment.
Continuously monitor model and rule performance and improve robustness against adversarial behaviors and evolving fraud tactics.
Experiment, prototype, and iterate on new detection strategies, algorithms, and evaluation metrics with a focus on rapid time-to-production.
Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
Communicate findings and technical insights clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.
Contribute to the broader fraud prevention strategy, driving innovation and best practices across the organization.

A day in the life
You will have the opportunity to enhance our existing models and develop new ones that have a direct impact on the business from reducing financial losses to protecting customer accounts in real time. You will own your models end-to-end, from sourcing data and building features through evaluation and productionalization, and you will be expected to move quickly as fraud threats evolve.

As part of this role, you will also support core fraud operations reviewing model outputs, tuning detection thresholds, and ensuring our mechanisms are performing as expected in production. This operational closeness to the data and to real fraud cases is what gives our scientists a unique edge: you will develop a deep, practical understanding of how fraud actually works, which directly sharpens the models and strategies you build. It is this combination of science and operational insight that makes our team's work so impactful.

Your role will also allow you to leverage your customer-obsession skills by thoughtfully considering the user experience and ensuring it is not adversely affected by the mechanisms you design. You will explore new techniques, including Generative AI, to stay ahead of increasingly sophisticated adversaries.

About the team
Our team plays a crucial role in safeguarding secure and profitable business operations. Our mission is to position AWS as the most cost-effective and user-friendly cloud service provider by protecting legitimate customer experiences from the financial, operational, and reputational impacts of fraudulent activities. We develop services that prevent, detect, contain, and mitigate the actions of fraudulent and malicious users. As part of an analytics-driven team, you will leverage large-scale data to inform business decisions, respond to fraud, and automate decision-making at scale.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: Principal Environmental Global Program Manager, AWS Environmental
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a talented and self-motivated Principal Environmental Technical Program Manager to serve as a senior individual contributor and a trusted part of the technical and business leadership of the organization. Reporting directly to the Director of AWS Environmental, this global Principal tackles intrinsically hard environmental problems, those that are complex, ambiguous, and undefined, with less existing structure and significant business risk, and delivers solutions with complete independence in partnership with teams across AWS.

This is a role for a seasoned environmental expert whose influence spans multiple organizations and who leads through expertise rather than positional authority. The Principal is an exemplary, hands-on practitioner who is technically deep, brings clarity to complexity, and has resounding impact by aligning teams toward coherent strategies. The Principal drives cross-functional alignment before decisions reach the field, resolves disagreements at the peer level rather than escalating them, and serves as the escalation point on the largest and most complex issues. Success is measured by the ability to move the hardest, cross-cutting problems to durable resolution across environmental media, regions, and partner teams.

Key job responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Influence. Serve as a recognized technical authority on the organization's hardest environmental problems, leading initiatives whose impact spans multiple organizations. Lead through influence rather than authority, aligning teams on coherent strategies so they deliver independently toward an integrated whole. Set the standard for technical excellence and share expertise across regions to raise the bar organization-wide. Mentor technical talent and program teams without direct-management responsibility.

Environmental Compliance. Serve as the deepest technical resource and escalation point for the most complex, ambiguous compliance challenges across media and regions. Define and influence regional and global environmental standards and policies, aligning teams on coherent approaches. Lead resolution of undefined, high-complexity compliance issues and analyze regulations across jurisdictions to anticipate requirements. Maintain expert command of global environmental regulations, standards, and Amazon policy.

Strategy & Program Management. Define environmental strategy where none exists and deliver with complete independence, owning large programs in new territory. Lead external initiatives such as advancing regulatory frameworks, contributing to advocacy, engaging regulators and communities, and designing assessment programs. Make organization-level trade-offs and implement durable mechanisms that reduce risk and increase efficiency. Define and track program-delivery and performance metrics, and work escalations to mitigate risk. Improve regulations by negotiating with regulators, and support community interactions.

A day in the life
The AWS Environmental team supports the full lifecycle of infrastructure development, beginning with site selection and due diligence and continuing through design, construction, and operations. No two days are the same in this role. Because this Principal works the hardest, most cross-cutting environmental problems, the work shifts with where the greatest risk and opportunity sit across the global portfolio. A typical week blends deep individual technical work with the cross-functional influence needed to move problems to durable resolution. On any given day, the Principal may move between diagnosing an ambiguous technical or compliance problem, pressure-testing a permitting or site-development strategy with a regional team, aligning partner organizations on a path forward, and advising senior leaders on risk and trade-offs.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

Within AWS Infrastructure Services, the AWS Environmental (Enviro) team enables the world's innovation by insisting on the highest standards of environmental performance to deliver capacity and reliably operate data center infrastructure. We manage environmental risk and regulatory compliance across the full data center lifecycle, from site selection through development, operations, and decommissioning, for all build types. Our work spans every environmental medium, including air, water, wetlands, threatened and endangered species, natural and cultural resources, noise, waste, hazardous materials, spill response, and contaminated land, across both the campuses we build and the water, power, and fiber infrastructure that supports them.

We are the team that secures and maintains AWS's license to operate. We accelerate capacity delivery by cultivating proactive relationships with regulatory authorities, streamlining permitting, and designing compliance programs and automation that reduce risk and manual effort at scale. We deliver the technical environmental expertise behind cleaner power and cooling technologies, navigate the most complex sites and jurisdictions, and partner across AWS to embed environmental requirements into how we plan, design, build, and operate. We are looking for talented people who bring curiosity and deep collaboration to solving hard problems.

For over 20 years, Amazon Web Services (AWS) has been the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud computing platform. What is cloud computing? Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of IT resources over the Internet.

Basic qualifications

- Experience delivering multi-media environmental due diligence, permitting, and compliance projects with specific expertise in CWA 404 and NPDES permitting, groundwater protection, wastewater discharge, and natural and cultural resource evaluations
- Bachelor's degree in environmental engineering, science, geology, or related discipline (or equivalent).
- 15+ years multi-media global environmental compliance with demonstrated depth.
- Proven record delivering high-priority projects on tight timelines with partners, consultants, counsel, and regulators.
- Strong data-driven problem-solving, decomposing complex problems into scalable solutions.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
- Advanced degree in environmental science, engineering, or related discipline, and/or professional certifications (e.g., PE, PG, CHMM).
- Data center or critical infrastructure due diligence, design, construction, and/or risk assessment experience strongly preferred.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Storage, AWS Hardware Engineering, Hardware Engineering Services
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

AWS operates the world’s largest fleet of storage servers powering exabyte-scale cloud storage services. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence so customers experience the highest quality of service.
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive end-to-end delivery of storage servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.


Key job responsibilities
RFP & ODM Selection:
Translate technical requirements into ODM evaluation criteria. Build scoring frameworks covering technical capability, manufacturing capacity, DFx maturity, automation capability, and commercial terms. Coordinate technical deep-dives between engineering and ODM design teams during competitive evaluation. Compile selection decision packages and drive decision meetings. Transition to NPI with requirements locked and statement of work signed.

NPI Program Delivery:
Facilitate requirements gathering with internal customers; develop Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs) covering server specs, rack configurations, PCIe topology, NVMe/SSD layout, power/cooling topology, and drive interconnects. Build program timelines with critical path analysis, risk identification, and milestone tracking. Own milestone-driven gate progression: manufacturing readiness, production readiness, operational readiness review, and general availability. Drive cross-functional dependencies across firmware, thermal, mechanical, and silicon teams. Communicate program status to leadership with clear reporting on milestone progress, risk posture, and mitigation plans.
Production Yield & Manufacturing Delivery
Own manufacturing readiness gates and production yield tracking from first build through volume ramp. Monitor first-pass yield by test stage, drive root cause analysis on excursions, and ensure corrective actions close before yield issues compound. Track ODM delivery cadence, line throughput, and supply chain continuity.

Fleet Operations & Feed-Forward:
Maintain fleet-level program visibility: AFR targets, unsellable resolution velocity, and component lifecycle risk. Own the feed-forward cadence — ensuring fleet failure patterns, manufacturing yield data, and vetting escapes translate into requirements and test content for next-generation programs.
Dashboards & Mechanisms
Build and own mechanisms for program visibility — defining metrics, dashboards, and review cadences that enable data-driven decisions and early risk detection. Define leading indicators: unsellable inflow/outflow rate, NPI milestone velocity, first-pass yield by test stage, and component lifecycle risk. Streamline delivery processes across teams; identify and eliminate dependencies, redundant gates, or coordination overhead that slow velocity.

Risk & Quality:
Challenge technical workstreams to surface risks early; quantify impact to schedule and reliability (annualized failure rate targets, availability SLAs) with proposed mitigations. Drive root cause analysis of fleet-wide hardware failures and ensure corrective actions flow back into qualification criteria and design requirements. Define acceptance criteria, coordinate qualification testing at server and rack levels, and manage go/no-go decisions for mission-critical storage services.
May require occasional (<10%) regional and international travel to Design and Manufacturing Partner sites.


A day in the life
You start the day syncing with ODM partners across time zones on build status and open engineering actions. Mid-morning, you run an engineering review connecting firmware, software, and hardware teams to unblock a qualification gate. In the afternoon, you lead the weekly feed-forward review — translating fleet failure patterns into test content requirements for the next-generation program. You end the day reviewing NPI milestone readiness and updating the production yield dashboard before the ODM delivery cadence call.

About the team
The Storage Server Hardware Engineering team designs and delivers the storage platforms that power Amazon S3, EBS, and other critical AWS storage services. We own our platforms cradle-to-grave: from architecture definition through NPI, manufacturing, fleet deployment, and end-of-life. Our sustaining engineers are the backbone of fleet reliability — ensuring that deployed platforms continue to meet quality and performance targets throughout their operational life.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline or equivalent
- 6+ years of technical product or program management experience, working directly with multiple engineering teams.
- 6+ years of experience driving hardware development programs (servers, racks, networking, or storage) through full product lifecycle including design, validation, manufacturing, and fleet deployment
- Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams, building processes, and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience coordinating complex server programs with ODM/JDM partners across multiple geographies, managing design reviews, manufacturing readiness gates, and quality checkpoints
- 5+ years of experience working with storage server platforms or NVMe/SSD infrastructure across NPI qualification phases (EVT, DVT, PVT)
- Experience driving root cause analysis and corrective action processes for hardware reliability issues at fleet scale
- Knowledge of server hardware development lifecycle: electrical/mechanical design, firmware, thermal/power validation, and manufacturing testing.
- Experience driving zero-touch automation or fleet health programs for large-scale infrastructure
- Experience communicating engineering trade-offs and technical risks in business terms to leadership.
