title: 5G NTN Payload Verification Architect, Payload Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite constellation initiative designed to bring fast, affordable broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. We are building a next-generation satellite system from the ground up — designing everything from the spacecraft and payload to the ground infrastructure and customer terminals. This is a rare opportunity to join a team that is shaping the future of global connectivity at scale.

We are looking for a 5G NTN Payload Verification Architect to join the Payload Architecture team in San Diego. You will own the D2D phased array verification strategy — the only role in the industry that bridges 5G NTN conformance verification with space-grade phased array qualification in a single position. You will work with the D2D Phased Array Architect to define what to verify, own the verification strategy tracing requirements through test plans, and work with teams across the program to build and execute those plans.

This role carries a dual-domain mandate. On the 5G NTN conformance side, you will own 5G NTN conformance verification adapted for satellite operations. On the phased array space qualification side, you will own the cascaded test hierarchy from component through system-level testing — including conducted characterization, panel RF and communication system performance, and OTA near-field scanning — as well as the full aerospace qualification campaign including thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, and radiation qualification per applicable space standards.

The role also owns terrestrial coexistence blocker testing for cellular band sharing, EPFD compliance boundary definition, production ATE design for constellation-scale manufacturing, D2D customer link verification to unmodified handsets, and on-orbit anomaly resolution. You will collaborate with the Vehicle and LRU integration and verification teams, Communication system, Regulatory, Silicon, Payload Architecture, Power Architecture, Thermal Design, Phased Array Calibration, Antenna Design, and Phased Array DSP & Digital Beamforming Architect.

This is a hands-on role — you will be in the lab, in the data, and on call when satellites are live. If you have experience with 3GPP conformance testing, phased array verification, or space-grade qualification, we want to hear from you.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Work with the D2D Phased Array Architect to define what needs to be verified, how, and what constitutes pass or fail across the full test hierarchy
• Own the D2D verification strategy tracing from payload requirements through subsystem and component-level test plans
• Work with systems, HW design, antenna, silicon, and calibration teams to build verification plans covering the full operating envelope
• Define RF and communications system test methodology — transmit quality, receive sensitivity, spurious emissions, blocker rejection, and regulatory compliance
• Own 5G NTN conformance verification strategy adapted for satellite operations
• Define the conducted-to-OTA test cascade from component through system-level testing
• Own aerospace qualification campaigns: thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, and radiation per applicable space standards
• Define terrestrial coexistence verification and EPFD compliance boundary definition
• Design production ATE infrastructure for constellation-scale manufacturing
• Support D2D customer link verification and on-orbit commissioning including launch health checks and beam validation
• Lead on-orbit anomaly resolution and fault isolation across digital, RF, and antenna domains
• Evaluate emerging test technologies for future generations — hands-on, on-call


A day in the life
A typical day starts with a check-in with the D2D Phased Array Architect — reviewing verification strategy, resolving open requirements, or updating test plans to reflect new architecture decisions. You might spend the morning reviewing NTN conformance test plans, then move to the lab to run RF measurements on a phased array panel. Afternoons often involve analyzing qualification data, optimizing a production ATE sequence for throughput, or supporting an on-orbit anomaly investigation by correlating telemetry with pre-launch test data. Every week looks a little different — but the work is always hands-on and consequential.

About the team
The Payload Architecture team is part of the Antenna organization at Amazon Leo. We are a small group of senior architects responsible for the phased array architecture across Amazon Leo’s satellite programs. We define the architecture, drive requirements, run trade studies, and make sure everything works from prototype through orbit. Our scope extends to customer link performance — working with systems and customer terminal teams to close end-to-end link budgets. We work closely with every engineering team on the payload and pride ourselves on being hands-on problem solvers.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- 7+ years of verification, preferably in communication systems experience
- Experience with RF measurement equipment, including: power meters, spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators, network analyzers, oscilloscopes
- Experience in communication theory, OFDM, MIMO, Digital/Wireless Communication Systems or RF engineering
- 5+ years of RF and Network test equipment associated with SATCOM communications experience
- Experience in test setup automation using MATLAB, Python, or Pearl
- 5+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Experience in 3GPP conformance testing or wireless system validation for cellular or satellite (NTN) networks
- Experience with phased array or antenna system testing, including conducted or over-the-air characterization

Preferred qualifications

- PhD in electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics
- Experience with space-grade qualification testing including thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, or radiation testing per applicable aerospace standards
- Experience bridging both telecom and aerospace domains — combining 3GPP standards fluency with satellite payload hardware qualification experience
- Experience with satellite-specific adaptations to wireless standards, including non-terrestrial network verification challenges
- Experience with OTA test system design for phased arrays or antenna systems, including near-field scanning or compact range test infrastructure
- Experience with production test infrastructure or ATE design for high-volume manufacturing of satellite or wireless hardware

title: Sr. Sourcing Manager, Manufacturing Capital Equipment, CNC Machining
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an exceptional Sourcing Manager to own the machine tools that will produce the highest cost content in our product.

Precision machining is the established process for our actuator components and gears, and the equipment you select sets cycle time, machine count and cost per part at volume. Multi axis machining centers, turning, grinding, gear cutting and finishing, EDM and metrology, along with the automation and work holding around them. You will commit long lead equipment ahead of production need and work directly with process engineering on capability requirements at tolerances and hardness levels that leave very little margin.

This is a builder role in a zero to one manufacturing environment. There is no incumbent equipment base and no established supplier list. You will build both, and what you specify will still be running when we are producing at a rate no program has reached.

Key job responsibilities
- Machining Equipment Sourcing: Own end-to-end capital equipment sourcing, including supplier identification, market analysis, RFQ/RFP execution, total cost of ownership modeling, and award decisions across multi-axis CNC machining centers, turning centers, grinding, gear cutting and finishing, EDM, deburring and cleaning, metrology, and the automation and work-holding supporting them. Develop and implement sourcing approaches that optimize cost efficiency while advancing technical capabilities. Build machine-rate and cycle-time models that translate equipment selection into cost per part at volume.
- Contract Negotiations: Lead complex negotiations with OEMs, equipment manufacturers, integrators and service providers, structuring commercial agreements covering pricing, payment terms, warranties, acceptance criteria, run-at-rate and capability protocols, SLAs, and long-lead-time components, and managing the full contract lifecycle including amendments, renewals, and dispute resolution.
- Long-Lead Commitment and Schedule Risk: Own the machining equipment commitment calendar against factory move-in and start-of-production dates. Flag items where lead time exceeds available schedule and drive mitigation through slot reservations, phased releases or alternate suppliers.
- Process and Tooling Partnership: Work with Manufacturing and Process Engineering on machine capability requirements, including tolerance, concentricity, surface finish and hardness. Support cutting tool, fixture and work-holding strategy as part of total cost.
- Procurement Frameworks: Develop sourcing frameworks, standard operating procedures, and operating mechanisms that scale with the organization, supporting and mentoring sourcing managers and buyers through technical guidance.
- Supplier Performance Management: Establish and manage supplier performance programs, including scorecards, SLAs, and regular business reviews. Identify and mitigate supply chain risks through dual-sourcing strategies, should-cost models, and contingency planning. Assess supplier capability to build, install and commission at rate, not only to quote.
- Budget Management: Manage capital budgets with cost controls, variance tracking, and change management governance. Support material planning, inventory strategy, and spare parts availability. Drive cost optimization initiatives with demonstrated results.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Align equipment procurement timelines with site milestones and schedules in close partnership with cross-functional teams across the organization. Serve as a procurement subject matter expert in cross-functional planning forums. Influence leadership on strategic direction and investment decisions related to the supply chain.

About the team
Amazon is building the next generation of robotics technology, and this role is key to our vision. Our Supply Chain team is responsible for standing up and scaling the procurement, sourcing, and supplier management functions. We are a small, high-impact team solving complex problems at the intersection of technology and production, and we are looking for builders who want to shape something from the ground up.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- 6+ years of experience in supply chain management, strategic sourcing, or procurement in manufacturing, industrial automation, or similar technical environment
- Experience managing capital equipment procurement programs and vendor portfolios for complex environments, including equipment, automation, and tooling
- Experience leading contract negotiations with OEMs, equipment manufacturers, or construction contractors for agreements of significant value
- Experience developing sourcing strategies, procurement frameworks, or standard operating procedures
- Experience sourcing machine tools, precision metalworking equipment or related production automation

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Experience in automotive, aerospace, medical device, automation, semiconductors, high-tech, or similar industries
- Direct sourcing experience with machine tool OEMs
- Working knowledge of machining processes and capability, including multi-axis milling, turning, grinding, gear hobbing and grinding, hard turning, and EDM
- Familiarity with machine capability and acceptance testing, including FAT, SAT, Cmk and Cpk studies, ballbar and laser calibration, and run-at-rate
- Understanding of cycle time, machine utilization and cost-per-part modeling, and how equipment selection drives machine count at volume
- Experience with cutting tool, fixture and work-holding sourcing as part of total cost of ownership

- Six Sigma, Lean, or other continuous improvement certifications

title: On Site Medical Representative, OMR
descriptionHtml:
El Representante Médico en Sitio (OMR, por sus siglas en inglés) es el profesional de salud responsable de la atención médica de primer contacto en el Centro de Distribución o Estación de Entrega. Su función principal es atender lesiones y malestares de los asociados mediante primeros auxilios, identificar de forma proactiva riesgos ergonómicos y de seguridad en las tareas operativas, y contribuir a la implementación del programa de bienestar del sitio.
#AmazonMexico


Key job responsibilities
• Realizar la clasificación inicial (triaje) de asociados que se presenten con lesiones o malestares, brindar primeros auxilios y, cuando sea necesario, canalizarlos a un proveedor médico externo.
• Documentar y mantener actualizados todos los registros de atención médica proporcionada a los asociados.
• Administrar los botiquines de primeros auxilios: llevar el control de inventario, reabastecer insumos y asegurar que el equipo utilizado esté limpio y en condiciones de uso.
• Capacitar a gerentes y asociados en temas de prevención, primeros auxilios y protocolos de emergencia.
• Elaborar y entregar bitácoras diarias de actividad al equipo de liderazgo del sitio.
• Generar un análisis mensual de todos los incidentes de salud y seguridad ocurridos en el sitio.
• Asistir y participar de forma constante en las reuniones de inicio de turno ("stand-up").
• Rotar turnos según las necesidades operativas del sitio. Este puesto es presencial y no admite trabajo remoto.


A day in the life
Reportarás directamente al Gerente de WHS (Seguridad, Salud y Bienestar en el Trabajo). Serás el representante médico asignado a un sitio específico, donde administrarás la sala de AmCare: atenderás casos de prevención de salud ocupacional y emergencias médicas, gestionarás el inventario y la adquisición de insumos médicos, e inspeccionarás periódicamente el equipo de emergencia (DEA, camillas, botiquines). Serás responsable de mantener la confidencialidad de la información médica de los asociados y de garantizar el acceso controlado a la sala de AmCare.

En Amazon abrazamos nuestras diferencias y estamos comprometidos con seguir fortaleciendo nuestra cultura de inclusión. Ofrecemos experiencias de aprendizaje anuales y continuas. title: Sr. Risk Mgr, Intake Litigation SME, Amazon Flex, Service Level Standards
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Flex works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With Amazon Flex, individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. Amazon Flex is powered by a mobile app that works in concert with our advanced logistics systems that allows delivery partners to on-board, schedule delivery times, guide them through their deliveries with in-app mapping and navigation, and more.

Amazon Flex's Service Level Standards (SLS) team is seeking a Litigation Risk Manager to join our Critical Operations function. Our team ensures that enforcement actions taken against delivery partners are fair, defensible, and well-documented — and when those decisions are contested through legal channels, we investigate thoroughly.

As a Litigation Risk Manager, you will play a crucial role in managing legal disputes arising from delivery partner enforcement actions. You'll be responsible for conducting in-depth investigations into contested offboarding decisions, developing disposition recommendations for legal proceedings, and serving as a subject matter witness when required. This role offers the opportunity to work with cross-functional teams - including legal, outside counsel, enforcement program owners, and regulatory stakeholders - while directly contributing to the protection and compliance of Amazon's last-mile delivery operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct end-to-end deep-dive investigations into contested delivery partner enforcement actions, determining whether offboarding decisions adhered to established policies and procedures
- Develop and deliver well-reasoned disposition recommendations for active litigation and arbitration matters
- Serve as a subject matter witness in arbitration hearings, tribunal proceedings, and regulatory inquiries - articulating the company's enforcement rationale clearly and accurately
- Partner closely with internal legal teams and outside counsel to align on case strategy, timelines, and desired outcomes
- Monitor and manage caseload with competing priorities, jurisdictional deadlines, and strict SLAs
- Identify emerging litigation trends, recurring claim patterns, and systemic risks across jurisdictions
- Provide closed-loop feedback to enforcement program owners to proactively address root causes of disputes
- Identify opportunities for workflow efficiency improvements and contribute to process optimization
- Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure responses are accurate, comprehensive, and delivered on time

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

descriptionHtml:

title: Onsite Medical Representative, Workplace Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
El Representante Médico en Sitio (OMR, por sus siglas en inglés) es el profesional de salud responsable de la atención médica de primer contacto en el Centro de Distribución o Estación de Entrega. Su función principal es atender lesiones y malestares de los asociados mediante primeros auxilios, identificar de forma proactiva riesgos ergonómicos y de seguridad en las tareas operativas, y contribuir a la implementación del programa de bienestar del sitio.
#AmazonMexico


Key job responsibilities
• Realizar la clasificación inicial (triaje) de asociados que se presenten con lesiones o malestares, brindar primeros auxilios y, cuando sea necesario, canalizarlos a un proveedor médico externo.
• Documentar y mantener actualizados todos los registros de atención médica proporcionada a los asociados.
• Administrar los botiquines de primeros auxilios: llevar el control de inventario, reabastecer insumos y asegurar que el equipo utilizado esté limpio y en condiciones de uso.
• Capacitar a gerentes y asociados en temas de prevención, primeros auxilios y protocolos de emergencia.
• Elaborar y entregar bitácoras diarias de actividad al equipo de liderazgo del sitio.
• Generar un análisis mensual de todos los incidentes de salud y seguridad ocurridos en el sitio.

• Rotar turnos según las necesidades operativas del sitio. Este puesto es presencial y no admite trabajo remoto.

Reportarás directamente al Gerente de WHS (Seguridad, Salud y Bienestar en el Trabajo). title: Sr. Finance Manager, Amazon Leo Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced low Earth orbit satellite network, delivering fast, affordable broadband to enterprise and consumer customers globally. This is one of the most ambitious infrastructure programs in Amazon's history — combining satellite manufacturing, silicon development, global supply chain, terrestrial infrastructure, and enterprise technology at unprecedented scale. Leo Infrastructure Finance is at the center of it all.

The successful candidate will have effective analytical and communication skills, with an ability to build and articulate financial results and analytical insights to executive level business and finance leaders. You will be entrepreneurial by nature as Leo has a start-up mentality, analytical in approach, have a demonstrated ability to develop financial models that provide intelligence for business decisions and be able to leverage your project management skills to lead simultaneous workstreams. This role requires a self-starter with superb business partnering skills, a keen attention to detail, ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of ambiguity, and a track record of deep financial analysis. The candidate must have the aptitude to incorporate new approaches and methodologies (including statistical concepts) while dealing with big data, be able to develop and define key business questions and to build data sets that answer those questions.

This role leads the financial architecture, cost accounting, and controllership functions for Amazon Leo's satellite manufacturing operations. The Senior Finance Manager serves as the principal finance partner to manufacturing site leadership, building financial processes, systems, and governance structures in a complex, multi-site production environment. This is an opportunity to build rather than inherit—designing the controllership framework that will scale with production ramp and site expansion.


Key job responsibilities
Controllership:
The Senior Finance Manager manages the income statement and balance sheet of the manufacturing business, monitoring and tracking, cost accruals, tangible assets, monthly close, and all items with material impact on business KPIs. The role monitors free cash flow including working capital drivers and other assets and liabilities. This leader supports adherence to Amazon's financial internal controls through regular monitoring and auditing, drives culture change in developing awareness of how internal controls impact business practices, and ensures compliance with documented financial directives including support of annual internal controls assessment campaigns.

Cost Accounting & Inventory Management:
This leader owns component-to-finished-good cost accounting across complex product structures, from raw component through final satellite assembly, integration, and testing. Responsibilities include managing production variance analysis across high-mix, volume components and standardized platforms, establishing inventory valuation methods for long-lead components, sub-assemblies, and high-value work-in-progress, and leading the financial governance of engineering change orders and their impact on material costs. The role develops and maintains engineered standards, work measurement systems, labor performance metrics, learning curve analysis, and cost estimating methodologies that drive manufacturing cost accountability from the program level down to individual work centers.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management:
This role creates and executes the Annual Operating Plans and quarterly forecasts in accordance with corporate schedules and governance. The Senior Finance Manager delivers meaningful variance analysis for monthly and quarterly business reviews, providing a coherent business narrative that drives corrective actions. Responsibilities include developing manufacturing cost center budgets, labor forecasts, and program support estimates. The role builds cost and performance management systems measuring labor utilization, manufacturing efficiency/yield, budget performance, cost performance, schedule performance, forecast accuracy, and resource utilization—creating the reporting framework that ensures transparency between operational execution and financial outcomes.

Strategic Partnership & Operational Decision-Making:
The Senior Finance Manager serves as the primary financial advisor to the site operations leadership team, providing strategic guidance on cost management, capital investments, and operational efficiencies. This includes analyzing results, explaining business trends, and recommending improvements. The role partners with plant managers, supply chain leaders, and business on capital investment analysis, productivity initiatives, cost reduction programs, and manufacturing process improvements. The leader provides clear and accurate financial guidance to leaders both on-site and across the broader organization, enabling optimal business decisions at every level.

Capital Planning & Investment Governance:
The role evaluates and prioritizes capital investment opportunities in manufacturing facilities and equipment, leading financial due diligence for new projects and ensuring alignment with ROI and payback criteria. This includes financial oversight and capital expenditure tracking, monitoring adherence to approved budgets, and supporting productivity initiatives that drive return on invested capital across the manufacturing footprint.

New Factory Financial Architecture & Launch Strategy:
The Senior Finance Manager develops the complete financial architecture for the manufacturing site, including labor-routing models, overhead absorption structures, and rate frameworks from inception. This includes modeling production ramp-up phases to analyze capacity constraints, cash flow implications, and break-even timelines. The role evaluates capital expenditure for automated assembly, cleanroom infrastructure, and advanced testing systems, partnering with engineering and supply chain teams to establish target costing and make-versus-buy frameworks that optimize the cost structure across satellite platforms.

ERP & Systems Leadership:
The Senior Finance Manager serves as the principal finance stakeholder for enterprise ERP and Manufacturing Execution System implementation. This includes designing the Chart of Accounts, cost centers, and work breakdown structures that form the digital financial backbone. The role automates inventory tracking, standard cost rollups, and material issuance within the manufacturing execution thread, and builds real-time financial dashboards and operational reporting tools that translate complex factory data into actionable business intelligence for site leadership.

Team Leadership & Development:
The Senior Finance Manager mentors and develops team members, fostering a continuous improvement environment. The role trains and supervises staff, interacts with peers to share ideas and develop best practices across the organization, and leads change management initiatives to improve site-level accounting, analysis, and financial decision-making capability.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of positions that require analysis and reporting financial results experience
- 5+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- 10+ years of spearheading strategic cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable financial results and advance organizational objectives experience
- 10+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of hiring, leading and developing teams experience
- 8+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- 8+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- MBA, or CPA

title: Regional Learning Manager BRCF, LATAM ACES Learning
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Regional Learning Manager to own the Learning & Development (L&D) strategy across Amazon's Brazil sites. In this role you lead the programs and the teams that build the capability of our associates, trainers, and operations leaders, and you turn operational problems into learning solutions that improve site performance in ways you can measure.

You set the L&D strategy for the region and lead the teams that deliver it. You define the metrics, design the long-term roadmap, and decide which programs move forward and in what order, starting from the operational problems the business needs to solve. You manage a team of learning professionals, including individual contributors and, where applicable, other managers across multiple sites. You are accountable for hiring, onboarding, calibration, and performance management within the region.

You will not do this alone. You are part of a broader LATAM L&D organization. You share best practices, co-develop cross-market programs, and calibrate standards across the region. You represent Brazil L&D to senior leadership, present decisions and results to leaders several levels above you, and influence stakeholders across Operations, Safety, HR, and Process Engineering.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and execute the L&D strategy for Brazil sites within the broader LATAM framework, and define the long-term vision and roadmap.
- Define and track the metrics that measure team progress, the associate learning experience, training effectiveness, and impact on operational results, including Level 3 and Level 4 learning-transfer measures.
- Turn operational problems into scalable learning solutions, and partner with site and regional leadership to prioritize what moves forward.
- Lead and develop a multi-site team of learning managers, trainers, and specialists. Hire strong talent, run onboarding and calibration, and manage both high and low performance.
- Manage launch readiness for Learning at new sites and processes, and run delivery-quality audits with the corrective actions that follow.
- Build reporting that shows the effectiveness of training and supports process improvement and business reviews (WBR, MBR, QBR).
- Partner with the Mexico-based LATAM L&D team to share best practices, align standards, and co-lead cross-market work.
- Coach and influence operations leaders at every level on their role in developing their people.
- Present decisions and results clearly, in writing and in person, to leadership up to three levels above.

A day in the life
A typical day includes reviewing learning and operational metrics, leading business reviews, and meeting with site leadership to drive improvements across Brazil sites. You coach your managers and trainers, audit training quality, and keep onboarding and trainer programs consistent across locations. Regular touchpoints with your LATAM colleagues in Mexico keep the work aligned across the region. The role involves travel between sites, and you will spend a good part of your time problem-solving with stakeholders to connect learning to performance.

About the team
You will join the ACES Learning team inside a broader LATAM L&D organization. We develop talent and drive operational excellence across our sites. We work together every day across Brazil and Mexico, share what works, and back each other's success.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience managing people including development, hiring, performance management, and leading teams dispersed across various regions
- Experience with Learning & Development and course facilitation or an equivalent professional qualification, or experience focused on Adult Learning Theory, including 1) virtual training facilitation and dealing with remote teams, and 2) delivering Soft Skills, Technology Skills and/or Technical or other Systems training
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- Experience defining and implementing process-improvement initiatives using data and metrics.
- Professional fluency in Portuguese and English, spoken and written.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading L&D strategy across sites or regions.
- Experience with Learning Management Systems and learning analytics.
- Experience working across cultures and with distributed teams in more than one country.
- Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and adapting quickly to changing priorities and processes.
- Ability to influence leaders at every level to own their role in developing their people.
- L&D certifications and/or an MBA.
- Familiarity with common AI tools and how to apply them to learning.

Combinando análise de dados em tempo real, modelos de machine learning e automação baseada em sinais, a STCO otimiza a capacidade de entrega diariamente.

Key job responsibilities

• Identificar e mitigar os riscos de entrega antes que eles se tornem obstáculos;
• Por meio do uso correto dos sistemas e da interpretação dos dados, garanta que os cronogramas críticos de entrega sejam atendidos, que as necessidades de recursos sejam compreendidas e que as prioridades diárias de trabalho sejam visíveis para a gerência sênior;
• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as demais equipes de TE para identificar as causas principais e resolver problemas complexos relacionados à melhoria da entrega, operação do sistema e aprendizado de máquina;

• Participar da calibração de parâmetros operacionais para o contexto brasileiro;

O analista de risco de STCO atuará como executor operacional do time, sendo responsável pelas análises e ajustes de risco das rotas em duas estratégias de risco: proativo e reativo. Esta é uma posição com alto grau de ambiguidade, pois estamos lançando processos novos adaptados ao contexto operacional brasileiro. O analista será peça fundamental na calibração de parâmetros, identificação de gaps e retroalimentação do time com insights de campo.

title: Software Development Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s Deployment Safety team and build the intelligent systems that keep our most critical cloud infrastructure running flawlessly. As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll use AI and automation to design, test, and deploy updates for EC2 Frontier with precision and scale. You’ll own every stage of the development lifecycle—from crafting AI-enhanced deployment pipelines that predict risks to creating automated testing tools that catch defects before they reach production. By integrating machine learning models to analyze deployment data and real-time monitoring to flag anomalies, you’ll help millions of Amazon customers rely on infrastructure that’s safer, faster, and more resilient.

This role is for collaborative engineers who thrive on solving ambiguous problems, mentoring peers, and turning cutting-edge AI concepts into practical, high-impact solutions. If you’re passionate about blending cloud-native engineering with intelligent automation, we want to hear from you.

#AI #MachineLearning #DeploymentSafety #Cloud #Frontier

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software features across the full development lifecycle, including working backwards from customer needs, architecting solutions, writing production-ready code, testing, deploying, and operating services at scale.
- Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, while continuously improving system reliability, performance, and maintainability for your team's software.
- Mentor and coach other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, helping raise the overall quality bar of the team's output.
- Evaluate technical tradeoffs between competing approaches, balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term architectural goals, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure solutions align with business and customer priorities.
- Write clear documentation for the software you build — covering design decisions, operational runbooks, and system architecture — so that others can maintain and extend it effectively.

A day in the life
Your morning begins with a collaborative code review—leveraging AI-assisted tools to provide feedback that elevates the team’s code quality and readiness for deployment. After a focused standup where you align on AI-driven metrics and automation priorities, you dive into building a feature you scoped last week: writing clean, scalable code to integrate a machine learning model that predicts deployment risks. You pair with a teammate to tackle a tricky integration point, using real-time debugging tools to ensure seamless automation.

Post-lunch, you join a design review where you help streamline an architecture proposal—applying AI-first principles to simplify complexity and boost efficiency. Then, you investigate an operational metric that’s flagged by your anomaly detection system, tracing it to a root cause using ML-powered correlation engines. Within hours, you’ve drafted a fix that not only resolves the issue but also enhances your predictive safety models.

Your day balances deep, heads-down coding on cloud-native features with cross-functional problem-solving—all while driving operational excellence and mentoring peers. Every task you tackle reinforces our mission: building smarter, safer systems that millions of Amazon customers rely on daily.

About the team
Our team builds software that millions of Amazon customers and internal partners depend on daily. We combine operational excellence with AI-driven insights and automation-first practices to deliver reliable, high-quality systems. Every engineer’s voice matters here—we thrive on clear thinking, open collaboration, and a shared commitment to learning from both successes and challenges. As we scale EC2 Frontier to serve even more users, we’re focused on elevating the customer experience and empowering our team with cutting-edge tools, from AI-enhanced deployment pipelines to real-time monitoring frameworks.

- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

title: Technical Program Manager III, Data Center Engineering -  AI & Design Technologies
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Data Center Engineering - AI & Design Technologies team is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered design automation programs for AWS's global data center infrastructure. In this role, you will own complex, cross-functional programs that bring generative AI capabilities to architects, engineers, construction managers, and facility operators, transforming how data center design documentation is created, validated, and delivered at scale.

You will work at the intersection of Building Information Modeling (BIM), generative AI, and cloud-based platforms, partnering with product managers, software engineers, applied scientists, and Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Ownership (AECO) domain experts to plan, execute, and launch programs that accelerate facility design workflows. You will translate ambiguous business and technical requirements into structured execution plans, drive cross-organizational alignment, and ensure AI-powered features maintain the high trust bar that engineering professionals demand. The ideal candidate combines deep technical program management expertise with the ability to navigate ambiguity, thrives in fast-paced environments, and is passionate about applying AI to real-world engineering challenges at unprecedented scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and deliver ambiguous, large-scale programs spanning multiple organizations and technology domains — defining mission, objectives, and measurable success criteria while driving alignment across business and engineering stakeholders throughout the end-to-end program lifecycle
- Analyze system architectures and engineering organizational structures to identify dependencies, risks, and opportunities, partnering with engineering leaders to ensure solutions scale effectively and meet both functional and non-functional requirements
- Drive clarity and crisp decision-making in highly ambiguous environments — providing context on business and technology trade-offs, questioning assumptions, and prioritizing work that delivers the highest customer value, even when the business strategy, architectural approach, or problem definition may not yet exist
- Translate complex AECO workflows and customer needs into clear technical requirements and implementation plans, partnering with product managers to inform and execute the product and technical roadmap
- Influence and advise VP-level leadership across data center engineering organization on technical investment decisions, organizational alignment, and long-term platform strategy — translating technical complexity into actionable insights that inform resource allocation and strategic direction
- Establish metrics, dashboards, and regular reporting mechanisms to provide stakeholders and senior leadership clear insight into program health, delivery timelines, and business impact
- Force-multiply across the TPM community by proactively identifying gaps between teams, processes, and systems, and establishing frameworks, mechanisms, and best practices that elevate the effectiveness of multiple teams and programs, reduce failure modes, and strengthen operational health

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing program metrics and identifying areas that need attention. By mid-morning, you are leading a cross-team design review, asking pointed questions about architectural trade-offs and helping engineers converge on a path forward. After lunch, you draft a program update narrative for leadership, distilling weeks of progress into a concise story. Later, you connect with partner teams to unblock a dependency and refine the delivery timeline. Throughout, you mentor a fellow program manager and carve out time to evaluate whether a new generative AI tool could streamline your reporting workflows.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
descriptionHtml:
Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization (PDM): helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and own software end to end - working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
- Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
- Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
- Own operational excellence for what you build - monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
- Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.

A day in the life
Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.

About the team
Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

title: Software Development Engineer, AI Trust & Innovation
descriptionHtml:
About the Team
Amazon's Devices & Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.

Role Overview
We are seeking an exceptional Software Development Engineer II to build the foundational systems and consumer-facing features that enable trustworthy AI experiences at scale. You will partner closely with our Principal Engineers and Managers to design and implement privacy-preserving AI architectures, responsible AI frameworks, and accessibility features that set the standard for consumer AI products.

This is a high-impact role where you'll tackle complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer trust—balancing performance with privacy, building explainable AI systems, and creating guardrails that protect customers while enabling delightful experiences.


Key job responsibilities
What You'll Build

Privacy-Preserving AI Systems:
* Design and implement federated learning and differential privacy techniques for on-device and hybrid AI architectures
* Build privacy-preserving data pipelines that minimize data collection while maintaining model quality
* Create consent management frameworks and data minimization systems that give customers control
* Architect on-device vs. cloud processing trade-offs that optimize for both privacy and performance


Consumer-Facing Trust Features:
* Develop explainable AI interfaces that help customers understand how AI makes decisions
* Build transparency controls that show customers what data is used and how
* Create privacy dashboards and settings that give customers meaningful control over their AI experiences
* Implement cross-device identity management with privacy-first design principles

Key Technical Challenges
* Latency vs. Privacy Trade-offs: Optimize time-to-first-token and response times while maintaining strong privacy guarantees through on-device processing and selective cloud offloading
* AI Safety at Scale: Reduce hallucinations to <1% while maintaining 95%+ accuracy across diverse customer queries and contexts
* Ambient Computing Privacy: Build privacy controls for always-on environments that balance proactive assistance with clear boundaries
* Multimodal AI Systems: Architect distributed systems that handle text, voice, and visual inputs while preserving privacy across modalities
* Real-time Evaluation: Create low-latency evaluation systems that assess model outputs for safety, accuracy, and bias before reaching customers

What Makes You Successful
Customer Obsession for Trust: You deeply understand that trust is earned through consistent, transparent, and privacy-respecting experiences. You make technical decisions that prioritize customer trust even when it means additional complexity.

Technical Excellence: You have strong computer science fundamentals and practical experience building distributed systems. You write clean, maintainable code and establish best practices that enable your team to move fast without breaking things.

AI & Privacy Expertise: You understand both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems. You know how to implement privacy-preserving techniques without sacrificing user experience.

Bias for Action: You thrive in ambiguous environments where you need to make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation and safety. You ship iteratively and learn from customer feedback.

Inclusive Mindset: You design systems that work for all customers, considering diverse abilities, contexts, and use cases from the start rather than as an afterthought.

Why Join Us
* Work on generative AI technology that impacts millions of customers daily
* Shape the future of responsible AI and set industry standards for privacy and trust
* Partner with world-class product, design, and research teams
* Solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer protection
* Build systems that make AI accessible and trustworthy for everyone

RME（Reliability and Maintenance Engineering）部門は、日々物流設備の保全と保守、改善を行い、お客様に満足いただけるように努めております。 今回、RME部門が募集する職種はFCに導入されている物流設備の保全と保守、および設備の安全性や生産性を向上させるための改善を担当いただく「サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン」というポジションになります。

title: Sr System Development Engineer, Amazon Leo - Sustaining Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We're looking for a hands-on Sr Systems Development Engineer with a background in the requirements management, design for manufacturing, hardware/software development for testing.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

This is a role for a highly collaborative individual who will help us with optimizing for high volume production and meeting cross discipline requirements.

We are looking for an engineer who combines superb technical and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead software/hardware integration testing
* Lead innovative software/firmware/hardware architectures and flows for multiple manufacturing test lines
* Lead review and analysis on data using tools such as MATLAB, Python, or similar.
* Support and organize the release of the software and hardware system documents through gate reviews
* Investigate and troubleshoot yield issues during prototype and production builds
* Write status and/or build reports for cross-functional review
* Drive and prioritize execution of system test campaigns
* Design and develop software/scripting test setups and supporting hardware for various subsystem validation of the satellite bus.
* Identify and analyze the cross-functional tradeoffs between design alternatives, including impact on performance, schedule, cost, risk, complexity, and scale.
* Drive cross-functional schedules, test requirements, specifications and limits with the hardware development team
* Work concurrently with the design engineers to provide design for testability (DFT) feedback throughout the design process
* Support production and integration efforts for hardware subsystems.
* Define test strategy, implement and optimize test setup/processes at the CM including design and qualification of test fixtures, test equipment, and test software
* Develop procedures, preventative maintenance plans, and troubleshooting guides to support production
* Develop and communicate system integration and evaluation strategies and plans in support of program learning, technical risk reduction, verification, and validation

Basic qualifications

- Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale

title: Brand Specialist - German
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role

Account Management- Brand Specialist

As a Brand Specialist you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon.

You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.

You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing activities/campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting business.

Timings will be as per EU shift, 12:00 pm IST to 9:00 pm IST

Key job responsibilities
• Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.

• Partnering with the Retail Category Team and build successful communication channels at all levels, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan for the vendors.

• Build and execute on a joint business plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.

• Conduct deep dive analysis on vendor issues and publish recommendations and action plans based on data to improve vendor experience.

• Success will be measured by the performance of your vendors on input metrics and impact on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers.

• Conduct regular WBRs, MBRs with the vendors, highlight business metric performance and building action plans.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German
- 2+ years of digital advertising or account management or client facing roles experience
- Experience with Excel
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience analyzing key open issues and resolution metrics for each of the managed accounts
- Experience in relationship management within technology, start-ups, or SaaS Platforms

title: Director, 3P Marketplace, International Seller Services
descriptionHtml:
This is a general management role with full ownership of the Australian 3P Marketplace. You will lead a cross-functional team spanning account management, program management, and seller operations, owning a significant and rapidly scaling P&L. Your job: grow selection strategically, transform the operating model through AI and automation, and make Amazon.com.au the obvious choice for Australian Sellers. You’ll define the strategy, build the team, and deliver the results — with the autonomy to move fast and the accountability that comes with it.
This role is based in Sydney, Australia and reports into the VP of International Seller Services.


Key job responsibilities
Growth & Strategy
• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the 3P Marketplace strategy for Australia. Set the ambition, align stakeholders, and make the hard trade-offs between selection breadth, Seller quality, and speed to market.
• Selection & Seller Acquisition: Strategically grow the Australian catalogue by recruiting high-value Selling Partners and driving adoption of FBA, Advertising, Brand Registry, and other key programs. Turn Australia into a destination marketplace for top local and international brands.
• P&L Ownership: Own a complex P&L end-to-end. Drive sustainable, profitable growth while balancing investment in long-term capability building.
• Negotiations & Partnerships: Personally lead negotiations with top Australian and international brands to bring them onto the platform as 3P Sellers.
Transformation & Innovation
• AI & Automation: Lead the transformation of the Australia 3P organization to be AI-first — automating Seller queries, operational reporting, WBRs/QBRs, and decision-making based on Seller performance, inputs, and cost to serve. Set the standard for what a modern marketplace team looks like.
• Seller Experience (SX): Reimagine the end-to-end Seller journey — from onboarding to listing to account health — removing friction and building tools that let Sellers scale without hand-holding.
• Customer Experience (CX): Raise the bar on what 3P Sellers deliver to customers: faster delivery, better product quality, seamless returns. Close the gap between 1P and 3P experience.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with regional and global teams (Retail, Product, Technology, Operations) to co-develop programs, influence product roadmaps, and scale what works beyond Australia.
People & Influence
• Team Leadership: Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team of account managers and program managers. Set a high bar for talent, coach leaders, and create an environment where people do their best work.
• PR & Public Policy: Be the external voice of Amazon’s marketplace in Australia — championing the story that Amazon empowers small- and medium-sized businesses to grow and reach more customers.



About the team
Since 1994, Amazon has continuously expanded its product selection and innovated on behalf of customers in an ongoing effort to fulfill its stated ambition of being earth’s most customer-centric company. Amazon strives to become a destination where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want — low prices, vast selection, and convenience — we continue to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform.

Amazon’s Third-Party (3P) Marketplace plays a critical role in this mission by enabling every trustworthy Seller to provide the best customer experience and grow successfully. In Australia, the 3P Marketplace is a key growth engine, and we are looking for a dynamic, customer-obsessed leader to drive the next phase of growth for our Australian Selling Partners.

Why This Role, Why Now: The Australian 3P Marketplace has reached an exciting inflection point. With strong foundational momentum, the opportunity now is to accelerate — expanding selection at pace, embedding AI and automation into the operating model, and establishing Australia as a benchmark for how modern marketplace teams operate. This role offers the chance to shape that next chapter with real ownership, global support, and the mandate to move decisively.

Basic qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, or equivalent professional experience
• Extensive progressive leadership experience, including managing large, multi-layered teams across multiple functions in a high-growth or scaled environment
• Hands-on P&L ownership of a large, complex business in online commerce, technology, retail, or marketplace industries, with demonstrated ability to drive sustainable and profitable growth at scale
• Demonstrated track record of building and scaling marketplace or e-commerce businesses, with measurable impact on selection growth, revenue, or seller acquisition
• Strong analytical skills with experience defining, tracking, and acting on KPIs to drive strategic decision-making
• Experience developing and executing multi-year business strategies in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

Preferred qualifications

• MBA or advanced degree in a relevant field
• Experience at Amazon with Retail or 3P marketplace operations (2+ years preferred)
• Experience with AI/ML tools and automation strategies to drive operational efficiency at scale
• Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate multi-layered regional teams while working cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business stakeholders
• Experience working in a matrixed, global organization with track record of driving alignment across geographies
• Knowledge of the Australian retail and e-commerce landscape, including regulatory and competitive dynamics
• Strong verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated experience engaging and influencing senior executives

title: Program Manager, Amazon Freight
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of Program Manager for its Amazon Freight Program team. The goal is to develop easy-to-use, reliable and transparent transportation services that beat all existing shipping alternatives for our customers. In doing this, Amazon Freight is deeply studying customer shipping needs and building innovative, market-leading solutions that will organically attract customers towards our services. To help us succeed in this large endeavor, we are looking for dynamic, self-starting and entrepreneurial individual who will organize, execute and deliver key features to the Amazon Shipping portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
1. Define, design, launch and manage new products and programs for improving experience within the Amazon Freight program and thereby enabling scale.
2. Gather requirements and conceptualize solutions to solve a business and shipper problems and work with key stake holders across various functions to define and launch the product/program.
3. Monitor key metrics on the program and work with all involved stakeholder teams to drive necessary action with field teams, business ops, finance, sales and leadership teams, to achieve goals. Manage Daily/weekly performance, build mechanisms to detect and drive down defects and work on continuous improvements for all processes.
4. Launch and expand the program as per the business requirements and build/own all the long term planning, program and product roadmap for Amazon Freight. Work extensively on industry bench marking, do shipper studies to understand the requirements of our prospective Shippers and work on building these capabilities.
5. Use customer and market feedback, competitive analysis and bench marking, and business metrics to make informed decisions.
6. Setup and manage end-to-end operational, performance measurement and customer satisfaction related processes for all shippers with whom amazon freight is tied up.


A day in the life
This role will require exceptional communication and influencing skills, and will work to influence stakeholders across shippers, Business, Operations, Sales and Tech teams. This role will require the ability to work effectively in a fast paced, startup environment, partnering with others as needed, and the ability to exercise sound judgment solving novel problems without clear direction from leadership. title: WHS Intern
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary
Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.
Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities
Amazon is looking for ambitious, curious and versatile candidates to join our unique world as interns. An Amazon internship will provide you with an unforgettable experience in a fast-paced, dynamic and international environment; it will boost your resume and will provide a superb introduction to our activities.
Key Responsibilities:
- Familiarize and help with the organization and processes for new launches
- Assist the Safety New Build Manager and the Safety Engineer in delivering safety excellent processes and operations
- Support safety process systems through participation in planned inspections of buildings, machines and jobs for accident prevention
- Perform and update Risk Assessments and Job Hazard Analyses

A day in the life

title: Graduate Logistik Manager - Wenden, NRW
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic qualifications

- Erfolgreich absolviertes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor- oder Master) vor Arbeitsbeginn
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Advertising
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television and providing Prime Video Live customers? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching? Prime Video is one of the leading digital video services on the Internet today, and we're just getting started. The Prime Video Ads team owns services that integrate with ad decision systems, handle dynamic transcoding and stitching of ad creatives using client/server side ad insertion (CSAI/SSAI) across HLS/DASH/SS streaming protocols. We helped launch Thursday Night Football and CBS All Access (with ads) on Prime Video and powered the tech of IMDB TV.

Key job responsibilities
As an engineer on an innovative, AI-first team, you will have the opportunity to work on challenging problems in the low latency/high throughput domain of dynamic ad insertion for Live Sports and Video on Demand increasingly powered by AI, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation.

Our architecture processes and handles high TPS (in millions) with obsessively high reliability and low operational overhead. The systems you design and build will be in the core path of video delivery to Prime Video customers worldwide. We leverage Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies including AWS CloudFront, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, SNS, SQS and internal AWS incubator technologies, and we build AI-powered systems and agents to automate operations and accelerate delivery.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you will have significant opportunity to design and build AI-driven agents and automation from agentic operational tooling to AI-assisted development workflows and to shape how the team applies AI across the ad-insertion stack. You'll work with other engineers to troubleshoot operational problems and fix them, building tools and intelligent automation to reduce manual effort as and when needed.

You will be able to influence and propose your ideas for the future of the space including the AI and agentic roadmap to product management, and get them into the roadmap.

About the team
The team is chartered to design large scale systems to power the live and VoD streams with ads viewed by a massive audience daily across the globe, and you will help bring customers streaming video view experience to a new level.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
