title: Technical Program Manager III (TPM), Vendor EDI/API Integration — Mexico & Brazil, SCOT - Supplier Electronic Integration team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Global Supplier Electronic integration team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM III) to lead EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and API (Application Programming Interface) integrations with Amazon’s external suppliers across Mexico and Brazil. The Supplier Electronic integration team powers the electronic integration flywheel behind the Amazon Retail Supply Chain, connecting suppliers to Amazon through automated data exchange.

In this role you will own several supplier integration projects in parallel and see each one through from first conversation to successful go-live. You will sit alongside the MX business teams and act as the bridge between two worlds: you translate business requirements and process needs into the right technical implementation, and you translate technical realities back into terms the business and the supplier understand. You will guide supplier SMEs and their IT teams through every aspect of our integration process, remove technical and process blockers, and drive excellence in data usage for the benefit of both the supplier and Amazon.

This is a role built for independence and collaboration at the same time. After an initial ramp-up period with our globally distributed team, you will be expected to be as self-sufficient as possible — making both the technical judgment calls and the strategic/tactical decisions needed to keep integrations moving. Beyond running projects, you will be on the pulse of the Mexico and Brazil business, building the strategy for how we make more vendor integrations happen: what makes it attractive for suppliers to integrate, which repetitive roadblocks to eliminate, and how EDI/API automation directly advances each country’s business goals when applied to a specific vendor’s situation.

Because this program is still early-stage in-region, you will get to pioneer with a business-development mindset — help the Mexico and Brazil business teams shaping the pitch to suppliers, codifying the recipe for a “perfect integration,” and continuously scaling the number of integrations that can be run in parallel. You will contribute to our documentation and AI-assisted tooling, feed ideas into our org’s improvement pipeline and feature roadmap, and be the voice of the MX/BR supplier back to our central product and tech teams.

The ideal candidate has a genuine technical background — enough to ramp up quickly on our systems, ask the right technical questions, judge trade-offs, and even build quick tooling for themselves — combined with the program-management discipline to run multiple projects cleanly, the business acumen to know why an integration matters to the country, and the communication skills to operate across languages and cultures. You are fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the lifecycle of a complex, cross-functional integration program spanning the Mexico and Brazil geographies. Manage multiple supplier EDI/API integrations in parallel — from concept and business-requirements gathering through technical implementation to successful go-live — with tactical execution and regional strategy ownership.

- Be the bridge between business and technology. Translate country and vendor business requirements into the right technical implementation, and translate technical realities back into business terms for suppliers and internal stakeholders. Deliver best-in-class, pro-active integration consultancy grounded in deep knowledge of our EDI/API solutions and the supplier's process and system blockers.

- Build and leverage strong relationships with external suppliers and 3rd party providers (including their SMEs, IT teams, and external service providers) and internal stakeholders to attract and grow adoption of our integration solutions.

- Own the region’s integration strategy. Stay on the pulse of the MX and BR business, understand how EDI/API automation advances each country’s goals, and build the strategy to drive more vendor integrations — making it more attractive for suppliers to integrate, evaluating and measuring the benefits for both Amazon and suppliers.

- Remove repetitive roadblocks and force-multiply. Identify recurring blockers across integrations, streamline or eliminate them, and codify the recipe for the “perfect integration and automation change management” so results scale beyond what one project-at-a-time allows.

- Operate with technical judgment and independence. After ramp-up, make sound technical and strategic/tactical decisions with limited guidance; understand our systems’ architecture, limitations, and the reasons behind design choices well enough to drive the right solution and mitigate the consequences of poor technology decisions.

- Contribute to documentation, AI solutions, and the product pipeline. Build and improve our integration documentation and AI-assisted tooling, and feed data-driven ideas from what you learn in-region into our org’s improvement pipeline and feature expansions.

- Be the voice of the MX/BR supplier. Add value with post-project analysis and case studies, influence our central product and tech teams on EDI/API tooling, and represent supplier needs internally.

- Deliver with rigor. Focus on goals with flexible prioritization and persistence; anticipate and overcome barriers; provide reliable reporting of your project activities, risks, mitigations, and outcomes; and make decisions that produce positive long-term impact.

- Communicate clearly to a wide range of audiences, from supplier IT teams to internal Directors — through status reports, narratives, and business/technical documentation.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience with APIs and technical integrations
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- Engineering/technical background (e.g., CS/CE/EE degree or equivalent hands-on experience) sufficient to ramp up quickly, understand system architectures, APIs, and data flows, and drive constructive technical discussions with engineers.
- Experience working with external service providers as part of integration delivery.
- Experience managing multiple external-facing integration or delivery projects in parallel, including working with external suppliers, customers, or third-party service providers.
- Demonstrated ability to work directly with external partners/customers and their technical teams, and to translate between business requirements and technical implementation.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
- Professional proficiency in Portuguese.
- Experience in the Mexico and/or Brazil supplier landscape, or working across LatAm markets.

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Transactional Services
descriptionHtml:
Maple SDM Job Description

Join us in building the next generation of distributed systems and database technologies to power AWS!

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

About Journal
Distributed systems such as Kinesis, S3, and DynamoDB need to durably and correctly commit customer writes at high scale and with high availability. For this, many such systems use Journal. Journal is a fault tolerant, high performance, durable log service. It offers an elegant solution to a complex, distributed systems problem. The challenges in building such a system stem with right durability, availability, resiliency, performance (microseconds matter), and scale (we commit in excess of 100 million transactions per second) at low cost.

As a Software Development Manager, you will be joining the team that builds Journal Control Plane services and automations at scale. You will be leading a team of software developers solving novel technical challenges, working with tenured Principal Engineers and Senior Software Engineers on a daily basis.



Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to enable opportunities based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded employee and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.


Key job responsibilities
Your responsibilities include:

* Own the delivery of software development projects end-to-end.
* Define your team's roadmap and manage the ongoing projects, keeping customers informed, update senior management, and represent the team to their dependencies.
* Work with the engineers in your team to invent, design, and develop highly available and scalable distributed systems and database technologies.
* Work with your team, your peers, senior management, and senior engineers to implement best practices in software development and operational processes.
* Develop and grow the members of your team, as well as mentoring others.
* Keep up to date with new technologies used in the field and by our customers, to stay current in our rapidly changing environment.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Woot! is the original daily deals website where an entertaining shopping experience meets deals so good they can't last long. title: Site Operations Leader, 1MHS - Field Fixed
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 2+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Refrigeration Trade School certificate
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with performance metrics such as OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), downtime, throughput, or quality
- Experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments

descriptionHtml:

We're seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead Prime CRM, turning bold ideas into live experiments on Amazon's highest-traffic surfaces while working alongside talented scientists, engineers, and business leaders.

Key job responsibilities

title: SSD/DC Project Manager, One MHS Strategic Planning
descriptionHtml:
One Material Handling System (OMHS) is building Amazon's in-house material handling capabilities, transforming how Amazon designs, builds, and operates its facilities. As Amazon's internal material handling system integrator, we combine precision in technical project management with the vision needed to revolutionize our material handling capabilities. We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager who will exemplify ownership of their assigned material handling projects, ensuring successful implementation across Amazon's network. Our S-TIPM works closely with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and cross-functional teams to deliver complex material handling systems. This role requires both strategic vision and tactical execution to standardize project delivery while maintaining the high standards that complex material handling systems demand. You will drive projects through our comprehensive Project Lifecycle Framework, from initiation through commissioning and handover, while helping establish the processes and playbooks that will enable OMHS to scale across Amazon's network.

Key job responsibilities
In partnership with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and other functional groups this individual will drive the execution strategy and management for material handling system implementations. This position will provide project leadership throughout the entire lifecycle of specific project(s) of a particular building type (ARS, SSD, AMZL, IXD, 1DC, RDC).
- Serve as the single-threaded leader for material handling system implementation programs, driving end-to-end execution across mechanical engineering, controls integration, power systems, and operational requirements for specific building types (ARS, SSD, AMZL, IXD).
- Lead a multi-disciplined team and sub-contractors; manage conflict, establish priorities, coordinate concurrent and sequencing activities, develop team members, and provide overall project leadership.
- Manage the project master schedule, administrative, contractual, technical, and financial aspects of projects to achieve timely completion, holding all internal teams and external vendors accountable for their commitments.
- Drive cross-functional communications and strategic planning for material handling system deployment, determining KPIs and driving standardization initiatives while building strong relationships with operations, functional groups, vendors, and senior leaders.
- Define and continuously improve technical standards, deployment methodologies, and best practices for material handling system implementations, including the development of the Project Lifecycle Framework and implementation playbooks.
- Coordinate across specialized engineering disciplines (mechanical, electrical, controls) to maintain ownership of system integration approaches, ensuring technical requirements, performance standards, and operational metrics are met throughout all lifecycle phases.
- Manage technical partnerships with OEMs and 3P engineering firms to ensure optimal system design, integration, and commissioning.
- Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks in system design, integration approach, and operational implementation while leveraging knowledge management systems and engineering documentation standards.
- Drive commercial and technical strategy during project execution, creating mechanisms and processes that increase velocity while maintaining quality and execution excellence

A day in the life
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to execute material handling system implementations while establishing standardized processes for future deployments. Provide cross-functional leadership by aligning engineering, operations, procurement, installation and commissioning teams around shared project objectives and milestones. Develop and deliver project execution strategies and detailed plans to drive implementation from initiation through commissioning, ensuring project(s) success. Own and manage project budgets, tracking expenditures against forecasts, identifying cost risks early, and implementing corrective actions to maintain financial targets. Maintain rigorous schedule oversight by developing comprehensive project timelines, monitoring critical path activities, and proactively addressing delays to keep projects on track. Interface with strategic partners to ensure successful integration of Amazon-spec equipment and facilitate cross-organizational collaboration to resolve technical and logistical challenges.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
- Minimum of 3+ years experience in contract management
- Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience demonstrating increasing levels of project value and complexity. Inclusive of experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders
- Experience with completion of multiple medium sized projects (up to $40M each) and/or Large projects (excess of $100M) in the Construction and/or Material Handling Industry.
- Must be willing and able to travel up to 50% (Note: Most travel is done on weekdays)

Preferred qualifications

- PMP, or PMP certificate
- Experience with Lean/Six Sigma
- Experience managing multiple internal stakeholders and advising cross-functional teams
- Experience with Automated Control System and material handing systems
- Master’s degree in project management, engineering or related field

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Optics
descriptionHtml:
Come and build innovative services that secure the foundation of our cloud from security threats.

The Amazon Optics team builds and manages services that are used by AWS employees to secure our physical sites. Our services allow our customers to protect AWS locations and preserves the trust that all AWS users have in us. You’ll work with other software development engineers every day that are as passionate as you are about building systems that are an essential tool for our customers in keeping AWS sites secure! The services you build are used around the world to secure assets for every single AWS customer!

Our team provides solutions where “can’t be done” isn’t considered an answer, taking on the impossible and finding creative solutions. You will stretch yourself and grow. You will share your knowledge with others and help others achieve. You’ll be empowered to automate away operational efficiencies for both the team and our customers. You will be challenged to solve complex architecture problems with solutions that are extensible and scale, yet are dedicated to looking for ways to further simplify your solutions. You will work with the team on multiple products that are deployed to every AWS region using AWS services in a fully IaC deployment environment where you own everything end to end - design, development, testing, deploying.

You will join a team that values strong intuition, but seek metrics and other data sources to back up their assumptions.

Key job responsibilities

You design software solutions to enable new features or improve software. You may still require guidance from your team’s leadership to ensure your designs are in alignment with your team’s long-term architectural strategy.

You work on difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks. You bring clarity to problems and identify simple designs for solutions.

You are active in the code review process on your team, providing meaningful feedback to others, including those who are more senior.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Inclusive Team Culture

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

title: プロセスアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は埼玉県川越市です。

物流未経験からキャリアアップ可能なポジションです。私達と一緒に新たにAmazonの歴史を作り上げましょう！

現在は当たり前となった「お急ぎ便」「お届け日時指定便」「当日便」は、お客様の利便性を追求し実現した、日本発の配送サービスです。そのサービスを実現しているのはアマゾンの心臓部である物流拠点、フルフィルメントセンター（以下FC）の仕組みにあります。
FCはお客様のご注文に対して、より早く正確に商品を、多くの地域へ提供するため、入荷から出荷までの各工程において、Amazon独自のノウハウを活かした効率的かつ的確な管理を実施し、最新の自社テクノロジーを導入する事で更なる最適化に挑戦し続けている事業です。
そのFC事業は、日本で2005年に開業して以来、現在27拠点以上に成長しました。本年も継続して事業の拡大に伴い、私達と一緒にお客様起点に考え、更なるイノベーションを起こしていただける情熱的な仲間を「プロセスアシスタント」として募集します。

■業務内容■
「プロセスアシスタント」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、そして先進テクノロジーと「People First」の考え方で、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。

具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
FCはAmazonの豊富な品揃えを実現する巨大な物流拠点です。商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。
お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。

■働き方■
・勤務形態：1ヶ月単位の変形労働時間制のシフト勤務。
・勤務時間：1日8時間勤務、1ヶ月を平均して1週間40時間を超えない範囲で設定します。
・休日：年間120日（月平均10日）　
※原則、日勤、夜勤含めた2～3シフトで会社が決定し、遅くとも当月末日までに翌月分をお伝えします。シフトは日勤・夜勤の間にも必ず公休を挟み、負担が少ないよう配慮しています。
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、FCの基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
プロセスアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、入荷/出荷チームのマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そしてFCの拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。
キャリアアップストーリー

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
また年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており「働く」、「プライベート」も充実できる環境です。
失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

最後に、募集しているポジションや組織、お仕事の詳細については以下のリンクよりご確認いただけます。

・勤務先のFCについて：川越FC
・プロセスアシスタントについて：プロセスアシスタント/シフトアシスタント特設サイト
・FCで働くリーダーのインタビュー：プロセスアシスタント３名のインタビュー
・フルフィルメントセンター部門のご紹介：フルフィルメントセンター (FC)
・職種：オペレーション

※FC内の様子も下記動画からご覧いただけます！
一部の拠点のみとなりますが、より職場環境をイメージ出来るかと思いますのでぜひご覧ください！

Basic qualifications

- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（読み、書き、日常会話－討論・交渉・プレゼンテーションなど、意思疎通ができる）

Preferred qualifications

title: SDE II, Amazon Leo, Flight SW
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s Low Earth Orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are hiring Full Stack engineers, Backend and FrontEnd engineers to build dashboards and backend services for two critical items for our org - 1/ dashboards for metrics that quite literally flow from out of this world - This would indeed be the satellites in-orbit telemetry flowing back to earth. 2/ tracking and managing software releases , organizing and scheduling the tests for the okay to fly ceremonies before handing off to the team that manages space OTAs.


The work is in Python, Rust, Node JS using standard well known cloud technologies and components.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement cloud applications and services to aid in Flight software releases.
- Partner with the Satellite, Networks and other engineering teams
- Collaborate and build scalable cloud application and services and UI that work across devices and browsers.

We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. title: Enterprise Growth Lead, Amazon Ads Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads helps businesses connect with customers through full-funnel advertising solutions that combine deep audience understanding with innovative technology. We develop marketing programs that provide actionable insights and opportunities for advertisers, partnering with enterprise brands, agencies, and technology platforms to drive mutually beneficial growth.
The Ads Regional Marketing team drives comprehension and accelerates adoption of Amazon Ads' full-funnel solutions among enterprise advertisers across international marketplaces. We are globally consistent yet locally relevant, aligning our marketing programs to regional buying cycles, customer behaviors, and product adoption patterns while reflecting the cultures and commercial environments of the markets we serve.
We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to own and deliver a Japan-first integrated marketing roadmap. You will define the audience strategy across all marketing activity in Japan, creating differentiated programs for enterprise advertisers, holding companies, and independent agencies that position Amazon Ads as a preferred partner within Japan's advertising landscape. You will drive measurable growth through always-on programs that integrate owned and industry events, digital content, partner marketing, executive engagements, industry partnerships, and paid media into a single, coordinated customer journey. This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence, reporting to the Head of Regional Marketing.
The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of the Japanese advertising landscape—including agency group structures, media buying norms, and advertiser planning cycles—and a track record of executing B2B marketing strategies aligned to enterprise sales cycles and Japan-specific planning windows. You understand how decisions are made across holding companies, their subsidiary agencies, and independent shops, and you translate that knowledge into programs that resonate with each cohort. This is a fast-moving role that demands strong ownership, sharp prioritization, and clear communication. Day-to-day activities will evolve as our business grows; by owning a cross-channel annual roadmap you can expect to deliver across both strategy and execution. Responsibilities span senior stakeholder management, channel investment allocation, and audience strategy, through to content development, thought leadership, and budget management. You thrive in ambiguity and operate with flexibility. You manage a demanding project pipeline autonomously, partner effectively across global and regional teams, and advocate confidently for Japan marketplace needs within a global organization.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the Japan integrated marketing roadmap, connecting events, digital and content marketing, partner marketing, executive engagement, industry partnerships, and paid media into a coherent, always-on customer journey aligned to Japan advertiser planning cycles and product adoption patterns
• Define the Japan audience strategy, determining how Amazon Ads priorities and engages enterprise advertisers, holding companies, and independent agencies with differentiated approaches that reflect their distinct decision-making structures and needs
• Develop Japan-specific thought leadership campaigns that articulate the Amazon Ads value proposition, leveraging research, insights, success stories, and industry partnerships relevant to the Japanese market
• Identify the right combination and sequencing of marketing touchpoints across the customer lifecycle to deepen engagement and accelerate commercial outcomes
• Own accountability for marketing's contributions to Japan business objectives. You build and maintain strong relationships with sales leadership, partner teams, industry leaders, and the broader Amazon Ads Marketing organization, representing marketing in key Japan-level business planning
• Establish clear goals and measurement mechanisms to understand marketing effectiveness; conduct structured reviews and contribute insights to operational planning narratives
• Own program budgets and finance reporting, ensuring investment aligns with strategic priorities


A day in the life
Lead regional enterprise marketing strategy and execution for Amazon Ads in Japan, driving advertiser engagement, market adoption, and business growth across enterprise advertisers, holding companies, and independent agencies. Drive B2B marketing events (e.g., Amazon Japan Upfront, unBoxed Tokyo) alongside branded content, trade media, integrated campaigns, and executive engagement programs as part of a coordinated, always-on customer journey. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, and executive stakeholders to align programs with regional business priorities and strengthen Amazon Ads' market position in Japan.

With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

A day in the life

You'll work alongside your dedicated mentor and team on real improvement and innovation projects that support the growth of Amazon's European network. You might spend your morning analysing a large dataset to identify operational bottlenecks, then spend your afternoon aligning with stakeholders across different countries on a project rollout plan. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, track project milestones, and share updates with senior management.

Amazon is a data-driven business, so no matter which project you are working on, part of your role will involve extracting insights from data to drive decisions. You'll develop solutions to real operational challenges, test different approaches, and present your findings to leadership — building your analytical, communication, and project management skills in a fast-paced, international environment.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Internal Auditor to join the Worldwide Amazon Stores Internal Audit team. Stores is one of the largest areas of Amazon’s business and continues to grow rapidly, spanning fulfillment centers, supply chain, logistics, transportation, and physical stores. This is a high-visibility opportunity where you will gain broad exposure across the business, contribute to audits that matter, and help drive meaningful improvements. Our team is cross-functional, and you will work on a wide range of operational and technical audits. You should be comfortable working independently on assigned audit work while also being a strong teammate.

In this role, you will execute audit procedures and testing based on defined audit scope and objectives. You will dig into the details of processes and controls, build an understanding of complex operational and technical environments, and help identify control gaps and process improvement opportunities related to operations, regulatory compliance, organisation, policy, and technology. You will work closely with Audit Managers and senior auditors, and interact with engineers and business leaders to gather information, test controls, and document results clearly and accurately. You will manage your own deliverables across multiple audits at the same time.

We are not looking for someone who only documents issues. You should be able to clearly explain what you observe, why it matters, and how it impacts the business. You will contribute to well-written findings and reporting, support the prioritisation of issues in line with business objectives and regulatory expectations, and over time build confidence working with stakeholders to align on practical solutions and help verify that issues are addressed appropriately.

- Works effectively as a contributor within the audit team, collaborating with peers and supporting Audit Managers and senior auditors.
- Applies analytical thinking, including the use of data analytics and audit tools, to identify control gaps, process inefficiencies, and exceptions in assigned audit areas.

Our team focuses on the Worldwide Amazon Stores Business, which includes all the processes and systems from the time the customer “clicks” to order a product to the item being delivered or returned and everything in between. descriptionHtml:

From Day 1 onboarding through career development, you will balance deep instructional design craft with the program management rigor needed to plan, prioritize, and deliver multiple concurrent projects on time and within scope. title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.

Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!

Key job responsibilities
* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.

Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.

AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.

Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.

About the team
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.

What Makes This Role Exciting:

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally
* Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually


Our tenets:

* Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights
* Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses
* No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Important: This role is based at a location with limited public transport. A valid driving license and access to a personal vehicle are required.

Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could

About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear
- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers
- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:
- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment
- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 24 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

- Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

- Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

- Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

- Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

title: WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL), Workplace Health and Safety (AMZL)
descriptionHtml:
The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) will be responsible for 5 to 7 Delivery Stations to execute company Safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. This individual must instruct and train Operations Leaders in company WHS policies and assist the regional teams in incorporating our WHS standards at their sites.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company Safety policies.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) will be required to possess WHS program and relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrates this expertise when working with Operations.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) will be responsible to lead a team of WHS Officers in their region. This individual must create and execute leadership development plans for their WHS Associates on their team. They must communicate safety team expectations and give frequent and appropriate feedback to their WHS teams and ensure they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon professional. This individual must also demonstrate the ability to judge and assess WHS talent and select appropriate bench strength to current and future business needs.


Key job responsibilities
• Manage overall compliance with local requirements and authorities.
• Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS Policies and regulatory requirements
• Measure the regions and sites’ performance against published requirements in WHS policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
• Ensure WHS recordkeeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business WHS initiatives.
• Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations. Deliver quality projects on time to Operations.
• Analyze WHS metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
• Audit recordkeeping practices and Global WHS Database entries to ensure compliance to global WHS standards and local regulations.
• Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
• Manage and mentor the region WHS Officers and WHS Associates in your assigned sites.
• Spend time at the sortation centers, and delivery stations, and seek input from WHS teams, Associates and leaders on WHS program improvement opportunities.
• Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
• Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy. Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required WHS training.
• Review for effectiveness the deployed WHS tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
• Partner with corporate and other regional field WHS personnel to leverage global WHS standards.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above
- Knowledge of current industry standards
- Experience in workplace health & safety (WHS) related field
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience in people management

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications and the use of pivot tables and the development of charts and graphics
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

title: Customer Solutions Manager, Retail CPG
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, focusing on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers — whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) at Amazon Web Services (AWS) is responsible for guiding a strategic customer through their multi-year cloud journey, ensuring effective collaboration across AWS teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. This role focuses on understanding industry-specific needs and driving digital transformation, orchestrating the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS Cloud journey.

In this role you will be a critical partner to the account team, owning the execution layer of the engagement to accelerate the customer's outcomes and multiply the impact of Sales and Solutions Architecture. You will drive the follow-up actions that turn strategy into delivered outcomes: planning and running executive engagements, coordinating cross-functional workstreams, tracking progress, and ensuring the customer consistently realizes value from AWS.

You will interface with customer stakeholders and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the core account groups (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, partners, and customer teams. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from the customer's key milestones. Executive meetings, roadmap-to-business-outcome alignment, quarterly and monthly business reviews, and enablement programs are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of the customer's cloud and AI journey.

Successful candidates will have a strong delivery and change-management background, be detail-oriented, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators at both the executive and project-team level. You will be a peer leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in. You will evangelize AWS services, be passionate about delivering a great customer experience, and be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of your customer's successful adoption of AWS.

Key job responsibilities
Own executive & customer engagement planning — plan and run executive meetings and customer visits with inputs and direction from the account team.
Own recurring business reviews — put together the monthly/quarterly business review for the customer, gathering inputs from all account and extended team members, and own the meeting itself.
Drive customer maturity & innovation programs — run activities such as Culture of Innovation, Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), and Cloud Maturity Model assessments, sustaining momentum through continuous effort.
Run cross-functional cadences & track execution — run weekly workstream meetings that bring in people beyond the account team, and track progress and actions in shared trackers so nothing slips.
Own stakeholder relationships where it adds value — hold specific customer stakeholder relationships (e.g., a platform or line-of-business team), positioning AWS as the right platform and driving the associated initiatives.
Support the customer's AI journey — help plan and shepherd the customer's AI adoption from planning through demos/POCs to production, including driving active usage of relevant AI tools.
Coordinate migrations and enablement as the engagement requires — while large-scale migration ownership (on-prem/other-cloud to AWS) and hands-on enablement delivery are not the primary focus of every engagement, the CSM owns or coordinates these where an account calls for it, including partnering with the AWS Training & Certification team to plan and run enablement.

A day in the life
As a part of the customer focused team your daily routine will swing from tactical tasks like driving team meetings, overseeing in-delivery initiatives to strategic activites like planning and driving business reviews, executive engagements. Through your interactions with the customer you will also open up new engagement avenues through motions like Cloud Adoption Framework, AI maturity assessment, etc. which help the customer accelerate their cloud and AI journey.

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
- 2+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
- Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
- Experience in a direct or matrixed role leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
- cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect - Associate
- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
- Experience in retail / CPG or a comparable industry, and comfort operating in a multicultural, cross-geography account team

descriptionHtml:

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Senior Product Design Electrical Engineer for our Electrical Products and Services (EPS) team. EPS is a global engineering team within AWS Data Center Engineering, responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of electrical power distribution products used across our rapidly expanding data center footprint. Our product portfolio spans the full electrical distribution chain, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other critical electrical infrastructure.

The EPS team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, they are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. They drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to senior leadership. They seek new ways to improve the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, they have the opportunity to design, innovate, and improve the products our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a work environment where speed and quality matter. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. Amazon's work environment is unique in every aspect and offers a great opportunity for the right candidate.

If you have led or worked with high performing teams of engineers and enjoy working on complex problems, we want to hear from you. At Amazon, the successful candidate will be responsible for working on product designs and supporting our wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

At Amazon, teamwork is necessary for us to accomplish our goals. The successful candidate must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As a product engineer at Amazon, they will work with other internal groups as well as external groups including engineering service providers, manufacturers, vendors, inspectors, third party testing labs, and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel will be necessary but should not be more than 30%. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel may be necessary. Their contribution could consist of leading international projects and could require developing engineering information packages. An understanding of international electrical product design requirements is helpful but not necessary.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with internal partner teams to solicit customer input and define design requirements for product design.
- Lead new product design, development and qualification of critical electrical power distribution equipment for AWS data centers, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other electrical infrastructure.
- Develop Capex and Opex spending budgets taking into account development costs with vendors, prototyping needs, testing and specialized tooling requirements.
- Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical equipment and components, ensuring tier 2-3 supply chain resiliency.
- Ensure compliance with UL, CSA, IEC and federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries through appropriate levels of testing.
- Validate design through prototype, pre-production and first-of-kind builds, conducting DFx and value engineering analysis through each step and updating design and documentation.
- Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical products.
- Provide support for manufacturing activities for new products on concurrent projects in multiple geographical locations.
- Be a leader within the product development team as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Experience developing solutions and executing plans on complex projects
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities

- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region

title: Senior Chip Design Engineer , Graviton
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is a fabless semiconductor company founded by industry veterans. We develop leading-edge products on state-of-the-art process technologies, and we're looking for talented engineers to help us build a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.
You'll help develop state-of-the-art products within a disruptive system architecture, working on the technologies that power the world's largest cloud provider in a dynamic, open and fast-paced environment. AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries.

AWS Graviton is a family of processors designed to deliver the best price performance for cloud workloads running in Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2). Graviton is designed in-house. It has reshaped what EC2 offers AWS customers and has become their preferred choice for cloud compute.
You'll join the Chip Design team on the Graviton product line. The team defines the product's features and owns their architecture and development. We work closely with product definition, pre- and post-silicon validation, physical design, software and other teams across the full chip development cycle, from idea to mass production. Your design will ship in Graviton products deployed in AWS data centers worldwide, so your work will have large-scale impact.
At Annapurna Labs, you'll play a key role in developing the next generation of semiconductor platforms for the world's largest cloud infrastructure, and in shaping the future of cloud computing.

Lead micro-architecture definition and own power, performance and area trade-offs, working with Physical Design and Software
Drive RTL design in Verilog/SystemVerilog and lead design reviews for the domain
Define and execute IP integration strategies
Set verification priorities with the Verification and Emulation teams, and lead system-level and post-silicon debug for your domain
Carry design learnings into the next Graviton generations, and improve design methodology and flows
Mentor and technically guide engineers working in your domain, raising the technical bar of the team

About the team
Annapurna Labs started in 2011, as a fabless chip start-up, focused on bringing innovation to the fast-growing cloud infrastructure. Four years after its inception, Annapurna Labs was acquired by Amazon Web Services (AWS). Since then, we have accelerated innovation and developed a number of products that benefit cloud customers, including AWS Nitro technology, AWS Graviton processors, AWS ML Inferentia & Trainium and more. Although Annapurna Labs is a small company, it is significant for AWS, with a reputation of being the key ingredient in the "secret sauce" behind its success. The Annapurna Labs team is responsible for building custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks that run on top of them, which gives us the possibility to optimize and improve our products in different layers more effectively.
We are a dynamic group of engineers dedicated to pushing the boundaries of semiconductor innovation. Our team combines the agility of a startup with the resources of Amazon Web Services, creating a unique environment where breakthrough technologies are born. We collaborate across disciplines, from product definition to silicon validation, ensuring each chip represents the pinnacle of performance and reliability.
