title: Software Development Engineer, Returns and Recommerce
descriptionHtml:
Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.

As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.

We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.

Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

title: Sourcing Recruiter, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth — and that starts with finding the right people. As a Sourcing Recruiter, you'll be on the front lines of talent discovery, identifying and engaging top engineering talent in some of the most competitive and niche markets in the industry.

In this role, you'll build and execute sourcing strategies, develop candidate pipelines, and partner closely with Recruiting Business Partners and hiring managers to understand what great talent looks like for each search. You'll own the top of the funnel — from market research and candidate identification to outreach and initial engagement — and play a critical role in delivering qualified, diverse slates against tight timelines.

We're looking for someone who is resourceful, curious, and relentless about finding people who don't show up in a keyword search. You should be comfortable using data to refine your approach, experimenting with new sourcing channels, and building relationships with passive candidates who aren't actively looking. Strong communication skills, a bias for action, and the ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously are essential.

Key job responsibilities
As a Sourcing Recruiter, you will:

Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to build effective sourcing strategies for Network Development Engineer roles, leveraging baseline networking knowledge to identify and engage passive candidates across technical talent markets and sourcing channels.

Proactively source passive networking engineers, assess initial fit and interest for NDE roles, and build strong pipelines for Seattle and Arlington locations.

Develop and execute search strategies using Boolean, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, and other tools to identify candidates with experience in routing protocols, network architecture, and infrastructure systems.

Craft personalized, compelling outreach that resonates with passive networking engineers and reflects Amazon's employer brand.

Contribute market intelligence on networking talent availability and competitive landscape to inform recruiter and hiring manager strategy.

Recommend sourcing strategies that contribute to pipeline health and quality, testing new techniques and channels for hard-to-fill technical openings.

Document sourcing plans with clear deliverables, timelines, and metrics to track pipeline development and candidate engagement effectiveness.

Conduct initial candidate outreach and interest assessments to qualify engagement-level fit before passing candidates to recruiters.

Contribute to sourcing experiments and pilot programs aimed at cracking new passive talent channels for hard-to-reach networking engineers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of corporate or search firm progressive recruiting or research experience
- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of full-time Amazon experience
- Experience with contact management system/applicant tracking system for sourcing, tracking and managing candidates

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a research capacity for candidate generation
- Experience recruiting technical talent in competitive markets

title: NTE Security Manager, Non-Traditional Environment (NTE)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Non-Traditional Environments Security team is seeking a highly motivated Security Operations/Program Manager to join our team. This role combines hands-on operational security management with strategic security program management, ensuring both day-to-day physical security excellence and the successful lifecycle management of security systems across AWS facilities.

You will drive operational security excellence across multiple facilities located within a metro area. You will interface with and direct vendors involved insecurity construction, repairs, daily security operations, patrols, and planning. A critical part of your work will involve extracting and analyzing security metrics to observe trends, measure improvements, and make data-driven decisions that strengthen our security posture.

You will evaluate and recommend improvements to electronic surveillance and access control systems while leading efforts to educate data center occupants on security best practices and false alarm reduction. You will write and implement security processes and procedures that standardize operations across your facilities. Your position will require you to prepare reports, create presentations, and communicate regularly with management on the status of physical security operations.

In addition to your operational responsibilities, you will support the installation of physical security systems including Access Control, Intrusion Detection, and CCTV Surveillance systems. You will conduct continuous reviews of existing security standards and stay abreast of new technology developments that enhance the physical security posture of AWS data centers and collocations.

You will work directly with Cluster Security Managers, Operations Teams, and internal customers to translate their requirements into physical security system design and implementation.

Strong written and verbal communication skills are required, including the ability to write security processes and procedures, prepare executive-level reports and presentations, and effectively manage vendor and stakeholder relationships. Experience in physical security operations management across multiple sites, along with demonstrated proficiency in electronic security systems such as access control, intrusion detection, and CCTV surveillance, is expected.

Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities
• Investigate security incidents, assess risk, and deliver actionable reports to leadership
• Design physical security systems for data center builds and expansions, including documentation and bills of material for vendor bidding
• Lead vendor negotiations, bid review, quality assurance, and submit packages for funding approval
• Manage end-to-end physical security installations from design through commissioning, acceptance, and operational readiness
• Track and report performance metrics including budget variance, vendor delivery, cost savings, and post-installation defect rates
• Provide cross-functional coverage across security operations and program management to ensure business continuity
• Train and mentor team members on security procedures and best practices
• Participate in on-call rotation and travel throughout the Americas up to 50%


About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Principal SAP Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building an SAP S/4HANA platform that will unify the entire supply chain into a single digital thread — connecting sales and distribution, procurement and supplier collaboration, manufacturing, logistics, and finance and accounting into one coherent system. As the Principal SAP Solution Architect, you will be the senior authority on how this ERP operates across every domain, shaping end-to-end business processes before they become a technical build. This is a business-process leadership role first: you will drive process standardization, lead cross-functional design reviews, and translate how the business actually operates into a scalable SAP design. If you are energized by complexity, thrive in ambiguity, and want to define the platform that powers a rapidly growing robotics business, we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end business process architecture spanning sales and distribution, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and finance and accounting, ensuring processes are standardized and designed to deliver the best outcomes across the supply chain.
- Lead Business Process Design reviews across all domains, facilitating cross-functional alignment sessions with Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Sales Operations, and Finance leaders to drive decisions on standard process adoption, exceptions, and trade-offs.
- Translate deep functional understanding of order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, plan-to-produce, and record-to-report flows into a coherent SAP design that the delivery team can build, while incorporating master data governance, process controls, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements from the start.
- Set the multi-year process and solution roadmap, influence business and engineering leadership on platform trade-offs, and mentor functional analysts and architects across the program.
- Navigate ambiguity across a fast-evolving greenfield program by bringing clarity to undefined requirements, challenging legacy ways of working, and championing modern SAP capabilities that enable the organization to adapt quickly.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing open design decisions from yesterday's Business Process Design sessions, then join a cross-functional working session where procurement, manufacturing, and finance stakeholders debate how a new process flow should work in SAP standard versus a custom extension. After aligning the group on a path forward, you sketch the updated process flow and share it with the delivery architects. In the afternoon you might mentor a junior functional analyst on a tricky order-to-cash scenario, review a system-integrator proposal, or draft the next iteration of the multi-year solution roadmap.

About the team
Our team designs and delivers Amazon's next generation of robotic systems. Our ERP program is a new initiative charged with building the SAP S/4HANA backbone that connects Amazon's supply chain end to end. The team is a small, collaborative group of functional architects, engineers, and business partners who value clarity over complexity and standard processes over custom code. We are in the early stages of the program, which means you will have a direct hand in shaping the platform, the processes, and the culture as we scale.

Basic qualifications

- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- 12+ years of SAP implementation and supply chain business process development
- Experience with building greenfield systems and designing business processes
- Experience across discrete and repetitive manufacturing environments

Preferred qualifications

- Deep functional knowledge across multiple SAP domains — Sales & Distribution, Materials Management / Procurement, Supplier Collaboration (e.g. Ariba, SAP Business Network), and Finance & Controlling
- Experience integrating manufacturing and logistics processes with the broader supply chain and finance into a single end-to-end design
- Experience integrating in-house manufacturing scenarios, consignment stock, and contract manufacturing processes into a single end-to-end supply chain design
- Experience leading Business Process Design (BPD) reviews and driving process standardization across cross-functional organizations
- Experience aligning systems and business process end to end across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, plan-to-produce, and record-to-report
- Experience with SAP clean-core design concepts, including design and build using non-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI and data & analytics
- Experience working backwards from business requirements to shape ERP configuration and integration decisions
- Experience mentoring functional teams and setting process and technical direction across a large delivery program

title: Design Verification Engineer - technical lead, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:

title: Lab and Build Engineer II, Battery Design, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Batteries power that mission, and getting from parts and cells to trustworthy test results takes careful, hands-on work in the lab. We are looking for a Lab Engineer to own that work: set up and maintain the equipment, prepare builds and work orders, and move tests through the lab's processes so the team's cell and pack testing keeps flowing, while steadily making the lab run better.

This is a very hands-on role, and it is also a self-directed one. Requests will often arrive loosely defined: a test that needs running, a build that needs prepping, equipment that is not behaving. You will work out what is actually needed, decide how and in what order to do it, and carry it to completion without being managed task to task. You will set up, maintain, and troubleshoot build process equipment such as ultrasonic wirebonders, epoxy dispense systems, custom fixturing and tooling, thermal chambers, and robot arms. You will manage consumables and parts so work is never blocked, prepare builds and work orders, and run tests through the lab's processes, pulling in engineers when a decision genuinely needs them and escalating early when something is blocked.

We are looking for someone who likes lab work, cares about doing a process the same way every time, and is technical enough to keep equipment running, solve difficult lab problems, and improve how the lab operates. You will manage your own queue against the team's priorities and keep several efforts moving at once. You will handle cells end to end (unpacking, registering, tracking, and measuring them), keep the lab to a high 5S standard, write and improve work instructions and procedures, and drive lab improvements you identify yourself. You will build effective relationships with the cell test, build, and design engineers and with suppliers, and begin to mentor and train new teammates.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Take loosely defined requests from engineers, clarify what is actually needed, and turn them into a concrete plan of lab work you own through completion.
- Prioritize and manage your own queue against team goals, sequence work so builds and tests are not blocked, and keep several efforts moving at once with limited supervision.
- Set up, calibrate, maintain, and troubleshoot build process equipment — ultrasonic wirebonders, epoxy dispense systems, custom fixturing, thermal chambers, robot arms — bringing new equipment online and working problems toward root cause.
- Prepare builds and work orders by kitting parts, staging materials, and readying stations against work instructions and engineering direction; process tests end to end from cell prep through clean, traceable results.
- Spot gaps in how the lab runs, recommend and implement process improvements, maintain 5S standards, contribute to engineering documentation, and begin mentoring new teammates on lab systems and tools.

A day in the life
You might start the day deciding what matters most: a test that needs to start today, a build that needs kitting, or a wirebonder that has been drifting out of spec. You sequence them yourself, stage the build, get the test running, then work the equipment problem toward root cause rather than just resetting it. An engineer stops by with a vague request for a new kind of coupon, and you ask enough questions to turn it into a plan, then estimate what it will take and tell them when it can be ready. In the afternoon you unpack and register a new batch of cells, update a work instruction based on what you learned this morning, and flag a consumable that needs reordering before it becomes a blocker.

About the team
We are the battery team behind Amazon Leo's power systems. We design, build, and test the cells and packs that keep satellites running. Over the coming years, we are scaling from development builds to flight-ready production, which means growing lab capacity, tightening processes, and building the team to support higher volumes. This role is the hands-on backbone of the lab: it keeps equipment, consumables, builds, and tests flowing, and steadily improves how the lab runs, so the cell test, build, and design engineers can focus on the engineering.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- 2+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Experience with precision torque, measurement and inspection devices (i.e., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, torque wrenches)
- Experience managing lab resources, equipment, and supplies

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience

title: WHS Officer
descriptionHtml:
The WHS Officer will partner directly with site operations teams (First Mile/Middle Mile/Last The WHS Officer will partner directly with site operations teams (First Mile/Middle Mile/Last Mile) to implement company safety policies, ensure compliance with all local and regional regulations, and maintain a secure, healthful work environment. Leveraging lean principles and kaizen methodologies, this individual contributor will independently lead continuous improvement initiatives to mitigate conditional and ergonomic risks in processes, utilizing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis to influence operational changes. The role requires good communication skills to deliver clear, consistent messages verbally and in writing, train Operations Leaders on safety protocols, and integrate best practices into company standards. Proven ability in teamwork, analytical thinking, sound judgment, and customer-focused problem-solving is essential to effectively collaborate across functions and drive meaningful safety outcomes. The WHS Officer will apply expertise in safety programs, environmental compliance, and ergonomics to support site teams, ensuring adherence to Amazon's safety frameworks while driving a culture of proactive risk management and operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
Ensure compliance with Amazon Safety Policies, standards, and applicable local/regional/national regulations through direct guidance and oversight.
• Support assigned site(s) in implementing Amazon WHS procedures as directed by WHS leadership.
•Partner with site stakeholders to drive compliance with WHS standards, procedures, and local laws.
• Conduct comprehensive site walks engaging associates on hazard observation, coaching on WHS requirements, ergonomic postures, and Permit to Work compliance.
• Conduct frequent site safety inspections and audits to identify non-compliant equipment or processes.
• Complete area readiness checks for the Wellness Room and replenish supplies as needed.
• Conduct risk assessments for all processes and update them for change management at defined frequencies.
• Implement corrective solutions to eliminate risks and prevent injuries across facilities.
• Initiate corrective actions for findings identified during standard work implementation.
• Analyze weekly/monthly/quarterly safety metrics and incident trends to prioritize resource allocation to high-risk areas.
• Measure site performance against safety policy requirements and develop action plans to address deficiencies.
• Complete assigned tasks and stretch assignments to advance site safety goals.
• Assist in conducting safety inductions, toolbox talks, and awareness programs.
• Coach associates on new/existing WHS requirements and their operational impact.
• Promote a proactive safety culture through engagement and collaboration with stakeholders to resolve safety barriers.
• Maintain all records related to safety operations (regulatory/non regulatory inspections, audits, SOPs).
• Support the site safety manager in timely reporting of compliance status to leadership.
• Implement Kaizen or other initiatives to strengthen workplace conditions and safety performance.
• Deliver on-time, high-quality projects to support Operations teams.
• Collaborate with site operations and WHS leadership to address day-to-day risks and escalate compliance issues through inspections/audits.
• Complete peak readiness actions, provide updates, and contribute to lesson-learned sessions.
• We have a 5-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.
• For roles in last-mile and Amazon Fresh sites, manage multiple small sites within a city as required.

A day in the life
Daily Deep Dive of metrics, Site safety audit / inspections, Incident reporting and investigation, Training, TBT, FGDs, Startups at site, AWHS committee meeting, Communication on required safety matters, Safety compliance adherence with respect to Amazon WHS Policies and procedures, PPE issuance and compliance, Risk Assessment, Inventory management and procurement of safety supplies. 

About the team
Workplace, Health & Safety - Amazon India Operations

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Bachelor's degree in science or equivalent
- 2+ years of experience in Workplace Health and Safety

Preferred qualifications

- A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent), or NEBOSH (National General Certificate)
- Experience in a fast paced, changing/growing organization
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment.
- Fulfillment Center or Manufacturing Safety experience with mix of exempt and non-exempt employees at a site of at least 200 people preferred.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with site leaders.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the next generation of financial operations technology that serves businesses of all sizes. You'll design and develop scalable systems that power end-to-end finance and accounting services, directly impacting how companies manage their financial operations with Amazon-grade accuracy and compliance.

Key job responsibilities

Architect and develop scalable, secure systems designed to handle sensitive financial data across diverse customer environments
Partner with business teams to understand customer requirements, investigate potential solutions, and deliver innovative features that address real financial challenges
Establish and communicate architectural principles and design patterns, then mentor team members in their adoption and implementation
Lead technical analysis of industry trends and emerging technologies to inform platform development and innovation strategy
Make data-driven architectural decisions that balance scalability, customer experience, and business priorities


A day in the life
As a Senior Software Developer on our Finance as a Service team, you'll focus on architecting and developing systems that handle sensitive financial data for a diverse customer base—from large multinationals to small local businesses. You'll collaborate with our business partners to understand customer needs, then investigate, prototype, and deliver innovative solutions that solve real financial challenges. Your day might include establishing architectural principles and design patterns that guide your team's work, staying informed about emerging technologies and industry trends, and making data-driven decisions about our technology roadmap. You'll work in an Agile environment, balancing the need for scalability and high performance with practical business priorities, all while mentoring team members and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

About the team
We're building a world-class finance and accounting platform that transforms how businesses manage their back-office operations. Our team is dedicated to creating technology that's secure, scalable, and accessible—whether serving large enterprises or growing businesses. We're focused on developing a multi-tenant operations stack with built-in data isolation and compliance controls from the ground up. Our vision is to make sophisticated financial operations technology available to everyone, and we're looking for collaborative partners who can help us shape that future. You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders who are committed to delivering solutions that genuinely meet customer needs while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and security.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都葛飾区の物流拠点です。

アマゾンジャパンのフルフィルメントネットワークは、アマゾンのカスタマーに毎日多くのパッケージと笑顔をお届けしています。当社は地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業を目指しており、意欲的でカスタマー志向の強いOperations Managerを募集しています。

当社の物流拠点のビジネスゴールを達成するためにチームのオペレーションを管理する責任を負います。あなたのチームは20～300 名程度のメンバーで構成されます。数十億円の予算規模の年間の運営計画を立て、その実行責任を負います。分析スキルや問題解決スキルに加え、チームとしてパフォーマンス目標を確実に達成するため、メンバーと良好な関係を構築し、チームのリーダーシップを強化するためのコーチングやメンタリングなどの人材管理スキルを発揮することやや新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力も期待されます。

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからDirectorまで、多様なBackgroundを持つメンバーとのCross-functionalワークを通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【キャリアパス】
Operations Managerは、大きな組織をリードしリージョンやネットワークの取り組みを実行する次のSite LeaderまたはSenior Operations Managerへと成長することが期待されます。また、Supply Chain、Transportation、およびLogisticsなどAmazon のオペレーションのあらゆるOpportunityを模索することもできます。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
- オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
- 物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
- メンバーがより生産的で、パフォーマンスが高く、多様性があり、インクルーシブになるようサポート、指導し、動機付けします。チームメンバーの個人的な成功に対するビジョンとコミットメントを持って、共感を持ってリーダーシップを発揮し、楽しく仕事をし、メンバーに楽しんでもらいましょう。
- Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
- 年間のオペレーション計画を編成し、日次/週次の生産計画と実績確認、短期/長期の需要変動対応、3PLを含む関係者との調整を通じて、コストを管理しながら、年間のオペレーション計画を実行します。
- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

title: Ausbildung - Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.


Key job responsibilities
• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.


A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst Du in unserer modernen Partnerlehrwerkstatt sowie der Berufsschule, während Du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon am Standort erwirbst.
Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst eine Störung an einer Förderanlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, führst eine vorbeugende Wartung durch oder unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Technik.
Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Du hast mindestens einen Hauptschulabschluss zum Beginn der Ausbildung
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Gute Schulnoten in Mathematik und Physik (abhängig von der Schulform)

Preferred qualifications

- Du besitzt handwerkliches Geschick und verfügst über ein technisches Grundverständnis
- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)
- Du bringst bereits erste Vorerfahrungen im handwerklichen Bereich mit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität“
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). Sollten die Bewerbungsunterlagen nicht vollständig sein, können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen! Bitte beachte, dass du im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses ein Videointerview über ein externes Tool durchführen musst. Mit der Übersendung Deines Lebenslaufs erklärst Du Dich mit der Speicherung Deiner Daten zum Zwecke der Feststellung der Eignung für dieses und zukünftige Stellenangebot/e in der weltweiten Amazon Konzernpersonaldatenbank, die derzeit in den USA geführt wird, einverstanden.

title: Graduate Area Manager in Rheinberg, NW, Operations - Customer Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
• Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
• Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
• Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
• Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
• Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
• Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort


A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium vor dem Starttermin oder Abschluss innerhalb der letzten 24 Monate
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung

title: SLP Specialist INTL, Worldwide Operations Security
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented professional who wants to join our team as Security and Loss Prevention (SLP) Specialist. In this key role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of security operations, delivering concrete on-the-ground contributions through direct operational support to our sites. You will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Execute day-to-day security operations and conduct regular physical security checks at assigned sites
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external parties (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards

A day in the life
As an SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. Your daily focus will be on hands-on execution of security operations, including conducting physical security rounds, monitoring CCTV systems, and responding to immediate security concerns. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. You execute established procedures to address security incidents and implement approved solutions for identified vulnerabilities. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Sitting within the Worldwide Operations Security organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:
• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation
Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience in security services, asset protection, loss prevention, risk management, inventory management, investigations, supply chain, auditing, compliance, or similar

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in an industry role
- Experience managing contract security and physical security operation programs such as access control/intrusion detection and CCTV surveillance systems
- Experience in retail, warehouse, or manufacturing is preferred
- Experience working with data and leveraging analytics to make decisions
- Valid and active driver's license

title: Security Specialist, Data Center Physical Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a detail-oriented professional to join our team as a Data Center Security Specialist (DSS) supporting our data centers across mainland Japan. In this role, you will work collaboratively with Data Center Security Managers to ensure the effective implementation and maintenance of physical security procedures. You will support Data Center Security Managers in implementing security standards and operational procedures across assigned facilities while assisting in monitoring and maintaining physical security systems and controls. Your responsibilities will include helping prepare and maintain security documentation, standard operating procedures, and participating in security system testing and maintenance activities. You will contribute to the development of security awareness training materials and assist in delivering training sessions, as well as generate and analyze security metrics and incident reports to support management decision-making. Working closely with security vendors, you will help coordinate maintenance, repairs, and operational needs while supporting security improvement projects and initiatives as directed by Security Managers. This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in data center security operations while working alongside experienced Security Managers in a dynamic, technology-driven environment. Collaborate with peers and internal stakeholders, develop solutions that help your team meet objectives. Assist in creating mitigation plans for security events or unique operational activities. Additionally, recruit and interview new team members while actively mentoring others to foster a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.

title: Production Planning Analyst, EU Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, customer success drives our mission. The Production Planning Team optimizes capacity across Fulfillment Centers through innovative solutions planning. We seek diverse perspectives and experiences to strengthen our global operations and customer experience.

This role requires expertise to develop network-wide strategies and drive operational excellence. Collaborate with multiple business teams including FC operations, HR, finance , supply chain, transportation, work force staffing and others.

* Develop and execute short/medium/long-term operational plans to optimize staffing costs.

- Implementare programmi di sicurezza e salute sul lavoro e organizzare sessioni di formazione.
- Analizzare le metriche di sicurezza e le tendenze degli incidenti per aiutare i colleghi a pianificare le risorse appropriate nelle aree a maggior rischio.
- Effettuare audit per verificare la conformità del sito alla legislazione vigente in materia di sicurezza e salute e implementare soluzioni dove si identificano rischi.

A day in the life
Lavorerai in sede presso uno dei nostri siti, che può essere un centro di distribuzione, un centro di smistamento o una stazione di consegna. Essere sul posto ti permette di tenere sotto controllo i processi. Oltre ad aiutarci a mantenere la conformità in materia di sicurezza e salute, individuerai potenziali problemi e opportunità di miglioramento. Questo significa lavorare a stretto contatto con le persone di tutta l'azienda per conoscere i rischi che affrontano e raccogliere dati per identificare modi più intelligenti e sicuri di lavorare. Organizzerai anche programmi di formazione per aiutare tutti a seguire i nuovi processi di sicurezza e raggiungere nuovi standard.

About the team
Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. Indipendentemente dal tuo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'implementazione della strategia di sicurezza sull'intera rete.

Basic qualifications

title: Tech Recruiting Manager, Global Strategic Sourcing
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer focus company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

Would you like to be a central part of a recruiting team that is responsible for fueling the rapid business growth? Are you a builder? Do you thrive in high growth ambiguous environments? Are you a process oriented data driven recruiting leader that loves to dive deep to fix complex operational challenges allowing for greater scalability and global impact? We want you on our team!

This Sourcing Manager (tech) role will be responsible for working closely with various business stakeholders to define the sourcing strategy, generate high caliber talents and close top candidates; all within a fast-moving and super dynamic environment. You will have the opportunity to draw on your extensive knowledge of Talent Acquisition and functional areas of the business, and forge dynamic relationships with business leaders, hiring managers and HR business partners.

Key job responsibilities
Lead a team of tech sourcing recruiters to ensure that the team is able to meet their sourcing goals of volume, speed and quality
Work closely with recruiting partners to deeply understand organization structure, responsibilities, strengths/weaknesses and key business drivers. Utilize this information to develop most effective recruiting strategies
Build and maintain network of potential candidates through proactive market research and on-going relationship management, gauging chemistry of candidates for fit and motivation rather than simply sell a role. Meanwhile, manage to ensure all sourcing channels are sufficiently utilized, including but not limited to employee referrals, career portals, events, job fairs, etc.
Consult on ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the long-range growth of the company, implementing any new processes and fine tuning standard processes for recruiting that fits within Amazon's mission to deliver the highest quality results to the customer. Also, articulated in writing recruiting plans with deliverables, timelines and a formal tracking process
Manage well on all the data associated with the sourcing process. Possess data-driven thinking and systematic approaches in achieving the operation excellence
Emphasis on continuous improvement, as such it is expected that you will spend time to ensure ongoing education of sourcers on “best practices” in sourcing processes and better utilization of tools and resources available
Implement the recruitment tools/systems in region through active collaboration with global contacts

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing pipeline metrics and preparing for a strategy sync with one of your client partners. Mid-morning, you hold a one-on-one with a recruiter to discuss a tricky offer negotiation and share guidance on candidate engagement. After lunch, you facilitate a calibration session with interviewers, then shift focus to reviewing your team's progress against weekly goals. You wrap up by connecting with a new hire on your team to check in on their onboarding experience and answer questions about team processes.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of business analytics and reporting or demand forecasting experience
- 4+ years of Recruiting, HR or operations experience
- Knowledge of recruiting media such as job postings, job site aggregators, ATS and job distribution tools
- Experience partnering with senior leaders to deliver results
- Experience working with recruiting tools and systems, including resume databases, internet sourcing tools, and spreadsheets
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building, managing and coaching a team in a high-growth environment
- Experience driving process optimization within a recruiting or equivalent environment
- Experience in recruiting operations leadership within a high growth tech company or high-volume RPO organization

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

descriptionHtml:
Pay starts at $20.3 per hour with benefits available.

Reduced Time Hours: Average work between 30-39 hrs per week.

This role requires open availability BH 7:45-14:15.

As a Retail Lead Associate, you will be the face of Amazon and contribute to the culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, integrity, continuous learning, and fun. You possess strong attention to detail, the ability to quickly prioritize tasks, the willingness to learn new things, and a commitment to delighting our customers. You will assist with customer service operations and floor leader responsibilities.

Key job responsibilities
- Interact with customers by effectively using customer engagement strategies and model desired behavior for the rest of the team.
- Utilize inventory management systems to scan, process, and count product.
- Provide peer-to-peer feedback on processes and standards, serving as the escalation point to assist associate peers in solving customer issues, where appropriate.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of the customer experience and operations by participating in the development of best practices.
- Help identify and communicate barriers and trends that contribute to the customer and associate experience and support the manager in building a strong site culture.
- Work with a manager to maintain the physical safety and quality standards of the site.
- Work in a fast changing and ambiguous environment.
- Perform additional duties, as assigned
- Work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, as well as continuously climb and descend stairs.

About the team
Interested in joining our dedicated team at Amazon that makes the return of pickup and packages convenient for our customers at our Locker+ retail locations? Curious to be at the heart of where innovation meets customer obsession?

Customer Experience Operations (CXO) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with quality service in an ever-changing environment. Our goal is to go beyond assisting with customer orders. We strive to connect personally with our customers and uplift their lives – even if for just a few moments. We operate out of designated retail locations – where it’s convenient for our customers – helping facilitate the delivery and return of customer orders.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Are 18 years of age or older
- 1+ years retail or customer-facing, or 1+ years floor leader or other leadership, or 1+ years Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in training others

- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: IT Support Technician
descriptionHtml:
Chez Amazon, nous nous efforçons d'être l'entreprise la plus centrée sur le client au monde, où les clients peuvent trouver et découvrir tout ce qu'ils veulent acheter en ligne. Nous recrutons des talents passionnés et leur offrons un environnement où ils peuvent chaque jour améliorer l'expérience client. L'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre ADN et encouragées à tous les niveaux de postes.

En tant que technicien(ne) informatique, vous ferez partie d'une équipe dynamique qui maintient l'infrastructure informatique opérationnelle sur le site MRS1, ainsi que sur un réseau plus large de sites de la région. MRS1 traverse actuellement un projet de conversion robotique, ce qui ajoute à un environnement stimulant et en constante évolution. Vous rendrez compte au responsable informatique de votre site principal et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs, vos collègues et les équipes de support à distance afin de mettre en œuvre et de maintenir les éléments d'infrastructure. En complément du support sur site, vous apporterez une assistance à distance et vous vous déplacerez sur d'autres sites pour des déploiements de projets, de la maintenance préventive et du dépannage terrain. Vous représenterez le visage de l'informatique au sein de l'entreprise et contribuerez à offrir à nos clients internes un service fiable et de qualité.

Vous serez un élément clé d'une équipe multinationale diversifiée, toujours à la recherche d'améliorations.

Domaine d'activité : Opérations, Centre de distribution et logistique

L'équipe des Opérations Informatiques prend en charge l'infrastructure et les terminaux informatiques de MRS1 et des sites distants de la région, et fournit un support informatique à nos clients internes.

Qu'est-ce qui fait de cette équipe un endroit idéal pour travailler ?

Opportunités dès le premier jour : vous rejoindrez une équipe responsable de ce qui se passe après que le client clique sur « acheter ». Possibilités de croissance : vous aurez l'occasion d'influencer et de façonner l'orientation de nos services, notamment dans le cadre du projet de conversion robotique en cours sur le site. Vous participerez à des projets concrets avec la possibilité de développer vos compétences dans les domaines qui vous intéressent.

Ce que nous recherchons : en donnant la priorité aux clients, vous apporterez un support informatique de qualité qui garantit le bon fonctionnement de l'ensemble des équipements et infrastructures informatiques sur MRS1, ainsi que sur les sites distants de la région soutenus par votre équipe.

Key job responsibilities
- Support technique aux utilisateurs : assurer l'installation, la maintenance et la résolution des incidents liés à l'infrastructure informatique, aux équipements et aux applications des utilisateurs finaux, sur MRS1 et sur les sites distants de la région
- Gestion des demandes : traiter et suivre les tickets d'assistance jusqu'à leur résolution complète, dans les délais convenus, sur site comme à distance
- Maintenance préventive et déplacements terrain : effectuer une maintenance proactive sur le site principal et lors de déplacements réguliers sur d'autres sites de la région, pour des interventions de maintenance et de support technique
- Gestion des actifs : administrer l'inventaire du matériel informatique et des pièces de rechange
- Participation aux projets et astreinte : contribuer à la mise en œuvre de projets informatiques, notamment le projet de conversion robotique de MRS1, et participer à une rotation d'astreinte pour les incidents critiques en dehors des heures ouvrées


A day in the life
Votre journée commence par la revue des tickets ouverts et des incidents survenus pendant la nuit sur MRS1 ou sur un autre site de la région. Vous pourriez passer la matinée à dépanner un problème réseau sur site, puis basculer vers un support à distance pour un collègue d'un autre site, par téléphone. L'après-midi, vous pourriez préparer du matériel pour un projet à venir, effectuer de la maintenance préventive, ou contribuer au projet de conversion robotique en cours sur MRS1. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles du site, ainsi qu'avec vos collègues techniciens et ingénieurs IT, en ajustant vos priorités au fil des incidents : deux journées ne se ressemblent jamais vraiment.

Basic qualifications

- Compétences techniques : Maîtrise démontrée des équipements informatiques et des logiciels, notamment la suite Microsoft Office et les systèmes d'exploitation Windows, dans un contexte professionnel IT
- Expérience en support : Expérience confirmée dans un environnement de support technique informatique ou dans la gestion et l'approvisionnement d'actifs IT
- Aptitudes relationnelles : Capacité avérée à communiquer efficacement avec différents niveaux d'interlocuteurs, des collègues aux cadres dirigeants
- Mobilité : Possession d'un permis de conduire valide
- Compétences linguistiques : Excellente maîtrise de la langue locale, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit

Preferred qualifications

- Les qualifications préférées ne sont pas obligatoires pour postuler chez Amazon. Si vous possédez l'ensemble des qualifications de base mentionnées ci-dessus, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.
- Formation académique : Diplôme en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe
- Expertise réseau : Expérience dans la gestion d'infrastructures réseau
- Amélioration continue : Expérience démontrée dans l'optimisation de processus et de procédures existants
- Documentation technique : Capacité à élaborer une documentation claire, concise et structurée

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: (Physical) Security Specialist Intern - 2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

Amazon's data centers house the infrastructure that powers the world's largest cloud. Protecting them is mission-critical — and as a Security Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help ensure the physical security of these facilities from the inside.

You will drive operational security excellence, write reports, create presentations, and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Security Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Security Management, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

About the Role

As a Security Specialist Intern, you will work within the Data Center Security team and play a hands-on role in the day-to-day physical security operations of Amazon's data centers. You will collaborate with security vendors, analyze operational data, and help identify improvements to surveillance systems, access controls, and security procedures.

This is not a desk-only role. You will engage directly with the people, systems, and processes that keep Amazon's most critical infrastructure safe.

What You Will Do

- Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations and patrols, and planning.
- Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements
- Make suggestions on improving electronic surveillance systems and access controls
- Help develop and deliver guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms
- Write reports and create presentations on the status of physical security operations for management
- Assist with planning and coordinating security-related projects
- Support incident documentation and follow-up processes

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily at a location not served by public transport. A valid driving license and reliable personal transportation are essential for the daily commute. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that a full-time Security Specialist position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help protect the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

- Impact. Your work protects the physical infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. The security operations you support keep Amazon's most critical facilities safe and running.
- Action. You will move fast, analyze real security data, and make recommendations that get implemented. Your ideas do not stay theoretical — they get tested and put into practice.
- Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how physical security operates at world-class scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
- Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Risk Management, Business Administration, Security Management, or a related field, graduating in 2027/2028
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
- You must have access to your own transport (note: public transit options may be limited)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
- Interest in physical security operations, including surveillance systems, access controls, and incident response
- Interest in analyzing data to identify security gaps and recommend improvements
- Familiarity with security policies, procedures, and compliance frameworks

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon.
