title: Senior Supply Chain Manager, Rapid & Rural Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by solving complex network design problems at scale? Amazon's Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) Supply Chain team is looking for a Senior Supply Chain Manager to lead site selection and launch planning for our Sub-Same Day (SSD) delivery network. In this role, you will conduct topology analysis, evaluate real estate options, and develop jurisdictional proposals and volume plans that shape where and how we expand. Your recommendations feed directly into financial modeling and capital approval decisions, making your work a critical input to one of Amazon's fastest-growing delivery programs.

This is a high-visibility opportunity at an inflection point: the SSD network is preparing for its largest expansion yet, and the team is investing in scalable, automated launch and expansion processes to support rapid growth in the years ahead. You will partner with Finance, Real Estate, Operations, S&OP, and Delivery Experience (DEX) teams to turn data into actionable plans that get new sites open on time and on budget.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct topology analysis using demand estimation and optimization tools to develop jurisdictional coverage proposals and volume plans for new and existing metro areas.
- Partner with Finance and Real Estate to translate site proposals into financial payback models that support the site selection and capital approval process.
- Collaborate with S&OP, launch, and DEX teams to align demand forecasts, capacity allocation, and launch timelines across the network.
- Identify and implement process improvements that scale and automate the jurisdictional planning and launch functions, reducing manual effort as annual launch volume grows.
- Manage trade-offs across competing priorities — building size, coverage boundaries, timeline, and cost — and present clear recommendations to leadership.

A day in the life
You will spend much of your time working in optimization and planning tools, estimating zip-code-level demand and mapping it against real estate options to build the strongest possible site proposal. From there, you will join cross-functional working sessions with planning and launch teams to align on timelines and capacity targets. When a live coverage gap surfaces, you may step in to help resolve it quickly, but most of your work is proactive and roadmap-driven. Expect a mix of heads-down analytical work and collaborative problem-solving with partners across the organization.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
- Maternity and Parental Leave Options
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan  

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The R2L Topology team supports several initiatives at the core of Amazon's delivery strategy, including sub-same day, rural, and grocery fulfillment. Today the team is roughly 10 supply chain managers and is expected to more than double over the next year. We sit within the broader R2L Supply Chain team of nearly 200 supply chain managers and we partner closely with the demand planning and Speed organizations within DEX to ensure volume and capacity plans are optimized for the best customer experience and delivery speed. Joining now means you will help shape how we scale from dozens of launches per year to hundreds in the coming years.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- 5+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

title: Safety Technician
descriptionHtml:
Keeping our people safe and well at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in making this happen. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop through a global company. You’ll work closely with our experts to monitor your site, which means you’ll get to see the difference that you make to people’s well-being every day.

Key job responsibilities
- Carry out risk assessments and audits
- Monitor the site to make sure processes are in line with Amazon's safety procedures
- Create and update reports on safety metrics for colleagues to review
- Work with colleagues in Operations and across the business on safety-related tasks and offer guidance on processes
- Support in putting new safety measures in place

A day in the life
You'll be based at one of our sites. This means that you can closely track what's happening and people can easily ask you any questions throughout their shifts. This role is all about spotting potential issues before they happen. You'll spend a lot of time checking the site and getting to know the way that people use equipment. By understanding how every task and machine works, you'll be able to think about the best way to keep processes safe. You'll also be one of the people to put safety changes into action, which means you'll get to work closely with lots of people. Alongside your daily and weekly tasks, you'll offer support to our Operations team on ad-hoc safety-related work. Safety is so important to Amazon, and you'll help us gather the vital data that keeps us on top of our processes and ahead of any issues. You'll also share that data with people across the business and work with other teams to make sure they're putting safety first.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent)
- Experience running metrics reports, analyzing data to identify problems and using data analysis to generate and explain metrics
- Knowledge of UK Health & Safety Legislation and pertinent regulations
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Global Procurement Finance
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever ordered something on Amazon and, when the box arrived, wondered how it got to you so fast, where it came from, and what it cost Amazon to deliver it? Behind every one of those packages is a network of partners, routes, and contracts, and a set of decisions about who should move the freight and what it should cost.

Our Customer Fulfillment network is world-class, delivering to customers across the globe. Our Finance teams don't just manage the books; we help steer the company by partnering with global, cross-functional teams to drive controllership, innovation, productivity, and cost-effective operations in a fast-paced environment. You'll use data to make sure your partners and leaders have the most reliable, up-to-date information, and you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with them to make the best possible financial decisions.

We are the Global Procurement Office (GPO) Finance team. We decide, with our partners, which third-party logistics (3PL) providers Amazon works with, on what terms, and at what cost, across a multi-billion-dollar portfolio. We are passionate about numbers and about turning them into insight that moves the business. We are the trusted business advisors who bring the holistic financial perspective to procurement and operations leaders.

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to own the finance lens on our North America 3PL network. You should be excited to join a company that is constantly re-imagining the logistics industry, passionate about using data to solve big, ambiguous problems, eager to keep learning, and attentive to the details that make the difference. If you want to help shape the new standard of fulfillment, come join GPO Finance.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the finance view of Amazon's North America 3PL spend: analyze cost drivers at a granular level (productivity by process path, labor, rent, capex) and link operational metrics to financial outcomes to surface cost-improvement opportunities.

- Lead the cost analysis within 3PL tenders, from should-cost modeling and RFQ evaluation to bid comparison, so Amazon secures competitive cost and service on every award.

- Benchmark relentlessly, 1P vs 3P, region vs region, site vs site, and use the gaps you find to drive decisions and savings.

- Communicate data clearly and concisely in writing and verbally, leading with the number, the driver, and the recommendation. Your communications drive critical business actions.

- Earn the trust of your business partners to influence tactical and strategic decisions that reduce cost and improve service.

- Identify risks, quantify their impact, propose changes, and implement improvements to close gaps, exercising sound judgment in ambiguous environments where data is hard to procure.

title: Software Development Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the infrastructure that every AWS service depends on before it can start? The AWS Secrets Management team builds and operates the system that distributes credentials and certificates to AWS's internal service fleet. The system sits on the critical path for service startup, runs across every host in the fleet, and has zero tolerance for downtime. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design and deliver backend services, APIs, and the host agent that powers credential distribution at massive scale. You will also lead migrations that modernize how credentials are stored and delivered, build AI-agent-driven operational tooling, and help bring the system up in new AWS regions. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving hard distributed-systems problems with real, immediate impact, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement production backend services, APIs, and host-level agents in Java, Rust, C++, and Python that distribute credentials and certificates across AWS's internal fleet with high availability and zero downtime.
- Own end-to-end migrations of live, heavily depended-upon systems, preserving backwards compatibility while modernizing how credentials are stored and delivered.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated test coverage, and AI-assisted operational tooling — including agentic coding tools for triage and remediation — to keep a fleet-wide system operable at scale.
- Collaborate with security partner teams, product managers, and principal engineers on cross-team designs, participating in written design reviews and code reviews to ensure solutions meet security and reliability requirements.
- Drive operational excellence through metrics, alarms, incident response, and on-call rotations, identifying root causes and implementing permanent fixes to reduce operational burden over time.

A day in the life
Most of your time is heads-down: writing code, reviewing designs, and working through complex migration plans for systems that thousands of other services depend on. Collaboration is concentrated at key moments — design reviews where you present your approach, code reviews where you give and receive candid feedback, and incident response where your deep knowledge of the system makes you the person others turn to. You use AI-assisted engineering tools daily, both for coding and for operational triage, applying your judgment on when to trust their output.

About the team
The AWS Secrets Management team is responsible for credential and certificate distribution across AWS's internal service fleet. Our system is a dependency for a large number of AWS and Amazon services, which means the work we do is upstream of other teams' launches, migrations, and security commitments. We operate in an inclusive environment that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Engineers each own an area of the system outright — serving as the required reviewer, the go-to person during incidents, and the one who sets its technical direction. We are focused on modernizing credential delivery and expanding into new AWS regions, and we are looking for engineers who are excited to shape that future.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

The ideal candidate is a versatile writer who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, can flex their voice across formats and audiences, and is passionate about producing high-quality work at scale. You are equally comfortable owning a short-form social post and a long-form technical asset, and you sweat the details of brand voice, accuracy, and clarity. You also embrace AI as a creative partner, using it to amplify your output and work at scale.

We are a team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement. You will help us raise the bar on content quality while educating stakeholders and refining how we work.

Key job responsibilities
Write, edit, and proofread clear, engaging, on-brand copy across a range of formats: emails, landing pages, whitepapers, blog posts, social media, paid media, and short-form video scripts.

Use AI tools as a force-multiplier to accelerate drafting, editing, ideation, and production, raising both the quality and volume of content you can deliver at scale.

Partner closely with the production management team to align on priorities, timelines, and workflow, ensuring content moves smoothly through intake, review, and delivery.

Collaborate with designers, video producers, campaign managers, and product marketers to turn creative briefs and business goals into effective content.

Help steer and guide external agency partners who support our content production, providing clear direction, brand guidance, and feedback to ensure their work meets AWS quality standards.

Interpret briefs quickly, ask the right questions, and deliver polished copy against tight timelines while managing multiple concurrent requests.

Adapt tone, voice, and messaging for different audiences, channels, and stages of the customer journey.

Ensure all content adheres to AWS brand, style, and quality standards, and is consistent across touchpoints.

Incorporate feedback from reviewers and stakeholders, and contribute to continuous optimization of content and process.

Help educate partner teams on content best practices and the value the Content Studio delivers.

A day in the life
You'll pick up briefs from our intake queue, sync with production management on priorities and deadlines, and draft copy that a designer or video producer can bring to life. You might write a customer email in the morning, use AI tools to accelerate a first draft and free up time for higher-value creative work, refine a landing page headline before a mid-day review, and provide direction to an agency partner on a campaign asset in the afternoon, all while incorporating feedback and keeping brand voice tight. You'll join a short daily sync with the copy team to align on priorities and unblock work.

About the team
Content Studio is the primary creative production unit for AWS Marketing's digital content. We handle design, copy, video, social, paid media, email, whitepapers, landing pages, motion graphics, and blogs, with most of our output powering integrated, multi-channel campaigns. We work in an Agile methodology, using regular syncs, iterative delivery, and continuous feedback to move quickly and improve as we go. Our objectives: deliver world-class, customer-centric content at AWS quality standards; create brand-consistent experiences; scale delivery efficiently with continuous optimization; and grow our capability while educating our stakeholders. We work hand-in-hand with production management and external agency partners, and we lean into AI to work smarter and scale our impact.

- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
- Experience producing marketing promotional material for Owned & Operated channels
- Experience in brand identity and voice development
- Experience creating brand marketing content

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing external agencies
- Experience using content management systems and content tools
- Experience writing for B2B, technology, cloud, or enterprise audiences.
- Experience using AI tools (e.g., generative AI writing assistants) to increase productivity, quality, and scale.
- Experience partnering with cross-functional creative teams (design, video, production management, campaign, product marketing).
- Ability to translate complex or technical topics into clear, accessible, customer-centric language.

title: Controls Design Engineer, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an exceptional Controls Design Engineer to join our Data Center Global Services (DCGS) Controls Design Engineering (CDE) team. This role will focus on Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) design standards and coordination across AWS's global data center portfolio.

The Controls Design Engineering team is responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing global data center design standards with a focus on controls, automation, and electrical power monitoring systems. As the primary owner of BMS/EPMS specifications, Controls Points Lists (CPL), Basis of Design (BOD) documents, and scope of work within AWS's infrastructure engineering organization, CDE ensures consistency and excellence across all data center control systems.

In this role, you will serve as a single point of contact for multiple internal and external stakeholders across:
• New construction builds (Leased/Owned, Build-to-Suit, and Colocation facilities)
• Legacy site enhancement and retrofit projects
• Data center support projects
• Special initiatives and innovation projects

You will drive significant cost reductions by minimizing change orders, eliminating scope gaps between contractors, reducing construction schedule delays, optimizing vendor pricing, and decreasing project management and engineering labor costs through standardization and clear documentation.

The ideal candidate brings a comprehensive knowledge in data center environmental controls systems, IT infrastructure, networking, mechanical facility operations, electrical power monitoring, and project management, combined with strong leadership and collaboration skills.

If you are passionate about customer experience, think and act with a global perspective, and want to contribute to sophisticated innovations in building controls and automation for the world's largest cloud infrastructure, we want to hear from you.

Key Job Responsibilities:
Technical Leadership & Standards Development
• Develop and maintain deep expertise in building operations, mechanical plant strategies, BMS/EPMS programming concepts, control diagrams, industrial HVAC systems, electrical lineups, one-line diagrams, and complex environmental and electrical concepts
• Apply knowledge of data center redundancy, mechanical failure strategies, Single Point of Failure (SPOF) analysis, energy and water conservation best practices, and data reporting analytics
• Create, maintain, and disseminate specification documents and Basis of Design standards for global projects
• Develop and maintain project-specific Scope of Work (SOW) documents incorporating global design standards
• Drive innovation of new solutions to support team initiatives and company goals

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:
• Serve as the central point of contact for multiple internal and external groups regarding BMS/EPMS controls standards
• Lead and facilitate collaboration with construction teams, controls programmers, MEP/ACS engineers, Design Engineering, Colocation Regional Engineering (CRE), and project managers to accomplish initiative goals
• Coordinate personally with regional project managers to review and finalize project SOWs
• Manage and prioritize requests for information across new construction builds, existing facility support, and legacy site enhancement projects

Vendor & Procurement Management:
• Lead vendor selection processes, bid reviews, and RFI support and coordination
• Evaluate and approve Modbus Device Templates (MDT) for electrical meters and control devices
• Review vendor submittals and technical documentation for compliance with AWS standards

Operations & Support:
• Operate successfully in high-security, mission-critical environments while maximizing productivity and maintaining safety standards
• Interact with AWS cloud services and applications to present, archive, and analyze accumulated control system data
• Participate in on-call rotations to support the global data center control system infrastructure
• Anticipate roadblocks and risks while providing escalation management and resolution
• Travel globally as needed to manage and support project initiatives

Continuous Improvement:
• Collaborate through design reviews to drive consistent standards across all delivery methods (Leased/Owned, Build-to-Suit, Colocation)
• Collect feedback data and lessons learned to arrive at unified, documented solutions
• Support risk identification and mitigation efforts during site assessments and project lifecycle phases

Key job responsibilities
Our Controls Design Engineers:
• Are controls subject matter experts (SMEs) with their knowledge of building operations, electrical generation and distribution equipment (i.e. generators, UPS etc.), mechanical plant and strategies (i.e. AHUs, chillers etc.), BMS/EPMS programming concepts, control diagrams, industrial HVAC, electrical line-ups, one-line diagrams, and complex environmental and electrical concepts
• Create, maintain, and disseminate project specific scope of work (SOW) documents, specifications and engineering drawings as well as global design standards
• Operate in high security critical environments while maximizing productivity
• Innovate to develop new solutions to support both team and company goals and initiatives
• Interpret and develop a combination of mechanical, electrical and plumbing drawings
• Are a central point of contact as technical subject matter experts for multiple internal and external groups regarding mechanical and electrical controls standards.
• Manage and prioritize requests for information on new construction builds, existing site facilities support and legacy site enhancement projects
• Ensure systems are deployed and commissioned to our documented standards
• Strive for frugality through budgetary review and approval with a strong customer focus and ability to interpret customer needs
• Are technical subject matter experts in mechanical and/or electrical controls
• Anticipate roadblocks and risks while providing escalation management
• Work quickly and autonomously to deep dive and resolve unexpected challenges
• Effectively manage external consultants’ performance ensuring high quality delivery
• Review vendor bid packages and make selection recommendations
• Work across multiple projects simultaneously
• Interact with AWS cloud services and other applications in order to present, archive and analyse accumulated data
• Solve problems to drive results whilst handling multiple tasks
• Travel domestically and internationally as needed to manage your projects (circa 25% of the time)

A day in the life
As part of the controls design team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be tasked to lead the electrical and mechanical controls design of critical infrastructure projects including HV Substations, Leased and Colocation Data Centres. You will work on developing new processes and standards and test new innovations in the controls space utilizing Amazon leadership principles.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- 4+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Good understanding of electrical diagrams, control diagrams, building operations, control circuits, industrial HVAC

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
What if the data you engineer could stop fraud before it happens - and protect millions of AWS customers worldwide?
The Payments and Fraud Data Platform team within AWS Payments & Fraud is the backbone of one of the most critical missions at AWS: ensuring every transaction is safe, every suspension is justified, and every customer experience is seamless. We process petabytes of data daily, powering the ML models, rule engines, and real-time reporting systems that allow us to detect bad actors.
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is passionate about building large-scale data systems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to work at the intersection of big data, machine learning, non-payment and fraud prevention.

Key job responsibilities
Architect & Build Petabyte-Scale Data Pipelines - Design, develop, and optimize batch and near-real-time data pipelines using Amazon Managed Airflow (MWAA), Fargate, EMR, Apache Iceberg, and Amazon Redshift to ingest, transform, and serve data at massive scale.
Power ML & Rules Engines - Deliver high-quality, timely datasets that fuel non payment and fraud detection ML models and business rule engines, directly impacting fraud prevention and non-payment suspension accuracy.
Build Intelligent Data Access Layers - Design and implement a Smart Query & Data Access Analyzer that profiles query patterns, identifies hot data, and automatically promotes frequently accessed datasets into hot memory tiers (e.g., OpenSearch, DynamoDB DAX, Redshift RA3 caching) for sub-second retrieval.
Create Natural Language SQL Interfaces - Leverage Amazon Bedrock and LLM (large language models) to build a natural language-to-SQL generation tool that empowers analysts and stakeholders to query complex fraud datasets conversationally - no SQL expertise required.
Develop Real-Time Dashboards & Insights - Build rich, interactive dashboards using Grafana and internal tooling that provide real-time visibility into fraud trends, pipeline health, data quality metrics, and operational KPIs.
Curate a Living Data Dictionary - Design and maintain a comprehensive, searchable data catalog and dictionary that provides rich metadata, lineage, and documentation - improving discoverability and self-service analytics across the organization.
Champion Data Quality at Scale - Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the entire data lifecycle.
Secure & Govern Sensitive Data - Implement encryption, fine-grained access controls, audit trails, and compliance frameworks to protect highly sensitive payments and fraud data.
Monitor, Optimize, Repeat - Build observability into everything , proactive alerting, pipeline performance tracking, SLA monitoring, and intelligent auto-remediation to ensure five-nines data reliability.

About the team
The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team protects AWS and its customers from fraud, abuse, and account compromise at global scale. We build highly scalable, batch and near real-time systems that ingest billions of signals daily, process petabytes of data, and make timed decisions to stop bad actors from account registration through the entire customer lifecycle. Our platform is built on a modern, cloud-native architecture designed for petabyte-class batch processing. Our stack includes Amazon MWAA orchestrates workflows, while EMR and Fargate handle scalable data processing. Amazon Redshift powers our data warehouse, complemented by an Apache Iceberg lakehouse for open table format flexibility. DynamoDB and OpenSearch drives search and analytics, and Amazon Bedrock serves as our AI/ML foundation. Development is accelerated with Kiro, an AI-powered IDE, and Grafana provides full-stack observability.
We are a team of builders who care deeply about customer trust and love solving complex problems at massive scale.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
descriptionHtml:
Ready to do something big?

How would you build the next generation of mission-critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store, and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for worldwide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, leveraging our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces.

In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.

What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb_kp4&t=2s

The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team
https://vimeo.com/80948105


Third-party sellers have become one of Amazon's greatest growth engines, outpacing our own first-party retail business for years. That success did not happen by accident. We invested in building the best possible selling tools — from inventory management and payment processing to shipment tracking, reporting, and cross-border commerce — and we continue to invent new ones every year. FBA and the Prime membership program sit at the heart of that effort, dramatically improving the customer experience of buying from independent sellers and unlocking growth for businesses of every size.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager with FBA, you will lead broad cross-organization efforts from the early stages through release. You will work closely with product managers, engineering managers, scientists, and engineers to build the next generation of seller platforms. You will be responsible for influencing the organization's product and technical roadmap and technical architecture. You will drive organization-wide engineering and operational excellence initiatives, represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to senior leaders, and leverage your technical knowledge to guide technical choices. You will manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs are aligned, guiding technical direction to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead broad, cross-organizational programs from strategy definition through delivery, owning the technology roadmap for seller-facing platforms and driving alignment across product, engineering, and science teams.
- Define and decompose complex technical problems into clear solutions, assessing risk, driving clarity, and creating the right sense of urgency to keep programs on track.
- Influence the organization's product and technical architecture by applying deep system knowledge, identifying gaps across services and workflows, and proposing improvements that reduce repeated effort year over year.
- Partner with senior leadership to communicate trade-offs, present options, and drive decisions — managing cross-functional stakeholder alignment and escalating with strong judgment when necessary.
- Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, driving adoption of program management best practices, and contributing to the broader technical community.

A day in the life
Your primary focus will be guiding large-scale, cross-team programs that directly shape how millions of sellers interact with Amazon's fulfillment network. You will spend your time working across product managers, engineering leaders, and scientists — aligning priorities, unblocking technical decisions, and ensuring delivery stays on course. Expect a mix of deep technical design reviews, strategic roadmap discussions with senior leaders, and hands-on problem solving when programs hit ambiguity.

About the team
The FBA team builds and operates the platforms that enable sellers in 135 countries to store, ship, and manage billions of products through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our mission is straightforward: make sellers successful so customers get the selection and value they expect. We are investing in the next generation of seller tools and infrastructure, and this role will be central to shaping that future. If you want to work on programs that operate at massive scale and have a direct impact on both sellers and customers worldwide, this is the team for you.

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be
proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
Own technical direction and architecture. Set the target-state architecture and technical roadmap for large, multi-workstream migration and modernization programs, tied to the customer's business objectives and measurable success criteria. Design scalable, secure AWS solutions, including multi-account strategies, networking (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPN), identity and security controls.

Set the technical bar and resolve escalations. Chair architecture and design reviews, approve technical decisions, and set the standards AWS, customer and partner teams follow. Lead technical escalations and resolve complex problems across the infrastructure, application and data layers.

Deliver migration and modernization end to end. Lead engagements from discovery, assessment and wave planning through execution and post-migration validation for on-premises VM and physical server workloads. Choose the right 7R path for each workload, and drive modernization where lift-and-shift isn't feasible, through re-platforming, re-architecting, containers, serverless and database modernization.

Advise customer executives and grow the account. Act as the trusted technical advisor to customer CTOs, CIOs and architecture boards, and give clear trade-off recommendations at executive steering committees. Work with Engagement Managers on scope, estimates, risks and delivery plans, and with account teams to shape follow-on modernization opportunities.

Build teams and reusable capability. Lead and develop technical teams across AWS, customer and partner organizations, and hold partners to defined standards through design reviews and quality gates. Mentor consultants and architects, run technical enablement, and publish reusable artifacts, reference architectures, runbooks and accelerators for the wider practice.

Key job responsibilities

title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWS AI Engineering (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Software engineering is where AI is changing work fastest. Almost every developer now uses AI coding tools, yet only a minority of engineering organizations see meaningful gains from them. The AWS AI Engineering team exists to close that gap. We help AWS customers systematically build better software with AI, and we aspire to be the team builders worldwide turn to when they want to do exactly that.

This is a big opportunity to have impact. You will join at the point where AI-native development is moving from early adopters to the enterprise, working with some of the largest organizations in EMEA as they change how they build software.

As our Senior Technical Customer Solutions Manager, you will be the coordination hub for every AI engagement routed to the team across EMEA: qualifying inbound requests, assigning owners, keeping engagements moving from first contact to launch, and being the single point of contact that account teams and customers rely on for status. Your work does not end when a workshop is delivered: you own what happens next, making sure the customer turns what they learned into lasting change in how they build software. You will apply your program management expertise and technical fluency so that our AI Engineers can spend their time building and delivering.


Key job responsibilities
You will work with customers, account teams, solutions architects, AI engineers, partners and a broad community of AWS practitioners on some of the most challenging AI adoption problems today. You will:
- Own intake: qualify new requests, assess each customer's readiness and make sure every engagement has a named owner.
- Drive engagements end to end as the single point of contact for customers and account teams on progress, risks and outcomes.
- Meet customer executives and engineering leaders to agree business outcomes, and stay with the customer after the workshop until those outcomes are achieved.
- Run the team's operating rhythm and own its operational metrics.
- Reinvent how the team works with AI. You will not manage engagements through spreadsheets and status boards; you will use AI agents and automation to take manual work out of intake, staffing and follow-up, so every engagement takes less effort than the last.
- Stay hands-on: run demos and immersion days, and join workshops alongside practitioners.
Travel within EMEA may be required up to 25% of the time.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing new requests with an AI engineer and deciding the right path for each. Later you meet a customer CTO to agree what success looks like after their workshop, and follow up with an account team whose customer's adoption has stalled. You lead the team's weekly planning, and in between you improve one of the agents that handles routine follow-up, so there is less to chase next week.

About the team
Our flagship program is AI-DLC, the open-source, AI-native software development lifecycle that we created and continue to evolve with customers. We also lead AI-DLC Discovery, which helps product and business stakeholders decide what to build now that the time and cost of building have fundamentally changed, alongside offerings that give AI agents a deep understanding of large codebases and step customers towards autonomous software delivery.
We work from first principles and anchor everything on customer outcomes: measurable, lasting improvements in speed, quality and economics.

AI moves fast, and so do we. Our offerings evolve as the technology does, and you will thrive here if you enjoy adapting quickly and are comfortable with ambiguity.

Basic qualifications

- Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
- Experience in enterprise IT, either as a vendor, consultant or have prior experience working with or managing technical programs
- Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
- Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

Preferred qualifications

title: Sr Strategic Account Manager, AB - EU - UK Government
descriptionHtml:
Can you build trusted relationships with the most senior leaders in UK central government — and turn them into long-term, mission-shaping partnerships?

Do you want to shape how the public sector procures, in one of Amazon Business’s fastest-growing and most strategically important verticals?

This is a senior, high-visibility role for a proven operator who thrives in the room with the most senior leaders in Whitehall and wants to shape how the public sector procures.

Customers rely on Amazon for convenient access to millions of products delivered right to their doorstep. The Amazon Business team is reimagining that experience to fit the specific needs of the UK’s public sector — the central government departments, agencies, and arm’s-length bodies that run the country’s critical services, alongside local authorities, combined authorities, blue light services, and the wider public estate. From Whitehall departments and national agencies to councils, emergency services, and the metro-mayor combined authorities now taking on devolved budgets, these customers exist to serve citizens — and we exist to help them do it more efficiently, transparently, and cost-effectively.

Amazon Business helps public sector organizations reshape their procurement with cost and time savings, greater productivity, and insightful purchasing analytics. Customers benefit from a curated site experience, Business Prime, business-only pricing and selection, multi-user accounts, approvals workflows, purchasing system and framework integrations, payment solutions, dedicated customer support, and more. In an environment of constrained budgets, heightened scrutiny of public spend, and rising demand for frontline services, every pound saved on procurement is a pound that can be redirected to delivering for citizens.

B2B procurement is undergoing a digital transformation, and nowhere is the opportunity greater than across UK central government. As a Strategic Account Manager in the UK Gov team, you will own the most strategically significant customers in our book — including major central government departments — and help shape how Amazon Business shows up across the wider public sector. This is a senior, strategic role built for someone who can sit across the table from a Permanent Secretary, Director General, CDIO, CFO, or Commercial Director at a central government department and build a long-term, multi-year partnership rooted in their mission and their commercial and digital agenda — and who can raise the bar for how the rest of the team approaches strategic account development.

Credibility at the most senior levels of central government is central to this role. You will build and sustain relationships with senior stakeholders across Whitehall, translate departmental priorities into a compelling Amazon Business proposition, and influence procurement and digital strategy at the executive level. Being comfortable and effective in CxO and Permanent-Secretary-level conversations — earning the trust of senior civil servants and commercial leaders, and leading those conversations autonomously — is a key attribute for success.

It’s always Day 1 at Amazon. The UK Gov vertical is one of the most strategically important growth areas within Amazon Business, and we need a senior operator to bring their creative spirit, customer obsession, and best ideas to shape how we serve a sector that operates differently to commercial customers. You will help define the playbook, not just execute against it, and have a lasting impact on the way the UK’s public services are procured and delivered.

A successful Strategic Account Manager will be a confident, autonomous self-starter with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a track record of building strategic customer relationships at the most senior levels, and genuine curiosity about the operational and political realities of central government. You will be motivated by public impact as much as commercial outcomes — and will see no tension between the two. You will also be the kind of senior team member who lifts those around you, mentoring junior Account Managers and raising the standard of how we engage with the sector.



Key job responsibilities
Own C-suite relationships in central government — build executive-level relationships with the most senior stakeholders across UK central government departments and agencies (Permanent Secretaries, Director Generals, CDIOs, CFOs, Commercial Directors).

Own and grow a portfolio of the most strategically significant UK public sector customers — central government departments, local authorities, combined authorities, and blue light services.

Lead high-stakes commercial and strategic conversations autonomously, positioning Amazon Business against departmental priorities, spending controls, and transformation agendas.

Shape the UK Gov vertical strategy with the team lead, championing where Amazon Business can do more for customers.

Evolve the proposition to public sector realities — procurement frameworks (e.g. Crown Commercial Service), the Procurement Act, spend controls, and governance.

Engage emerging combined authorities and metro-mayor bodies taking on devolved budgets — a first-mover opportunity to shape platform needs.
Own strategic customer and territory planning; forecast accurately and represent UK Gov in leadership reviews.

Advise customers on Amazon Business solutions (100+) to free up frontline resources, and surface new product opportunities internally.

Maintain deep expertise on the UK public sector and competitive procurement landscape.

Mentor junior Account Managers and meet or exceed targets for customers and Amazon Business.

A day in the life
Most days blend deep customer work with cross-border teamwork. You might spend the morning prepping a QBR with a major central government department, jump into a Pan-EU sync with colleagues on public sector procurement, then talk strategy with a department's Commercial Director or CDIO about how Amazon Business supports their transformation agenda. You'll own your accounts autonomously while working as one team across five countries — mixing strategic planning, internal influencing, and time in front of senior customers.
Want to spend your career helping the organizations that serve UK citizens do more with what they have?



About the team
You’ll be part of the EU Public Sector team at Amazon Business, a tight-knit group of Account Managers and Account Executives covering the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and Spain. We are a small team with an outsized remit, working across five of Europe’s most distinctive public sector landscapes and learning from one another constantly. The culture is collaborative, ambitious, and unapologetically mission-driven — we genuinely care about the customers we serve, and we expect every member of the team to bring both commercial rigor and a real sense of purpose to the work.

title: Security Engineer-Pentest, Continuous Security Testing
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Security Engineer to join Continuous Security Testing (CST), the AWS team that thinks like an adversary against systems running in production. You will follow real-world signals to where testing matters most, work out what an adversary could do, and leave behind detections and tools that keep watch long after you've moved on.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud provider. Businesses of every size, from start-ups to large enterprises, run their most sensitive workloads on it. As AWS grows, the surface we need to test grows faster than any team could keep up with by effort alone. CST meets that by pairing deep human expertise with signal-driven, AI assisted testing, so coverage grows with AWS rather than falling behind it.

We work from real world signals, such as threat intelligence and automated scanner output, to decide where testing will matter most. We steer AWS's most advanced AI tooling to hold the bar, then apply human judgement to raise it: imagining how an adversary might combine behaviours nobody thought to put together, adding the business and service context a model lacks, and designing the abuse cases that still need a person.

This is creative work. The most valuable things we find are the ones nobody knew existed: new techniques, novel attack paths and ideas that no checklist or scanner would ever suggest. We want engineers who love asking "what if?" and following the answer wherever it goes.

You will decide where to look, as well as test what you're given. You must produce results in ambiguity, follow a signal wherever it leads, and drive resolution with teams outside your own when a fix isn't simple. You will deliver independently, ask for guidance when a problem moves into unfamiliar territory, and say clearly when a line of investigation should stop.

Amazon's Leadership Principles of "Dive Deep", "Ownership", "Earn Trust" and "Invent and Simplify" will be called on daily.

Key job responsibilities
- Turn real world signals, threat intelligence, scanner output and past findings into testable hypotheses about how an adversary might think about systems in production
- Test live AWS services and internal systems, combining penetration testing with AI-augmented source code review, and direct the tooling at trust boundaries and attack paths it would not reach on its own
- Bring creativity to every investigation: invent new techniques and research areas nobody has explored yet
- Investigate whether something novel you've uncovered could apply across other systems, then prove or rule out impact end to end with safe, reproducible proof-of-concept work
- Trace attack paths across chained components to show compound risk that stays invisible when each component is tested alone
- Take each finding to a resolution: work with service teams, SecOps and AppSec on the fix, validate it, and check the fix can't be bypassed
- Turn what you find into lasting defences, such as detections that run across the fleet, security canaries, fuzzers and documented methods, and track whether other teams adopt them
- Build and tune the harnesses that steer the team's AI testing tools, measuring where they miss attack patterns or produce false positives
- Test agentic AI systems as an adversary would, including tool use, memory, agent-to-agent communication and orchestration
- Write clear results that record what you tested, why, what you found or ruled out, and the risk that remains
- Peer review other engineers' scopes and findings, and mentor engineers and apprentices on the team

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cluster of real world signals that hint at something nobody has looked at yet. You form a hypothesis: if one system could be built this way, could others? You point the team's AI tooling at the source code to find candidates, then test the most promising ones by hand.

By the afternoon you've tested your hypothesis on one system and know exactly what an adversary could or couldn't reach. Now the question is scale. You write a query to see whether it could apply more widely, prove or rule out the worst cases safely, and agree priorities with SecOps and the service teams that own them.

Over the following weeks you stay with it. You review the proposed fix and check it can't be bypassed. You work with a detection team to turn your test into a check that runs across the fleet without you, so what you discovered keeps protecting AWS wherever it might appear.

In between, you review a peer's scope before their testing starts, help an apprentice through their first proof of concept, and share what you learned with the team so others can build on your idea.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores
Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
- Perform offensive testing of web applications and services, and source code review, to identify non-trivial issues
- Script your way out of problems and deploy code in an enterprise environment
- Experience with AWS technologies and services (e.g. S3, Lambda, EC2, KMS, IAM)
- Be data-driven and support your conclusions with evidence
- A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Experience in professional penetration testing, source code auditing, bug hunting, or CTF experience
- Demonstrable depth in at least two complex security domains such as identity and access management (IAM), web application and API security, networking, or workload and tenant isolation
- Experience finding security issues in multiple languages, including one or more of Java, Python, JavaScript, Rust, Ruby and C
- Experience in code development using Python or an equivalent language, including boto3

Preferred qualifications

- Experience turning a single finding into a campaign or detection across many systems
- Experience using AI tools or LLMs to scale security research, and judging where they fall short
- Experience working with threat intelligence or detection teams
- Experience performing or supporting Red Team engagements
- Experience running an initiative such as a CTF or an apprenticeship

title: Senior Global Engineering Program Manager – Building Controls & Automation, GREF – Design, Sustainability & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team is seeking an innovative and experienced Sr Global Engineering Program Manager – Building Controls & Automation to lead the technical strategy, standards, and optimization of mechanical and Building Management Systems (BMS)/Controls across our global corporate office portfolio. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for a mechanical or controls engineering specialist. You will own the mechanical and building automation backbone (HVAC, central plant, BMS/BAS, sequences of operation, fault detection) for the global GREF portfolio, while partnering across the broader MEP disciplines.

The ideal candidate combines deep, demonstrable expertise in mechanical systems and building controls with strong leadership and strategic thinking. You are fluent in the language of open-protocol building automation — BACnet, Modbus, Niagara/Tridium — and you can read a sequence of operations, interrogate a controls submittal, and diagnose why a system is not performing. You will develop and execute global engineering initiatives that enhance workplace environments, improve operational efficiency, and advance sustainability goals, navigating complex stakeholder relationships and making data-driven decisions that balance innovation with cost-effectiveness at a global scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Standards & specifications — Develop and maintain global controls/BMS and mechanical design standards, guidelines, and specifications — including sequences of operation, points lists, and naming/tagging conventions — for new construction and retrofits.
- Automation architecture — Define open-protocol BMS architecture (BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus, Niagara/FOX, MQTT), network topology, and integration; partner with InfoSec and IT on OT network security and data governance.
- Operations & maintenance — Lead operational guidelines and SOPs for mechanical systems, controls, and equipment.
- Performance & FDD — Establish fault detection & diagnostics, trending, and analytics to drive optimization and energy efficiency across the portfolio.
- Technical leadership — Provide SME support to regional teams on complex mechanical and controls issues, including commissioning, Test and Balance (TAB), and root-cause failure analysis.
- Lifecycle & modernization — Develop strategies for equipment lifecycle management, preventive maintenance, and system modernization.
- Sustainability — Advance corporate environmental goals through mechanical and BMS initiatives.
- Technology & innovation — Evaluate and recommend new building systems, controls, and smart-building technologies.
- Metrics & vendors — Set KPIs and track portfolio improvements; partner with procurement on equipment/controls-vendor standards, qualification, and performance.
- Strategy & growth — Support due diligence for acquisitions and renovations, deliver technical training, and shape long-term strategy and capital planning.

About the team
The GREF Global Engineering team drives continuous improvement for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems across Amazon's corporate office portfolio worldwide. We set design and construction standards, develop operations and maintenance guidelines, and shape long-term MEP strategy — balancing innovation, sustainability, and cost-effectiveness at global scale. Our team thrives on diverse expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and data-driven decision-making to deliver resilient, high-performing workplaces. We're looking for technical leaders who challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to complex building system challenges.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 6+ years of experience in building systems engineering

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes
- Professional Engineering (PE) license
- Certifications such as LEED, PMP, CEM, and/or HBDP.
- Deep hands-on experience with BMS/BAS platforms and open protocols — Tridium/Niagara (FOX), BACnet, Modbus — including programming, commissioning, and integration.
- Experience with fault detection & diagnostics (FDD) and building analytics platforms (e.g., SkySpark) and using building data to drive optimization.
- Experience with OT network architecture and building-systems cybersecurity/InfoSec coordination.
- Experience directly related to the design or construction of commercial office buildings.
- Experience managing engineering programs for large, global real estate portfolios.
- International project experience.

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:
• Medium and low voltage power systems
• Generators
• UPS
• HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
• Chilled Water Systems
• Building Management systems (BMS)
• Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
• Testing and balancing
- Pumps and Hydronic systems

Key job responsibilities
As the Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will provide testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. This includes, but not limited to, review of design documents and equipment submittals, leading Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and managing third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. You will own your projects’ successes where you Deep Dived to resolve technical issues and had Bias for Action to address schedule impacts and coordination demands onsite. You will be sharing your lessons learned leading towards team growth and program improvements.

You will get the opportunity to provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. During commissioning, you will be continuously auditing Cx vendors’ activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Following the AWS project reporting format, you will be responsible for regular reporting of commissioning progress and metrics of assigned project to your Regional Commissioning Manager. You will have the opportunity to lead several projects simultaneously to achieve key milestones and deliver data center capacity, while monitoring project budget as approved by Finance.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to execute functional tests, identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:

Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. - Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
