Law Enforcement Response (LER) Specialist

Level 5 • Legal Operations & Compliance • Amazon India
Role LER Specialist (Paralegal II)
Level L5 — Individual contributor with team leadership
Team Law Enforcement Response (LER), India
Location Delhi NCR, India
Work model Full-time · Work From Office
People management Leads a team of 3 associates
Experience 6–10 years of relevant experience




About the Role
Amazon is searching for a smart, motivated specialist to join its Law Enforcement Response (LER) team in India. The LER team is a dedicated group of specialists responsible for receiving, reviewing, and responding to law enforcement requests — such as notices, summons, and court orders — received from government agencies and police authorities across different Amazon India entities.

As an LER Specialist, your principal duty is to ensure that these requests are processed professionally and expeditiously, while safeguarding the privacy and security of business and customer information in accordance with the law and with Amazon’s policies and procedures. The role sits at the intersection of law[ and demands sound judgment in challenging and ambiguous situations.

This is a high-judgment, high-ownership role. You will lead a small team, serve as a trusted point of contact for law enforcement officers, and help Amazon meet its legal obligations in India’s rapidly evolving regulatory landscape. Candidates must be self-motivated, have a strong work ethic, and be able to work independently — at times with little supervision.




Key Job Responsibilities

• Triage high request volumes. Receive, log, and process law enforcement information requests arriving through multiple channels, internal portal, the dedicated police-inquiries mailbox, the government portals.

• Respond lawfully and accurately. Evaluate and respond to each request in a manner consistent with the privacy and security of business and customer information, and in accordance with the law and with Amazon’s policies and procedures.

• Meet urgent SLAs. Triage and close requests in line with established SLAs and SOPs, recognizing that delayed responses can result in loss of customer trustin customers losing funds; periodically receive and process emergency requests on a set rotation, including outside normal business hours and sometimes overnight.

• Manage external stakeholders. Communicate verbally and in writing with law enforcement officers, Amazon employees, and others — including significant phone-based coordination with officers who follow up on submitted requests. Explain what information Amazon can and cannot legally share, and guide officers on legally compliant intake formats (e.g., Section 94 BNSS notice requirements).

• Lead a team. Manage and develop a team of 3 associates who actively process requests; help lead the training and development of other LER specialists.

• Coordinate internally. Work with internal Amazon partner teams — some of whom run data queries to retrieve relevant information — and apply familiarity with data-retrieval concepts to challenge or validate the outputs you receive.

• Use the right tools. Use a combination of web-based applications and data-extraction tools to compile information potentially responsive to a particular request.

• Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, compliance playbooks, and process documentation

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows and partner with engineering/product teams to develop tools and automation for legal compliance processes

• Spot patterns. Assist in the identification of patterns and trends evident from the processing of certain law enforcement requests, and handle the most complex and challenging requests and special projects.

• Authenticate evidence. Sign and issue certificates / letters to authenticate digital evidence in response to law enforcement requests.

• Represent Amazon. Travel periodically, including on short notice, to represent Amazon in courts and law enforcement offices as required.



A Day in the Life

You will start your day reviewing incoming law enforcement requests from government agencies for validity, scope, and compliance requirements. You will exercise independent judgment to determine appropriate responses, balancing legal obligations with customer privacy and data security. Because a large share of information requests you will lean on your team to keep the queue healthy, partner with internal data teams to retrieve and validate information, and escalate the genuinely hard calls. It is fast-paced, operationally intense work where clear judgment and calm, credible communication make all the difference.




Basic Qualifications

• 6–10 years of relevant experience (e.g., law enforcement / regulatory response, legal operations, compliance, trust & safety, or high-volume operations).
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent work experience.
• Excellent English-language communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong judgment.
• Experience working in fast-paced environments and managing workload even during times of stress or escalated activity.
• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to demonstrate sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
• Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities at once.
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with colleagues and manage external stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience responding to, or making, requests from law enforcement agencies.
• Demonstrated experience managing external law enforcement or regulatory communications.
• Familiarity with high-volume operational tools and data systems; comfort with data-retrieval concepts (SQL proficiency is not required).
• Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Written and/or verbal proficiency in Hindi and/or any other Indian language.
• Background in e-commerce, banking and financial services, or technology companies with trust & safety functions (e.g., Meta, Google).

Note: An LLB qualification is not required for this role.



What Sets a Strong Candidate Apart

The differentiating competency for this role is the ability to build trust with law enforcement officers while professionally pushing back. Officers can be demanding or aggressive, follow-ups come at all hours — including over weekends — and the right person stays composed, credible, and firm on what the law permits.
• Builds genuine rapport with officers while holding the line on Amazon’s legal and privacy obligations.
• Guides officers toward legally compliant intake formats (e.g., Section 94 BNSS notices) rather than simply rejecting flawed requests.
• Exercises independent, defensible judgment on complex and novel request types.
• Owns outcomes end-to-end and raises the bar for the team through coaching and clear process.

Additional Information
• Rotation & on-call. This role includes a set rotation to receive and process emergency requests outside normal business hours, including overnight and weekends.
• Background check. Given the sensitive nature of the work, candidates should expect a thorough background check. A strong track record of handling confidential information with discretion is a differentiator.
• Education. An LLB is not required; demonstrated experience managing law enforcement or regulatory communications is valued over a specific educational background.
• Location & work model. Full-time, Work From Office, based in Delhi NCR, India.



Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other legally protected status. We believe building a team that reflects the communities we serve makes us better at protecting them.


Key job responsibilities
• Evaluate and respond to law enforcement requests in a manner consistent with the privacy and security of business and customer information, in accordance with the law and with Amazon's policies and procedures
• Ability to periodically (on a set rotation) receive and process emergency law enforcement requests both during and outside of normal business hours, and sometimes overnight
• Utilize a combination of web-based applications and data extraction tools to compile information potentially responsive to a particular law enforcement request
• Communicate verbally and in writing with law enforcement personnel, Amazon employees, outside counsel, and others
• Assist in the identification of patterns and trends that might be evident from the processing of certain law enforcement requests
• Handle the most complex and challenging law enforcement requests, as well as special projects
• Help lead the training and development of other LER specialists
• Travel periodically, including on short notice, to represent Amazon in courts and law enforcement offices, as required.
• Sign and issue certificates/letters to authenticate digital evidence in response to law enforcement requests

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity
- Experience in business development and building strong client relationship
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills and judgment
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate with colleagues
- Excellent organizational skills, and ability to work independently and manage multiple projects at once
- Ability to demonstrate sound judgment even in ambiguous situations

Preferred qualifications

- Experience responding to requests from law enforcement agencies
- Experience in making and/or responding to law enforcement requests
- Experience with computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Written and/or verbal proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Hindi

title: Campaign & Creative Manager II, Live Event Ad Services
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for a highly motivated Campaign and Creative Manager who is passionate about helping our advertisers make effective, analytically driven marketing decisions. Change the world as our advertiser’s “go-to” experts on Amazon Advertising’s policy, process, creative services and retail business.

Impact and Career Growth:

- Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions
- Develop never-been-done-before executions with advertisers and internal partners during the pre-sales stage
- Establish and standardize creative and operational best practices with advertisers to drive creative performance and provide frustration-free campaign launches
- Grow and broaden your skills as you work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the planning and delivery of high quality advertiser engagements to educate advertisers on Amazon policies and creative best practices to positively impact campaign performance within the Live Events space
- Project managing the execution of complex Live Event advertising campaigns with internal Design, AdOps, Sales, Quality Assurance and Account Management teams as well as external stakeholders
- Consulting with advertisers on creative strategy using historical advertiser and industry data
- Manage the troubleshooting of sometimes complex issues surfaced during the campaign life-cycle
- Dive deep on data to develop and manage process and product improvement projects with internal and external stakeholders to improve cross-vertical/cross-locale efficiency

You will earn trust and foster frustration-free advertiser experiences through seamless project management of campaigns, data-driven creative strategy recommendations and ongoing advertiser education, all aimed at helping advertisers grow their business on Amazon while upholding our end customers’ experience. You will work with our partners to deliver results that matter to our advertisers for long-term growth. This means diving deep on creative data, recommending creative testing, and providing creative insights to our advertisers. CCMs provide efficient and accurate campaign management while identifying opportunities to continuously improve our workflows and implement best practices across teams. The role provides a fast-paced environment that offers team members continual opportunities to learn, be curious and develop their skills.

About the team
If you love sports, solving big-customer problems and have a passion for new technology in the media space, then this role is an amazing opportunity that lies at the intersection of your interests. With broadcast agreements around the world including the NFL’s Thursday Night Football in the US, The English Premier League in the UK and The French Open (Roland-Garros) in France, Amazon Prime Video is delivering the future of Live Sports for our Prime customers. Advertising is a crucial part of our success in Live Sports and at Amazon Advertising, we sit at the intersection of advertising and eCommerce. - Experience with annual brand and media planning
- Knowledge of MS-Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in e-commerce or online advertising
- Experience delivering innovative entertainment experiences (inclusive of live events) to large audiences

title: Applied Scientist , Customer Experience and Business Trends
descriptionHtml:
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is looking for an Applied Scientist to join their team. CXBT's mission is to create best-in-class AI agents that seamlessly integrate multimodal inputs, enabling natural, empathetic, and adaptive interactions. We leverage advanced architectures, cross-modal learning, interpretability, and responsible AI techniques to provide coherent, context-aware responses augmented by real-time knowledge retrieval.

As part of CXBT, we have a vision to revolutionize how we understand, test, and optimize customer experiences at scale. Where traditional testing approaches fall short, we create AI-powered solutions that enable rapid experimentation, de-risk product launches, and generate actionable insights, all before a single real customer is impacted.

Be a part of our agentic initiative and shape how Amazon leverages artificial intelligence to run tests at scale and improve customer experience.
As an applied scientist, you will research state-of-the-art techniques in agent-based modeling, and lead scientific innovation building foundational agentic simulation capabilities.

If you are passionate about the intersection of AI and human behavior modeling, and want to fundamentally influence how Amazon tests and improves customer experiences, this role offers a great opportunity to make your mark.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement frameworks for multi-modal content handling and creating representative, diverse agents that faithfully capture real-world characteristics
- Use state-of-the-art techniques in user modeling and behavioral simulation to build robust agentic frameworks
- Research and implement novel algorithms and modeling techniques.
- Acquire and curate diverse datasets while ensuring user privacy.
- Create robust evaluation metrics and test sets to assess language model performance.
- Innovate in data representation and model training techniques.
- Apply responsible AI practices throughout the development process.
- Write clear, scientific documentation describing methodologies, solutions, and design choices

A day in the life
Our team is dedicated to improving Amazon's products and services through evaluation of the end-to-end customer experience using both internal and external processes and technology. Our mission is to deeply understand our customers' experiences, challenge the status quo, and provide insights that drive innovation to improve that experience. Through our analysis and insights, we inform business decisions that directly impact customer experience as customers of new GenAI and LLM technologies.

About the team
CXBT is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings – for almost every business at Amazon – for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, employees, investors, streamers, gamers).

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- PhD or equivalent research experience
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application

Preferred qualifications

- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl
- Deep expertise in multimodal AI systems combining vision and language models and designing and building LLM-based agent systems

title: Engineering Operations Technician , DCEO
descriptionHtml:
How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer-centric company? You would work with teams of front-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most Customer Centric data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation.

AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT’s) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market.

We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule including night shift. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

About the team
This position is for back half night shift. We work Wednesday through Saturday from 6pm to 6am. There is a shift differential for night shift.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Senior Product Designer, Comms Tech
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an ambitious Senior Product Designer to join the Communications Tech team that builds products to boost the productivity and efficiency of Amazon's global Communications organization. This role will have high impact, senior leadership visibility, several engineering teams to influence, and ownership over the end-to-end product design of tools communications professionals need to do their jobs. 

A Designer with previous experience and interest in the media (social and traditional), communications, and public relations fields is a significant positive. 

The Senior Product Designer role needs to be both capable and interested in being deeply in the weeds on product design, while also force-multiplying across dozens of colleagues. Amazon's Communications organization is primarily non-technical—the Designer needs to be comfortable with non-technical stakeholders, and obsessed with making complex, data-heavy products as simple as possible to use.

The ideal candidate can juggle competing priorities across projects and stakeholders without losing the thread of what’s best for the customer. They know how to present ideas professionally through a strategic and creative lens. They approach design through an AI-native mindset, actively integrating AI tools and capabilities into their research and delivery to move faster and raise the quality of their output. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. The Senior Product Designer will embed alongside engineering teams, conduct research, define interaction models, produce designs, and iterate based on how real users actually work. 

Key job responsibilities
- Passionate about creating elegant, simple to understand designs.
- Lead design strategy and deliver solutions from concept through launch, using AI-assisted prototyping to compress the gap between idea and testable artifact.
- Partner deeply with engineering. Work closely with engineers to ensure designs are technically feasible, production-ready, and aligned with underlying system architecture.
- Continuously adopt emerging AI capabilities into your design workflow to increase speed and quality of output.
- Influence product direction by identifying design opportunities, producing functional prototypes to validate assumptions, and shaping roadmaps with product and business leaders.
- Develop working prototypes to learn and fail fast. 
- Partner with product and business teams to plan and balance immediate requirements with long-term, scalable solutions. 
- Proactively manage your own work queue, time, and expectations. Meet deadlines and communicate needs and tradeoffs if your schedule is in jeopardy. 

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of design experience
- Experience with design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign and prototyping in HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Ajax
- Experience prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with UX design of complex workflows
- Experience with data-heavy, consumer-facing products

descriptionHtml:
Do you enjoy translating data into actionable insights? Are you excited by the opportunity to troubleshoot features and products at the world's most customer-centric company? Are you passionate about mining data, developing models, using statistical and visualization techniques, and helping leaders make data-driven decisions? Do you want to be a part of a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and contribute to one of the most visited sites on the Internet?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Business intelligence Engineers use innovative technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.

NOTE: By applying to this position, your application may be considered for all Business Intelligence Engineer roles at all locations we hire for in the United States including but not limited to: Greater Seattle Area (Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond), Greater Bay Area (San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara), Greater DMV (DC, MD, VA), Austin (TX), New York City (NY), Minneapolis (MN).

Key job responsibilities
As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will/may:
- Build small- to mid-size business intelligence (BI) solutions – data sets, queries, reports, dashboards, analyses – or components of larger solutions to answer business questions with data
- Use well-defined requirements to build a solution that enables effective, data-driven business decisions. Deliver end product on schedule

A day in the life
The challenges Business Intelligence Engineers solve for at Amazon are big and impact millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. Our path is not always simple, so we are selective about who joins us on this journey. There is a certain kind of person who takes on this role at Amazon – someone who is excited by the idea of creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company whose ship cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow.

At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact individual you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.

How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift

title: Applied Scientist, Fauna Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Robots are about to step out of the movies and into our homes. If you're excited about this robotics revolution, come join Amazon's Fauna Robotics. As an Applied Scientist in this org, you'll push the state-of-the-art techniques in Robotics. You'll drive technical excellence in areas such as perception, manipulation, sim2real transfer, reinforcement learning and multi-task learning, designing novel algorithms that bridge the gap between research and real-world deployment.

In this role, you will integrate hands-on technical expertise with scientific leadership, ensuring your team delivers robust solutions for dynamic real-world environments. While staying updated with the latest advancements in robotics research, you will leverage your experience and expertise to guide the team towards the most promising direction. Collaborating with a talented group of software engineers and scientists, you will bring your ideas to fruition. Deploying robots in home environments requires you to anticipate challenges not encountered in structured settings like warehouses. Additionally, consumer-grade sensors and actuators necessitate working around their limitations, requiring out-of-the-box innovative ideas. As such, you are someone who truly enjoys thinking about problems using first principles at a holistic and systems level to address the aforementioned challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead technical initiatives in areas such as robotics foundation models, reinforcement learning and manipulation - - Design experiments to identify the limitations of current state-of-the-art models and developing new models or techniques that can surpass these models
- Design and implement novel deep learning architectures that push the boundaries of what robots can understand and accomplish
- Mentor fellow scientists while maintaining strong individual technical contributions
- Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize and scale models for real-world applications
- Influence technical decisions and implementation strategies within your area of focus
- Experienced in communicating complex technical work to a non-technical audience
- The ability to work with minimal guidance, be proactive and to handle ambiguity and the challenge of quickly evolving goals

A day in the life
- Train ML models for deployment in simulation and real-world robots, identify and document their limitations post-deployment
- Drive technical discussions within your team and with key stakeholders to develop innovative solutions to address identified limitations
- Guide fellow scientists in solving complex technical challenges, from sim2real transfer to training RL policies
- Mentor team members while maintaining significant hands-on contribution to technical solutions

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- PhD, or Master's degree and 3+ years of applied research experience
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning
- Strong publication record at major Robotics/CV conferences (e.g., RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV)

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer, Agentic Workspaces
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon WorkSpaces has protected and empowered enterprise work for over a decade and we are now reimagining what a workspace is. We are building Agentic WorkSpaces: a platform where the workspace itself is an active partner in how you work not just infrastructure that delivers applications. Today more than a million users rely on WorkSpaces daily; tomorrow those workspaces will host AI agents alongside humans agents that code, troubleshoot, analyze, and act on behalf of their users governed by the same identity and security policies as the people they serve. We compete with Microsoft Citrix and Omnissa and we intend to leapfrog them by building the workspace that was designed for the agentic era not retrofitted for it.

Agentic WorkSpaces' Data Plane is the connective tissue that makes this possible: the single entry point through which every WorkSpaces connection flows and the streaming backbone that delivers the desktop experience once a session begins. We own the end-to-end pre-session journey authentication across every identity method, session authorization, resource discovery, gateway selection, and cross-region failover as well as the in-session streaming stack that carries pixels to the user and the pipeline that delivers workspace health and performance metrics back to our customers.

Our vision is for that connection to be seamless and invisible: users and the agents working beside them reach their workspace instantly and securely sessions stream with high fidelity and low latency failover is transparent and the health of every connection is observable through the same AWS tools customers already use delivered reliably from commercial regions to classified partitions at a scale where availability and security are non-negotiable.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design build and operate the services that authenticate authorize connect and stream WorkSpaces sessions for humans and increasingly for the AI agents that work beside them across every supported identity provider and streaming protocol. You will own end-to-end delivery of features and systems within the Data Plane from design through deployment and operations holding a high bar for availability latency and security on the services that stand between every customer and their workspace.

You are customer-obsessed technically deep and energized by solving hard problems. You think big about what the workspace of the future looks like a connection fabric that treats humans and agents as first-class principals streaming that adapts intelligently to network conditions and brokering that routes and heals itself before users notice a problem and then you build the systems to get there.

You thrive in ambiguity make sound trade-off decisions with incomplete information and hold yourself accountable for results that matter. You want to solve challenging problems in distributed systems identity real-time streaming and network infrastructure at a scale that impacts more than a million users daily.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and deliver features and systems within the Data Plane contributing to the architecture strategy for how the connection and streaming layer evolves to broker and stream sessions for AI agents alongside human users.
• Drive the work that unifies and simplifies how sessions are brokered and streamed across protocols making a consistent high-fidelity connection experience the default. Partner with compute identity providers networking and gateway teams earning trust by driving technical discussions that result in impactful architectural decisions.
• Design and implement pre-session authentication authorization and governance for a world where humans and agents share the same connection path: identity integration across every authentication method session authorization and access policies that treat agents as first-class principals and a security posture built in rather than bolted on.
• Own the operation of low-latency high-availability brokering and streaming services that are the single entry point for more than one million WorkSpaces users globally. Ensure your services meet stringent SLAs across multiple production regions AWS partitions and streaming protocols with self-healing routing transparent cross-region failover and autonomous issue resolution before customers are impacted.
• Drive engineering excellence through instrumentation automated testing and pipeline-based deployment eliminating manual toil and delivering a consistent connection and streaming experience across every protocol. Think big about the agentic era and experiment boldly with AI-powered capabilities such as intelligent gateway selection self-diagnosing connections and AI-assisted operational management.
• Raise the bar on connection reliability and observability so that authentication session brokering high-fidelity streaming and customer-facing metrics are delivered without imposing an operational tax on the customer or the agent workflows running on the desktop.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: EMEA Payroll Compliance Manager, Global Payroll Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for an experienced Payroll Compliance Manager to join our EMEA Payroll Compliance team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring payroll compliance across EMEA countries. You will proactively identify and mitigate payroll compliance risks, and lead responses to regulatory inspections and audits. You will also work with Payroll Tech stakeholders to build scalable process improvements and transformation mechanisms that raise the compliance bar and protect Amazon's employees and the business.

This role offers a unique blend of regulatory depth, cross-border complexity, and technology-driven innovation — ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex compliance challenges at scale. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of payroll operations, human resource, benefits and employment tax and legal. You will work across countries, and across functions to ensure that every employee is paid accurately and in full compliance with local laws.


Key job responsibilities
• Proactively monitor payroll compliance and regulatory updates at a regional level, communicate their impact on business and payroll operations and update policies accordingly.
• Lead proactive compliance assessments across EMEA payroll operations, identifying risks in Social Security contributions, tax withholding, and statutory reporting before they become regulatory findings.
• Design and implement EMEA-wide payroll compliance assessment frameworks with country-specific depth and regional consistency.
• Manage responses to labor inspections, Social Security audits, and tax authority inquiries, coordinating with Legal, Payroll Operations, and external advisors.
• Monitor legislative changes, court rulings, and regulatory guidance across assigned markets and translate them into country-specific operational guidance, process updates, system and control improvements — ensuring payroll calculation accuracy and compliance with applicable laws, policies, and collective bargaining agreements.
• Partner with payroll vendors to validate system configurations, establish compliance checkpoints, and drive remediation of identified gaps.
• Work with Product and Tech teams for automation initiatives and implement compliance control mechanisms that work across countries, legal entities, and payroll platforms
• Partner with HR, Benefits, Legal, Employment Tax, Payroll Technology, and Product teams to develop and enhance existing payroll systems to meet payroll compliance requirements.
• Produce clear, concise compliance risk assessments and present findings and recommendations to senior leadership.


A day in the life
Your primary focus will be ensuring payroll compliance across Western European countries, developing payroll risk control frameworks, payroll blueprints, and compliance rulebooks for mitigating risks, while assisting colleagues across the wider EMEA region. You will respond to stakeholders and/or employee requests on compliance questions, partner with tech colleagues to build AI solutions for risk assessments, and ensure payroll accuracy and compliance. You will join Payroll Product design PODs, where you share compliance requirements, develop self-service mechanisms using AI agents for compliance monitoring, bring new ideas, and learn new opportunities to improve payroll processes and controls.

About the team
The Global Payroll Compliance team within Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) is a fast-paced, team-focused, dynamic environment. Our mission is to pay employees accurately and on time, every time, with highest controllership and compliance with all regulatory requirements.
You will have opportunities to expand your technical depth, explore new technologies, and contribute ideas that shape the direction of our payroll platform. If you are looking for a team where your work is visible and your development is a priority, this is the place for you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources Management or related field.
- Payroll qualifications (e.g. CIPP).
- A minimum of 5 years extensive hands on experience in EMEA payroll and tax related compliance.
- Experience undertaking internal risk reviews covering payroll compliance is essential.
- Proven expertise in payroll compliance and administration, with a strong background in employment tax consulting.
- Experience in leading payroll tax audits and resolving complex tax issues.
- Proven ability to build frameworks and documentation from scratch in ambiguous or evolving environments.
- Strong knowledge of EMEA payroll engines.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Finance/Tax (MBA or related discipline)
- Exposure to payroll system transformations and/or tax compliance audits.
- Experience working in a government (state or federal) payroll tax or regulatory environment.
- Experience with end-to-end project management, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround
- Experience building and scaling knowledge management systems (wikis, runbooks, shared repositories).
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan

title: Test Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a FLS Test Engineer at Leo, you will be directly responsible for testing, qualifying and troubleshooting integrated satellites for the Kuiper broadband internet network. You will utilize innovative solutions and leading-edge technology to solve difficult manufacturing and engineering problems on a daily basis, at both a systems and specialized level. You will be a critical lynchpin between the engineering, operations, tooling, supply chain and quality teams, and help lead production on the assembly line as well as new production introduction. You will provide vital manufacturability input to the design engineering teams for both new and existing hardware. Finally, you will be responsible for standing up new processes, equipment, and assembly lines to support Kuiper’s rapid build ramp, making data-driven decisions at each step in the process.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Plan, develop, document and execute test operations to validate satellite systems for flight to meet Kuiper production build rates.
• Bring-up, test and troubleshoot integrated satellite assemblies
• Lead acceptance and qualification test (environmental, functional and performance) campaigns for development satellite system designs.
• Analyze test failures to ensure defects are fully understood and provide design recommendations for the product to increase performance, reliability, and yield.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical and RF performance problems on the fly, working with an integrated cross-functional team of electrical, mechanical, software and manufacturing engineers.
• Specify, procure and set up test cell layouts for the production floor.
• Write technical specifications for system assembly and test from scratch.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or equivalent
- 1+ years in a Space/Aerospace/Military/Automotive hardware testing environment
- 1+ years of test experience with embedded systems, integrated systems, or flight hardware.

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of experience testing and troubleshooting integrated systems.
- 1+ years of programming experience

title: Environmental Test Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable broadband to customers and communities everywhere — including the places the internet has never reliably reached. Every satellite we launch is qualified in our Space Simulation Lab at SEA133. If flight hardware is going to survive launch, vacuum, thermal cycling, and years on orbit, it has to prove it to us first.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

As an Environmental Test Engineer on the SSL team, you won't be one of many engineers maintaining a shared pool of equipment. You'll be the primary owner of an entire class of test equipment — Thermal, TVAC, Vibe, Shock, or HASS — accountable for keeping it running, driving its reliability upward, and building the processes that let the lab test at launch cadence. When something goes wrong at 2 AM, your name is on the escalation. When something needs to change, you own the engineering decision and the vendor conversation. When a technician learns the equipment, they learn it from you.

This is a build job, not a maintain job. We're scaling SSL fast and we need an engineer who looks at tribal knowledge and turns it into standard work; who looks at a vendor's response time and decides it's not good enough; who can read a thermal ramp trace or a shaker response curve and tell you whether it's a tuning problem, a hardware problem, or a software problem. You will have autonomy, a direct line to leadership, and a tangible connection between the work you do this week and the hardware that leaves Earth next quarter.

If you want your engineering decisions to show up in orbit — not just in a dashboard — come build this with us.

Key job responsibilities
Equipment Ownership
• Serve as primary owner for an assigned class of environmental test equipment (Thermal, TVAC, Vibe, Shock, or HASS), managing configurations, maintenance, calibration, and improvement projects.
• Provide technical leadership during troubleshooting events, driving issues from first response through root cause and corrective action.
• Manage relationships with 3rd-party equipment vendors (service, spares, upgrades, escalations).
Process Development
• Establish standardized test processes and work instructions that enable technicians to operate with minimal engineer supervision.
• Train and mentor technicians on equipment operation and troubleshooting; keep documentation accurate and current.
Rate Improvement
• Analyze test data to validate ability of test procedures to meet requirements.
• Identify and lead projects that increase throughput, reduce cycle time, and improve first-pass yield.
Automation Troubleshooting
• Read and triage simple errors in LabVIEW and Python code execution; clearly articulate failures to support teams for more complex issues.
• Apply understanding of control loops used in environmental test (thermal ramp control, vacuum/pressure control, shaker control) to diagnose equipment behavior.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- Experience in complex work environments, including (but not limited to robotics, automation, diagnostic and test equipment)
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience with automation and any version control tools
- Knowledge of industry standard test automation tools and experience developing product test frameworks
- Experience in reliability/maintenance environments, or experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in engineering or equivalent
- 3+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications, or experience leading technical teams through daily operations and maintenance evolutions
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors, or experience in planning, scheduling and auditing maintenance activities
- Experience leading cross-functional projects and implementing strategic initiatives
- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software

title: Security Support Engineer, Identity and Access Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Corporate Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking a talented Security Support Engineer to help make the secure way the easy way. You will support programs that deliver innovative approaches to securing access management at massive scale, working directly with business owners across the company to drive security initiatives from problem through to resolution. This is an opportunity to operate as a technical lead, applying your expertise in complex problem-solving, pattern recognition, and automation to strengthen Amazon's security posture.

In this role, you will resolve complex access management issues, help customers adopt new security products, and bring configurations in line with current security standards. You'll identify trends across cases to set the technical approach for recurring problems, drive automation at scale, and act as a subject matter expert who mentors less experienced engineers. Your work will have direct impact on how Amazon secures access for internal and external identities.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Drive security-related operational initiatives in a security-first, enterprise-scaled environment
- Assist customers with following remediations steps, identify any blockers, and recognize patterns or trends.
- Work directly with customers to help them adopt new security products or adjust their configuration to meet current security standards
- Contribute to scripting and security tool development efforts
- Own security metrics delivery and improvements
- Directly support Security Engineers by contributing research for IAM security reviews and initiatives
- Act as a subject matter expert, handle escalations, and mentor other engineers on the team


A day in the life
You drive the remediation of known security issues by working directly with customers to help them adopt new security products or adjust their platform configuration to comply with the latest security standards. As an experienced engineer, you identify issue trends and apply automation to drive bulk remediations. You set the technical direction for how the team resolves recurring problems, handle escalations, and collaborate with engineers across Amazon to strengthen security practices.

This role includes occasional on-call responsibilities.

About the team
Our team's mission is to make the secure way the easy way. We focus on Identity and Access Management improvements, and our remit covers both internal and external identity. As a technical lead on the team, you'll work in an environment that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

We tackle complex security challenges at Amazon scale, developing new approaches to access management that balance security with ease of use. The team values mentorship and knowledge sharing, creating an environment where engineers grow their expertise while delivering meaningful impact on Amazon's security posture.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in software development, or experience in technical support
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience with Linux
- Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
- Experience in one or more of the following: application security frameworks, security code reviews, incident response, security infrastructure, penetration testing, mobile security, cloud security, AI security, identity and access controls
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or other related discipline, or experience with equivalent introductory technical domain knowledge

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security
- Experience in scripting or programming work in Ruby, Python, Shell/BASH scripting, Java, C/C++, C*, Perl, or other languages
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience with one or more of the following domains: systems administration (Linux/Window), network administration (DNS, IPsec, BGP, VPN, Load Balancing), or programming (Node.JS, Java, Ruby, C#, Python, or PHP)
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Experience mentoring or training the engineering community on complex technical issues
- Experience working on and delivering end to end projects independently

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands-on AI Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.

SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud-based system.
Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.

title: Propulsion Functional Technician, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The Propulsion team is seeking a Manufacturing Functional Technician to join the team to support production manufacturing of future flight hardware.
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will work within the Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team supporting the build and integration of electric propulsion subsystems, including feed systems, thrusters, cathodes, PCBAs, tanks, and the integrated propulsion system.
This technician will be knowledgeable across multiple manufacturing process paths, perform troubleshooting activities, support training programs, and lead process improvement initiatives within their scope. The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing experience with flight hardware and thrives in a fast-paced production environment.

Additional Requirements:

Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position

Able to lift-up to 25lbs. unassisted

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

The starting pay for this role in Washington State is up to $33.50 / hour and employees are eligible for incremental raises based on tenure. This information is provided per the Washington State Pay Transparency Act. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via Amazon’s internal or external careers site.

Key job responsibilities
Assemble, fabricate, and process materials into complex manufactured products across propulsion subsystems per engineering documentation and SOPs, following one or more defined process paths.

Learn to perform troubleshooting activities associated with manufacturing products, observing, receiving, and obtaining information from all relevant sources to assist in debug and root cause analysis. Seek guidance when deviation from available procedures is needed.

Learn to perform hardware inspections and document discrepancies. May assist with development stage assemblies and first article builds under guidance of senior peers.

Read, interpret, and work from engineering documentation and drawings following well established processes.

Provide engineers with feedback on tooling, consumables, debug observations, and process issues through structured channels such as MES WOT entries.

Identify training needs for the team and assist in the training of new hires and junior peers to help them scale in their role.

Contribute to process improvement ideas within your project scope, working with leaders and engineers individually or in group settings.

Follow best practices as defined by leaders, lead techs, manuals, and SOPs. Meet productivity and quality standards consistently.

Uphold job and site safety standards and operations protocol. Follow proper procedure when quality or safety issues occur.

Attempt to resolve individual work blockers before escalating. Identify additional tasks once assigned work is complete and communicate to Lead Technician before proceeding.

Utilize MES and SAP systems for production tracking, traceability, and work order documentation. Capture and record data accurately in applicable systems.

May assist with servicing, repairing, calibrating, regulating, fine tuning, and testing machines, devices, and equipment.

Attend all relevant technical trainings offered by the organization.

A day in the life
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will perform a variety of hardware manufacturing, testing and integration tasks across propulsion subsystems to ensure hardware meets production requirements for flight. They will work closely with engineering teams to provide feedback on processes and identify improvements.
This technician is expected to be knowledgeable across multiple process paths, support peers and new hires, and lead process improvements within their scope. They will utilize MES and SAP systems for daily production tracking and traceability and will actively support the team in resolving work blockers and general operational needs.
A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced, start-up-like environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment to quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Team is responsible for the design and development of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.

Basic qualifications

- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- High school diploma or equivalent
- 2+ years relevant aerospace/automotive manufacturing experience or equivalent industry experience
- 2+ years of hands-on work experience with electro-mechanical assemblies, final integration and/or harness integration experience
- 2+ year’s experience in a fast-paced production environment with flight hardware
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with precision torque, measurement and inspection devices (i.e., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, etc.)
- Proficiency in reading, interpreting, and working from engineering documentation and/or drawings
- Ability to work effectively in a team environment

Preferred qualifications

- Aircraft & Powerplant certification/license, automotive certifications, or other technical certifications/Associate's degree
- Experience working with FOD, ESD sensitive hardware and clean room requirements
- Experience working with MES software packages (SAP, SFC transactions, traceability)
- Experience with root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective action processes
- Experience contributing to or owning SOP development and process documentation
- Experience with 6S, Kaizen, or continuous improvement methodologies
- Experience with PCBA inspection/rework and troubleshooting

title: Principal Software Engineer, Devices Global Retail Technology
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

We're building the Gen AI–powered platform that takes a Devices product idea from concept to production in days — not months.

The Devices Global Retail Tech organization is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to lead diverse, cross-organizational initiatives spanning Devices financial systems automation, product development acceleration, and multi-agent orchestration architectures. As the most senior individual contributor, you will work on our hardest problems, help establish technical standards, NativeAI development practices, and drive the overall technical architecture for products that delight our customers.

The Devices Financial System Automation (DFSA) team owns the consolidated technical architecture that transforms how Devices & Services (D&S) businesses set up and operate their financial systems. D&S launches a fast-growing portfolio — Alexa, Fire TV, Ring, Blink, eero, Kindle, Appstore, Amazon Smart Vehicles, and more — and every new business launch requires financial record-keeping (FRK) setup spanning the entire fintech domains from contract review, business requirements, tax classification, accounting entries, billing and payments. DFSA partners with teams across the Amazon's D&S division to accelerate new product launches.

Architecting agentic primitives at scale is central to our strategy. We are building a Gen AI–powered automation platform that takes a product idea or partner deal from initial idea to a live, automated financial record-keeping capabilities in days to weeks — using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-agent orchestration workflows. These solutions draft contracts, requirements, engineering specifications, and code that previously took teams months to produce. As Principal Engineer, you will define and drive the multi-year, architecture for this platform: unifying fragmented workflows into scalable, flexible, and compliant FinTech solutions, and setting the technical direction for how Gen AI is applied safely and accurately across financial systems. This is a strategic investment adopted not just by the Devices & Services organization, but also teams across Digital, Ads and Consumer groups. You will shape the strategy that accelerates timelines from months to days, enabling every D&S business to launch and monetize faster.

Another core dependency for accelerating Devices product development lifecycle from months to days requires providing agentic and builder access to Amazon's diverse portfolio of Devices throughout the build process. We provide 16 businesses across Devices, Ads, and Digital teams elastic device capacity and operate as the singular entry point for every device type and setup at Amazon. Amazon Device Farm services provide the device signal that fuels the fast feedback loops autonomous agentic systems and builders need for product development - providing agents and builders unified, elastic device capacity, configured on demand, with the functionality, reliability, and scale teams require to ship products to customers faster and to higher quality.

As a core leader in the Devices Global Retail Tech org, you'll work to simplify and accelerate Devices and Services product launches across every Product Line (FireTV, Kindle, Alexa, echo, eero, Leo, and more) as well as key partners in Digital, Ads and Consumer teams by driving the architecture and agentic solutions that remove existing constraints spanning diverse problem domains.

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will:

  - Serve as a technical leader on our most demanding, cross-functional projects, owning the consolidated, Gen AI–powered system architecture that solves key fintech problems across all of D&S and Set the technical vision and direction for the org's fintech space

  - Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions — designing for reuse across 12+ product lines and multiple geographies rather than one-off integrations.

  - Possess and apply expert knowledge in performance, scalability, enterprise system architecture, and engineering best practices, with financial accuracy, auditability, and tax/regulatory compliance treated as first-class architectural concerns — ensuring Gen AI outputs are grounded, verifiable, and compliant.

  - Understand the evolving needs of the D&S business and partner deeply with stakeholders across Business Development, Finance, Product, Tech, Accounting, and Tax to translate those needs into durable technical strategy.

  - Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. You are a technical thought leader, builder, and operator.

  - Balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices, sequencing a pragmatic roadmap that delivers incremental value while converging on the target-state consolidated system.

  - Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues — including Gen AI engineering best practices — and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.

Basic qualifications

  - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  - 12+ years of software development experience, including designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems.

  - Experience serving as a technical leader across product and tech teams, driving architecture and technical strategy.

  - Expert knowledge of performance, scalability, and enterprise system architecture.

  - Demonstrated ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders and align diverse teams behind a common direction.

Preferred qualifications

  - Experience architecting and delivering systems to production — including agentic AI systems in product at scale.

  - Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks and AWS services including Bedrock and Amazon Q

  - Experience in FinTech, metering, billing, and payments financial enterprise systems with strong compliance, accuracy, and auditability requirements (tax, accounting, revenue recognition, e-invoicing).

descriptionHtml:

We are currently seeking a CMMS Engineer to serve as a system mater expert within Amazon data center region. Ideal candidates will posses the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both individual delivery as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams.

The scope of this role will include but not limited to owning the process from start to finish with deploying the EAM platform in your data center region. Working to support local data center teams with asset collection; maintenance schedules, reporting, and training. As part of the global EAM team, you will help drive global processes and document development. This role acts as the gatekeeper for mission critical data in EAM, responsible for the accuracy and reports produced in EAM. You will be required on a frequent basis to help develop systems enhancement modules of core and advanced modules to meet Regional or Global business requirements. There will be 20% travel when launching new locations.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
The CMMS Engineer will be responsible for setup and maintaining site asset data through Hexagon EAM. The engineer will work within the data centers to ensure that asset details are captured to match the digital record. They will work with corresponding teams to align and schedule maintenance within the CMMS application. The engineer will proactively perform routine data scrubs, identify and correct any anomalies, while continuously looking for ways to automate and enhance processes. They will also plan and conduct training and workshop sessions for large audiences within the organization.

A day in the life
CMMS Engineers connect AWS data center operations teams with the systems that track physical equipment. They tag and catalog new equipment as sites grow, support staff through Slack and training, schedule preventive maintenance, and keep asset records accurate. They also handle administrative work and contribute to projects that improve the tools the team relies on. It's a hands-on role blending fieldwork, customer support, and system upkeep - ensuring every piece of data center equipment is properly tracked, maintained, and ready to support reliable operations.

About the team
The CMMS team is part of AWS Data Center Availability Team, responsible for the Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) systems that keep our physical infrastructure organized, maintained, and audit-ready across data center sites. We work closely with multiple teams including Data Center Operations, Field Engineering, and Infrastructure Reliability teams to make sure every asset is accurately tracked and properly scheduled for maintenance. Our team combines on-site fieldwork with system administration, and we're continually looking for ways to automate manual processes and improve the tools our stakeholders depend on daily.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) experience
- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- Bachelor's degree in enginnering or equivalent, or 3+ years of facilities management experience
- Detail-oriented, comfortable walking large facilities, and precise with data entry.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) experience
- 2+ years SQL Server database query and reporting experience using ETL, data warehouse, and SSAS/SSRS tools.
- Working knowledge in EAM equipment hierarchy, object coding and naming convention.
