title: Manager, Conversation Design, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Want to help people at an extraordinary scale? Amazon Customer Service is seeking a hands-on team manager to lead the critical Conversation Design function. Our mission is to make customer service interactions so good they become a primary reason customers choose Amazon. When our customers need help, we make solutions effortless. We innovate relentlessly, spending time with customer service associates, with customers in the field, in the UX research lab, and iterating on UX prototypes. Our work greatly impacts our customers' experience and is critical for Amazon.

In this role you will lead a team to define voice, tone, and language guidelines that shape how Amazon communicates with customers — creating conversational specifications, writing prompts, authoring evaluation guidelines, and annotating data to identify patterns in model behavior. You will be critical to providing high quality conversational interfaces across voice and text platforms, defining the strategic, building scalable documentation and governance frameworks, and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Applied Science teams to develop AI agents. This leader will be responsible for delivering measurable customer experience results, ensuring consistent and high quality voice and tone across Customer Service touchpoints.


Key job responsibilities
- Leads with deep empathy for our customers, our customer service associates, and team members.
- Ensures creative quality through the methods and mechanisms set in motion.
- Invested in growing people, developing talent, creating an inclusive and inspiring environment, and fostering collaboration.
- Presents design work to partners and executive leadership for review, feedback, and sign-off. Coaches others to do the same.
- Prioritizes effectively, uses data to inform decisions, weighs the impact and trade-offs of decisions, and seeks input where needed to drive alignment.
- Works closely with product and business partners to develop a shared vision and leads a process to define and design experiences that deliver on those shared objectives.
- Develops processes that drive quality and efficiency to help designers accomplish more than they could otherwise.
- Drives the strategy for our overall copy, language, and communication for Customer Service. Aligns the organization on voice and tone.
- Leads a transformation of the function from UX Writing to Conversation Design, evolving from writing copy to shaping what chatbots write, applying guardrails, and annotating data.


A day in the life
You will partner closely with product and tech leaders, using quantitative and qualitative evidence to deliver high-impact design work at a global scale. The conversation design leader embodies and instills in their team customer-centric judgment throughout all parts of the design process, enables their team to validate their design strategies, and maintains the highest quality standards, while relentlessly advocating for high-quality customer experiences. Your organizational savvy will position the team to have optimal impact and deliver strong, measurable results. You sincerely believe that design is more than surface level; it's also about how it feels and functions.

About the team
The Customer Service Design team comprises a diverse group of product designers, researchers, writers, and program managers with a shared mission to make every experience we design intuitive, effortless, seamless, and empathetic. We trust each other, collaborate regularly, and work together to ensure we all raise the bar on UX quality. We work hard; however, we also strive to support each other, remain genuine, and create a positive culture that balances work and personal life.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of design experience
- 3+ years of leading design teams experience
- Experience managing teams
- Have an online portfolio or samples of work on resume, demonstrating experience creating great end-to-end, user-centered design solutions and patterns, across desktop and mobile devices
- A deep curiosity about generative AI and strong familiarity with it

title: Safety Technician
descriptionHtml:
Keeping our people safe and well at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in making this happen. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop through a global company. You’ll work closely with our experts to monitor your site, which means you’ll get to see the difference that you make to people’s well-being every day.

Key job responsibilities
- Carry out risk assessments and audits
- Monitor the site to make sure processes are in line with Amazon’s safety procedures
- Create and update reports on safety metrics for colleagues to review
- Work with colleagues in Operations and across the business on safety-related tasks and offer guidance on processes
- Support in putting new safety measures in place

A day in the life
You'll be based at one of our sites. This means that you can closely track what's happening and people can easily ask you any questions throughout their shifts. This role is all about spotting potential issues before they happen. You'll spend a lot of time checking the site and getting to know the way that people use equipment. By understanding how every task and machine works, you'll be able to think about the best way to keep processes safe. You'll also be one of the people to put safety changes into action, which means you'll get to work closely with lots of people. Alongside your daily and weekly tasks, you'll offer support to our Operations team on ad-hoc safety-related work. Safety is so important to Amazon, and you'll help us gather the vital data that keeps us on top of our processes and ahead of any issues. You'll also share that data with people across the business and work with other teams to make sure they're putting safety first.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent)
- Experience running metrics reports, analyzing data to identify problems and using data analysis to generate and explain metrics
- Knowledge of UK Health & Safety Legislation and pertinent regulations

title: InfraOps Support Engineer, Operations Management Center (OMC)
descriptionHtml:
The InfraOps Support Engineer is a Tier 1 support engineer in Amazon's Operations Management Center (OMC) - a 24/7/365 team that keeps the technology inside Amazon's 400+ corporate office buildings running across Networking, Audio-Visual (AV), and Print services. This engineer is the first line of response for office-infrastructure incidents.

Operating within the Amazon Support Engineer (SupEng) job family, the engineer provides high-quality support across all three service areas while beginning to develop deep subject-matter expertise in one or more focus areas, for which they become the technical point of contact on their team. They respond, triage and resolve incidents within target times using established procedures, detect trends before they become problems, contribute to and refine the team's operating procedures, and mentor more junior engineers. Success requires the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, shift-based environment.

Key job responsibilities
On a typical shift, an InfraOps Support Engineer will:

1. Monitor, Detect & Triage

Be the first line of response and keep ahead of problems.

Triage incoming incidents (tickets) within defined target response times, using judgment to resolve in place or route to the responsible team.

Use dashboards, alarms, and other tools for Networking, AV, and Print services across the global building fleet, interpreting what those signals indicate to solve incidents.

Detect ongoing trends or emerging problems before they occur and define proactive actions to prevent customer impact.

Assess incident scope and severity, correlate related incidents into a single parent incident, and prioritise work against SLAs.

2. Troubleshoot & Support

Resolve issues and support the team's products and systems.

Provide high-quality Tier 1 support for the products and systems in the team's scope, resolving straightforward problems with limited documentation and minimal escalation.

Support critical issues using existing runbooks; maintain composure through difficult interactions until the issue is resolved.

Perform on-call duties on a rotating schedule and respond to emergent events.

Escalate appropriately when resolution requires significant deviation from procedure or when an issue becomes a risk.

3. Subject-Matter Expertise & Technical Leadership

Grow into the go-to person for a focus area.

Develop and apply expertise in one or more focus areas (e.g., Networking, AV, or Print), acting as the technical point of contact for that area within the team.

Give technical direction to others and impart knowledge to users, customers, and teammates.

Lead internal team projects and deliver on defined goals and timelines.

4. Documentation & Operational Improvement

Improve how the team operates.

Identify areas to improve support documentation and processes, and author new runbooks/SOPs and knowledge-base articles where gaps exist.

Identify improvements to existing and new support tools that increase operational efficiency, and help drive their implementation.

Help develop and refine the operational policies and procedures used by the team.

5. Mentoring & Collaboration

Raise the bar for the team.

Serve as a mentor to junior engineers and act as a training buddy for new hires; may assist in hiring activities.

Maintain good working relationships across Amazon and work cross-functionally with partner teams to solve problems and improve processes.

Communicate infrastructure health and trends clearly, both in real time and as inputs to weekly/monthly business reviews.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience
- Experience scripting in modern program languages
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- 1+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM experience
- 1+ years of troubleshooting in a multi-user high availability environment experience
- 1+ years of IT client, server, and network service delivery experience
- 1+ years of networking (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, and TCP/IP) experience
- 1+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience
- 1+ years of supporting and maintaining a corporate network environment experience
- High school diploma, or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
- Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID
- Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON
- 2+ years of computer networking experience, or experience in computer networking
- Experience supporting video conference and teleconference equipment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP

title: Sr. Product Manager, Legal Technology
descriptionHtml:
You will be the product manager for Contract Central, Amazon Legal's contract lifecycle management platform. It holds about 3.5 million contracts, about 20,000 to 25,000 more are signed through it each month, and it has nearly 60,000 users. Hundreds of internal teams connect to it through APIs.

Most business users open it only a few times a year, so it has to make sense without training or a call to Legal. The team also leads a 2026 S-Team goal and works closely with the Amazon Quick organization on bringing AI into contracting.

Where the platform goes next is not fully defined. You will set the goals and lead the work, asking for direction when you need it. You should be comfortable with SQL, with how APIs work, and with detailed technical conversations with engineers.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Contract Central. Decide what to build and what to leave out, often with incomplete data, and explain your choices in writing to senior managers and Directors, and to VPs when needed.
- Watch business users, lawyers and admins use the product, and separate problems many of them share from one-off requests.
- Work with design and engineering to take steps out of intake, approvals, signing and workflow setup, and decide where AI and automation should do the work, such as prefilling forms or routing contracts for signature.
- Evaluate technical proposals by asking what each design makes harder to change later, and balance new features with the health of a platform that hundreds of internal teams build on.
- Own launches and their results. Define metrics that separate adoption from outcomes such as satisfaction, cycle time and contracts completed without Legal, and pull the data yourself.
- Align lawyers, legal operations, tax, procurement and business teams with different priorities, and mentor and help hire other product managers.


A day in the life
It is release day for Contract Central. You send the release note and hold office hours. Then you sit with an admin setting up a new contract workflow and note each decision that slows them down. After lunch you write the SQL for the monthly business review yourself, because every number needs a denominator and a trend. The Amazon Quick team asks for an API change, and you work out with an engineer whether it is worth doing now. You end the day in a recorded session with a business user who uses the platform a few times a year.

About the team
We are the Legal Technology team in Amazon Legal. We build the software Amazon's lawyers and business teams use to create, approve, sign and manage contracts. The team is small for what it owns, so the role is broad. You will work with a dedicated engineering team, design, business intelligence and legal leads, and you will write your own queries, release notes and user surveys. Over the next year we are focused on recovering user satisfaction, making contracting easier for occasional users and admins, and keeping Contract Central reliable as more teams and AI tools build on it.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Knowledge of key customer experience metrics and methodology (e.g., NPS)
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning technology products

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, New Product Success
descriptionHtml:
Third-party sellers account for about 60% of units sold in Amazon's stores. New Product Success helps them identify, launch, and scale new products, and helps customers discover them. Our 100+ person organization builds ML and AI powered products and experiences across the entire new product launch journey - from identifying high-potential opportunities, to guiding sellers toward the right products, to accelerating discovery and conversion in the critical early weeks after launch for all new products launched on Amazon across the world.

You'll be the lead product marketing manager for all of New Product Success - setting marketing strategy across a multi-product portfolio that spans the full seller launch journey. You'll define the narrative, shape annual plans, set marketing goals and metrics, build partnerships inside and outside Amazon, and drive the overall GTM approach.

In addition to leading strategy, you'll go hands-on as the PMM for New Product Accelerator, our post-launch AI powered experience that helps sellers scale new products through their most critical growth window. The role is both strategic and operational - you'll influence Directors and VPs on where to invest, and then ship the work yourself. For the right person, it's a chance to define how product marketing works in a high-growth, AI-driven product organization.

We are looking for a marketer who thinks like a single-threaded product leader. You can set strategy for an entire product organization and then go deep on positioning for a single product - in the same week. You're as comfortable analyzing seller sentiment data across cohorts as you are crafting a mainstage narrative that earns conviction in large conferences. You bring structure to ambiguity, judge success by whether the message landed rather than whether it shipped, and make a complex product suite feel simple and essential. You build mechanisms, not just campaigns, and you see marketing as a system that drives adoption, not just awareness. If you want to shape how sellers think about launching products on Amazon, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
1. Set marketing strategy for New Product Success end to end. Define the narrative, goals, metrics, and GTM approach across the full product portfolio.

2. Shape annual marketing plans, and ensure every product launch has clear positioning, target segments, and success measures.

3. Lead partnerships inside and outside Amazon. Build relationships with ecosystem partners, industry publications, and internal stakeholders that extend New Product Success's reach and credibility with sellers.

4. Own the seller satisfaction signal. Design and run the measurement framework for seller sentiment across the product suite, and turn insights into inputs for roadmap decisions.

5. Own the New Product Success narrative at Amazon Accelerate, our flagship global conference. Lead track strategy, content, mainstage and breakout messaging, multi-VP stakeholder alignment, speaker preparation, and claims review.

6. Own product marketing for New Product Accelerator. Go hands-on as the PMM for our post-launch experience - positioning, messaging, go-to-market, and full-funnel adoption from seller awareness through activation and sustained usage.

7. Close the loop between marketing and product. Make sure feedback from surveys, campaigns, events, and partners reaches product teams as actionable input, not just data.

8. Build mechanisms that scale. Create repeatable processes for launch planning, messaging, campaign execution, and post-launch measurement that raise the bar across the PMM team.

9. Communicate impact to senior leadership. Own marketing performance in business reviews, tie awareness and satisfaction to business outcomes, and build the narrative that earns investment.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience building scalable marketing mechanisms (launch playbooks, campaign frameworks, measurement templates) that outlast individual campaigns
- Experience using generative AI tools in marketing workflows, with willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- Experience in product marketing for SaaS, marketplace, or seller-facing products

title: Software Development Engineer, Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's network carries traffic for hundreds of millions of customers, and the Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR) team keeps it healthy. As a Software Development Engineer II on NMR, you will build streaming data pipelines, automated remediation services, and diagnostic tooling that detect and resolve network impairments before customers ever notice. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, turning ambiguous problems into well-designed, maintainable solutions. If you are a collaborative engineer who enjoys solving hard distributed-systems problems and mentoring teammates along the way, this is a role where your code has real, measurable impact every single day.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build streaming data pipelines that ingest network telemetry at scale, and develop the automated remediation services that act on those signals in real time.
- Create and improve diagnostic tooling that helps network operators quickly identify and resolve the issues automation has not yet addressed.
- Participate actively in code reviews, provide constructive feedback to teammates, and mentor other engineers on writing well-documented, reliable software.
- Collaborate with network engineers, data scientists, and product partners to translate operational needs into clear system designs and working solutions.
- Identify root causes of operational issues, drive improvements to your team's technical processes, and evaluate new tools and approaches, including generative AI, to raise productivity and code quality.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and triaging any alerts from overnight deployments. From there you might write and test code for a new remediation workflow, then join a design discussion where you and your teammates sketch out approaches to an ambiguous detection problem. Later you could pair with a network engineer to validate telemetry signals or review a pull request from a newer team member. Your work blends deep technical problem-solving with regular collaboration across engineering and operations.

About the team
Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR) prevents, predicts, detects, and remediates network impairments before they reach customers. Our systems ingest trillions of telemetry data points daily from millions of network devices, apply streaming analytics and ML/AI to surface actionable signals, and drive automated mitigation through our event management platform. Today, over 98% of detected issues are resolved without human intervention. Our vision is a future where every network failure is pre-emptively resolved by autonomous systems, with zero customer impact.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.

- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation

Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.

In this role you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible within a diverse and evolving market.

The Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a sound technical foundation and a desire to learn.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical relationship with the customer and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide
- Lead technical discussions, architecture design and reviews, and workshops across trading, risk, post-trade, market data, asset and wealth management domains to drive business value
- Design scalable and secure solutions leveraging AWS services and emerging technologies (AI/ML)
- Collaborate with sales teams to develop and execute customer engagement strategies
- Create technical content and reference architectures for capital markets use cases
- Influence AWS product roadmap based on customer needs

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field or military
- Experience in IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries
- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
- Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing AI solutions that can include integration of LLMs/multi-modal FMs in large scale systems, fine-tuning LLMs, deployment and distributed inference of LLMs, RAG, FM evaluation, Vector DBs, Agentic workflows, prompt/context engineering, and MLOps.
- Hands-on experience with AWS ecosystems (including Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker) to set up secure, private-network AI environments, and practical experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation using embeddings, vector stores, and semantic search optimization.

title: Software Development Engineer II, New Security Service
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Our team's mission is to help customers manage their network security complexity with ease. We're looking for a lead full-stack engineer to shape the development of a new, greenfield product that radically improves on this mission by offering an Agentic experience to help customers meet their security needs. This project is a novel application of AI that goes beyond current industry standards.

As a developer, you will shape how we design, develop, build, deploy, and support this exciting new product. You will work closely with your team, mentoring and supporting other team members, and ensuring the results we deliver our customers are of the highest quality.

Key job responsibilities
* Design and implement key features of the security management system using Rust and/or Java
* Lead and influence teams of developers to deliver global, highly available, and scalable services.
* Apply advanced security techniques to enhance the system's defenses.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI technology into the security management process.

A day in the life
As a SDE II, you'll be at the forefront of our advanced security management system, driving the design, implementation, and delivery of critical components.

About the team
Join the AWS Firewall Manager Service team and help build and scale a new security service that protects customers' cloud environments. As an SDE II, you'll design and deliver high-impact, distributed systems that operate at AWS scale. You'll work alongside talented engineers to solve complex security challenges, drive technical innovation, and directly influence how customers secure their networks. This is a unique opportunity to shape a greenfield service from the ground up within one of AWS's most critical security domains.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Category Merchant Manager III
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by building strategies that shape how millions of customers discover and purchase products? As a Category Merchant Manager III at Amazon, you will own a significant portion of a category's performance, combining analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to drive meaningful business growth. In this role, you will develop and execute category strategies, manage vendor and seller relationships, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to optimize the customer experience. You will navigate ambiguous challenges, identify new opportunities, and deliver solutions that balance short-term wins with long-term value. If you are a self-starter who thrives on turning data into action and influencing outcomes across teams, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute category strategies by analyzing financial performance, market trends, and customer insights to maximize growth and profitability across your category portfolio.
- Manage vendor and supplier relationships, including negotiating terms, evaluating performance, and ensuring alignment with category objectives and pricing strategies.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams — such as marketing, supply chain, finance, and product — to drive category initiatives, remove blockers, and deliver results against business plans.
- Lead end-to-end delivery of complex projects by identifying risks, presenting multiple solution paths to leadership, and making informed trade-offs between competing priorities.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing category performance dashboards, identifying trends that inform a pricing recommendation you will present to leadership later that week. By midday, you are in a working session with marketing and supply chain partners, aligning on a promotional plan for an upcoming event. In the afternoon, you dig into a vendor negotiation, balancing cost targets with selection goals. Throughout it all, you bring clarity to ambiguous problems and help your team prioritize what matters most.

About the team
Our team is focused on creating a world-class shopping experience by building the right product selection at the right price for our customers. We operate in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where analytical thinking and creative problem-solving go hand in hand. We are investing in new ways to grow our categories and improve the customer journey, and this role will be central to shaping that vision. If you are excited about working with talented colleagues who care deeply about the customer and about each other, this is the team for you.

- Bachelor's degree or above
- 5+ years of business development, account management, product management, project management, financial analysis and/or marketing experience

title: Sr Manager Portfolio Strategy, XCM
descriptionHtml:
About the Role
The Portfolio Strategy & Planning team determines how Amazon invests its fixed marketing portfolio across the Amazon and Prime brands in North America. We build the planning frameworks, investment strategies, and inspection cycles that shape where, when, and how brand marketing shows up for customers. This is a strategy role. You will support and co-lead the analytical foundation that turns consumer research, business intelligence, media performance data, and econometric/ROI reads into investment recommendations for senior executive audiences. You will contribute to telling senior leaders where to invest, where to cut, and why. The primary output of this team is written memorandums for senior leadership (Directors upwards), so the ability to make data tell a clear story on paper without “marketing fluff” is the core skill.

You will work primarily with the Cross-Category and Channel Marketing (XCM) organization in North America, and partner closely with finance, measurement, performance marketing, and media planning teams. This is not a media planning role. Media planning is a close collaborator. Our job as Portfolio Strategists is to build the strategic scaffolding that media planning executes against.

Key job responsibilities
What You'll Do
- Support the annual Operating Plan (OP1/OP2) development for North America's fixed marketing portfolio, coordinating inputs from media, campaign teams, customer insights, finance, and measurement into a single integrated investment recommendation.
- Reconcile top-down financial guardrails with bottom-up media cost realities. Co-lead in defining the trade-offs and present them with a clear recommendation, not a menu of options.
- Own the Quarterly Business Review (QBR) process: inspect input and output metrics, surface risks early, and recommend course corrections with quantified impact.
- Manage spend tracking across budget owners (media, production, measurement) and coordinate quarterly guidance updates with Finance.
- Co-Lead bi-annual portfolio laydown reviews to ensure execution stays aligned to strategy. Flag drift and propose fixes.
- Synthesize consumer research, business intelligence, econometric models, and media performance data into a holistic view of which marketing bets to fund, scale, or cut.
- Support the development of investment strategies that optimize short- and long-term returns across Amazon's priority categories, including grocery and healthcare.
- Partner with business intelligence and measurement teams to improve marketing and customer lifecycle measurement. Push for better data where current reads are insufficient.
- Write and present high-quality documents to Directors and support in the creation of VP and SVP documents. Support in the translation of complex analytical findings into clear investment narratives.
- Build scalable planning processes and frameworks that allow the portfolio function to operate at the pace the business requires.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 6+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience communicating results to stakeholders
- Experience in marketing
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
- MBA
- Experience in online advertising, marketing, sales or digital media

title: Risk Manager, Global Product Verification (GPV)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Product Verification (GPV) team supports the Perfect Order Experience (POE) organization's goal to ensure a great ordering experience by acting as a reliable product authentication and verification service for products sold by our selling partners. As a GPV Risk Manager II, you will own and manage risk program(s) and/or risk projects within GPV, where the risk strategy is defined, but the business problem and solution may not yet be fully defined. You will deliver independently, seeking guidance as needed, and may be embedded in a single team or work across multiple teams. You will serve as a subject matter expert for your risk program/projects, staying current on related industry trends—including changing regulations, innovations in risk mitigation, and testing mechanisms—and knowing how to apply them across teams. You will apply process improvement and risk-mitigation methodologies (e.g., risk assessments, Lean) to drive operational excellence across GPV's product authentication and verification operations. You will oversee the rollout of controls or audits, including testing and measuring their effectiveness, and ensure your team accurately and consistently meets both qualitative and quantitative metrics as defined by leadership. You will mentor and develop your team, preparing them professionally to take on additional responsibilities and new opportunities. You will work closely with regional program stakeholders and internal partner teams (e.g., engineering, Legal) to identify trends and learnings that inform and support defect reduction initiatives and strategies. You will identify and drive efforts to reduce inefficiencies and costs in our operations while scaling and developing capabilities to support operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
You will own and drive risk program(s) end-to-end, including defining business problems, developing risk-mitigation solutions, and ensuring controls bring risk within tolerance levels.

You will measure and test processes or controls to inform product-level and program-level risk assessments, identifying and escalating potential gaps in risk assessment methodology, customer experience, and operational processes.

You will identify key performance indicators (KPIs) for your risk program, determine if success metrics are in place, and work to define them where they do not exist.

You will track individual and team-level performance and metrics, including quality assurance (QA) goals and weekly production targets, and drive corrective actions as needed.

You will support leadership and program stakeholders in meeting the organization's goals and objectives, including providing verbal and written communications and updates (e.g., weekly business reviews, strategy docs, narratives, escalation responses, risk assessments).

You will contribute to and/or deliver program documentation, including narratives, risk assessments, and escalation responses, and may manage post-launch support plans for controls.

You will actively identify and drive opportunities to improve internal processes and procedures to streamline day-to-day operations, including leveraging AI to increase efficiency and scalability across teams.

You will make recommendations to partner teams about risk tolerance levels based on data, and drive teams to adopt and maintain risk-reducing controls with data-driven documentation (e.g., competitor analysis, legislation interpretation, safety research, cost of avoidance).

You will help partner teams and engineering teams make trade-offs by educating them on the current risk and regulatory environment.

You will manage overall schedules for risk mitigation projects, overcome issues, keep scope under control, and accelerate progress by driving crisp and timely decisions, clearing blockers, and escalating effectively.

You will work closely with leadership, Sr. Investigators, and Risk Specialists in identifying trends and themes to assist internal customers and POE stakeholders in driving upstream improvements in Seller quality metrics, Brand trust, and overall customer experience.

Basic Qualifications

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- 3+ years of managing food safety and quality in a large-scale retail or manufacturing environment experience
- Bachelor's degree in Food Science or related field
- Knowledge of retail food code and regulations governing grocery retail at local, state, and federal levels
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience handling confidential information
- Experience interacting with local food safety regulators

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with SQL and Excel

descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity and inclusion of our teams within the organization.
How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos). If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.
Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team!

Prime Air is revolutionizing delivery services through innovative drone technology. We're seeking a Ground Handler to support our drone delivery operations through ground support activities, basic operational tasks, and community engagement.

Key job responsibilities
* Support daily drone operations by handling and organizing equipment, including batteries and related components
* Monitor airspace in the area of operations and report any potential hazards or obstacles
* Assist with basic warehouse tasks including inventory management and package preparation
* Execute standard operating procedures while maintaining safety and compliance standards
* Engage positively with community members and address basic inquiries about our operations
* Document and report operational activities using standard templates and tools

This role requires the ability to carry/lift up to 50 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach. In addition, this role requires the ability work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (outside temperature, and include refrigerated environments)

This role requires the ability to work any shift, including nights, weekends, and holidays

This role may require travel, up to 25% of the time

Export Control License: This position may require a deemed export control license for compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Placement is contingent on Amazon’s ability to apply for and obtain an export control license on your behalf.

This position will be subject to Department of Transportation (DOT) drug and alcohol testing if conducting safety sensitive functions as defined by the FAA. Federal law also requires Amazon to determine an applicant's DOT drug and/or alcohol testing history prior to hiring him/her into a position that would require them to conduct safety sensitive functions as defined by the FAA

About the team
For any inquiries about the role/your application, please reach out to prime-air-hiring-support-team@amazon.com

Basic qualifications

- High School diploma or equivalent
- Knowledge of basic mechanical aptitude and equipment troubleshooting
- Experience working in a fast-paced, team environment
- Can demonstrate strong attention to safety and ability to follow detailed procedures
- Can travel to local sites up to 25% of the time
- Can provide valid Drivers License

Preferred qualifications

- FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate
- Knowledge of aviation terminology and regulations
- Experience in warehouse or logistics
- Experience in aviation, aerospace, or drone operations

title: Lab Test Engineer, Environmental Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The Lab Test Engineer role is responsible for keeping aerospace environmental test production running smoothly. You will troubleshoot issues that technicians encounter during daily testing, resolving problems with test setup, equipment, and IT infrastructure. The Lab Test Engineer will be an expert for our various Automated Test Equipment (Test Racks) used during environmental testing. With your expertise in environmental testing procedures, equipment, and basic Python scripting, you will identify root causes and implement corrective actions to maximize productivity and product quality. Additionally, you are responsible for production support activities including ticket management, change management, monitoring, metrics, documentation, process development, host provisioning, and hardware management. You may also debug, evaluate, and resolve software issues for applications and services that will improve availability and performance. You will develop scripts and applications to automate redundant tasks and to improve operational efficiency. You will work cross-functionally with Development, QA, and other Support teams to maintain and improve availability and performance of Amazon LEO's production Automated Test Equipment.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintain, troubleshoot and improve test automation hardware supporting production testing
- Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical or software problems on the fly, working with an integrated cross-functional team of manufacturing engineers, test engineers, lab technicians and maintenance teams to resolve
- Perform RCCA of issues in production testing and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence
- Develop and maintain calibration procedures for RF test equipment
- Define and implement solutions to optimize and automate environmental testing
- Work with other engineers to refine test requirements and the methodologies to achieve those requirements
- Willing to “roll up sleeves and do what needs to be done” in a small, specialized, team environment
- Must be willing to work off shifts and weekends as required



A day in the life
The primary goal of this role is to ensure all automated production test racks remain fully operational, properly calibrated, and ready for use by production technicians. Daily responsibilities include planning and coordinating preventive maintenance with schedulers, organizing and tracking all rack calibration activities, and maintaining accurate documentation and hardware configuration data in partnership with supporting engineering teams.

This role also oversees the readiness of spare test racks, ensuring they are maintained, functional, and available for rapid swap-in when needed. It includes coordinating any required repairs to return equipment to operational status. Additional responsibilities include cataloging test harness requirements, monitoring inventory and life-usage of harnesses, and ensuring adequate spare coverage.

The engineer is expected to respond quickly to escalations from technicians, providing troubleshooting support and resolving operational issues with the test racks to minimize production downtime.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- 2+ years of experience testing, troubleshooting, and debugging automated test systems including electrical, mechanical, electronic, networking, and software systems
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field and/or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of production test station (automated test equipment) hardware/software design and factory deployment
- 2+ years of experience with electrical test equipment, data acquisition, and control software
- Experience writing/reading/debugging software in Python, C, C# or other language

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of hardware design, development, validation and delivery of embedded hardware product experience
- 2+ years of experience with environmental testing focusing on thermal and vacuum test processes
- 2+ years of experience working with RF test systems

Your code runs infrastructure millions of developers depend on. You own real problems end-to-end, work with experienced mentors, and grow fast. No two days are the same.

Our platform processes billions of events daily for millions of customers worldwide. We value ownership, mentorship, and shipping quality software. We support each other's growth, invest in operational excellence, and believe the best ideas can come from anyone on the team.

The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

- Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and making high-judgment decisions that align with policy intent while minimizing risk. Establish and implement mechanisms that ensure consistent, fair application of policies while maintaining compliance with evolving regulations.

- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict future challenges, and implement proactive solutions at the site level. Turn insights into practical initiatives that drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance.

title: Maintenance Optimization TPM, Availability Serviceability Team
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Data Center Availability Serviceability team works with hundreds of AWS data centers globally to deliver the highest quality and lowest cost availability, capacity, and scaling results for our customers. We standardize operations globally by delivering tools, policy, processes, and procedures to our internal teams.

Serviceability is the ability to maintain, repair, and manage infrastructure assets efficiently throughout their lifecycle -- encompassing maintenance standards, spares management, training and certifications, operational readiness, and the systematic use of data and automation to prevent disruptions and drive continuous improvement.

We are seeking a Maintenance Optimization Technical Program Manager to own how AWS data center infrastructure is maintained: which tasks, at what interval, with what controls, and why. The fleet runs thousands of preventive maintenance plans inherited from vendor manuals and historical practice. This role applies reliability-centered maintenance thinking to that inventory at fleet scale, deciding what each task protects against, whether the control fits the failure mode and its consequence, and where a human check can be replaced by telemetry or retired altogether.

Key job responsibilities
You will lead preventive maintenance optimization across equipment classes (electrical and mechanical), taking each change from failure-mode analysis through a revised maintenance standard to the published procedures technicians execute, with the labor and risk impact quantified. You will set the method: a repeatable, lightweight way to challenge a maintenance task (failure mode, consequence, existing detection, proposed control) that program managers across the team can run without you. Working with our monitoring, controls, and maintenance-planning teams, you will drive decisions on where remote telemetry can replace a physical inspection, removing a human check only when the data demonstrably covers it.

You will own decisions that most maintenance organizations never revisit. The problem is real engineering, not process administration: you will be asked why a task exists, what happens if it stops, and whether the data can prove it. You will work across EAM data, equipment telemetry, regulatory regimes, vendor warranty terms, and the physical gear itself, and you will do it inside the constraints of a live production fleet where being wrong has consequences. And you will build the capability in others. The TPMs you coach will carry this reasoning into every program they touch.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience applying reliability-centered maintenance methods (FMEA, task selection by failure mode and consequence, condition-based alternatives to calendar PMs) to a live fleet, including defending a change to an established maintenance standard.

It spans more than 50 channels covering AI, cloud infrastructure, security, databases, and more. We are looking for an Editor-in-Chief to lead this transformation. This person is equal parts editorial craftsperson and technology enthusiast. You follow the technology landscape closely, form strong opinions about where it is heading, and translate that judgment into editorial decisions about what to publish, when, and for whom. Equally important, you will determine what does not fit with the publication’s editorial direction. You will commission, write, and edit stories alongside subject-matter experts, preserving each author's voice while raising every piece to a consistent bar. This role sits in AWS Marketing and partners with product teams, developer relations, field marketing, and communications.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.
- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.
- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.
- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.
- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.
- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.
- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience in professional, non-internship software development
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

title: Applied Scientist II, International and Emerging Stores Payments
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to translate innovative science into products that expand financial access for millions? At International and Emerging Stores Payments (IESP), we build payment solutions for communities and geographies that Amazon's selection and prices do not yet reach because of payment barriers. These markets make up roughly 80% of the world's countries and 85% of its population.

As an Applied Scientist II on our team, you will design, build, and ship machine learning and generative-AI solutions that remove those barriers and advance financial inclusion, working at the intersection of research and production alongside scientists, engineers, and economists. If you are a curious, self-motivated researcher who turns ambiguity into clarity, we would like to hear from you.

What you will work on:

• Build models that recommend the most suitable payment method for each customer—for example installments, cards, or local payment options—and identify the right customers to reach, balancing customer preference, cost, and risk.
• Take models to production behind a real-time, low-latency personalization layer that serves live shopping traffic at scale.
• Build multi-agent generative-AI systems that turn unstructured inputs—customer feedback, documents, and operational data—into reliable, decision-ready insight, with verification that guards against model hallucination.
• Help customers discover and adopt installments and alternative payment methods.
• Design and analyze large-scale online experiments and causal measurement to validate real customer and business impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models, and deploy production-ready solutions to complex customer and business problems.
• Conduct rigorous scientific research: form hypotheses, run experiments, evaluate model performance, and iterate on approaches within your domain of expertise.
• Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code that integrates smoothly into larger systems and meets a high bar for operational excellence.
• Partner with engineering to take your models to production, and with scientists across related payments ML teams to solve shared, complex problems.
• Contribute to team roadmaps, priorities, and technical direction; mentor peers and provide constructive feedback on research and code.
• Publish at peer-reviewed venues and file patent applications where appropriate.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing experiment results and refining model architectures based on new insights. Throughout the day you will alternate between writing research code, analyzing data, and discussing technical approaches with teammates, working closely with engineering to build your ideas and take them to production. You will regularly present findings and propose new ideas, and you may write research papers and submit patent applications.

About the team
We are the science team for International and Emerging Stores Payments. We build solutions that directly shape how customers pay and that drive conversion across Amazon's fast-growing international markets—and there is no shortage of hard science and engineering problems, since these markets span most of the world's countries and the majority of its customers. We value scientific rigor, creative problem-solving, and a genuine commitment to learning and growth. If you are excited about building impactful solutions and advancing financial inclusion through applied science, we would love to have you join us.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming or scripting language like Python, Java, C or C++
- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms

Preferred qualifications

- Ph.D. in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Master's degree and 1+ years of a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science experience
- Experience in building machine learning models for business application
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Experience working with big data, machine learning and predictive modeling
- Experience providing and effectively communicating strategic and tactical recommendations based on data
- Experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits), or experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience creating and delivering written and oral communications for technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience in data science, business analytics, business intelligence, or similar experience in big data environments
- Experience working with stakeholders to plan and execute programs that are strategic in nature
- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related quantitative field. Published research work in academic conferences or industry circles.
- Experience in building large-scale machine-learning models and personalization
- Effective verbal and written communication skills with non-technical and technical audiences.
- Experience working with large real-world data sets and building scalable models from big data.
- Thinks strategically, but stays on top of tactical execution.
- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related quantitative field. Published research work in academic conferences or industry circles.
- Experience in building large-scale machine-learning models and personalization

descriptionHtml:

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


私たちは数億という膨大な商品を取り扱っており、多くのサプライヤーから入荷したアイテムはフルフィルメントセンターという物流拠点に集約され、各地のデリバリーステーション（DS）を経てお客様先に届けられます。
エリアマネージャーには、膨大な数の商品を効率的かつスムーズにお届けするための出荷計画や配送ルートの立案・管理などをお任せします。

現在、私たちは物流網を拡大すべくDSの全国展開に注力しています。Amazonの重要拠点で物流を進化させる新規ビジネスに携わる…そんな挑みがいのあるミッションに、あなたの経験を活かしてみませんか。

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
■配送管理
入荷した商品の仕分け・出荷作業および配送ルートの計画を立案します。
“どのアイテムを、いつ、何人で仕分けするか”、“どの地域に、どのような順番で配送するか”などをプランニングします。
全体の作業・人員計画はシニアエリアマネージャーが行ないます。連携をしっかり取り、仕分けや配送などが滞りなく進む計画を立てていただきます。

■シフト・勤怠・作業管理
仕分けや出荷、配送などを担うスタッフの管理業務です。
人員は数十名。
物流量に合わせてシフトを組むほか、業務がスムーズに進捗しているかなどを管理します。
シフト調整を担当するアシスタントスタッフ（3～4名）と連携し、状況把握や指示出しなどを行います。
業務管理は社内システムで行います。

■業務改善
安全・品質・生産性向上や業務効率化などを実現するための業務です。

title: Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Generation, AWS Global Energy
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about large power infrastructure systems? Do you love to innovate, discover, and apply your knowledge to advance world-class systems? Do you get excited about the idea of pushing the boundaries of power systems to handle the latest emerging technology? We are seeking a power systems engineer with experience in power systems and energy storage to support our growing requirements for novel solutions to delivering power to AWS data centers.

We are looking for a candidate with a track record of working on difficult power system problems and deep understanding of energy and power systems. As a Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Generation you will work within the Power Generation Solutions team to develop advanced electrical systems, model and evaluate power flow, define power generation requirements, and lead design integration to maximize the capacity out of our systems. You will own challenging problems that span multiple teams and drive technical decisions that impact AWS’ global infrastructure strategy. You will work on the technical strategy of different power and energy configurations, including developing optimization and control logic to ensure that we can exceed our customers’ expectations for delivering highly available power at the lowest costs for our data centers. You will work across multiple organizations, including utility-facing teams, data center and hardware engineering teams, compute and software teams, operations, finance, legal, and public policy teams to advance new concepts. Your technical expertise on power systems and power generation will guide cross-functional teams in making critical design decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and managing technical risks across complex power systems.

Amazon has a global presence, therefore, domestic and international travel may be necessary. Teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and collaborate with others to accomplish the required tasks. This includes working with internal groups as well as external suppliers and consultants, including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), our data centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of data center critical infrastructure design, space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market, reliability, and lowest total cost of ownership. Our Engineers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is continually improving the world of cloud computing. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our mission, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. AWS’s work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. If you are a creative, smart, and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems, we want YOU!

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Generation on the Power Generation Solutions team, you will be responsible for:

• Developing designs and analysis of different energy storage technologies, including, but not limited to; battery energy storage systems, long duration energy storage systems, and utility-scale energy storage
• Evaluating and supporting the development of power generation configurations for different applications, including primary, temporary, or backup power
• Support the integration of different power sources, such as electric utilities, diesel generators, reciprocating engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, microgrids, distributed energy resources, and renewable energy, to serve data center loads in grid connected or grid independent configurations
• Understanding current trends in data center power demands and grid integration of large loads
• Understanding the design and functionality of the global data center fleet, including existing, upcoming, and unique site designs
• Interpreting, evaluating, and developing Single Line Drawings (SLD), engineering drawings, equipment submittals, equipment specifications documentation, and performance data to advance concepts and solutions
• Providing input and direction to Data Center Engineering teams for design revisions for new data centers as well as to Field Engineering for operational data center upgrades to meet critical strategic requirements
• Working independently and have frequent reviews with Senior and Principal Engineers in the team and with partner teams
• Working on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions
• Being positive and offer creative, out of the box solutions
• Continuously learning curious about how things work, and willing to test and push new ideas
• Having fun and working hard!

About the team
The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- 6+ years of experience with power systems or electrical design
- Experience with dynamic and transient power system modeling software, such as PSCAD, PSSE, or similar software.
- Extensive experience and knowledge of power generations equipment, systems, controls, including, but not limited to; diesel generators, distributed energy resources, or gas turbines.
- Design experience and operational knowledge of medium-voltage and high-voltage equipment, including substation configurations, protection requirements, and integration of energy storage systems
- Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, single and three-line diagrams, submittals, sequence of operations, and electrical drawing packages

Preferred qualifications

- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- 6+ years of direct experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical data centers or power infrastructure
- Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or related field
- Working knowledge of continuous operating redundant electrical systems and power infrastructure. This includes but is not limited to; uninterruptable power sources, medium and low voltage electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches.
- Experience in electrical power design, including interpreting wiring diagrams, single and three-line diagrams, P&ID drawings, sequence of operations, and electrical drawing packages, failure mode analysis.
- Experience with gathering, compiling, and analyzing data to identify availability and/or performance risks within the design and operations of critical power infrastructure, including an understanding of data analysis methodologies and statistical techniques.
- Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, R), or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) and machine learning or related optimization frameworks
- Possess excellent attention to detail and communication skills in order to maintain high quality standards for being organized, setting priorities, meeting deadlines, and staying within budgets
- Possess leadership and problem-solving skills
