title: Principal Applied Scientist, FAIM (Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models)
descriptionHtml:
The FAIM (Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models) builds the agentic AI systems behind next-generation advertising. The team develops multimodal foundation models and LLM-driven agents that power shopper understanding, audience-aware creative generation, and agentic advertising workflows.

As a Principal Applied Scientist for the FAIM team, you will invent the models that help advertisers achieve desired outcomes. Today's state of the art models can setup ad campaigns to a specification, but do not understand advertising strategy well enough to help with abstract goals that real advertisers ask about like "how can I make more money."

This is a rare charter to build foundational optimization science where little exists today, spanning campaign recommendation, cross-product budget allocation, incrementality measurement, and long-term-sales modeling. You will set technical direction for a growing team, partner with engineering and product to take models from research to production at Amazon scale, and directly move advertiser ROAS and new-to-brand growth.

In this role you will
- Own the science vision for training models in our RL Gym from end-to-end
- Invent models for joint budget allocation, incrementality, and long-term value
- Take innovations from prototype to production serving live advertiser campaigns
- Raise the technical bar across scientists and engineers

Key job responsibilities
- Define the long-term scientific vision for our RL Gym based training process focusing on campaign optimization and other advertising workflows
- Translating ambiguous advertiser needs and competing objectives into a concrete science roadmap.
- Invent, prototype, and productionize machine learning and optimization solutions for joint budget allocation across sponsored ad products, spanning the shopper journey from awareness to purchase.
- Develop rigorous approaches to incrementality measurement and long-term-sales modeling that ground optimization in true advertiser value.
- Design and lead large-scale experiments and analyses to validate hypotheses and guide product direction.
- Partner closely with engineering and product to define technical contracts, data schemas, and serving systems that carry models into production.
- Raise the technical bar across science and engineering through mentorship, design reviews, and hands-on collaboration.
- Grow scientific talent and publish impactful research internally and at top-tier venues.

- PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field

- Experience leading experienced scientists, as well as a record of developing junior members from academia or industry into a career track in a business environment

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Manager, RF System Integration and Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a satellite constellation delivering Ka-band broadband and NTN Direct to Device connectivity to standard 3GPP handsets. Nothing launches until its radio performance is proven, and nothing stays healthy in orbit without the means to watch it. Both are the responsibility of RF System Integration and Test team in Amazon Leo.

We are looking for a senior engineering leader to own this function. You will lead an organization of managers and engineers accountable for RF and RAN-level verification across multiple generations of Ka-band broadband and the NTN Direct to Device payload — product lines at different stages of maturity, from production through integration to definition. You will also own the purpose-built test and monitoring systems that make that verification possible.

As a growing team this is a build-the-organization role as much as a run-the-organization role. The function is scaling substantially against a production ramp and a Direct to Device launch, across multiple sites. You will set the multi-year verification strategy, own the investment case for it, and be accountable for the verified performance data that gates every generation's launch readiness.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



Key job responsibilities
Verification strategy across product lines
• Own the multi-year RF and RAN-level verification strategy spanning multiple generations of proprietary Ka-band broadband and 3GPP NTN Direct to Device
• Define what constitutes sufficient evidence of radio performance for launch readiness, and hold that line under based on lab and outdoor tests
• Own end-to-end RF verification of each new generation as hardware and software arrive, including line-replaceable unit acceptance testing that de-risks program timelines
• For Ka-band: own performance and conformance verification of customer terminal and gateway links, production and general-availability readiness, throughput and capacity investigation, over-the-air debug and field validation
• For NTN Direct to Device: own RF conformance of the payload, radio resource management verification, radio-access-to-core end-to-end testing, user equipment acceptance testing, and the progression from laboratory into over-the-air trials
• Direct test infrastructure definition for future capability — new spectrum bands, and integrated communication and sensing

RF and RAN-level system verification
• Own RF characterization across both product lines: EIRP, beam pattern and pointing accuracy, beam steering, array calibration, spectral conformance, and transmit and receive array performance
• Own RAN-level and radio resource management verification: scheduling, beam hopping, admission control, power control, link adaptation, and behavior under load and across capacity modes
• Own verification of the RAN system-level use cases that determine whether the service actually works, including initial network entry, handover and mobility, radio link monitoring and recovery, session continuity, and GNSS-less operation
• Ensure these campaigns are executed across both the indoor laboratory and the mobile test laboratory, so that behavior proven in a controlled environment is confirmed under real-world motion, geometry and propagation

Test and monitoring systems as a product portfolio
• Own the roadmap, investment case and delivery of a portfolio of purpose-built test and monitoring systems, developed in house as custom hardware and software rather than assembled from commercial instrumentation
• Own the ground-based monitoring network that provides automated, real-time visibility of phased array transmit and receive health and signal quality on live payloads. This is the only mechanism by which payload RF performance can be observed in production, and scaling it from a limited set of ground stations toward constellation-wide coverage is a strategic deliverable, not a tooling task
• Own the mobile test laboratory development and opeation — vehicle-based platforms that take RF and RAN-level verification into the field
• Own flight-representative channel-emulation test venues, which serve as reference environments for payload qualification across the organisation
• Decide build versus buy across the portfolio, and own the consequences of those decisions
Organizational leadership
• Lead and develop a team of engineering managers, and extend the organizational structure as the scope scales
• Own hiring strategy for a specialized and competitive talent pool spanning RF, antenna, protocol and test-systems engineering and software / automation development
• Lead a multi-site organization, including laboratory build-out and operational readiness across facilities
• Develop senior technical and managerial talent, and build bench strength ahead of need
Planning and investment
• Own annual and multi-year planning for the function: headcount, operating expense, and capital
• Own the investment case for test infrastructure and laboratory build-out, and defend it in planning forums
• Manage significant test capital and vendor commitments, including silicon and protocol stack partners

Cross-organization leadership
• Partner with systems and PHY/MAC design teams on what must be verified and how, with payload development on designing for testability, and with the Payload Integration and Test (PIT) team for payload qualification and flight validation organization whose gates consume your evidence
• Represent verification status, risk and readiness to program and executive leadership
• Lead technical engagement with silicon, protocol stack and test equipment partners at commitment level


About the team
Communication Systems is the systems engineering and technology organisation responsible for designing, simulating, integrating and verifying satellite communications across every generation of Amazon Leo — Ka-band broadband and NTN Direct to Device. The team owns the signal chain from PHY and MAC design through RF verification, and produces the analytical and verification foundation the business depends on for capacity planning, coverage forecasting and network investment decisions. RF System Integration and Test is the function that turns design intent into proven performance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics
- 5+ years of engineering management experience, including experience managing engineering managers
- 10+ years in RF, wireless or satellite communications engineering, with significant depth in test, integration or verification
- Experience owning verification for a commercial wireless or satellite communications product through launch or general availability
- Experience owning headcount and capital planning for an engineering function

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading verification across multiple concurrent product generations at different maturity stages
- Depth in active phased array test and characterization — near-field, compact antenna test range or far-field methods, beam pattern, pointing accuracy and array calibration verification
- Experience building organizations that develop custom test systems as products, hardware and software together, rather than operating purchased instrumentation
- Experience verifying system-level radio behavior — initial access, handover and mobility, link recovery — rather than component performance alone
- 3GPP NR or LTE RF conformance and radio resource management verification experience; non-terrestrial network experience strongly preferred
- Satellite payload or space hardware verification leadership, with an appreciation of what changes when the article becomes unreachable after launch
- Experience owning field, drive-test or mobile laboratory programs, and production monitoring networks at geographic scale
- Experience with both proprietary and standards-based air interfaces
- Experience leading multi-site engineering organizations and multi-million-dollar test capital program
- Master's degree or higher in a relevant field

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager , Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings daily. As we rapidly become the world's largest consumer of corporate services in many categories, the Corporate Strategic Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join our team. This role is uniquely positioned at the nexus of business units across Amazon, and offers singular vision into a broad spectrum of cross-company initiatives and strategies on a global scale. Using this unique insight, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will build and lead sourcing engagements for both existing and newly emerging categories of spend, as well as negotiate multi-faceted partnership agreements for Amazon's high-growth businesses worldwide. Strategic Sourcing Managers own complex categories across multiple business units and regions, often in markets with limited competition and pricing transparency, and lead transformational sourcing initiatives with global scope. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments, and have a strong bias for decision making rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence C-level vendor relationships by advising senior Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business unit and corporate goals, and they raise the bar for sourcing peers across the global team. Successful candidates must work well in a fast-paced and often ambiguous arena, and will be rewarded by working alongside highly collaborative and entrepreneurial colleagues in an environment that feels much more "startup" than "big company". This role supports the Logistics spend category and we are seeking experienced sourcing professional with experience in this arena who have a passion for serving customers and for driving change and impact on a global scale, then we would love to talk with you.

Key job responsibilities
- Owning one or more complex (sub-)categories across multiple business units and/or regions, developing and executing (sub-)category strategies
- Developing global sourcing strategies to deliver against business objectives for internal clients, and achieving sustainable relationships with suppliers.
- Managing categories in markets with limited competition and limited pricing transparency, proactively identifying and mitigating supplier, commercial, and ESG risk.
- Evaluating supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and bench-marking analysis.
- Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities, including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
- Leading transformational sourcing projects with complex, global scope, coordinating work across team members and regions.
- Working with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership, and value creation beyond cost savings.
- Presenting sourcing strategies, recommendations, and decisions to senior leaders up to three levels above you.
- Contributing inputs to annual and long-range operating plans (OP1, OP2, and three-year forecast).
- Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement processes and maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Amazon's global policies.
- Preparing and holding business reviews with stakeholders to review vendor performance, future opportunities, and/or challenges.
- Mentoring and sharing best practices with sourcing peers across the global team.


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you're on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You'll close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you'll balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.


About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate & Facilities. We're a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. You'll be joining a team where your work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, etc.)
- Experience managing spend categories that include three or more of the following: IT Software, IT Services, Corporate Services, Marketing, Contingent labor, Facilities and Real estate, Capital Expenditure and Tail Spend (Indirect Categories)
- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing and category management in categories such as professional services, support or maintenance spend, supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a non-mandated, indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience owning complex sourcing categories across multiple business units and/or regions
- Experience managing categories in markets with limited competition or limited pricing transparency, including proactive supplier risk management
- Experience leading transformational or cross-regional sourcing initiatives with global scope
- Experience advising and presenting sourcing strategy to senior executives and influencing C-level vendor relationships
- Experience contributing to annual or long-range operating plans

title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?

DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights.

This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
• You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
• You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
• Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
• Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
• Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
• Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
• Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
• Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
• Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
• Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

A day in the life
You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands on technical leadership, ensuring your team delivers operationally stable, scalable solutions across multiple countries.

About the team
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.

We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 3+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Work Based Learning Program Logistics Specialist
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) are seeking Logistics Specialists as part of our Work Based Learning Program (WBLP). This entry- level position requires the successful candidate report to a site location. Amazon has multiple WBLP trainee openings between June and December of 2026. Trainees will participate in our 12-month work and training program in our Ohio facilities.

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:

* Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds

* Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed

* Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments

* Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day

* Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

* Tolerance for working in non-climate –controlled environment with temperature functions.

NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

NOTE: If applying for positions in Oregon (OR) and Ohio (OH), these sites are within AWS GovCloud region. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States). (Internal Only Section)



Key job responsibilities
Vendor and team communication including data entry, coordinating with suppliers, and resolving inquiries from cross-functional teams

* Ensure that all billing associated with the Inventory supply chain is accurate, validated and ready for processing

* Assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials

* Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations

* Keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company is required

* Traveling with personal vehicle within the regional work area is required.

* Successfully completing the 12-month Work Based Learning Program training curriculum, including all required safety certifications, technical competencies, and performance mile

A day in the life
The Logistics Specialist reviews Data Center inventory, in-bound shipments, and ongoing demand to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained in the assigned data center to support build and repair activities. Working with the Logistics Manager, you will create plans to optimize the flow of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory location, movement, age, and returns. You will work closely with Data Center Operations Technicians and Data Center Engineers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately. You will also work with Procurement and Hardware Engineering to purchase new parts and interface directly with vendors to process RMAs and receive replacements. Regular and ongoing communications with vendors to resolve issues and help them understand our business requirements necessitates a high-level communicator.

In addition, Logistics Specialists are required to understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e forklift or cherry picker). Candidates will work in a warehouse or data center environment depending on the region.

All candidates should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organization skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights and may be required to work weekends/holidays. Traveling within the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and a valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provide

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

title: Principal PMT, NTN Handsets, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. As part of this mission, we are seeking a Senior Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to define product requirements, lead feature alignment and drive roadmap planning with NTN Handset OEMs globally. You will bridge the gap between engineering teams across satellite RAN, Core, and industry-leading 5G Handsets to ensure we seamlessly connect people anywhere on Earth.

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP control and user plane protocols, extensive experience with 4G/5G Handset launch, product lifecycle and device portfolio management, and the ability to translate customer experiences and user stories into detailed product requirements. The Senior Product Manager - Technical (PMT) will be at the forefront of defining NTN device requirements and building 0-to-1 satellite systems for consumer, business, and government customers globally.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive User-Equipment (UE) feature alignment with 5G Handset vendors to ensure interoperability with Amazon Leo RAN, Core, Transport, and cloud infrastructure, including standards-compliant connectivity and roaming services between satellite and terrestrial networks.
• Own the NTN Handset product roadmap, UE Compliance, and Amazon Leo device technical acceptance (TA) execution plan, ensuring NTN Handset delivery across multiple workstreams with high standards and operational excellence.
• Work closely with Amazon Leo engineering teams, Payload Integration Test (PIT) and telco MNO/Device/Chipset partners to define, build and test 3GPP-compliant protocol layers, ensuring deterministic behavior, low latency, and high reliability for satellite-based connectivity and TN-NTN mobility. Lead by example with systems thinking to solve problems.
• Stay current with 3GPP releases, industry trends, and evolving NTN deployment models to guide long-term product strategy aligned to Amazon Leo’s roadmap.
• Write and present technical documents (6-pagers, PR/FAQs, BRDs, PRDs) to senior leadership.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering hardware, software, systems, operations, and program management teams across Amazon Leo.
• Be structured and flexible at the same time to learn as the business evolves.
• Provide visibility and communicate extremely well, with responsibility to provide updates to VPs, author operation plans, business review documents, and communicate to the broader Amazon Leo team.
• Be a seasoned product leader with a demonstrated history of leading product strategy, technology solutions, data analytics, and customer experience.
• Thrive on ambiguity and have a track record of delivering large-scale technology products and/or led large operational or technical teams.
• Lead large, global, and complex technology initiatives in a large business unit, working cross-functionally with several business and technical teams.
• The ability to think and move quickly and is inspired to build mechanisms to simplify and continuously innovate.
• Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills; ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases.
• Operate with a bias for action while maintaining the highest bar for quality and safety in satellite communications systems.
• Demonstrate Ownership by treating the team's mission as your own and Earn Trust through transparent communication and consistent delivery.


A day in the life
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

About the team
You will be joining a team focused on defining and driving the product requirements for the Amazon Leo Direct-to-Device (D2D) satellite system.

-Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
-Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
-Experience technical product management

-Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
-Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

title: AWS Sr. Partner Sales Manager, TMEGS Partner Sales
descriptionHtml:
The Partner Sales Manager (PSM) is a quota-carrying sales professional responsible for co-sell execution from partner selection through close, driving partner-delivered revenue across an industry-aligned territory. The role requires matching partner capabilities to active customer needs, positioning joint value to field and customer stakeholders, and maintaining pipeline discipline across one or more sales territories.

Operating across AWS Marketplace, cloud migrations, and Generative AI, the PSM engages customer, partner, and AWS field stakeholders to build pipeline, increase partner-led deal flow, and deliver revenue against quota.

The ideal candidate operates with minimal direction, prioritizes decisively, escalates with context when deals exceed scope, and builds credibility through consistent execution.

Key job responsibilities
SALES — Revenue Achievement, Co-Sell Execution & Partner Solution Positioning
Achieve Revenue Targets: Own direct quota accountability across an industry-aligned territory, co-selling with GSI/SIs and ISVs. Prospect, qualify, develop, and close partner-delivered opportunities through joint pursuit plans that align partner capabilities to specific customer outcomes. Maintain pipeline accuracy across AWS and partner CRM systems, advance deals from qualification to close, and deploy co-sell funding mechanisms to compress sales cycles.

Execute Co-Sell Motions: Co-sell with GSI, SI, and ISV partners to accelerate pipeline and close revenue. Engage partners early in joint accounts to shape deals and establish credibility. Position joint solutions alongside field sellers by connecting partner capabilities to specific customer outcomes. Structure deals to simplify procurement and compress sales cycles.

Drive Migration-Attached Revenue: Lead cross-functional deal progression for migration opportunities — coordinating GSI/SI delivery partners, positioning solution options (mainframe modernization, DC exit, VMware displacement, app rationalization), and building multi-stakeholder consensus across procurement, IT leadership, and business owners. Accelerate client migration of legacy environments to AWS at scale.


ALLIANCES — Strategic Partner Development & Industry Ecosystem Building
Develop Strategic Partner Relationships: Build and deepen partner relationships that unlock new line-of-business personas and buying centers within customer accounts. Drive pipeline creation through joint account planning, QBRs, and targeted scale campaigns with the One Partner Team — mapping partner capabilities to high-priority workloads and active customer initiatives to generate qualified co-sell opportunities.

Shape Partner Co-Sell Deals Through AWS Marketplace: Identify, structure, and advance partner-sourced opportunities that solve customer challenges in areas such as regulatory compliance, data modernization, security, and digital transformation — aligning the right ISV solution to the right business outcome.

Accelerate Marketplace Adoption: Articulate the financial and operational benefits of consolidated ISV purchasing to procurement, vendor management, and business stakeholders. Position Marketplace as the single platform where clients evaluate and purchase partner solutions — simplifying procurement and reducing cost.


OPERATIONS — Execution Rigor & Cross-Functional Orchestration
Own Territory Strategy: Mobilize cross-functional resources across field sales, solution architects, AWS Professional Services, business development, and partner delivery organizations to drive sales velocity. Develop and execute territory plans that map specific partner capabilities to customer transformation priorities — Marketplace adoption, migration programs, and Generative AI readiness — with defined owners, timelines, and success metrics.

Maintain Operational Discipline: Ensure CRM accuracy, forecast precision, and program utilization tracking. Use AI tools to produce pipeline briefs and risk assessments for leadership. Execute through the OneTeam model, holding cross-functional stakeholders accountable to shared commitments.

Deliver Against Goals and Mitigate Risk Proactively: Identify blockers early, escalate with context and proposed resolution paths, route field feedback to close execution gaps, and engage the right stakeholders to unblock stalled deals — accelerating close and protecting partner and customer trust.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

descriptionHtml:
As an Operations Engineer, you will lead and manage the lifecycle of challenging cross-functional projects, developing and delivering the next generation of sortation and distribution solutions. You are a customer obsessed leader that will play an integral part in planning and implementation of the facility network infrastructure including new builds, retrofits, expansions, and program initiatives. Partnering with internal customers and internal/external stakeholders to engage as a team and ensure a timely handover will be part of your critical tasks.

Amazon is seeking an industry proven and detail-oriented Operations Engineer for the design, build, and continuous improvement of our order fulfillment infrastructure. Successful candidates are natural self-starters who have prior engineering experience in the integrated automation project life cycle, including their development, design, implementation, enhancement, and support. This individual ideally has directly managed the execution of large capital automation projects with a cumulative spend of less than $5MM and high schedule commitments.

Our Operations Engineers must be agile with the ability to quickly adapt strategies, plans, and solutions in response to dynamic business requirements. They also must be comfortable interfacing and driving various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. Open minds, customer focus, innovation empowerment, advanced technologies, team comradely, individual drive, and occasional senses of humor enable our Regional Operations Engineering team to deliver the most advanced fulfillment solutions in the world.

As an Operations Engineer for Amazon, you will work with some of the most talented engineers in the design, development, and delivery of physical distribution systems around the globe. You are responsible for managing a technology or integration project, successfully delivering the solution to meet project goals within schedule, budget, safety, and quality targets. You may work directly with external equipment vendors, customers, partners, internal customers, and stakeholders to provide technical expertise. You have a solid understanding of the design approaches and industry technologies utilized in fulfillment and distribution center designs to analyze, deep dive, and improve systems performance. To meet timelines and minimize disruption to support teams, you manage the overall schedule, proactively mitigate risks, and keep the scope of engineering deliverables under control.

If you have proven integrated automation project engineering experience, thrive on the corresponding challenges, seek an opportunity for professional growth, and want to help Amazon further raise our fulfillment solution bar, then this role is for you!

This role requires 75% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, improve, and innovate order fulfillment infrastructure throughout the large-scale supply chain network.
- Manage, design, and implement medium scope integrated automation projects with system elements such as high-speed sortation, multiple conveyors, package lines, and/or robotic work cells.
- Typical project installation values range from less than $1MM to greater than $5MM.
- Manage on-site vendors through their leads and escalate issues through vendor and Amazon leadership.
- Evaluate issues and propose actionable resolutions to design problems.
- Identify and communicate needs for design improvements.
- Monitor and enforce project schedules and quality with vendors or subcontractors.
- Lead and coordinate design and execution efforts between internal teams and outside vendors including equipment specifications, material flow, process design, and site layout.
- Develop and manage budget and contract documents including request for proposals (RFPs), change order controls, purchase orders, and invoicing.
- Lead system commissioning and predefined testing activities, including administering the plan, interpreting statuses and reporting results.
- Coordinate with local site management to ensure proper operator training, procedural compliance, maintenance and safety practices are followed for new and existing equipment.
- Thoroughly document, investigate, and submit change requests (CRs).
- Build strong working relationships with NA Operations leadership and their operations teams across multiple sites as well as their Launch, Facilities, Finance, Safety and Process Engineers business stakeholders.
- Identify and lead process improvement initiatives in support of operations teams within the node.
- Support Kaizen events and occasionally participate when appropriate.
- Leverage working knowledge of Amazon operations with an understanding of day-to-day workings and strategic Amazon NA network planning.
- Perform and direct data analysis to provide recommendations or conclusions.
- Inspect facilities in accordance with corporate standards and procedures relating to material handling, processing and storage.
- Develop cross-functional knowledge of Start-Up team systems, processes, procedures and tools.

A day in the life
You are managing one or multiple projects that can vary in scope, complexity and duration.
Daily tasks may comprise of site coordination with operations teams and contractors on project execution activities or changes; deep diving project progress, schedule and resources, while identifying barriers, creating solutions and driving resolutions. You may be facilitating the planning and/or implementation meetings with projects’ stakeholders, ensuring alignment in objectives, expectations, and the next steps; you would capture and publish detailed notes after each meeting to drive ownership and follow-through on the actions and decisions. Reviewing and approving Sorter System Functional specification document is one of the essential tasks, and you may be tracking the on-time creation of the sorter configurations with the internal automation teams. You may be brainstorming and developing workaround solutions while mitigating the project delays or design issues. As a part of the acceptance testing, you may be performing systems installation quality, safety, throughput, and performance qualifications, frequently communicating the progress to internal and external stakeholders. In addition, you may be supporting/training other engineering team members, utilizing the knowledge of Amazon’s safety, mechanical, electrical and controls installation standard and guidelines.

Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Operations Engineering, or Ops Eng, works across North America to deliver Material Handling System launches, retrofits, and innovations. A day in the life can take place on a jobsite, in an active facility, or in one of Amazon’s corporate offices. GES NA Ops Eng is highly team-oriented, working daily be smarter together, be faster together, and to grow together.

About the team
Within Amazon, we are part of the Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Operations Engineering, or NA Ops Eng, organization. The Ops Eng Execution Team is responsible for delivery of Automation Infrastructure projects related to material handling, storage, processing, and delivery of products to retrofits and newbuilds throughout First and Middle Miles across all regions within North America.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything
from firm engineering to project execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse,
upbeat, creative team of engineers and managers working on a daily basis to ensure that our internal
customers have capabilities to deliver on the Customer Promise.
We not only build, but we are also consistently improving our capabilities at Amazon. Continuous
improvement is the ongoing enhancement of our systems through incremental and
breakthrough developments. We are continually raising the quality bar, and are never satisfied.
We seek to improve through captured lessons learned that are incorporated back into our mechanisms
as a way to perpetually improve upon the next design and processes iterations.
We continually learn, grow, and develop throughout the organization and our Subject Matter Expertise is leveraged globally.
We are the Team! We collaborate, support, help and leverage each other in delivering on the business
objectives.

title: Principal Technical Business Development
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to shape the future of how Amazon partners with the world's most influential companies? In this role, you will own the strategy and execution for Amazon's most complex and high-impact business development opportunities, working directly with C-level executives at major external partners while influencing product direction and long-term investment decisions internally. You will operate at the intersection of technology and business, identifying transformative opportunities that create lasting value for customers and partners alike. If you are a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, excels at building trust with senior stakeholders, and has a track record of closing large-scale, strategic deals, we want to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

title: Sr. Program Manager, HL B2B
descriptionHtml:
In the "Hardlines B2B & Category Expansion" division at Amazon Japan, this role owns the end-to-end MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operation) initiative — one of the highest-priority growth segments within Amazon Business Japan. As the MRO Initiative Owner, you will hold direct accountability for MRO GMS growth, define the short-to-long-term strategic roadmap, and execute against ambitious targets by influencing and aligning cross-functional stakeholders through shared goals.

MRO is a large and rapidly growing segment serving manufacturing, construction, engineering, automotive, and other industries. The addressable universe spans millions of SKUs across consumables (PPE, tapes, cleaning supplies), industrial equipment and parts (compressors, pumps, valves), plant maintenance supplies (gaskets, lubricants, repair tools), and construction products (light bulbs, breakers, HVAC filters). This role requires a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — setting the vision for best-in-class Selection, Pricing, Availability, and Customer Experience (CX) while driving day-to-day execution with urgency.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Reference: What is MRO? https://business.amazon.co.jp/en/discover-more/blog/mro

Key job responsibilities
A) MRO Growth Ownership & Strategic Planning
Own the MRO business targets and develop the short-term, mid-term, and long-term strategic roadmap with clear milestones and measurable goals. Build the annual operating plan, establish review mechanisms, and drive accountability for results through data-driven decision making.

B) Cross-Functional Influence & Execution through Shared Goals
Influence and align multiple stakeholders — including category, sales, marketing, operations, pricing, and product teams — through shared goals and joint business plans. Drive execution across organizations without direct authority, negotiate priorities, resolve trade-offs, and ensure MRO targets are achieved.

C) Delivering Best-in-Class Customer Experience across Selection, Pricing, Availability & CX
Define and execute the strategy to achieve competitive leadership across the four pillars of B2B procurement excellence: comprehensive product selection, competitive pricing, reliable availability, and a differentiated customer experience tailored to professional buyers' mission-oriented purchasing needs.

D) Global Stakeholder Collaboration & Influence
Serve as the primary Japan representative for worldwide MRO initiatives. Engage with US and EU counterparts to align roadmaps, share best practices, and influence global product and technology prioritization to reflect Japan market requirements.

E) Go-to-Market Partnership & Customer Engagement
Partner with sales and marketing teams to develop and execute MRO-specific go-to-market strategies. Leverage customer insights and competitive intelligence to continuously refine the value proposition and identify new growth opportunities.

title: Senior Strategic Supply Chain Manager, JP Books
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンでは、書籍事業部に参画してくれるお客様志向で、自発的、且つ、分析力のあるリーダーを探しています。 そして、サプライチェーンにおける複雑な問題に責任を持つSenior Strategic Supply Chain Manager (SSCM) の役割を担ってもらう方です。 この職種では、様々なチームと協業して、お客様、および、ベンダーのエクスペリエンスを向上させることを目的とした施策を計画・実行します。

Amazon is looking for a customer focused, self-driven, and analytical leader to join the Books organization. We are looking for a Senior Strategic Supply Chain Manager (SSCM) who can own complex problems within Supply Chain team. In this role, the candidate will work with cross-functional teams to identify and launch initiatives aimed at improving the customer and vendor experience.

書籍事業部について
読書は健全な社会にとって必須であるという信念のもと、読者が手軽に本に手を伸ばし、より多くの恵沢を享受できるようにすることが私たちの使命です。さらに、本ポジションが所属するサプライチェーンチームのミッションは、お客様の読みたい書籍を読みたいタイミングで届けることを通じて、日本のお客様に満足して頂くことです。この使命を全うするため、我々は革新的なプロダクトやサービスの立ち上げを通じて、サプライチェーンを改革・改善し続けることを目指しています。日本の書籍業界のサプライチェーンは変革期にあり、お客様のために様々な改善を適用していく豊富な機会があります。特に、AIのモデルなどの最新の技術を活用してサプライチェーンや在庫管理の様々な活動を自動化し、お客様に貢献する機会があります。
About Books organization
We believe reading is essential for a healthy society; our mission is to inspire readers by making it easy to read more and get more out of reading. Especially mission for Supply Chain team, which this role belongs to, is to satisfy our customers in Japan by providing the right products with the right quantities, in the right place, at the right time. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class Supply Chain experience through the introduction of pioneering new products and services. Supply chain of books industry in JP is in the turning point where industry is changing and there are abundant opportunities to make improvements for our customers. Especially there are opportunities to leverage advanced technologies such as machine learning models to automate multiple aspects of supply chain and inventory management.

職務概要
Senior Strategic Supply Chain Manager は、サプライチェーン戦略に責任を持つことで、最高クラスの顧客体験を実現すると同時に、コストの最適化を図ります。このロールは、需要予測・発注・在庫管理などのエコシステムの構築、管理、最適化を含むサプライチェーンの改革・改善に重要な役割を果たします。また、商品のセレクションの拡充、在庫化率の向上、お客様への配送スピードの向上、および、コストの最適化を実現するため、施策を計画し、実行に移します。これらのことを、アマゾン内のグローバルな関連チームや日本の出版社や取次などのベンダーと密接に協力することで実現します。

Key responsibilities
The Strategic Supply Chain Manager will demonstrate ownership of supply chain strategies to realize the best-in-class customer experience while optimizing cost structure. This role plays a critical role in helping Amazon build, manage and optimize a complex supply chain including Forecasting/Ordering/Inventory manage ecosystem. As Strategic Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for defining and executing plans to improve availability of products, delivery speed to customers, and supply chain cost. You will achieve these initiatives by partnering closely with and influencing cross-functional internal teams and Books vendors.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

descriptionHtml:
Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Payload Processing Quality team is driven to develop a Leo Quality System that is capable of scaling aerospace quality to volume and cost levels to meet end customer needs. This position will join the team at an exciting moment, with an opportunity to own quality system development and contribute to the design of requirements, processes, and systems used across the business.

Partners with cross-functional groups to develop and qualify internal production processes, including Quality Assurance processes

Develop and modify process flow diagrams, PFMEAs, control plans, MSAs, and other APQP artifacts to support continued high quality production.
Working within an AS9100 (or similar) certified quality system

title: System Development Engineer,, DSP Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in building high-performance, globally scalable systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top engineering talent get you charged up?

Looking for a highly motivated System Development Engineer to help build Amazon's business critical delivery systems and build solutions to operate at scale. You will work on critical business functions for our customers around the world while meeting system availability goals and ensuring system performance with growing business needs. You will discover innovative ways to automate and scale our infrastructure as we expand globally. You will work together with multiple teams and departments, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

The ideal candidate has a passion for understanding computing systems and for applying that understanding with an obsession for delighting customers. In this role, you will apply your skills of system design, networking, coding/scripting languages, as well as technical communication and project organization to make your impact on improving our business processes. The candidate is expected to contribute work critical initiatives, build products, lead engineers to troubleshoot, debug, evaluate and resolve computer-identified alarms, make feature enhancements, systems management, perform software deployments and migrations, host management and automate the operational tasks.

They would also be responsible to develop tools and end to end automation to achieve human free operations.

As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.

Key job responsibilities
Design, implement, maintain, and deploy components that solve problems in a complex ecosystem. We work in lots of different languages (not limited to, but most often Python and Java). It is more important to us that you understand coding in the context of working in distributed systems and/or widely scaled web applications.

● Lead migration projects from planning through execution, including infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation

● Identify and implement cost optimization strategies to reduce per-offering costs through automation and streamlined operations.

● Mentor and guide junior engineers, conducting code reviews, providing technical direction, and fostering a culture of operational excellence within the team.

● Lead root cause analysis for high-severity incidents, implement preventive measures, and drive operational improvements across the team's processes and tooling.

● Collaborate with service teams across Amazon to identify and resolve migration blockers

● Participate in on-call rotations to ensure operational support for critical migration activities

● Building AI-assisted workflows that streamline migration operation or make our day to day job easier and faster.

● Perform deep dive on services with different compute type to generate recommendations for optimization of resources.

A day in the life
You will lead the technical direction for complex migration challenges using AWS technologies and modern development practices. You might collaborate on pipeline infrastructure setups, build AI-assisted workflows that streamline migration operations, or develop tools in Python and Java to automate critical migration tasks. You'll work closely with service teams across Amazon to identify and resolve migration obstacles, analyze memory efficiency across service fleets. Your work will span infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation, all while supporting operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. You'll also mentor team members, participate in design reviews, and collaborate with Seattle-based leadership on strategic priorities.

About the team
We are the Amazon DSP Analytics team, supporting all business pillars across the DSP organization horizontally, with the vision to enable data-, insights-, and science-driven decision-making. We are an exceptionally talented and fun-loving team. Here, you'll have the opportunity to dive deep into complex business and data problems, drive large-scale technical solutions, and raise the bar for operational excellence. We love sharing ideas and learning from each other, and we believe in using those ideas to disrupt the status quo.

- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- 4+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Sr Principal, Industrial Design, industrial robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building robotic systems that combine AI, advanced control systems, and mechanical design to create automation solutions that work safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. Our teams are solving hard problems in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction at Amazon’s scale.

We are looking for a Sr Principal Industrial Design to own the vision for our robotics portfolio. You will lead a multidisciplinary team and define how our robots look, feel, move, and communicate intent to the humans who work alongside them. The scope is broad: the robot itself, its enclosures and packaging, the charger, accessories, and the physical environment in which it operates. You will also own our external design agency relationships, setting direction and managing deliverables across internal and external teams. This role requires balancing cost, schedule, and performance while maintaining a high bar for design quality. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, bringing structure where there is none, and driving decisions with data and good judgment.

You will have the creativity to translate a customer-centric design vision into physical products that are simple, intuitive, and refined despite underlying complexity. You have a strong eye for detail, form, and proportion. You think in systems, not just individual objects. You are direct, clear, and persuasive in how you communicate, whether presenting to engineers or senior executives.

• Establishes and owns the design language for the entire portfolio, spanning UX, visual, motion and industrial design, and physical identity across all products, enclosures, accessories, and ecosystem touchpoints.

• Brings structure to ambiguity when defining new products and applying new technologies. Ensures the resulting products are simple, clear, and functional.
• Stays current on advances in industrial design, manufacturing processes, ergonomics, and motion/character design. Leads the team to identify and experiment with new approaches.
• Maintains strong working relationships with Product Management, Marketing, and other stakeholder groups.
• Inspires and develops a small diverse team, creating a culture of inclusion and creativity.
• Contributes as a key leader to the Design Culture and Community at Amazon.

• 10+ years of experience in industrial design, product design, or a similar role focused on physical product development

title: Senior Manager, Hardware Engineering, Robotics Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics Technical Services (RTS) is building a central hardware support function to keep the world's largest robotics fleet running, and we are hiring a Senior Manager, Hardware Development to lead it. This leader will own hardware outcomes across the fleet, from readiness of new products, through in-field hardware services, reliability, and maintainability. You will lead multiple teams — Custom Tools, Retrofits, and Problem Management — along with individual contributors, and build the central Hardware Support Engineering capability that partners across every hardware team in Amazon Robotics. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role for a leader with deep hardware expertise who can set strategy, raise the engineering bar, and operate across organizational boundaries as the function grows.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a multi-team hardware organization spanning Custom Tools, Retrofits, and Problem Management, plus individual contributors, with scope expected to expand as the function matures.
- Set the multi-year technical and organizational strategy for central hardware support across Amazon Robotics, defining the mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that keep the world's largest robotics fleet serviceable at scale.
- Act as the central hardware authority partnering across product engineering, deployment, RME, field hardware support, safety, and supply chain teams — aligning priorities and resolving contentious technical trade-offs beyond any single team.
- Build and develop leaders: hire, coach, and grow managers and senior ICs, and raise the engineering and operational-excellence bar across the organization.
- Own headcount planning, team structure, and delivery accountability as the organization scales, surfacing risks early and driving them to resolution.

A day in the life
You review the hardware portfolio and delivery risks across Custom Tools, Retrofits, and Problem Management with your leads, and decide where to steer resources. You walk the BOS12 lab on an in-progress build of a custom tool and pressure-test a reliability trade-off. You meet cross-functional partners in RME, field support, and supply chain to unblock fleet-wide issues with spare parts and training. You coach a manager on a growth plan, review an escalation, and shape the longer-term strategy for central hardware support — balancing today's field needs against the organization's multi-year direction.

About the team
Amazon Robotics designs and deploys the robotics solutions that power Amazon's fulfillment network. Robotics Technical Services keeps the fleet running. Your organization is the central hardware function — spanning Custom Tools, Retrofits, and Problem Management, and growing into a broader central Hardware Support Engineering capability. We build what nothing off-the-shelf can deliver, work across every hardware team in Amazon Robotics and resolve systemic issue ocuring in the field.

title: Transportation Program Manager, ROC Quality Management
descriptionHtml:
■ポジション概要
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) 部門では、年間数億にのぼる商品をお客様とお約束したお届け日に安全かつ正確にお届けすべく、日本全国のAmazon物流拠点を結ぶ大規模な幹線輸送ネットワークを構築・運営しています。1日5,000運行を超えるこの複雑なネットワーク運営の中核を担うRelay Operation Center (ROC) において、幹線輸送における品質を管理するQuality Management (QM) チームのメンバーを募集します。
ROC QMチームは以下の3つの機能を有し、それぞれの品質水準を高めることで、お客様に最上のサービスを提供します。

(1) 幹線輸送（出荷拠点から配達拠点まで）における輸送期日遵守率の品質管理・改善
期日順守率全体の数値管理を行います。また輸送キャパシティや拠点での処理能力を超過することで発生する貨物の滞留への初動対応、および中期的な対応精度の向上と最適化に取り組みます。

(2) ネットワーク拡大や時季的要因で変動する遅延リスクに対する幹線トラック定刻運行の品質管理・改善
トラックの運行は、大型連休や物流の繁閑期、気象条件、交通事故など、様々な要因の影響を受けます。このような環境下において、社内外のステークホルダーと連携し、輸送品質の安定的な維持・向上を実現します。

(3) 天候災害発生時（台風・大雪など）の品質維持と早期回復に向けたプロセス管理
自然災害が配送網に与える影響を予測・分析し、お客様へのお届け予定日時の調整や配送網の復旧オペレーションを指揮します。また、災害対応プロセスの構築や改善を通じて、安定した配送サービスを実現します。

■本ポジションの魅力
業界経験を問わず、課題解決や業務プロセス改善に意欲的に取り組めるメンバーが活躍できる環境があり、以下のような魅力があります。
- インパクトの大きさ：ROCは日本におけるAmazonの輸送ネットワークの中核を担う組織です。全国のネットワークに影響を及ぼす意思決定に携わり、出荷拠点や配達拠点の担当者、運送会社とも連携した大規模なアクションをリードすることができます。
- キャリア成長機会：オペレーション構築、データ分析、プロセス設計など、幅広いスキルを習得できます。将来的にはチームマネジメントの経験も積むことが可能です。また、物流において特定領域に限定されず、セントラルオペレーション、倉庫業務、プランニングなど、総合的な知見を習得できます。
- グローバル対応力：EUや北米で実践されているベストプラクティスの導入に関わることができます。また、希望に応じて海外のテクノロジーを日本のオペレーションに最適化して導入するプロジェクトにも参画できます。

Amazonの輸送オペレーションの仕組みづくりに携わりながら、様々なスキルを磨くことができます。あなたの経験と可能性を活かし、世界最高品質のECサービスの実現に共に取り組みませんか。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
- チームのイニシアティブを理解して、担当する業務領域におけるプロジェクトを推進する。
- 管理指標やデータを分析することで現状の課題を見出し、解消のためのアクションやKPIを策定・実行する。
- 業務プロセス上の異常を検知し、要因分析と改善に向けた対応を実施する。

A day in the life
[50%] 品質指標の改善に向けたデータ分析、ステークホルダーとの調整を含むプロジェクト推進
[30%] チームが管理する業務プロセス改善、イレギュラー対応
[20%] ドキュメント、作業手順書の作成

勤務地：品川オフィス

出社形態：週5日出社（フルタイム勤務）

勤務日：月曜日〜金曜日（原則平日勤務）

勤務時間：9:00〜18:00（実働8時間）

休日・休暇
- 月10日休み（年間120日）
- 年次有給休暇
- 特別休暇

About the team
本ポジションの所属部門等に関する詳細は、下記リンク先参照ください。

サプライチェーンマネジメント(SCM)・ミドルマイル部門の紹介
https://www.amazon.co.jp/b/?_encoding=UTF8&node=5637338051

東京オフィス(品川)の紹介
https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=5589794051

Basic qualifications

- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（会議ファシリテーション および ビジネス文書作成 が可能なレベル）
- 中級レベルのExcelスキル（SUMIF関数、VLOOKUP関数、ピボットテーブルを使った分析経験）
- プロジェクトマネジメントまたは業務改善の実務経験（業界不問）

Preferred qualifications

- 物流・運輸・流通業界における知見、業務経験
- KPI設定/プロセス改善の経験
- SQL/Oracle/Redshiftいずれかのデータベースの使用経験
- 定量的な分析力および高いITリテラシー
- 日常会話レベルの英語力（英語でのメールや文書の理解が可能なレベル）
- インクルーシブなカルチャーへの貢献や多様性に富んだグループで働くことに対して前向きであること

title: Package Program Manager, JCFS CPEX
descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、環境に配慮した梱包施策の企画・導入を進めています。これを担うオペレーション技術統括本部（JCFS: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions）のCustomer Packaging Experience（CPEX）部門では、事業の成長と、お客様の購入体験の保護、そして環境・サステナビリティへの貢献を同時に実現するため、梱包の最適化（梱包内の無駄な空間を減らし、配送物の体積と配送コストを削減する取り組み、製品の箱のまま出荷する簡易包装の拡大、CO2・プラスチック削減）を推進しており、体制強化のため新たなメンバーを募集しています。

近年、当日配送のGrocery（食品・日用品）ECサービスが急速に拡大しており、新しい業態特有の商品・配送形態に対応したパッケージ施策とプロジェクトマネジメントの強化が求められています。本ポジションは、こうしたGrocery配送サービスの拡大に伴う新規プロジェクトのマネジメント体制を強化するために新設された枠であり、拡大するビジネスを支える新たなメンバーを募集しています。

パッケージ プログラムマネージャーは、「配送・資材コストの低減（配送1件あたりコストの削減を含む）」「お客様の購入体験」「環境配慮」の3つを両立できる梱包施策を、出荷データの分析と現場での検証に基づいて企画・立案し、社内外の関係者を巻き込みながら、企画から実行まで一貫して推進します。出荷実績データに基づいて最適な梱包を導入し、使用する梱包の種類を整理・統合することで効率化を図ります。効果予測に基づくプロジェクトの企画・立案、実行計画の策定、導入後の成果説明までに責任を持ちます。

Amazon is committed to reaching net-zero carbon by 2040, and Amazon Japan is looking for a self-driven and strategic Package Program Manager to help achieve this goal within the JCFS (Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions) team in Tokyo. In the Customer Packaging Experience (CPEX) organization, you will plan and run packaging programs that reduce shipment volume and delivery cost, expand simplified shipping, and advance sustainability — working effectively with internal teams and external partners.
With the rapid growth of same-day grocery (food and daily-goods) e-commerce services, we need to strengthen packaging programs and project management for the unique products and delivery formats these new businesses require. This position has been newly created to reinforce project management capacity as these grocery delivery services expand.

As a Package Program Manager, you will identify cost-reduction opportunities from large internal datasets (using tools such as SQL and Excel) and from on-site verification, propose the highest-priority packaging programs to leadership, and own them from planning through implementation. You will clarify business requirements for package size, type, and cost; introduce optimal packaging based on actual shipment data; consolidate the range of packaging in use; and reduce per-shipment cost — all while understanding the end-to-end flow from fulfillment centers through sortation and delivery stations to final-mile delivery.

Because packaging-reduction initiatives do not always improve operational productivity, you will balance dialogue, active listening, clear proposals, logical thinking, and change management to co-design the right operations and process improvements, building trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders. Not everything goes as planned, so you are expected to solve unexpected problems and ask for support when needed. Your results will be shared with Japan and global leadership through regular business reviews.
The CPEX mission is to delight customers by advancing packaging innovations that reduce waste, cost, and carbon emissions. The Package PM team plans and executes packaging programs that reduce shipment volume and delivery cost, expand simplified shipping (sending orders in the product’s own box without extra Amazon packaging), and advance carbon and plastic reduction. Success depends on close collaboration with internal teams (fulfillment and delivery operations, supply chain, finance, procurement, customer service, and sales) and external partners (vendors, marketplace sellers, logistics providers, and packaging suppliers).


Key job responsibilities
• エンジニアや関連部門と連携して、梱包施策に求められる最新の要件を把握し、優先度の高い施策（梱包の体積削減、簡易包装の拡大など）をリーダー層へ提言し、企画・導入を推進します。
• 出荷データの分析（SQL・Excel等）と現場検証に基づき、資材費・配送費や配送1件あたりコストの削減につながる施策を企画・立案し、実行計画を策定します。
• 社内外の関係部門・取引先（物流・配送オペレーション、調達、サプライチェーン、販売、カスタマーサービス、資材メーカーや出品者など）を巻き込み、企画から実行まで一貫して推進し、結果に責任を持ちます。成果は定量的に評価し、共有・合意を図ります。
• 環境配慮（CO2・プラスチック削減）と現場の生産性を両立させる合意形成を行い、若手メンバーの指導・育成も担います。

• Work closely with engineers and business stakeholders to clarify requirements for packaging programs and present proposals to Amazon Japan leadership.
• Build execution plans for packaging solutions using data and metrics, engage stakeholders and leadership to obtain approval, and launch projects.
• Implement projects with company-wide stakeholders across operations, transportation, supply chain, customer service, finance, and sales, and provide clear, timely reporting of key performance metrics to internal and external stakeholders.
• Report to the CPEX Manager within JCFS, while serving as a point of contact for packaging and technology teams in Japan and across global regions.

A day in the life
パッケージ プログラムマネージャーは、出荷データを分析して体積やコストの削減機会を見つけ、物流・配送拠点を訪問して現場を確認し、施策の提案・関係者との合意形成・経営層への定量的な成果報告まで、プログラムを一貫して推進します。
A Package Program Manager spends time analyzing shipment data to find opportunities to reduce volume and cost, visiting fulfillment and delivery sites to verify operations, and driving programs end to end — proposing initiatives, aligning stakeholders, and reporting measurable results to leadership.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
