title: Senior BMS Specialist, Global BMS Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.

OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.

Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.

GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.

We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.

Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.

Key job responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, HVAC controls, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.

1. Support the development and execution of a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services
2. Collaborate closely with GRBD&E, D&C, Sustainability, RME, and other stakeholders to understand customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs
3. Design, implement, and manage BMS standard operating procedures, policies, and processes that are scalable across the globe
4. Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics tools
5. Monitor and maintain ticket and work order queues, ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar
6. Ensure compliance with change management processes
7. Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings
8. Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach
9. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies
10. Take ownership of BMS initiatives, develop technical documentation, manage timelines, and coordinate with stakeholders
11. Lead training sessions and development programs to continuously enhance the capabilities and technical skills of field RME teams and BMS Specialists
12. Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team
13. Willingness to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support across global time zones

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent
- Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, and SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization.
- Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP).
- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
- Deep understanding of HVAC, lighting, Utilities, field devices, and other building systems, as well as energy management principles.
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize initiatives in a dynamic environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a strategic and innovative mindset.
- Organized and self-motivated to take ownership of complex tasks.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software
- Experience working in cross-regional BMS projects with multicultural teams
- Proficiency in cloud-based IoT platforms, data analytics, and visualization tools
- Certification in relevant programming languages or BMS systems
- Certification with Tridium Niagara
- Certification with Distech Controls
- Strong customer relationship management skills
- Experience and understanding of facility management and relevant electrical and mechanical aspects of BMS equipment
- Proficiency in additional spoken languages

title: Data Center Technical Operations Engineer, AWS Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS Data Centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer with experience in critical facilities management, a result-driven individual with strong technical (electrical/mechanical) understanding and the drive and vision to take our data center engineering operations to the next level. The role will report to the DCEO Manager and be responsible for sustaining availability, cost management, risk assessment and mitigation, review corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure and metric reporting.

You’ll interface with a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
- Undertake and support management of both routine maintenance and emergency service of a variety of critical systems such as switch-gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, fire systems, etc.
- Installation of new rack capacity and provisioning of power/cooling
- On-site management of contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed, is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses and prepare reports and documentation of all aspects of critical facility infrastructure operations and maintenance. Manage the facility’s assets
- Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for all facility related events (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) and assist in the resolution of infrastructure engineering and services issues
- Collaborate with data center IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate day to day operations, projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability, and efficiency
- Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability as well as assist in the design implementation, commissioning and build out of new data center facilities.

Additional role requirements
- This role may involve bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching, ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely
- This role has a rostered on-call requirement to provide 24x7 support. This may change based on the future needs of the business
- Due to the location of our sites, candidates should possess a valid driver's license and their own vehicle.

A day in the life
At today's large-scale data centers, you will be involved in:
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs.
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service-Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management
- Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
- On-site management of contractors, subcontractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
- Experience in vendor management

Preferred qualifications

- Are enrolled in or have completed a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in facilities management, or experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.)

descriptionHtml:
アマゾンの「Hardlines 産業研究開発用品（BISS）」事業部では、主にB2B(法人様向け)ビジネスの顧客満足度向上、および継続的なビジネス成長を担います。その中で、本ポジションは特にMRO*セグメントの担当を想定しており、その事業戦略・商品戦略立案から実行に至るまでを担います。MROセグメントはアマゾンにとって比較的新規領域であるため、対象法人カスタマーのニーズを満たすカスタマーエクスペリエンスやサービスの企画立案、アマゾンビジネスチーム(アマゾンの法人ビジネスに特化した組織)と連携しての法人カスタマー獲得、Amazon US/EUチームとの(連携など幅広いアクションが求められます。様々な関連各署と連携しビジネスを牽引でき、かつ、自ら行動しスピーディに成果を出すことができるリーダーを募集します。
MRO*は”Maintenance(メンテナンス)、Repair(修理)、Operation(運用)”の略で、製造、建設、エンジニアリング、自動車など幅広い企業が必要とする間接資材の用語です。MROセグメントには、消耗品（PPE、テープ、クリーニング用品など）や産業機器や部品（コンプレッサー、ポンプ、バルブなど）からプラント維持用品（ガスケット、潤滑剤、修理工具など）や建築作業用製品（電球、ブレーカー、HVACフィルターなど）など幅広い商材が含まれます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

シニアマネジメント層を含む社内関連部署（事業部長、在庫管理担当者、Amazonビジネス、出品者事業担当者、およびマーケティング部門など）と密接に連携し、効率化と高質化を目指しながら上記の各業務を遂行します。

全社に影響を及ぼし得る複数のプロジェクトに参画し、プロジェクトをリード、あるいはメンバーとして実績を残します。

title: Software Development Manage, Prime Video Title Promotions and Personalization
descriptionHtml:
Just finished “Rings of Power” or “Thursday Night Football” and want to find something new to stream? So do tens of millions of our Prime Video customers. The Prime Video Recommendation team's mission is to leverage Machine Learning (ML) systems that establish deep connections between customers and their favorite Movies, TV shows, and Live Events in order to power highly personalized recommendations, identify the most delightful content for each customer to engage with at the right time, in the right place, across Prime Video. We help our customers find content they didn’t even know they were looking for, continuing to surprise them with the breadth and depth of content available to enjoy.

As a Prime Video technology leader, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career in Prime Video Tech takes you!


Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Manager, you will manage a group of talented SDEs and work with them on the design, implementation, and delivery of large technology initiatives for Prime Video Personalization and new content promotions on the PV Homepage.

You will be responsible for leading initiatives, managing roadmaps, forward looking technical strategy, and designing/building innovative software solutions for our customers. You will need to be an excellent leader and bridge across various parts of Tech, Product, and business.

A day in the life
- Craft a goal update for a key goal that goes up to our VP
- Attend an engineering standup and help unblock a key milestone
- Update the engineering roadmap with updates on the initiatives in flight in your team
- Work through a launch-blocker with some engineers
- Talk with Product managers about the requirements for an upcoming project
- Respond to some emails and work through the release strategy for an upcoming project

About the team
We are a team that is passionate about using Machine Learning and experiments to help make new titles launching on Prime Video into big hits, and surfacing the right content to the right customer at the right time. We love experimentation and learning how we can improve the quality of our recommendations. As an SDM, you will work across the team and the broader PV organization to deliver meaningful change.

We move fast, seek impact and don't forget to have fun on the way. Come help shape this important business for Prime Video and change the streaming industry.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Mgr, Partnerships, Prime Video Customer Growth
descriptionHtml:
Shape the Future of Entertainment in Japan! Prime Video Japan is one of the fastest-growing streaming services in the country, and we're looking for a strategic marketing leader to accelerate our growth through partnerships and customer lifecycle innovation. Come join us to help millions of entertainment lovers discover the magic of streaming their favorite shows and movies on demand, at any time, on any device.

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager independently owns Prime Video Japan's partnership marketing strategy — managing and expanding relationships with major distribution partners — building out new, zero-to-one initiatives where no playbook exists, while also leading customer lifecycle research and experimentation that shapes leadership decisions. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can navigate ambiguous, structurally complex partner dynamics, resolve challenges with partners and internal stakeholders, and combine deep customer understanding with strategic partnership execution.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end development and execution of Prime Video Japan's partnership marketing strategy — including partner prioritization, consumer offer differentiation, marketing campaign execution, placement acquisition, and testing/experimentation — supported by a forward-looking initiative calendar
• Develop and champion new partnership offer constructs, driving cross-functional alignment and leading commercial negotiations with strategic partners
• Drive partner growth strategy to expand Prime Video Japan's distribution partnerships across diverse industry verticals, deepening joint marketing and investment opportunities
• Continuously evaluate and evolve Prime Video Japan's partnership marketing operations, standard operating procedures, and approval processes, driving process improvements that increase speed and responsiveness with partners
• Lead day-to-day partner relationship management with telco partners, running recurring partner business reviews, negotiating co-marketing promotions, and escalating/resolving issues with partner leadership
• Own creative and brand asset operations for partnership marketing end to end: title/asset placement decisions, IP and talent clearance approvals, and creative production, prioritizing tent-pole titles and partner-specific campaigns
• Exchange learnings with stakeholders in other markets, bringing proven Go-To-Market playbooks, tooling, and best practices into Japan, while sharing Japan's own partnership marketing insights back out to the broader partnership marketing community
• Drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Legal, and PR on partnership deal structuring, financial simulations, and resourcing, ensuring partnership marketing initiatives are resourced and executed on plan

About the team
The Prime Video Japan Customer Growth team is a high-impact, cross-functional group dedicated to growing Prime Video's subscriber base and deepening customer engagement across Japan. We operate at the intersection of brand marketing, partnerships, and customer lifecycle strategy — collaborating closely with Content, Consumer Insights, Product, and Finance teams to deliver campaigns and programs that resonate with Japanese audiences. Our team values ownership, creative problem-solving, and a bias for action in a fast-moving entertainment landscape.

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 8+ years of marketing experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience in building, executing and scaling cross functional marketing programs
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in a business-to-business (B2B) environment, high-tech products/services
- Experience working with telecommunication partners

title: Senior Enterprise Account Manager, CS-EMEA Sales
descriptionHtml:
AWS is a place where thousands of different personalities with the same customer obsession come to turn can’t-be-done into done. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join AWS, and we encourage our employees to bring their own voice and chart their own path.

Do you look around corners for ways to engage and service customers? Are you passionate about using technology to solve business problems that have big customer impact?

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you are driving digital transformations through effective engagement with C-level executives, business line executives and IT leaders. You are establishing Amazon Web Services as the key cloud technology provider across the strategic accounts you manage, promoting the entire AWS products and services portfolio to the Fortune 1000 market segment.

On a daily basis you empower your customers to solve challenges while attaining both their operational and innovation goals. You deliver business outcomes while guiding them to become more agile, innovative, and efficient. With AWS, our customers benefit from the fastest pace of innovation, the broadest and deepest functionality, the most secure computing environment, and the most proven operational expertise.

We're obsessed with customers, we see beauty in simplifying the complex, and we are comfortable with being called "peculiar." That might sound peculiar, but our unusual approach and our culture - focused on removing obstacles so builders can build - are part of why our employees enjoy working at AWS.

- Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
- Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services to business executives.
- Create & maintain an opportunity pipeline and drive consistent account-specific activities
- Work with partners to extend reach & promote adoption
- Manage complex customer interactions
- Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts executives
- Ensure customer satisfaction
- Expect moderate travel

Come build the future with us.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Key job responsibilities
As an Enterprise Account Manager, you lead cloud and AI transformation across strategic accounts by engaging at the highest levels of the organization starting with C-suite executives and board-level stakeholders to align AWS to their most critical business priorities. You orchestrate multi-threaded relationships across business development leaders, IT executives, and lines of business to build and accelerate transformation agendas from the top down.

You position Amazon Web Services as the strategic cloud and AI partner of choice for your portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving measurable business outcomes through the full breadth of the AWS platform from infrastructure and data to generative AI and industry solutions.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

As an Operations Engineer at Amazon, you will manage the lifecycle of greenfield and brownfield projects — from initial design through installation and qualification. You will collaborate with cross-functional partners including Engineering, Safety, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations to deliver solutions on time and within budget. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team that is expanding its project portfolio, where your ability to navigate change, solve problems, and drive results will have a visible impact on how Amazon serves its customers.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Leo Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are looking for a senior software development engineer to be a founding engineer on the Engineering and R&D team within Leo Space Security. The team defends the manufacturing lines, launch sites, and global ground infrastructure behind the constellation from the most sophisticated threat actors on the planet. You will build a neuro-symbolic reasoning platform: large language model agents combined with a knowledge graph and real-time asset state store that ground every conclusion in verifiable fact, so every automated decision is auditable. The platform automates incident response, threat analysis, offensive security testing, and detection authoring, backed by a high-throughput streaming pipeline that takes a detection from concept to production in hours. This is a unique opportunity to build a security platform from early stage through global scale, at a consequence level few teams ever encounter.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen.


Key job responsibilities
You will own architecture decisions across the platform, providing system-wide design guidance and ensuring our services are secure, scalable, and operationally simple. You will design and build the distributed systems that carry the platform, from telemetry ingestion and real-time correlation through agent execution and observability, in an environment where a wrong automated action has real operational consequences. You will drive automation relentlessly: replacing manual security operations with software, building the evaluation and backtesting infrastructure that proves a model or detection is correct before it is trusted in production, and creating deployment guardrails that prevent human error in high-consequence environments. You will partner with applied scientists to turn research prototypes into production capabilities, mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and set the standard for code quality across the team. You will operate what you build, owning operational health, incident response, and reliability for services the security organization depends on.

A day in the life
One morning you might lead a design review for a new detection pipeline stage, challenging the team to eliminate every manual step and asking what happens when each component fails or is fed hostile input. That afternoon you could be writing code to tighten the guardrails on an agent tool, or profiling the correlation path to shave seconds off the time from event to detection. The next day you might investigate an anomalous pattern in your service metrics, treating it as hostile until proven otherwise, then work with a scientist to backtest a candidate detection against retained telemetry before it ships. You will obsess over the two latencies that define the platform, the time from event to detection and the time from detection to containment action, and question any process that relies on a human doing the right thing under pressure. The team is new, so the architecture decisions you make now will carry the platform for years.

About the team
Leo Space Security protects the people, facilities, hardware, and supply chain behind a global satellite constellation. The Engineering and R\&D team within this organization builds the platforms and tooling the security pillar teams operate on, moving security operations from manual triage to correlation-based detection, automated response, and agentic AI. The team is composed of applied scientists, software engineers, and security engineers working across physical and digital security domains.

title: Sr. Manufacturing HW Eng, AI/ML & Storage server development
descriptionHtml:
Team Introduction
AWS Hardware Engineering designs and delivers next-generation cloud infrastructure at global scale. Our Storage & AI/ML Manufacturing team owns the manufacturing engineering lifecycle for custom server platforms — from early design engagement and NPI execution through volume production, supplier quality, and continuous improvement. We partner with ODM/JDM design and manufacturing partners across a global network to deliver hardware at scale with exceptional quality.

We are seeking a Cloud Hardware Development Engineer (Manufacturing) to drive manufacturing excellence across our server portfolio. Depending on the specific role, you will own NPI execution, manufacturing process quality, test and diagnostic development, automation strategy, DFx standards, or reliability engineering — ensuring our platforms launch on time, at quality, and at scale. You will work directly with hardware design teams, ODM/CM partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to close the loop between design intent and manufacturing execution.
What You Will Do
You will own manufacturing engineering for cloud storage server platforms deployed at global scale. Your work spans the full product lifecycle: engaging early with design teams on manufacturability, driving NPI builds through EVT/DVT/PVT at partner sites, building quality systems and test strategies that scale across a multi-ODM network, and continuously improving yield, throughput, and cost. When a new storage platform launches into production, the manufacturing readiness, quality gates, reliability, and process controls are yours. You treat manufacturing risk probabilistically — planning to distributions, not point estimates.
Why You Will Love It
The storage infrastructure you manufacture powers exabytes of customer data across AWS. You will see your process decisions, quality systems, and automation initiatives scale to millions of units across a global manufacturing network. The team is deeply technical, high-trust, and moves fast — you own your domain end to end, from early DFx engagement through production ramp and fleet operations.
 
The Ideal Candidate
You think across the full manufacturing stack — from PCBA assembly and SMT process control to system-level integration and rack deployment. You are as comfortable on an ODM production floor as you are analyzing yield data or reviewing a DFx scorecard. You drive quality through data and structured problem-solving, not assumption. You hold manufacturing partners to the same standard you hold yourself, and you communicate with clarity across engineering, operations, and leadership. You look for automation and ML-assisted approaches to solve complex issues.


Key job responsibilities
Process Quality & Supplier Management
• Lead and oversee quality control processes across Contract Manufacturers (CM), Original Design Manufacturers (ODM), and component vendors
• Own PFMEAs, Control Plans, and process flows from NPI startup through end of life
• Drive Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) for manufacturing blockers, yield detractors, and quality escapes
• Execute Test Rack Inspections and OK2Ship checklists; issue quality alerts, deviations, and ship-holds as required
• Conduct factory audits and supplier quality assessments across the ODM/vendor network
• Scale up manufacturing processes across a global network ensuring consistent quality and throughput targets
Manufacturing Test, Diagnostics & Debug
• Design, develop, and maintain manufacturing test software and diagnostic tools deployed at ODM/CM lines
• Debug complex system-level failures at the manufacturing line across compute, storage, networking, power, and thermal domains
• Perform root cause analysis correlating across firmware, kernel, driver, PCIe, signal integrity, and physical layers to isolate faults
• Build automation that reduces manual triage — enabling faster fault isolation and higher first-pass yield
• Develop and optimize system-level test flows (BFT, functional test, stress test, burn-in) for storage server platforms
• Analyze test data and yield trends to identify systemic issues; drive design and process improvements
 
Automation & Controls
• Own automation strategy, equipment selection, and ROI justification for manufacturing line automation
• Develop and implement manufacturing test fixtures at the server and rack level
• Define processes around assembly and test fixtures to ensure consistent, repeatable results
• Research and implement automation techniques to improve manufacturing efficiency and reduce human intervention
• Scale up tooling, fixturing, and process across the manufacturing network; standardize across multiple ODM sites
• Build, manage, and deploy CI/CD pipelines for rapid deployment of test code to manufacturing environments
DFx, Standards & Cross-Program Reuse
• Lead DFx reviews (DFM/DFA/DFT) leveraging mechanical CAD models, gerber files, and mock-up samples; drive design improvements in partnership with hardware engineering
• Develop and maintain DFx scorecards and NPI playbooks that capture cross-program learnings
• Define manufacturing engineering standards and design best practices adopted across teams and partner organizations
• Drive cross-vertical knowledge reuse — ensuring lessons from one program propagate to others
• Collaborate on manufacturing simulation, digital twin, and throughput modeling initiatives
• Own the interface between design intent and manufacturing execution for DFx requirements
Reliability & Failure Analysis
• Own cross-program reliability coverage, matrixed to verticals on demand
• Monitor fleet quality metrics post-launch: server-level annualized failure rates and component-level failure modes
• Correlate component-level failure data with manufacturing lot information to identify systemic issues
• Partner with test and fleet health teams to ensure manufacturing diagnostics align with production monitoring and field failure analysis
• Drive design or process changes for current and future platforms based on operational telemetry
• Perform risk assessment, mitigation, and change management throughout the product lifecycle


A day in the life
You start the day analyzing cross-program yield trends, identifying a common failure mode across two verticals that points to a shared component vendor issue. Mid-morning, you facilitate a DFx standards review — updating the NPI playbook with lessons from the latest program launch. In the afternoon, you run a throughput simulation for an upcoming automation investment, building the ROI case for leadership. You end the day reviewing reliability data with the fleet health team, feeding findings back into manufacturing process controls for the current and next-generation platforms. title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.

- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.

- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- High school or equivalent diploma

- Proficient in Microsoft Office

title: Senior AV Producer/Editor, MGM+ Creative Services
descriptionHtml:
MGM+ is looking for a talented Senior AV Producer/Editor to join our Creative Services team.

In this dual role, you will serve as a creative force in both editorial and production, owning AV projects from concept through final delivery on a global scale. Leading the creation of trailers, TV spots, sizzle reels, branded content, social-first video, and promotional assets, you will play a pivotal role in driving viewership and elevating the MGM+ brand. This position requires the ability to seamlessly shift between cutting compelling narratives in the edit bay and managing the logistical and creative demands of agency and internal production teams. You will collaborate closely with Creative Directors, Production Managers, Marketing and Social Leads, and external agency partners to bring bold creative visions to life and set the gold standard at MGM+. You will also have a lot of fun doing it.


Key job responsibilities
• Edit stylized and emotionally compelling videos, including music and sound design, for trailers, TV spots, sizzle reels, branded content, and social-first video assets that align with the MGM+ brand identity and campaign strategies to resonate across platforms.
• Manage all operational aspects of AV campaigns including production, timelines, asset development, delivery, and stakeholder approvals through internal workflows and external vendors.
• Perform and manage post-production finishing including color correction, audio mixing, graphics integration, and quality control to ensure all deliverables meet the highest technical and creative standards.
• Stay current with editing techniques and software, digital content trends, AI-assisted creative tools, and platform best practices to continuously raise the bar on creative output.
• Maintain and suggest process improvements for efficient post-production workflows, media organization, naming conventions, project archiving and other best practices within the team infrastructure and future development of AI initiatives.
• Anticipate and effectively mitigate production challenges across department communications.
• Collaborate with Creative Directors, Production Managers, Marketing leadership, Social, PR, and Network Operations.
• Make outrageously cool content.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Film & Television Production, Media Studies, Digital Arts or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 5+ years of experience editing trailers, TV spots, or promotional AV content at a network, streaming service, studio, or entertainment marketing agency.
• 3+ years of experience producing AV campaigns including creative feedback, timelines, schedules, finishing coordination and external relationships.
• Proven track record in premium television, streaming content and/or theatrical marketing.
• Mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro.
• Working knowledge in Adobe After Effects and DaVinci Resolve.
• Demonstrated understanding of the creative production process, post-production workflows, and production etiquette standards
• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional editorial craftsmanship, strong music and sound design sensibilities, and visual storytelling ability.
• Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines in a quick-moving environment.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present creative concepts to senior executives and external stakeholders.
• Genuine passion for the entertainment industry and creative content production.

• Experience with Digital Asset Management and workflow tools such as Iconik, Wiredrive, Frameio, Airtable, Microsoft Office

• Extensive network within the entertainment industry and agency landscape




A day in the life
Your day starts by rolling into the office on the creative high of yesterday’s FROM trailer release while also buzzing with the inspirational energy of the last night’s binge-worthy TV show. You jump into the edit bay and work through a handful of creative notes for a new music docu-series TV spot ahead of an afternoon marketing leadership review. Midday, you shift into producer mode and check in with the agency cutting the new MGM+ brand sizzle to coordinate logistics for finishing so that the delivery pipeline stays on track. After lunch you sit down with the Creative Director to review a critics spot for Robin Hood and work through an alternative structure together. Late afternoon you’re back in the edit bay, reviewing a batch of your social behind-the-scenes edits that the graphics team just polished up with animation to ensure every asset meets the gold standard that MGM+ audiences expect. As you head out you stop by the design team to trade thoughts with the Art Director about a new album release you both continue to obsess over. As a Senior Editor/Producer and creative collaborator, you’ve spent the day crafting fantastic content, managing complex workflows, and elevating the MGM+ brand.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) designs, delivers, and operates the global data-center fleet that powers every AWS service. Our servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling assets in more than 245 countries and territories. We tackle some of the world’s most complex supply-chain problems so our customers can innovate without limits.

You will partner with cross functional teams to deeply understand requirements for servers (power, materials, manufacturing capacity, etc.) and build forward looking plans on what we can deliver and when. Due to the quickly evolving nature of this business, requirements and designs change quickly and often involve long lead time inputs. You will partner with our tech teams to build systems that automate and optimize our planning strategies to enable scaling. Success requires exceptional judgment, a builder’s mindset, and the ability to influence at all levels—from front-line planners to VP- and SVP-level business owners.

Key job responsibilities
Own the global S&OP cycle – Drive an end-to-end, weekly/monthly/quarterly cadence that aligns AWS demand signals with supply, power, and capital plans.

Run executive planning forums – Frame one-way vs. two-way-door decisions, articulate trade-offs, and secure leadership alignment across AIS, EC2, S3, EBS, Finance, and Energy.
Architect planning systems – Guide software teams in automating demand-, supply-, and scenario-planning workflows (e.g., Connect, o9, Infor, Manhattan); own interim manual mechanisms until automation is in place.
Build decision frameworks – Develop constrained-planning models that surface risks and levers under power, permitting, or component shortages.
Measure what matters – Define KPIs and dashboards that quantify forecast accuracy, inventory turns, build-plan adherence, and capacity-delivery cycle time.
Champion continuous improvement – Sponsor digital-transformation sprints that simplify processes, eliminate waste, and raise planning maturity across AIS.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience leading and collaborating with a large cross-functional team

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in a technology field
- Experience in one or more of the following areas: data center or network capacity planning, data center or network infrastructure program/project management, or related technical fields
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

title: Embedded Software Engineer II, Ring, Ring Firmware
descriptionHtml:
Ring is growing in Poland and we are looking for experienced Embedded Software Engineers to join our team in Gdansk. You will work on firmware for IoT devices used by millions of customers worldwide, developing new features and shipping products from concept to production.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will own the design and implementation of firmware subsystems running on resource-constrained hardware. You will work across the full development cycle: architecture, implementation, code review, testing on real devices, and production release. Our team operates with high autonomy and a strong feedback culture.

The ideal candidate:

Has shipped embedded products to production and understands what it takes to go from prototype to millions of devices in the field.
Writes clean, maintainable C/C++ for constrained environments and cares deeply about code quality.
Communicates proactively, raises technical risks early, and drives solutions across teams.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as customer needs evolve.
Is curious about the full stack, from hardware registers to cloud connectivity, and enjoys learning new domains.

Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C++ for Ring devices.
Specify and implement functionality for embedded subsystems (connectivity, streaming, power management, sensors, or security).
Collaborate with hardware, QA, cloud, and app teams to deliver integrated product experiences.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and cross-team architecture decisions.
Debug complex issues across hardware and software boundaries using JTAG, UART, and protocol analyzers.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a code change from a colleague working on a new sensor driver. After your team standup, you spend focused time implementing a feature for an upcoming product launch, testing it on real hardware at your desk. In the afternoon, you dig into a tricky issue that only reproduces on one board variant, tracing it from application code down to a register misconfiguration. You push your fix, verify it on the device, and close the day knowing it will ship to customers in the next release.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer , Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. You will play a critical role in developing, optimizing, and maintaining the embedded systems that power our robots. This role involves working on real-time operating systems (RTOS), low-Level firmware, and communication protocols to enable precise motor control, sensor integration, and robust system performance.

Key job responsibilities
- You will develop and maintain firmware for robotic control platforms, ensuring reliability and performance.
- You will design, implement, and optimize software for real-time operating systems such as FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or Zephyr.

- You will design and implement communication protocols over CAN and RS485 for motor control, sensor data acquisition, and power management.

- You will analyze and optimize system performance, including timing, resource usage, and latency, and conduct testing using scripting languages like Python for automated testing and data analysis.

- You will work closely with hardware and robotics engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and power systems.

- You will troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues using debugging tools and techniques.

- You will create clear, concise documentation for firmware designs, APIs, and test procedures.

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, or systems engineering
- Experience in embedded development in C/C++, or experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems
- Proven experience with RTOS platforms such as FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or Zephyr including system performance characterization and design for realtime performance
- Extensive hands-on experience developing firmware for STM32 microcontrollers and familiarity with the ST Micro IDEs and toolchains

Preferred qualifications

- Familiarity with robotics frameworks and simulation tools such as ROS and Isaac Sim
- Familiarity with safety-critical systems and fail-safe mechanisms
- Experience with motor control
- Experience with sensor fusion algorithms

title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Data Center Engineering - Electrical Products and Services (DCE-EPS)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical infrastructure that powers one of the world's largest and most complex networks? Amazon is looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to take on a technical leadership role in the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of our data center infrastructure systems. In this role, you will tackle ambiguous, high-impact problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will serve as a key technical resource, guiding infrastructure strategy and influencing decisions that shape the long-term reliability and efficiency of our facilities. If you are a collaborative problem solver who thrives on simplifying complex systems and mentoring others, we want to hear from you.


Key job responsibilities
• Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
• Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
• Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well-thought-out products.
• Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
• Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
• Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
• Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
• Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
• Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
• Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
• Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
• Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
• Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
• Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing infrastructure designs for an upcoming global deployment, collaborating with partner teams to align on architectural decisions. Later, you could lead a project review where you assess proposed solutions for their long-term impact on systems and processes. In the afternoon, you may work through a complex power distribution or cooling challenge, diagnosing root causes and developing a path forward. Throughout, you will share your expertise with colleagues, helping to raise the technical bar across the team.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Experience developing solutions and executing plans on complex projects

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: Regional Environmental Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through scalable, sustainable, and technology-enabled solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Regional Environmental Manager, EAP leads a team of field environmental managers responsible for driving regulatory compliance across the sites in their region. This leader translates the organization's environmental compliance plans into regional execution, sets priorities for their team, and holds site and operations partners accountable to compliance milestones through regular program controllership mechanisms. They develop the people on their team, build bench strength through hiring and coaching, and embed environmental compliance into the day-to-day operating rhythm of the sites they support.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in environmental regulatory compliance combined with the people leadership capability to grow and direct a field team. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data and business intelligence to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their region.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage team priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-growth operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory problems in the field and building a strong environmental compliance team, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive environmental regulatory compliance across the sites in your region, aligning your team's priorities to the organization's compliance plans and the OP1, OP2, and quarterly planning cycles.
- Translate media-specific compliance programs and field execution frameworks into regional execution, adapting them to the sites and conditions you support.
- Manage your team's resource allocation and input to annual operating plans, balancing immediate compliance obligations against the work needed to build durable site capability.
- Operate program controllership mechanisms that drive speed, quality, and accountability across your team and site partners, surfacing and mitigating compliance risk early.
- Communicate compliance status, risks, and escalations clearly and concisely to senior leaders and partners across Operations, Legal, Finance, and Technology.
- Partner with Amazon Legal, state and local regulators, environmental consultants, and technology teams to resolve compliance barriers at the regional and site level and reduce manual effort in compliance execution.
- Track your region against KPI and compliance metric frameworks, using the data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and report milestone and regulatory posture across your sites.
- Lead the talent management lifecycle for your team, including hiring, onboarding, and structured development planning that builds depth and capability.
- Oversee work performed by third-party contractors, consultants, and inspection vendors in your region, holding them accountable to milestones and quality standards through structured audit and governance mechanisms.
- Exercise sound independent judgment in an ambiguous, high-stakes regulatory environment, choosing the right mechanisms and team priorities to deliver compliance outcomes.
- Embed environmental compliance into the day-to-day operating rhythm of the sites you support.
- Travel expected up to 25-50% of the time.

A day in the life
This role will be based in the United States and will report to the Business Environmental Leader. Travel to Amazon sites within the region is expected up to 50% of the time and 5 days/week in office. The REM will partner with the operations leadership teams to execute company environmental procedures and ensure compliance with all applicable specific Federal, State and Local regulations. The REM will deliver a strategy for execution, supported by the EAP leadership team.

About the team
The Environmental Assurance and Protection team protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

- 5+ years of conducting workplace risk investigations experience
- Experience building and managing a high-performing team of direct reports
- Experience collecting, analyzing, and utilizing data to drive process and system improvements

- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws

title: Sr. Manager, Post-Silicon Eng, AWS Hardware Engineering Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services designs and builds the servers and custom silicon that power the world's largest cloud. The Core Hardware team owns the cross-cutting engineering capabilities that every server product depends on: power delivery, PCIe connectivity, signal integrity, CPU and memory quality, board design, thermal and mechanical systems, and the test and quality infrastructure that validates and sustains all of it.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead engineering teams within Core Hardware. This is a manager-of-managers role. Your organization owns PCIe validation and signal integrity, CPU and memory quality engineering, server performance, and test automation infrastructure. These teams are responsible not only for validating that every server platform meets the highest bar for silicon quality, interconnect reliability, and system performance before production, but also for owning the ongoing quality and operational health of those subsystems once they are deployed in the fleet.

This is a technical leadership role with real depth and end-to-end ownership. Your teams operate at the intersection silicon, servers and the fleet, and that boundary does not disappear at production release. They validate PCIe connectivity at the physical and protocol layer, find and resolve bugs in shipped silicon, characterize server performance at scale, build the automation infrastructure that makes all of this repeatable, and then own the outcomes when those platforms are running in production. When a fleet-wide issue surfaces that traces back to silicon, interconnect, or memory behavior, your organization owns the response: root cause, corrective action, and the systemic fix that prevents recurrence. The right leader for this role brings deep fluency in post-silicon validation and uses that fluency to drive outcomes across the full lifecycle, from first silicon through fleet operations.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end technical output and operational health of engineering teams spanning PCIe validation and signal integrity, CPU and memory engineering, server performance, and test automation, from silicon bring-up through fleet deployment and ongoing operations.
• Lead first-line managers and set the technical direction for validation methodology and fleet engineering, ensuring that validation plans, coverage models, debug workflows, and production monitoring strategies reflect the complexity of Amazon's custom server platforms and silicon.
• Build the processes and tooling that connect what your teams learn in validation to how they operate in the fleet, closing the loop between pre-production findings and production outcomes.
• Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for issues that surface at any point in the lifecycle, whether during bring-up, qualification, or in the production fleet. When a fleet-wide issue traces back to silicon, interconnect, or memory behavior, your organization owns the technical response end-to-end: diagnosis, root cause, fix, and the systemic improvement that prevents recurrence.
• Partner with silicon suppliers, firmware, and hardware design teams to drive cross-functional resolution of platform-level issues that span silicon, firmware, board, and operational boundaries.
• Represent your organization's technical findings, fleet health posture, and risk assessments to senior leadership with the depth and clarity expected at the director level and above, translating complex silicon and platform data into actionable decisions for product teams, fleet operations, and architecture teams.
• Build and develop a team of managers engineers who think beyond validation and own outcomes in the fleet, developing the institutional knowledge and end-to-end mindset that Amazon's ownership model demands.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- 10+ years of experience in post-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, platform validation, or fleet engineering for server-class hardware.
- 5+ years of engineering management experience with direct people management responsibility.
- 2+ years of experience managing managers, not just individual contributors.
- Direct technical experience with server-class processor debug and validation, including CPU, memory, and high-speed interconnect subsystems such as PCIe, spanning both pre-production validation and production fleet operations.
- Experience owning engineering outcomes across the full product lifecycle, from silicon bring-up through production deployment and ongoing fleet operations, not limited to a hand-off at production release.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with PCIe physical layer signal integrity, including SerDes characterization, compliance testing, and link training debug in both lab and fleet environments.
- Experience with firmware and software validation in a post-silicon environment, including driver-level and protocol-level test development that carries forward into production monitoring and regression.
- Experience building or leading teams that develop test automation infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling used across both validation and fleet-facing engineering workflows.
- Experience with server performance characterization, including memory bandwidth, latency, and CPU microarchitecture-level performance analysis, with the ability to translate findings into fleet-level operational decisions.
- Experience driving root-cause analysis and corrective action for hardware issues discovered in production fleets at scale, including coordination with silicon vendors, firmware teams, and fleet operations.
- Experience hiring and scaling engineering teams, particularly in competitive talent markets or during site buildouts.
- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

title: Infrastructure Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Infrastructure Reliability Engineer you will be proactively driving the reliability risk identification, assessment and mitigation for datacenter infrastructure equipment (Example: PDC and Rack Whips, MC Cables, Busduct, LV SWGR, Breakers, UPS, Power Distribution Cabinets). You will also be responsible for root cause analysis of critical equipment failures, testing and drive the continuous improvements to improve datacenter availability for AWS customers. You will work closely with both internal and outside partners including suppliers to drive key aspects of product specification, risk identification plan, qualification testing and execution. You must be ownership minded, independent, action and results oriented to succeed in an open collaborative environment.

The candidate should have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based approach to develop and implement both analytical and empirical approaches for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during product design, manufacture as well as deployment stages. The individual should be able to drive AWS application-specific requirements in carrying out both lifecycle environmental and operational stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical, chemical and mechanical stresses so to identify overstress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. Candidate should be capable of evaluating not only product design quality/reliability risks, but also have the skills and experiences in assessing electronics manufacture process related quality/reliability issues. Knowledge of statistical techniques and models is required to analyze test as well as field data.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification and the associated vendor selection and qualification requirements. The candidate will be expected to use knowledge of process capability for electronic component production as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical to quality and reliability metrics.

At the system level, the individual will develop datacenter system level reliability model and related reliability quantification and risk analysis for datacenter configuration optimization. The candidate will be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and data analytics.

During sustaining stage, candidate will be responsible for monitoring product performance in the field and will be responsible to drive root cause analysis of any critical failures and the associated corrective and preventive actions. The individual should also be able to drive effective vendor auditing and quarterly review process to drive the continuous improvements of datacenter availability.

The successful candidate should be considered as an expert in the reliability engineering field and have a proven track record of success in not only product reliability leadership, as well as business negotiations and program management. Strong skill-set in problem analysis and solving as well as communication and vendor management are necessary. Candidates should also be able to travel within US and internationally.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location. You will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with speed in which we can make items appear on their doorsteps. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to innovate for the last mile customer experience. Come build the future with us!

Key job responsibilities
- Support, mentor, and motivate your team
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Create and implement productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Ops Integration, Loss Prevention and Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, as well as continuously climb and descend stairs
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments, and grocery locations include refrigerated environments)
- Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
