title: AIT Auditor II, Audits & Insights Team, Audit and Insights
descriptionHtml:
Amazon provides individuals or enterprises the opportunity to sell their goods on the Amazon platform. Over 2 million sellers in 14 countries (and growing) list their products for sale on Amazon and thereby contribute to the success of Amazon. Amazon is growing worldwide and Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. These Sellers offer hundreds of millions of unique items, providing a broad and diverse inventory of products from Books, Electronics, Apparel, Consumables and beyond.

Our team, through a partnership with core business teams, contribute to key goals that help improve Seller/Buyer experience on Amazon. This team is made up of people like you. People who are: a) Entrepreneurial – we build solutions for Buyers and Sellers, regardless of size, b) Innovative – our problem space evolves every day due to scale, new categories, and new geographies. There is no playbook, so innovation and creativity are a must, c) Passionate – Everyone’s an owner at Amazon, and our team is no exception. We are passionate about our customers, both Sellers, and Buyers.


Key job responsibilities
Establish SOPs, process controls, recommend revisions and ensure alignment with business goals
· Build and scale system-level solutions that have metric impact; drive adoption of solutions across teams
· Perform data analysis on trends observed and recommend solutions to the product and BD teams
· Collaborate with partner teams and stakeholders across the globe to deliver on key business goals and objectives by driving consensus and building trust
· Perform high level failure (error) investigations which may be either operational or business specific in nature
· Establishes key reporting/MIS for functional area & write strong, well-structured and detail oriented reports in a clear, concise and audience-specific format
· Drives continuous improvement and contribute to COE (Correction of Error) process by documenting any issues/RCAs/action planning in functional area and own specific action or change
· Demonstrates the ability to dive deep into a problem, performs ‘root cause analysis,’ and identifies constraints to recommend a solution
· Interacts with multiple stakeholders to communicate on gaps identified/metrics information and project reviews

Basic qualifications

- Minimum 1 year of experience displaying high ownership, ability to dive deep and deliver results through projects, contributions to program level goals etc.
- Minimum 1 year of experience managing a team directly or indirectly (coaching underperformance, mentorship, training new hires etc.)
- Experience leading initiatives and/or managing operational metrics at program or org level
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Experience managing multiple stakeholders and collaborating with partner teams (Ops, product, policy etc.)
- Knowledge of Quality auditing methodology and tools
- Proficiency in Excel (Pivots, VLOOKUP etc.)
- Excellent analytical thinking, problem solving skills and proven ability of managing multiple competing priorities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in seller facing risk functions (SEPO, SPR etc.).
- Experience managing multiple programs and driving high level process improvement initiatives
- Knowledge of Lean principles or DMAIC methodology will be an added advantage

The ideal Program Manager will be detail-oriented, organized, and able to juggle multiple priorities effectively. S/he should be proficient in using project management tools and be ready to learn and adapt to new methodologies and technologies in the world of geospatial data.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Own the Program, define and achieve KPIs; Drive performance improvement initiatives.
- Develop and monitor program metrics to identify potential issues in last mile deliveries.
- Identify patterns of defects that will help us build initiatives to reduce defects at scale.
- Ability to pull data and perform deep-dives and root-cause analysis as needed.
- Lead initiatives to identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to reduce defects and improve the delivery experience for Amazon customers.
- Very good communication, both verbal and written to regularly provide business updates during weekly/monthly/quarterly reviews.
- Communicate with stakeholders to share regular updates, resolve blockers and deliver programs/initiatives on time.
- Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed and ensuring service requirements are met.
- Must be able to systematically escalate problems to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.

About the team
The Last Mile Analytics & Quality (LMAQ) team is part of the Last Mile Tech team and works on improving Geospatial data, Route Quality, and support the driver lifecycle programs. We run programs to identify and reduce defects through manual audits, and leverage data and anecdotes to identify opportunities and closely collaborate with Tech, Science and Product teams to improve our products at scale.

- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with SQL
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

title: Security Engineer, Field Innovation, Security Search and Observability (SSO)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Security Search and Observability organization. Our team builds and operates the detection, correlation, and vulnerability-management capabilities behind multiple security services such as AWS Security Hub, AWS CloudTrail, AWS GuardDuty, as well as our newest AI-powered offering, AWS Continuum, which manages the full lifecycle of code vulnerabilities at machine speed. If you have deep information-security expertise and enjoy working at the intersection of hands-on detection engineering and direct customer and partner engagement, this is an exciting opportunity to shape how enterprises secure their cloud and AI workloads.

This is a dual-facing role. As a field-facing security engineer for Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJ), you will work directly with customers to implement the latest features of our newest security services: leading threat-modelling sessions, performing vulnerability assessments with security agents, and guiding remediation - then channel what you learn back into the product. As a partner-facing security engineer, you will work with leading third-party security providers to identify their highest-signal findings and turn them into correlated, customer-visible detections that raise the security value of our services. Across both, you will design and implement detection content, reduce false positives at scale, and expand coverage across cloud resources, runtime, and AI/ML workloads.

The AWS Security Services team builds technologies that help customers strengthen their security posture and better meet their security requirements in the AWS Cloud. We build massively scalable, globally distributed systems that power the next generation of security services.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the field-facing security engineer for APJ, running early-access and gated previews: including our newest AI-powered vulnerability management capabilities with customers, leading threat modelling, vulnerability assessment using security agents, and remediation guidance
- Partner with leading third-party security providers to identify high-signal findings and turn them into correlated, high-fidelity detections that increase the security value of AWS security services
- Work backwards from customers to shape detection coverage and influence service roadmaps, feeding field and partner insights back to science and engineering teams
- Stay up to date with the ever-changing cloud security and threat landscape, including emerging threats targeting agentic AI and ML applications
- Drive detection engineering best practices, including threat modelling, security-value evaluation, false-positive reduction, and coverage measurement
- Collaborate across science, engineering, partner, and field teams, operating with flexible working hours to support global customers and distributed stakeholders

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C++ or similar object oriented language experience
- 2+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non-internship) experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non-internship) experience
- Knowledge of industry-based security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of command line tools to troubleshoot protocols, analyze log outputs, or automate basic tasks
- Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP(S), DNS, and TCP/IP
- Experience with AWS products and services
- Experience in scripting, programming, or security code reviewing in a common language, such as Python, Java, or C++
- Experience performing security activities across one or more phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), such as security design review, threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing

title: Regulated Waste Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
Shift Code/Description: AAAA
Department: Safety

Our Operations team is looking for Regulated Waste Coordinator with a strong record of achieving results to join the expanding team supporting operations leaders and associates in delivering strong operations results within our fulfillment centers. Regulated Waste Coordinators will also be responsible for communicating instructions to other associates, motivating them, and keeping their work areas safe.

Since opening our virtual doors in 1995, Amazon has been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further. Our entire business works hard to delight our customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, fluid and intentional. Our teams band together, roll up their sleeves, and aren’t content with just standing still. We’re aiming to become the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Things to know about working in Operations:
- We’re committed to providing a safe work environment. This means you wear a reflective vest, stretch and recognize others for working safely.
- We have a relaxed, casual dress code (as long as your attire meets our safety requirements).
- We work to regulate our sites as much as possible, but even with climate controls the noise and temperature levels can vary day to day. Hearing protection is available.
- You may be asked to work on a secure mezzanine at a height of up to 40 feet, or on powered equipment (forklift, cherry picker, etc.)
- You may be asked to lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours, and push, pull, squat, bend and reach with or without reasonable accommodation.

For this role, you will need to be:
- At least 18 years old, and authorized to work in the United States
- Able to work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Able to lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach

Benefits include health care (medical, dental, vision) coverage starting on day 1 as well as 401(k) with company match, holiday/overtime pay and employee discount. Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

Key job responsibilities
- Function as the lead for the Waste Program within the site where product and hazardous waste sent for resale, donation, or disposal are properly managed in a manner compliant with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
- Provide technical support and tactical execution of the Regulated Waste Procedure, and works in partnership with both Operations and the EHS Teams to maintain compliance while providing oversight over the waste process.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

Preferred qualifications

- Has a Certificate in Waste Management and/or equivalent experience or regulatory training, such as the completion of a Career Choice Waste Coordinator program or Environmental Mentorship Program

title: 物流設備メンテナンスサポート
descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は、神奈川県にある小田原FC（フルフィルメントセンター）になります。

Amazonの入荷・出荷のプロセスを行うFCには、世界最先端の自動化物流設備が導入されています。コンベア、ロボット、自動仕分けシステムなど、最新テクノロジーを活用し、商品の入出荷を効率的に行っています。このような先進的な環境で、次世代の物流技術に携わることができます。
　
RME（Reliability and Maintenance Engineering）部門は、日々物流設備の保全と保守、改善を行い、お客様に満足いただけるように努めております。今回、RME部門が募集する職種はFCに設置されている入出荷オペレーションに関わる設備・装置を安全に取り扱い、安定稼働のための物流設備の軽微なエラー対応、および保全作業や設備の安全性や生産性を向上させるための改善を担当いただく「物流設備メンテナンスサポート」というポジションになります。
　
本ポジションは保全業務が未経験の方からのご応募を歓迎しており、主体的に学ぶ姿勢を持ち、保全エンジニアとしてのキャリアに強い意欲のある方を求めております。入社後は体系的な教育プログラムと、経験豊富な先輩社員によるサポートにより、実践的な実務経験と専門技術を身に付けていくことができます。
　
RMEにて技術力と現場感を身に着けることで将来的なキャリア選択肢は大きく広がります。RME内にてマネージャーや技術スペシャリストとして活躍することはもちろん、社内公募制度を利用して他エンジニアリングチーム（設備導入、設計、開発など）へ異動し活躍の幅を広げることも可能です。
　
【More Information】
■メンテナンス部門について
　・メンテナンスエンジニア特設サイト
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員T.S.さん
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員E.M.さん

　・フルフィルメントセンター (FC)

Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp
オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
下記業務をチームで対応いただきます。
■60%：日常点検・異常対応…稼働監視/巡回による設備点検/異常対応、故障復旧/オーバーホール、部品修繕
■20%：メンテナンス業務…予防保全/定期保全/状態保全/事後保全
■10%：安全対策…設備・作業環境の安全対策/5S活動
■5%：技術研修…機械、電気、制御（PLC）に関わる技術トレーニングを受講
■5%：その他…メンテナンス計画/デザインレビュー
　
【取り扱う設備の一例（FCによって異なる）】

■荷合わせシステム（同じお客様が注文された商品を一つにまとめる設備）

A day in the life
【教育・研修】
・入社後は、体系化された教育プログラムに沿って、安全ルール、保全作業、専門的な技術習得を進めていただきます。集合研修も用意しており、少数のグループで座学だけでなく実務研修を行っていただきます。同時に所属拠点ではOJTを通してより実践的な業務スキルを習得いただきます。充実した技術研修プログラムとマンツーマンのサポート体制により、未経験の方でも着実にスキルアップできる環境を整えていますので、不明点の確認や相談がしやすい環境となります。

シフトパターンは希望を考慮の上、決定させていただきますが、将来的なシフト勤務形態の変更の可能性もございます。

退勤時間には次の班が出勤し引継ぎを行う為、残業時間が少なく、急な呼び出しも発生しません。
公共交通機関が運行しない時間帯でも交代勤務に出社できるようお願いいたします。
（自家用車・自転車は可（入社前に要申請・許可制）、バイク・タクシーは不可）

Basic qualifications

- 工具（ハンドツール、ドリルなど）の使用、測定機器（ノギス、マルチメーター、クランプメーター等）の使用、電気関連の作業、製造業での実務のいずれかのご経験のある方

- 探究心と向上心：いままで経験がない業務においても新しい知識を学ぶことに意欲的で、何事にも前向きに取組むことができる。

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we believe that every day is still Day One. We are striving to be Earth's Best Employer and to get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon’s MyHR Live Support team is seeking customer-focused professionals who thrive in a dynamic contact center environment.
Do you excel at real-time communication, problem-solving, and delivering exceptional customer service? The MyHR Live Support Team operates a state-of-the-art contact center, caring for 1.5 million Amazonians worldwide by assisting them with their HR needs. Our organization delivers best-in-class HR support to Amazon employees, applicants, and candidates globally. We specialize in topics related to time-off, employee relocations, offboarding processes, employment verification, benefits, bereavement support, and comprehensive pay and compensation services.
As an HR Contact Center Professional, you will be at the forefront of our customer service operations, primarily handling live phone calls and/or chats. You are someone who is skilled at building positive relationships with employees through empathetic and effective communication. You are approachable and able to handle sensitive situations with tact and diplomacy in real-time. You pride yourself on maintaining high ethical standards and confidentiality when dealing with sensitive employee information, conflicts of interest, and compliance issues.
You thrive in a fast-paced contact center environment, using your critical thinking and fact-finding skills to resolve issues efficiently. You excel at managing multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction. You are adaptable and open to change, quickly adjusting to new policies, technologies, and industry trends.
Amazon’s MyHR Live Support team is comprised of HR Contact Center Professionals supporting Amazon employees globally within multiple languages, with services 24 hours a day, 7 days a week in some countries. As a MyHR Live Support Advisor, your primary responsibilities will be:
• Handle a high volume of live contacts, primarily through phone calls and potentially chats, taking ownership in ensuring each interaction is resolved with a high degree of problem-solving and customer obsession.
• Resolve inquiries holistically by referring to available documentation such as frequently asked questions, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures – escalate when these cannot be resolved.
• Build customer trust through empathetic, personalized conversations by assessing and adjusting resolution plans to each employee's changing needs during live interactions.
• Respond promptly to employees' urgent issues, ensuring the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
• Use high judgment, critical thinking, and rationale to balance process adherence with employees' needs, analyzing and deciding on resolutions for their requests in real-time.
• Consistently consult and collaborate with partner teams on process changes to resolve cross-functional issues and improve policies.
• Maintain high performance metrics in areas such as contact handling time, first-contact resolution, and customer satisfaction scores.
• Adhere to set schedules, including timed breaks and lunches, to ensure consistent coverage and support for our 24/7 contact center operations.
• Demonstrate flexibility in working various shifts, including evenings, weekends, and overnight shifts, to support our global workforce across different time zones.
This role requires excellent multitasking abilities, strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced contact center environment. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service through live interactions and are ready to make a difference in people's lives, we want to hear from you!

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, InfoPath, SharePoint, etc.
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- 1+ years of customer service, or 1+ years of contact center experience

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of human resources experience, or Bachelor's degree
- 1+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Do you aim to have a dynamic impact on the world? Are you up for creating solutions and solving tomorrow’s problems today? Then we have the opportunity for you! We are looking to hire an ICQA Area Manager to be part of our fulfillment center Inventory Control and Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. Our fulfillment centers (FC) sit at the heart of Amazon’s rapidly growing operations network: they are where we manage our fast-moving inventory. In each fulfillment center, our teams stow deliveries, pick products, package them up and ship them out; each of these groups have played their part in taking us where we are today. These fulfillment centers are fast-paced and high reward environments, where adherence to policies and procedures is key. title: Frontend Engineer, AI Business Automation, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies, TV shows, and live sports, offering a vast library of content to a global audience. We are constantly innovating to enhance the customer experience, from how content is discovered and consumed to how we produce and deliver it at scale. Our mission is to be the premier entertainment destination, and we achieve this through a relentless focus on the customer, a passion for storytelling, and a commitment to technical excellence.

We are forming a new organization within Prime Video to redefine our operational landscape through the power of artificial intelligence. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will play a key role in building the next generation of business automation. You will collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and scientists to design, develop, and deploy the agentic AI solutions that will power this transformation. This is an opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a new initiative, work with complex distributed systems, and see your contributions directly improve how Prime Video operates for our customers worldwide.

For this team we are hiring, we are building an AI-powered creative production platform for one of the world's largest entertainment studios — a browser-based tool where creative professionals compose marketing key art using 50+ layers, AI-generated characters, dynamic lighting, and real-time image manipulation. The product is a professional-grade, canvas-based creative editor — closer to Photoshop or Figma in complexity than a web application with forms and tables.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and build a high-performance, browser-based creative editor with multi-layer canvas compositing, real-time image manipulation, and GPU-accelerated rendering for professional-grade creative workflows.
- Architect and optimize rendering pipelines for complex layer stacks, handling high-resolution assets, blend modes, masking, and non-destructive editing with fluid performance.
- Integrate AI/ML model outputs into interactive UI workflows, enabling users to generate, edit, and compose visual content through intuitive creative controls.
- Implement production file export capabilities (including PSD with preserved layer structure) and asset management features that serve downstream creative teams.
- Collaborate with backend engineers, applied scientists, and product managers to deliver on our product roadmap and solve customer problems across the full creative production pipeline.
- Own performance, reliability, and quality of the frontend platform — profiling, measuring, and optimizing to ensure the application feels responsive under demanding workloads.
- Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, and architectural decisions that will define the platform's technical foundation.

This role offers a unique opportunity to build professional creative tooling powered by AI — the kind of software where rendering performance, pixel-level precision, and deep browser expertise matter as much as product intuition. If you're passionate about building visually intensive, high-performance applications that push the boundaries of what's possible in the browser, we want to hear from you.


About the team
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

- Experience using JavaScript frameworks such as angular and react

title: Software Development Manager, Project Dawn
descriptionHtml:
As an SDM in the OAS Offers Tech org, you will own the engineering infrastructure that determines the breadth of off-Amazon merchant selection available to Amazon customers — spanning web-scale data ingestion, structured extraction, and catalog contribution.
This role sits at a genuinely hard frontier: applying large language models and hybrid extraction strategies to the inconsistent structure of millions of e-commerce websites, while maintaining the reliability and throughput requirements of a production catalog system. The right extraction approach varies by merchant, by platform, and by the maturity of the science models your team hosts and serves — and navigating those tradeoffs in real time, at scale, is one side of the challenge. The other is guiding the team through the internal complexity of Amazon's catalog — the data contracts, ingestion standards, quality thresholds, and partner system requirements that govern whether extracted merchant data successfully becomes discoverable, purchasable selection for customers. This role sits at the boundary between web-scale extraction and Amazon's catalog infrastructure, and engineering judgment on both sides is required.
You will collaborate with Science and Product partners in the Selection & Coverage pod, own the infrastructure that hosts and deploys extraction models in production, and be the engineering owner of OAS's selection coverage strategy.

* Lead, hire, and develop a team of software development engineers across multiple workstreams, maintaining a high engineering bar and a culture of ownership

* Set and own the engineering delivery roadmap against committed KPI ramp targets; identify risks early and provide clear path-to-green or escalation when milestones are at risk

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Controls team
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for! The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Key job responsibilities
· Primarily work in and support multiple Data Centers by Deploying, Servicing, and Upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
· Mentor and train Facilities team members on operation and control of the BMS and EPMS systems.
· Audit, maintain, and manage computer enterprise asset management systems for BMS and EPMS installations
· Manage small to medium size projects and programs.
· Perform point to point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
· Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with the BMS and EPMS in data centers.
· Perform provisioning process for servers, controllers, industrial PCs and network configurations and communication testing between third party devices and controllers or servers.
· Installation, replacement, configuration, and calibration of sensors.
· Able to read and understand Electrical schematics, control panel drawings. Basic understanding of close loop controls, field sensors scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
· Supervise low voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
· Commissioning and systems level testing support.
· Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
· Follow change management process to generate work requests and method of procedures.
· Participate in Factory witnessed tests at vendors or in panel builders facility.
· Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.
· Recommend design improvements based on consultation with users and system operation.
· Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
· Ensure all personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
· Work on-call and a rotating schedule when required and respond to after-hours emergencies.
· Perform service activities such as monitoring/reviewing ticketing systems, performing root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
· Actively manage service agreements to include vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.
Physical Requirements:
· Walk job-sites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch
or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

A day in the life
A typical day is attending morning construction/commissioning meetings, assessing and prioritization of project tasks and service tickets for the given day. Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. Technician is responsible for logging their daily efforts in construction and service related AWS tools.
The mission of the Data Center Controls Engineering team is to manage the design, deployment, and service of a highly reliable electrical and mechanical control system for the life-cycle of an AWS data center.


About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 1+ year of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 3+ years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- 1+ year of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experiencing using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).

Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you'll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. That focus on customers is why we are one of the world's most trusted brands and nowhere is that trust more on the line than in security. It is a role with real ownership from day one: every improvement we ship earns and protects the trust customers place in Amazon. And we do it like a startup: an owner's mentality in everyone, and real investment in turning new engineers into strong builders. We move fast, we ship fast, and we learn from everything we put in front of customers. Your work here is visible, it matters, and you will see its impact from day one.

Key job responsibilities
ASCOT Engineering is the engineering arm of the AWS Security Customer Outcomes Team (ASCOT), building the products, services, and automations that protect AWS customers across the supply chain. We are security builders, not security checkers, an engineering-first organization that designs and ships tooling at AWS scale to automate security outcomes across incident response, security escalation, and customer enablement. Our work spans AI-powered security automation, supply chain security, and secure delivery platforms, with a growing focus on securing AI and agentic workloads. You will build alongside a tight, high-ownership team that ships fast, operates what it builds, and collaborates closely partner teams across AWS Security.
Design, build, and own highly available, scalable, and secure distributed systems on AWS, driving architectural decisions and owning the full lifecycle from design through production deployment.

You might start the morning building an automation that accelerates incident response, spend the afternoon shipping a feature on a secure delivery platform, and close the day prototyping agentic security tooling with your team. title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics

title: Principal Delivery Consultant-Migrations, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in leading large-scale portfolio assessment and application disposition for enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS — assigning R-strategies (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retire, Retain, Relocate) and designing wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on migration best practices, risk mitigation, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end migration assessment process, ensuring adherence to AWS well-architected principles, optimizing wave sequencing, and managing risks throughout the programme lifecycle.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
2. Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
3. Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
4. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
5. Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

About the team
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

The position may require up to 50% travel to customer sites.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 10+ years of cloud architecture, solution implementation or consulting experience, with a focus on large-scale cloud migration and modernization programmes
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math, Engineering or a related field
- Experience leading the delivery of large-scale, mission-critical enterprise IT and migration programmes, including data centre exits, in a customer-facing role
- Experience as the technical lead of large-scale migrations: defining the migration strategy and target architecture, choosing the right approach for each workload (re-host, re-platform, re-architect, etc.), and translating these technical choices into business outcomes for executive audiences
- Experience using AI-powered and agentic migration and modernization tools (e.g., AWS Transform, ModelizeIT, Kiro or equivalent) to speed up discovery, assessment, code transformation and migration execution at scale
- Hands-on experience with technology infrastructure: network, compute, storage and virtualization
- Experience with wave planning, including dependency grouping, capacity balancing and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints
- Experience leading large teams and matrix organizations, and driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders
- Experience with the software development life cycle (SDLC) and agile/iterative methods

Preferred qualifications

- Work experience in financial services (banking, capital markets, payments, insurance or other segments), including regulated workloads and compliance and security standards
- Deep knowledge of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC), including AWS migration services (e.g., AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), Database Migration Service (DMS), Migration Hub)
- AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional)
- Experience with at least two of these migration domains: VMware, SAP, Windows/SQL Server, Database (e.g., Oracle licensing, EC2 vs. RDS, PostgreSQL), Mainframe
- Experience with infrastructure as code, automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell)
- Experience with public, hybrid and multi-cloud platforms
- Comfortable dealing with ambiguity in complex, multi-vendor environments with incomplete documentation and conflicting data sources, while prioritising needs and delivering measurable results
- Spanish language skills (written and spoken) are highly valued

title: Case Mgr, US-PR [S], US-PR [S]
descriptionHtml:
This is a contractual role.
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.
We are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best-in-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability & Leave Services Team.
The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.
This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.
Essential Responsibilities:
• Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
• Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
• Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
• Address and respond to sensitive situations
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
• Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
• Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
• Other duties as assigned

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 2+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree
- Experience with process improvement and stakeholder management
- Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
- Experience with six sigma methodologies
- Bachelor's degree in full-time industry or military work, or experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate

title: Duales Studium - Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest verstehen, wie Roboter, Sensoren und automatisierte Anlagen zusammenspielen?

Bei Amazon setzt du dein Wissen direkt in der Praxis ein. Du arbeitest an Anlagen, die Produkte durch eines der komplexesten Logistiknetzwerke der Welt bewegen. Vom ersten Tag an übernimmst du Verantwortung, arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und siehst den direkten Einfluss deiner Arbeit.

Als Teil von Amazon eröffnet sich dir ein Universum an Möglichkeiten: Zugang zu modernster Technik, vielfältige Karrierewege und ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen zählen und du früh gefördert und gefordert wirst.

Während des dualen Studiums besuchst du die Hochschule, um einen Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) mit Vertiefung Automatisierungstechnik zu erwerben. In einem Trainingszentrum erhältst du eine praktische Grundausbildung, und bei Amazon wendest du dein Wissen direkt an, an der Seite von erfahrenen Automation Engineers, die dich fördern und fordern.

Dabei entwickelst du Kenntnisse in Elektronik und Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Programmierung sowie Automatisierungs- und Steuerungstechnik. Gleichzeitig tauchst du in Zukunftsthemen wie Robotik, Smart Systems und IoT ein.

Beginn: 01.08.2027
Standort: Witten
Hochschule: HS Düsseldorf
Ausbildungszentrum: Siemens AG Düsseldorf

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
• Hardware Engineering und Konfiguration von Anlagen
• Inbetriebnahme komplexer Infrastruktursysteme
• Arbeit mit Automatisierungssystemen und Prozessvisualisierungen
• Intelligente Fabrikautomation mit Cloud-Konnektivität
• IoT-Anwendungen in der Gebäude- und Anlagentechnik
• Installation elektrischer Einrichtungen
• Prüfung von elektrischen, pneumatischen und hydraulischen Steuerungen
• Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und technischen Teams an realen Projekten

A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du an der Hochschule sowie in einem Trainingszentrum, während du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon an deinem Standort erwirbst.

Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers eine Störung an einer Förder- oder Sortieranlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. An einem anderen Tag konfigurierst du eine Steuerung und nimmst neue Technik in Betrieb. Und dann gibt es die Tage, an denen du an einem Projekt rund um Robotik, Sensorik oder IoT mitarbeitest.

Kein Tag ist wie der andere – mal stehst du an der Anlage, mal suchst du Fehler vor Ort, mal analysierst und optimierst du Systeme am Computer.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers zusammen, lernst von ihnen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Du probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Elektro-/ Automatisierungs-/ Steuerungstechnik oder verwandten Bereichen

Preferred qualifications

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität"
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Umgang mit MS-Office (insbesondere Kenntnisse in Excel, Word und PowerPoint)
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). Sollten die Bewerbungsunterlagen nicht vollständig sein, können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen! Bitte beachte, dass du im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses ein Videointerview über ein externes Tool durchführen musst. Mit der Übersendung Deines Lebenslaufs erklärst Du Dich mit der Speicherung Deiner Daten zum Zwecke der Feststellung der Eignung für dieses und zukünftige Stellenangebot/e in der weltweiten Amazon Konzernpersonaldatenbank, die derzeit in den USA geführt wird, einverstanden.

title: Líder de Operações (Cajamar), OB - Front Night
descriptionHtml:
Esta é uma posição de tempo integral, permanente, presencial baseada em GRU9- Cajamar, BR e não oferece benefícios de realocação. Os candidatos devem estar localizados e legalmente autorizados a trabalhar em Brazil para serem elegíveis para consideração.

A Amazon esta no Brasil desde 2012, estabelecendo parte de sua operação no centro de distribuição em Cajamar – SP, somos reconhecidos como uma empresa obcecada em trazer inovações para o cliente.

Estamos em busca de Líder de Operações.

Essa pessoa trabalhará presencialmente em Cajamar, em escalas 3X2 (trabalha três dias e folga dois), em turno das 18:00 - 05:00.

Quatro áreas principais de atuação: Segurança, Qualidade, Experiência do cliente e Produtividade.

Você e sua equipe são responsáveis ​​por garantir a saúde e qualidade do inventário para garantir que os produtos estejam disponíveis para clientes da Amazon.

Você é responsável em garantir que sua equipe esteja devidamente treinada e seguindo os padrões de qualidade Amazon.

Atividades:

-Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas e acompanhar as auditorias da área.
-Analisar indicadores e montar relatórios de qualidade, e realizar o planejamento das demandas do turno.
-Garantir produtividade, qualidade e segurança do time de expedição; Identificar e remover barreiras do processo, e escalar quando necessário, para atingir as métricas da área;

title: Senior Security Engineer, Special Projects
descriptionHtml:
Innovators wanted! Are you an entrepreneur? A builder? A dreamer? This role is part of an Amazon Special Projects team that takes the company’s Think Big leadership principle to the extreme. We focus on creating entirely new products and services with a goal of positively impacting the lives of our customers. No industries or subject areas are out of bounds. We launched products such as Comprehend Medical, Echo Frames and Amazon Explore. If you’re interested in innovating at scale to address big challenges in the world, this is the team for you.

As the Sr. Security Engineer, you will own the end-to-end threat model and translate it into concrete engineering deliverables: hardware attestation for compute nodes, encrypted workload delivery, result integrity verification, API authentication, and workload isolation guarantees. You will work across every component — reviewing the runtime's sandbox model, the scheduler's trust assumptions, the API surface, and the network layer's encryption — to ensure the system is secure by design.

Key job responsibilities
- Author the threat model for the platform architecture, identifying attack surfaces across compute nodes, network transit, and the control plane.
- Design and implement the attestation flow that verifies node integrity before workloads are dispatched, leveraging TPM/TEE where available and defining fallback assurance levels.
- Specify and validate encrypted workload delivery, ensuring model weights and inference inputs/outputs are protected at rest and in transit.
- Build result integrity verification mechanisms, conduct security reviews, lead penetration test preparation, and author compliance documentation.

About the team
Amazon Special Projects is building distributed infrastructure that operates across compute environments Amazon does not fully control. That sentence alone should tell you why this role matters. You will design the trust model that makes this architecture viable: ensuring that workloads are protected, results are verifiable, and the platform meets a bar that earns the confidence of internal and external customers. Security is not a layer we bolt on — it is a constraint that shapes every design decision from day one.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of at least two of the following programming languages: Scala, Java, Python, C/C++, or Go
- Experience (non-internship) in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools
- Experience (non-internship) in industry-based security vulnerabilities identification, attack patterns, and remediation techniques
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience with threat modeling and penetration testing, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience in Linux and Networking protocols
- Deep expertise in hardware attestation (TPM, TEE, secure enclaves) and cryptographic protocols
- 7+ years of experience in security engineering, with at least 3 years focused on systems or infrastructure security
- Strong understanding of zero-trust architectures and their practical implementation
- Experience with secure API design, authentication, and authorization frameworks

Preferred qualifications

- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
- Knowledge of cloud computing services and deployment architecture
- Experience performing technical audits/assessments in direct support of a major compliance effort (e.g., ISO, NIST, SOX, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR and other regulatory/industry certifications)
- Experience securing edge or distributed platforms where hardware is not under direct organizational control
- Background in secure enclave programming (Intel SGX, ARM TrustZone, or AWS Nitro Enclaves)
- Familiarity with ML model protection, including model watermarking or obfuscation techniques
- Published research or patents in applied cryptography, remote attestation, or secure computation

The AWS Infrastructure Capacity Planning Team is searching for a passionate and talented Regional Capacity Planner to drive capacity planning across multiple AWS regions, resulting in a single plan of record for each region. title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Network Firewall, NAT Gateway
descriptionHtml:
AWS Network Firewall, NAT gateway, Network Load Balancer (NLB), and Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) sit in the data path for a large share of AWS customer traffic. Customers rely on them to secure, translate, and distribute traffic at global scale. We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager (Sr. TPM) who can break down complex, ambiguous problems and has a strong drive to deliver.

In this role, you'll own programs across a portfolio of network services where availability, security, and performance are essential. You'll set a high bar for operational and engineering excellence. You'll be a hands-on, pragmatic problem solver who can weigh trade-offs between competing priorities. You'll do well in a fast-moving environment with complex cross-team dependencies, where ambiguity is normal and creative solutions are expected.

Key job responsibilities
As the Sr. TPM for Network Firewall, NAT gateway, and Load Balancers, you'll work with engineering, product management, security, and senior leadership to raise the bar on how these services are built, launched, and operated. You will:

* Lead end-to-end technical programs across the portfolio, including feature launches, infrastructure and fleet improvements, and multi-team initiatives that span several services.
* Drive security and compliance programs, working with internal security and audit teams to find gaps, set priorities for fixes, and track them to completion.
* Align engineering teams on how to architect, plan, and implement improvements and new programs, especially where work cuts across service boundaries.
* Translate business strategy into technical requirements, with clear milestones, owners, and timelines, using both technical and business judgment.
* Raise the operational bar by driving availability, resilience, and operational-readiness programs, and by turning lessons from operational events into lasting mechanisms.
* Partner across functions with Product Management, UX, engineering, security, and leadership to give customers a secure, reliable, high-performance networking experience.
* Think big and look around corners by leading long-range planning and making sure the organization invests in the right areas for the long term.
* Own complex dependencies, including cross-team requirements, release schedules, regional expansion, and trade-off decisions, and communicate status and risks clearly to senior leadership.

A day in the life
You'll spend your time where the portfolio's hardest problems meet. On a given day you might run a launch-readiness review for a new Network Firewall capability, align NLB and GWLB engineering teams on a shared infrastructure dependency, review progress on a security remediation program with audit partners, and write a document that frames a multi-year investment for leadership. You'll work closely with engineers and principal technologists, and you'll be trusted to make calls, unblock teams, and keep programs moving.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

title: Software Development Manager, Amazon Simple Storage Service, S3 Express
descriptionHtml:
Managing trillions of objects, retrieving them in sub-millisecond time, deploying software to tens of thousands of hosts, and achieving 99.999999999% durability (yes, that's 11 nines). These numbers hint at the scale of problems you'll tackle every day on Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3). S3 powers businesses across the globe, and we are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team building the index layer of S3 Express, our high-performance storage tier. You will own the technical direction for your team's distributed systems, guide engineers through algorithmically complex challenges like noisy-neighbor isolation and sub-millisecond latency, and help shape what could become the largest data storage service on the planet. If you care deeply about growing people, inventing new solutions, and operating at cloud scale, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical vision and roadmap for the S3 Express NameSpace index layer, defining how the system evolves to meet customer latency and durability requirements over the next one to two years.
- Lead a team of software engineers through the full development lifecycle, including system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational health for distributed storage services running on tens of thousands of hosts.
- Drive solutions to complex performance problems such as noisy-neighbor isolation and sub-millisecond retrieval, partnering closely with front-end and storage system teams to deliver cohesive results.
- Build and develop an inclusive team of engineers by investing in coaching, career development planning, and strategic project assignments that grow future technical leaders.
- Establish operational metrics and audit mechanisms that give your team clear visibility into system performance, customer experience, and service reliability at scale.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing latency dashboards and durability metrics for the S3 Express index layer, then join a design review where your engineers walk through a proposal for reducing tail latency. After lunch, you could be working with the front-end systems team to align on an upcoming integration, followed by a one-on-one coaching session with an engineer preparing for their next career step. You'll move between strategic planning and hands-on technical guidance, ensuring your team has the context and support they need to ship high-quality software.

About the team
The S3 Express NameSpace team owns the index layer that underpins Amazon S3 Express, a high-performance storage tier built for workloads that demand single-digit-millisecond access. We sit within the broader Amazon S3 organization and partner closely with front-end and storage system teams to deliver an end-to-end customer experience at massive scale. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, technical curiosity, and an inclusive environment where every engineer's perspective makes the product better. If you want to solve problems that few teams in the industry ever encounter, we would love to hear from you.

- 1+ years of providing technical leadership and project management for all aspects of the software development lifecycle experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using service-oriented architecture experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using distributed programming experience

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Communications
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security’s Security Communications (SecComms) team builds and operates the platforms, tools, and systems that enable Amazon’s security organization to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at scale. We support security events, ongoing security programs, vulnerability communications, and strategic initiatives that span multiple Amazon business units and AWS services. Our engineering products are the connective tissue between security findings, remediation owners, and the people responsible for keeping Amazon and its customers safe.

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to drive the design, development, and operation of software systems that power security communications workflows, automation, and integrations at scale. This role is for a builder who brings engineering rigor to ambiguous problems, cares deeply about customer outcomes, and thrives working across organizational boundaries with security engineers, program managers, and communications professionals.

Security Communications serves as the engineering and operations hub for AWS-related security messaging, stakeholder notification, and communications tooling across the organization. Our team is responsible for building scalable platforms that enable consistent, reliable, and timely communication during high-severity security events, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and routine security program operations. We are a cross-functional team — engineers work shoulder-to-shoulder with communications professionals, security operations personnel, AWS service owners, and executives. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating in this environment and contributing to discussions that span both technical and non-technical domains.



Key job responsibilities
Design & Delivery

* Design and deliver software features and improvements spanning the full lifecycle — including scoping, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance — for major portions of the SecComms platform.
* Work backwards from customer and stakeholder needs to define requirements and translate them into well-designed, maintainable software solutions.
* Design cohesive software implementations for difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks; bring clarity to ambiguous requirements and identify simple, extensible designs.
* Balance constraints across new feature development, technical debt, and operational reliability; limit short-term workarounds in favor of sustainable solutions.
* Produce high-quality, well-tested, documented code that adheres to the Amazon Code Bar and can be maintained and extended by teammates who did not author it.

Operational Excellence

* Demonstrate operational excellence in all work; own and operate production services with appropriate alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and on-call response.
* Actively participate in operational support; identify and resolve the root causes of operational issues rather than accepting the status quo.
* Routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve team operational processes, automation, and tooling — do not settle for operational friction when it can be eliminated.
* Ensure that software failures are addressed with permanent fixes; avoid recurring incidents by addressing systemic causes.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership

* Work closely with security engineers, program managers, communications leads, and partner teams to understand the business and customer value of your software.
* Operate effectively across team and organizational boundaries; collaborate with adjacent teams in an inclusive and constructive manner when integrations, dependencies, or shared priorities arise.
* Balance customer requirements with team requirements; make effective priority tradeoffs between feature development and operational work.
* Communicate clearly and proactively about work in progress, technical decisions, blockers, and scope changes to all relevant stakeholders — both technical and non-technical.

Mentorship & Engineering Culture

* Actively mentor engineers on the team; provide substantive, constructive code review feedback to peers including more senior engineers.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Identify and implement process improvements that drive better outcomes across safety, cost, schedule, and quality

title: Finance Manager, Amazon Supply Chain Services - Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) enables third-party merchants to leverage Amazon's fulfillment, distribution, and transportation network across multiple services including Shipping, Freight, Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCCF), Air, Multi-Channel Distribution (MCD), and Veeqo. As the organization scales, capital investments, network design decisions, and long-term cost structure planning are becoming increasingly critical to ASCS profitability and strategic direction. We are looking for a Finance Manager to own CAPEX investment analysis, network finance, and long-term financial modeling across all six ASCS businesses.

This role sits at the intersection of ASCS Finance, Operations, Network Planning, and the corporate CAPEX finance team. The ideal candidate has strong experience building return on investment models, analyzing capital allocation decisions, and translating complex financial analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership. They are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, partnering with operations and cost owners to evaluate trade-offs, and presenting investment cases to VP-level audiences. This role reports into ASCS FP&A Finance.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end CAPEX investment analysis and reporting across all six ASCS businesses (Shipping, Freight, MCCF, Air, MCD, Veeqo), delivering consolidated views for monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles.

- Build and maintain Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) and Return on Assets (ROA) models to evaluate the financial performance of ASCS capital deployments

- Develop long-term free cash flow models to inform multi-year investment strategy and help leadership understand the cash generation trajectory of ASCS.

- Partner with operations teams on network design decisions, providing financial analysis on facility investments, capacity expansion, and network topology changes

- Analyze long-term cost structure across ASCS to identify opportunities for cost optimization, margin improvement, and investment prioritization

- Partner with the corporate CAPEX finance team to ensure ASCS capital requests are properly justified, documented, and aligned with Amazon-wide capital allocation frameworks

- Work directly with cost owners in each business to understand cost drivers, validate assumptions, and build bottom-up investment cases

- Present investment analytics and recommendations to ASCS leadership (L8-L10), translating complex financial models into clear narratives that shape capital allocation decisions

- Support OP1/OP2 annual planning and QxG quarterly cycles with CAPEX and investment-specific inputs, bridging variances and forecasting future capital needs

- Build long-term scalable solutions leveraging AI, including dashboards, automation workstreams, and self-service tools for business and finance leaders

- Thrive and deliver results in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment with competing priorities across finance, operations, and business teams

A day in the life
As part of a team that is building from scratch, you will spend your time connecting with key stakeholders across operations, the corporate CAPEX finance team, and business cost owners. You will build financial models that evaluate capital investment trade-offs, present analytics to help shape where ASCS invests, and own the numbers that inform network design and long-term cost decisions. One day you might be modeling the ROI of a new sort center, the next day you could be analyzing the free cash flow impact of a fleet expansion. The work is highly visible, directly influencing decisions made by VPs and senior leadership.

About the team
Our Finance team is dedicated to providing the insights and analysis that help Amazon make smart, informed decisions at every level. We operate in a collaborative environment where analytical rigor meets creative problem-solving, and where every team member has the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, large-scale outcomes. We are focused on building scalable processes, strengthening financial governance, and continuously raising the bar on how we support the business. If you are looking for a team where your work has visible impact and your growth is supported, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 5+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience

descriptionHtml:
