descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Amazon LEO is seeking a Senior Manufacturing And Automation Engineer to develop, automate, and scale manufacturing processes for complex aerospace hardware, including PCBAs, battery packs, LRUs, and associated components. This role is responsible for transforming prototype and manual manufacturing processes into scalable, reliable, and efficient production solutions. The successful candidate will lead manufacturing process development, automation equipment integration, process optimization, and production readiness, ensuring manufacturing systems meet quality, throughput, safety, and cost objectives.
The ideal candidate combines strong manufacturing process engineering expertise with hands-on experience in industrial automation, equipment design, robotics, and production system integration.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Manufacturing Process Development: Develop, optimize, and industrialize manufacturing processes for PCBA, battery pack, LRU, and component assembly, improving efficiency, repeatability, quality, and scalability.

Manufacturing Automation: Design, develop, and implement automated and semi-automated production systems incorporating robotics, PLCs, motion control, machine vision, sensors, and industrial controls.

Equipment and Tooling Development: Define requirements and lead the design, fabrication, integration, and commissioning of manufacturing equipment, fixtures, tooling, and automated assembly stations.
Process Capability and Optimization: Establish manufacturing process parameters, implement process controls, and apply PFMEA, DOE, SPC, and capability analysis to improve yield, reduce variation, and eliminate defects.

Production Scalability: Develop manufacturing strategies and automation solutions to increase production capacity, reduce cycle time, minimize manual operations, and support production ramp-up.
Equipment Integration and Qualification: Lead equipment acceptance, commissioning, process validation, and production release, ensuring manufacturing systems meet performance, safety, and reliability requirements.

Manufacturing Troubleshooting: Lead root cause investigations of manufacturing defects, equipment failures, and process inefficiencies, implementing sustainable corrective actions.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Quality, Test Engineering, and suppliers to improve manufacturability, implement process automation, and transition products into production.

Basic qualifications

title: Data Scientist, Amazon Ads Marketing Decision Science
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising drives billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks daily, powering discovery and sales for advertisers across Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses. The Ads Marketing Decision Science team sits at the intersection of data science and marketing strategy. We build intelligent, data-driven systems that analyze advertiser behavior at large scale to deliver the right guidance to the right advertiser at the right time. Our work spans behavioral modeling, content intelligence, automated decision systems, and GenAI applications, enabling personalized marketing experiences that help advertisers make smarter advertising decisions and grow their business on Amazon.

We are looking for a Data Scientist who brings strong fundamentals in machine learning, causal inference, and statistical modeling to solve real advertiser problems. You will build predictive models, design experiments, develop segmentation frameworks, and leverage GenAI capabilities where applicable, taking solutions end-to-end from proof-of-concept to production at scale. You will partner closely with scientists, engineers, and product managers on a daily basis to prototype rapidly, ensure data integrity in production systems, and deliver measurable advertiser impact. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems with cutting-edge science, come join us as we innovate and make history.


Key job responsibilities
• Define and execute data science solutions end-to-end, from problem framing through production deployment.
• Build machine learning models (classification, regression, clustering, ranking) for advertiser segmentation, propensity modeling, and recommendations.
• Apply causal inference and experimentation methods (A/B testing, difference-in-differences, propensity score matching) to measure the impact of marketing interventions.
• Analyze large-scale advertiser behavioral data to identify trends, surface growth opportunities, and support optimal decision making.
• Collaborate with colleagues across science and engineering disciplines for fast turnaround proof-of-concept prototyping at scale.
• Establish and drive data hygiene best practices to ensure coherence and integrity of data feeding into production ML/AI solutions.
• Leverage GenAI and LLM capabilities to enhance science products where applicable


A day in the life
You will solve real-world problems by analyzing large volumes of advertiser data, building predictive models, designing experiments, and measuring business impact. You will prototype rapidly, validate ideas with data, and partner with engineers to productize and scale successful solutions. You will collaborate daily with scientists, engineers, and product managers across the advertising organization, working in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment where data drives decisions and helps advertisers grow.

About the team
We are a team of Applied Scientists, Research Scientists, Data Scientists, and Business Intelligence Engineers with deep expertise in ML, NLP, Gen-AI, RL, and causal inference, from a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with strong engineers, product managers, and sales leaders who bring ads-industry depth and experience building scalable modeling and software solutions.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 2+ years of data scientist experience
- 3+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
- Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company

title: Principal Applied Scientist, AWS Data Center Services
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

The AWS Data Center Services team is hiring a Principal Applied Scientist to innovate and advance the science behind solutions to problems in the rapidly growing AWS data center space.

These problems range from bespoke computer vision models to support our physical infrastructure functions such as repair activities, to increasing the certainty of decisions made by our generative AI service without sacrificing latency or performance. For example, when a data center technician is triaging a critical electrical event at 2am and alarms cascade in seconds, our AI service has to cross-reference topology, live readings, maintenance history, and design documents within minutes - work that today takes an order of magnitude more time and intervention from a senior engineer.

As a Principal Applied Scientist, you will work backwards from these problems and partner with software development teams to deliver solutions. You will work on problems ranging from selecting, training and evolving computer vision models for targeted activities on AWS infrastructure inside our data centers; to building smart retrieval algorithms, reduce model hallucination on safety-critical outcomes, continually improve latency and performance, and ensure our generative AI service's knowledgeable stays current and the service is constantly getting smarter beyond just knowledge retrieval.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing traces from last night’s incident triage. The agent correctly walked the topology to the upstream breaker but missed a recent maintenance change that was the real cause — so you design an experiment: does feeding work-order history into the traversal improve accuracy? You test it against historical incident data. Mid-morning, you review verification traces and catch the agent missing a spec deep in a submittal. After lunch, a field engineer walks you through manually cross-referencing five systems during an incident and you turn their scenario into a new benchmark. In the afternoon, you prototype cross-discipline reasoning: when a cascade spans electrical and cooling, can the lead agent delegate scoped investigations and still hold one coherent hypothesis? You publish results and draft a paper. You own the full lifecycle — research through production deployment.

About the team
Data Center Services is part of AWS Infrastructure Services that owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic qualifications

PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Statistics or in a highly quantitative field.
Strong Problem solving ability
Good skills in Python (or similar language)
Strong communication and data presentation skills
Proven track record of delivery

Preferred qualifications

7+ years of industrial experience in predictive modeling and analysis, predictive software development
Experience in Generative AI
Publications or presentation in recognized Computer Vision, Machine Learning or Data Mining journals/conferences
Experience in mentoring junior team members, and guiding them on machine learning and data modeling applications
Experience working with retail or e-commerce data
Experience working with distributed systems and device level software

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Security Experiences, Analytics and Science Team
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Security Experiences (ASE) organization is the data intelligence backbone of Amazon Security. We build and operate the data platform that powers security insights, builder experience analytics, and tooling decisions across Amazon's security ecosystem. Every insight surfaced to security leadership, from builder productivity trends to security issue quality metrics, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

We operate at scale, processing large volumes of security and operational data daily through hundreds of pipelines consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems across AWS and SDO (Security, Developer, and Operations) data domains to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer I to join our Security Data Intelligence (SDI) team. In this role, you will build and maintain BI solutions (datasets, queries, reports, dashboards, and analyses) that inform how security leadership makes decisions across Amazon. Working on well-defined problems with guidance from senior engineers, you will maintain data lineage understanding, apply analytics and visualization tools, and deliver reliable insights on schedule. You will partner with teams across ASE, BizOps, MapSec, and other security organizations to translate business questions into data-driven answers that serve the broader Amazon Security organization.

Key job responsibilities
Learn and apply team BI best practices when building data artifacts including ETL, data models, queries, and reports. Measure and improve dataset quality across owned solutions. Automate manual processes where possible.

Maintain understanding of relevant data lineage: sources of data, how metrics are aggregated, and how BI is consumed and acted upon by security leadership. Learn the business context behind the team's data infrastructure and metrics definitions. Investigate data anomalies and validate outputs against source data and business logic.

Build small to mid-size BI solutions, or components of larger solutions, to answer straightforward business questions with data. Be proficient in SQL, maintain straightforward ETL, and create data structures using schema definition languages. Use analytics and visualization tools (e.g., QuickSight, Excel, Tableau) to deliver actionable insights.

Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code with minimal defects. Get analyses and code reviewed before deployment. Document solutions for ease of use, interpretation, and maintainability. Handle data in accordance with Amazon security and compliance policies.

Solve straightforward problems where what to accomplish is clear but how requires skill and knowledge. For example, building a dashboard that surfaces security issue quality trends, or creating a report that tracks builder productivity across SDO tooling data. Troubleshoot and research root causes, taking ownership or ensuring clear hand-off.

Take well-defined requirements and deliver on schedule. Seek input and guidance from team members on technology and business context. Participate in team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions. Communicate findings effectively to a technical audience.

Work effectively with customers (e.g., business teams, Data Scientists) and internal partners to ensure deliverables meet expectations. Partner with peer BIEs and others on the team. Help train new peers. Participate in the interview process.

Apply descriptive statistics to analyze security and operational data. Be familiar with inferential statistics and know when such methods are appropriate. Identify trends in metrics and segment along suitable dimensions to reveal deeper dynamics.

Assume responsibility for code, queries, reports, and analyses you inherit or produce. Ensure proper access control, data integrity, and auditability. Track security risks, mitigate issues, and escalate in a timely manner.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build
experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience in data querying or modeling with SQL, Excel
- 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)

Preferred qualifications

title: Sr. Product Manager, Global Compliance, Amazon Compliance Safety Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead compliance product strategy for sellers manufacturing and selling globally from China. You will own the seller compliance experience for the fastest-growing cross-border seller population on Amazon, working directly with Chinese manufacturers, testing labs, certification bodies, and logistics providers to make compliance frictionless for sellers expanding into US, EU, UK, Japan, and beyond.

You will define and execute the product roadmap for compliance capabilities that serve China-based sellers across multiple programs: product safety testing, restricted products documentation, cross-border trade requirements, and regulatory filings. You will work backwards from seller pain points to build experiences where sellers learn their requirements once, test once, and launch globally from day one. This role is based in Shenzhen to be co-located with the seller population, the TIC (Testing, Inspection, Certification) partner ecosystem, and the AGS (Amazon Global Selling) team.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for compliance capabilities serving China-origin sellers expanding to global Amazon marketplaces
Partner with local TIC providers (SGS, TÜV, Intertek, Bureau Veritas, domestic Chinese labs) to build integrated testing workflows that reduce seller compliance cost and time
Define requirements for the Forge pilot: consolidated test plans, lab connections, and pre-listing compliance guidance delivered through Seller Assistant
Represent the China seller voice in global compliance product decisions, translating on-the-ground seller friction into product requirements for Seattle-based engineering teams
Work with AGS, Cross-Border, and Global Store teams to identify compliance barriers preventing seller expansion and quantify the GMS opportunity behind each
Drive seller research through direct engagement with manufacturers in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and Yiwu to validate product assumptions and test prototypes
Own metrics for China seller compliance experience: time to compliance, testing cost reduction, first-time approval rate, and cross-marketplace launch rate
Coordinate with regulatory bodies and industry groups on emerging requirements (EU Digital Product Passport, GPSR, battery regulations) that disproportionately affect China-origin sellers

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing seller feedback from the latest Forge pilot cohort in Toys, identifying patterns in where sellers get stuck during the consolidated testing flow. By mid-morning you are meeting with a Shenzhen-based TIC partner to negotiate pre-negotiated pricing tiers for the next product category expansion. After lunch you join a weekly sync with the Seattle engineering team to review sprint progress on the Seller Assistant compliance integration, translating seller context from your field visits into prioritized requirements. Late afternoon you draft a product brief for the next China Seller Conference demo, working backwards from a seller who manufactures LED lighting and wants to sell in 9 marketplaces simultaneously. You close the day reviewing cross-border compliance data to identify which requirement gaps are blocking the most GMS for China sellers expanding to EU.

About the team
Amazon Compliance Safety Services (CoSS) builds the systems and experiences that help sellers meet compliance requirements across every Amazon marketplace. Our mission is to make compliance something Amazon handles on behalf of sellers, not something sellers navigate alone. The One Compliance program is unifying the seller compliance experience across product safety, restricted products, cross-border trade, and regulatory filings into a single journey. We are building toward a world where a seller tests once and sells globally from day one. The Shenzhen role is critical because China-origin sellers represent the largest cross-border seller population on Amazon and face the most complex multi-jurisdiction compliance requirements.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products

title: Safety Risk Engineer, WHS Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.
- Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.
- Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.
- Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.
- Use data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements across sites.

A day in the life
You work across several sites, moving between machinery inspections, risk assessments and working sessions with engineering and operations leaders. You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. You use data to see patterns across sites and to prioritise where safety effort has the biggest impact. A large part of your day is influencing — helping functional leaders understand machinery risk and building buy-in to the Health & Safety standards and changes you recommend.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in electrical, mechanical, civil or industrial engineering.
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience in English language communication skills (B2/C1), both written and verbal.
- Experience conducting machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites, applying the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC).
- Experience engaging and influencing functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sr HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Im Streben danach, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, treiben unsere globalen Human-Resources-Teams – bekannt als People eXperience and Technology (PXT) – den Unternehmenserfolg voran, indem sie eine sichere, inklusive und innovative Unternehmenskultur fördern. Der/Die Senior HR Business Partner:in ist verantwortlich für operative Exzellenz und organisatorische Gesundheit durch PXT-Führung an den zugewiesenen Standorten. Als erfahrene HR-Führungskraft agierst du als Individual Contributor und arbeitest direkt mit Field Leaders, Standortleitungsteams und General Managers zusammen. Du bringst dabei die Seniorität und Glaubwürdigkeit mit, die für strategische Diskussionen zu komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen erforderlich sind. Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für das End-to-End-Mitarbeitererlebnis an deinen Standorten und verantwortest Feedback-Mechanismen, Anerkennungsprogramme sowie Umgebungsstandards, die Vertrauen, Engagement und Leistung nachhaltig prägen. Diese Rolle erfordert die Balance zwischen taktischer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick – unter Nutzung von Technologie und menschlichem Urteilsvermögen, um qualitativ hochwertige Mitarbeitererlebnisse zu schaffen und gleichzeitig eine proaktive Risikoidentifikation und -minderung voranzutreiben.
Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten und mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner Region (Campus) betreuen, mit regelmäßiger Mobilität zwischen den zugewiesenen Standorten.

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement

Förderung einer offenen Zwei-Wege-Kommunikation durch Voice of the Associate-Programme, Rundtischgespräche und GEMBA-Walks mit zeitnaher Lösung von Anliegen und Stärkung der Beziehungen zwischen Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften. Umsetzung von Engagement-Strategien und Anerkennungsprogrammen, die die Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit messbar steigern. Schaffung eines inklusiven Umfelds, in dem sich Mitarbeitende sicher fühlen, ihre Meinung zu äußern und authentisch aufzutreten – durch die Etablierung von Employee Resource Groups und die Sicherstellung gerechter Talentpraktiken. Regelmäßige und sichtbare Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche, um Vertrauen auf allen Ebenen aufzubauen und Anliegen frühzeitig zu erkennen, bevor sie eskalieren.



Operational Excellence & Site Standards

Bewertung der Arbeitsbedingungen durch regelmäßige Standortbegehungen und Etablierung von Routinen zur Einhaltung der Standards gemäß den Amazon-Vorgaben. Zusammenarbeit mit Standortleitungen und Safety-Teams zur konsequenten Umsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards und -programmen. Leitung strategischer Community-Initiativen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams für Public Policy und Public Relations. Proaktive Risikoidentifikation und -minderung durch die Einrichtung von Frühwarnsystemen, Nutzung von Datenerkenntnissen und fundierte Entscheidungen, die den Richtliniengeist mit den Geschäftsanforderungen in Einklang bringen. Umsetzung zentraler PXT-Prozesse nach strengen Standards sowie Durchführung von Inspektionen und Audits zur Sicherstellung der Compliance. Effektive Koordination mit Shared Services und funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zur Gewährleistung einer nahtlosen Serviceerbringung.



Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology

Führende Nutzung von Analysen und KI-Tools zur Aufdeckung verborgener Muster, Antizipation aufkommender Risiken und Förderung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung. Umwandlung von Erkenntnissen in überzeugende Narrative, die Senior Stakeholder beeinflussen und messbare Verbesserungen im Mitarbeitererlebnis und in der Unternehmensleistung vorantreiben. Strategische Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen und Self-Service-Tools für Effizienz und Exzellenz – unter Nutzung von Automatisierung bei gleichzeitiger Beibehaltung eines persönlichen Service für sensible Anliegen, die menschliches Urteilsvermögen und Empathie erfordern.



Strategic PXT Leadership

Regelmäßige Partnerschaft mit Standortleitungen und General Managers zur Balance zwischen operativen Anforderungen und Amazons Werten sowie Personalstrategie – mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen bei komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen. Hinterfragen des Status quo und Förderung von Innovationen in HR-Praktiken bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung einer nachhaltigen Umsetzung. Coaching von Business Leaders zu effektivem Personalmanagement, einschließlich Leistungsfeedback, Teamentwicklung und komplexen Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen. Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen durch Verstärkung von Botschaften, Abbau von Widerständen und Unterstützung von Führungskräften bei der Übertragung von Veränderungen in lokale Routinen. Festlegung klarer Ziele für die Kulturtransformation und Umsetzung umfassender Strategien zur systematischen Stärkung der Organisationsgesundheit, Talentkompetenzen und Führungseffektivität.



PXT Leadership & Organizational Health

Mitwirkung bei PXT-Personalentscheidungen, Ressourcenallokation und Dienstplanung zur Sicherstellung angemessener Abdeckung und Kompetenz. Beteiligung an Nachfolgeplanung und Beförderungsentscheidungen sowie Identifikation von High-Potential-Talenten und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Durchführung von Talentbewertungen für PXT-Teammitglieder mit Beiträgen zu Leistung, Potenzial und Entwicklungsbedarf. Unterstützung der Entwicklungsplanung und Beitrag zum Aufbau von Nachfolgekapazitäten für kritische Positionen. Beiträge zum Performance Management des PXT-Teams sowie Förderung einer positiven Teamkultur und Anerkennungspraktiken.

A day in the life
Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet strategisches Denken mit praxisnaher Umsetzung auf Standortebene. Du nutzt fortgeschrittene Analysen und KI-gestützte Tools, um Trends zu erkennen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die das Arbeitsplatzerlebnis verbessern. Vom Coaching von Senior Leaders bei komplexen Personalherausforderungen bis hin zur Förderung von HR-Prozessexzellenz arbeitest du eng mit Field Leaders und General Managers an zukunftsorientierten Strategien zusammen. Du pflegst eine starke Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche durch Standortbegehungen, Mitarbeiter-Feedback-Runden und strategische Initiativen und navigierst dabei komplexe organisatorische Herausforderungen mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen. Darüber hinaus trägst du zur organisatorischen Gesundheit des PXT-Teams durch Talentbewertungen, Nachfolgeplanung und Performance Management bei. Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt von deiner Fähigkeit ab, Veränderungsinitiativen zu leiten, in unklaren Situationen fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und eine Unternehmenskultur zu schaffen, in der sich Mitarbeitende wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen.

About the team
Unsere HR-Abteilung bei Amazon spielt bei der Betreuung unserer Mitarbeitenden eine wesentliche Rolle. Oberste Priorität des sogenannten People Experience und Technology Solutions Team (PXT-Team) ist es, unseren Kolleg:innen ein großartiges Amazon-Erlebnis anzubieten und uns dabei zu helfen, eines der innovativsten, kundenorientiertesten und agilsten Unternehmen der Welt zu bleiben.
Wir arbeiten proaktiv und wenden einen holistischen Ansatz für das People Management an. „Customer Obsession“ – Die oberste Priorität haben immer unsere Kund:innen. Unser Team konzentriert sich darauf, Fragen in Bezug auf das Engagement der Mitarbeitenden zu lösen und dafür zu sorgen, dass nichts unser makelloses Mitarbeiter- und Kundenerlebnis beeinträchtigt. Unsere Aufgabe besteht darin, auf den allerhöchsten Standards zu bestehen und den Fortschritt in allen Strategie- und Zielbereichen von Amazon zu fördern.

descriptionHtml:
ROLES AVAILABLE IN MADRID AND BARCELONA


There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?

An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

The Amazon European Supply Chain Control and Analytics team is a growing and international team and we are looking for a talented, smart and enthusiastic Supply Chain Operations Intern to work with us on innovating and improving our processes on behalf of our Customers in EU.



Key job responsibilities
• Lead strategic initiatives related to network capacity within Amazon's various business units.
• Concentrate on optimizing and managing the flow of goods, information, or services within the supply chain network.

• Analyze and synthesize data to identify opportunities for enhancing customer experiences and operational efficiency in network capacity.
• Define metrics, develop program management mechanisms, and invent/simplify processes to drive decision-making in complex network capacity situations.
• Collaborate with stakeholders across different functions, influencing and facilitating agreements to achieve shared network capacity goals.

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.
Basic qualifications
• Hold a valid and active driver’s license
• High School or equivalent diploma
• Candidates must be 21 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirement and safety guidelines in English.
• Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, reach and ascend/descend stairs
• Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
• Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications
• Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills with diverse audiences
• Experience building strong, collaborative relationships with colleagues and outside vendors
• A valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL)
• Completion of Career Choice Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) Course


Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Driver's license
- Are 21 years of age or older
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

descriptionHtml:
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) Global Engineering is looking for a System Development Engineer (SysDE) to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team. As a SysDE III on the NPI team, you will embed with Hardware Development programs from the Alpha phase to influence controls and system architecture *before* solutions are built. Rather than fixing deployment and reliability problems in the field, you will design them out, shaping the automation, firmware, and integration decisions that determine how easily a solution scales across our global network. Lead design reviews that surface architectural and scalability risks early, and prototype frameworks, emulators, automated validation, CI/CD for controls code that become the foundation future solutions are built on. You build and engineer solutions that are correct by design.

title: Sr. UX Product Researcher, AWS Region Services
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior UX Product Researcher on our team, you'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product managers to bring customer evidence into product and roadmap decisions. You'll go deep on how builders and technical teams actually work, and make sure their needs shape what we build.

You'll lead end-to-end research programs across major product lifecycles, influence strategy through evidence, and help define the experience for the AWS service teams and customers who depend on our products every day.

You'll partner closely with senior leadership and product stakeholders to ensure what we build is grounded in a deep understanding of our users — many of whom are technical builders with sophisticated needs.

Why join us?
- Work closely with engineering and bring customer evidence directly into technical architecture and roadmap decisions.
- Research a sophisticated builder and technical audience whose work powers products used by millions worldwide.
- Shape product and platform strategy through deep user understanding, not just validate decisions after they're made.
- Collaborate with world-class designers, engineers, and product leaders in a culture that values innovation, ownership, and customer obsession.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and manage research programs for major product and service lifecycles, from discovery through launch and post-launch evaluation.
- Design and execute research using a mix of methods suited to a technical audience — including developer and stakeholder interviews, surveys, diary studies, usability testing, and behavioral/log and telemetry analysis.
- Embed with engineering teams to translate customer and builder needs into technical requirements and influence how services are designed.
- Identify new research opportunities that inform product strategy and influence business decisions.
- Translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights for cross-functional partners and senior leadership.
- Inform strategic planning documents (e.g., Press Releases / Working Backwards narratives) with customer evidence and recommendations.
- Navigate ambiguous business problems and define research approaches that drive clarity.
- Contribute to the broader research community through patents, publications, or internal knowledge sharing.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We make it radically easier for AWS service teams and customers to find, understand, and act on the right information about AWS services across regions.

Behind that mission is the Product Registry — the source of truth for AWS service metadata (naming, categorization, lifecycle stage, ownership, hierarchy, regional availability, technical dependencies, and more). Service teams rely on us to track, report, and self-correct their feature catalogs; customers rely on us (through AWS Capabilities by Region and Capability Insights) to understand what's available where. We also help teams achieve parity across AWS regions as they expand.

That's a rich experience problem: our users are technical, their decisions are high-stakes, and their current tools are complex. Research is central to how we decide what to build and judge whether it's working, and you'll have real influence over the direction of the product.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of proven success leading User Research projects with demonstrated impact experience
- 5+ years of hands-on work with: field research, ethnography, lab-based user testing, remote testing, paper prototype testing, iterative prototype testing, concept testing, and survey design experience
- Bachelor's degree in HCDE, Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field
- Experience in leading User Research projects with demonstrated impact
- Experience with field research, ethnography, lab-based user testing, remote testing, paper prototype testing, iterative prototype testing, concept testing, and survey design
- Experience with all aspects of research (study design, recruiting, moderation, analysis, reporting)
- Experience with behavioral data collection, quantitative data analysis, and statistics
- Have a portfolio demonstrating past work experience and deliverables (e.g., study plans, reports, personas)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Human Factors, HCDE, Cognitive Psychology or equivalent
- Experience in a technical field (software development, network development, IT, other related)
- Experience with UX Research in non-US markets
- Experience working in a highly Agile/Scrum environment

title: Executive Assistant II, AWS Field Experiences
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive as a trusted partner to a senior leader, anticipating what's next and keeping the business moving? Do you believe details matter and want to help a fast-moving leadership team stay focused on what counts?

We are looking for a well organized, self-motivated Executive Assistant (EA) to support the Executive of AWS Field Experiences and the broader AFX leadership team at Amazon Web Services. We want someone driven and resourceful who has a record of high performance. The role calls for sharp attention to detail, strong judgment on priorities, and the ability to plan ahead and hit tight deadlines while juggling several critical requests.

In this role, you will:

- Act as a strategic partner to the Executive, making sure their time matches business priorities and making judgment calls on where their attention matters most
- Run the leadership team's operating rhythm, including staff meetings, business reviews, offsites, and planning cycles
- Coordinate executive communications, org announcements, and meetings with senior leaders across SMGS and with external partners
- Manage travel, events, and logistics end to end
Partner with EAs and business managers across SMGS to keep work moving between teams

You hold yourself to a high standard of integrity and discretion with confidential information, and you're polished and professional with leaders inside and outside Amazon. You stay flexible and can change direction quickly. You finish complex tasks with little guidance, move fast when something needs a quick turnaround, and look for new projects and skills. You can act effectively without seeing the full picture, and you solve problems before they reach your leader's desk.

You're also curious about AI-powered productivity tools and use them to work smarter, automating routine scheduling, meeting prep, and follow-ups so you can focus on higher-value work.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

AWS Field Experiences (AFX) is part of the SMGS team. AFX delivers the world's most advanced, intelligent go-to-market (GTM) experience, setting the standard for how AWS Field and Operations teams plan, execute, and optimize business success.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities for this position include playing a leadership role, thinking and planning ahead, delegating appropriately, and managing time effectively. Other key responsibilities include:

- Act as a strategic partner to the Executive, managing a complex calendar with diplomacy and discretion so that time reflects business priorities, including protected time for focused work.
- Prepare the Executive for key meetings with agendas, pre-reads, and briefing materials, so they walk in ready.
- Organize, prioritize, and handle time-sensitive, confidential information, including people and org matters, and make sure required actions are addressed on time.
- Drive the AFX leadership team's operating rhythm: staff meeting agendas, business reviews, annual planning (OP1/OP2), talent reviews, on-sites/off-sites, and team events.
- Coordinate executive communications and org announcements with stakeholders across SMGS.
- Plan domestic and international travel end to end, including detailed itineraries that account for time zone changes. Coordinate with in-house travel agents and submit expense reports on time.
- Partner closely with Recruiting, HR, Finance, Facilities, and other EAs and business managers across Amazon, including coordinating interview loops for open roles.
- Track and drive completion of key deliverables. Capture meeting notes and action items, and follow up until items close.
- Use AI and automation tools to streamline scheduling, meeting prep, and follow-ups, and keep finding ways to improve how the office runs.

A day in the life
You'll work in a fast-moving, often ambiguous environment where you take initiative, complete tasks and projects quickly, and act without needing the full picture. You'll learn how AFX is organized, what its priorities are, and how it connects to the rest of SMGS, and you'll build a strong network across the business.

On any given day, you might prepare the Executive for a senior leadership review, reshuffle the week around a high-priority customer meeting, line up the next staff meeting or off-site, and follow up on open action items from yesterday's business review. You'll bring sharp attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to meet tight deadlines and juggle several critical requests while staying flexible, keeping a sense of humor, and, most of all, staying calm under pressure.

Over time, you'll build deep, trusted relationships with the Executive and the AFX leadership team. Those relationships will turn into strong partnerships, with chances to take on special projects, more responsibility, and long-term career growth.

title: Applied Scientist, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to lead the development of evaluation frameworks and data collection protocols for robotic capabilities. In this role, you will focus on designing how we measure, stress-test, and improve robot behavior across a wide range of real-world tasks. Your work will play a critical role in shaping how policies are validated and how high-quality datasets are generated to accelerate system performance.
You will operate at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and human-in-the-loop systems, building the infrastructure and methodologies that connect teleoperation, evaluation, and learning. This includes developing evaluation policies, defining task structures, and contributing to operator-facing interfaces that enable scalable and reliable data collection.
The ideal candidate is highly experimental, systems-oriented, and comfortable working across software, robotics, and data pipelines, with a strong focus on turning ambiguous capability goals into measurable and actionable evaluation systems.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure robot capabilities across structured tasks, edge cases, and real-world scenarios
- Develop task definitions, success criteria, and benchmarking methodologies that enable consistent and reproducible evaluation of policies
- Create and refine data collection protocols that generate high-quality, task-relevant datasets aligned with model development needs
- Build and iterate on teleoperation workflows and operator interfaces to support efficient, reliable, and scalable data collection
- Analyze evaluation results and collected data to identify performance gaps, failure modes, and opportunities for targeted data collection
- Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate evaluation tooling, logging systems, and data pipelines into the broader robotics stack
- Stay current with advances in robotics, evaluation methodologies, and human-in-the-loop learning to continuously improve internal approaches
- Lead technical projects from conception through production deployment
- Mentor junior scientists and engineers

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

title: Sr. Financial Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Senior Financial Analyst, FAIM Finance (Amazon Ads)

Amazon Ads is building toward a future where an advertiser specifies a few marketing parameters (budget, success definition, which products to promote) and a set of AI agents handles the rest. The Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models (FAIM) organization owns that bet: the Ads Nova agent, the Ads Nova model it reasons with, and the full-funnel campaign products that put them in front of advertisers. FAIM Finance is the team that answers whether the bet is paying off, and at what cost.

We are hiring a Senior Financial Analyst to own financial planning and analysis for this organization: the operating plan, the monthly actuals and forecast, the business reviews, and the models that translate agent and model usage into revenue and cost. This is a ground-up build. The products are new, the cost structure is GPU and compute heavy with inference costs that scale with every advertiser conversation, and the forecasting methods have to be invented rather than inherited. You will work alongside a small team of finance managers, business intelligence engineers, and data engineers, with regular exposure to the leaders who run FAIM and to senior leadership across Ads Finance. If you want a finance seat where the P&L looks nothing like a traditional advertising business and the decisions are still being made, keep reading.

What you'll own

- The FAIM operating plan and forecast: annual planning (OP1/OP2), quarterly forecasts, and monthly actuals with variance analysis across revenue, headcount, and infrastructure spend
- The business review mechanism: weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews that leaders trust for accuracy and read for the story behind the number
- Driver-based models that connect product usage (advertisers, campaigns, agent conversations, tokens, GPU hours) to revenue and cost to serve, for products with little or no history to extrapolate from
- The investment cases: financial support for compute and GPU requests, headcount asks, and new product bets, including the analysis in documents that go to senior leadership

Key job responsibilities

- Drive the planning cycle: build and maintain the FAIM financial model, consolidate inputs from Product, Engineering, and Science, and own the bridge between plan, forecast, and actuals
- Run the monthly close analysis: explain variances, identify root causes, state the financial implication, and follow through on the actions that come out of it
- Partner with product and engineering leaders to anticipate business needs, interpret trends, and evaluate the economics of new products, pricing, and infrastructure decisions
- Build the models behind investment decisions (compute capacity, headcount, pricing) and write the financial sections of documents that senior leaders act on
- Coordinate the business review mechanisms, ensuring reporting accuracy and clear communication of results and recommendations
- Work with the team's business intelligence and data engineers so the finance data platform answers the questions the P&L raises; define what the business needs to measure and how it is read
- Lead projects to automate, simplify, or scale finance processes, including AI-enabled tools that reduce manual work and defects
- Uphold strong financial controllership: accurate accruals, clean cost allocation, and documented SOPs that let others pick up the work

We're looking for an analyst who brings

- 3+ years of finance, FP&A, or related analytical experience, and a bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field
- Strong financial modeling skills: driver-based forecasts, scenario analysis, and the attention to detail to make the numbers tie
- Experience building financial and operational reports that inform decisions, and applying key performance indicators to explain what happened and why
- Working SQL and advanced Excel fluency, with the habit of pulling your own data rather than waiting for it
- Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a variance or a recommendation to a senior leader in plain language
- Experience in advertising, software, or cloud infrastructure finance, especially with usage-based cost structures (compute, GPU, inference), is a plus
- Python or equivalent for analysis and automation, and familiarity with QuickSight or similar reporting tools
- Experience supporting a new product or 0-to-1 business where forecasting is built from drivers rather than trends
- AI-native working style: using tools such as Kiro, Claude Code, or equivalent to automate recurring analysis and catch defects faster
- Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a bias for action and the judgment to know when precision matters and when direction is enough

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of Tableau
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
- Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
- Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
- Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components
- Collaborate with ML scientists to productionize computer vision models and optimize their performance at scale
- Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence

A day in the life
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. descriptionHtml:
AWS Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) is seeking a Risk Specialist to join our team within Risk Management Excellence (RMX). In this role, you will help identify, assess, and manage enterprise-level risks that could affect AWS’s operations, strategy, and compliance posture.

title: Applied Scientist, Agentic AI, AWS Governance
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the ML models that power every compliance verdict customers and auditors rely on? We are building a new Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) service at AWS where every action — human or agent — is recorded, assessed, and provably governed, continuously and at any scale.

As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own the Natural Language Inference (NLI) model at the center of our compliance engine: fine-tuning, calibrating, and monitoring it in production. You will also design the science behind framework decomposition, evidence auto-linking, and a new agent-context system that tackles retrieval, grounding, and hallucination measurement for AI agents. Your work will directly shape the accuracy and trustworthiness of every customer-visible result we produce.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the production NLI model end-to-end: fine-tune, promote, calibrate thresholds, and monitor for drift to ensure accurate compliance verdicts across frameworks.
- Design and implement framework decomposition pipelines that translate compliance controls into NLI hypotheses, including enrichment and per-framework threshold calibration.
- Build and improve the evidence auto-linking system using ranking, embedding, and reranking techniques, tuning precision-recall tradeoffs and addressing OCR quality challenges.
- Drive the quality flywheel by establishing labeling standards, designing offline and online evaluation methods, orchestrating retraining cycles, and ensuring privacy-safe data handling.
- Research and develop the agent-context capability — retrieval and representation of lifecycle signals, cross-framework knowledge, memory, grounding, and hallucination measurement — collaborating with engineering pods to bring these models into production.

A day in the life
You will split your time between collaborative and heads-down work. On the collaborative side, you will partner with several pods of software development engineers in an Agile cadence — aligning on data collection needs, sharing experiment results, and integrating models into production services. On the heads-down side, you will dig into model training runs, analyze evaluation metrics, and iterate on threshold tuning until the numbers meet the bar. Your work is roadmap-driven, giving you the space to plan experiments methodically while still responding to new framework onboarding requests as they arise.

About the team
Our team builds the AI and ML systems behind AWS Governance, Risk, & Compliance service, where science is not auxiliary — it is the core. Every customer-visible compliance result flows through models our scientists create and maintain. We are investing in next-generation capabilities including observability and governance for AI agents, and the multi-quarter Agent Context initiative is an organization-defining program that will need technical leaders.

Growth here is tangible. You will own the full model lifecycle from training through production monitoring, develop rare expertise at the intersection of ML and compliance, and have a clear path to expand your scope into technical leadership as the service scales.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of building models for business application experience
- 2+ years of programming in Java, C++, Python or related language experience
- 2+ years of hands-on predictive modeling and large data analysis experience

Preferred qualifications

- PhD in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Experience with one of the following areas: machine learning technologies, Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) or related applications
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Extensive experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment.
- Experience with building agentic systems using LLMs and familiar with common agentic framework such as Strands Agent, LangGraph, etc.
- Solid knowledge on LLM techniques and experience with LLM post-training.

title: Finance Manager, AMZL/RSR, AMZL/RSR OTR Cost
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Operations is at the heart of what we do, delivering millions of packages each day and fulfilling customer orders from all over the world. Amazon is seeking a Finance Manager to support Amazon Logistics (AMZL) and Rural Super Rural (RSR) - our expanding delivery and pickup operations, purpose-built to deliver for both Amazon customers and third-party (3P) shippers.

This Finance Manager role will focus on On-the-Road (OTR) cost and play a key role in disruptive new transportation initiatives that are changing the nature of Amazon’s supply chain and customer experience. This role will focus on defining granular cost segmentation for new and expanding commingled delivery activities, including Hub delivery partner supply runs, Multiple Modes of Transportation (MMOT, e.g. walkers and e-bikes) deliveries, Merchant Fulfillment Network (MFN) and 3P deliveries, Amazon Shipping pickups, Customer Returns pickups, and other new activities. This individual will collaborate cross-functionally to redefine how we plan and report actual productivity and OTR cost as AMZL takes on new pickup and delivery activities, and serving as a key contributor through the team's intensive quarterly and annual financial planning cycles (OP1/3YF, OP2, Q2G, Q3G, Q4G). The AMZL/RSR OTR Finance team is focused on costs associated with both Last-Mile (LM) deliveries and First-Mile (FM) pickups, supporting both tactical and strategic initiatives to provide a better customer experience and reduce overall costs. This role plays a key part in further enhancing the largest and most cost-effective delivery business in the world, offering opportunities to demonstrate financial leadership and make strategic, long-term impact.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in operational and financial planning, and they will be at the forefront of identifying scalable solutions to segment costs associated with commingled LM delivery activities, creating granular reporting that enables accurate cost allocation to partner business lines. This individual will support weekly, monthly, and quarterly financial review processes, with an emphasis on analyzing and forecasting to provide financial insights to leadership. The role requires extensive cross-functional partnership with various operations, transportation, finance, planning, and other support teams to identify and address cost opportunities across the network and improve reporting practices. This individual will contribute to business reviews, network scale initiatives, risk mitigations, and ad-hoc analysis.

The successful candidate will have a high attention to detail, unlimited curiosity, a strong passion for continuous improvement, and excellent technical skills (e.g. SQL querying, Excel modeling, AI integration). They will demonstrate strong business judgment, influence senior leaders through data-driven insights, and drive innovation in ambiguous environments. This role provides opportunities to lead the development of scalable solutions and solve difficult problems while collaborating effectively with Director and Vice President-level leaders across Amazon.
Amazon is looking for leaders with deep analytical skills and financial acumen, strong ability to partner with other teams, excellent stakeholder management skills, and an aptitude for driving initiatives with data in these quickly expanding businesses.


Key job responsibilities
- Proven ability to develop strategic relationships with operations and finance partners; you influence decisions through data-driven insights and business judgment.
- Ensure timely and accurate financial metrics, forecasts, and variance analyses are created and maintained to support business reviews, formal financial reporting, risk mitigations, and ad-hoc financial analysis, providing reliable insights that enable data-driven decisions by senior leaders.
- Partner with your team and business partners to drive continuous innovation in financial reporting, forecasting, and planning models through automation, AI integration, and process improvements that simultaneously reduce manual workload while delivering enhanced insights to senior leadership stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to root cause cost variances quickly and uncover financial drivers using data, then consult with and educate business partners on how operational decisions impact Cost to Serve (CTS).
- Expertise in collecting, analyzing and managing quantitative data to create meaningful analyses that drive cost reduction initiatives, improve financial performance, and support strategic decision-making for Last-Mile deliveries and First-Mile pickups.
- Develop and implement scalable cost segmentation and allocation methodologies for commingled delivery activities (e.g. MFN/3P deliveries, Hub delivery partner supply runs, MMOT), collaborating with planning, operations, and technology teams to redefine how these activities are planned, reported, and allocated across business lines.
- Serve as a key contributor during the team's intensive quarterly and annual financial planning cycles, managing tight timelines and ensuring accurate, complete deliverables under pressure.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- 5+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity and inclusion of our teams within the organization.

How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos). If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.
Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team!

Prime Air is seeking a highly skilled and vigilant Flight Monitor to join our dynamic team. This critical role is central to our commitment to delivering packages safely, efficiently, and reliably through our advanced drone fleet. The Flight Monitor will be responsible for real-time monitoring of drone flights, ensuring operational compliance, and maintaining the highest standards of safety and efficiency.


Key job responsibilities
• Continuously monitor the status of all active drone flights within the assigned region, utilizing our state-of-the-art monitoring systems.
• Identify and respond to any deviations from planned flight paths or operational parameters.
• Ensure all drone flights comply with regulatory requirements and company safety policies.
• Coordinate effectively with the relevant teams to implement immediate response strategies to mitigate risks and resolve situations.
• Prepare and submit detailed reports on flight activities, incidents, and anomalies. Provide feedback and insights to support continuous operational improvement.
• Utilize excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills while maintaining a high attention to detail in all tasks.
• Demonstrate strong communication and interpersonal skills while working effectively in a high-pressure environment.
• Adhere to FAA regulations and Prime Air directives and processes.


This role requires the ability to carry/lift up to 50 lbs., stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.

This role requires the ability to work any shift, including nights, weekends, and holidays

This role may require travel, up to 25% of the time

Export Control License: This position may require a deemed export control license for compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Placement is contingent on Amazon’s ability to apply for and obtain an export control license on your behalf.

This position will be subject to Department of Transportation (DOT) drug and alcohol testing if conducting safety sensitive functions as defined by the FAA. Federal law also requires Amazon to determine an applicant's DOT drug and/or alcohol testing history prior to hiring him/her into a position that would require them to conduct safety sensitive functions as defined by the FAA.


About the team
For any inquiries about the role/your application, please reach out to prime-air-hiring-support-team@amazon.com

Basic qualifications

- High School diploma or equivalent
- Travel up to 25% of the time
- FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate
- Knowledge of basic mechanical aptitude and equipment troubleshooting
- Experience working in a fast-paced, team environment
- Can demonstrate strong attention to safety and ability to follow detailed procedures

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of aviation terminology and regulations
- Experience in warehouse or logistics
- Experience in aviation, aerospace, or drone operations

descriptionHtml:
