title: Program Manager - Tester Quality & Engagement, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are looking for a Program Manager to own the quality of the beta tester experience and keep testers active and engaged across programs. In this role, you will work with beta program owners to design and run the “homework” that testers complete, own day-to-day communications with testers, provide them with support as needed to complete user journeys, and translate customer signals into product improvements. You will work across a wide set of partners—beta program leads, user research, engineering, and field operations—to make sure every tester has a clear task, a smooth experience, and a trusted channel to be heard.

Key job responsibilities
You will own tester quality and engagement end-to-end across beta programs.

On homework, you will develop, execute, and analyze the structured tasks testers complete during a program. You will design homework that produces the signal each study needs, keep it clear and achievable for testers, drive completion, and analyze the results to turn tester activity into actionable findings for program and product teams.

On the tester journey, you will own the communications that guide testers from activation through completion. You will build and maintain the communications plans and templates that keep testers informed, motivated, and on track at each stage of their journey, and you will tune messaging to lift participation and reduce drop-off.

On Slack and through email, you will be the first line of support for testers. You will own operational and enablement issues—app distribution, provisioning problems, and login credentials—resolving them quickly to keep testers unblocked while also initiating AI-led first level triage and bug reporting for any hardware or software issues

On Voice of the Tester, you will run a continuous improvement loop to improve the test experience. You will capture, synthesize, and address tester feedback, surface recurring pain points and opportunities, and drive changes to homework, communications, and support that measurably improve the tester experience over time.

Success in this role comes from strong operational execution, attention to detail, clear and empathetic communication, and the ability to coordinate many moving parts without dropping any. You will define and track the metrics that show tester quality and engagement are healthy—homework completion and quality, tester engagement and retention, and time-to-resolution on support issues —and you will continuously tighten processes as the program scales into new territories.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized program manager who is comfortable owning operational details end to end, communicates clearly with both testers and partner teams, and thrives in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. You are energized by interacting with customers and delivering high-quality experiences.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

title: Data Center Technician, ADC InfraOps DCO Tech
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Technician, you are a primary resolver for your support team, and are skilled at troubleshooting one or more operating systems. You are able to troubleshoot and solve all but the most complex infrastructure issues. Issues are escalated to the appropriate resolver groups when necessary. You create and maintain documentation on technologies you support and are able to convey SOPs to junior staff. You understand all aspects of the equipment you support. You know how to innovate and make decisions on his/her own, but also know how to take direction when it is given, paying attention to all details involved.

You are able to execute small projects on your own and work with your manager in planning and executing larger local projects. You act as an escalation point for junior technicians. You understand all aspects of the equipment you support.

Position may include rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day/night work weeks, and may change based on the needs of the business. Travel may be required up to 10% of the time. This position will fill an opening at one of multiple separate sites.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- High school or equivalent diploma, or A+ or CND (Certified Network Defender) or Network+ or Security+
- 2+ years of computer hardware experience, including troubleshooting and repairing experience
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of TCP/IP networking, network cabling, fiber, optic types, and test equipment experience
- 1+ years of data center experience

title: Manager Product Research & GTM, Program Adoption
descriptionHtml:
Work Timings - Monday to Friday;
Timings- 1 Noon to 10 PM (Day Shift)
We're looking for exceptional talent to join Amazon's Product Acceleration Team (PAT), a specialized unit that sits at the intersection of product development, seller experience, and Seller research. PAT plays a crucial role in fast-tracking product improvements through direct seller engagement, rapid research execution, and actionable insights generation.

We’re looking for an enthusiastic user experience researcher to explore the world of building amazon products and generate insights that connect product experiences to business needs. Your focus will cover all aspects of customer research, from learning more about our customers types to uncovering problems that need to be solved to usability testing new designs. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand the decisions that need to be made and then conduct research projects to gather the correct data to help make those decisions.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
* Plan and execute quantitative and qualitative research studies to shape Product roadmap. That may include large-scale surveys, usability testing, or conducting interviews. Select the right methodology, while demonstrating good judgement in making trade-offs between speed and rigor.

* Understand business needs and develop a product marketing strategy and roadmap in partnership with business and product stakeholders.

* Deliver findings that will directly address the business need, create actionable recommendations, and work with stakeholders to shape product roadmaps based on data.

* Generate insights from business analytics, as well as customer feedback. Synthesize and triangulate data from various sources to deliver insights to the business. Know when enough data has been collected to answer the question.

* Generate ideas on new or more efficient ways to drive product marketing at scale

* Partner closely with product and business teams on the full product lifecycle (customer research, ideation, proposal, launch and post-launch analysis). Develop relationships and processes to connect decision-makers to customer needs.

* Lead an extended team of Research Managers and Marketing managers to meet overall goals

* Develop weekly metrics to track critical inputs and outputs and report out in weekly business reviews


About the team
Seller Enablement Growth (SEG) specializes in driving seller adoption of new features and programs across Amazon's marketplace, working closely with product teams to gather Voice of Seller feedback, accelerate feature launches, and ensure seller success through strategic engagement and educational initiatives.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience managing teams
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional email and push marketing campaigns (including automated flows) from concept to completion
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders at various levels and in different locales to drive alignment

title: Sr. Partner Operations Manager, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
How often have you had an opportunity to be at ground zero of a disruptive, fast-growing, and revolutionary global Amazon service? How frequently do you get to start from the foundation and solve customer needs at a global scale in a fast-growing entertainment streaming industry? At Prime Video, we are pioneering a new generation of digital supply chain at a remarkable speed to accelerate our market position and global reach. If this sounds interesting, come build the future of streaming entertainment with us!

Prime Video is a global premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic and global environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. The Partner Operations Management (POM) team is looking for a bright, partner-obsessed, driven, and creative individual to join our team in India. POM is responsible for driving a world-class partner experience through enabling partners to deliver assets of all varieties on-time, in full and at the Prime Video quality bar.

As a Sr. Partner Operations Manager, you will serve as the primary relationship owner for our third-party studios, content distributors, and fulfillment vendors (collectively "partners") in India. You will build and nurture long-term, strategic partnerships — engaging studio executives to influence their supply chain investments, delivery workflows, and feature adoption strategies. You will be the voice of the partner within Prime Video, capturing partner-specific insights and regional nuance to ensure our partners succeed and our customers benefit.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end partner experience — from driving timely and cost-effective delivery of source materials to identifying improvement opportunities through reporting, data analysis, and innovative workflow enhancements. You will conduct regular partner business reviews, manage complex escalations, and tailor strategies to individual partner contexts across India's diverse content landscape (including SVOD, AVOD, TVOD,Channels, and partner direct business lines). The ability to develop, own, and report on key performance metrics is critical.
This role will work with executive-level leadership within the streaming community. Internal teams include content acquisition, marketing, engineering, content processing, legal, finance, and accounting teams. External teams vary based on partner and may include marketing, rights management, IT, engineering, localization, compliance, and digital operations teams.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned studio partners in India, building trusted executive-level relationships that influence partner investments in delivery capabilities and content quality
• Conduct trend analysis and deep dives on partner performance against KPI targets to drive perfect delivery to Prime Video
• Act as the voice of the partner — capturing partner-specific feedback, regional nuances, and operational realities to advocate for solutions that enable partner success
• Own and lead regular partner business reviews (WBRs,MBRs, QBRs), translating performance data into actionable strategies tailored to each partner's context
• Manage complex escalations that may span across multiple business units, driving resolution while maintaining strong partner relationships
• Distill insights on partner capabilities to advise and enhance business strategies such as new content and market launches in India
• Drive partner adoption of delivery best practices and new platform capabilities by tailoring strategies to individual partner needs and technical maturity
• Identify opportunities for process improvement, product development, and cost reduction through data analysis and direct partner engagement
• Drive long-term solutions through next-gen automation and AI innovations to complex workflows
• Mentor team members and help develop talent across the organization


A day in the life
• Engage directly with studio partner executives to understand their priorities, address delivery challenges, and align on strategic goals
• Lead partner performance reviews, using data-driven insights combined with partner context to identify root causes and drive improvements
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure partner feedback is heard and acted upon, influencing how Prime Video builds and evolves its tools and features
• Design workflow strategies for accelerated content delivery in multiple languages and formats across India's diverse content ecosystem, while simplifying and eliminating redundant practices
• Streamline business and technology solutions that strengthen our partnerships while advancing our services
• Work effectively in a team environment and cross-functionally with Prime Video Catalog technology teams, engineers, business teams, analytics, and product

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 7+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience, or MBA
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience building and growing relationships with internal and external partners
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- Experience negotiating with internal and external stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Knowledge of digital video landscape, including solid understanding of digital video distribution technologies
- Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
- Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience in the entertainment industry
- Experience building and maintaining relationships with business partners

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

The Data Centre Supply Solutions team, within the Data Centre Planning and Delivery team at AWS is looking for a Senior Real Estate Transaction Manager based in EMEA (London, Dublin or Madrid). In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape and execute on strategies to expand our Data Center portfolio and related infrastructure. You will help develop strategies of where we go, negotiate the business contracts and deliver the infrastructure needed to provide best in market Data Center projects.

Our Real Estate Transaction Managers;
- Have a real estate, development, business, financial, strategic and technical background that enables them to drive engagement and develop strategic alternatives from inception to conclusion.
- Have the ability to negotiate multi-million dollar contracts for real estate and infrastructure transactions.
- Have the ability to think strategically about business, market, and technical challenges with the skill to build and convey compelling value strategy plans.
- Prepare, review and negotiate financial analysis of potential deal structures.
- Have strong negotiation abilities to include legal document review and negotiation in conjunction with legal counsel.
- Are willing and able to travel roughly 25%-50% of the time both domestically and internationally.
- Have strong analytical skills with ability to provide big picture insights from multiple sources of data.
- Prioritize, manage time effectively and are self-starters.

- Develop and implement expansion strategies based on demand

title: Safety Monitoring Compliance Analyst, NAST Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's North American Surface Transportation Safety & Compliance team (NAST S&C) is looking for a Compliance Analyst to join Safety Monitoring. Safety Monitoring assesses carrier safety performance against Amazon's standards. We use FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS) data and Amazon's Violation Rate Metrics (VRM), and we take action when a carrier falls below the standard.
This role can be assigned to third-party (3P) carrier monitoring or to monitoring for Amazon's own fleet, Transportation Operations Management (TOM). The core work is the same in both. You will run recurring monitoring steps on a fixed schedule, pull and validate data, keep every case record current, and report results. The work follows written procedures and thresholds. Each result can drive an enforcement or safety action, so you will check the data before it moves. You will report to the Safety Monitoring manager and escalate anything that falls outside the procedure.


Key job responsibilities
Pull safety data from FMCSA SMS and internal sources on the monthly schedule.

Validate every record against source data before it goes out, reconciling counts, spot-checking individual records, and documenting each check.

Maintain SIM and Asana so the current status of every case lives in one place.

Prepare recurring metrics for business reviews, including suspension and reinstatement counts, exception outcomes, inspection results, and cycle timeliness.

Maintain procedure documents and recommend process improvements.

Escalate data discrepancies, new case types, and anything with possible legal exposure.

Prepare the monthly BASICs and VRM suspension and reinstatement lists against the written thresholds.

Log carrier exception requests, build each case file against the written criteria, and present cases at the weekly exception review.

Record every review decision as granted, denied, or pending final review.

Submit suspension and reinstatement tickets to Carrier Health and confirm they are actioned.

Send carrier notifications from approved templates once a decision is recorded, answer carrier questions about their status, and route anything outside the templates to your manager.

Monitor carriers under review each week for new violations, out-of-service events, and safety rating changes.

Run the same monitoring steps for Amazon's own fleet, tracking roadside inspection results, out-of-service events, violations, and BASICs results for TOM.

Report trends and open items to TOM safety and operations leaders on a set schedule.

Flag changes that need attention, such as a rising violation rate or a new out-of-service event, to your manager and TOM safety leaders.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of professional or military experience

title: Senior Applied Scientist, PV Ads Science
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!



Key job responsibilities
The science challenges include:
- Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time.
- Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals.
- Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles.
- Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies.
- Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric.

A day in the life
- Lead the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind
- Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale
- Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization
- Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements
- Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions
- Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions


About the team
Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability

title: Safety Technician
descriptionHtml:
Ensuring the safety and well-being of our associates at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in this area. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop within an international company. You will work closely with our experts to monitor your site, allowing you to see the impact of your work on everyone's well-being every day.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct risk assessments and audits.
- Monitor the site to ensure processes comply with Amazon's safety procedures.
- Create and update reports on safety metrics for colleagues.
- Collaborate with operations and other departments on safety-related tasks and provide process advice.
- Support the implementation of new safety measures.

A day in the life
You will work at one of our sites. This means you can closely follow what's happening and associates can easily approach you with questions during their shifts. This role is all about spotting potential problems before they occur. You will spend a lot of time checking the site and understanding how associates use equipment. By understanding how each task and machine works, you will be able to find the best way to ensure processes are safe. You will also be one of the people implementing safety changes, which means you will work closely with many people. In addition to your daily and weekly tasks, you will support our Operations team on one-off safety-related assignments. Safety is paramount at Amazon, and you will help us collect essential data that allows us to control our processes and anticipate problems. You will also share this data with company teams and collaborate with other departments to ensure safety remains the priority.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays an essential role in ensuring the mental and physical well-being of our associates at work. Our team works with managers, associates, and local authorities across all our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing safe work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Program Managers. Whatever your role, you will contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the network.

Basic qualifications

- Level 3 qualification in occupational safety or equivalent.
- Relevant experience using data analysis to generate and explain metrics.
- Knowledge of Belgian health and safety legislation.
- Fluent English and Dutch or French proficiency (A2), spoken and written.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.
- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies.
- Experience planning or managing environmentally conscious initiatives.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

title: HR Business Partner, PXT
descriptionHtml:
Was wäre, wenn deine Arbeit den Alltag von Tausenden von Menschen positiv verändern könnte? Bei Amazon tut unser People eXperience and Technology (PXT) Team genau das — wir gestalten eine Arbeitskultur, in der sich jeder Mensch sicher, einbezogen und befähigt fühlt, sein Bestes zu geben.



Als HR Business Partner:in stehst du im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission. Dies ist eine praxisnahe Individual-Contributor-Rolle — ohne direkte Personalverantwortung — in der du in direkter Partnerschaft mit den Führungsteams deiner Standorte echten, sichtbaren Einfluss erzielst. Du überführst organisatorische Prioritäten in konkrete Maßnahmen, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und arbeitest Seite an Seite mit den Campus-Führungskräften, um das Mitarbeitererlebnis kontinuierlich zu verbessern.



Du verantwortest das End-to-End-Mitarbeitererlebnis an deinen Standorten: von Feedback-Mechanismen und Anerkennungsprogrammen bis hin zu Arbeitsplatzstandards, die Vertrauen schaffen, Engagement fördern und Leistung nachhaltig steigern. Diese Rolle ist standortbasiert und umfasst regelmäßige Mobilität zwischen mehreren Standorten innerhalb deines regionalen Campus.

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement

- Förderung einer offenen Zwei-Wege-Kommunikation zwischen Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften durch Instrumente wie Voice of the Associate, Rundtischgespräche und GEMBA-Walks

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Engagement-Strategien und Anerkennungsprogrammen, die Mitarbeitende spürbar wertschätzen

- Schaffung eines Umfelds, in dem sich alle Mitarbeitenden sicher, gehört und einbezogen fühlen

- Regelmäßige und sichtbare Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche — frühzeitige Anzeichen von Desengagement erkennen und aktiv darauf reagieren



Operational Excellence & Standortstandards

- Regelmäßige Standortbegehungen zur Bewertung der Arbeitsbedingungen und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Amazon-Standards

- Zusammenarbeit mit Standortleitungen und Safety-Teams, um Sicherheitsprogramme an deinen Standorten konsequent umzusetzen

- Leitung von Community-Initiativen an deinen Standorten in Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Netzwerk sowie den Teams für Public Policy und Public Relations

- Steigerung der Standorteffektivität durch die Identifikation systemischer Muster, Behebung von Ursachen und konsequente, faire Anwendung von Richtlinien



Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung & Technologie

- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um aufkommende Trends zu erkennen, Herausforderungen frühzeitig zu antizipieren und proaktive Lösungen umzusetzen

- Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen, KI-Tools und Self-Service-Plattformen — bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung eines persönlichen Service in entscheidenden Momenten



Strategische PXT-Führung

- Partnerschaft mit der Standortleitung, um operative Anforderungen mit Amazons Werten und Personalstrategie in Einklang zu bringen

- Coaching von Business Leaders zu effektiven Personalmanagement-Praktiken — einschließlich Leistungsfeedback, Teamentwicklung und Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen

- Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen durch Verstärkung von Botschaften, Abbau von Widerständen und Begleitung von Führungskräften bei der Übertragung von Veränderungen in lokale Routinen

- Umsetzung zentraler PXT-Prozesse unter Aufbau von Vertrauen und Einfluss durch fundiertes unternehmerisches Denken

A day in the life
Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen — und genau das macht diese Rolle so spannend. Dein Arbeitsalltag ist eine dynamische Mischung aus strategischem Denken und praktischer Problemlösung. Du nutzt fortgeschrittene Analysen und KI-gestützte Tools, um Trends zu erkennen, die Bedürfnisse deiner Standorte zu antizipieren und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die das Arbeitsplatzerlebnis wirklich verbessern.



Vom Coaching der Führungsteams bis hin zur Förderung von HR-Prozessexzellenz arbeitest du eng mit Field Leaders an operativen Zielen und der Effektivität des Teams zusammen. Du verbringst wertvolle Zeit auf der Betriebsfläche — baust Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen auf, führst Standortbegehungen durch, moderierst Mitarbeiter-Feedback-Runden und leitest strategische Initiativen, die nachhaltige Verbesserungen schaffen.



Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt von deiner Fähigkeit ab, organisatorische Dynamiken zu navigieren, Veränderungsinitiativen zu leiten und in unklaren Situationen fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Durch unternehmerisches Denken, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und starke Partnerschaften trägst du dazu bei, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich alle Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen.

About the team
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) ist das Team hinter der „letzten Meile“ — dem letzten Schritt, der Pakete in die Hände unserer Kundinnen und Kunden bringt. In Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferpartnern verbinden wir kreatives Denken mit kontinuierlicher Verbesserung, um täglich Millionen von Produkten zuzustellen. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten und gleichzeitig globale Lösungen für Konzepte wie Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants voranzutreiben.

- Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation

title: Data Center Infrastructure Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
Transform the backbone of digital infrastructure by leading a dynamic team that builds and maintains the critical networks powering global technology. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence, optimize data center deployment strategies, and create seamless connectivity solutions that support Amazon's massive technological ecosystem.

The Infrastructure Delivery Manager will manage the implementation and delivery of inbound capacity and equipment. This manager will be responsible for a growing team and will oversee their development and growth. The successful candidate will have experience managing and mentoring people, tracking budgets, providing strategic direction, and proposing technical solutions. This manager will ultimately be responsible for installing and delivering our network equipment and related infrastructures, as well as responsible for driving low voltage structured cabling across the Amazon data center platform.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

This role will be physically based at our new MDD Pecos, TX site.

Key job responsibilities
Prioritize and assign tasks to data center technicians and operators, project management, coaching, and creating documentation.
Manage inbound capacity from receiving through deployment stages
Manage the installation network and cabling infrastructure in a data center environment
Guide, train and educate staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
Manage tasks and deliverables across small to large-size projects
Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures to meet industry best practices and to meet required SLAs
Provide weekly report to the data center manager
Coordinate team resources to support project and delivery needs, including emergency projects, change management and maintenance window support, and potential off-hours and on-call needs.
Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
Host weekly staff meetings
Drive compliance to Amazon performance management requirements

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of people management experience
- 4+ years of experience in a data center technology role and/or 4+ years of knowledge in TCP/IP networking, network cabling, fiber, optic types, and test equipment

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience in an IT-related field (e.g. computer science, network engineering, etc.)
- Understanding of networking infrastructure topology
- Certifications in a relevant field (CCENT, Network+, CCNA)
- Behavioral interviewing and hiring experience
- Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.
- Experience with fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment & troubleshooting methodologies
- Experience contributing to the definition and implementation of automation opportunities within an operations environment

descriptionHtml:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.

About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

title: Principal Product Manager, Freight Express, Amazon Supply Chain Services
descriptionHtml:
You are a Principal Product Manager who has owned product at scale inside complex, rapidly growing organizations the kind of environment where the hardest part is not shipping features, but setting a durable product direction that senior leaders and multiple teams align to. You think in systems and economics, you are relied on to be right a lot, and you have a track record of turning a messy, multi-dependency problem into a single product that customers choose.

You bring deep analytical judgment you are comfortable diving into unit economics, reliability and performance data, and the cost and margin structure of a product, and you use that insight to decide where to place the long-term bets. You are equally strong at influencing across organizations without direct authority, aligning operations, network, commercial, finance, compliance, and engineering leaders behind one plan, and engaging senior leadership to secure investment and drive high-stakes decisions.

The domain for this role is Freight Express at Amazon Air Cargo how Amazon moves freight gateway-to-gateway, extends it into a true door-to-door experience, and connects international lanes into the domestic network across the US and EU. Deep freight, transportation, or logistics experience is a strong plus, but it is not the gate. If you have operated a product at scale, reason fluently from data and economics, and have influenced broadly across a large organization, we want to talk to you we will bring you up the domain curve.

The Product: Freight Express
Freight Express spans three connected layers. The opportunity is to define a single, coherent product promise across all of them — not a stack of disconnected legs.

Gateway-to-gateway — the existing Amazon Air Cargo airport-to-airport experience, from booking through air movement to arrival.
End-to-end with ground — extend the product into a door-to-door experience by integrating first-mile and last-mile ground into a single, reliable freight offering.

International — enable international lanes to feed into the domestic Freight Express network, connecting cross-border origins into the end-to-end product.

You will own the Freight Express product experience across both the US and EU, accounting for the regulatory, operational, and commercial differences between regions while holding a consistent product bar — deciding where the product converges across regions and where it must adapt.



Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end product strategy for Freight Express and define the product customer-back across all three layers. Make the hard trade-offs between operational feasibility and customer experience, decide when to build versus influence a platform or operations team’s roadmap, and ensure capabilities land in the right long-term home. Set strategy that other senior leaders and teams align to.

Deep-dive the data and economics:
Instrument the product and define success metrics up front, then dive deep into lane economics, transit-time and connection reliability, first- and last-mile ground performance, customs and cross-border delays, and the cost and margin structure of the end-to-end product. Measure actual performance against the product promise and the business case, identify the highest-impact quality gaps from the data (connection misses, ground exceptions, customs delays, failure modes), and feed them back into the product and network.

Influence and lead across organizations:
Drive alignment across air gateway operations, ground first/last-mile carriers, international and customs operations, commercial, finance, compliance, and engineering — across the US and EU, without direct authority. Translate hard operational constraints (gateway cutoffs, ground pickup/delivery timing, cross-border clearance) into a single recommended path, eliminate fragmented ownership and missed handoffs across the air-to-ground and international-to-domestic seams, and unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations.

Own the full product lifecycle and quality:
Run the product cycle end to end — product definition and strategy, capability enhancement that closes gaps across the air and ground legs and the international feed, performance measurement, and continuous quality improvement. Continuously evolve the product based on customer feedback, operational quality and cost, and P&L outcomes.


A day in the life
Set the strategic direction for the Freight Express product across teams — aligning air, ground, international, commercial, and engineering around one gateway-to-gateway-to-door product definition.
Deep dive into data (lane economics, connection and on-time performance, ground first/last-mile reliability, customs and cross-border delays, customer feedback) to shape the roadmap and decide where to invest for maximum reliability and margin impact.

Run the product cycle end to end — move initiatives from strategy to requirements to capability launch, then measure outcomes, surface quality gaps, and feed them back into the next iteration.
Partner with engineering and operations leaders across the US and EU to shape network and product design, ensuring the product scales and holds its service promise in both regions.

Unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations; frame program narratives for senior leadership — connecting network and product progress to business outcomes.
Spend time with Ops teams and in the network — air gateways and ground legs — to pressure-test whether the product performs for shippers in the real world.

What this takes
Someone who toggles between deep product and operational insight and strategic product leadership — owning the full product cycle across air and ground, domestic and international, US and EU — and turning a complex multi-modal, multi-region network into a single reliable Freight Express product that shippers choose.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- 10+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner

Preferred qualifications

- Experience owning technology products

title: Software Engineer II - AI/ML, Neuron Inference, Neuron Inference
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.

The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. We not only optimize performance on open weight models but also contribute to future architecture designs and work closely with customers to enable optimal performance on their models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

As a Software Engineer II - AI/ML, you will design and implement business-critical features and own the performance of models on AWS Trainium end to end. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team also collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

This role is responsible for development, enablement, and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive-scale large language models like the GLM, GPT-OSS, Kimi, and beyond. The Model Enablement team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build, and tune distributed inference solutions with AWS Trainium.

You can learn more about Neuron:

* https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/index.html
* https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
* https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-neuron
* https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

Are you passionate about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will design, build, and maintain systems that solve complex problems while delivering meaningful results. You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from working backwards from customer needs to designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and operating production software. This role offers the opportunity to tackle challenging technical problems, collaborate with talented engineers, and grow your skills while making a real impact. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on turning ambiguity into clarity and shipping high-quality code, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
This role contributes to building distributed inference support for PyTorch in the Neuron SDK, and tunes models to ensure the highest performance and maximize efficiency running on AWS Trainium. Strong software development in Python, system-level programming, and ML knowledge are all critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models and frameworks for deployment on custom ML hardware accelerators.
* Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle, including distributed-computing-based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, hardware-specific optimizations, testing, and production deployment.
* Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architectures.
* Understand and produce NKI (Neuron Kernel Interface) kernels, and design and implement high-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models.
* Analyze and optimize system-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware, using knowledge of the underlying Trainium hardware architecture to guide optimization decisions.
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling.
* Conduct comprehensive testing, including unit and end-to-end model testing with continuous deployment and releases through pipelines.
* Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators.
* Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques, and share proposals, findings, and learnings with internal developers and external customers via high-quality designs and documentation.


A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, systems engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and contributing to the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you'll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.

You will also build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions and code reviews, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup-like development environment, where you're always working on the most important initiative.You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts from the systems you own. From there, you might dive into designing a new feature, writing and reviewing code, or pairing with a teammate to debug a tricky issue. You will participate in design discussions, contribute to sprint planning, and document your systems so that others can learn from and extend your work. Expect regular collaboration with product and engineering partners as you shape solutions that serve customers at scale.

About the team
The Model Enablement team fosters a builder's culture where experimentation is encouraged and impact is measurable. We emphasize collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop their engineering expertise so they feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Join us to solve some of the most interesting and impactful infrastructure challenges in AI/ML today.Our team builds and operates software that powers key experiences for Amazon customers. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer on the team has a voice in shaping our technical direction and the opportunity to mentor others. We are focused on building reliable, scalable systems while creating an inclusive environment where engineers at all levels can learn, grow, and do their best work. If you want to solve meaningful problems alongside a supportive and motivated group of engineers, this is the place for you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of Python and/or C++ programming

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
- Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference
- Experience with CUDA kernels or ML/low-level kernels
- Knowledge of syntax and tile-level semantics similar to Triton
- Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT or similar platforms in production environments
- Experience with PyTorch, JIT compilation, and AOT tracing

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. title: Product Manager - Learning Experience Designer, Amazon Stores Learning & Development (ASLD)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Stores Learning & Development (ASLD) is looking for a Learning Experience Designer (LXD) to design and develop learning experiences that build critical capabilities across Amazon Stores. This role owns the end-to-end design of learning solutions — from understanding the business problem and learner need through design, development, launch, and evaluation.

You’ll partner with business leaders, subject matter experts, program and product managers, and other learning professionals to turn complex business challenges into practical learning experiences. The work spans self-guided and instructor-led learning, simulations, performance support, and AI-enabled learning solutions designed to help employees build and apply new skills.

The right candidate combines strong learning design and development skills with curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to experiment. You should be comfortable working through ambiguity, simplifying complex topics, building learning content directly, and using data and learner feedback to improve your work.

This role supports a global learning portfolio that evolves alongside the business. We’re looking for someone who can think beyond individual courses or training events and design experiences that are practical, scalable, and built around how employees actually learn and work.

Key job responsibilities
- Learning Design & Development: Own learning solutions from needs analysis through design, development, launch, and evaluation. Design self-guided, instructor-led, blended, simulation-based, and other applied learning experiences.
- Content Development: Create high-quality learning materials including digital modules, scripts, videos, assessments, facilitator and discussion guides, performance support, and other resources that help employees apply new skills on the job.
- Learning Portfolio Management: Manage and continuously improve a portfolio of 300+ digital courses and resources serving a global audience, ensuring content remains accurate and aligned with evolving business, legal, retail, marketing, and tool requirements.
- Learning Strategy: Develop learning approaches for organization-wide capability priorities, including AI fluency, emerging tools, and business and technical skills. Partner with business leaders and SMEs to identify performance gaps and determine the right learning approach.
- Learner Experience & Innovation: Use learner research, prototyping, A/B testing, AI, and emerging technologies to test and improve how employees learn and practice new skills. Translate findings into scalable design practices and standards.
- Measurement & Evaluation: Use learner feedback, learning data, business metrics, and evaluation frameworks to assess effectiveness and inform improvements.
- Learning Technology: Manage course deployment and the learner experience within learning platforms. Partner with technical teams to investigate and resolve issues affecting access, completion, learner records, or platform functionality.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work across SMEs, program and product managers, Legal, HR, and business leaders to translate complex business needs into practical learning solutions and keep learning aligned with changing priorities.
- Onboarding & Change Support: Design role-specific learning and performance support for onboarding, organizational changes, new tools, and evolving ways of working.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing customer feedback and usage data to spot trends and inform your priorities for the day. From there, you might join a design review to evaluate prototypes, then shift into a working session with engineers to refine requirements for an upcoming launch. Expect to write and review product documents, participate in planning discussions, and connect directly with customers through research sessions to validate that what you are building meets their actual needs.

- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services

title: InfraOps Support Engineer, Operations Management Center (OMC)
descriptionHtml:
The InfraOps Support Engineer is a Tier 1 support engineer in Amazon's Operations Management Center (OMC) - a 24/7/365 team that keeps the technology inside Amazon's 400+ corporate office buildings running across Networking, Audio-Visual (AV), and Print services. This engineer is the first line of response for office-infrastructure incidents.

Operating within the Amazon Support Engineer (SupEng) job family, the engineer provides high-quality support across all three service areas while beginning to develop deep subject-matter expertise in one or more focus areas, for which they become the technical point of contact on their team. They respond, triage and resolve incidents within target times using established procedures, detect trends before they become problems, contribute to and refine the team's operating procedures, and mentor more junior engineers. Success requires the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, shift-based environment.

Key job responsibilities
On a typical shift, an InfraOps Support Engineer will:

1. Monitor, Detect & Triage

Be the first line of response and keep ahead of problems.

Triage incoming incidents (tickets) within defined target response times, using judgment to resolve in place or route to the responsible team.

Use dashboards, alarms, and other tools for Networking, AV, and Print services across the global building fleet, interpreting what those signals indicate to solve incidents.

Detect ongoing trends or emerging problems before they occur and define proactive actions to prevent customer impact.

Assess incident scope and severity, correlate related incidents into a single parent incident, and prioritise work against SLAs.

2. Troubleshoot & Support

Resolve issues and support the team's products and systems.

Provide high-quality Tier 1 support for the products and systems in the team's scope, resolving straightforward problems with limited documentation and minimal escalation.

Support critical issues using existing runbooks; maintain composure through difficult interactions until the issue is resolved.

Perform on-call duties on a rotating schedule and respond to emergent events.

Escalate appropriately when resolution requires significant deviation from procedure or when an issue becomes a risk.

3. Subject-Matter Expertise & Technical Leadership

Grow into the go-to person for a focus area.

Develop and apply expertise in one or more focus areas (e.g., Networking, AV, or Print), acting as the technical point of contact for that area within the team.

Give technical direction to others and impart knowledge to users, customers, and teammates.

Lead internal team projects and deliver on defined goals and timelines.

4. Documentation & Operational Improvement

Improve how the team operates.

Identify areas to improve support documentation and processes, and author new runbooks/SOPs and knowledge-base articles where gaps exist.

Identify improvements to existing and new support tools that increase operational efficiency, and help drive their implementation.

Help develop and refine the operational policies and procedures used by the team.

5. Mentoring & Collaboration

Raise the bar for the team.

Serve as a mentor to junior engineers and act as a training buddy for new hires; may assist in hiring activities.

Maintain good working relationships across Amazon and work cross-functionally with partner teams to solve problems and improve processes.

Communicate infrastructure health and trends clearly, both in real time and as inputs to weekly/monthly business reviews.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with Windows server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience in IT client, server, and network service delivery
- Experience with networking technology (TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS and DHCP)
- Experience supporting Windows, Mac and/or Linux operating systems in a corporate setting
- Experience working in large-scale networking environments
- High school diploma, or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in computer networking
- Experience in network and operating system support
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP

descriptionHtml:
