title: IMDb Policy Manager, IMDb
descriptionHtml:
IMDb is the world's most popular source for movie, TV, and celebrity content, reaching an audience of more than 250 million unique visitors per month. We're looking for a Senior Policy Program Manager to join IMDb's Content Operations team and own the full lifecycle of content policy — from creation and versioning through to enforcement and machine-interpretability.

In this role, you'll be the dedicated owner of IMDb's policy framework, ensuring that our policies are clearly authored, properly versioned, consistently enforced, and structured for machine consumption by our automated moderation systems. You'll define and maintain the policy store and tag definitions that power IMDb's multi-layered moderation architecture. This role requires someone who can navigate ambiguity, drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Legal, PR, and Operations, and deliver measurable improvements to policy coverage and enforcement accuracy at scale.

The most successful candidate will think strategically about how policy decisions impact hundreds of millions of users, while diving deep into the technical details of how policies are codified and interpreted by automated systems.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end policy creation, versioning and publication across IMDb's content ecosystem, managing the full lifecycle from identification of need through stakeholder sign-off to implementation.
• Design and maintain the policy store authoring framework and tags that enables policies to be machine-readable and enforceable by automated moderation systems.
• Drive cross-functional collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Legal, PR, Risk Management, and Operations to ensure policies are comprehensive, compliant, and implementable.
• Define program strategy for policy governance, including prioritization frameworks, SLA tracking, and metrics to measure policy effectiveness and enforcement accuracy.
• Present policy risks, recommendations, and program updates to Directors and VPs, building consensus across discordant views and securing resources for policy initiatives.
• Identify and drive process improvements to streamline policy workflows, reduce time-to-enforcement, and eliminate redundant or conflicting policies across the organization.
• Identify new trends in the entertainment industry and develop new policies to support them.

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing policy effectiveness metrics and enforcement signals, identifying where gaps or inconsistencies exist between policy intent and automated enforcement. You might spend the morning drafting a new policy in response to an emerging content challenge, working through the stakeholder review process with Legal and PR. In the afternoon, you could be partnering with Engineering to refine how a policy is codified for machine interpretation, ensuring the tag definitions and rule configurations accurately reflect the policy's intent. You'll regularly present to senior leadership on policy program health, upcoming changes, and strategic direction.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Knowledge of general AI tools

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading process improvements

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Security is seeking a Vulnerability Management Analyst to identify, assess, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities across information systems supporting a high-priority U.S. Government program.

In this role, you will develop and maintain the vulnerability management plan, sustain an accurate asset inventory, and establish a disciplined patching cadence across the platform. You will run periodic security scans, analyze and prioritize findings by risk, and drive resolution of Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVAs) to closure. Working alongside the Information System Security Manager (ISSM), platform build and engineering teams, and U.S. Government counterparts, you will ensure vulnerabilities are tracked, reported, and remediated in a timely manner. You will also maintain the System Security Plan (SSP) as it relates to vulnerability and patch management, support audit review, and help sustain a valid Authorization to Operate (ATO).

This position requires U.S. Citizenship and an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the vulnerability management plan and supporting documentation.
- Build and sustain an accurate, comprehensive asset inventory as the basis for vulnerability coverage.
- Establish and enforce a patching cadence, coordinating with platform and engineering teams to remediate on schedule.
- Conduct periodic vulnerability scans, validate results, and prioritize findings by risk and operational impact.
- Drive resolution of Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVAs) from identification through closure.
- Track remediation to completion and report status to the ISSM and U.S. Government counterparts.
- Maintain the System Security Plan (SSP) as it pertains to vulnerability and patch management.
- Support periodic audit review and respond to ad hoc security inquiries from government stakeholders.
- Contribute to the development and refinement of scanning, reporting, and remediation processes and automation to improve efficiency.
- Help sustain a valid Authorization to Operate (ATO) by ensuring continuous vulnerability management.

A day in the life
Your day starts with the latest scan results. You review new findings, prioritize them by risk and operational impact, and update the asset inventory so nothing falls outside coverage. You work with platform and engineering teams to schedule patches against the cadence, then drive an open IAVA toward closure, tracking remediation until it is verified. Midday, you refresh the vulnerability management plan and update the SSP to reflect current patch posture. You report status to the ISSM and your Government counterparts, field an audit inquiry, and refine a scan report. Every action you take keeps the system covered, documented, and holding a valid ATO.

title: Solutions Architect Senior Manager, Mexico Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
As Senior Manager of Solutions Architecture for AWS Public Sector Mexico, you will lead a team of Solutions Architects who work side-by-side with government and institutional leaders to turn complex technical challenges into real outcomes. You will own the technical strategy for the portfolio: setting priorities, building executive relationships, and making sure AWS shows up with the right architecture for every mission-critical program.

This isn't a behind-the-scenes role. You will sit across the table from CIOs, CTOs, and CDOs at federal agencies and state governments. You will represent AWS at government forums and industry events. You will push our product teams to build what Mexico's public sector actually needs — from data sovereignty to local compliance to AI-ready infrastructure. And you will build and grow the team that makes it all happen.

We're looking for someone who has done this before: led technical teams, earned trust with senior government stakeholders, and delivered cloud and AI strategies that moved the needle. Someone who writes and speaks with authority on where technology is going — and brings others along. Someone who knows that the best architectures start with listening to the customer, not with a slide deck.

Key job responsibilities
- Be the technical executive sponsor for our most strategic public sector accounts and programs in Mexico — the person our customers trust to solve their hardest problems.

- Develop direct, lasting partnerships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and Directors of IT across federal agencies, state governments, public universities, and healthcare institutions.

- Speak at government technology forums, industry conferences, and executive events across Mexico and Latin America. Write and publish thought leadership on cloud, AI, and digital government.

- Set and execute the strategy that moves Mexico's public sector toward cloud-native and AI-first architectures — with measurable results.

- Partner with Sales leadership to jointly own pipeline and win rate for the Mexico Public Sector segment.

- Bring the voice of Mexico's government customers into AWS product and engineering teams — data sovereignty, regulatory compliance, local infrastructure.

- Coordinate across Sales, Professional Services, Partners, and Training to make sure the entire organization moves together for Public Sector Mexico.

title: Shipper Success Specialist (French), Amazon Shipping Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's mission is to be Earth's most customer-centric company, and Amazon Shipping exemplifies this commitment. As a shipping service provider supporting e-commerce businesses, we offer competitive rates and delivery speeds without compromising on customer obsession. The Amazon Shipping team drives strategic innovation to transform the shipping experience for our business partners. We leverage Amazon's core strengths in logistics excellence, flexible delivery options, and end-to-end visibility to create competitive advantages for our enterprise shippers. We play a critical role in listening to shippers and escalating pain points, enabling Amazon to improve and deliver world-class service while building a scalable and profitable network that brings value to both our customers and Amazon. Our team's dedication to service reliability and innovation directly supports our global tenets of maximizing existing technology while providing value-based pricing that works for shippers and Amazon alike.

As a Shipper Success Specialist in San Jose, Costa Rica, you will be at the forefront of supporting our enterprise shippers, handling complex inquiries and escalations while delivering solutions that optimize their shipping operations. You will be responsible for resolving shipper issues, identifying trends, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the overall shipper experience.


Key job responsibilities
- Provide high-touch support to enterprise shippers, resolving day-to-day inquiries and complex escalations with high standards and sense of urgency
- Advocate for shippers by escalating critical issues when necessary and following through until resolution
- Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Amazon Shipping services, policies, and procedures to effectively address shipper concerns
- Analyze shipper issues, identify root causes, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement effective solutions and ensure a seamless shipper experience
- Document shipper pain points and provide insights to leadership that inform product and process improvements
- Create and maintain internal knowledge resources to support team consistency and education
- Track and report on key performance metrics while continuously seeking ways to improve service quality


About the team
Amazon Shipping is a customer-obsessed delivery service that serves Shippers (vendors, sellers) who ship their items either into Amazon buildings or to non-Amazon destinations. The Enterprise Shipper Support team's main mission is to provide best-in-class customer service to our Shippers. We are a metrics-focused organization who keep raising the bar on shipper-facing performance.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Italian
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience with analytical, sales, and productivity tools including Oracle Business Intelligence, Salesforce, Microsoft Office Suites, Microsoft OneNote, and Microsoft SharePoint
- Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels
- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- 1+ years of using a CRM (Customer Relationship Management) tool experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish and English at C1 level or above
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- Experience with startups or large enterprise customers
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, DSL
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.


Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:
- Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
- Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
- Upholding company values and respecting every customer
- Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
- Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
- Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
- Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
- Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
- Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule

Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
- Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
- Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
- Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.


About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.

Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- Experience in Customer Service
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- Experience prioritizing and managing time effectively in dynamic environments
- Familiarity with multiple web browsers, data base searching and instant messenger tools

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience working on a merchandising/brand ambassador team for a nationally recognized consumer brand

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities
- Independently assess and administer first aid to Amazon Associates for both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses.
- Refer AAs to outside medical providers when injuries or conditions exceed onsite care capabilities.
- Minimize associate risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement on the operations floor.
- Coordinate and manage the workers' compensation and return-to-work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Collaborate with the WHS team to implement the Amazon Global WHS Program.
- Attend weekly associate safety committee meetings and participate in weekly case management review meetings.
- Greet and engage all new hires during New Hire Orientation or through daily one-on-one interactions to promote health and wellness awareness.
- Coach AAs and site leadership on observed at-risk work habits through regular floor engagement.
- Maintain accurate records of all care provided and submit daily activity logs and end-of-shift reports.
- Ensure appropriate medical supply inventory levels and maintain a clean, organized work environment.
- Facilitate and maintain certifications for first aid, CPR, and AED classes.
- Support emergency response protocols and deliver effective care during site emergencies.
- Facilitate drug testing protocols as required.
- Work flexible shifts, including days, nights, holidays, and weekends.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities

- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

- Technical writing to support change management program

- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

- Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

title: Principal Security SA, AWS Industries Tech, Security Specialists
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to solve the hardest security challenges behind the world's most ambitious innovations? Join AWS as a Principal Security Solutions Architect and become the advisor that industry-leading organizations rely on to move faster and safer in the AI era, against a threat landscape that reinvents itself every day.

Our team is dedicated to the world's largest and most recognized enterprises - the organizations whose innovations define their industries - and you will be part of the group that supports them directly. The toughest, highest-stakes security problems are the ones standing between their boldest ideas and real-world impact, and that is where you come in. You turn security, risk, and compliance into an accelerator for innovation rather than a barrier to it, helping customers adopt AWS - including AI specific solutions - securely, modernize their security capabilities and practices, and help customers defend against emerging threats. You'll be the trusted advisor who owns multiple CISO relationships and earns a place on their speed dial, sitting shoulder to shoulder with the business and technology decision makers at these organizations to turn their hardest problems into outcomes that move their industry forward. Internally, you'll be recognized as a key thought leader and influence how AWS shapes its platform to meet the evolving needs of our customers - raising their security bar while enabling them to move faster and safer.

This role supports our largest customers in the telecommunications industry, so an interest in or exposure to that space is a welcome bonus, though it is the security and AI expertise you bring that matters most.

If you love solving hard problems, want your work to matter, and get energy from helping others succeed, this is a place to do the best work of your career.

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Security Solutions Architect, you will:

- Serve as the trusted security advisor to the customers you support, owning relationships with CISOs and other senior business and technology decision makers
- Operate in ambiguous, first-of-their-kind situations where no established playbook exists, bringing clarity and creating the approach others will follow
- Decompose your customers' hardest security, risk, and compliance problems into clear architectures they can confidently implement
- Think big and drive security change at industry scale, shaping how entire sectors - not just individual customers - adopt and secure emerging technology
- Advise on securing AI workloads, from protecting sensitive data to safely adopting new generative and agentic capabilities
- Help customers stay ahead of a fast-changing threat landscape and strengthen their defenses against emerging threats
- Operate with a high degree of independence, setting your own direction and delivering strategic outcomes with minimal guidance
- Create reusable guidance, reference architectures, and best practices that scale your impact far beyond any single engagement
- Advocate for your customers by channeling their needs and emerging trends into the AWS services roadmap
- Establish thought leadership, inside AWS and publicly, through writing, speaking, and engagement with the broader security community

A day in the life
No two days look the same. One morning you might be deep in a working session with a customer's security architects, untangling a thorny compliance question that's been holding up a major launch. By the afternoon you're in front of a CISO, helping them think through how to safely adopt AI without slowing their teams down. In between, you're comparing notes with other security advisors, sharing a pattern you developed, and flagging a customer trend to the AWS service teams who can act on it. Some days you're writing or speaking; every day you're making security a little easier for the people who depend on it.



About the team
We are a team of security advisors to the world's largest and most recognized enterprises, and our mission is simple: make security the thing that helps our customers move faster and safer, not the thing that slows them down. We work alongside each other and with teams across AWS - service owners, account teams, and industry specialists - to solve problems no one has a playbook for yet. Our culture runs on trust, deep technical curiosity, and a bias for sharing what we learn so the whole organization gets better (raising the bar for all customers). We have each other's backs, we take real ownership of our customers' hardest challenges, and we care as much about building each other up as we do about the work itself.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Strategic Sourcing Specialist, Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
Are you a Strategic Sourcing superstar looking to make a big impact? As Amazon rapidly becomes the world's largest consumer of corporate services, our Global Corporate Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Specialist to join us in Arlington, VA. Strategic Sourcing Specialists independently own one or more sourcing categories and manage strategic sourcing engagements as a central team supporting a wide range of Amazon and subsidiary business units. In this pivotal role, you'll design innovative sourcing strategies and lead sourcing engagements across a wide range of business units, owning and delivering against assigned spend and savings targets. Your mission? Improve performance, optimize efficiency, ensure top-notch quality, and enable new initiatives to launch and scale with lightning speed. Demonstrating a passionate commitment to procurement excellence, you will flawlessly handle and execute sourcing initiatives, communicating efficiently and effectively with stakeholders across various business units, regions, and categories, and presenting your recommendations to senior leaders. Adept at juggling multiple priorities, you will thrive in the fast-paced, dynamic environment, contributing to both short-term tactical and long-term strategic efforts. Does this sound like your next great challenge? If you're passionate about finding the right products, goods and services at the right time from the right suppliers, we want to hear from you. Come join our fast-paced, innovative team and help Amazon make history in Corporate Procurement. Apply today!

Key job responsibilities
As a Strategic Sourcing Specialist, you will independently manage semi-complex sourcing projects end to end and support complex sourcing projects from start to finish. This will involve closely engaging with a diverse array of internal and external stakeholders to identify sourcing strategy that balances business needs, effort, and efficiencies.
- Independently own one or more sourcing (sub-)categories, including the assigned spend and savings targets for your portfolio
- Review spend data and market trends for key indirect spend categories
- Participate in cross-functional team meetings to align on sourcing priorities and requirements, influencing matrixed stakeholders across business units
- Conduct market research and prepare RFP documents for upcoming sourcing projects
- Manage the RFP process, evaluate proposals, negotiate commercial deal terms and contracts, including standard commercial legal terms, and create award recommendations
- Present supplier recommendations, negotiation outcomes, risk assessments, and sourcing results to leaders up to three levels above you
- Partner across regions and categories within Global Corporate Procurement to share best practices and align on sourcing approaches
- Contribute to the development of category management plans
- Provide procurement analytics and insights to support data-driven decision making
- Stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices in strategic sourcing


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you could be on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You might close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you will balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.

About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate and Facilities. We are a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. Your work will be visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, etc.)
- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing and category management in categories such as logistics, professional services, support or maintenance spend, supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience
- Experience managing spend categories that include three or more of the following: Logistics, IT Software, IT
- Services, Corporate Services, Marketing, Contingent labor, Facilities and Real estate, Capital Expenditure and Tail Spend (Indirect Categories)

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a non-mandated, indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience owning complex sourcing categories across multiple business units and/or regions
- Experience managing categories in markets with limited competition or limited pricing transparency, including proactive supplier risk management
- Experience leading transformational or cross-regional sourcing initiatives with global scope
- Experience advising and presenting sourcing strategy to senior executives and influencing C-level vendor relationships
- Experience contributing to annual or long-range operating plans
- Experience mentoring peers or coordinating sourcing work across a distributed team

title: Quality Manager, WW Consumables Private Brands
descriptionHtml:
The WW (World Wide) Consumables Private Brands (CPB) team is building a global portfolio of consumables products and is seeking an experienced Quality Manager to support end-to-end product lifecycle management. This role is responsible for ensuring product quality from early product development through mature assortment already launched in the marketplace.

Would you like to be part of an organization that is developing a pipeline of leaders in a growing, highly innovative, global business? Are you passionate about driving continuous improvement through the strategic application of the newest technologies? Are you curious about Amazon's Private Brands business and do you want to be part of it? If yes, the Amazon Private Brands team is the right fit for you.

This position will work with internal cross-functional stakeholders and external suppliers to develop and implement Amazon Private Brands' quality program. You will use customer insights to drive product development and improvement opportunities, assess product performance and quality attributes, ensure quality standards in manufacturing, develop and manage risk assessment plans, manage corrective actions, manage audits and supplier relationships, and develop SOPs and templates. You will manage quality programs in conjunction with Food Safety and Compliance teams, Product Development and Sourcing teams, and various other stakeholders.

Your role will also involve optimizing our global supplier quality management program and building manufacturing excellence, as well as designing and implementing scalable Quality Assurance solutions in collaboration with Product Development, Sourcing, and Tech teams. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply AI solutions to monitor, evaluate, and improve supplier quality performance to ensure the highest quality products for our customers.

This role requires expertise in consumer-packaged goods manufacturing, strong organizational and communication skills (verbal and written), a solution-oriented mindset, a high bar for quality, a clear focus on customer needs, and a track record of operating in a dynamic environment. A successful candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, has strong attention to detail, can operate autonomously, is motivated by a fast-paced environment, and has the capacity to invent and simplify their ways of working through the use of AI tools.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
-Own end-to-end product quality from a customer perspective, from concept to launch, developing new products and improving existing products to meet customers' expectations
-Partner closely with suppliers to influence product quality and ensure an optimized selection of new products that customers love, based on product assessment against technical documentation and customer preferences
-Drive manufacturing excellence through data-driven approaches to identify quality trends, predict potential issues, and implement preventive measures across supplier networks
-Maintain product quality metrics for assigned assortment in alignment with APB Quality goals, including technical product and packaging specifications, tolerances, and quality testing plans
-Write, maintain, and update SOPs to develop quality assurance programs; design and operate scalable quality management programs and drive continuous improvement across different business models
-Work with suppliers to ensure adherence to GMP requirements, Factory Quality Audits, CAP development, implementation and closure, product specifications, finished product production approval, product traceability, ongoing supplier quality programs, and continuous product improvement
-Ensure products continuously comply with Amazon's quality, performance, and reliability requirements, as well as industry safety and regulatory requirements worldwide
-Develop and audit processes and tools to ensure supplier compliance to internal (Amazon) and external (Regulatory) standards and requirements
-Establish, manage, and monitor key performance metrics for suppliers, internal stakeholders, and Amazon customers; manage supplier performance proactively to ensure consistent quality of finished products
-Manage and coach strategic suppliers to improve quality management systems, manufacturing processes, and customer satisfaction; utilize AI-powered analytics to provide data-driven recommendations for improvement
-Manage corrective actions with suppliers in response to customer review feedback and concessions, and manage product improvement activities post-launch
-Communicate technical, quality, and process requirements effectively to non-technical stakeholders through data visualization and analytical insights
-Collaborate with other members of the WW Amazon Private Brands team, including other Quality Managers, Category Managers, Product Managers, Instock Managers, Packaging Managers, Sustainability Managers, Compliance, Safety, Food Safety, Legal, and all relevant stakeholders involved in supporting project timeline deliverables

The WW Consumables Private Brands team is a growing, highly innovative, global organization developing a pipeline of leaders who are passionate about delivering the highest quality consumables products to Amazon customers. We operate across multiple countries with a highly diverse group of colleagues, united by a shared commitment to customer obsession and continuous improvement.

Our team thrives in a highly collaborative, analytical, creative, and fast-paced environment. We have a strong inclination to get things done and deliver scalable results at speed. We work cross-functionally with Product Development, Sourcing, Food Safety and Compliance, Tech, and other teams to build and maintain a world-class quality program. We are committed to leveraging the newest technologies—including AI and data-driven analytics—to optimize our supplier quality management programs and build manufacturing excellence across our global supply chain.

title: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Tech - Security and Growth , AWS Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to decide where a fast-growing business places its next marketing bet — and prove whether it paid off? Enterprise security is one of the fastest-growing areas at Amazon Web Services (AWS), and it is a place where we form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and learn quickly what works and what does not. In this role you own the analysis behind those decisions: you measure how our marketing initiatives perform, diagnose which ones are moving the business, and recommend where we should invest to get the greatest return.

You pull together signals from customer research, campaign and web data, and product usage to build a data-based view of what is working, and then partner with product management, finance, go-to-market, and sales teams to pressure-test that view and turn it into a recommendation: where to double down, where to stop, what to test next, and what net-new initiatives we should design and launch. You move between deep analysis and initiative design, turning data and customer insight into a point of view that shapes how we grow. If you thrive at the intersection of marketing, data, and technology and want to shape how AWS grows its security business, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
Partner with product management and go-to-market teams to develop portfolio-level strategy and guide prioritization of marketing investment across the security and observability portfolio.

Measure how marketing initiatives perform, and diagnose which ones are driving pipeline, awareness, and revenue.

Analyze and synthesize data from multiple sources, including direct customer feedback, to identify what is working, where to invest for the greatest return, and where to stop.

Design experiments and measurement plans that test marketing hypotheses, and validate those hypotheses through customer research and direct customer engagement.

Partner with our technical PMMs to turn your insights into positioning and messaging that clearly articulates the value of the portfolio to customers and helps drive demand.

Partner with engineering, finance, go-to-market, and sales teams to build a shared view of what is working and what is not, and translate it into growth plans and recommendations for leaders.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 5+ years of direct experience working with customers on cloud technology adoption OR 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud architectures in technical domains
- Demonstrated experience creating technical content and delivering technical presentations to diverse audiences

- MBA, or Master's degree
- Experience developing go-to-market strategies for technical products
- Track record of creating compelling technical demonstrations and reference architectures
- Strong data analysis skills with ability to synthesize insights from multiple source
- Experience presenting to executive-level audiences and industry analysts

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager (Indirect), Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings daily. As we rapidly become the world's largest consumer of corporate services in many categories, the Corporate Strategic Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join our team. This role is uniquely positioned at the nexus of business units across Amazon, and offers singular vision into a broad spectrum of cross-company initiatives and strategies on a global scale. Using this unique insight, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will build and lead sourcing engagements for both existing and newly emerging categories of spend, as well as negotiate multi-faceted partnership agreements for Amazon's high-growth businesses worldwide. Strategic Sourcing Managers own complex categories across multiple business units and regions, often in markets with limited competition and pricing transparency, and lead transformational sourcing initiatives with global scope. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments, and have a strong bias for decisionmaking rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence C-level vendor relationships by advising senior Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business unit and corporate goals, and they raise the bar for sourcing peers across the global team. Successful candidates must work well in a fast-paced and often ambiguous arena, and will be rewarded by working alongside highly collaborative and entrepreneurial colleagues in an environment that feels much more "startup" than "big company". Spend categories under management include indirect categories such as Logistics, Technology, such as Software, Hardware, Data Purchase, Telecommunication, Cybersecurity, among others. If you are an experienced sourcing professional with a passion for serving customers and for driving change and impact on a global scale, then we would love to talk with you.

Key job responsibilities
- Owning one or more complex (sub-)categories across multiple business units and/or regions, developing and executing (sub-)category strategies
- Developing global sourcing strategies to deliver against business objectives for internal clients, and achieving sustainable relationships with suppliers.
- Managing categories in markets with limited competition and limited pricing transparency, proactively identifying and mitigating supplier, commercial, and ESG risk.
- Evaluating supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and bench-marking analysis.
- Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities, including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
- Leading transformational sourcing projects with complex, global scope, coordinating work across team members and regions.
- Working with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership, and value creation beyond cost savings.
- Presenting sourcing strategies, recommendations, and decisions to senior leaders up to three levels above you.
- Contributing inputs to annual and long-range operating plans (OP1, OP2, and three-year forecast).
- Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement processes and maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Amazon's global policies.
- Preparing and holding business reviews with stakeholders to review vendor performance, future opportunities, and/or challenges.
- Mentoring and sharing best practices with sourcing peers across the global team.


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you're on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You'll close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you'll balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.





About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate & Facilities. We're a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. You'll be joining a team where your work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in an indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience with practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, etc.)
- 2+ years of relevant strategic sourcing and category management in categories such as logistics, IT, professional services, support or maintenance spend, supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a non-mandated, indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience owning complex sourcing categories across multiple business units and/or regions
- Experience managing categories in markets with limited competition or limited pricing transparency, including proactive supplier risk management
- Experience leading transformational or cross-regional sourcing initiatives with global scope
- Experience advising and presenting sourcing strategy to senior executives and influencing C-level vendor relationships
- Experience contributing to annual or long-range operating plans
- Experience mentoring peers or coordinating sourcing work across a distributed team

title: Water Infrastructure Engineer, AWS Water Team (ADC)
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a results-oriented individual to join the Water Infrastructure Team (ADC). In this role, you will execute water-based cooling infrastructure projects in the US East region, working with internal teams—including real estate, engineering, construction, commissioning, and operations—as well as external partners such as engineering consultants, general contractors, water treatment vendors, and local utilities. You will drive feasibility, design, and delivery of infrastructure projects that meet regulatory standards and a high bar for operational efficiency, reliability, and safety at the lowest possible cost.

You will manage the delivery of multiple concurrent projects, monitor operational efficiency metrics, and build system resiliency for handoff to regional operations teams. You will also serve as the central point of contact for all matters related to water and wastewater treatment and disinfection systems, and for maintaining productive relationships with utility partners.

The ideal candidate brings a strong water infrastructure background, an understanding of data center water-based cooling systems, and an interest in innovation and sustainability in the water sector.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the planning, design, and execution of water and wastewater infrastructure projects that support water delivery to data centers
- Negotiate the terms and oversee the execution of utility system contracts and connection agreements related to domestic, fire, and cooling water supply and wastewater infrastructure
- Engineer, design, construct and monitor water treatment/operations projects and identify optimal design criteria for scaling projects to full-scale deployment across different regions in North America
- Manage projects that directly support water sustainability goals
- Work with internal teams to troubleshoot problems and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective Action (CA) for design and fleet deployed water systems
- Work with local water utilities to understand and coordinate site utility requirements, site inspections and compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes
- Track and manage reliability and maintenance of water systems, as well as the resiliency of sources of water supply required for data center cooling
- Work with Operations to monitor water consumption and develop resiliency plans for water supply sources
- Oversee support and testing/validation of systems during installation, operation, and maintenance of water treatment equipment and associated mechanical system.
- Interface with internal engineering, operations, real estate and environmental health and safety and legal teams to develop and implement solutions in rural areas that often lack adequate available water and wastewater infrastructure.
- Oversee maintenance, reliability and compliance of on-site water treatment and disinfection systems.
- Up to 20% travel as needed for project execution where authorized

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: Técnico de Mantenimiento, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME
descriptionHtml:
Ubicación: Parque Industrial León Bajío, Calle Oliver Evans 107, 109, 111 y 113, León 37680, Gto., México.
Horario: Disponibilidad para rolar turnos día, noche y fines de semana

Nuestra misión en Amazon es ser la empresa más centrada en el cliente de la Tierra, y nuestro galardonado equipo de Reliability Maintenance Engineering es una parte clave para lograr ese objetivo. Amazon es una de las marcas más reconocidas en el mundo porque distribuimos millones de productos a nuestros clientes. Hacer nuestro mejor esfuerzo por nuestros clientes es de donde obtenemos nuestra energía, y es por eso que encontrará que abordamos las cosas de manera diferente aquí.

El equipo de Ingeniería de Mantenimiento y Confiabilidad (RME) de Amazon es fundamental para nuestras operaciones: son ellos quienes mantienen la maquinaria vital en funcionamiento en todo momento. Como técnico de RME, mantendrá una amplia gama de equipos y espacios de trabajo manteniendo al mismo tiempo las mejores prácticas de salud y seguridad. Ayudará a mantener seguros a sus colegas y evitará el tiempo de inactividad de la máquina. Nuestros técnicos de RME aumentan la disponibilidad y la calidad de nuestros equipos y también trabajan para mejorar el entorno operativo.

Key job responsibilities
- Tareas de mantenimiento proactivo y preventivo de una amplia gama de equipos de obra.
- Realizar reparaciones reactivas y diagnóstico de fallas en un centro de distribución en funcionamiento.
- Utilizar las herramientas más recientes para maximizar la efectividad del equipo.
- Mantener todas las políticas y prácticas de salud y seguridad.
- Apoyar el desarrollo y progresión de los aprendices en sitio.
- Trabajar en proyectos de mejora continua e implementar mejores prácticas en varios sitios en México.

A day in the life
Nuestros técnicos de RME están ubicados en el sitio para que puedan responder rápidamente a cualquier problema con la maquinaria. Llevará a cabo una serie de mantenimiento preventivo planificado en los equipos de nuestros sitios para garantizar que funcionen de manera segura. Como técnico de RME, también responderá con prontitud a las averías, investigando, encontrando e implementando soluciones lo más rápido posible. También hará sugerencias para mejoras a largo plazo.

Trabajando junto a colegas más experimentados, llevará a cabo tareas de mantenimiento diarias y se comunicará con contratistas si necesita experiencia externa. Podrá trabajar en una variedad de turnos para garantizar que nuestros sitios tengan soporte las 24 horas del día, lo que permitirá a Amazon realizar entregas a la velocidad por la que somos conocidos.

About the team
Nuestro equipo de Ingeniería de Mantenimiento y Confiabilidad o RME mantiene nuestros equipos funcionando con su mejor rendimiento. Somos un equipo con mentalidad técnica, formado por excelentes jugadores de equipo y guiados por líderes experimentados. Trabajamos juntos para mantener, solucionar problemas y reparar equipos en nuestra red global de centros de distribución. Algunos de nuestros empleados son líderes que supervisan el equipo mientras trabajan en tecnologías interesantes, algunas de las cuales solo existen en Amazon.

Desde la instalación de sistemas de embalaje automatizados hasta la supervisión del mantenimiento general de un sitio web y la reparación de equipos de distribución clave, nuestro equipo maneja la mayoría de los aspectos técnicos de Amazon. Esto incluye mantener los edificios cumpliendo con la ley, garantizar que todos estén seguros y que nuestros sitios funcionen con la máxima eficiencia. Hay muchas oportunidades de progresión, tanto dentro del equipo de RME como en general en Amazon.

Trabajamos para reducir el tiempo de inactividad en los sitios de operaciones críticos de Amazon para que los clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo. Si identificamos una mejor manera de hacer algo, tenemos las habilidades y la oportunidad de desarrollar e introducir procesos completamente nuevos o tecnologías de vanguardia.

title: Database Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

As a Database Engineering Intern on the Amazon Redshift team, you will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced database and software engineers to solve challenging problems in cloud database technology. You will gain hands-on experience with database systems, data warehousing, performance analysis, automation, and distributed computing while contributing to projects that impact AWS customers.

Joining the Amazon Redshift team gives you the opportunity to:
• Work on a widely used cloud data warehouse product
• Learn about database internals, distributed systems, and data warehousing
• Work with experienced engineers and receive mentorship throughout your internship
• Gain hands-on experience analyzing database workloads and performance
• Develop software and automation tools that improve database engineering processes
• Solve real-world technical problems at cloud scale
• Learn how large-scale data systems are designed, tested, and optimized


Key job responsibilities
As a Database Engineering Intern, you will work with engineers and technical teams to learn and contribute to database engineering projects.

Depending on your experience and interests, you may:
• Assist with database design, data modeling, and SQL development
• Write and optimize SQL queries involving multiple tables and large datasets
• Analyze database workloads and help identify opportunities for performance improvements
• Participate in performance benchmarking and testing of database workloads
• Develop scripts and software tools to automate repetitive engineering tasks
• Learn about distributed database architectures, query processing, and database system internals
• Investigate technical issues and work with engineers to identify and evaluate potential solutions
• Participate in design discussions and technical reviews
• Document technical findings and communicate results clearly to team members

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field
