title: Solutions Architect III, Salesforce Account Team
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers solve complex technical challenges and shaping their technology strategy? At Amazon, we're looking for a Solutions Architect who thrives at the intersection of business and technology. In this role, you'll partner directly with customers to design and deliver cloud-based solutions that address real business needs — from reducing costs and mitigating risk to launching new products and transforming legacy platforms. You'll bring both technical depth and practical judgment to every engagement, working to understand each customer's unique context and crafting architectures that are secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-optimized. If you're a curious, collaborative problem-solver who wants to make a measurable impact on how organizations build for the future, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end AI/ML solutions by combining business understanding with deep technical expertise across the ML lifecycle, model training and fine-tuning, inference, and MLOps, ensuring architectures are extensible, secure, reliable, and cost-optimized while balancing short-term needs with long-term business outcomes. Guide customers on generative AI, foundation models, and classical ML, and help them select the right approach (e.g., prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, or custom model training) for their use case.

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer leadership, building relationships, understanding their data and technology challenges and industry context, and guiding their AI strategy through considered options and clear articulation of trade-offs, risks, and responsible-AI considerations such as governance, bias, security, and cost.

- Lead technical AI/ML solution discussions with customer teams, diving into model selection, data pipelines, training and inference architecture, evaluation, and best practices — proactively identifying high-risk or overly complex approaches (e.g., unnecessary model training, unscalable inference patterns) and engaging the right specialist and service-team resources when needed.

- Develop and deliver technical AI/ML content such as workshops, hands-on labs, presentations, blog posts, and reference architectures that educate customers on generative AI and ML strategy and best practices, applying your depth of experience to create reusable, high-quality artifacts that accelerate adoption.

- Collaborate with internal teams across sales, engineering, professional services, science, and product groups to accelerate AI/ML solution adoption, gather customer feedback on models and services, and translate it into clear requirements that improve the AI/ML product portfolio.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a deep-dive architecture review alongside a customer's engineering team, working through design decisions for a cloud migration or a new application platform. After lunch, you could be whiteboarding a proof of concept that demonstrates how to simplify a complex workflow, then jumping into a call with product engineers to share feedback you've gathered from recent customer engagements. You'll regularly create and refine technical content, mentor fellow architects, and contribute to patterns that help the broader team deliver better solutions.

About the team
Our Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to helping customers achieve their most ambitious technology goals. We work across industries and use cases, partnering closely with engineering, sales, and professional services to deliver solutions that create lasting business value. We're a collaborative group that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and creative problem-solving. If you're excited about working with customers to turn complex challenges into elegant solutions and want to grow your career alongside some of the most thoughtful technical minds at Amazon, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience with at least one major cloud platform and its AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, or equivalents).

Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Senior Construction Manager, Quick Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Quick Commerce team is revolutionizing the customer experience through sub-30-minute delivery by rapidly scaling a first-of-its-kind micro-fulfillment network across North America. We are seeking an experienced Senior Construction Manager to serve as a individual contributor responsible for the construction execution and delivery of a portfolio of complex projects.

This role is ideal for an experienced builder who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can independently drive projects through accelerated schedules, evolving requirements, and complex field conditions. The Senior Construction Manager will own construction execution from contractor procurement and mobilization through substantial completion, Certificate of Occupancy, turnover, and launch readiness.

The Senior Construction Manager will partner closely with Pre-Construction, Real Estate, Design, Launch, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and external consultants while directly managing General Contractors and vendors across multiple concurrent projects. This individual will be accountable for delivering projects safely, on schedule, within approved budgets, and to Amazon’s quality and operational standards.

Successful candidates bring deep experience in construction management, development, general contracting, architecture, engineering, or owner-side project delivery. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and field expertise with operational rigor, sound judgment, executive communication skills, and the ability to independently resolve complex construction challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Own construction execution across a portfolio of Quick Commerce tenant improvement and conversion projects from contractor award through substantial completion, Certificate of Occupancy, turnover, and launch.
- Manage General Contractors, vendors, and consultants, ensuring performance against scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety expectations.
- Lead construction RFPs, bid leveling, contractor selection, and GMP development; present budgets, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
- Establish and manage project budgets, schedules, scopes, and critical milestones in partnership with internal and external stakeholders.
- Serve as Amazon’s primary point of contact during construction, driving alignment across contractors, Design, Pre-Construction, Operations, Launch, landlords, and consultants.
- Monitor progress through site visits, OAC meetings, schedule reviews, and milestone tracking; proactively identify risks and drive mitigation and recovery plans.
- Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, unforeseen conditions, and schedule impacts while maintaining appropriate cost and schedule controls.
- Coordinate resolution of MEP, life safety, utility, permitting, inspection, and jurisdictional issues impacting project delivery.
- Lead project closeout, commissioning, punch list completion, documentation, and operational turnover.
- Drive continuous improvement and lessons learned to reduce costs, shorten timelines, improve quality, and standardize construction execution across the portfolio.

Travel up to 60%.

A day in the life
A typical day may start with reviewing construction schedules, budgets, and critical risks across several active projects, followed by OAC meetings with General Contractors, designers, and consultants. You’ll partner throughout the day with Pre-Construction, Design, Real Estate, Procurement, Launch, and Operations teams to resolve field conditions, RFIs, change orders, permitting challenges, and upcoming milestones. Site visits provide opportunities to validate progress, quality, safety, and operational readiness firsthand. You’ll work directly with contractors to remove roadblocks and develop recovery plans when needed, ensuring projects remain on track for turnover and launch for our Operations customers.

About the team
Amazon’s Quick Commerce Construction team is building the infrastructure behind a new way for customers to receive everyday essentials faster. Our mission is to deliver safe, high-quality spaces at speed while balancing cost, quality, and operational needs. We operate with a builder mentality: challenging traditional construction timelines, simplifying where possible, and developing solutions that can scale. Our culture values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and practical problem-solving. We work across disciplines to test new approaches, learn quickly, and continuously improve how we build. Ultimately, we are turning ambitious delivery concepts into physical spaces enabling a faster, more convenient customer experience.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of relevant discipline work, or 5+ years of construction or project management experience
- 5+ years of experience negotiating construction, procurement and labor contracts
- 5+ years of project management, real estate development, architecture/design experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Structural, Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
- 10+ years of construction or project management, or 10+ years of relevant discipline work experience

title: Sr.Software Dev Engineer, DDB Index and Search
descriptionHtml:
Senior Software Development Engineer, DynamoDB Search and Indexing


Amazon DynamoDB is looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help build two new initiatives: native vector, full-text, and hybrid search; and Krupa, which aims to provide strongly consistent global secondary indexes (GSIs). These initiatives expand how customers access operational data—from finding semantically relevant results to querying current data through alternate keys.

You will work on problems at the intersection of database internals, distributed systems, information retrieval, and consistency protocols. This role offers the opportunity to shape foundational architecture, write performance-critical software, and lead engineering work across multiple DynamoDB components.

Search introduces a new set of indexing and retrieval challenges. How do you organize high-dimensional vectors across a partitioned dataset? Combine approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval with selective attribute filters? Rank results that mix semantic similarity and keyword relevance? You will help build the infrastructure behind these capabilities, including vector and inverted indexes, distributed query execution, and hybrid ranking. Your designs will balance recall, relevance, latency, freshness, and cost while the underlying data changes continuously.

Krupa addresses a different foundational problem: strongly consistent access through GSIs. Asynchronous index propagation creates a gap between a successful table write and its visibility in an index. Closing that gap requires reasoning about updates across independently partitioned table and index data, concurrent operations, transaction interactions, and partial failures. You will help design and implement the mechanisms that preserve these guarantees through retries, recovery, and changes in partition ownership.

Across these initiatives, the engineering challenge extends through the entire index lifecycle. Indexes must be built over existing data while writes continue, maintained as workloads evolve, and recovered when machines fail. You will work closely with engineers across storage, replication, transactions, routing, and the control plane to make these capabilities correct, performant, and operable.

As an SDE III, you will own significant technical decisions and carry them through implementation, validation, launch, and production operation. You will lead designs spanning component boundaries, identify risks early, and create interfaces and implementation plans that enable other engineers to deliver independently. This is an opportunity to combine deep systems engineering with technical leadership on new DynamoDB capabilities.





Key job responsibilities

- Own architecture and implementation. Lead substantial work across search and indexing, translating ambiguous requirements into precise designs, working software, and measurable customer outcomes.
- Build vector and text retrieval infrastructure. Develop vector indexing, approximate nearest-neighbor search, inverted indexes, text analysis, and relevance scoring.
- Deliver distributed search execution.Design partition selection, query fan-out, filter execution, candidate retrieval, top-k merging, and hybrid ranking using techniques such as rank fusion or reranking.
- Develop strongly consistent indexing mechanisms. Design and implement coordination between table mutations and index visibility, including concurrent updates, index-key changes, retries, and failure recovery.
- Build the index lifecycle. Deliver online creation, backfill, incremental maintenance, compaction, rebalancing, and deletion while customer traffic continues.
- Make guarantees testable. Define correctness invariants and search-quality criteria; build concurrency tests, failure-injection scenarios, and benchmarks that expose architectural weaknesses.
- Optimize the complete system. Investigate CPU, memory, storage, and network bottlenecks; quantify tradeoffs among retrieval quality, coordination overhead, write amplification, throughput, and tail latency.
- Lead across teams. Resolve design questions with partner teams, define clear contracts, and drive changes that span storage, replication, transactions, and query processing.
- Raise engineering capability. Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and break complex work into independently deliverable pieces with clear testing and rollout plans.
- Own production outcomes. Build diagnostics and recovery mechanisms, participate in operations, and use production evidence to improve architecture and reliability.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience, or Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in computer science or equivalent
- Experience leading the design or architecture of distributed systems, databases, search infrastructure, storage engines, or comparable data platforms.
- Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and system performance.
- Experience leading technical work across multiple engineers or teams and mentoring other engineers.
- Experience taking complex systems through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- - Depth in one or more of the following areas:
- Vector search, approximate nearest-neighbor algorithms, full-text retrieval, or hybrid ranking.
- Secondary indexes, distributed transactions, replication, concurrency control, or consistency protocols.
- Storage engines, including logging, LSM trees, compaction, caching, snapshots, and recovery.
- Knowledge of vector-indexing approaches such as HNSW, IVF, clustering, or product quantization.
- Knowledge of inverted indexes, BM25, query planning, filtering, or distributed top-k retrieval.
- Experience with online backfills, partition splits, rebalancing, or recovery under concurrent writes.
- Experience with formal modeling, deterministic simulation, fault injection, or performance and retrieval-quality benchmarking.
- Experience developing systems software in Java, Rust, C++, or a comparable language.

title: Sr. Demand & S&OP Manager, PAC
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
The Power & Cooling (PAC) team is seeking a results-oriented individual with strong business judgement and experience working with internal and external stakeholders to own demand planning and the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process for Data Center Power & Cooling equipment. Our Demand & S&OP Managers are high-energy self-starters who are excited to work across functions to turn a volatile demand signal into a clean, executable plan that the rest of the supply chain can run on.
As a member of the Power and Cooling Supply Chain Management Team, this is an individual-contributor role that owns the demand signal end to end: verifying it, resolving anomalies with upstream teams, reading the patterns in it, and absorbing the volatile long-horizon work — the changes a year or more out — so the execution team does not have to. You will run the S&OP process as the organization’s orchestration layer, and act as the single point of truth for what the business actually needs, when it needs it. You do this through influence rather than authority, partnering across Design, Technical Infrastructure Program Managers (TIPMs), Global Category Managers (GCMs), and the Materials Managers who execute against your signal.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own projects through completion.


Key job responsibilities
• The Demand & S&OP Manager is an individual contributor who serves as the orchestrator of the demand signal for AWS data center Power & Cooling equipment. This role drives forecast accuracy, pattern detection, and cross-functional alignment so the execution team receives a clean, executable signal.
• Demand Planning and Forecasting — You will spearhead the development and maintenance of a rolling three-year forecast for Long Lead Equipment (LLE), collaborating with business partners to capture evolving requirements. This includes managing schedule changes, tracking design modifications, and validating net-new demand to maintain forecast accuracy, and coordinating with Design teams so equipment specifications align with construction timelines through a change-management process that achieves first-time-right implementations.
• S&OP Orchestration — You will run the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process as the organization’s nerve center, built on four pillars: demand changes and their impact, the supply position and its constraints, the inventory and storage position, and the operational patterns underneath. You will convert S&OP from a report-out forum into a true orchestration mechanism that reduces noise in the demand signal and drives cross-functional resolution.
• Pattern Detection and Signal Integrity — You will act as the gatekeeper of signal quality — distinguishing confirmed demand from speculative demand, catching anomalies and impossible date sequences before they propagate, and reading patterns across the operation so recurring issues are routed to the function that can fix them at the source.
• Risk Highlighting and Prioritization — You will serve as an early-warning system for demand-side risk, maintaining a dynamic view of where the plan and reality diverge. While Global Supply Chain Managers handle supplier negotiations, you will partner with them to highlight risk and support mitigation, and you will drive build-prioritization decisions as the key liaison to the business.
• Cross-Functional Alignment — You will align the PAC demand and S&OP cadence with the broader AWS S&OP cycle and bring Design, TIPMs, and GCMs into that rhythm, so our plan feeds — and is shaped by — the decisions made around us rather than arriving after they are set.
• Success in this role directly impacts AWS’s ability to deliver data centers on schedule, with performance measured by forecast accuracy, signal quality, and the reduction of downstream noise — rather than supplier negotiations and capacity management.

A day in the life
• Communicate ideas concisely to a wide variety of stakeholders, for purposes ranging from informative to securing approvals from executives.
• Embody a true pioneering spirit, willing to “get your hands dirty” in a start-up environment while simultaneously developing processes, automation, and delivering results.
• Clearly define data requirements and metrics, working with teams to implement the entire data flow from capture to presentation and management.
• Apply high attention to detail and a proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
• Continuously improve the demand and S&OP process, building the automation and standards that make it repeatable and teachable.


About the team
*Why AWS* Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
*Diverse Experiences* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
*Work/Life Balance* We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
*Inclusive Team Culture* Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
*Mentorship and Career Growth* We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program, project or product management, or leading product implementation experience
- 6+ years of related industry experience
- 8+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience
- 8+ years of high volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent
- Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
- Experience with Continuous Improvement and Six Sigma methodologies
- Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company
- Experience in program, project or product management, or leading product implementation

title: Site Operations Leader, OneMHS
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 2+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with performance metrics such as OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), downtime, throughput, or quality
- Experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments

• Manage inbound capacity from receiving through deployment stages

• Guide, train and educate staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
• Manage tasks and deliverables across small to large-size projects
• Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures to meet industry best practices and to meet required SLAs
• Provide weekly report to the data center manager
• Coordinate team resources to support project and delivery needs, to include emergency projects, change management and maintenance window support, and potential off-hours and on-call needs.
• Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
• Host weekly staff meetings
• Drive compliance to Amazon performance management requirements

The Infra Delivery Manager

• Oversee their development and growth of their team

• Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
• Installing and delivering our network equipment and related infrastructures to improve effectiveness through process innovation

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

What is fulfillment you ask? Fulfillment is how we refer to completing or fulfilling a customer’s Amazon.com order and the acts of picking, packing, shipping and delivering their order to meet or exceed their expectations!

title: Tax Program Manager, Foreign Reporting and Compliance
descriptionHtml:
The Tax Program Manager will lead transformational projects that shape how Amazon manages tax reporting and compliance across the globe. In this role, you'll bridge tax expertise, process innovation, and technology to solve complex challenges at scale, directly influencing how we operate in markets worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end project delivery for Foreign Reporting & Compliance initiatives—developing comprehensive project plans, tracking progress against milestones, managing dependencies, and communicating clear status updates to leadership and stakeholders.

Identify and drive process improvements across tax reporting and compliance workflows by analyzing current operations, establishing performance metrics, and implementing changes that streamline work and reduce cycle times.

Translate stakeholder needs into actionable specifications by gathering requirements from tax, accounting, and audit teams, documenting them clearly, and ensuring technology teams have what they need to execute effectively.

Evaluate and implement technology solutions that automate manual processes, enhance data accuracy, and improve operational efficiency across our tax and compliance functions.

Facilitate cross-functional collaboration as a subject matter expert on foreign reporting and compliance, bringing together sponsors, project owners, and operational teams to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and deliver results.


A day in the life
As a Tax Program Manager for our Foreign Reporting & Compliance team, you'll spend your time orchestrating initiatives that touch every corner of our tax operations. You might start your morning reviewing project timelines with stakeholders across tax, accounting, and audit, then shift into translating their compliance requirements into technical specifications that our technology partners can build against. You'll facilitate collaborative sessions where you help teams see how a new process or system solves real problems—reducing manual work, improving accuracy, or accelerating reporting cycles. Throughout the day, you'll move between strategic conversations with leadership about where we should focus next and hands-on work documenting solutions, managing dependencies, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. You'll also spend time identifying where we can do things better, smarter, or faster—then championing those improvements across teams.

About the team
We are a collaborative group focused on ensuring Amazon's tax reporting and compliance processes keep pace with our global growth. Our team works at the intersection of tax expertise, operational excellence, and technology innovation. We serve internal stakeholders across finance, accounting, and audit—and ultimately, we help Amazon operate responsibly and efficiently in every market we serve. We're building toward a future where our processes are more automated, our data is more reliable, and our teams can focus on strategic work rather than manual tasks. You'll be a key connector in this vision, helping us break down silos and create solutions that scale. We value people who bring curiosity, collaborative energy, and a genuine commitment to understanding the problems we're solving before jumping to answers.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of maintaining and operating transaction tax calculation software (e.g. Vertex) experience

title: Supply Chain Manager, WWGS - SCOPE (Supply Chain Optimization Planning & Execution)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS) SCOPE team is looking for a Supply Chain Manager to plan, execute, and continuously improve how inventory moves from Amazon's All Temperature Distribution Centers (ATDCs) to the customer-facing Amazon Now sites.

Amazon Now is an ultra-fast delivery service that brings fresh groceries and everyday household essentials to your doorstep in 30 minutes or less. You will partner across ATDC Inbound, Outbound, and Transportation, along with site operations, planning, and tech teams, to deliver inventory in full and on time at a competitive cost. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, makes sound data-driven judgments quickly, and keeps building depth in both the business and the technology behind it.

Key job responsibilities
- Own ATDC-to-spoke distribution performance across quality (OTIF, defects), cost, and capacity, and lead root-cause analysis when results slip.
- Work with inbound, outbound, and transportation leaders to align S&OP, labor, and carrier capacity plans, and flag risks early with clear mitigation plans.
- Escalate network constraints such as inbound gridlock, capacity shortfalls, or carrier gaps, and drive them to lasting fixes.
- Lead process improvements and automation that lower cost-to-serve and reduce manual intervention.
- Build scalable mechanisms and tech requirements so the network adapts to demand spikes, new business formats, and unexpected requirements.
- Deliver weekly and monthly business reviews that give leadership a clear view of performance, risks, and next steps.

About the team
Amazon Now is a new, fast-growing business delivering groceries and household essentials in 30 minutes or less. SCOPE (ATDC Inbound, Outbound, and Transportation) is scaling it through our All-Temp DCs and RANCH consolidation hubs. We're seeking a Supply Chain Manager to own successful inventory flow from ATDCs through RANCH to Amazon Now sites, driving our three-pronged focus: quality, efficiency, and scalability. The work is fast-paced and fun. You will set goals and metrics, build mechanisms, influence cross-functional partners, and automate manual processes as the network grows. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, makes data-driven trade-offs with senior leaders, and mentors others.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- 4+ years of supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience
- 4+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in business, engineering, operations, supply chain, transportation logistics
- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Knowledge of SQL at an intermediate level, including: compile queries, subqueries, aggregation/grouping, data modification, etc.

title: Manager, Program Management, Amazon Business Operations & EF Analytics
descriptionHtml:
AB IN addresses a massive $109 B B2B procurement opportunity, with the enterprise segment (CPS) representing $76B across ~100K customers—yet online penetration remains below 2% (expected to reach 5% by 2030). IN AB Operations is executing an ambitious 2026 plan to build India's most reliable and efficient B2B delivery network through targeted operational interventions: leveraging dedicated 3P B2B carriers for enterprise fulfillment, optimizing and scaling the AWIPL 3P FC network for B2B-specific selection, and enhancing core AMZL capabilities for commercial address deliveries. Without these foundational investments, AB cannot meet the differentiated service expectations that enterprise customers require. We are looking for an exceptional leaders who leads the Delivery experience for AB from Operations and also leads Analytics & AI charter for the broader External fulfillment org. This is a people manager role

Key job responsibilities
1. To partner with AB Business to define the right DEX and provide partnership as the Operations Leader for the same
2. To maintain engagement with partner teams, AB Ops has organized fortnightly internal reviews, MBRs with AB Business, and QBRs with INOPS and Business leaders.
3. Help find solutions for the unique DEX requirements for AB and champion the same across Operations team. Also tactically address day to day operation challenges faced by AB Business to protect CX
4. Lead the AI & Analytics charter for broader External fulfillment & 3P org and the lead the BA team.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 5+ years of team management experience
- 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

title: Technik BHP
descriptionHtml:
Bezpieczeństwo i dobrostan naszych pracowników to najwyższy priorytet w Amazon. Nasi Technicy BHP odgrywają kluczową rolę w jego zapewnianiu. To stanowisko jest szansą na rozpoczęcie kariery w dziedzinie bezpieczeństwa pracy i rozwój w międzynarodowej firmie. Będziesz ściśle współpracować z naszymi ekspertami, monitorując swój obiekt, dzięki czemu każdego dnia zobaczysz, jaką różnicę robisz dla dobrostanu ludzi.

Key job responsibilities
- Przeprowadzanie ocen ryzyka i audytów.
- Monitorowanie obiektu w celu zapewnienia zgodności procesów z procedurami bezpieczeństwa Amazon.
- Tworzenie i aktualizacja raportów dotyczących wskaźników bezpieczeństwa do przeglądu przez współpracowników.
- Współpraca z kolegami z działu Operations i całej firmy przy zadaniach związanych z bezpieczeństwem oraz doradztwo w zakresie procesów.
- Wsparcie we wdrażaniu nowych środków bezpieczeństwa.

A day in the life
Będziesz pracować w jednym z naszych obiektów. Oznacza to, że będziesz mógł/mogła ściśle śledzić to, co się dzieje, a pracownicy będą mogli łatwo zadawać Ci pytania podczas swoich zmian. Ta rola polega na identyfikowaniu potencjalnych problemów, zanim się pojawią. Będziesz poświęcać dużo czasu na sprawdzanie obiektu i poznawanie sposobu, w jaki ludzie korzystają ze sprzętu. Rozumiejąc, jak działa każde zadanie i każda maszyna, będziesz w stanie znaleźć najlepszy sposób na zapewnienie bezpieczeństwa procesów. Będziesz również jedną z osób wdrażających zmiany w zakresie bezpieczeństwa, co oznacza, że będziesz ściśle współpracować z wieloma osobami. Oprócz codziennych i tygodniowych zadań będziesz wspierać zespół Operations w doraźnych pracach związanych z bezpieczeństwem. Bezpieczeństwo jest niezwykle ważne w Amazon, a Ty pomożesz nam gromadzić kluczowe dane, które pozwalają nam kontrolować nasze procesy i wyprzedzać wszelkie problemy. Będziesz również dzielić się tymi danymi z pracownikami w całej firmie i współpracować z innymi zespołami, aby zapewnić, że bezpieczeństwo jest zawsze na pierwszym miejscu.

About the team
Zespół Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) odgrywa kluczową rolę w zapewnieniu dobrostanu psychicznego i fizycznego naszych pracowników. Nasz zespół współpracuje z kierownikami, pracownikami i lokalnymi władzami we wszystkich naszych obiektach, dbając o zgodność z politykami Amazon i przepisami prawnymi oraz zapewniając bezpieczeństwo naszych środowisk pracy. Zespół oferuje różnorodne możliwości — od Techników BHP po Kierowników Programów. Niezależnie od Twojego stanowiska, będziesz przyczyniać się do rozwoju i wdrażania strategii bezpieczeństwa w całej sieci.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie Technik BHP lub wyższe z zakresu BHP (zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Rady Ministrów Dz.U.1997.109.704).
- Odpowiednie doświadczenie w wykorzystywaniu analizy danych do generowania i objaśniania wskaźników.
- Znajomość polskiej legislacji w zakresie BHP.
- Biegła znajomość języka polskiego i podstawowa znajomość angielskiego (A2), w mowie i piśmie.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do aplikowania na stanowisko w Amazon. Jeśli posiadasz wszystkie powyższe kwalifikacje podstawowe, chętnie poznamy Twoją kandydaturę.
- Doświadczenie z metodologiami Lean, 5S lub Kaizen.
- Doświadczenie w planowaniu lub zarządzaniu inicjatywami proekologicznymi.
- Umiejętność pracy samodzielnej oraz w zespole.

title: Solutions Architect, Alps ISV
descriptionHtml:
This role is within the EMEA Independent Software Vendors (ISV) organization. You will be working with Software Vendors in Austria, in order to help them be successful on AWS, working backwards from their needs.

Solutions Architects work close to customers. They engage with organizations at all stages of their cloud adoption and are responsible for the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS. They make recommendations on architecture, security, cost, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with AWS technology.

Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos, and technical workshops.

They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams, and the AWS partner ecosystem.

In this role, you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. (e.g., Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Serverless, and Container-based architectures, Analytics and Big Data, DevOps or Security).

The Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a sound technical foundation and a desire to learn. You will have the support to grow your expertise in industry and technology areas of depth. Every day you will learn something new from your customers, your peers, and your experiments.

At Amazon, you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is suitable for the customer's long-term success. We value your passion for discovering, inventing, and building on behalf of customers.

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.


Key job responsibilities
• Help Austrian ISVs accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects, from architecture design to hands-on implementation. Recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes, and build alongside customers: prototypes, proofs of concept and production-ready code when it speeds up their journey. Agentic AI and SaaSification are key topics, as are containerization and adding innovative services to their solutions.
• Build technical relationships with customers and act as their trusted advisor, earning credibility by working hands-on with their engineering teams. The customer's best interests will shape the guidance you provide.
• Share the voice of the customer to inform the AWS feature roadmap.
• Help create and share best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g., white papers, code samples, open-source repositories, reusable assets, blog posts).
• Evangelize and educate about AWS technology (e.g., through hands-on workshops, hackathons, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
• Develop deep expertise in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customers' outcomes, including staying hands-on with the latest AWS services and AI-assisted development tools.

About the team
Our team is based in Switzerland and Austria, offering a dynamic and collaborative work environment in the heart of Europe. As part of a broader EMEA organization working with Software Vendors, we benefit from strong cross-regional synergies that foster knowledge sharing, diverse perspectives, and innovative approaches to our work. This structure provides exciting opportunities for team members to collaborate with colleagues across multiple geographies and engage in cross-border projects.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- Knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including modern Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI integration patterns or equivalent
- Fluent English

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Understanding of agentic AI frameworks and architectures, including autonomous agents and multi-agent orchestration
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Speaking German

title: Solutions Architect, Software & Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth, business acumen and strong interpersonal skills. You will engage with some of the world’s largest companies to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate their ability to innovation.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.


Key job responsibilities
As a trusted customer advocate, the Solutions Architect will work to understand their business needs and provide guidance and best practices on how to leverage cloud technologies to solve these with traditional or innovative solutions.

The ability to connect technology with measurable business value and help customers solve problems is critical to a solutions architect.

You will represent AWS in face-to-face meetings and own the overall technical relationship between AWS and the customer up to C-level.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Solid experience in design/implementation/management of complex distributed IT applications and infrastructure or database architectures
- Awareness of cloud computing benefits, concepts and principles; software development tools and methodologies
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across internal and external organizations
- Demonstrated ability to continuously adapt to new technologies and trends and learn new skills quickly
- Fluency in French and English

Preferred qualifications

- Technical degree; Computer Science, Engineering or Math background highly desired, or equivalent work experience
- History of successful technical sales consulting and architecture engagements with large-scale customers or enterprises
- Experience architecting, migrating or transforming customer solutions to the cloud
- Familiarity with SaaS workloads

title: Assistant·e RH, PXT (HR)
descriptionHtml:
L’une des nombreuses raisons pour lesquelles Amazon place la barre très haut en matière d’expérience client tient au fait que les RH veillent à ce que nous ayons la meilleure équipe derrière nous. Nous avons besoin d’une main-d’œuvre agile, afin d’avoir les bons talents en nombre suffisant pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients. En tant qu’ Associate Partner, PXT, vous aurez pour objectif de motiver nos collaborateurs·trices et de maintenir leur engagement en leur offrant une expérience enrichissante. En travaillant au sein d’une équipe, vous aurez l’occasion de partager des idées et d’apprendre des autres pour faire évoluer votre carrière.

Key job responsibilities
Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles et les responsables RH dans le déploiement de projets et d'initiatives stratégiques, en contribuant activement à l'engagement des collaborateurs et à l'amélioration continue de l'environnement de travail.

Assurer une gestion RH opérationnelle rigoureuse et réactive, en prenant en charge les processus d'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs, le suivi des temps de travail et des absences, ainsi que le traitement des demandes RH quotidiennes, tout en garantissant une expérience collaborateur de qualité.

Piloter et analyser les indicateurs de performance RH (KPIs) à travers les outils et tableaux de bord internes, identifier les tendances et les axes d'amélioration, et fournir des analyses pertinentes pour soutenir la prise de décision des équipes de management.

Déployer des initiatives favorisant l'engagement, le bien-être et l'expérience collaborateur, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, afin de renforcer la satisfaction et la qualité de vie au travail.

Garantir la conformité et la fiabilité des processus RH, en réalisant des audits réguliers, en identifiant les écarts et en mettant en œuvre des actions correctives, dans le respect des procédures internes, de la législation du travail et des exigences de protection des données.

A day in the life
Vous n’occuperez pas une fonction de bureau conventionnelle, mais travaillerez sur site au contact de nos équipes d’entreposage. En fonction de votre lieu d’affectation, vous travaillerez peut-être en rotation avec vos collègues Associate Partners Cela signifie qu’un membre de l’équipe RH est toujours à proximité pour répondre aux interrogations du personnel.
Le rôle de l'Associate Partner est très varié. En plus de nous aider à maîtriser les principaux processus RH, vous épaulerez les responsables de votre équipe dans différents projets visant à impliquer le personnel. Il peut s’agir de recueillir les commentaires des employé·es et d’organiser des activités pour les faire adhérer à de nouveaux plans. Vous pourriez, par exemple, avoir à recueillir les commentaires des équipes impliquées, organiser des activités pour les faire adhérer à de nouveaux projets ou participer à la création d’un environnement inclusif dans lequel les employé·es se sentent à l’aise pour poser toutes leurs questions relatives aux ressources humaines.

About the team
Le service RH joue un rôle essentiel dans le fonctionnement de l’entreprise et la gestion des collaborateurs·trices. Baptisée « équipe PXT » (People Experience and Technology Solutions), elle veille avant tout à la mise en place d’un environnement de travail exceptionnel pour que l’innovation, la satisfaction client et l’agilité continuent de faire rayonner Amazon partout dans le monde.
Nous adoptons une approche holistique, proactive et intégrée de la gestion du personnel. Notre équipe a « l’obsession de la satisfaction client ». Elle s’attache à résoudre rapidement les problèmes d’implication et de motivation des employé·es, afin que rien n’affecte l’expérience globale des employé·es et des clients. En définitive, notre travail consiste à veiller à la conformité d’Amazon aux normes RH les plus strictes et à faire progresser la stratégie et les objectifs d’Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Connaissance de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) dans un environnement professionnel
- Une expérience dans la communication avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris avec vos pairs et la direction
- Parfaite maîtrise du Français, à l’écrit et à l’oral, l'Anglais est préferable.
- Une expérience significative dans le domaine des ressources humaines, des relations avec les employé·es ou de la paie

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience dans le traitement des processus de nouvelles recrues et des tâches administratives
- Connaissances de base du droit du travail et des pratiques en matière de RH et de paie

title: シフトアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都府中市を予定しています。
入社後、数カ月間は他の事業所でトレーニング（出張ベース）をしていただく予定です。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. title: Category Manager, Global Procurement Organization (GPO)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Category Manager to join our Global Procurement Operations (GPO) CAPEX Category team within the Equipment, Mobility & Infrastructure (EMI) organization. In this role, you will own end-to-end category management for the Racking (Storage) subcategory across Europe and Latin America, supporting Amazon's fulfillment, sortation, and logistics network.

You will develop and execute sourcing strategies, drive cost savings, manage supplier relationships, and partner cross-functionally to deliver best-in-class storage solutions at optimal total cost of ownership. You will report to the Global Storage Category Leader and work closely with Engineering, Operations, Finance, and regional stakeholders to ensure procurement strategies are aligned with business priorities and network expansion plans.

Key job responsibilities
Category Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute regional category strategies for Racking across Europe and Latin America, including market analysis, spend segmentation, should-cost modelling, sourcing roadmaps, and supply chain optimisation.

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management: Lead competitive sourcing events (Requests for Proposal/Quote/Information), negotiate commercial terms, and execute contracts that deliver best value. Build and manage strategic supplier relationships — from vendor scouting and qualification through regular business reviews, performance tracking, and continuous improvement in cost, quality, delivery, and sustainability.

Cost Optimisation & Market Intelligence: Identify and deliver year-over-year cost savings through negotiation, value engineering, specification optimisation, demand management, and consolidation opportunities. Monitor industry trends, technology shifts, raw material dynamics (particularly steel), and supply market conditions to proactively inform category strategy.

Risk Management & Compliance: Proactively identify and mitigate supply chain risks including single/sole source dependencies, geopolitical exposure, and capacity constraints. Maintain catalogue accuracy, drive catalogue coverage improvements, and ensure supplier compliance with contractual obligations and Amazon's Supplier Code of Conduct.

Stakeholder Engagement & Process Improvement: Partner with Engineering, Safety, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and Operations stakeholders to align sourcing strategies with business requirements. Identify and implement process improvements across the procure-to-pay cycle; define and report on key metrics that measure effectiveness.

This role is open for candidates based in Luxembourg, Barcelona or London.

Bachelor's degree
Experience in strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, contract management, and financial analysis
Experience being responsible for and leading large, complex negotiations
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading process improvements and building scalable procurement processes

A day in the life

Lead supplier negotiations and business reviews, ensuring delivery against cost, quality, and timeline commitments.

title: Senior Tax Analyst in Indirect Tax and Impositions, Tax Engine Operations
descriptionHtml:
Ever wondered how tax gets calculated on hundreds of millions of transactions across dozens of countries, automatically, in real time? That's the Tax Engine. It's the system behind every tax calculation Amazon makes, and this role puts you right at the centre of it.

We're hiring a Tax Analyst for the Global Tax Engine Operations team in Bratislava, SK focused on regulatory fees and special impositions. Think eWaste levies, deposit return schemes, beverage container fees, and similar charges that vary wildly across jurisdictions. You won't just research these fees. You'll build the end-to-end calculation logic that makes them work at Amazon global scale.

This is not a traditional tax compliance role. You'll work with SQL, data analysis tools, and AI-powered classification models to turn complex legislation into automated, production-grade tax solutions. If you like the intersection of tax, data, and technology, this is it.


Key job responsibilities
- Own tax calculation end-to-end. From reading the legislation, through feasibility and accuracy analysis, to deploying automated calculations in the Tax Engine and monitoring them post-launch.
- Analyse transaction data, validate tax calculation accuracy, and identify gaps in fee coverage across jurisdictions.
- Use and help build AI solutions. You'll work with Amazon internal tools and generative AI tools. But you won't just be a user. You'll actively contribute to shaping how these tools are developed, tested, and improved for tax operations.
- Build and track success metrics. Define KPIs for deployed solutions and use data to drive continuous improvement.
- Identify new fee types and jurisdictions to expand coverage. Contribute directly to the team's product roadmap.
- Partner with Engineering, Legal, and Product teams to translate regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions.
- Drive process improvements. Automate repetitive workflows and propose better ways of working.


A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing a new state-level fee proposal, then pivot to use SQL to validate calculation accuracy on live transaction data. After lunch, you're testing a new AI-assisted product classification model with the engineering team. By end of day, you're presenting accuracy metrics to stakeholders and proposing next steps. The scope grows with you. The more you bring, the more you'll own.

About the team
Tax Engine Operations sits at the crossroads of tax, engineering, and data science. People who do well here tend to grow into roles that didn't exist when they started. You could move deeper into tax automation and AI strategy, lead a programme across multiple jurisdictions, or shift into product or technical programme management within Amazon's Tax Engine org. The space is evolving fast, and we need people who want to evolve with it. If you're someone who wants to shape how AI is applied to tax at scale, not just use it, this is a strong place to start.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Knowledge of general AI tools

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in international indirect tax planning and strong understanding of or practical experience with tax laws in other countries
- Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business or related field
- Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
- Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
