* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- A Bachelor's degree or International Equivalent, OR 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience, OR 6+ years of Military Experience

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager, Ring Business
descriptionHtml:
Ring's mission is to make neighborhoods safer, and businesses are an integral part of it. The Amazon Key and Ring teams empower customers to seamlessly manage access to their homes and businesses. We are looking for a results-driven Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own demand generation for Ring Business and build a repeatable engine that acquires new business customers at scale.

This is a builder's role. Business demand does not always exist, in many of our segments it has to be created. You will own the full demand funnel across both established and new channels, deciding where to invest, what to test, and what to scale. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset and a sprint-based approach: form a hypothesis, run a tightly-scoped test, read the data, and double down or kill it fast.

You will: i) own and execute the Ring Business demand generation strategy across the funnel; ii) stand up, test, and scale new acquisition channels; iii) run a rigorous test-and-learn operating cadence; and iv) deliver the reporting and insight that steers investment. As a senior individual contributor, you will set the plan, influence cross-functional partners, and be measured on business outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Own demand generation end-to-end: Build and execute the Ring Business demand gen strategy across the full funnel, from category awareness and consideration through to conversion, accountable for new business location growth and qualified lead/pipeline targets.

- Scale established channels: Drive performance across in-market channels (Amazon.com, Amazon Business, Search, paid media, retail), improving targeting, conversion, and cost per acquired location.

- Build new channels: Stand up, test, and scale emerging channels (LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, events, association and partner marketing, 3P-led / influencer content) to create demand where it does not yet exist.

- Run a test-and-learn cadence: Operate in sprints, define hypotheses and kill criteria, launch scoped experiments, read results quickly, and reallocate budget to what works.

- Develop and localize B2B materials:Create demand gen assets and adapt them to resonate across diverse markets and business segments (small vs. medium businesses), including EU localization.

- Lead market research: Plan and manage research initiatives (incl. EU) to uncover customer and category insight that sharpens targeting and messaging.

- Provide B2B reporting: Deliver weekly and quarterly business reviews (WBR & QBR), own the demand gen dashboard and KPIs, and translate performance into clear investment recommendations.

A day in the life
In this role you balance strategy with hands-on execution to drive B2B growth. You set the demand gen plan, then get into the detail of making it work. A day might include reviewing live campaign performance and reallocating spend, scoping the next channel test, briefing and localizing creative for EU markets, pressure-testing a targeting segment with the analytics team, and preparing the week's demand gen read-out for leadership. You work closely with sales, product, finance, and regional teams — and you are comfortable moving fast, making decisions with incomplete data, and owning the outcome.

About the team
The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 6+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

title: Sr. Manager, Global SMB Ads Marketing
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Manager, SMB Global Performance Marketing leads the worldwide first-party (1P) channel marketing team and content strategy for Amazon Ads' Small and Medium Business (SMB) segment. This leader owns two critical pillars: 1) Owned and operated ("1P") marketing channels (email, in-portal nudges across Seller/Vendor Central, Ad Console...), and 2) Click Credit promotions strategy and execution. The role spans demand programs (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Brand Stores, and others), as well as vertical programs for Amazon Business and Authors.

Rooted in a deep understanding of SMB advertiser needs, this leader acts as the strategic bridge between customers and the broader Ads organization—translating pain points, behaviors, and performance signals into lifecycle marketing strategies that drive long-term growth. By combining customer and performance insights with business objectives, this role shapes messaging, influences product direction, and ensures marketing efforts align to advertiser success across their lifecycle. Success is measured through business impact: advertiser activation, retention, and sustained revenue growth.

As the team evolves toward an AI-enabled operating model in 2027, this leader will guide the transition from static campaign execution to continuous iteration—where Marketing Demand Automation (DMA) anchors end-to-end advertiser journeys, and marketers shift from hands-on execution to active system stewardship. This includes guiding strategy, defining business requirements, interpreting advertiser sentiment, and continuously calibrating outcomes based on customer satisfaction, engagement, and business impact.

Key job responsibilities
1. Owned and Operated ("1P") Marketing Channels
- Define and execute the worldwide 1P channel marketing strategy across email and in-portal nudges, driving reach, engagement, and attributed revenue at scale.
- Own end-to-end advertiser growth domains—acquisition, optimization, growth, and retention—defining problem statements, shaping strategy, and owning performance outcomes across the full advertiser lifecycle.
- Design customer-centric, experience-led marketing around cohesive end-to-end advertiser journeys.
- In partnership with decision science and mar-tech, define content frameworks, value propositions, and modular messaging that power 1:1 personalized experiences at scale.
- Own demand generation and performance, managing trade-offs between volume, quality, and Return on Investment (ROI) to maximize total business impact.
- Drive deep dive analysis and continuous experimentation.
- Lead the transition toward Marketing Demand Automation as the anchor of the operating model, shaping increasingly precise inputs and content frameworks to unlock scaled variation, personalization, and performance over time.

2. Click Credit Promotions
- Own the worldwide promotions strategy, including offer design, experimentation, and performance measurement, operating promotions as a key lever within Marketing Demand Automation journeys.
- Define and optimize promotional offer structures that incentivize advertisers to take actions supporting long-term changed behaviors.
- Drive continuous experimentation on promotional targeting, timing, and value to maximize incremental revenue and advertiser activation while managing ROI trade-offs.
- Converge promotions into a unified system across targeting, journeys, and messaging strategy, ensuring promotional offers are integrated within lifecycle marketing rather than operating as standalone tactics.

3. Strategic Leadership and Team Development
- Lead and develop a high-performing team of marketers operating as single-threaded owners across their respective domains.
- Guide the team's evolution from content creation to curation, system design, and business impact as AI scales execution.
- Serve as the strategic bridge between SMB advertisers and the broader Ads organization.

Basic qualifications

15+ years of work experience, 5+ years of management experience of international teams in a fast moving environment, MBA

Preferred qualifications

Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
Strong knowledge of AI applications, interest of project simplification, scaling and automation

descriptionHtml:
Shape what comes next | Discover careers in Tech

At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.


What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.

Our SDE interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As a SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.

Applicants will be considered at all locations we host interns in the United States.

• Machine Learning • Query Processing and Optimization • Automated Reasoning • Prompt Engineering • Distributed Systems

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
• Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation
• Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.
• Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness, including for AI-generated code.
• Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
• Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output and when not to

title: Applied Science Manager
descriptionHtml:
Help authors around the world publish their books, reach readers, and get help when they need it. You'll build and lead our first science team in Bengaluru and shape the assistant authors turn to for answers and the models that keep the Books catalog trustworthy.

Key job responsibilities
- Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of applied scientists across levels, and set its practices for experimentation, evaluation, reviews, publishing, and patents
- Define the science strategy for how we help authors publish, grow, and succeed, balancing near-term launches with long-term bets
- Partner with engineering, product, and policy teams to take science from prototype to production and measure its impact on authors
- Write design and planning documents for your area, and present options, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leaders so they can decide
- Work closely with our scientists in the US to deliver faster for our authors and improve their experience with our services

About the team
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) lets anyone publish a book. We are the science organization for Amazon's Books business, now building our science teams in Bengaluru. Our team works in three connected areas: a support assistant that answers authors' questions from their own account data, in every language KDP supports; multimodal models that use book attributes to keep the catalog trustworthy and help authors reach the right readers; and fine-tuned models that power the assistant and catalog models with KDP expertise. We serve authors, from first-time writers to full-time publishers. We value safety before speed and shared foundations over one-off fixes. Scientists here get dedicated time for innovation, which can lead to patents and conference papers.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree, or PhD
- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- 6+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building large language model (LLM)-based agents or multimodal generative AI workflows, including tool use, planning, retrieval-augmented generation, or vision-language models
- Experience fine-tuning or post-training models, including with reinforcement learning
- Experience with natural language processing (NLP), statistics, data mining, or large-scale retrieval, embeddings, and ranking
- Experience evaluating generative AI systems, such as LLM-as-a-judge, human-calibrated audits, or online A/B testing
- Experience building a new team, including hiring across several levels
- Experience leading teams that deliver complex software systems to customers, including teams that use AI coding agents with safeguards such as automated tests and code review

title: Senior Process Engineer, NA SSD Network, Sub Same Day Process Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building the next generation software, hardware, and processes that will run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many millions of units of inventory, and ensure that customers get what they want faster than ever. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well.

We are constantly innovating in the ways we are automating and accelerating the delivery of products and packages which includes building custom hardware and applying robotics, autonomy, supply chain optimization, machine learning, manipulation, image processing, and real-time data processing using distributed systems.

Sub Same Day (SSD) Engineering is looking for a Senior Process Engineer with a strong delivery record and proven project management experience to own strategic and tactical, cross-functional operations and technology projects associated with (SSD) facilities.

As a Senior Process Engineer for Amazon, you will work with some of the most talented engineers in the design, development, and delivery of physical distribution systems around the globe.

You will lead initiatives and complex cross-functional projects or programs that focus on the building of new, the alteration of existing, and the closing of end-of-life material handling and technology systems. As a working leader, you are able to take the lead on the implementation and delivery of large system designs and advanced technology in ambiguous and complex problem spaces.

You integrate systems for safety, security, stability, and efficiency. You participate in the full system development life cycle, working within broadly defined parameters, including test plan execution and solution quality needs.

You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open collaborative environment. Amazon’s culture encourages innovation and expects engineers to take a high-level of ownership in solving complex problems.

If you are a leader with enhanced focus on Quality, strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication skills, an ability to influence business and technical leaders in a dynamic environment with the desire to contribute to Amazon's next generation fulfillment technology, this opportunity is for you.

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deploy systems that benefit millions of customers.

The ideal candidate will draw upon exemplary leadership skills, program and project management, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

The candidate should be open to new tasks, innovative, creative, self-directed and a great team player. Candidate should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and development teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

Travel expected between 30% and 50%.


Key job responsibilities
- Design Process: Develop new processes or modify existing ones, focusing on equipment, workflows, and material flow, select and specify equipment required for the process, ensuring it meets productivity goals and safety standards, analyze and optimize existing processes to identify areas for improvement to reduce waste, increase efficiency, and minimize costs.
- Ensure quality and safety: Develop and implement testing methods to ensure product standards, ensure processes adhere to safety regulations and standards, and investigate, resolve issues that may arise.
- Collaboration and Communication: partner/ collaborate with critical stakeholders ensuring safety, quality, and efficiency gains, effectively communicate technical information to stakeholders, including technical and non-technical audiences.
- Monitoring and Analysis: monitor process performance, collect and analyze data for further improvement, leverage data analysis techniques to understand process behavior, trends to make informed decisions.
- Utilize emerging technologies: leverage process simulation tools to model and analyses processes, research and implement new technologies to improve process efficiency and effectiveness.

A day in the life
As a Senior Process Engineer, you will work across organizations to find solutions for complex problems, innovating on behalf of our customers. You will be engaged in tactical and some strategic problem solving and decision-making. You will drive efforts, individually or in collaboration to optimize productivity, prioritizing high impact projects. Your strong communication skills will be required when you present documents and findings to senior leadership. Your experience in conducting root cause analysis, will help in implementation of long-term solutions. You will be traveling (50%) to sites to ensure practical outcomes match theoretical ones.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools

descriptionHtml:
The ABM Solutions & Implementation team within the AWS Global ABM Practice is chartered to define, build, deploy, govern, and enable the solutions that empower 200+ ABM practitioners globally to operate efficiently and at scale. We create, manage, and support the end-to-end delivery of ABM capabilities — from AI-powered technologies to process automation to content management — ensuring our marketers spend less time on manual execution and more time on strategic customer impact.
We are seeking an ABM Program Manager to own and scale the AI, data, and operational solutions that support our ABM community. This role sits at the intersection of marketing and technology: you will take complex, ambiguous problems and deliver AI-based solutions end-to-end — from problem definition through design, build, testing, and global rollout. You will act as the key partner between ABM stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors, translating strategic ABM objectives into scalable solutions.
This role combines strategic thinking with a builder mindset. You will not simply route requirements to a cross-functional support team — you will assess ABM requirements, and where a solution can be built using out-of-the-box AI tools (such as Amazon Quick, MCP integrations, and Asana), you will build it and enable ABMers to use these solutions effectively. Success means ABM practitioners have an integrated, easy-to-use set of AI-powered tools embedded in their daily workflow that adapt as their accounts evolve — delivered with rigor, field-tested adoption, and measurable impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the business lead for ABM AI, data, and operational solutions end-to-end — define the vision, program strategy, requirements, and success criteria for AI-based ABM solutions with limited guidance, operating in problem spaces where the solution is not yet defined.
• Design and build AI-powered tools and automation flows from problem definition through production — including customer journey engines, Quick Skill automations, MCP integrations across enterprise platforms (CRM, Highspot, Asana), and reactive signal-monitoring layers that keep solutions current as accounts evolve.
• Drive delivery and support of complex, cross-functional solutions — including design, AppSec compliance, build, user acceptance testing with field practitioners, documentation (SOPs and training guides), product demonstrations, and global rollout.
• Serve as the key partner between marketing stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors — translating business requirements into technical specifications, and communicating technical constraints back to marketing stakeholders.
• Drive AI enablement and adoption across a globally distributed practitioner community — assess AI maturity, build leveling frameworks, deploy Quick Skills tooling, and coach practitioners (e.g., via a Champions program) to scale adoption across all Geos.
• Spot risks and drive appropriate trade-offs — understand design approaches within the ABM technology domain (AI/ML frameworks, MCP integrations, data sources, agent orchestration, UI/UX) and ask the right questions to ensure sound decisions.
• Define, track, and report on program KPIs (adoption, usage volume, practitioner impact, time savings, delivery quality). Use data to identify bottlenecks, drive improvements, and inform investment decisions.
• Create new processes and mechanisms — AI solution generation workflows, orchestration patterns, coaching methodologies, and global rollout mechanisms — and optimize cross-team delivery across engineering and marketing organizations.
• Facilitate cross-functional decision-making forums with leaders, technical program managers, and vendors to secure resources, align priorities, and drive timely decisions. Present decisions and program status to senior leadership.
• Partner with the Martech team on ABM solution lifecycle management — contributing requirements and field-informed input to platform builds such as buying-group identification services, account planning platforms, and ABM experience products.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion

- Experience utilizing systems and tools involving email, web, analytics, and CRM (Marketo, Tableau, Salesforce, etc.) for targeting, segmentation, reporting for demand generation

This role will own the product vision, define the strategic roadmap, and drive end-to-end delivery of seller-facing experiences that directly impact seller adoption, retention, and operational success across three of Amazon’s fastest-growing marketplaces. You will be responsible for some of the highest-judgment product decisions within FBA’s emerging markets portfolio — decisions that shape how hundreds of thousands of sellers experience fulfillment and how Amazon grows its third-party marketplace in these geographies.

Fulfillment by Amazon is one of Amazon’s most important seller-facing programs, enabling third-party sellers to leverage Amazon’s world-class fulfillment network to delight end customers. The Seller Fulfillment Experience (SFX) team owns the seller journey, workflows, and interfaces that power this program — from shipment creation and inventory planning through performance optimization and product removal. We operate at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, logistics complexity, and seller experience, solving problems that require deep understanding of local nuance, operational constraints, and seller behavioral economics across emerging markets at different stages of maturity.

This role sits within the SFX product team and will own strategic product leadership across interconnected charter areas: (1) product strategy and roadmap definition; translating seller pain points, country opportunity analysis, and business priorities into a cohesive product vision that balances seller experience with operational and economic sustainability; (2) cross-functional delivery leadership; driving alignment across engineering, UX, data science, operations, and business teams to deliver complex, multi-component product experiences on ambitious timelines; and (3) organizational influence and thought leadership; shaping the broader FBA product direction through compelling narratives, data-driven recommendations, and active participation in leadership forums (WBRs, planning cycles, investment reviews).

As an ideal candidate, you are a strategic product leader who combines vision with execution discipline. You thrive in ambiguity and can translate complex, multi-geo challenges into clear product strategies and crisp leadership recommendations. You bring strong analytical skills with the ability to build business cases, evaluate trade-offs across multiple dimensions (seller experience, operational cost, marketplace growth), and drive data-informed decisions at scale. You are comfortable navigating contentious prioritization decisions across organizations with competing perspectives and partnering with engineering, finance, operations, and senior leadership to drive alignment. You think big about how product experiences can accelerate FBA growth in emerging markets while ensuring long-term sustainability, and you mentor and elevate the product managers around you.


Key job responsibilities
• Define and drive the product strategy for a major product area or multiple related product areas within FBA seller experience, setting multi-quarter roadmaps aligned with org vision
• Own complex, ambiguous problem spaces; frame problems, generate innovative solutions, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders and partner teams
• Write and present high-quality product narratives (PRFAQs, strategy docs, business cases) to VP/Director-level leadership, securing buy-in for significant investments
• Lead cross-functional product development efforts spanning engineering, UX, data science, operations, finance, and business teams across multiple geographies
• Establish and monitor key business metrics, building mechanisms to track product performance and identify opportunities at scale
• Drive a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision making; design experimentation frameworks that enable your team to validate assumptions rapidly
• Influence the broader organization’s product direction through thought leadership, best practices, and cross-pollination of ideas across teams
• Mentor and develop Product Managers; provide guidance on product strategy, stakeholder management, and career development
• Navigate geo-specific complexity (regulatory, operational, cultural) to ensure product strategies are adapted for emerging markets while maintaining global scalability
• Identify and drive operational improvements and automation opportunities that create leverage for the team and organization
• Represent your product area in leadership forums (WBRs, business reviews, planning cycles) and proactively escalate risks and trade-offs


A day in the life
As a Senior Product Manager on the SFX team, your morning might begin with reviewing a weekly business review (WBR) pack, identifying inflection points in seller adoption metrics across Brazil or Australia, and framing a narrative for leadership. You’ll lead a strategy session where you guide your team through a complex trade-off, balancing seller experience improvements against operational cost constraints, and land on a clear recommendation backed by data. Between meetings, you’re refining a PRFAQ for a net-new capability that could unlock seller growth in an underserved segment, incorporating feedback from the senior leader review earlier this week.

Afternoons include a cross-org design review where you challenge assumptions and elevate the quality of the proposed seller workflow, followed by coaching a junior PM through their first product narrative. You close the day with a quick sync with your engineering lead to unblock a critical launch dependency, ensuring your team maintains velocity. You thrive in ambiguity, connect dots across multiple workstreams, and consistently deliver products that move the needle for sellers and the business.

About the team
The FBA Seller Fulfillment Experience (SFX) team owns the seller journey and workflows that power Fulfillment by Amazon across emerging and growth countries: Brazil, Mexico, and Australia. We are responsible for making it easy, transparent, and rewarding for sellers to leverage Amazon’s world-class fulfillment network. Our mission is to remove friction from the seller journey, from listing creation and inventory management to shipment tracking and performance optimization, enabling sellers to grow their business while delighting end customers with fast, reliable delivery.

descriptionHtml:
We're enhancing the shopping experience on Amazon through the conversational capabilities of large language models, and we're looking for innovative professionals who are passionate about technology and customer experience. You'll have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to the industry while working alongside talented scientists, engineers, and technical program managers (TPMs) to create solutions that serve our customers.
If you're excited about collaborating with a dynamic team and contributing to this evolving field, we'd love to have you join us on this journey!

Key job responsibilities
We're looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer with expertise in back-end system and online service to architect, design, and develop agentic services and applications powered by large language model.
In this role, you will build expertise in online service architecture, API development, and distributed systems that power responsive agentic AI applications at scale. You'll get opportunities to develop service orchestration patterns, efficient agent frameworks, and real-time processing systems, partnering with engineers and scientists in a fast-paced environment to deliver exceptional user experiences. The charter of the Amazon Shopping Team is to improve shopping on Amazon using the conversational capabilities of large language models. We are working on an AI-first initiative to further improve the way we do search using large-scale foundation models. These foundation models are also used in downstream applications by various partner teams in Amazon Stores. Our goal is to build large language models (LLMs), which can empower conversational applications and facilitate online shopping.

- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

- Experience building or operating LLM-powered agent systems (tool use, ReAct loops, multi-step orchestration)
- Experience with agent evaluation frameworks — offline evaluation, LLM-as-Judge, composite scoring, or quality measurement at scale.

title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We're looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to Lead Optical Head Assembly production development.

As the lead Manufacturing Engineer for a Line Replaceable unit at Amazon Leo, you will be directly responsible for the production process development, introduction, improvement, & maintenance of a key module on our next generation spacecraft. You’ll be the leading technical voice for a team of manufacturing engineers working on the product, solving challenging technical problems associated with delivering an ultra-high-performing optical, electrical, and mechatronic module to space.

You will serve as a key lynchpin connection design/development, factory operations, quality engineering, program management, and more as you drive the manufacturing processes, we use from initial production introduction to full rate production. You will leverage your expertise in Manufacturing systems design to partner with development on the design of future iterations of the Optical Head Assembly and our associated production test systems & tooling.

You’ll solve complex industrial challenges associated with balancing production velocity, exceptional quality, and cost competitive production concepts while ensuring smooth technical execution of current production operations. You’ll be a key animating force in the increase in production capacity through vision & execution of capital investment for production scaling & automation.

Key job responsibilities
- Conceptualize, design, develop, and improve production processes (assembly, integration, test processes) through collaboration/leadership of a team of manufacturing engineers.
- Serve as primary technical interface to development team for Optical Head Assembly, participating as the lead technical voice from the factory in Design Reviews, key technical escalations, and new product development activities.
- Support operations team directly by being a high solving power engineer, capable of bringing multiple diverging technical perspectives together in high pressure escalation moments such as quality containments.
- Own the capacity increase roadmap for production including defining the relevant capital equipment required for rate increase and helping to lead the design, procurement, install, and qualification of new rate enabling equipment.


A day in the life
- 25% - On the shop floor, working with production teams to implement new processes, review & solve key technical blockers in production, performing production development testing, etc.
- 25% - Independent development work such as deep diving on available data sets to identify and implement key production improvement actions, acting on quality escapes by developing and implementing new quality control measures, developing & executing to existing roadmaps for capacity increase, process simplification, etc.
- 40% - Meeting settings, collaborating with others on topics such as new design introductions, production process change management, production solution finding reviews, etc.
- 10% - Mentorship settings with other engineers on the team, performing collaborative work & coaching to develop the team members skillsets, while ensuring common team execution to your technical vision

About the team
The Optical Inter-Satellite Link Production team is a multi-disciplinary organization responsible for all aspects of production of the key modules enabling satellite-to-satellite communication. The Manufacturing Engineering Team is the technical arm of this organization, with 50+ engineers from all disciplines collaborating on all aspects of technical development & execution in production. As a Lead Manufacturing Engineer, you will be the technical leader of a team of 6-10 manufacturing engineers.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of experience as a manufacturing engineer in discrete manufacturing
- Bachelor's degree or above in a Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Aerospace engineering

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of new product introduction experinece
- 4+ years of experience in regulated manufacturing environment (aerospace, medical devices, or pharmaceuticals)
- Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification
- Master of Business Administration, PMP certification, or practical Project Management Experience in industry

title: Sr Program Manager, Workplace Health & Safety, Central Programs Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Workplace Health & Safety’s (WHS) mission is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and well being. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking a Senior Program Manager for the WHS Central Programs Team (CPT) to lead safety projects from ideation through network deployment using the Project Bolster Framework. In this role, you will dive deep into operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build programs and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence operations to sustain a culture of safety.

This role requires you to operate effectively in ambiguous environments structuring complex problem spaces, defining project scope and success criteria, and building clear narratives when inputs are incomplete. You will own end-to-end project delivery across multiple Business Units (BUs) and geographies, managing concurrent workstreams through Proof of Concept, Pilot, and Network Deployment phases. The role demands strong execution rigor: managing vendor relationships, purchase orders, site deployments, and cross-functional dependencies against tight timelines.

You will influence without authority; earning trust with cross-functional partners including Operations, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT), Amazon Robotics (AR), Engineering Services, Global Procurement (GPO), and WHS field teams to drive alignment and secure resources. You will communicate proactively through written narratives, tollgate reviews, and stakeholder updates, translating data into actionable insights for audiences ranging from site-level associates to senior leadership.

A critical dimension of this role is process improvement. You will identify inefficiencies, document lessons learned, create mechanisms that the broader team adopts, and contribute to the continuous refinement of CPT's project management standards. You will use FMEA, process maps, value stream maps, and decision matrices to surface risks and drive evidence-based decisions.

This position requires travel up to 25%, when needed (and with appropriate health and safety conditions).

Key job responsibilities
• Own full project lifecycle from ideation through network deployment, including tollgate preparation, narrative development, entitlement submission, and project closure
• Develop and maintain project plans (waterfall gantt), deployment schedules, and vendor Scopes of Work with clear milestones and accountability
• Manage vendor relationships including 3PL labor coordination (3-5x/week cadence), material supplier engagement, Avetta compliance, and Coupa PO management
• Produce clear, data-backed written narratives for tollgate reviews, MBR/WBR read-outs, and escalation documents; anticipate questions and address them preemptively
• Identify and implement process improvements that reduce cycle time, eliminate rework, and create reusable playbooks for future deployments

About the team
The WHS Central Programs team is on a mission to engineer risk out of Amazon's operations. We are a ~160-person global team united by a single goal: delivering the highest-impact safety improvements in the network through smart capital investment and disciplined program execution.
We operate at the intersection of Operations, Engineering, and WHS, which means our work is technically complex, organizationally demanding, and deeply meaningful. Every dollar of capital we deploy, every engineering control we install, translates directly into safer outcomes for the associates who power Amazon's fulfillment network.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or Safety.

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

title: Sr. Industrial Hygienist, Worldwide Industrial Hygiene
descriptionHtml:
We are expanding our Industrial Hygiene team and need a talented professional to join our global field team to support our North America region. Are you a passionate leader who is practical, business focused and have strong skills in building trust? In this role, you will assess industrial hygiene risk, evaluate the control effectiveness, and educate stakeholders on industrial hygiene programs, risks and impacts. As the industrial hygiene subject matter expert to the field, you will support field-based projects, including designing exposure monitoring strategies. During and after impactful incidents, you will provide technical support for response, post incident investigation, and risk management. You will work collaboratively across matrixed organizations with Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Field Operations, WHS Program Managers, Operations, and Legal. Adaptability, persistence, and ability to influence are essential to success in this role. This role requires travel up to 25% of time.

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as cross-functional resource for industrial hygiene and provide expert level exposure assessment support to field operations
• Research background and historical multi-source information specific to topical areas using both internal data sources as well as with being actively aware of external trends
• Apply industrial hygiene principles into complex problems using modeling, data and other methods to eliminate or reduce risk of injury/illness
• Research and be familiar with applicable regulations.
• Support industrial hygiene requests from operations, including responding to incidents
• Provide support in incident investigations and action plan management related to industrial hygiene exposures
• Provide support to develop recommended exposure control strategies
• Lead or be involved in field-based projects addressing industrial hygiene risks
• Communicate effectively with operations, WHS leadership, legal, procurement, and finance
• Provide industrial hygiene support for new facilities and projects as part of design review
• Maintain subject matter expertise across the full range of industrial hygiene hazards

A day in the life
• Lead IH Programs: Support and advance industrial hygiene programs for business unit partners across multiple geographies and risk areas, providing expert guidance to field operations
• Manage Complex Risk Programs: Own the full lifecycle of cross-functional risk programs, from strategy development through implementation and continuous improvement
• Drive Risk Reduction: Define risk program objectives, support implementation of controls, and drive measurable improvements in your risk area (e.g., increased compliance, wider control adoption, automation)
• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with Workplace Health and Safety Field Operations, Environment, Operations, Disaster Recovery, Legal, and other stakeholders in a matrixed organization
• Influence & Execute: Work with internal and external legal teams, policy owners, and regulators to interpret laws, regulations, and business policies; oversee rollout of controls and audits
• Represent the Organization: Present risk management programs to internal partners, senior leaders, external audit firms, regulators, and potentially at industry association meetings
• Contribute to Strategic Planning: Support the strategic business planning process and own organizational goals related to your risk program
• Measure Impact: Define and track metrics that quantify program effectiveness and risk reduction

About the team
Worldwide Industrial Hygiene (WWIH) supports all Worldwide Amazon Stores (WWAS) business units (BUs) and regions focusing on physical, chemical, and biological health hazards that cause acute and long-term illnesses. Health hazards that impact associates: mold, noise, heat, cold, communicable disease, ionizing radiation (x-rays), non-ionizing radiation (UV, EMF, lasers), chemicals (ASINs, janitorial, manufacturing), pharmaceuticals, indoor/outdoor air quality, illumination, blood borne pathogen, and legionella. The team is comprised professionals that own specific hazard types (e.g. heat, noise) and control systems (e.g. ventilation). As well as professionals that build mechanisms to ensure conformance to industrial hygiene programs (e.g. training, data management systems). The Field team provides tactical support to WHS Field and Operations. Individuals work alone and collaboratively across all verticals depending on the business need. WWIH partners with the business to define risk tolerance, controls, and guide the business on compromises between competing priorities.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Hygiene, Environmental Health, Occupational Safety or related field
- Minimum of 8 years work experience in an environmental, health, and safety related field, with at least 4 years in industrial hygiene
- Working knowledge and experience with chemical safety, hazard communication, noise, thermal stress, and air quality
- Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience relevant experience working in an industrial, manufacturing, or warehouse environment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in technical support
- Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
- Master’s degree from an accredited US university, or international university of equivalent standard in Industrial Hygiene, Environmental Health, Occupational Safety, or related field

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory compliance problems in the field, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.
- Apply risk management methods such as waste compliance audits and site inspections to monitor compliance thresholds, test controls, and take corrective action when findings arise.
- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, including status reports, audit results, metrics, and project communications, so the right information reaches the right audience at the right time.
- Travel expected up to 50% of the time.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin by reviewing incoming risk-related requests and prioritizing your project tasks. You will spend time conducting audits or risk assessments, updating documentation, and coordinating with compliance operations and partner teams. Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- 2+ years of experience in environmental compliance, regulated waste management, or workplace risk investigations
- Experience interpreting and applying environmental regulations (RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules)
- Experience collecting and analyzing data to identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience managing a regulated waste program across multiple sites, including hazardous waste accumulation, manifesting, and disposal
- Hazardous waste certification such as RCRA or DOT (49 CFR) training, or 40-hour HAZWOPER
- Experience conducting site audits or inspections and tracking findings to closure
- Master's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

title: Data Center Technician , DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).


- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
- Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
- Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
- Improve effectiveness through process innovation

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting experience, or experience related IT
- 2+ years of computer layer 1/2 networking (including troubleshooting and repair) experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of network design, protocols and troubleshooting
- Knowledge of Linux/Unix Administration
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience in an IT-related field (e.g. computer science, network engineering, etc.)

title: Software Dev Engineer , Hub Tech
descriptionHtml:
We are Lockers team! We solve the problem of package delivery to customers. A lot of time Amazon customers have to go through hassles of coordinating delivery time with carriers and are not able to receive their packages. We solve this problem for them. We allow customer to get their package (and do their returns) when and where they want. In other words, we make the package delivery asynchronous in nature. Is that an important problem? Draw a comparison with how messaging solutions like AWS SQS / JMS are critical part of tech architecture, the same way we are becoming important to package delivery.

We've been established for over a decade, boasting a network of over 50,000 lockers globally across NA, EU, and the FE, facilitating the delivery of millions of packages monthly. Despite this, we continue to identify ourselves as a startup due to our operational style and scalability. Our key stakeholders and dependencies are centralized under unified leadership, enabling us to make swift decisions and execute rapidly. Over the past three years, we've successfully launched two new products. Presently, we're embarking on the development of the latest generation of lockers designed to accept packages from any carrier or retailer, with robust return capabilities. This ambitious endeavor aims to facilitate a tenfold scale-up within the next three years, aligning with our strategic goals. Additionally, we offer various customer-facing features and maintain direct integration with retailers.

If you are looking for an opportunity to solve deep technical problems and build innovative solutions in a fast paced environment working with smart, passionate software developers, this might be the role for you. As an SDE, you will develop a deep understanding of our business, work closely with development teams and own the architecture and end-to-end delivery of software components. In this role, you will:

* Collaborate with other team members and partner teams to investigate design approaches, participate in design reviews, prototype new technology, and develop both customer-facing and back-end services features.
* You will lead and coordinate design/implementation efforts, coordinating across multiple teams to develop optimal solutions.
* Work with modern web development technologies to improve customer workflows
* Write high-quality distributed system software
* Drive best practices and engineering excellence

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 1+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Product Manager, Delivery Experience Improvement (DXI)
descriptionHtml:
As Senior Product Manager for Middle Mile & Fulfillment, you will own the end-to-end customer experience across the Middle Mile network and drive defect identification and elimination across a focused set of high-impact opportunities. You will not be handed a tidy problem statement. We have more customer experience gaps than people to work them, and your first job is to find the ones that matter most: where defect volume is highest, where customer impact is greatest, and where Amazon has real leverage to act.

This role requires strong autonomy and a high tolerance for ambiguity. You will build relationships with operational and technical partners across the delivery network, develop a point of view on where to focus, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch -- authoring PRDs, defining product requirements, and holding the thread from upstream process failure to downstream customer outcome. Your work will directly contribute to CPU reduction at the S-Team level and will help define the Middle Mile KPI framework that does not yet fully exist.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end customer experience across the Middle Mile network

title: Loss Prevention Specialist, WWOS
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Specialists.

In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external parties (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards

A day in the life
As a Loss Prevention Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality.

You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters.

Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Sitting within the World Wide Security Operations organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:


• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation

Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in security and loss prevention
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with MS Office Professional Suite, including Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with physical security best practices which includes the application of physical security systems, investigation techniques and management of contract security guards
- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience working with data and leveraging analytics to make decisions
- Valid driver's license

title: Operations Manager (Middle Mile), Middle Mile, AMXL JP
descriptionHtml:
AMXL Middle Mile is seeking an Area Manager to support daily operations at an AMXL Sort Center in Japan. The role focuses on executing smooth inbound, sorting, and outbound operations while achieving key operational metrics such as safety, quality, throughput, and on-time departures.

The Area Manager will work alongside 3PL operations teams on the floor, communicate with 3PL partners to identify quality gaps, and support corrective actions to ensure compliance with operational standards. The role requires active collaboration with Fulfillment Centers, Delivery Stations, carrier partners, and internal teams to ensure shipments flow through the network efficiently.

Key responsibilities include floor-level execution and supervision, labor and equipment utilization tracking, operational metrics monitoring, and contributing to process improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and reduce defects. The role will also support capacity planning activities and help maintain operational stability as the AMXL Middle Mile network continues to expand.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

---

**職務概要 – エリアマネージャー（AMXL ミドルマイル・ソートセンター）**

AMXLミドルマイルでは、日本のAMXLソートセンターにおける日々のオペレーションを支える **エリアマネージャー** を募集しています。本ポジションでは、入荷・仕分け・出荷業務が円滑に実行されるよう現場をサポートし、安全性、品質、生産性、定時出荷などの主要なオペレーション指標の達成に貢献します。

エリアマネージャーは、3PLパートナーと現場で密に連携し、品質上の課題を特定・共有するとともに、3PLパートナーを通じた是正アクションを推進することで、運用基準の遵守を支援します。また、フルフィルメントセンター、デリバリーステーション、キャリアパートナー、社内チームと連携し、ネットワーク全体でのスムーズな貨物フローの実現に貢献します。

主な業務には、現場レベルでのオペレーションの稼働状況トラッキングならびに品質改善、生産性向上と不具合削減を目的としたプロセス改善活動への参画が含まれます。また、キャパシティプランニングのサポートを担い、拡大を続けるAMXLミドルマイルネットワークの安定運用維持に貢献します。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool、生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazonでは学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

・Department: AMZL
・Job: Program / Project Management

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, visit https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp

Key job responsibilities
-Monitor and control critical Cost to serve and performance metrics such as fill rates, on time arrivals, and touch points/shipments.
-Collaborate with the ROC, Stations, and EF/VFs to manage the ordering and cancellation of trucks, ensuring optimal resource utilization.
-Lead the activation of new connections as part of the expansion strategy.

-Implement strategies to minimize delays and optimize transit times across the network.

フィルレート、オンタイム到着率、タッチポイント／出荷数などの重要な Cost to Serve（サービス提供コスト）およびパフォーマンス指標 をモニタリングし、管理する。
ROC、各ステーション、EF/VFチームと連携 し、トラックの手配およびキャンセルを管理し、リソースの最適活用を確保する。
ネットワーク拡張戦略の一環として、新規接続（コネクション）の立ち上げをリードする。
追加接続の再開および停止の管理 を行い、ネットワークへの円滑な統合を確保する。
出荷の定時到着を確保 し、サービスレベル契約（SLA）を達成または上回るパフォーマンスを維持する。
ネットワーク全体での 遅延を最小化し、輸送リードタイムを最適化する戦略 を実行する。
通常運用（BAU）およびピーク期間に向けたキャパシティプランニング戦略を策定・実行する。
需要予測、ピーク期の計画、十分なキャパシティ確保のため、クロスファンクショナルチームと密に連携する。
オペレーション効率を向上させるためのプロセス改善*を特定し、実行する。
ステークホルダーと連携し、イノベーションの推進および物流ネットワークのパフォーマンス最適化を図る。
ネットワークのコスト削減と効率向上のためのプログラム施策やテクノロジー導入を支援し、新しい取り組みの円滑な導入に向けてステークホルダーと連携する。



A day in the life
A day in this role involves monitoring key performance metrics, coordinating with teams on truck scheduling, and ensuring sufficient capacity across lanes. You will work on short term plans on the activation of new connections, manage capacity planning. The role will require you to troubleshoot operational issues. Additionally, you'll strategize and implement new initiatives, optimize for cost and efficiency.
この役割では、主要なパフォーマンス指標をモニタリングし、トラックのスケジュール調整について各チームと連携しながら、各レーンにおいて十分なキャパシティが確保されていることを確認する業務を日々行います。

また、新規コネクションの立ち上げに関する短期的な計画の策定やキャパシティプランニングの管理にも取り組みます。オペレーション上の課題が発生した場合には、問題の特定とトラブルシューティングを行い、迅速な解決を図ります。

さらに、新しい施策の立案と実行を行いながら、ネットワーク全体のコスト最適化と運用効率の向上を推進します。

About the team
AMXL is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end Customer experience for heavy and bulky products. AMXL consolidates supply chain, tech, FC operations, transportation, delivery stations, and last mile delivery. We also provide special handling services such as Room of Choice delivery, Haul-Away and Installation/Assembly for select items.
We are a dynamic, fast-growing team dedicated to building and optimizing a robust logistics network. Our focus is on ensuring seamless, efficient transportation of large items, driving innovation, and continuously improving our processes to meet the evolving needs of our customers.

AMXLは、重量物および大型商品のエンドツーエンドの顧客体験を一貫して担うシングルスレッド型の組織です。AMXLは、サプライチェーン、テクノロジー、フルフィルメントセンター（FC）オペレーション、輸送、デリバリーステーション、そしてラストマイル配送までを統合して管理しています。

descriptionHtml:
Partner Development Manager - Technology Partnerships, AWS（ISV PDM）は、日本発および海外発のテクノロジーパートナー/独立系ソフトウェアベンダー（ISV）とのパートナーシップを構築し、両社を成功に導くビジネス開発担当者です。ISV PDMは、ソフトウェア/SaaSソリューションを持つテクノロジーパートナーに対して、クラウド・コンピューティングを活用したソリューションの構築、共同マーケティングや共同販売の推進、を含むGo-to-Market（GTM）活動を推進します。共同販売には、AWS Marketplaceを活用した拡販も含みます。担当するパートナーとそのAWS上で稼働するソリューションのSubject Matter Expertとなり、パートナー戦略とValue propositionsを深く理解し、GTMプログラムの作成を支援します。
ISV PDMはCustomer Facing Role となり、担当するパートナーの経営陣やチャンピオンおよびAWSの各関係者と連携し、新たなビジネスモデルやソリューション販売について戦略的に考え、行動することが求められます。日本発のパートナーであれば海外展開、海外発のパートナーであれば、その本社Leadershipと、日本でのビジネス展開を協議・推進する機会もあるため、ビジネスレベルの英語ができることが望ましいです。本Role は People Manager ではありません。

Key job responsibilities
・担当するテクノロジーパートナーの窓口として、経営層から担当者まで幅広く信頼関係を築き、パートナーシップ全体に責任を持っていただきます。
・パートナーと一緒に、どの市場・どのお客様に向けてどう売っていくかを考え、共同の事業計画を立てて実行します。
・AWS 営業と協力して新しい商談をつくり、パートナーと AWS が一緒に提案・販売する活動を、商談の発掘から受注まで進めます。
・AWS Marketplace を通じて、パートナーの製品がより多くのお客様に購入されるよう支援します（個別の価格・条件での販売や、販売代理店を通じた販売も含みます）。
・AWS の技術担当（パートナーソリューションアーキテクト）と協力し、パートナーの製品やサービスが AWS 上でより良く動き、他社と差別化できるよう支援します。生成AI を活用した機能づくりの支援も含みます。
・パートナーや AWS 営業と商談の状況を定期的に確認し、進まない原因を見つけて、社内の専門チームと協力して素早く解決します。
・AWS 営業にパートナー製品の強みや提案先を伝え、社内でパートナーを応援してくれる仲間を増やしていきます。
・イベントやキャンペーン、お客様向け説明会などを企画・実施し、AWS のパートナー制度や資金支援も活用しながら、パートナーの成長を後押しします。
・売上や商談数、AWS Marketplace での取引額などの数字を追いかけて報告し、データをもとに取り組みを改善します。
・パートナーの声を AWS 社内に届け、課題があれば関係チームに働きかけて、パートナーとお客様にとってより良い仕組みづくりにつなげます。

- 3+ years of business agreements development, negotiation and execution experience
- 3+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Japanese Fluency and Business level English
